223.name: 5.56x45mm '.223 Remington'
223.description: .223 Remington ammunition with 36gr JHP bullets.  The .223 round has been very popular with civilian shooters for almost a century, finding use in a wide variety of weapons.  It generates lower pressure than 5.56x45mm NATO leading to slightly decreased accuracy and recoil.

308.name: 7.62x51mm '.308 Winchester'
308.description: .308 Winchester ammunition with 168gr hollow point bullets.  The .308 round is one of the most popular hunting cartridges in the world due to its accuracy and power.

556.name: 5.56x45mm NATO M855A1
556.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition with a 62gr FMJ bullet containing a steel penetrator.  Its light weight, high accuracy, and manageable recoil lead to widespread use in the 20th century and it remains popular among militaries and civilians.

3006.name: .30-06 Springfield
3006.description: .30-06 Springfield rounds with 165gr soft point bullets.  The .30-06 cartridge has excellent accuracy, range, and stopping power making it popular with hunters and snipers for well over a century.

architect_cube.name: The Architect's Cube
architect_cube.description: This is a solid cube that is much heavier than its size suggests.  When you look at it, it pulls your gaze inward until you fall through the sky, showing you a top-down view of your position with the surroundings revealed.

radiation_triangle.name: The irradiation triangle
radiation_triangle.description: Who so ever dares to hold this triangle inside inventory when not underground shall gain 1 to 3 irradiation every 10 minutes.

onyx_eye.name: onyx eye
onyx_eye.description: A small, light gemstone made of an unknown pitch black material.  The gem's surface is lined with cracks, through which a blinding white light shines through.  Holding it gives you profound, indescribable perspective, as countless worlds along with your own flash before you, all somehow equally discernible.  However, you get the feeling you aren't the only one looking…

debug_active_relic_test.name: Cube of Shame
debug_active_relic_test.description: This is a debug-only item for testing relic properties, powered by batteries.  Turn it on to lose intelligence and perception, but gain clairvoyance.

use_action.msg: You inject yourself into the Cube of Shame.

debug_active_relic_test_on.name: Cube of Shame (on)
debug_active_relic_test_on.description: This is a debug-only item for testing relic properties, powered by batteries.  Drop it or turn it off to retrieve your mind.

use_action.msg: You extract yourself from the Cube of Shame.

RTG_coffee.name: radioisotope thermoelectric generator
RTG_coffee.description: Did your neighbors brag about their cool beta-decay powered nightlights?  Do them one better!  The CuppaTech 4 radioisotope thermoelectric generator is a three kilogram chunk of metal - mostly lead - with a slug of curium-244 encased within.  It is capable of generating somewhere between 100-150 Watts of thermal energy, although its electrical generation capacity is minimal at only 2 Watts.  Careful!  Curium is great at making heat, and also releases deadly gamma radiation.  Keep away from cellular life forms.

bot_EMP_hack.name: inactive EMP hack
bot_EMP_hack.description: This is an inactive EMP hack.  EMP hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains an EMP grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use or throw this item to reprogram and release the EMP hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The EMP hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the EMP hack; take cover!

bot_c4_hack.name: inactive C-4 hack
bot_c4_hack.description: This is an inactive C-4 hack.  C-4 hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains some C-4 and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use or throw this item to reprogram and activate the C-4 hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The C-4 hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the C-4 hack; take cover!

bot_flashbang_hack.name: inactive flashbang hack
bot_flashbang_hack.description: This is an inactive flashbang hack.  Flashbang hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a flashbang and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use or throw this item to reprogram and activate the flashbang hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The flashbang hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the flashbang hack; take cover!

bot_gasbomb_hack.name: inactive tear gas hack
bot_gasbomb_hack.description: This is an inactive tear gas hack.  Tear gas hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a tear gas canister and attacks by flying at its target and releasing tear gas.  Use or throw this item to reprogram and activate the tear gas hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The tear gas hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the tear gas hack; take cover!

bot_grenade_hack.name: inactive grenade hack
bot_grenade_hack.description: This is an inactive grenade hack.  Grenade hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use or throw this item to reprogram and activate the grenade hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The grenade hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the grenade hack; take cover!

bot_laserturret.name: inactive laser turret
bot_laserturret.description: This is an inactive laser turret.  Using this item involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its revolving laser cannons.  It requires sunlight in order to fire.

bot_manhack.name: inactive manhack
bot_manhack.description: This is an inactive manhack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  They are covered with whirring blades and attack by throwing themselves against their target.  Use or throw this item to reprogram and activate the manhack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The manhack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the manhack; it's hostile!

bot_mininuke_hack.name: inactive mininuke hack
bot_mininuke_hack.description: This is an inactive mininuke hack.  Many times as large as a normal manhack, a mininuke hack contains a mininuke and attack by flying at their target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the mininuke hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.  An inhumanly strong user could also deploy it remotely by throwing it, which might give you a head start if it's programmed incorrectly.

use_action.friendly_msg: The mininuke hack floats from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the mininuke hack.  Pray.

bot_turret_riot.name: inactive riot control turret
bot_turret_riot.description: This is an inactive riot control turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the 40x46mm M1006 sponge rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever beanbag rounds you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its riot control gun.

bot_secubot.name: inactive M16A4 TALON UGV
bot_secubot.description: This is an inactive TALON UGV equipped with an M16A4.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56x45mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56x45mm you do NOT want to give the robot) turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the UGV will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its rifle.

use_action.friendly_msg: The UGV beeps affirmatively and begins scanning for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the UGV and it trains its gun on you. RUN!

bot_talon_m202a1.name: inactive M202A1 TALON UGV
bot_talon_m202a1.description: This is an inactive TALON UGV equipped with an M202A1.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the M235 rockets in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever M235 rockets you do NOT want to give the robot) turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the UGV will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its M202A1.

use_action.friendly_msg: The UGV beeps affirmatively and begins scanning for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the UGV and it trains its gun on you. RUN!

bot_talon_m249.name: inactive M249 TALON UGV
bot_talon_m249.description: This is an inactive TALON UGV equipped with an M249.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56x45mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56x45mm you do NOT want to give the robot) turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the UGV will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its machine gun.

use_action.friendly_msg: The UGV beeps affirmatively and begins scanning for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the UGV and it trains its gun on you. RUN!

bot_nursebot.name: inactive nurse bot
bot_nursebot.description: This is an inactive nurse bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the nurse bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and assist you in surgeries.

use_action.friendly_msg: The nurse bot beeps affirmatively and awaits orders.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the nurse bot. It's looking at you funny.

bot_grocerybot.name: inactive grocery bot
bot_grocerybot.description: This is an inactive grocery bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the grocery bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you.

use_action.friendly_msg: The grocery bot beeps affirmatively and awaits orders.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the grocery bot. It's looking at you funny.

bot_grocerybot_busted.name: inactive busted grocery bot
bot_grocerybot_busted.description: This is an inactive grocery bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the grocery bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you.

use_action.friendly_msg: The grocery bot beeps affirmatively and awaits orders.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the grocery bot. It's looking at you funny.

bot_broken_cyborg.name: inactive broken cyborg
bot_broken_cyborg.description: This is a deactivated broken cyborg, the last shreds of its humanity still rotting away.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the cyborg will then follow you and attack enemies.  You monster.

use_action.friendly_msg: The broken cyborg rises to the sound of screeching metal and peers around for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: The broken cyborg lets out a howl of agony and attacks you!

bot_prototype_cyborg.name: inactive prototype cyborg
bot_prototype_cyborg.description: This is a deactivated prototype cyborg, glimpses of humanity can still be seen in its empty eyes.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the cyborg will then follow you and attack enemies.  You monster.

use_action.friendly_msg: The prototype cyborg rises to the sound of screeching metal and peers around for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: The prototype cyborg lets out a howl of agony and attacks you!

bot_copbot.name: inactive police bot
bot_copbot.description: This is an inactive police robot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the police bot will then identify you as law enforcement, roam around or follow you, and attempt to detain lawbreakers.

use_action.friendly_msg: The police bot rolls into action ready to pursue criminals.
use_action.hostile_msg: A siren howls and lights flash as the police bot prepares to arrest you!

bot_eyebot.name: inactive eyebot
bot_eyebot.description: This is an inactive eyebot.  Using this item involves turning it on and launching the UAV.  If programmed successfully the eyebot will then keep watch for intruders, marking targets that can be tracked if you possess a control laptop, military scouter, or similar equipment; or have a bionic infolink installed.  An inhumanly strong user could also deploy it remotely by throwing it.

use_action.friendly_msg: The eyebot hums and takes to the sky.
use_action.hostile_msg: The eyebot beeps disapprovingly and focuses its camera on your face. Say cheese!

bot_hazmatbot.name: inactive cleaner bot
bot_hazmatbot.description: This is an inactive cleaner bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the cleaner bot will respond to future commands.

use_action.friendly_msg: The cleaner bot emits a friendly beep and starts scrubbing.
use_action.hostile_msg: The cleaner bot plays an error sound, but starts cleaning anyway.

bot_haulerbot.name: inactive hauler bot
bot_haulerbot.description: This is an inactive hauler bot for commercial and military use, able to autonomously carry up to 180 kilograms (400 pounds).  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the hauler bot will respond to future commands, serving as a robotic packmule.

use_action.friendly_msg: The hauler bot unfolds its legs and stands up, awaiting commands.
use_action.hostile_msg: The hauler bot scrambles awkwardly onto all fours, ignoring you entirely.

bot_molebot.name: inactive miner bot
bot_molebot.description: This is an inactive mining robot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the miner bot will respond to future commands.

use_action.friendly_msg: The miner bot whirrs and tunnels into the ground.
use_action.hostile_msg: The miner bot spins out of control and lunges at you. Make way!

bot_riotbot.name: inactive riot control bot
bot_riotbot.description: This is an inactive riot control bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the robot will bring order and peace to the horde.

use_action.friendly_msg: The riot control bot rolls into action.
use_action.hostile_msg: The riot control bot gases you and approaches with a pair of handcuffs.

bot_skitterbot.name: inactive skitterbot
bot_skitterbot.description: This is an inactive skitterbot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the robot will race towards enemies and shock them.

use_action.friendly_msg: The skitterbot gives a quick bow and scurries away.
use_action.hostile_msg: The skitterbot darts around you and menacingly clicks its tazers.

bot_science_bot.name: inactive lab defense bot
bot_science_bot.description: This is an inactive experimental robot plundered from a science lab.  It resembles a human-sized spider and was designed to deploy manhacks.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the robot will race towards enemies and deploy a variety of experimental devices.

use_action.friendly_msg: The lab defense bot shudders briefly and skitters away.
use_action.hostile_msg: The lab defense bot raises its front legs and shines a multitude of colored lights in your face!

bot_turret_searchlight.name: inactive milspec searchlight
bot_turret_searchlight.description: This is an inactive military-grade automated searchlight.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the searchlight will then identify you as an ally, survey the area, and illuminate approaching hostiles.  Seems to have an unhealthy fascination with you.

use_action.friendly_msg: The searchlight flares up and establishes a perimeter.
use_action.hostile_msg: A bright light blinds you as the searchlight refuses to turn away from you.

bot_dispatch.name: inactive riot dispatch
bot_dispatch.description: An inactive Northrop Dispatch, guard model, serving as a mobile assembler and deployer of kamikaze manhacks for defense.  Activate it to place it onto the ground; due to a one-way switch triggered during deactivation, however, it will be nonaggressive, and serves only as a distraction.

use_action.friendly_msg: The dispatch whirrs onto its legs and searches for a target.
use_action.hostile_msg: The dispatch turns on you, whacking at you with its arms!

bot_dispatch_military.name: inactive military dispatch
bot_dispatch_military.description: An inactive Northrop Dispatch, military model, serving as a mobile assembler and deployer of lethal manhacks for combat situations.  Activate it to place it onto the ground; due to a one-way switch triggered during deactivation, however, it will be nonaggressive, and serves only as a distraction.

use_action.friendly_msg: The dispatch whirrs onto its legs and searches for a target.
use_action.hostile_msg: The dispatch turns on you, slashing at you with its arms!

bot_turret_light.name: inactive autonomous light turret
bot_turret_light.description: This is an inactive light turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 9x19mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 9x19mm you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its SMG.

bot_turret_medium.name: inactive autonomous medium milspec turret
bot_turret_medium.description: This is an inactive medium milspec turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56x45mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56x45mm rounds you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its gun.

bot_turret_longrange.name: inactive autonomous longrange milspec turret
bot_turret_longrange.description: This is an inactive longrange milspec turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 7.62x51mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 7.62x51mm rounds you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its gun.

bot_turret_antimateriel.name: inactive autonomous anti-materiel milspec turret
bot_turret_antimateriel.description: This is an inactive anti-material milspec turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded .50 BMG rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever .50 BMG rounds you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its gun.

bot_turret_mark19.name: inactive autonomous grenade launcher milspec turret
bot_turret_mark19.description: This is an inactive grenade launcher milspec turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 40x53mm grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 40x53mm grenades you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its grenade launcher.
bot_turret_mark19.name_plural: inactive autonomous grenade launcher milspec turrets

bot_mech_recon.name: inactive recon mech
bot_mech_recon.description: A pilotable RMES (Recon Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit) designed to be used in a scout-recon-sniper role, built for mobility with an integrated laser sniper rifle and advanced suite of optics.  This one has been deactivated for transport.  Using it will deploy and activate it, allowing you to pilot it if it's been successfully reprogrammed or unlocked by a previous operator.

use_action.friendly_msg: The X-03: 'Spectre' Recon Mech whirs into life and opens its restraints to accept a pilot.
use_action.hostile_msg: The X-03: 'Spectre' Recon Mech unfolds but remains unresponsive.

bot_mech_combat.name: inactive combat mech
bot_mech_combat.description: A pilotable CMES (Combat Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit) designed to be used in a fire support role and with an integrated gatling laser.  This one has been deactivated for transport.  Using it will deploy and activate it, allowing you to pilot it if it's been successfully reprogrammed or unlocked by a previous operator.

use_action.friendly_msg: The X-02: 'Grunt' Combat Mech whirs into life and opens its restraints to accept a pilot.
use_action.hostile_msg: The X-02: 'Grunt' Combat Mech unfolds but remains unresponsive.

bot_mech_lifter.name: inactive mech lifter
bot_mech_lifter.description: A pilotable LMES (Lifting Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit) designed for loading and unloading heavy material, and for limited combat support roles.  Lacks any integral weaponry, but the frame can support heavier firearms fired from the open cockpit.  This one has been deactivated for transport.  Using it will deploy and activate it, allowing you to pilot it if it's been successfully reprogrammed or unlocked by a previous operator.

use_action.friendly_msg: The X-01: 'Jack' Lifting Mech whirs into life and opens its restraints to accept a pilot.
use_action.hostile_msg: The X-01: 'Jack' Lifting Mech unfolds but remains unresponsive.

bot_tankbot.name: inactive tank drone
bot_tankbot.description: This is an inactive Beagle Mini-Tank UGV.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 rounds and 40mm cartridge grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the robot) and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tank drone will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.

use_action.friendly_msg: The tank drone rolls out and begins acquiring targets.
use_action.hostile_msg: The tank drone swivels its turret and aims directly at you.  Don your brown pants!

bot_chickenbot.name: inactive chicken walker
bot_chickenbot.description: This is an inactive chicken walker.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 rounds and 40mm cartridge grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the robot) and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the chicken walker will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.

use_action.friendly_msg: The chicken walker rises to its feet, sways away from you and begins surveying the area.
use_action.hostile_msg: The chicken walker whirrs and aims directly at you. Take cover!

bot_tripod.name: inactive tripod
bot_tripod.description: This is an inactive Honda Regnal.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, wondering how it fuels its flamethrower and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tribot will then identify you as an ally, roam around or follow you, and impale hostiles with its spiked cable weapons.

use_action.friendly_msg: The tribot rises to its feet and scans the area for contaminants.
use_action.hostile_msg: The tribot glowers down at you and ignites its flamethrower. Turns out you hate the smell of napalm.

ac_unit_item.name: air conditioner
ac_unit_item.description: A household AC unit, designed to be mounted in a window.

freezer.name: freezer
freezer.description: A large and heavy freezer, used in restaurants, megastores and other environments where you need a large volume of things frozen.

freezer_industrial.name: industrial freezer
freezer_industrial.description: An industrial freezer, the freezer's imposing big brother. It stops just short of being a commercial walk-in freezer, but has nearly as much capacity.

glass_fridge.name: glass refrigerator
glass_fridge.description: A glass refrigerator.  Used to display chilled goods in shops.

glass_freezer.name: glass freezer
glass_freezer.description: A glass freezer.  Used to display frozen goods in shops.

plut_generator_item.name: plutonium generator
plut_generator_item.description: A generator used on large ships or submarines.  Using a compact nuclear reactor, refined nuclear fuel is sealed within and configured to provide a constant low yield of power when properly installed.  It could be taken apart to reuse the minireactor for more energy-intensive applications, or installed in a local grid to continue providing a small but limitless source of electricity.

recycler_item.name: metal compactor
recycler_item.description: A hydraulic compactor that can accept items made of various metals, and press them into basic shapes, ready for further crafting.

clothes_hanger.name: clothes hanger
clothes_hanger.description: A plastic clothes hanger with a metal hook to hang something on a rail.

talking_doll.name: talking doll
talking_doll.description: This is a talking doll, meant for children.  Fortunately it still works, and you could unload the batteries out of it.

creepy_doll.name: talking doll
creepy_doll.description: This is a talking doll, meant for children.  Fortunately it still works, and you could unload the batteries out of it.

cash_card.name: cash card
cash_card.description: A yellow plastic card used to store money.  These became popular once the government officially moved to all electronic money.  It holds up to 2 million dollars.

robofac_test_data.name: prototype I/O recorder
robofac_test_data.description: This small transparent card was attached to the prototype robot's CPU.  It might contain the data the intercom spoke of.

gasdiscount_silver.name: silver gas discount card
gasdiscount_silver.description: This card gives you a little discount on the purchase of gasoline.

gasdiscount_gold.name: gold gas discount card
gasdiscount_gold.description: This card gives you a good discount on the purchase of gasoline.

gasdiscount_platinum.name: platinum gas discount card
gasdiscount_platinum.description: This card gives you a splendid discount on the purchase of gasoline.

plastic_jack_o_lantern.name: jack o'lantern
plastic_jack_o_lantern.description: This is a plastic lantern that is painted to look like a pumpkin with a face.  It has a candle inside it, that can be replaced when burnt down.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

use_action.msg: You light the candle in the jack o'lantern.

plastic_jack_o_lantern_lit.name: spooky jack o'lantern
plastic_jack_o_lantern_lit.description: There is a thick LED candle inside the pumpkin face.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  This candle is lit.  The face shifts.

use_action.msg: The candle winks out inside the lantern.

decorative_wreath.name: yule wreath
decorative_wreath.description: This decorative wreath can be deployed as furniture to decorate for the winter holidays.

l-stick.name: L-stick (off)
l-stick.description: Produced by the Light corporation, this stylish staff not only functions as a light source, but doubles as a light-weight weapon, due to the superalloy materials it is made of.  Due to proprietary efficiency improvements over standard light sources, the L-stick or light stick as it is commonly called, batteries last longer than other light sources.

use_action.msg: The L-stick(tm) lights up.

l-stick_on.name: L-stick (on)
l-stick_on.description: Produced by the Light corporation, this stylish staff not only functions as a light source, but doubles as a light-weight weapon, due to the superalloy materials it is made of.  Due to proprietary efficiency improvements over standard light sources, the L-stick or light stick as it is commonly called, batteries last longer than other light sources.  The staff is glowing brightly, which is slowly draining the batteries.

use_action.msg: The l-stick(tm)'s light fades away.

shock_staff.name: powered quarterstaff (off)
shock_staff.description: This is an ironshod quarterstaff that has a high-voltage stun gun built into the handle.  The stun gun is wired to the metal caps at either end of the staff, allowing you to zap a dangerous opponent with each strike.  It is currently off.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the staff crackles with electricity.

shock_staff_on.name: powered quarterstaff (on)
shock_staff_on.description: This is an ironshod quarterstaff that has a high-voltage stun gun built into the handle.  The stun gun is wired to the metal caps at either end of the staff, allowing you to zap a dangerous opponent with each strike.  It is currently on.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the staff turns off.

shocktonfa_off.name: tactical tonfa (off)
shocktonfa_off.description: This is a reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is hollowed out and is filled with capacitors and a battery compartment.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the tonfa, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.  It's currently turned off.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the tonfa crackles with electricity.

shocktonfa_on.name: tactical tonfa (on)
shocktonfa_on.description: This is a reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is hollowed out and is filled with capacitors and a battery compartment.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the tonfa, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.  It's currently turned on.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the tonfa turns off.

battletorch.name: battletorch
battletorch.description: This is sturdy wood bat, wrapped in gasoline-soaked rags and flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  Light it, and the ball game will REALLY heat up.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

use_action.msg: You light the battletorch.

battletorch_lit.name: battletorch (lit)
battletorch_lit.description: This is a sturdy wood bat, wrapped in gasoline-soaked rags and flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  It is burning brightly, and makes it much easier to see the baselines at night games (It also makes the umpire FAR more likely to call a ball instead of a strike).

use_action.msg: The battletorch is extinguished.

knife_butcher.name: butcher knife
knife_butcher.description: This is a sharp, heavy knife.  It makes a good melee weapon, and is an ideal item for butchering corpses.

knife_steak.name: steak knife
knife_steak.description: This is a sharp knife, designed for cutting meat.  It makes a poor melee weapon, but is decent at butchering corpses.

knife_paring.name: paring knife
knife_paring.description: This is a short-bladed knife with a sharp blade, made for fine controlled cuts to vegetables without using a cutting board.

knife_chef.name: chef knife
knife_chef.description: This is a long-bladed kitchen knife.  The blade is wider than the handle, giving room for the wielder's knuckles, and it has a characteristic curve for a fast rocking action for chopping vegetables.  It makes a good melee weapon, but the wide blade is unwieldy for butchering.

knife_carving.name: carving knife
knife_carving.description: This is a long-bladed kitchen knife with a thin, slightly curved blade for deftly slicing meat either in flat sheets or around the bone.  It would be a decent melee weapon, and excellent for butchery.

knife_bread.name: bread knife
knife_bread.description: This knife has quite a long blade with a scalloped edge for cutting bread.  It's not that sharp, but its length and heft mean it could do a bit of damage and cause some nasty tearing.

knife_vegetable_cleaver.name: vegetable cleaver
knife_vegetable_cleaver.description: This is a menacing looking knife with a broad, square shaped blade, curved for fast vegetable chopping.  Its heft and sharpness would make it a decent weapon as well, although not as good as a meat cleaver.

knife_meat_cleaver.name: meat cleaver
knife_meat_cleaver.description: This is a menacing looking knife with a broad, square shaped blade.  Its heft and sharpness would make it a very effective melee weapon, and an excellent butchering tool.

lobotomizer.name: lobotomizer
lobotomizer.description: This is a hand-forged collapsible tool that has two axe heads and sharp shovel-like tip on one end.  It can be used as a shovel, or you could chop some zombies with it instead.

resin_knife.name: resin shiv
resin_knife.description: a shattered fragment of alien resin, wrapped at one end to make a crude knife.  It's not very durable, but useful in a pinch.

tazer.name: tazer
tazer.description: This is a high-powered stun gun.  Use this item to attempt to electrocute an adjacent enemy, damaging and temporarily paralyzing them.  Because the shock can actually jump through the air, it is difficult to miss.

spear_spike.name: spike on a stick
spear_spike.description: A flimsy pole made of wood with a basic metal spike tied to it.  It's barely sharp, and crudely constructed, but it will keep the zombies out of arm's reach until you can find something better.

spear_knife.name: simple knife spear
spear_knife.description: A flimsy pole made of wood with a knife bound to the end.  It's long enough to slice from a distance, but the knife isn't that well attached.  You could take a bit more time to carefully split the shaft and attach the knife blade more permanently.

spear_knife_superior.name: knife spear
spear_knife_superior.description: A sturdy wooden pole that has been carefully split and reinforced.  At the split point, a sharp blade has been bolted into place and reinforced with layers of sturdy wrapped bindings.

spear_homemade_halfpike.name: homemade halfpike
spear_homemade_halfpike.description: A short do-it-yourself spear made out of a smooth wooden shaft with a metal spike seated and bound into place at its tip.  Its functional grip and decent construction makes it a usable, if not effective, weapon.

switchblade.name: switchblade
switchblade.description: This is a long and thin knife with a spring-loaded blade that rests inside the handle while not in use.

knife_folding.name: folding knife
knife_folding.description: This is a small folding knife, with a locking blade and a pocket clip.  Not as good a weapon as a solid fixed-blade knife, but better than a penknife.

knife_hunting.name: hunting knife
knife_hunting.description: Commonly used by hunters, this single-edge sheath knife is designed for cutting and skinning game rather than combat.

knife_swissarmy.name: Swiss Army knife
knife_swissarmy.description: An iconic pocket knife imported from Europe.  Its red plastic handle conceals many small tools.

makeshift_knife.name: makeshift knife
makeshift_knife.description: A knife consisting of a long, somewhat sharpened, spike and a tightly wrapped rag as a handle.  It makes a good melee weapon.

bone_knife.name: bone shiv
bone_knife.description: A femur or other bone, at least 30 cm long, which has been broken at one end and sharpened into a cutting tool.  Its jagged edge is serviceable but fragile.

machete_gimmick.name: machete multitool
machete_gimmick.description: A thin, wobbly steel blade with sawteeth on one side and a flat chisel tip for digging.  A jack of many trades and a master of none.

shock_foil.name: electrified foil (off)
shock_foil.description: The modifications made to this fencing foil may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired through the electronic scoring circuit to the tip.  Activate the switch to elecrocute your foes!

use_action.msg: You press a button and the foil crackles with electricity.

shock_foil_on.name: electrified foil (on)
shock_foil_on.description: The modifications made to this fencing foil may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired through the electronic scoring circuit to the tip.  It is currently turned on.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the foil turns off.

shock_epee.name: electrified épée
shock_epee.description: The modifications made to this fencing épée may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired through the electronic scoring circuit to the tip.  Activate the switch to electrocute your foes!

use_action.msg: You press a button and the epee crackles with electricity.

shock_epee_on.name: electrified epee (on)
shock_epee_on.description: The modifications made to this fencing épée may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired through the electronic scoring circuit to the tip.  It is currently turned on.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the epee turns off.

shock_sabre.name: electrified saber (off)
shock_sabre.description: The modifications made to this fencing saber may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired to the tip along the saber's groove.  Activate the switch to electrocute your foes!

use_action.msg: You press a button and the sabre crackles with electricity.

shock_sabre_on.name: electrified saber (on)
shock_sabre_on.description: The modifications made to this fencing saber may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired through the electronic scoring circuit to the tip.  It is currently turned on.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the foil crackles with electricity.

shock_rapier_off.name: electrified rapier (off)
shock_rapier_off.description: The modifications made to this rapier may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired to the tip along the saber's groove.  Activate the switch to electrocute your foes!

use_action.msg: You press a button and the rapier crackles with electricity.

shock_rapier_on.name: electrified rapier (on)
shock_rapier_on.description: The modifications made to this rapier may not be sporting, but they might give you an edge in this final competition.  Extra effort has been made to insulate the grip and a high voltage stun gun has been attached to the guard, wired through the electronic scoring circuit to the tip.  It is currently turned on.

use_action.msg: You press a button and the rapier turns off.

cs_lajatang_off.name: chainsaw lajatang (off)
cs_lajatang_off.description: A long wooden pole with chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  The product of either genius or insanity, but not both; the weight ensures that only someone both strong and very skilled could possibly hope to use it.

use_action.msg: You turn on the chainsaw lajatang.

cs_lajatang_on.name: chainsaw lajatang (on)
cs_lajatang_on.description: A long wooden pole with chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  They are currently on and draining gasoline; use this item to turn them off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the chainsaw lajatang.

ecs_lajatang_off.name: electric chainsaw lajatang (off)
ecs_lajatang_off.description: A long wooden pole with electric chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  The product of either genius or insanity, but not both; the weight ensures that only someone both strong and very skilled could possibly hope to use it.

use_action.msg: You turn on the chainsaw lajatang.

ecs_lajatang_on.name: electric chainsaw lajatang (on)
ecs_lajatang_on.description: A long wooden pole with electric chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  They are currently on and draining power; use this item to turn them off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the chainsaw lajatang.

combatsaw_off.name: combat chainsaw (off)
combatsaw_off.description: This is a chainsaw that has been lightened, tuned, and extensively modified to be a more effective weapon.  Unfortunately these modifications have rendered it much less effective as a woodcutting tool.

use_action.msg: You turn on the combat chainsaw.

combatsaw_on.name: combat chainsaw (on)
combatsaw_on.description: This combat chainsaw is on, and is continuously draining gasoline.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the combat chainsaw.

e_combatsaw_off.name: electric combat chainsaw (off)
e_combatsaw_off.description: This is an electric chainsaw that has been lightened, tuned, and extensively modified to be a more effective weapon.  Unfortunately these modifications have rendered it much less effective as a woodcutting tool.

use_action.msg: You turn on the combat chainsaw.

e_combatsaw_on.name: electric combat chainsaw (on)
e_combatsaw_on.description: This electric combat chainsaw is on, and is continuously draining power.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the combat chainsaw.

knife_heat.name: thermoblade
knife_heat.description: This is a knife or dagger with an aftermarket modification to heat the blade.  The makeshift atomic battery means it will effectively never run out of power, but it can irradiate the wielder when damaged.

shishkebab_off.name: shishkebab (off)
shishkebab_off.description: This is a large blade with a fuel pipe on the side, and a small tank and igniter built into the insulated hilt.  When filled with gasoline, the blade can be made scorching hot to singe enemies and light your way.  Use to ignite.

use_action.success_message: A burst of flame roars to life, crawling along the blade.
use_action.failure_message: The igniter clicks, but nothing catches.
use_action.lacks_fuel_message: You hear a sputter—it's dry. No fuel left.

shishkebab_on.name: shishkebab (on)
shishkebab_on.description: This is a large blade with a fuel pipe on the side, and a small tank and igniter built into the insulated hilt.  The blade is glowing brightly.  Use to shut off the gas.

use_action.noise_message: The shishkebab crackles as flames whip along its edge.
use_action.auto_extinguish_message: The flame sputters, then dies with a faint hiss.
use_action.voluntary_extinguish_message: You shut it down. The flame gutters out.
use_action.charges_extinguish_message: The fuel runs dry. The flame gutters and dies in an instant.
use_action.water_extinguish_message: Your shishkebab hisses in the water and goes out.

firekatana_off.name: Rising Sun
firekatana_off.description: This is a katana with a nozzle just behind the cutting edge of the blade.  People love fire, and people love katanas, so why not put them together?  The gas burners attached to this blade can really turn up the heat on your foes.  Use to ignite.

firekatana_on.name: Rising Sun (on)
firekatana_on.description: This is a katana that glows with the fury and heat of the SUN!  Well, okay it's not THAT hot, but getting hit with it still stings like the dickens.  Use to shut off the gas.

use_action.water_extinguish_message: Your sword hisses in the water and goes out.

broadfire_off.name: firebrand (off)
broadfire_off.description: This is a combination of two classic methods of conflict resolution, the broadsword and the torch.  Use to light it up and show those heathen zombies who's Lord around here.

broadfire_on.name: firebrand (on)
broadfire_on.description: This is a combination of two classic methods of conflict resolution, the broadsword and the torch.  The blade is glowing with heat.  Excalibur can eat its heart out.  Use to shut it off.

use_action.water_extinguish_message: Your sword hisses in the water and goes out.

zweifire_off.name: flammenschwert
zweifire_off.description: Ein großes zweihaendiges Schwert aus Deutschland, an dessen Klinge sich, unter Zufuehrung von Benzin, eine anhaltende Flamme erzeugen laesst.  Es ist eine sehr maechtige Waffe.

use_action.lacks_fuel_message: Dein Flammenschwert hat keinen Brennstoff mehr.

zweifire_on.name: flammenschwert (an)
zweifire_on.description: Ein großes zweihaendiges Schwert aus Deutschland, an dessen Klinge sich, unter Zufuehrung von Benzin, eine anhaltende Flamme erzeugen laesst.  Es ist eine sehr maechtige Waffe.

use_action.noise_message: Das Feuer um deine Schwertklinge leuchtet hell!
use_action.charges_extinguish_message: Deinem Flammenschwert ist der Brennstoff ausgegangen!

exploding_arrow_warhead.name: explosive arrowhead
exploding_arrow_warhead.description: This simple IED is designed to be attached to an arrow or crossbow bolt, and detonate on impact.

alien_pod_resin.name: alien resin pod
alien_pod_resin.description: This is a large pod, the size of a keg, filled with gooey alien resin.  Squeezing it firmly causes resin to squirt from the broken stalk at the end, hardening within a few seconds of being exposed to the air.

alien_pod_storage.name: alien storage pod
alien_pod_storage.description: This is a large pod, filled with a thick gel obscuring its contents.  Something is suspended in it, suggesting this is an alien container of some sort.  Activate to tear it open and see what's inside.

alien_pod_organ.name: alien organ pod
alien_pod_organ.description: This is a large pod.  What appear to be human organs can be seen floating instead, like some sort of morbid trophy.  Activate to tear it open and see what's inside, if you really want to.

cannonball_explosive.name: unpacked cannon shell
cannonball_explosive.description: A metal case tightly packed with gunpowder and an impact fuse.  With some gunpowder, wadding, and a fuse, it could be prepared to load into a cannon.

atomic_pseudo_churn.name: deployed atomic butter churn
atomic_pseudo_churn.description: This is a crafting_pseudo_item if you have it something is wrong.

carver_off.name: electric carver (off)
carver_off.description: An electric meat carver powered by batteries.  Two serrated blades that vibrate together to slice just about anything from turkey to ham… even zombies!

use_action.msg: You turn on the electric carver.

carver_on.name: electric carver (on)
carver_on.description: This carver is on and the blades are buzzing.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the electric carver.

char_purifier.name: charcoal water purifier
char_purifier.description: Using this item on a container full of water will purify the water using layered charcoal.  Once the charcoal has purified enough water, it will become unusable and can be disassembled and recycled.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.

char_smoker.name: charcoal smoker
char_smoker.description: This is a portable charcoal smoker.  Good for weekend barbecuing and preserving meat with smoke.

charcoal_cooker.name: charcoal cooker
charcoal_cooker.description: This is a little metal tank for holding charcoal with a pilot light attached.  You could use it for cooking food.

coffeemaker.name: coffeemaker
coffeemaker.description: This is a heating element with pot and frame for holding coffee or other powders.  It's got a battery compartment for use when the power goes out.  You can use it to make coffee, or other drinks if you so choose.

dehydrator.name: food dehydrator
dehydrator.description: This is a portable electric food dehydrator.  It's powered by batteries, and could be invaluable in preserving food.

esbit_stove.name: hexamine stove
esbit_stove.description: Known as an Esbit stove, this is a lightweight, folding stove designed to use small hexamine tablets for cooking.

food_processor.name: food processor
food_processor.description: This is a kitchen appliance capable of slicing, chopping, shredding, grinding, pureeing and mixing.

soda_machine.name: soda machine
soda_machine.description: This is a kitchen appliance capable of creating carbonated beverages.

atomic_soda_machine.name: atomic soda machine
atomic_soda_machine.description: This is a Curie-G soda machine, a follow-up to the infamous coffeepot by CuppaTech.  It uses the same miniature RTG core to chill and carbonate beverages.  Normally, it dispenses standard fizzy drinks using stored CO₂ and coolant, but with a twist of the dial, it can cycle irradiated condensation from the RTG chamber into the mix.  Like its predecessor, the atomic soda machine is banned in most regions.

gasoline_cooker.name: camping stove
gasoline_cooker.description: This is a simple burner powered by pressurized fuel, such as butane or gasoline.  It is designed for cooking food.

hotplate.name: hotplate
hotplate.description: This is a small heating element on a stand, powered by batteries.  It is indispensable for cooking and chemistry.  Try not to burn yourself.

afs_atompot.name: atompot
afs_atompot.description: Rivtech's premiere self-heating kitchen appliance, complete with lid, hand-crafted with the power of the atom to reach any temperature in thirty seconds.  As bulky as it is, its plutonium power source means that it can be used to cook an absurd amount of meals without ever worrying about running low on power.  Unsurprisingly, sales weren't particularly good because of the prospect of irradiating your food, but internal shielding ensures that only trace amounts find its way into the center.

makeshift_sealer.name: makeshift vacuum sealer
makeshift_sealer.description: This is a homemade heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.

mess_kit.name: mess kit
mess_kit.description: A self-contained camping mess kit, containing everything you might need for wilderness cooking.  This model relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the more commonplace chemical-fueled butane and Esbit stoves.

mil_mess_kit.name: military mess kit
mil_mess_kit.description: Military mess kit designed for long-range reconnaissance patrols deployed behind enemy lines.  All parts are made from thin sheet of aluminum / superalloy composite and are insulated with ceramic coating.  Relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the smoke-producing chemical-fueled Esbit stove.  Compact, durable and lightweight.

multi_cooker.name: multi cooker
multi_cooker.description: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating.  Its multitude of settings and features promise to handle any sort of cooking, from parboiling potatoes to cooking curry to popping popcorn.  There's no manual, but you're sure you can work it out.

multi_cooker_improved.name: improved multi cooker
multi_cooker_improved.description: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating. This has been tinkered with.

oil_cooker.name: lamp oil cooker
oil_cooker.description: This is a simple heater powered by lamp oil.  It is designed for cooking food.

popcan_stove.name: soda can stove kit
popcan_stove.description: This is an ultra-light alcohol-burning stove with simmer ring.  It comes with a 500 ml container to hold concentrated alcohol fuel.

survivor_mess_kit.name: survivor mess kit
survivor_mess_kit.description: A homemade mess kit, containing everything you might need for creating post-apocalyptic cuisine.  Powered by a lamp oil burner, it is composed of simple yet durable tools and materials.

vac_sealer.name: vacuum sealer
vac_sealer.description: This is a portable heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.

water_purifier.name: water purifier
water_purifier.description: This is a battery-powered device designed to purify drinking water.  Using this item on a container full of water will purify the contents.  It could be useful for water taken from uncertain sources like a river, as it may be non-potable.

folding_bicycle.name: folding bicycle
folding_bicycle.description: This is a bicycle folded into a relatively portable package.

use_action.unfold_msg: You painstakingly unfold the bicycle and make it ready to ride.
You lay the skateboard down on the ground.

sea_scooter.name: sea scooter
sea_scooter.description: A super fast Rivtech sea scooter. Includes a headlight for night expeditions. Can be recharged in the sun.

use_action.unfold_msg: You place the sea scooter down.

inflatable_boat.name: inflatable boat
inflatable_boat.description: This rubber rowboat (oars included) is deflated for storage.  Activate it (having an air pump in inventory) to inflate and launch.

use_action.unfold_msg: You painstakingly unfold, inflate, and launch the %s.

chair_folding.name: folding chair
chair_folding.description: Folded plastic chair on a metal frame, deploy to sit down.

metal_charcoal_kiln.name: metal charcoal kiln
metal_charcoal_kiln.description: A huge metal kiln with a door cut in to allow easy loading and unloading of char materials. When deployed, it can process up to 200L of bone or wood into charcoal.

debug_testing_dimension_travel.name: dimensional pocket watch (desert)
debug_testing_dimension_travel.description: A pocket watch that allows the user to travel to the desert dimension.  Used for debugging purposes only.  Transforms after use.

use_action.fail_message: The watch vibrates but nothing happens.
use_action.success_message: You feel a wrenching sensation as you are pulled through space and time.

use_action.msg: The watch reconfigures itself.

debug_testing_dimension_travel_return.name: dimensional pocket watch (default)
debug_testing_dimension_travel_return.description: A pocket watch that allows the user to return to the default dimension.  Used for debugging purposes only.

use_action.fail_message: The watch vibrates but nothing happens.
use_action.success_message: You feel reality snap back into place.

use_action.msg: The watch reconfigures itself.

pocket_dimension_key.name: pocket cave key
pocket_dimension_key.description: A strange key that glows with an otherworldly light.  When activated, it opens a door to a pocket dimension containing a small extradimensional space.  The pocket dimension is tied to this key - if the key is destroyed, the dimension collapses.

adv_UPS_off.name: advanced UPS
adv_UPS_off.description: This is an advanced version of the unified power supply, or UPS.  Designed for military use to power advanced weapons, it uses plutonium fuel cells which provide better efficiency and self-charging capability, in exchange for lacking the ability to swap out batteries for sustained use.  It can power many household electronics as well.

camera.name: camera
camera.description: A point-and-shoot digital camera, with digital viewfinder, a backup 'iron-sight', and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen, or transfer them with a memory card.  Takes conventional batteries.

camera_pro.name: professional camera
camera_pro.description: A 35 mm digital SLR (single-lens reflex) camera, with optical and digital viewfinders, zoom lens with auto-focus and stabilizer, and flash.  You can view your photos on it or transfer them with a memory card; it runs on a rechargeable power cell that can be switched to charge via Unified Power Supply.  Before the Cataclysm, you could have taken professional-grade photos using this.

cell_phone.name: cellphone
cell_phone.description: This is a cellphone, an older cousin of a smartphone but still popular in certain circles due to its reliability, sturdiness and the ability to run on common batteries.  Using this cellphone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is sufficiently charged.  It also has a clock app that includes an alarm.

use_action.msg: You light up the screen.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The cellphone's batteries need more charge.

cell_phone_flashlight.name: cellphone - Screenlight
cell_phone_flashlight.description: This is a cellphone, an older cousin of a smartphone but still popular in certain circles due to its reliability, sturdiness and the ability to run on common batteries.  Using this cellphone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is sufficiently charged.  It also has a clock app that includes an alarm.

use_action.msg: You stop lighting up the screen.

control_laptop.name: control laptop
control_laptop.description: A modified laptop, now capable of transmitting in the ultra-high frequencies utilized by robots.  Activate it to command robots from afar, or to toggle charging via UPS.  It will also automatically display any targeting data provided by friendly drones in the area.

use_action.msg: You light up the screen.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The control laptop's batteries need more charge.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The control laptop's batteries need more charge.

control_laptop_screen_lit.name: control laptop - lit screen
control_laptop_screen_lit.description: A laptop computer with an internal rechargeable battery, also capable of using UPS.

use_action.msg: You stop lighting up the screen.

control_laptop_music.name: control laptop - music
control_laptop_music.description: A laptop computer with an internal rechargeable battery, also capable of using UPS.

wrist_comp_budget_music.name: wrist computer - music
wrist_comp_budget_music.description: This wrist computer is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

wrist_comp_budget_flashlight.name: wrist computer - Flashlight
wrist_comp_budget_flashlight.description: A fancy wrist-mounted computer, with a menagerie of useful features, such as SD reading, a built-in thermometer, and even a radiation monitor!

use_action.msg: You deactivate the flashlight.

wrist_comp_control_music.name: wrist control computer - music
wrist_comp_control_music.description: This wrist computer is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

wrist_comp_control_flashlight.name: wrist control computer - Flashlight
wrist_comp_control_flashlight.description: A fancy wrist-mounted computer, with a menagerie of useful features, such as SD reading, a built-in thermometer, and even a radiation monitor!

use_action.msg: You deactivate the flashlight app.

e_handcuffs.name: electronic handcuffs
e_handcuffs.description:
A pair of electronic handcuffs, used by police and riot bots to detain captives.  Their continuous siren clearly identifies the wearer as an arrested criminal and alerts human police.  Wait for their arrival, don't try to escape or to remove the cuffs - they will administer an electric shock.
However, since the only police likely to respond are undead, you may have a long wait ahead, unless you get creative…

eink_tablet_pc.name: e-ink tablet PC
eink_tablet_pc.description: A tablet PC using an efficient color e-ink display, with a recharging battery that can be switched to draw from a UPS.  Before the Cataclysm, these were nifty gadgets; now, it's an almost priceless resource.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The e-ink tablet PC's batteries need more charge.

eink_tablet_pc_music.name: e-ink tablet PC - music
eink_tablet_pc_music.description: This e-ink tablet PC is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

electrohack.name: electrohack
electrohack.description: This device has many ports attached, allowing it to connect to almost any control panel or other electronic machine (but not computers).  With a little skill, it can be used to crack passwords and more.  It requires 25 charges of battery power per use.

geiger_off.name: geiger counter (off)
geiger_off.description: This is a tool for measuring radiation.  Using it will prompt you to choose whether to scan yourself or the terrain, or to turn it on, which will provide continuous feedback on ambient radiation.  It is currently off.

geiger_on.name: geiger counter (on)
geiger_on.description: This is a tool for measuring radiation.  It is in continuous scan mode, and will produce quiet clicking sounds in the presence of ambient radiation.  Using it allows you to turn it off, or scan yourself or the ground.  It is currently on.

sonar_device.name: handheld sonar
sonar_device.description: A rugged sonar unit with a compact transducer and display.  Activate it to ping nearby underwater terrain and sketch what you find onto the overmap.

hand_crank_charger.name: hand-crank charger
hand_crank_charger.description: This is a hand-powered battery charger.  It has an adjustable receptacle designed to accept a wide variety of rechargeable battery cells.

use_action.start_message: You start cranking the %s to charge its %s.
use_action.already_charged_message: You could use the %s to charge its %s, but it's already charged.
use_action.need_battery_message: You need a rechargeable battery cell to charge.
use_action.underwater_message: It's not waterproof enough to work underwater.
use_action.exhausted_message: You're too exhausted to keep cranking.

laptop.name: laptop computer
laptop.description: A laptop computer with an internal rechargeable battery, also capable of using UPS.

use_action.training_msg: You update software and check logs, improving your understanding slightly.

use_action.msg: You light up the screen.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The laptop's batteries need more charge.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The laptop computer's batteries need more charge.

laptop_music.name: laptop computer - music
laptop_music.description: A laptop computer with an internal rechargeable battery, also capable of using UPS.

laptop_screen_lit.name: laptop computer - lit screen
laptop_screen_lit.description: A laptop computer with an internal rechargeable battery, also capable of using UPS.

use_action.msg: You stop lighting up the screen.

mp3.name: mp3 player (off)
mp3.description: This battery-powered device is loaded up with someone's music collection.  Fortunately, there's lots of songs you like, and listening to it will raise your morale slightly.  Use it to turn it on, or toggle charging on the go from a Unified Power System.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The mp3 player's batteries need more charge.

mp3_on.name: mp3 player (on)
mp3_on.description: This mp3 player is turned on and playing some great tunes, raising your morale steadily while on your person.  It runs through batteries quickly; you can turn it off by using it.  It also obscures your hearing.

noise_emitter.name: noise emitter (off)
noise_emitter.description: This device was constructed by 'enhancing' a speaker ripped off from some electronic device with some amplifier circuits.  It has now no other use beside emitting loud crackling static noise, that could distract zombies.

noise_emitter_on.name: noise emitter (on)
noise_emitter_on.description: This device has been turned on and is emitting horrible crackles, pops and other static sounds.  Quick, get away from it before it draws zombies to you!

portable_game.name: handheld game system
portable_game.description: This is a portable games console in working condition, with an LED-screen allowing you to play in the dark.  You can use it to play it for a little while, running down the integrated battery.  Can also be set to draw power from a UPS.

smart_phone.name: smartphone
smart_phone.description: A popular, fancy smartphone.  Capable of making photos due to integrated camera and illuminating an area as per flashlight app, assuming it has enough charge.  The smartphone also has a clock app that includes an alarm.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with Unified Power Supply if set to charge from one.

use_action.msg: You activate the flashlight app.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The smartphone's charge is too low.

use_action.training_msg: You fiddle with your phone’s settings and apps, picking up some basic computer knowledge.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The smart phone's batteries need more charge.

smart_phone_music.name: smartphone - music
smart_phone_music.description: This phone is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

smart_phone_flashlight.name: smartphone - Flashlight
smart_phone_flashlight.description: A popular, fancy smartphone.  Capable of making photos due to integrated camera and illuminating an area as per flashlight app, assuming it has enough charge.  The smartphone also has a clock app that includes an alarm.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with Unified Power Supply if set to charge from one.

use_action.msg: You deactivate the flashlight app.

afs_atomic_smartphone.name: atomic smartphone
afs_atomic_smartphone.description: Never charge your phone again with the Rivtech atomic smartphone.  Rated for 10 million years of use, this cutting-edge gadget had been on public markets for less than a week when the Cataclysm hit, and their eye-watering price made them a rarity.  It includes an alarm clock, a high-resolution camera, and a bright flashlight.

use_action.msg: You activate the flashlight app.

use_action.training_msg: You fiddle with your phone’s settings and apps, picking up some basic computer knowledge.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The atomic smartphone's batteries need more charge.

afs_atomic_smartphone_music.name: atomic smartphone - music
afs_atomic_smartphone_music.description: This phone is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

afs_atomic_smartphone_flashlight.name: atomic smartphone - Flashlight
afs_atomic_smartphone_flashlight.description: Never charge your phone again with the Rivtech atomic smartphone.  Rated for 10 million years of use, this cutting-edge gadget had been on public markets for less than a week when the Cataclysm hit, and their eye-watering price made them a rarity.  It includes an alarm clock, a high-resolution camera, and a bright flashlight.

use_action.msg: You deactivate the flashlight app.

UPS_off.name: UPS
UPS_off.description: This is a unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a civilian evolution of a military project.  Designed to power advanced weapons and armor, the civilian version serves as a portable power bank and inverter for many household electronics.

vibrator.name: vibrator
vibrator.description: This battery-devouring device is just the thing to knead the tension out and help you relax.  Use it to take a break and unwind.

bullet_vibrator.name: bullet vibrator (off)
bullet_vibrator.description: This battery-devouring device is just the thing to knead the tension out and help you relax.  Use it to turn it on and start letting it buzz away.

use_action.msg: You turn on the bullet vibe and place it appropriately.

bullet_vibrator_on.name: bullet vibrator (on)
bullet_vibrator_on.description: This battery-devouring device is just the thing to knead the tension out and help you relax.  You can feel it buzzing away all that tension.

gps_device.name: gps pinpointer
gps_device.description: Durable handheld GPS unit built for outdoor navigation.  Activate to acquire satellite lock and search the database.

mil_gps_device.name: military gps pinpointer
mil_gps_device.description: Durable handheld GPS unit built for outdoor navigation.  Activate to acquire satellite lock and search the database.  This one has encrpytion keys for military-grade satellites, allowing a much greater search range.

bionic_scanner.name: bionic scanner
bionic_scanner.description: A small metal scanner specialized in detecting bionic hardware.  Activate to start scanning nearby corpses for bionics.

use_action.msg: You start scanning for bionics.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The scanner doesn't have enough power.

bionic_scanner_on.name: bionic scanner (on)
bionic_scanner_on.description: A small metal scanner specialized in detecting bionic hardware.  While in use it will steadily drain power, automatically scanning corpses near you for bionics.

genome_sampler.name: genome sampler
genome_sampler.description: A handheld device designed to extract and analyze DNA from living organisms.  If you have an empty USB drive on hand, scanning a creature with it can create a genome sample for later sequencing in a cloning vat.

dna_editor.name: genome workstation
dna_editor.description: A medium-sized, high-tech machine with screens and sample trays.  It can scan genetic samples off USB drives, and produce DNA samples for cloning if provided with growth medium.  It can also be used as a microcentrifuge in a pinch.

power_portal_key.name: power portal keycard
power_portal_key.description: A programmable electronic keycard used to pair two power portal nodes. Stores the absolute location of a single portal endpoint; re-attuning it to a different portal simply overwrites the stored data. Carry this to the second portal and use its interface to complete the link.

debug_shrapnel_blast.name: debug shrapnel
debug_shrapnel_blast.description: This item, which shouldn't exist, has shrapnel range larger than the reality itself.

acidbomb.name: acid bomb
acidbomb.description: This is a fragile container filled with acid.  Throw it to spill out a pool of potent acid.

can_bomb.name: can bomb
can_bomb.description: This is a tin can filled with some explosives provided with a fuse.  Won't make a big explosion but you still wouldn't want to be near it.  Will explode in 5 seconds if lit.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the can bomb.  Throw it before it blows in your face!

can_bomb_act.name: active can bomb
can_bomb_act.description: This is a tin can filled with some explosives and provided with a fuse.  Won't make a big explosion but you still wouldn't want to be near it.  The fuse has been lit, you should throw it.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - what are you waiting for?

c4.name: C-4 explosive
c4.description: This is military grade RDX composition explosive, made of a bundle of demolition blocks, meant to breach heavily reinforced bunkers and destroy large structures.  A label reads: "Highly explosive, use with extreme caution!" It comes with a small timer.

c4armed.name: C-4 explosive (armed)
c4armed.description: This is military grade RDX composition explosive, made of a bundle of demolition blocks, meant to breach heavily reinforced bunkers and destroy large structures.  A label reads: "Highly explosive, use with extreme caution!" It comes with a small timer, which is currently ticking down.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already set the %s's timer, you might want to get away from it.

c4_breaching.name: C-4 breaching charge
c4_breaching.description: This is military grade RDX composition explosive.  It has been formed into a charge meant to breach walls and doors without causing undue structural damage.  It comes with a small timer.

c4_breaching_armed.name: C-4 breaching charge (armed)
c4_breaching_armed.description: This is military grade RDX composition explosive.  It has been formed into a charge meant to breach walls and doors without causing undue structural damage.  It comes with a small timer, which is currently ticking down.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already set the %s's timer, you might want to get away from it.

dynamite.name: dynamite
dynamite.description: These are several sticks of explosives with a fuse attached.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

use_action.msg: You light the dynamite.

dynamite_act.name: dynamite (lit)
dynamite_act.description: The fuse on this dynamite is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

dynamite_bomb.name: dynamite bomb
dynamite_bomb.description: These are several sticks of explosives surrounded by shrapnel stuffed inside a metal container.  The fuse is sticking out through a small hole.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

use_action.msg: You light the dynamite.

dynamite_bomb_act.name: dynamite bomb (lit)
dynamite_bomb_act.description: The fuse on this dynamite bomb is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

EMPbomb.name: EMP bomb
EMPbomb.description: This substantial device is a bomb that generates an electromagnetic pulse.  When this magnetic field is fed into the antenna, it creates a strong electro-magnetic pulse.  It will also create a sizable explosion, so stay clear of it.

use_action.msg: You activate the EMP bomb.

EMPbomb_act.name: active EMP bomb
EMPbomb_act.description: This EMP bomb is active, and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.  It will also create an explosion, which may hurt you.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already activated the %s, try throwing it instead.

improvised_demolition_charge.name: improvised demolition charge
improvised_demolition_charge.description: This is a improvised demolition charge.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  20 seconds after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

use_action.msg: You light the %s.

improvised_demolition_charge_act.name: improvised demolition charge (lit)
improvised_demolition_charge_act.description: The fuse on this primitive demolition charge is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

firecracker.name: firecracker
firecracker.description: A solitary firecracker with a short fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse it will explode, so throw it quickly!

firecracker_act.name: firecracker (lit)
firecracker_act.description: A firecracker that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw it quickly before it explodes.

firecracker_pack.name: pack of firecrackers
firecracker_pack.description: This is a pack of 25 firecrackers with a starter fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse they will begin to explode, so throw them quickly!

firecracker_pack_act.name: pack of firecrackers (lit)
firecracker_pack_act.description: A pack of 25 firecrackers that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw them quickly before the start to explode.

flashbang.name: flashbang
flashbang.description: This is a military police style flashbang.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it detonates with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening and disorienting anyone nearby.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the flashbang.

flashbang_act.name: active flashbang
flashbang_act.description: This flashbang is active, and will soon detonate with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening and disorienting anyone nearby.  It may be a good idea to throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.

gasbomb_makeshift.name: makeshift gas grenade
gasbomb_makeshift.description: This is a crude gasbomb using household chemicals.  Use this item to arm it.  In three turns it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for a short time.  This gas poisons those exposed to it, in addition to obscuring vision and scent.

use_action.msg: You arm the makeshift gas canister.

gasbomb_makeshift_act.name: active makeshift gas grenade
gasbomb_makeshift_act.description: This homemade canister of poison gas has been unsealed, and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly toxic gas.  You should consider getting rid of it soon.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already armed the %s, try throwing it instead.

grenade.name: grenade
grenade.description: This is a military-grade fragmentary hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the grenade.

grenade_act.name: active grenade
grenade_act.description: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin; try throwing it instead.

grenade_emp.name: EMP grenade
grenade_emp.description: This is a grenade that generates an electromagnetic pulse with a low-inductance capacitor bank discharged into a single-loop antenna.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active EMP grenade.  You will then have three turns before it detonates, creating an EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the EMP grenade.

grenade_emp_act.name: active EMP grenade
