grenade_emp_act.description: This EMP grenade is active, and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.

grenade_inc.name: incendiary grenade
grenade_inc.description: This is a military-grade incendiary hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes into a raging inferno; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the grenade.

grenade_inc_act.name: active incendiary grenade
grenade_inc_act.description: This is an active incendiary grenade, likely to burst into an inferno any second now.  Better throw it!

LAW_Packed.name: packed M72 LAW
LAW_Packed.description: This is a M72 LAW, packed in its storage form with attached shoulder strap.  Use it to pop it out and make it ready to fire.  Once it is activated, it cannot be repacked.

use_action.msg: You pull the activating lever, readying the LAW to fire.

improvised_grenade.name: improvised grenade
improvised_grenade.description: A improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have some amount of time before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows in your face!

improvised_grenade_act.name: active improvised grenade
improvised_grenade_act.description: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s's fuse; try throwing it instead.

mininuke.name: mininuke
mininuke.description: This is an extremely powerful weapon, a portable nuclear bomb.  Use it to activate the timer.  You guess that the explosion would be large enough to take out a small house.

mininuke_act.name: mininuke (armed)
mininuke_act.description: This miniature nuclear bomb has a light blinking on the side, showing that it will soon explode.  You should probably get far, far away from it.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already set the %s's timer, you might want to get away from it.

molotov.name: Molotov cocktail
molotov.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a rag inserted.  Use this item to light the rag.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  After lighting it, throw it to cause fires.

use_action.msg: You light the Molotov cocktail!

molotov_lit.name: Molotov cocktail (lit)
molotov_lit.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a flaming rag stoppered in its neck.  Throwing it will shatter the bottle on impact and ignite a fireball.  You can also activate it to smash it on yourself, but why would you want to do that?

improvised_pipebomb.name: improvised pipe bomb
improvised_pipebomb.description: This is a section of a pipe filled with stable explosives and a primer.  Use this item to light the fuse, which gives you six seconds to get away from it before it detonates.  You'll need a lighter or some matches to use it.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the pipe bomb.

improvised_pipebomb_act.name: active improvised pipe bomb
improvised_pipebomb_act.description: This pipe bomb's fuse is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

scrambler.name: scrambler grenade
scrambler.description: This is a specialized grenade, designed to scramble robots' IFF control chips.  This converts the robot to your side for a short time, before the backup systems kick in.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active scrambler grenade.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the scrambler grenade.

scrambler_act.name: active scrambler grenade
scrambler_act.description: This scrambler grenade is active, and will soon detonate, releasing a control wave that temporarily converts robots to your side.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin; try throwing it instead.

tool_anfo_charge.name: ANFO charge
tool_anfo_charge.description: This is a large metal keg filled with ANFO pellets and equipped with a dynamite primer.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have twenty turns before it explodes and creates a large fireball.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the ANFO charge.  Run survivor, run!

tool_anfo_charge_act.name: active ANFO charge
tool_anfo_charge_act.description: This is a large metal keg filled with ANFO pellets and equipped with a dynamite primer.  The fuse has been lit - better run like hell!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - run!

tool_small_improvised_fragmentation_devi.name: small improvised frag device
tool_small_improvised_fragmentation_devi.description: This is a home-made explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal, equipped with a long fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Once you do it should explode in about 20 seconds.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the small improvised fragmentation device.  Get rid of it quickly!

tool_small_improvised_fragmentation_devi.name: small improvised frag device
tool_small_improvised_fragmentation_devi.description: This is a home-made explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal, whose fuse has been lit, its final countdown starting.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - run!

tool_improvised_barrel_bomb.name: improvised barrel bomb
tool_improvised_barrel_bomb.description: This is a metal keg, filled with a lot of stable explosives.  Contains a volatile explosive core so 100 seconds after the fuse has been lit the charge detonates completely and delivers its entire destructive power to everything in sight.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the barrel bomb.  Clear the area!

tool_improvised_barrel_bomb_act.name: active improvised barrel bomb
tool_improvised_barrel_bomb_act.description: This is a metal keg, filled with a lot of stable explosives.  The fuse has been lit and once it ignites the primary explosive, the bomb will detonate and rain fire and steel on everything in sight.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - clear the area immediately!

tool_rocket_candy.name: rocket candy
tool_rocket_candy.description: A pear-shaped chunk of rocket candy obtained by heating saltpeter with sugar and casting the obtained liquid.  Can serve as a rocket fuel, but also as a smokescreen - if you lit the narrow end, you should be able to throw it before the flame reaches the broad end.

use_action.msg: You light the rocket candy on fire.  Throw it!

tool_rocket_candy_act.name: burning rocket candy
tool_rocket_candy_act.description: This is a chunk of rocket candy that has been lit on fire and burns with a loud hiss, spewing forth large amounts of smoke.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - get rid of it immediately!

aerial_bomb.name: aerial bomb
aerial_bomb.description: A hefty explosive meant to be air-dropped from a plane.  If deployed from a vehicle bomb bay, it will activate and automatically explode on impact with enough force to reduce a house to rubble.  You'll want to be at least 4 stories above your target to maintain a safe distance.  Trying to arm it manually and throw it by hand would be a terrible idea.

use_action.msg: You arm the bomb.  Activate again to disarm it, or drop it to explode on impact.

aerial_bomb_armed.name: aerial bomb (armed)
aerial_bomb_armed.description: A hefty explosive designed to be air-dropped from a plane or other vehicle.  It's currently armed, and will explode if it hits the ground.  If you're currently struggling to lift this monstrosity, you should probably disarm it before you drop it on your foot and blow yourself up.

use_action.msg: You carefully disarm the bomb.

crude_firestarter.name: electric firestarter
crude_firestarter.description: This is a crudely made electric firestarter, which can function as an inefficient lighter.

fire_drill.name: fire drill
fire_drill.description: This fire drill is a simple item for starting fires; it is made from two pieces of wood and some string.  Since it is constructed out of simple materials, it's slow and rather difficult to get a fire started using this tool.

fire_drill_large.name: camp fire drill
fire_drill_large.description: This stout fire drill is a simple item for starting fires; it is made from two pieces of wood and some string.  Since it is constructed out of simple materials, it's slow and rather difficult to get a fire started using this tool.

flint_steel.name: flint and steel
flint_steel.description: This is a magnesium bar and a carbon steel striker.  Use it to spark a flame.

lighter.name: lighter
lighter.description: This is a disposable plastic lighter.  A lighter must be carried to use various drugs, like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use a lighter to light nearby items on fire.

matches.name: matchbook
matches.description: This is a small book of matches with a coarse strike surface on the outside flap.  Matches must be carried to use various drugs like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use matches to light nearby items on fire.

ref_lighter.name: refillable lighter
ref_lighter.description: This is a lighter featuring a flip top cover and refuelable tank.  A lighter must be carried to use various drugs, like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use a lighter to light nearby items on fire.

use_action.msg: You flick the lighter.

ref_lighter_on.name: refillable lighter (lit)
ref_lighter_on.description: This is a lighter featuring a flip top cover and refuelable tank.  It is lit.

use_action.msg: You extinguish the lighter.

tinderbox.name: ember carrier
tinderbox.description: This is a small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  It can nurture a smoldering ember for a long time, to start fires without modern tools.

use_action.msg: You light the tinder.
use_action.need_fire_msg: You need a lighter or fire to light this.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The ember carrier is out of tinder.

tinderbox_on.name: ember carrier (lit)
tinderbox_on.description: This is a small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  An ember is smoldering inside it, and can be used to start a campfire.

use_action.msg: The ember is extinguished.

electric_lighter.name: electric lighter
electric_lighter.description: A battery-powered lighter.  More efficient than a crude electric firestarter, its batteries last for quite a while.

survivor_lighter.name: survivor lighter
survivor_lighter.description: This makeshift refillable lighter contains a simple wick and ignitor that can be used with improvised fuels such as diesel or lamp oil.

extinguisher.name: large fire extinguisher
extinguisher.description: This is an emergency fire extinguisher containing five gallons of fire retardant foam.  It would be useful for putting out adjacent fires.

sm_extinguisher.name: small fire extinguisher
sm_extinguisher.description: This is a hand held fire extinguisher containing a liter of highly compressed CO2 gas.  It would be useful for putting out adjacent fires.

throw_extinguisher.name: throwable fire extinguisher
throw_extinguisher.description: This is a fire extinguisher in grenade form.  While not as effective as a regular fire extinguisher, you can use it from a distance.  It is activated by heat, so just throw it into the flames.

fish_trap.name: plastic fish trap
fish_trap.description: This is a makeshift fish trap made from plastic bottles.  It's simple, even primitive, but easy to use.  The principle of action: the fish swims inside for bait, but can't get out.  Not humane, prohibited by law, but there are no cops left to care.

clay_fish_trap.name: clay fish trap
clay_fish_trap.description: This is a fish trap made from clay canisters, closely resembling old Japanese squid traps.  It's simple, even primitive, but easy to use.  The principle of action: the fish swims inside for bait, but can't get out.  Not humane, prohibited by law, but there are no cops left to care.

trimmer_off.name: hedge trimmer (off)
trimmer_off.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  A long line of sharp-edged teeth extends from the engine; turning the trimmer on will make them rapidly vibrate.  The poor man's chainsaw as far as the zombies are concerned.

use_action.msg: You turn on the hedge trimmer.

trimmer_on.name: hedge trimmer (on)
trimmer_on.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  It is currently on, ready to do some zombie topiary; use this item to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the hedge trimmer.

candle.name: candle
candle.description: This is a thick candle.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

use_action.msg: You light the candle.

candle_lit.name: candle (lit)
candle_lit.description: This is a thick candle.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  This candle is lit.

use_action.msg: The candle winks out.

electric_lantern.name: electric lantern (off)
electric_lantern.description: This is a battery-powered lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the lamp on.

electric_lantern_on.name: electric lantern (on)
electric_lantern_on.description: This is a battery-powered lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the lamp off.

flashlight.name: flashlight (off)
flashlight.description: This is a typical household flashlight with a plastic handle.  Using this flashlight will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

use_action.msg: You turn the flashlight on.

flashlight_on.name: flashlight (on)
flashlight_on.description: This is a typical household flashlight with a plastic handle.  Using this flashlight will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

use_action.msg: You turn the flashlight off.

gasoline_lantern.name: gasoline lantern (off)
gasoline_lantern.description: This is a small gasoline powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the lamp on.

gasoline_lantern_on.name: gasoline lantern (on)
gasoline_lantern_on.description: This is a small gasoline powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The lantern is extinguished.

glowstick.name: glowstick
glowstick.description: This is a small blue light glowstick.  Use it to bend the plastic and break the glass cylinder inside to start the reaction.  It will produce a small amount of light.

use_action.msg: You activate the glowstick.

glowstick_lit.name: active glowstick
glowstick_lit.description: This is an active glowstick and is producing light.  It will last for a few hours before burning out.

handflare.name: flare
handflare.description: This is a slow-burning magnesium flare.  Use it to strike the striker and light it.  It will produce a bright light for about a half hour.

use_action.msg: You strike your flare and light it.

handflare_lit.name: active flare
handflare_lit.description: This burning magnesium flare is producing light.  It will last for about a half hour before burning out.

heavy_flashlight.name: heavy duty flashlight (off)
heavy_flashlight.description: This is a heavy duty tubular aluminum LED flashlight as often used by security guards.  Makes for a passable melee weapon.  Using this flashlight will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

use_action.msg: You turn the heavy duty flashlight on.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The heavy duty flashlight's batteries are dead.

heavy_flashlight_on.name: heavy duty flashlight (on)
heavy_flashlight_on.description: This is a heavy duty tubular aluminum LED flashlight as often used by security guards.  Makes for a passable melee weapon.  Using this flashlight will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

use_action.msg: You turn the heavy duty flashlight off.

lightstrip.name: lightstrip
lightstrip.description: This is a light-emitting circuit that has been wired directly to a battery.  It provides some weak light and can't be turned off until the battery dies.

lightstrip_inactive.name: lightstrip (inactive)
lightstrip_inactive.description: This is a light-emitting circuit that can be wired directly to a battery.  It provides some weak light and can't be turned off until the battery dies.

use_action.msg: You irreversibly activate the lightstrip.

oil_lamp.name: oil lamp (off)
oil_lamp.description: This is an oil fueled lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the lamp on.

oil_lamp_on.name: oil lamp
oil_lamp_on.description: This is an oil fueled lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The lantern is extinguished.

oxylamp.name: acetylene lamp (off)
oxylamp.description: An antique brass lamp designed to run from a pressurized cylinder of acetylene.  It is an efficient, if not somewhat dangerous light source.

use_action.msg: You light the %s.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The %s must be attached to a gas cylinder to light.

oxylamp_on.name: acetylene lamp (on)
oxylamp_on.description: An antique brass lamp designed to run from a pressurized cylinder of acetylene.  It is an efficient, if not somewhat dangerous light source.

use_action.msg: The %s is extinguished

reading_light.name: reading light
reading_light.description: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.

use_action.msg: You switch on the reading light.

reading_light_on.name: reading light (on)
reading_light_on.description: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.  This one is turned on.

use_action.msg: You switch off the reading light.

smart_lamp.name: smart lamp (off)
smart_lamp.description: This is a smart lamp, it can be activated remotely.

use_action.msg: You turn the smart lamp on.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The smart lamp batteries are dead.

smart_lamp_on.name: smart lamp (on)
smart_lamp_on.description: This is a smart lamp, this smart lamp is turned on.  It can be deactivated remotely.

use_action.msg: Your smart lamp turned off

torch.name: torch
torch.description: This is a large stick, wrapped in rags that are soaked with a flammable material.  When lit, produces a fair amount of light.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

use_action.msg: You light the torch.

torch_lit.name: torch (lit)
torch_lit.description: This is a large stick, wrapped in rags that are soaked with a flammable material.  It is burning, producing plenty of light.

use_action.msg: The torch is extinguished.

masonrysaw_off.name: masonry saw (off)
masonrysaw_off.description: This is a construction tool for cutting through concrete or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon or a terrible chainsaw.

use_action.msg: You turn on the masonry saw.

masonrysaw_on.name: masonry saw (on)
masonrysaw_on.description: This masonry saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the masonry saw.

anesthetic_kit.name: anesthesia kit
anesthetic_kit.description: A kit for inducing anesthesia for surgery, containing specialized canisters with a variety of powerful hypnotic, analgetic, and stimulative drugs.  It's intended for use in specialized medical equipment, and can't be administered manually.

autoclave.name: autoclave
autoclave.description: This is an autoclave.  It's useful for sterilizing things like CBMs.  It requires a massive amount of power, so standard batteries will not power it sufficiently.  Examine a non-sterile CBM and mend it to sterilize.

inhaler.name: inhaler
inhaler.description: Albuterol inhaler.  Used in the treatment of bronchospasm, it is a lifeline for people with asthma.  A mild stimulant, it may cause nervousness or tremors.

rx12_injector.name: RX12 jet injector
rx12_injector.description: The Rivtech RX12 jet injector is a small pistol-shaped device used to inject advanced fast-healing chemicals through the skin without using a needle.  A label on the side warns against using more than two doses per hour.

smoxygen_tank.name: emergency oxygen pack
smoxygen_tank.description: This is a small tank of compressed medical oxygen with a folding regulator and mask.  Commonly used in emergency situations, it provides immediate relief for asthma attacks or smoke inhalation, and can provide a brief burst of energy.

syringe.name: syringe
syringe.description: A medical syringe.  Used for administering intravenous drugs.

oxygen_tank.name: oxygen tank
oxygen_tank.description: This is tank of compressed medical oxygen with a regulator and mask.  Commonly used in emergency situations, it provides immediate relief for asthma attacks or smoke inhalation, and can provide a brief burst of energy.

autodoc_couch.name: Autodoc operation couch
autodoc_couch.description: A plush red sofa made less comfortable by the medical machinery directly above it.  It has a single leather strap on the right armrest.

autodoc.name: Autodoc Mk. XI
autodoc.description: A surgical apparatus used for installation and removal of bionics.  It's only as skilled as its operator.

char_forge.name: charcoal forge
char_forge.description: This is a portable, charcoal fired, metalworking forge.  If combined with the right tools, you could use this for metalworking, or it could be used to repair metal items.

forge.name: electric forge
forge.description: This is a portable electric metalworking forge, powered by batteries.  Combined with the right tools, you could use this for metalworking, or it could be used to repair metal items.  With a little mechanical know-how, you could probably even convert it to run directly off a vehicle's power system.

hydraulic_press.name: hydraulic press
hydraulic_press.description: A large, barely portable hydraulic press, that uses a 36kW motor to squash whatever needs squashing.  Do not put your hand in here, it will get squashed.  Can run off heavy-duty batteries, installed to run off a power grid, or mounted on a vehicle.

airhorn.name: compressed air horn
airhorn.description: This is a small can of compressed air attached to a plastic horn.  Pressing the button on top causes it to emit a loud honking sound.

use_action.no_charges_message: You depress the button but no sound comes out.

flamable_arrow.name: flammable arrow
flamable_arrow.description: This arrow has a rag soaked in a flammable liquid wrapped around the shaft near the head.  You need to light it before shooting.

horn_bicycle.name: bicycle horn
horn_bicycle.description: This is a simple bulb horn, found on many bicycles.  Use to honk.  Honk honk.

large_space_heater.name: large space heater
large_space_heater.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees C and fills a larger volume of air than the smaller version.

use_action.msg: You turn on the heater.

large_space_heater_on.name: large space heater (on)
large_space_heater_on.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees C and fills a larger volume of air than the smaller version.

use_action.msg: You turn off the heater.

lifestraw.name: lifestraw
lifestraw.description: Set the lifestraw in suspect water, let sit for one minute then drink.  The two part filtration system will purify the water you drink.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.

permanent_marker.name: permanent marker
permanent_marker.description: This is a King Size(tm) industrial strength permanent marker, about halfway between a typical marker and a can of spray paint in size.  Use it to write something down.  However, writing "Elbereth" probably won't help you.

pheromone.name: zombie pheromone
pheromone.description: This is a disgusting ball of rotting meat of zombie origin.  Squeezing this gland causes a small cloud of pheromones to spray into the air.  Apparently the foul secretion can change zombies' attitude towards you, and they may ignore you for a short period of time.  Perhaps they briefly consider you as one of them.

small_space_heater.name: small space heater
small_space_heater.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees C.

use_action.msg: You turn on the heater.

small_space_heater_on.name: small space heater (on)
small_space_heater_on.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees C.

use_action.msg: You turn off the heater.

spray_can.name: spray can
spray_can.description: This is a spray can, filled with paint.  Use this tool to make graffiti on the floor or to paint objects.

super_spray_can.name: Prototype CMHP-9000
super_spray_can.description: You dont really know what this is, it appears to be filled with paint. But the paint seems to be shimmering and switching colors as you look at it. Use this tool to make graffiti on the floor or to paint objects.

stepladder.name: stepladder
stepladder.description: This is a wooden stepladder.  Use it to set it down.

survival_marker.name: survival marker
survival_marker.description: This is a sharpened piece of charcoal that is almost guaranteed to make your hands all covered in charcoal.  Use it to write something down.

tear_gas_payload.name: tear gas payload
tear_gas_payload.description: This is a dummy item used by tear gas hacks.  You should never see it outside of debug.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the payload.

tear_gas_payload_act.name: active tear gas payload
tear_gas_payload_act.description: This is a dummy item used by tear gas hacks that just so happens to be counting down.  You should never see it outside of debug.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.

vortex_stone.name: vortex stone
vortex_stone.description: This is a stone with spirals all over it, and holes around its perimeter.  Though it is fairly large, it weighs next to nothing.  Air seems to gather around it.

whistle_multitool.name: whistle multitool
whistle_multitool.description: A cheap gadget combining a whistle, thermometer, magnifying glass, and compass.

embryo.name: artificial womb
embryo.description: This artificial womb holds a nearly fully grown clone, nurtured from extracted DNA within a cloning vat.  Activate it, and the organism will swiftly complete its development and emerge ready to function.  Ideal for quickly repopulating herds, restoring endangered species, or deploying engineered creatures with minimal wait.

use_action.friendly_msg: The cloned creature seems to enjoy your presence.
use_action.hostile_msg: The cloned creature seems aloof to you!

embryo_empty.name: artificial womb
embryo_empty.description: A single-use vessel for transporting clones safely from the cloning vat to the field.  Currently empty, if sufficiently sterile it can be used by a cloning vat to grow a creature from a viable DNA sample.

item_var_viewer.name: object variable viewer
item_var_viewer.description: A compact analyzer that scans any nearby object and reveals every stored variable for quick debugging without needing to drop the object.  It can also add, update, or remove item variables.

banjo.name: banjo
banjo.description: A standard factory-made banjo.  Looks to be in working condition.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your banjo.
You play a bluegrass tune on your banjo.
You play a quick, Southern ditty on your banjo.

bone_flute.name: bone flute
bone_flute.description: A polished bone flute with five finger holes.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your flute.
You play a beautiful piece on your flute.
You play a piece on your bone flute that resembles the howling wind through Aurignacian caves.
Your bone flute wails for the fallen during the hunt.

wood_flute.name: wooden flute
wood_flute.description: A simple flute carved from wood with five finger holes.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your flute.
You play a beautiful piece on your flute.
You play a piece on your flute that resembles the howling wind through Aurignacian caves.
Your flute wails for the fallen during the hunt.

clarinet.name: clarinet
clarinet.description: An ornate clarinet made from wood.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your clarinet.
You play a moving, orchestral piece on your clarinet.
You play an uplifting marching tune on your clarinet.
You play a little tune on your flute.
You play a beautiful piece on your flute.
You play a piece on your flute that sounds harmonious with nature.

trumpet.name: trumpet
trumpet.description: A brass trumpet with only a few dents here and there.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your trumpet.
You play a slow, mourning piece on your trumpet.
You play a little ballad on your trumpet.

ukulele.name: ukulele
ukulele.description: A small factory made ukulele.  Looks to be in working condition.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your ukulele.
You play a cute little ditty on your ukulele.
You play a small jam on your ukulele.

violin.name: violin
violin.description: A cheap, factory-made violin with a built-in holder for a bow.  Still produces a nice sound.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your violin.
You play a beautiful orchestral piece on your violin.
You play a quick, southern ditty on your fiddle.

violin_golden.name: golden fiddle
violin_golden.description: A shiny golden fiddle, with a strange aura around it.  You feel like it once belonged to the best there's ever been.

player_descriptions: You play a quick, folksy tune on your fiddle.
As you pull the bow across its strings, it makes an evil hiss.
You play a tune so fierce, it feels like hell's broke loose.

elec_shears.name: electric shears
elec_shears.description: These electric shears can be used to shear animals quicker.

radiocontrol.name: RC control
radiocontrol.description: A remote control for RC cars, with joystick to steer the car and colorful buttons that don't seem to do anything.  Perhaps they were for the deluxe model?

radio_car.name: RC car
radio_car.description: A remote-controlled car.  Fun for young and old alike.

radio_car_on.name: RC car (on)
radio_car_on.description: This remote-controlled car is on, and draining its batteries just like a real electric car!  Use a remote control to drive it around.

radio_mod.name: radio activation mod
radio_mod.description: This small piece of electronics can be attached to certain items and activate them after receiving a radio signal.

radio.name: radio (off)
radio.description: This is a portable radio.  Using this radio turns it on.  It will pick up any nearby signals being broadcast and play them audibly.

radio_on.name: radio (on)
radio_on.description: This portable radio is turned on, and continually draining its batteries.  It is playing the broadcast being sent from any nearby radio towers.

two_way_radio.name: two-way radio
two_way_radio.description: This is a radio with a transmitting unit.  You could use it to contact someone who also has one.  Unfortunately no one seems to use those nowadays…

remotevehcontrol.name: remote vehicle controller
remotevehcontrol.description: A remote controller for real cars.  Can turn onboard devices on and off.  Some cars can be driven remotely.

canister_goo.name: goo canister
canister_goo.description: There is a label on this canister: "Warning: contains highly toxic and corrosive materials.  Contents may be sentient.  Open at your own risk." You think you can feel something moving inside it.

chemistry_set.name: chemistry set
chemistry_set.description: This is a chemistry set stored in a box.  The contents include glass containers, hoses, metal wire, a hotplate, and safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined.

electrolysis_kit.name: electrolysis kit
electrolysis_kit.description: A set of wiring and electrodes for applying a direct current, usually to a liquid.  Useful for crafting.  Load with a storage battery or 12V vehicle battery to use.

hydrogen_tank.name: hydrogen tank
hydrogen_tank.description: This is a tank of compressed hydrogen gas.  If you need to make water from scratch, or lift a zeppelin, it could come in handy.

nitrogen_tank.name: nitrogen tank
nitrogen_tank.description: This is a tank of compressed nitrogen gas.  Nitrogen is useful for its lack of reactivity.  Don't try to breathe it.

oxygen_cylinder.name: oxygen cylinder
oxygen_cylinder.description: A large steel cylinder used for storing pressurized gas.  It is marked with a faded, but legible O2 symbol.

carbondioxide_tank.name: carbon dioxide tank
carbondioxide_tank.description: This is a tank of compressed carbon dioxide gas.

portal.name: portal generator
portal.description: This is a rare, bizarre, and arcane device of an otherworldly nature.  It's giving you a headache just looking at it.  It is covered in alien markings.

teleporter.name: teleporter
teleporter.description: This is an experimental device that will teleport you a short distance when activated.

weather_reader.name: Doppler Radar Turbo 2000
weather_reader.description: A briefcase with built-in laptop that looks like it's from the 80s.  Its vintage monochrome monitor displays a plethora of meteorological data.  No sign of the FLDSMDFR, however.

analytical_set_basic.name: basic laboratory analysis kit
analytical_set_basic.description: This hefty kit contains some basic things you should probably not try to do precise chemistry without: namely, a small balance scale, a spectrophotometer, a melting point apparatus, a pH meter, and a set of paper for thin layer chromatography.  This makes it a lot easier to feel confident that the chemical you've made is what you think you've made.

spectrophotometer.name: spectrophotometer
spectrophotometer.description: This ubiquitous analytical chemistry tool measures the light absorption of a liquid sample in a special tube called a cuvette.

ph_meter.name: pH meter
ph_meter.description: This is basically a pair of glass probes on a voltmeter.  By putting one probe into a calibration solution (conveniently included) and the other in a substance, you can calculate the acidity.

voltmeter.name: voltmeter
voltmeter.description: This device has two probes that let you measure the electrical potential between two points.  Activate to check the status of any local grid connections or battery charge in your surroundings, as well as make modifications to grid connections

melting_point.name: melting point apparatus
melting_point.description: This is basically a hot plate, with a metal housing attached.  The metal housing has a magnification viewport and a slot into which a capillary tube containing a crystallized sample is inserted.  The device lets you precisely measure the melting point of a crystal, a property very useful in identifying what it is and how pure it is.

microcentrifuge.name: microcentrifuge
microcentrifuge.description: This is a smaller, benchtop version of the larger furniture-sized centrifuge.  Don't be fooled by its portable scale; it's still a very powerful piece of equipment that can spin stuff really quickly.  It's not a toy!

3d_printer_basic.name: 3D printer
3d_printer_basic.description: Although it's not nearly as fancy as the experimental nanofabricators, this civilian-grade 3D printer can produce almost any item out of plastic, polymer, or carbon fiber…  so long as you can program it.  It's also useful for repairing items made out of plastic or carbon fiber.

3d_printer_advanced.name: advanced 3D printer
3d_printer_advanced.description: Recent advances in 3D printing technology have resulted in the ability to quickly and cheaply 3D print metals and alloys.  Such 3D printers are highly expensive, but sought out by collectors and preppers alike.  In addition to crafting, it can be used to repair polymer and metal items alike, or permeate fabric items with carbon fiber for added protection.

large_tent_kit.name: large tent
large_tent_kit.description: This is a family sized tent.  It provides a large amount of space, but is very bulky.

shelter_kit.name: shelter kit
shelter_kit.description: This is a small shelter, made of sticks and skins.  Use it to place.

tent_kit.name: tent
tent_kit.description: This is a small personal tent, it's just big enough to fit you comfortably.

advanced_ecig.name: boxmod vape
advanced_ecig.description: An advanced version of the electronic cigarette.  A less harmful way to get your nicotine fix than regular cigarettes, but still addictive.  It needs batteries and nicotine liquid to function.  The side has a display showing the battery and amount of nicotine liquid left.  Additionally, it allows you to play simple games on it.

use_action.activation_message: You take a puff from your boxmod vape.

ecig.name: disposable vape
ecig.description: This battery-operated device vaporizes a liquid that contains flavorings and nicotine.  A less harmful alternative to traditional cigarettes, but it's still addictive.  It can't be reused once it's empty.  The side has a display showing the battery and amount of nicotine liquid left.

use_action.activation_message: You take a puff from your disposable vape.

dab_pen.name: dab pen
dab_pen.description: This is a dab pen for vaporizing cannabis.  Now all you need is 'thc distillate' and you're ready to rock and roll.

use_action.activation_message: You hit your dab pen. Sooooo smooth...

dab_pen_disposable.name: disposable dab pen
dab_pen_disposable.description: This is a disposable dab pen for vaporizing cannabis.  This one is already filled with distillate for your convenience, but can't be recharged.

use_action.activation_message: You hit your disposable dab pen. Sooooo smooth...

nectar_collector.name: nectar collector
nectar_collector.description: This is a metal and wooden nectar collector.  The top cover can be attached and detached magnetically.  The wood has engravings depicting bees, honey, and flowers.  You need 'thc wax' to use this item.

use_action.activation_message: You heat the nectar collector and hit it. Sooooo smooth...

pen.name: pen
pen.description: A plastic ball point pen.  Use it to write something down.

needle_bone.name: bone needle
needle_bone.description: This is sharp needle made from a bone.  It would be useful for making rough clothing and items.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision.

needle_curved.name: curved needle
needle_curved.description: A curved sharp needle made of steel.  Its rounded shape allows it to make stitches that only pierce one side of the material.  While unsuitable for most tailoring projects, it's a necessity for stitching neoprene.

needle_wood.name: wooden needle
needle_wood.description: This is a wooden needle whittled down to a sharp point.  It has a narrow hole carved into the head for threading.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision, or involving tougher materials like Kevlar.

sewing_kit.name: sewing kit
sewing_kit.description: This is a plastic kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, and a few other useful textile tools.  Use a sewing kit on an article of clothing to attempt to repair or reinforce that clothing.  This uses your tailoring skill, and can also sew pockets or warmer liner into your gear, or resize it for mutant wearers.

tailors_kit.name: tailor's kit
tailors_kit.description: This is a high quality kit consisting of a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, some small scissors, and an awl.  Using your tailoring skill, this kit can customize your clothing and armor, whether up-armoring them or altering some items to fit mutant wearers.

sewing_machine.name: sewing machine
sewing_machine.description: A sturdy foot-crank sewing machine for fast stitching and repairs.

elec_hairtrimmer.name: electric hair trimmer
elec_hairtrimmer.description: This is a pocket-sized electric trimmer made for cutting hair.  You can use it to cut your hair if it's supplied with batteries.  It requires 10 batteries per use.

mop_folded.name: collapsible mop
mop_folded.description: A long unwieldy mop with a collapsible handle for convenient transportation.  You may use it to clean up any 'mess' you have made.

shavingkit.name: shaving kit
shavingkit.description: This is a compact and lightweight shaving kit made for travelers.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.

survivor_shavingkit.name: makeshift shaving kit
survivor_shavingkit.description: This is a makeshift shaving kit.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.

chainsaw_off.name: chainsaw (off)
chainsaw_off.description: This is a lumbering tool moonlighting as weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with gas, using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

use_action.msg: You turn on the chainsaw.

chainsaw_on.name: chainsaw (on)
chainsaw_on.description: This chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the chainsaw.

circsaw_off.name: circular saw (off)
circsaw_off.description: A lightweight handheld cordless circular saw.  Spins a circular blade fast enough to cut wood, zombies, or in an emergency, pizza.  The blade, while effective in combat, is hard to hit with due to its small size.

use_action.msg: You turn on the circular saw.

circsaw_on.name: circular saw (on)
circsaw_on.description: A lightweight handheld cordless circular saw.  It is currently on and the blade is spinning; use this item to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the circular saw.

elec_chainsaw_off.name: electric chainsaw (off)
elec_chainsaw_off.description: This is a lumbering tool moonlighting as weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with batteries, using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

use_action.msg: You turn on the electric chainsaw.

elec_chainsaw_on.name: electric chainsaw (on)
elec_chainsaw_on.description: This electric chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn off the electric chainsaw.

stone_chisel.name: stone chisel
stone_chisel.description: This is a short stone chisel.  It can be used to engrave on stone, wood, or soft metals.

angle_grinder.name: angle grinder
angle_grinder.description: This widespread powertool is often used for removing excess material or polishing surfaces.

brick_kiln.name: brick kiln
brick_kiln.description: This is a portable charcoal-fired kiln.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.

chipper.name: paint chipper
chipper.description: A tool similar to a chisel, designed to remove paint.

con_mix.name: concrete mixer
con_mix.description: A portable concrete mixer.  It is still large and heavy, but it can be operated solo, and runs on batteries.  It also has a heater built in.

cordless_drill.name: cordless drill
cordless_drill.description: This is a cordless battery-powered drill with a selection of drill bits.

elec_jackhammer.name: electric jackhammer
elec_jackhammer.description: This is a construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on a rechargeable cell, optionally compatible with UPS.  Use it to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.

plumber_toolkit.name: plumbing kit
plumber_toolkit.description: A compact kit for probing, joining, and extending fluid grid connections in buildings.

jackhammer.name: jackhammer
jackhammer.description: This is a construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Use it (if loaded) to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.

auger.name: Auger
auger.description: This is a construction tool for boring holes in ground.  It runs on gasoline.  For health reasons alone, augers are a worthwhile investment.

kiln.name: electric kiln
kiln.description: This is a portable electric kiln, powered by batteries.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.  With a little mechanical know-how, you could probably even convert it to run directly off a vehicle's power system.

large_repairkit.name: gunsmith repair kit
large_repairkit.description: This is a complete toolkit made to repair damaged firearms, disassemble ammunition and manufacture firearm modifications.  Powered by standard batteries, it can tackle any armory work when coupled with a hand press.  It requires 25 charges of battery power per use.

misc_repairkit.name: misc repair kit
misc_repairkit.description: This is a portable toolkit, consisting of a small carving knife for precise carving of replacement parts from raw materials, a wood saw for more heavy-duty wood cutting, and a patch of soft material for cleaning surfaces.  If supplied with duct tape, it can be used to repair certain items.

misc_repairkit_makeshift.name: makeshift repair kit
misc_repairkit_makeshift.description: This is a portable toolkit, consisting of a primitive knife for carving replacement parts, an adze for more heavy-duty wood cutting, and a patch of soft material for cleaning surfaces.  It can be used to repair certain items if supplied with pitch, though it isn't ideal for complex work.

oxy_torch.name: acetylene torch
oxy_torch.description: A compact tool kit intended for welding and cutting metal, this portable oxyacetylene torch includes a torch handle and cutting attachment in an easy-to-carry tote.  It requires connecting to pressurized cylinders of an appropriate welding gas before use.  In addition to its metalworking uses, you can activate it in order to destroy metal barriers.

polisher.name: electric polisher
polisher.description: An electric polisher which can be used to buff metal surfaces until they are reflective like a mirror.

small_repairkit.name: firearm repair kit
small_repairkit.description: This is a portable toolkit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 100 charges of battery power per use.

soldering_iron.name: electric soldering iron
soldering_iron.description: This is a device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  You could also use it to cauterize wounds, if you had to.

soldering_ethanol.name: alcohol-fueled soldering iron
soldering_ethanol.description: This is a device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  A metal tip is hold over the burner to create enough heat to solder.  Not as sophisticated as a regular soldering iron.

welder.name: arc welder
welder.description: This is a battery powered tool for welding metal pieces together using an electric arc.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or repair.

folding_poncho.name: folded poncho
folding_poncho.description: A folded lightweight plastic rain poncho with a hood.  Use it to unfold for use.

emer_blanket.name: folded emergency blanket
emer_blanket.description: A folded blanket made of space-age materials that covers your most important body parts.  Use it to unfold for use.

jumper_cable.name: jumper cable
jumper_cable.description: A jumper cable, like you've seen many times before: it's a short multi-stranded copper cable with power leads on either end, whose main purpose is to share power between vehicles, but can also link other electrical systems.

hd_tow_cable.name: heavy duty tow cable
hd_tow_cable.description: An extremely heavy duty tow cable made from thick steel wire.  If attached to a vehicle, it could be used to pull another vehicle of any weight.

jumper_cable_heavy.name: heavy-duty cable
jumper_cable_heavy.description: A long, thick, heavy-duty cable with power leads on either end.  It looks like you could use it to hook up two vehicles to each other.  Can also link other electrical systems.

jumper_cable_debug.name: shiny cable
jumper_cable_debug.description: This is the cable of the gods: 50 meters long, light as a feather and fits in a matchbook.  You're sure this wasn't supposed to exist, and the way it shimmers makes you uneasy.

black_box.name: military black box
black_box.description: This is a black box, seemingly pulled from some sort of military vehicle wreckage.  If you can find a system to analyze this, you may find something of interest.

minireactor.name: minireactor
minireactor.description: A small portable plutonium reactor.  Handle with great care!

acid_artillery_shell_act.name: fuming acidic mass
acid_artillery_shell_act.description: A congealed mass of roiling acidic goop.  It's expanding as if it's about to burst, get back!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: Why are you trying to touch it?  Run!

unstable_grub_bomb.name: acid grub bomb
unstable_grub_bomb.description: Fake ammo for unstable acid grub.

unstable_grub_bomb_act.name: acid grub bomb
unstable_grub_bomb_act.description: The acidic liquid mass is bubbling away. It's about to burst!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: The acidic liquid mass is bubbling away! It's about to burst!

bot_unstable_grub.name: inactive unstable acid grub
bot_unstable_grub.description: This is an unstable acid grub generated by an acid-spawner zombie. If you see this, it is a bug, literally.

fertilizer_bomb.name: fertilizer bomb
fertilizer_bomb.description: This is a volatile homemade explosive.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

use_action.msg: You light the %s.

fertilizer_bomb_act.name: fertilizer bomb (lit)
fertilizer_bomb_act.description: The fuse on this fertilizer bomb is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

fragment_bomb.name: fragment bomb
fragment_bomb.description: A crude and bulky improvised bomb.  Made from a container, an explosive surrounded by small pieces of metal and a fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the %s.

fragment_bomb_act.name: active fragment bomb
fragment_bomb_act.description: A crude and bulky improvised bomb.  Made from a container, an explosive surrounded by small pieces of metal and a fuse.  The fuse has been lit, you should throw it.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - what are you waiting for?

pipebomb.name: pipe bomb
pipebomb.description: This is a section of a pipe filled with explosive materials.  Use this item to light the fuse, which gives you five turns to get away from it before it detonates.  You'll need a lighter or some matches to use it.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the pipe bomb.

pipebomb_act.name: active pipe bomb
pipebomb_act.description: This pipe bomb's fuse is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

nail_bomb.name: nail bomb
nail_bomb.description: A crude and bulky improvised bomb.  Made from a container, an explosive surrounded by nails and a fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the %s.

nail_bomb_act.name: active nail bomb
nail_bomb_act.description: A crude and bulky improvised bomb.  Made from a container, an explosive surrounded by nails and a fuse.  The fuse has been lit, you should throw it.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - what are you waiting for?

tool_rdx_charge.name: RDX charge
tool_rdx_charge.description: This is a metal keg, filled with 50 liters worth of RDX and scrap metal.  Contains a core of primary explosive to ensure that the charge detonates completely and delivers its entire destructive power to everything in sight.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the explosive charge.  Clear the area!

tool_rdx_charge_act.name: active RDX charge
tool_rdx_charge_act.description: This is a metal keg, filled with 50 liters worth of RDX and scrap metal.  The fuse has been lit and once it ignites the primary explosive, the charge will detonate and rain fire and steel on everything in sight.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - clear the area immediately!

tool_black_powder_charge.name: black gunpowder charge
tool_black_powder_charge.description: This is a home-made explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with black gunpowder and scrap metal, equipped with a long fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Should explode in a few minutes…

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the black gunpowder charge.  Get rid of it quickly!

tool_black_powder_charge_act.name: active black gunpowder charge
tool_black_powder_charge_act.description: This is a home-made explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with black gunpowder and scrap metal, whose fuse has been lit, its final countdown starting.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - run!

laptop_boris.name: Ash's laptop computer
laptop_boris.description: A small, somewhat worn-out laptop computer.  The flip-top is decorated with various stickers.

use_action.training_msg: You update software and check logs, improving your understanding slightly.

use_action.msg: You light up the screen.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The laptop's batteries need more charge.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The laptop computer's batteries need more charge.

makeshift_grenade.name: makeshift grenade
makeshift_grenade.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have about 5 seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the makeshift grenade.

makeshift_grenade_act.name: active makeshift grenade
makeshift_grenade_act.description: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin; try throwing it instead.

matchbomb.name: match head bomb
matchbomb.description: This is a homemade bomb consisting of a bottle filled with match heads and equipped with a fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse; you will, of course, need a lighter in your inventory to do this.

use_action.msg: You light the match head bomb.

matchbomb_act.name: match head bomb (lit)
matchbomb_act.description: This is a bottle filled with match heads and equipped with a fuse.  This one has been lit, and its fuse is rapidly burning down.  You may not want to hold onto it much longer.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

tool_black_powder_bomb_act.name: active black gunpowder bomb
tool_black_powder_bomb_act.description: This is a tin can filled to the brim with black gunpowder and with a lit fuse stuck inside of it.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - throw it!

hobo_stove_on.name: hobo stove (lit)
hobo_stove_on.description: This is a small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can or similar container of the right size.  Useful for defrosting and reheating food, uses simple tinder.

use_action.msg: The ember is extinguished.

firemachete_off.name: No. 9
firemachete_off.description: This huge steel knife has been modified with a fuel tank, insulated handguard, and ignition system.  When filled with gasoline, a system of torches heats the blade, burning your target.

firemachete_on.name: No. 9
firemachete_on.description: This huge steel knife has been modified with a fuel tank, insulated handguard, and ignition system.  The blade is glowing with heat, making it a great plant scorcher and nightlight.

use_action.water_extinguish_message: Your No. 9 hisses in the water and goes out.

tool_rdx_sand_bomb.name: RDX sand bomb
tool_rdx_sand_bomb.description: This is a steel pipe, containing a mixture of RDX and sand, the former propelling the latter into a deadly mist of vicious shrapnel.  Use this item to light the fuse.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the sand bomb.  Throw it!

tool_rdx_sand_bomb_act.name: active RDX sand bomb
tool_rdx_sand_bomb_act.description: This is a steel pipe, containing a mixture of RDX and sand, the former propelling the latter into a deadly mist of vicious shrapnel.  The fuse has been lit, so why are you still holding it?

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - what are you waiting for?

heatpack_used.name: used heat pack
heatpack_used.description: This is a chemical heat pack.  It's used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  This one has been used and is chemically inert, rendering it useless.

bot_rifleturret.name: inactive autonomous M249 CROWS II
bot_rifleturret.description: This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56x45mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56x45mm rounds you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M249.
bot_rifleturret.name_plural: inactive autonomous M249 CROWS II turrets

bot_crows_m240.name: inactive autonomous M240 CROWS II
bot_crows_m240.description: This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 7.62x51mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 7.62x51mm rounds you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M240.
bot_crows_m240.name_plural: inactive autonomous M240 CROWS II turrets

bot_antimateriel.name: inactive M2HB autonomous CROWS II
bot_antimateriel.description: This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded .50 BMG rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever .50 BMG rounds you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M2HB.
bot_antimateriel.name_plural: inactive M2HB autonomous CROWS II turrets

bot_turret.name: inactive turret
bot_turret.description: This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 9x19mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 9x19mm you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its SMG.

hand_axe.name: stone hand axe
hand_axe.description: This is a broad piece of stone with an edge narrow enough to roughly chop wood.

makeshift_axe.name: metal hand axe
makeshift_axe.description: This is a chunk of steel with one edge hammered down to something resembling a cutting edge.  It works passably well as an axe but really can't compare to a proper axe.

sieve_primitive.name: wicker sieve
sieve_primitive.description: This is a primitive sieve constructed from woven strips of plant material.  Early sieves like this were used to sift grain, though the openings on this one are too small for that.

sieve_steel.name: sieve
sieve_steel.description: This is no mere strainer for noodles; it's a sieve used to separate particles of certain sizes.  You could use this to do a really good job sifting flour, remove dust and soil from grain, or perhaps conduct gradiation tests for any civil engineers you might know.  This one has been constructed from steel mesh.

vac_oven_small.name: small vacuum oven
vac_oven_small.description: A small 0.9 cubic foot vacuum oven used to purge residual solvents out of liquids and solid.  Looks kind of like a microwave.

vac_oven_small_full.name: filled small vacuum oven
vac_oven_small_full.description: A small vacuum oven filled with extract ready to be purged of residual solvents.

use_action.msg: You turn on the vacuum oven and pump.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The vacuum oven's batteries need more charge.

vac_oven_small_on.name: small vacuum oven (on)
vac_oven_small_on.description: A small vacuum oven filled with extract currently purging out all residual solvents.  This process takes about 72hrs.

use_action.msg: The vacuum oven is done purging.  Your shatter is ready!
use_action.not_ready_msg: The vacuum oven is still purging.

vac_oven_small_done.name: finished small vacuum oven
vac_oven_small_done.description: A small vacuum oven filled with extract ready to package up for consumption.  WooHoo!

vac_pump.name: vacuum pump
vac_pump.description: A small belt driven mechanical pump capable of achieving a vacuum of -29.99 hg (50 microns).

use_action.msg: You turn on the vacuum pump.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The vacuum pump's batteries need more charge.

vac_pump_on.name: vacuum pump (on)
vac_pump_on.description: A small belt driven mechanical pump capable of achieving a vacuum of -29.99 hg (50 microns).

use_action.msg: You turn off the vacuum pump.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The vacuum pump's batteries need more charge.

dab_pen_on.name: dab pen (on)
dab_pen_on.description: This dab pen, for vaporizing cannabis, is turned on.  Now all you need is 'thc distillate' and you're ready to rock and roll.

use_action.msg: You turn off the dab pen.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The dab pen's batteries need more charge.

closed_loop_extractor_small.name: small closed loop extractor
closed_loop_extractor_small.description: A small closed loop extractor used for extracting essential oils from organic material producing a high quality extract.  It consists of a long metal tube clamped onto a steel "honey pot".  Organic material is packed in the tube, flushed with solvent, and essential oils gathered from the pot.  Must be powered up to operate.

use_action.msg: You turn on the small closed loop extractor.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The small closed loop extractor's batteries need more charge.

closed_loop_extractor_small_on.name: small closed loop extractor (on)
closed_loop_extractor_small_on.description: The small closed loop extractor is running, it just needs some material to pack the tube with and an organic solvent like butane and it's good to go.

use_action.msg: You turn off the small closed loop extractor.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The small closed loop extractor's batteries need more charge.

closed_loop_extractor_large.name: large closed loop extractor
closed_loop_extractor_large.description: A large machine used for extracting essential oils from large batches of organic material producing a low quality crude oil.  It consists of three long metal tubes funneled into a large drum that's set horizontally.  A series of hoses and tubes come out of the machine going to different valves.  It needs to be powered up to operate.

use_action.msg: You turn on the large closed loop extractor.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The large closed loop extractor's batteries need more charge.

closed_loop_extractor_large_on.name: large closed loop extractor (on)
closed_loop_extractor_large_on.description: The large closed loop extractor is running, it just needs some material to pack the tube with and an organic solvent like butane and it's good to go.

use_action.msg: You turn off the large closed loop extractor.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The large closed loop extractor's batteries need more charge.

oil_extractor_crude.name: makeshift essential oil extractor
oil_extractor_crude.description: A makeshift extraction system.  It's pretty much just a 55gal drum, a pipe to stir the solution, and a faucet at the bottom to drain the extractor.  Not the most ideal piece of equipment but it will work.

welder_crude.name: makeshift arc welder
welder_crude.description: This crude arc welder has been fashioned from a few small transformers, some wire, improvised electrode holder and complete disregard for personal safety.  While it's not as efficient as a factory welder, it will serve in a pinch.

multi_cooker_filled.name: multi cooker - cooking
multi_cooker_filled.description: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating.  There is a dish in it.

butane_can.name: can of butane
butane_can.description: A typical can of butane that you would normally use to fill a lighter.  It could be useful as a fuel, but also as a solvent or chemical reagent.

butane_tank.name: butane tank
butane_tank.description: This is a tank of liquid compressed butane.  It can be used to extract essential oils from organic material.

toolset_extended.name: extended toolset
toolset_extended.description: Your toolset, protruding from your hands.  It can slice, dice, and make everything nice.

washcloth.name: washcloth
washcloth.description: A piece of cloth that can be used for cleaning impervious surfaces.

chaos_dagger.name: chaos dagger
chaos_dagger.description: A small but surprisingly heavy knife seemingly made of crystalline bismuth, iridescent rectangular patterns twisting into a fractal towards the blade's edge.

use_action.msg: The chaos dagger starts shifting, the crystals moving about in a scintillating rainbow.

chaos_dagger_on.name: chaos dagger (shifting)
chaos_dagger_on.description: A small but surprisingly heavy knife seemingly made of crystalline bismuth, iridescent rectangular patterns twisting into a fractal towards the blade's edge.  The crystals are shifting as you look at them, rapidly growing, melding together and reforming.

use_action.msg: The chaos dagger goes still

debug_trait_enchantment.name: Trapezohedron of Edginess
debug_trait_enchantment.description: This is a debug-only item for testing enchantment mutations.  Wield it to stay up all night, become stealthy, and to see in the dark.

debug_pain_enchantment.name: Triacontahedron of Weightlessness
debug_pain_enchantment.description: This is a debug-only item for testing weight modification enchantments.

debug_pacifist_enchantment.name: Pyramid of Explosiveness
debug_pacifist_enchantment.description: This is a debug-only item for testing overkill enchantments.

ammolink25mm.name: 25x137mm autocannon belt linkage
ammolink25mm.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

25mm_casing.name: 25mm casing
25mm_casing.description: A canister from a spent 25mm shell.

105mm_casing.name: 105mm canister
105mm_casing.description: A canister from a spent 105mm shell, now an expensive paperweight.

120mm_case_base.name: 120mm case base
120mm_case_base.description: The steel case base from a spent 120mm shell.  With combustible case walls forming the bulk of the casing itself, what's left is now an expensive paperweight.

120mm_casing.name: makeshift 120mm canister
120mm_casing.description: A spent 120mm case base converted into an improved casing, by welding new case walls of appropriate dimensions to the base.  Hopefully the welds are good, or else it might be a better fit for a pipe bomb instead.

fetid_goop.name: fetid goop
fetid_goop.description: A foul smelling goop.  It has a disgusting texture and a powerful smell that overrides every other smell around it.

labmap.name: scientific operations map
labmap.description: A small, meticulously folded piece of paper, filled with tiny handwriting and some surprisingly precise diagrams of subway tunnels, access codes, ventilation shafts, and…guard shifts?  You have the feeling they weren't supposed to write any of this stuff down.

use_action.message: You add the hidden stations to your map

regionaltransportmap.name: regional transport map
regionaltransportmap.description: This is a printed guide to the local regional transportation systems.  This one specifically seems to show bus stations, airports, and entrances to subways.

use_action.message: You add the regional transportation systems to your map.

militarymap.name: military operations map
militarymap.description: This is a printed topographical map of the local area.  Originally of military origin, it details the locations of evacuation centers and military facilities.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and facilities to your map.

survivormap.name: survivor's map
survivormap.description: This is a hand-drawn map of the local area.  Whoever created it has marked down the locations of nearby supply sources including gun stores and gas stations.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and possible supply points to your map.

roadmap.name: road map
roadmap.description: This is a road map for the local area.  Listing information on civic sites like hospitals and police stations, it can be used to add points of interest to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and points of interest to your map.

subwaymap.name: subway maintenance map
subwaymap.description: This is a map of subway tunnels formerly used by public maintenance workers.  Using it will add subway lines and underground stations to your map.

use_action.message: You add subway lines and underground stations to your map.

labmap_mission.name: classified train information
labmap_mission.description: A large sheaf of documents ranging from maps of a classified underground rail network to secret cargo manifests.

use_action.message: You add the hidden stations to your map

sewermap.name: sewer maintenance map
sewermap.description: This is a map of sewer tunnels formerly used by public maintenance workers.  Using it will add sewer systems to your map.

use_action.message: You add the local sewer systems to your map.

cavemap.name: spelunker's map
cavemap.description: This is a handmade map of local caving spots, some requiring trespassing.  There's probably bigger worries than that now, though.

use_action.message: You mark potential entry points and underground routes in the margins of your map.

trailmap.name: trail guide
trailmap.description: This is a printed guide to the best local trails.  It has general details about the trails, trailhead amenities, suggestions for the best thru-hikes, and advice on interacting with local wildlife in a responsible and respectful manner.

use_action.message: You add trails and trailheads to your map.

touristmap.name: tourist guide
touristmap.description: This is glossy printed pamphlet for tourists that details local hotels and attractions.

use_action.message: You add roads and tourist attractions to your map.

restaurantmap.name: restaurant guide
restaurantmap.description: This is glossy printed pamphlet that details dining establishments in the local area.  Printed by the Chamber of Commerce, it lists the addresses of all the best diners and bars.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and restaurants to your map.

waterwaymap.name: waterway map
waterwaymap.description: This is a map of local rivers and lakes, along with the location of notable points of interest such as marinas and lighthouses.

use_action.message: You add local waterways and notable features on the shore to your map.

urbexmap.name: urban explorer's map
urbexmap.description: This is a printout of a local road map, with several buildings circled in red.  Using it will add roads and abandoned buildings to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and abandoned buildings to your map.

satellitemap.name: satellite map
satellitemap.description: This is a printed satellite map of the local area.  Due to it's low quality and lack of map legend, you are unable to recognise most buildings.  Using it will add terrain and roads to your map.

use_action.message: You add terrain and roads to your map.

manual_boxing.name: Practical Pugilism
manual_boxing.description: A complete guide to boxing.  Let's get ready to rough-up some ruffians!

manual_centipede.name: The Centipede Lu Feng
manual_centipede.description: A complete guide to Centipede Kung Fu.

manual_crane.name: The Red Crane
manual_crane.description: A complete guide to Crane Kung Fu.

manual_dragon.name: The Jade Dragon
manual_dragon.description: A complete guide to Dragon Kung Fu.

manual_karate.name: The Shotokan Karate Handbook
manual_karate.description: A complete guide to Shotokan Karate.

manual_krav_maga.name: Complete Krav Maga
manual_krav_maga.description: A complete guide to Krav Maga.

manual_leopard.name: The Deaf Leopard
manual_leopard.description: A complete guide to Leopard Kung Fu.

manual_lizard.name: The Lizard Kuo Chui
manual_lizard.description: A complete guide to Lizard Kung Fu.

manual_muay_thai.name: Ultimate Muay Thai
manual_muay_thai.description: A complete guide to Muay Thai.

manual_niten.name: The Book of Five Rings
manual_niten.description: A primer on Miyamoto Musashi's style of combat and philosophy, Niten Ichi-Ryu.

manual_scorpion.name: The Scorpion Sun Chien
manual_scorpion.description: A complete guide to Scorpion Kung Fu.

manual_silat.name: The Indonesian Warrior
manual_silat.description: A complete guide to Pentjak Silat.

manual_snake.name: The Black Snake
manual_snake.description: A complete guide to Snake Kung Fu.

manual_tai_chi.name: Becoming One with the Tao
manual_tai_chi.description: A complete guide to T'ai Chi Ch'uan.

manual_tiger.name: The White Tiger
manual_tiger.description: A complete guide to Tiger Kung Fu.

manual_toad.name: The Toad Lo Mang
manual_toad.description: A complete guide to Toad Kung Fu.

manual_venom_snake.name: The Viper Wei Pai
manual_venom_snake.description: A complete guide to Viper Kung Fu.

manual_zui_quan.name: Zui Quan and You
manual_zui_quan.description: A complete guide to Zui Quan.

manual_wingchun.name: Beautiful Springtime
manual_wingchun.description: A complete guide to Wing Chun Kung-fu.

manual_medievalpole.name: Fior Di Battaglia
manual_medievalpole.description: A completely translated medieval guide teaching various techniques with polearms, there is a chapter about the many variations of common polearms… there are even pictures!

manual_swordsmanship.name: Historic European Swordfighting
manual_swordsmanship.description: A complete guide to medieval swordsmanship.  Compares the German and Italian traditions for longsword and side sword, in and out of armor, with and without shield.

material_shrd_limestone.name: limestone shard
material_shrd_limestone.description: A small shard of limestone.  Pretty flimsy and not much of a weapon, but its alkaline properties may yet find some use.

material_rocksalt.name: rock salt
material_rocksalt.description: A handful of rock salt crystals.  Could be refined into table salt.

material_rhodonite.name: rhodonite
material_rhodonite.description: A chunk of rhodonite.  It has manganese dioxide covering and going through it in veins, which can be obtained using a chisel.

material_zincite.name: zincite
material_zincite.description: A chunk of zincite.  Could be refined into zinc oxide, then into zinc by reduction with a source of carbon.

alpha_sample.name: alpha sample
alpha_sample.description: Pure superiority extracted from an alpha mutant.  Could be used by an experienced chemist to harness some of its power.

medical_sample.name: medical sample
medical_sample.description: Unnatural life extracted from a medical mutant.  Could be used by an experienced chemist to harness some of its power.

elfa_sample.name: elf-a sample
elfa_sample.description: Natural communion extracted from an elf-a mutant.  Could be used by an experienced chemist to harness some of its power.

iron_ore.name: chunk of iron ore
iron_ore.description: A large chunk of iron ore, from one source or another.  With the right knowhow, it could be smelted into usable metal.

copper_ore.name: chunk of copper ore
copper_ore.description: A small green chunk of copper ore, from one source or another.  With the right knowhow, it could be smelted into usable metal.

lead_ore.name: chunk of lead ore
lead_ore.description: A small yet dense chunk of lead ore, from one source or another.  With the right knowhow, it could be smelted into usable metal.

tin_ore.name: chunk of tin ore
tin_ore.description: A small, nondescript lump of metallic ore, seems to be tin.  With the right knowhow, it could be smelted into usable metal.

silver_ore.name: chunk of silver ore
silver_ore.description: Silver with a few million years of tarnish on it.  With the right knowhow, it could be smelted into usable metal.

gold_ore.name: chunk of gold ore
gold_ore.description: A small, dense chunk of what seems to be quartz,but what interests you is the gold interlaced. With the right knowhow, it could be smelted into usable metal.

geode.name: geode
geode.description: A large rock, sounds kinda hollow, could crack it open easy enough, wonder whats inside?

hickory_root.name: hickory root
hickory_root.description: A root from a hickory tree.  It has an earthy smell.

steel_grille.name: steel grille
steel_grille.description: This is a metal grille.  It can be used as a framework for making a chemical catalyst.

cobalt_60.name: cobalt-60 pellet
cobalt_60.description: Radioactive material that used to be a part of some nuclear industry equipment.  You are yet to find some use for it.

sandbag.name: sandbag
sandbag.description: This is a canvas sack filled with sand.  It can be used to construct simple barricades.

earthbag.name: earthbag
earthbag.description: This is a canvas sack filled with soil.  It can be used to construct simple barricades.

1st_aid.name: compact first aid kit
1st_aid.description: A compact medical kit containing bandages and antiseptic.  Used for healing large amounts of damage.  Disassemble to get its content.

1st_aid_deluxe.name: first aid kit
1st_aid_deluxe.description: A full medical kit, with bandages, antiseptic, local analgesics, and basic medical tools.  Used for healing large amounts of damage.  Disassemble to get its content.

mre_accessory.name: MRE - Accessory Pack
mre_accessory.description: An MRE accessory pack containing a variety of utensils and drinks.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.

mre_dessert.name: MRE - Dessert Pack
mre_dessert.description: A sealed plastic bag containing an array of desserts.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.

mre_chilibeans_box.name: MRE - Chili & Beans
