mre_chilibeans_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a chili & beans entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good.

mre_bbqbeef_box.name: MRE - BBQ Beef
mre_bbqbeef_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a BBQ beef entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_chickennoodle_box.name: MRE - Chicken & Noodles
mre_chickennoodle_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a chicken & noodles entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes bland and gross, even after all the flavoring added.

mre_spaghetti_box.name: MRE - Spaghetti
mre_spaghetti_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a spaghetti entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good.

mre_chicken_box.name: MRE - Chicken Chunks
mre_chicken_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a chicken chunk entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good, if not a bit bland.

mre_beeftaco_box.name: MRE - Beef Taco
mre_beeftaco_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a beef taco entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good, but the flavors are a bit off.

mre_beef_box.name: MRE - Beef Brisket
mre_beef_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a beef brisket entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_meatball_box.name: MRE - Meatballs & Marinara
mre_meatball_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a meatball entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good.

mre_beefstew_box.name: MRE - Beef Stew
mre_beefstew_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a beef stew entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_chilimac_box.name: MRE - Chili & Macaroni
mre_chilimac_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a chili & macaroni entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes fantastic, could be one of the best MRE menus you can get your hands on.

mre_veggy_box.name: MRE - Vegetarian Taco
mre_veggy_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a vegetarian taco entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes decent, not good but not offensive either.

mre_macaronimarinara_box.name: MRE - Macaroni Marinara
mre_macaronimarinara_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a macaroni marinara entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_cheesetort_box.name: MRE - Cheese Tortellini
mre_cheesetort_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a cheese tortellini entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good.

mre_mushroomfettuccine_box.name: MRE - Mushroom Fettuccine
mre_mushroomfettuccine_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a mushroom fettuccine entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes horrible, a few steps above the infamous vomelette.

mre_mexicanchickenstew_box.name: MRE - Mexican Chicken Stew
mre_mexicanchickenstew_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a Mexican chicken stew entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good.

mre_chickenburritobowl_box.name: MRE - Chicken Burrito Bowl
mre_chickenburritobowl_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a chicken burrito bowl entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_maplesausage_box.name: MRE - Maple Sausage
mre_maplesausage_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a maple sausage entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good.

mre_ravioli_box.name: MRE - Ravioli
mre_ravioli_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a ravioli entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes decent, but the flavor is just not there.

mre_pepperjackbeef_box.name: MRE - Pepper Jack Beef
mre_pepperjackbeef_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a pepper jack beef entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes decent and just a step above bland.

mre_hashbrownbacon_box.name: MRE - Hash Browns & Bacon
mre_hashbrownbacon_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a hash browns & bacon entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good.

mre_lemontuna_box.name: MRE - Lemon Pepper Tuna
mre_lemontuna_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a lemon pepper tuna entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes decent, the sweet flavor is just too strong.

mre_asianbeef_box.name: MRE - Asian Beef & Vegetables
mre_asianbeef_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with an asian beef & vegetables entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes good and exotic.

mre_chickenpesto_box.name: MRE - Chicken Pesto & Pasta
mre_chickenpesto_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a chicken pesto entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes decent, just enough to eat.

mre_southwestbeef_box.name: MRE - Southwest Beef & Beans
mre_southwestbeef_box.description: A 'Meal Ready to Eat' with a southwest beef & beans entree and everything a hungry soldier needs.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  This one tastes fantastic, could be one of the best MRE menus you can get your hands on.

mre_hotdog_box.name: MRE - Frankfurters & Beans
mre_hotdog_box.description: A vintage MRE, still perfectly preserved and edible.  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  You have the potential to become the first person on Earth to be capable of enjoying this, with enough training.

mre_omelette_box.name: MRE - Cheese Omelette
mre_omelette_box.description: A vintage MRE, still perfectly preserved and edible.  Or is it?  The contents are individually packed and will remain sealed after you open this box.  Activate or disassemble it to get to its contents.  If you dare.

rmi2_corpse.name: desiccated corpse
rmi2_corpse.description: A dead body, badly mangled and desiccated.  It seems whatever killed him did so with a gigantic claw.

corpse_generic_male.name: corpse
corpse_generic_male.description: A dead body of a middle-aged man.

corpse_generic_female.name: corpse
corpse_generic_female.description: A dead body of a young woman.

corpse_generic_boy.name: corpse
corpse_generic_boy.description: A dead body of a little boy.

corpse_generic_girl.name: corpse
corpse_generic_girl.description: A dead body of a little girl.

corpse_child_calm.name: corpse
corpse_child_calm.description: The dead body of a small child.  Their corpse bears a calm facial expression, as if they died instantly.

corpse_child_gunned.name: corpse
corpse_child_gunned.description: The dead body of a child, riddled by bullets to the extent that you can no longer tell their gender.

corpse_oldwoman_jewelry.name: corpse
corpse_oldwoman_jewelry.description: A dead body of an old woman.  Both of her earlobes are torn, several fingers on her hands have been chopped off, and several teeth have been knocked out.

corpse_bloody.name: corpse
corpse_bloody.description: A dead body, coated in congealed blood.

corpse_painful.name: corpse
corpse_painful.description: A dead body with a frightful grimace.  He appears to have been horribly mangled prior to his death.

corpse_scorched.name: corpse
corpse_scorched.description: An awful, almost unidentifiable mass of charred flesh.

corpse_stabbed.name: corpse
corpse_stabbed.description: A dead body with a gaping stab wound in its back.

corpse_gunned.name: corpse
corpse_gunned.description: The dead body of a person.  Their forehead bears a large bullet entrance wound.  An even larger exit wound is present on the back of their head.

corpse_halved_upper.name: corpse
corpse_halved_upper.description: The upper half of a dead body, as if torn apart with enormous force.  Some organs are hanging out.

corpse_half_beheaded.name: corpse
corpse_half_beheaded.description: A half-decapitated dead body.  It is unclear what could have caused such a wound.

broken_uafv_xm246e1.name: broken Mini-Tank UAFV
broken_uafv_xm246e1.description: A hulking wreck of treads, composite plating, and cold robotic hatred.  Hopefully won't ever be operational again, now only good for parts.

fake_hands.name: unarmed
fake_hands.description: Dummy item.  If you see this, then something went wrong.

fake_milling_item.name: semi ground grains
fake_milling_item.description: A paste of half-finished milled grains, not yet flour.

fake_smoke_plume.name: smoldering embers
fake_smoke_plume.description: A handful of smoldering embers emitting smoke.  They are fading away even when you look at them.

trade_writ_chemist.name: writ of trade (chemist)
trade_writ_chemist.description: A few sheets of paper from the chemist living out in the wilderness listing some of the chemicals they're capable of making.

trade_writ_scrap.name: writ of trade (scrap)
trade_writ_scrap.description: A handwritten listing of the inventory at the scrapyard.

trade_writ_lumberyard.name: writ of trade (lumberyard)
trade_writ_lumberyard.description: A printout of the local lumberyard's latest inventory.

magic_8_ball.name: Magic 8-Ball
magic_8_ball.description: A fortune-telling device from the 1950s.  The kind of moral support you didn't know you needed.

coin_quarter.name: coin
coin_quarter.description: A now-ancient form of currency.  Stripped of its original purpose, it now serves, faithfully, flippant Flippists for free.

family_photo.name: family photo
family_photo.description: A photo of a smiling family on a camping trip.  One of the parents looks like a cleaner, happier version of the person you know.

chess.name: chess set
chess.description: A wooden box containing all the equipment needed to play a game of chess.

checkers.name: checkers set
checkers.description: A wooden box containing a set of round tokens used to play checkers.

cards_magic.name: deck of Sorcery cards
cards_magic.description: A set of cards meant to play the game "Sorcery."  Each card has a fun picture of a different monster.

pictionary.name: Picturesque
pictionary.description: A game where one draws an image, and the others attempt to guess what it is.

monopoly.name: Capitalism
monopoly.description: A game where players traverse around the board buying property and swindling their friends.

dnd.name: Blobs and Bandits
dnd.description: A roleplaying game set in the post-apocalypse, so you can pretend to survive the apocalypse while surviving the apocalypse.

g_warhammer.name: Battlehammer
g_warhammer.description: A strategy game featuring a set of tiny figurines of fantasy creatures.

g_warhammer40k.name: Battlehammer 20k
g_warhammer40k.description: A strategy game featuring a set of tiny figurines of grotesque aliens and imperious space marines.

catan.name: Settlers of the Ranch
catan.description: A strategy game where players build settlements and trade for supplies.
catan.name_plural: sets of Settlers of the Ranch

battleship.name: Warships
battleship.description: A game where players try to guess where the opponent placed their ships on the board.

clue.name: Murder Mystery
clue.description: A game where players try to figure out who murdered the butler.

weightbench.name: exercise machine
weightbench.description: Typically used for, well, exercising.  Could be set up to pump some iron, or scrapped for parts.

ballmachine.name: ball machine
ballmachine.description: A machine used to launch various balls for different types of sports.  Could be set back up and connected to the grid to play with, or disassembled for parts.

table_pool.name: pool table
table_pool.description: A good-looking pool table.  Could be set back up or scrapped for parts.

arcade.name: arcade machine
arcade.description: Play stupid games, win stupid prizes.  That was the idea, anyway.  Good for all kinds of electronic parts, or you could hook it up to the grid and see if it still works.

pinball.name: pinball machine
pinball.description: Most underrated game of the 20th century.  Press buttons so the ball doesn't go in the hole.  Unless you hook it back up to the power grid, it's only good for parts.

ergometer.name: ergometer
ergometer.description: A rowing exercise machine, might have useful parts in it.  Could also be set back up if you feel you need the exercise.

treadmill.name: treadmill
treadmill.description: Used for training leg muscles.  If you set it back up and provide electrical power it'd be a great way to run in circles, otherwise it's just a source of scrap.

heavybag.name: punching bag
heavybag.description: Punch Punch!  Exercise those arms!  It won't be fighting back anytime soon, now it's only good for parts unless you set it back up.

strippole.name: dancing pole
strippole.description: Tall metal pole meant for dancing.  Setting it back up again will let you practice your moves.

table_roul.name: roulette table
table_roul.description: A big, scratched roulette table.  Could be set back up to take it for a spin, or just taken apart for material.

ammolink223.name: 5.56x45mm ammo belt linkage
ammolink223.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

ammolink308.name: 7.62x51mm ammo belt linkage
ammolink308.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

ammolink40mm.name: 40mm grenade belt linkage
ammolink40mm.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

ammolink50.name: .50 ammo belt linkage
ammolink50.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

ammolink277.name: 6.8x51mm 'Fury' ammo belt linkage
ammolink277.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

razor_shaving.name: shaving razor
razor_shaving.description: A razor blade on a comfortable handle.  Much easier to shave with than a loose razor.  Could also be used for some basic fine cutting tasks.

string_floss.name: dental floss
string_floss.description: Twenty-five yards of finely waxed thread wound up inside a plastic container.  Perfect for picking bits of smoked meat out of your teeth.  Disassemble to use the thread for something else.

comb_pocket.name: comb
comb_pocket.description: A grooming tool with teeth for straightening your hair.

hair_dryer.name: hair dryer
hair_dryer.description: This tool dries your hair by pushing air through a coil of hot wires.  Without a functioning power grid, it is a motorized paper weight.

curling_iron.name: curling iron
curling_iron.description: A wand made of heat-resistant ceramics.  When plugged into an outlet, it is hot enough to shape your hair into curls.  Too bad the power's out.

223_casing.name: 5.56x45mm casing
223_casing.description: An empty casing from a 5.56x45mm round.

22_casing.name: .22 casing
22_casing.description: A used, empty casing from a .22 round.

22_casing_new.name: primed .22 casing
22_casing_new.description: A like-new .22 rimfire casing, with fresh primer in the rim.

3006_casing.name: .30-06 casing
3006_casing.description: An empty casing from a .30-06 round.

300_casing.name: .300 Win Mag casing
300_casing.description: An empty casing from a .300 Winchester Magnum round.

308_casing.name: 7.62x51mm '.308 Winchester' casing
308_casing.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x51mm '.308 Winchester' round.

277_casing.name: 6.8x51mm 'Fury' casing
277_casing.description: An empty casing from a 6.8x51mm 'Fury' round.

762_51_casing.name: 7.62x51mm casing
762_51_casing.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x51mm M80 round.

32_casing.name: .32 ACP casing
32_casing.description: An empty casing from a .32 ACP round.

38_casing.name: .38 Special casing
38_casing.description: An empty casing from a .38 Special round.

40_casing.name: .40 S&W casing
40_casing.description: An empty casing from a .40 S&W round.

10mm_casing.name: 10mm Auto casing
10mm_casing.description: An empty casing from a 10mm Auto round.

40x46mm_casing.name: 40x46mm casing
40x46mm_casing.description: A large canister from a spent 40x46mm grenade cartridge.  With an ammunition press, it can be reconditioned for 40x46mm handloads.

40x53mm_casing.name: 40x53mm casing
40x53mm_casing.description: A large canister from a spent 40x53mm grenade cartridge.

44_casing.name: .44 Magnum casing
44_casing.description: An empty casing from a .44 Magnum round.

45_casing.name: .45 ACP casing
45_casing.description: An empty casing from a .45 ACP round.

45colt_casing.name: .45 Colt casing
45colt_casing.description: An empty casing from a .45 Colt round.

4570_casing.name: .45-70 casing
4570_casing.description: An empty casing from a .45-70 Government round.

5x50_hull.name: 5x50mm hull
5x50_hull.description: An empty plastic hull from a 5x50mm flechette round.

50_casing.name: .50 BMG casing
50_casing.description: An empty casing from a .50 BMG round.  These are rare, so you might want to hold onto these.

762R_casing.name: 7.62x54mmR casing
762R_casing.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x54mmR round.

762_casing.name: 7.62x39mm casing
762_casing.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x39mm round.

9mm_casing.name: 9x19mm casing
9mm_casing.description: An empty casing from a 9x19mm round.

357sig_casing.name: .357 SIG casing
357sig_casing.description: An empty casing from a .357 SIG round.

357mag_casing.name: .357 magnum casing
357mag_casing.description: An empty casing from a .357 magnum round.

380_casing.name: .380 ACP casing
380_casing.description: An empty casing from a .380 ACP round.

atgm_spent.name: 152mm ATGM tube
atgm_spent.description: An empty steel tube which once contained a 152mm ATGM.  Now it's essentially just a huge pipe.

shot_hull.name: shotgun hull
shot_hull.description: An empty hull from a shotgun shell.

410shot_hull.name: .410 hull
410shot_hull.description: An empty hull from a .410 shotgun shell.

300blk_casing.name: .300BLK casing
300blk_casing.description: An empty casing from a .300 AAC Blackout round.

FMCNote.name: Merch
FMCNote.description: The Free Merchant Certified Note, also known by names such as a 'c-note' or 'merch', is a currency based on old American bills.  Fifty dollar bills and larger are printed with a promissory note signed by the treasurer of the Free Merchants, along with a complex design.  The note explains that this can be exchanged for food, water, and other services through the Free Merchants in the Refugee Center.

RobofacCoin.name: Hub 01 Gold Coin
RobofacCoin.description: This is a small but surprisingly heavy gold coin.  One side is etched with circuitry and the other side reads 'Hub 01 exchange currency'.

FlatCoin.name: FlatCoin
FlatCoin.description: This is a coin that has been flattened in a novelty coin flattening machine.  The machine has been somewhat crudely altered so that the design - which appears to once have been Mickey Mouse - is overlaid with a handwritten emblem of a book.  There is some text that faintly reads 'Campus Exchange Token'.

signed_chit.name: chit
signed_chit.description: This is a slip of paper signed by the issuer.

icon.name: icon
icon.description: This is a small picture, about the same size as an ID card, symbolizing a religious figure.  On the back, there is a text that faintly reads 'New England Church Community'.

ceramic_plate.name: ceramic plate
ceramic_plate.description: A ceramic dinner plate, unremarkable in every way.

ceramic_bowl.name: ceramic bowl
ceramic_bowl.description: A perfectly ordinary ceramic soup bowl.

ceramic_cup.name: ceramic cup
ceramic_cup.description: A light ceramic teacup.  Quite classy.

ceramic_mug.name: coffee mug
ceramic_mug.description: A ceramic coffee cup with a logo on the side.

tin_plate.name: tin plate
tin_plate.description: A tin dinner plate, lightweight and clanky.

tin_cup.name: tin cup
tin_cup.description: An enameled tin cup.  Great for camping or for prison use; makes a wonderful sound when clanged along bars.

bowl_pewter.name: pewter bowl
bowl_pewter.description: A small pewter serving bowl without a lid.  Holds 250 ml of liquid.

wine_glass.name: wine glass
wine_glass.description: A stemmed drinking glass that makes you feel very fancy when you drink from it.

glass_bowl.name: glass bowl
glass_bowl.description: A glass bowl for soup or dessert.

tumbler_plastic.name: plastic tumbler
tumbler_plastic.description: A durable plastic drinking vessel.  This one is made of clear acrylic and looks almost like glass.

plastic_bowl_kids.name: kiddie bowl
plastic_bowl_kids.description: A plastic bowl designed for use by children.

sippy_cup.name: sippy cup
sippy_cup.description: A plastic cup with a spill-proof lid, designed for use by children.

pot.name: pot
pot.description: Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.

iron_pot.name: cast-iron pot
iron_pot.description: This hefty black pot is made from cast iron and coated in a sturdy enamel.

pot_copper.name: copper pot
pot_copper.description: Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.  Made from copper, with a lining of tin to prevent metal from leaching into acidic foods.

casserole.name: casserole
casserole.description: A ceramic pot made for both cooking and serving, particularly one-pot dinners.

stock_pot.name: stock pot
stock_pot.description: A large pot for making soup stocks.  You could fit a whole turkey in there, with a bit of shoving.

pot_canning.name: canning pot
pot_canning.description: A very large 25 liter pot, primarily meant for canning food in glass jars via the water bath method, though it can cook normal foods just as well.  Canning foods with it will require a lot of water.  If you're only canning a couple of jars at a time, you'd fill it up with rocks or something to displace the water above the lids.

pan.name: cast-iron frying pan
pan.description: A cast-iron pan.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.

steel_pan.name: steel frying pan
steel_pan.description: A steel frying pan.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.

copper_pan.name: copper frying pan
copper_pan.description: A copper frying pan, coated in a thin layer of tin.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.

pot_makeshift.name: makeshift pot
pot_makeshift.description: A sheet of metal crudely hammered into a cooking pot.  Good enough to cook food and boil water, but not as useful as proper cookware.

pot_makeshift_copper.name: makeshift copper pot
pot_makeshift_copper.description: A cooking pot crudely hammered out of copper.  Good enough to cook food and boil water, but not as useful as proper cookware.

kettle.name: kettle
kettle.description: A stovetop kettle for boiling water.

cable_xlr.name: XLR cable
cable_xlr.description: A balanced cable used for sending audio signal.  The connectors have three prongs.

cable_instrument.name: instrument cable
cable_instrument.description: Known as an instrument cable because it is usually used to connect a guitar to a powered amp, it is an unbalanced cable with 1/4" male connectors on each side.

headphones_circumaural.name: headphones
headphones_circumaural.description: Typical headphones that cover your ears.  A well-known brand that is very high quality, with a detachable 1/8" cable.  Comes with a 1/8" to 1/4" adaptor.

microphone_xlr_generic.name: XLR microphone
microphone_xlr_generic.description: A typical microphone used to record or amplify voice.  Comes with a clip.  Has a 3-pin XLR connector on the bottom in order to connect to am amp.

mic_stand_tall.name: microphone stand
mic_stand_tall.description: A telescoping boom stand made of steel and painted black.  About 6' tall when full extended, or 3' when closed fully.  Has threads for a mic clip on one end.

guitar_stand.name: guitar stand
guitar_stand.description: A small, oddly shaped piece of steel hardware with three legs.  When placed on the ground, this can support one guitar in an upright position.

mixer_music.name: mixer
mixer_music.description: A device with faders, switches, and knobs that mixes input signal and sends it to two output XLR cables.  (left and right)

drivebelt.name: drive belt
drivebelt.description: A synthetic rubber V-belt with steel reinforcement fibers commonly fitted to engines or other industrial equipment.

drivebelt_makeshift.name: makeshift drive belt
drivebelt_makeshift.description: An improvised belt useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

five-point_harness.name: 5-point harness
five-point_harness.description: A harness made of three belts meant to be mounted on vehicle to fasten a passenger securely to their seat.

filter_air.name: air filter
filter_air.description: A plastic box containing creped paper used to filter the air supply for combustion engines or other industrial equipment.

filter_air_makeshift.name: makeshift air filter
filter_air_makeshift.description: An improvised air filter useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

filter_liquid.name: automotive filter
filter_liquid.description: A steel can containing filter paper designed for automotive use.

filter_liquid_makeshift.name: makeshift automotive filter
filter_liquid_makeshift.description: An improvised automotive filter useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

glowplug.name: glow plug
glowplug.description: A cylindrical heating device designed to be screwed in to a diesel engine to aid starting in cold weather.

pump_complex.name: high-pressure pump
pump_complex.description: A complex mechanical pump capable of achieving high pressures.  Far beyond anything you could reasonably improvise.

well_pump.name: mechanical pump
well_pump.description: A simple cast iron mechanical impeller pump.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

cordage_6.name: short cordage piece
cordage_6.description: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper string.

cordage_36.name: long cordage piece
cordage_36.description: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper string.

cordage_6_leather.name: short leather cord
cordage_6_leather.description: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of rawhide or leather cord.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper string.

cordage_36_leather.name: long leather cord
cordage_36_leather.description: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of rawhide or leather cord.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper string.

string_36_plastic.name: long plastic cord
string_36_plastic.description: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of plastic cord.  Useful for a variety of purposes, but it's not as flexible as string.

string_6_plastic.name: short plastic cord
string_6_plastic.description: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of plastic cord.  Useful for a variety of purposes, but it's not as flexible as string.

string_6.name: short string
string_6.description: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of cotton string.

string_36.name: long string
string_36.description: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of cotton string.

rope_6.name: short rope
rope_6.description: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of rope.  Too small to be of much use.

rope_30.name: long rope
rope_30.description: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) long rope.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.

rope_6_plastic.name: short plastic rope
rope_6_plastic.description: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of plastic or nylon rope.  Too small to be of much use.

rope_30_plastic.name: long plastic rope
rope_30_plastic.description: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) length of plastic or nylon rope.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.

vine_6.name: short vine
vine_6.description: A sturdy 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long vine.  Too small to be of much use.

vine_30.name: long vine
vine_30.description: A sturdy 30-foot (or about 9 m) long vine.  Could easily be used as a rope.  Strong enough to suspend a large corpse for butchering.

rope_makeshift_6.name: short cordage rope
rope_makeshift_6.description: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper rope.

rope_makeshift_30.name: long cordage rope
rope_makeshift_30.description: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) long rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Not strong enough to hold up to falls, but still useful for some things, such as suspending large corpses for butchering.

seatbelt.name: seat belt
seatbelt.description: A length of synthetic fiber weaved into a flat band, usually used to securely fasten a passenger inside a vehicle.

apparatus.name: a smoking device and a source of flame
apparatus.name_plural: a smoking device and a source of flames

file.name: file
file.description: Several documents with all kinds of information, customer data and charts kept together, pretty useless now though.

classified_file_docmission.name: classified lab reports
classified_file_docmission.description: A large stack of papers detailing all manner of classified information regarding the secret labs.

log_immersion27.name: INCIDENT REPORT: IMMERSION-27A
log_immersion27.description: A white piece of paper, with a fancy-looking logo printed on its upper left corner.  It'd probably be very fascinating reading material.

report_t_substrate.name: MATERIAL: T-SUBSTRATE
report_t_substrate.description: A white piece of paper, with a fancy-looking logo printed on its upper left corner.  It'd probably be very fascinating reading material.

HAADF_t_substrate.name: HAADF MICROGRAPH: T-SUBSTRATE
HAADF_t_substrate.description: A white piece of paper, with a fancy-looking logo printed on its upper left corner.  It'd probably be very fascinating reading material.

physics_anomaly_description.name: CONTAINMENT PROCEDURES: PE-025-X
physics_anomaly_description.description: A white piece of paper, with a fancy-looking logo printed on its upper left corner.  It'd probably be very fascinating reading material.

physics_anomaly_epsilon.name: PROCEDURE 025-EPSILON
physics_anomaly_epsilon.description: A white piece of paper, with a fancy-looking logo printed on its upper left corner.  It'd probably be very fascinating reading material.

fp_loyalty_card.name: foodplace loyalty card
fp_loyalty_card.description: A bright pink loyalty card, all the points are stamped.  This would definitely prove your fidelity to Foodplace, if it still meant anything…

withered.name: withered plant
withered.description: A dead plant.  Good for starting fires or making a pile of leaves to sleep on.

fur.name: fur pelt
fur.description: A small bolt of fur from an animal.  Can be made into warm clothing.

faux_fur.name: faux fur pelt
faux_fur.description: A small bolt of garishly colored faux fur.  Can be made into clothing.

leather.name: leather patch
leather.description: A smallish patch of leather, could be used to make tough clothing.

felt_patch.name: felt patch
felt_patch.description: A smallish patch of felt, could be disassembled for wool fiber.

nomex.name: Nomex patch
nomex.description: A small bolt of Nomex fire-resistant fabric.

nanofab_item.name: dismantled nanofabricator control panel
nanofab_item.description: The control panel from a dismantled nanofabricator.  Must be attached to the body to make the nanofabricator work again.

nanofab_body_item.name: dismantled nanofabricator body
nanofab_body_item.description: The machinery from a dismantled nanofabricator.  This massive column of advanced 3D printers and robotic assemblers is useless without its control panel.

portable_nanofab.name: portable nanofabricator
portable_nanofab.description: A massive nanofabricator manufacturing column and it's control panel combined together into a semi-portable unit.

superglue.name: superglue
superglue.description: A tube of strong glue.  Used in many crafting recipes.

bone_glue.name: bone glue
bone_glue.description: Glue made from boiling animal bones.  The adhesive isn't strong enough for heavy-duty usages, but it can be used to hold together small items.

fertilizer.name: fertilizer
fertilizer.description: A token, representing fertilization of a plant.

chain.name: steel chain
chain.description: A heavy steel chain.  Useful as a weapon, or for crafting.  It has a chance to wrap around your target, allowing for a bonus unarmed attack.

chitin_piece.name: chunk of chitin
chitin_piece.description: A piece of an insect's exoskeleton.  It is light and very durable.

mutant_bug_hydrogen_sacs.name: cluster of gas sacs
mutant_bug_hydrogen_sacs.description: This is a cluster of membranous bubbles, each about the size of a grape, retrieved from inside a mutant insect.  They float like tiny helium balloons, and are likely full of a lighter-than-air gas helping the bug to fly.

ceramicdisks.name: set of 100 ceramic disk
ceramicdisks.description: A set of small slightly elongated disks, made of high-grade ceramic.  They remind you of scales.

acidchitin_piece.name: chunk of biosilicified chitin
acidchitin_piece.description: A lump of exoskeleton that has undergone biosilicification.  It is acid-resistant and remarkably sturdy.

bundle_rag.name: bundle of rags
bundle_rag.description: Cotton rags, bundled tightly together for storage.  Activate or disassemble to unpack.

bundle_leather.name: bundle of leather
bundle_leather.description: Leather patches, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.

bundle_wool.name: bundle of felt
bundle_wool.description: Felt patches, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.

sample_t_substrate.name: t-substrate sample
sample_t_substrate.description: An acrylic cube cast around a small black crystal.  It's tepid to the touch.

biollante_bud.name: biollante bud
biollante_bud.description: An unopened biollante flower, brilliant purple in color.  It may still have its sap-producing organ intact.

canister_empty.name: empty canister
canister_empty.description: An empty canister, which may have once held tear gas or other substances.

petrified_eye.name: petrified eye
petrified_eye.description: A fist-sized eyeball with a cross-shaped pupil.  It seems to be made of stone, but doesn't look like it was carved.

spiral_stone.name: spiral stone
spiral_stone.description: A rock the size of your fist.  It is covered with intricate spirals; it is impossible to tell whether they are carved, naturally formed, or some kind of fossil.

usb_drive.name: USB drive
usb_drive.description: A USB thumb drive.  Useful for holding software.

genome_drive.name: genome drive
genome_drive.description: A USB thumb drive labeled with tape.  Stores genetic information that can be used in a genome workstation, to create DNA samples for cloning.

genome_drive_black_rat.name: genome drive
genome_drive_black_rat.description: A USB thumb drive labeled with tape.  Stores genetic information that can be used in a genome workstation, to create DNA samples for cloning.

genome_drive_wolf_mutant_huge.name: genome drive
genome_drive_wolf_mutant_huge.description: A USB thumb drive labeled with tape.  Stores genetic information that can be used in a genome workstation, to create DNA samples for cloning.

blank_card.name: blank card
blank_card.description: An RFID or NFC style card.  Useful for holding identifying information like bank accounts or entry codes.

data_card.name: data card
data_card.description: Some type of advanced data storage device.  Useful for storing very large amounts of information.

fema_data.name: FEMA data
fema_data.description: Evacuation plans, disaster risk projections, personnel lists and last minute communications from just before the end, all scrubbed from FEMA servers and stored in an external hdd.

blade.name: blade
blade.description: A large, relatively sharp blade.  Could be used to make bladed weaponry, or attached to a car.

blade_scythe.name: scythe blade
blade_scythe.description: A large, curved blade.  Could be used to assemble a scythe, or make an improvised polearm.

circsaw_blade.name: circular sawblade
circsaw_blade.description: An 8" circular sawblade.  You could make a saw with it, or throw it.  Wielding it without sturdy gloves is a bad idea.

tree_spile.name: tree spile
tree_spile.description: A hollow metal cylinder which is inserted in a tree crust in order to slowly harvest its sap.  Can be used on a maple tree in between late winter and early spring to harvest maple sap.

wire.name: wire
wire.description: A length of thin, relatively stiff, steel wire.  Like the sort you find in wire fences.

wire_barbed.name: barbed wire
wire_barbed.description: A length of stiff wire, covered in sharp barbs.

wire_mesh.name: steel mesh
wire_mesh.description: A mat of woven fine steel wire, useful for dryer lint traps and reusable coffee filter baskets.  You could put these on a window to keep mosquitoes and other bugs out, but chainlink fencing will do these days.

rebar.name: rebar
rebar.description: A length of rebar, makes a nice melee weapon, and could be handy in constructing tougher walls and such.

railroad_track_small.name: small railroad track
railroad_track_small.description: A length of track, made from some planks and rails.

concrete.name: concrete
concrete.description: Some concrete, ready to be used in a construction project.

skewer_bone.name: bone skewer
skewer_bone.description: A thin skewer carved from bone.  Can be used to cook food over a fire or as a terrible lockpick.

torch_done.name: burnt out torch
torch_done.description: A torch that has consumed all its fuel; it can be recrafted into another torch.

handflare_dead.name: dead flare
handflare_dead.description: This is a spent magnesium flare.  It is essentially trash.

spring.name: spring
spring.description: A large, heavy-duty spring.  Expands with significant force when compressed.

lawnmower.name: lawnmower
lawnmower.description: A motorized pushmower that seems to be broken.  You could take it apart if you had a wrench.

broketent.name: damaged tent
broketent.description: A small tent, just big enough to fit a person comfortably.  This tent is broken and cannot be deployed.

largebroketent.name: large damaged tent
largebroketent.description: A family sized tent, very bulky but with plenty of space.  This tent is broken and can not be deployed.

element.name: heating element
element.description: A heating element, like the ones used in hotplates or kettles.

thermostat.name: bimetal thermostat
thermostat.description: A simple thermostat controlled by thermal expansion of a bimetal strip.

television.name: television
television.description: A large LCD television, full of delicious electronics.

pilot_light.name: pilot light
pilot_light.description: A pilot light from a gas-burning device, this particular one is a simple piezoelectric igniter.

delay_fuze.name: delayed fuze
delay_fuze.description: A complex mechanical fuze.  It seems it can be used to detonate stable explosives after a short time by triggering it.

impact_fuze.name: impact fuze
impact_fuze.description: A complex mechanical fuze.  It seems it can be used to detonate stable explosives upon a solid impact.

toaster.name: toaster
toaster.description: A small two slice toaster, not much use as anything but spare parts

microwave.name: microwave
microwave.description: A home microwave, has probably seen its share of baked beans.  Good for scrap parts.

broken_eyebot.name: broken eyebot
broken_eyebot.description: A broken eyebot.  Much less threatening now that it won't be calling for backup.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_skitterbot.name: broken skitterbot
broken_skitterbot.description: A broken skitterbot.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_science_bot.name: broken lab defense bot
broken_science_bot.description: A broken lab defense bot, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_copbot.name: broken police bot
broken_copbot.description: A broken police bot.  Much less threatening now that it's quiet and still.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_nursebot.name: broken nurse bot
broken_nursebot.description: A broken nurse bot.  Its smooth face staring vacantly into empty space.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_grocerybot.name: broken grocery bot
broken_grocerybot.description: A broken grocery bot.  Its smiling face staring vacantly into empty space.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_grocerybot_busted.name: broken grocery bot
broken_grocerybot_busted.description: The body of a busted grocery bot.  Its tarnished face is still smiling.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_haulerbot.name: broken hauler bot
broken_haulerbot.description: A broken hauler bot, now just a mass of limp mechanical limbs and busted chassis.  Only useful for parts now.

broken_nursebot_defective.name: broken nurse bot
broken_nursebot_defective.description: A broken nurse bot.  Its smooth face staring vacantly into empty space.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_riotbot.name: broken riot control bot
broken_riotbot.description: A broken riot control bot.  Much less threatening now that it's out of gas.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_robofac_prototype.name: broken prototype robot
broken_robofac_prototype.description: A broken prototype robot, well more broken than before.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_molebot.name: broken miner bot
broken_molebot.description: A broken miner bot.  Much less threatening now that it's no longer capable of drilling anything.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_mech_recon.name: broken recon mech
broken_mech_recon.description: This is a broken mech exoskeleton suit, it looks beyond repair.

broken_mech_lifter.name: broken mech lifter
broken_mech_lifter.description: This is a broken mech exoskeleton suit, it looks beyond repair.

broken_mech_combat.name: broken combat mech
broken_mech_combat.description: This is a broken mech exoskeleton suit, it looks beyond repair.

broken_dispatch.name: broken riot dispatch
broken_dispatch.description: A broken riot dispatch, with its mesh midsection filled with fried manhacks and its motor limp and still.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_dispatch_military.name: broken military dispatch
broken_dispatch_military.description: A broken military dispatch.  Though the scratched, disarmed manhacks visible in its belly are disarmed, their destructive potential still inspires a spark of fear, even now.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_manhack.name: broken manhack
broken_manhack.description: A broken manhack.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_grenade_hack.name: broken grenade hack
broken_grenade_hack.description: A broken grenade hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_mininuke_hack.name: broken mininuke hack
broken_mininuke_hack.description: A broken magenta hack.  Just looking at the wreck makes you shiver.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_gasbomb_hack.name: broken tear gas hack
broken_gasbomb_hack.description: A broken tear gas hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_EMP_hack.name: broken EMP hack
broken_EMP_hack.description: A broken EMP hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_flashbang_hack.name: broken flashbang hack
broken_flashbang_hack.description: A broken flashbang hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_c4_hack.name: broken C-4 hack
broken_c4_hack.description: A broken C-4 hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_dissector.name: broken dissector
broken_dissector.description: Some kind of automated medical laser cutting system.  It has suffered some damage and doesn't seem to work any more, but it could be gutted for parts.

laser_source.name: industrial laser
laser_source.description: A high-power laser source, salvaged from some industrial machinery.  Doesn't do anything on its own, but could probably be useful in electronics crafting.

processor.name: processor board
processor.description: A central processor unit, useful in advanced electronics crafting.

RAM.name: RAM
RAM.description: A stick of memory.  Useful in advanced electronics crafting.

power_supply.name: power converter
power_supply.description: A power supply unit.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.

amplifier.name: amplifier circuit
amplifier.description: A circuit designed to amplify the strength of a signal.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.

transponder.name: transponder circuit
transponder.description: A circuit designed to repeat a signal.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.

receiver.name: signal receiver
receiver.description: A module designed to receive many forms of signals.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.

large_lcd_screen.name: large LCD screen
large_lcd_screen.description: A large backlit screen, used for displaying images.  Useful in some electronics recipes.

small_lcd_screen.name: small LCD screen
small_lcd_screen.description: A small backlit screen, used for displaying images.  Useful in some electronics recipes.

lens.name: high-quality lens
lens.description: A high-quality lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for starting a fire.

lens_small.name: small high-quality lens
lens_small.description: A small high-quality lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for crafting.

glass_tinted.name: pair of tinted glass
glass_tinted.description: A pair of small darkened glass, like the one that sunglasses are made of.

burnt_out_bionic.name: burnt out bionic
burnt_out_bionic.description: Once a valuable bionic implant, it has not held up well under repeated use.  This object has been destroyed by excessive electric current and is now useless.

standard_template_construct.name: nanofabricator template
standard_template_construct.description: A state-of-the-art optical storage system.  This small slate of transparent glass holds, inscribed as a miniature pattern, the instructions required to create an item through a nanofabricator.

template_photonics.name: nanofabricator template (silicon photonics)
template_photonics.description: A state-of-the-art optical storage system, containing the instruction set required for the fabrication of complex silicon photonic circuitry.  The data within was once clearly worth millions, but now, you are not sure if it's anything more than a fancy, high-tech paperweight.

antenna.name: antenna
antenna.description: A simple thin aluminum shaft.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.

motor_micro.name: micro motor
motor_micro.description: A very small electric motor like those used in RC cars.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.

circuit.name: circuit board
circuit.description: A printed card that supports and electrically connects electronic components on a non-conductive substrate.

e_scrap.name: electronic scrap
e_scrap.description: A random collection of resistors, capacitors, and diodes which have been stripped from printed circuits.

radio_repeater_mod.name: radio repeater mod
radio_repeater_mod.description: A system designed to convert a radio station into an autonomous repeater.

fan.name: desk fan
fan.description: A small fan, used to propel air around a room.

ceramic_armor.name: ceramic armor plate
ceramic_armor.description: A ceramic armor plate, specifically engineered for use in a bullet resistant vest.

fish_bowl.name: fishbowl
fish_bowl.description: A filled fishbowl, the tag says 'to Ed' and the fish's name, 'Hoss'.  The fish appears to have tiny antlers.

rag.name: rag
rag.description: This is a largish piece of cloth, useful in crafting and possibly for staunching bleeding.

rag_bloody.name: blood soaked rag
rag_bloody.description: A large rag, drenched in blood.  It could be cleaned with boiling water.

pipe_cleaner.name: pipe cleaner
pipe_cleaner.description: This is a tool designed to clean interior surface of pipes, bottles, and similar objects.  This one is thin enough to be used for cleaning firearm barrels from dirt and fouling.

clock.name: clock
clock.description: A small mechanical clock.  Tells the time and has an alarm clock feature.

clockworks.name: clockworks
clockworks.description: A small assortment of gears and other clockwork gubbins.

mobile_memory_card.name: SD-Memory card
mobile_memory_card.description: A memory card, used.  Might be worth a look.

mobile_memory_card_used.name: SD-Memory card (clean)
mobile_memory_card_used.description: This memory card is either unused or has been wiped clean.  You could use it to store your data, though!

mobile_memory_card_encrypted.name: SD-Memory card (encrypted)
mobile_memory_card_encrypted.description: This memory card appears to have the firmware encryption set.  Hopefully it contains something worth encrypting.

mobile_memory_card_science.name: Science SD-Memory card
mobile_memory_card_science.description: This memory card appears to be related to 'XEDRA', and is certainly encrypted.  Looks *Interesting*, though…

manhole_cover.name: manhole cover
manhole_cover.description: A heavy iron disc that typically covers a ladder into the sewers.  Lifting it from the manhole is impossible without a crowbar.

pine_bough.name: pine bough
pine_bough.description: A branch from a pine tree, oozing sticky sap and bristling with prickly needles.

pinecone.name: pinecone
pinecone.description: A spiny pod from a pine tree.  Dry seeds rattle around inside when you shake it.

poppy_bud.name: poppy bud
poppy_bud.description: A poppy bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a mutated poppy flower.

sunflower.name: sunflower
sunflower.description: The top of a sunflower, with yellow pedals and some seeds that have yet to be eaten by animals.

chamomile.name: chamomile flowers
chamomile.description: White chamomile flowers, used as a herbal remedy since the ancient times.

lotus.name: lotus flower
lotus.description: A lovely flower that grows on the surface of bodies of freshwater.  Traditionally connected with many Eastern cultures.

spurge.name: spurge flowers
spurge.description: A handful of yellow-green flowers.  Can be brewed into a tea that prevents asthma attacks.

clay_lump.name: lump of clay
clay_lump.description: A fresh piece of clay.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

brick.name: brick
brick.description: A fire hardened building block used in masonry construction.

mortar_build.name: mortar
mortar_build.description: Some mortar, ready to be used in building projects.

soft_adobe_brick.name: soft adobe brick
soft_adobe_brick.description: A compacted mass of soil and natural fibers, still too wet to build with.  You could load it onto a pallet and leave it to dry to process them in bulk.

use_action.msg: You test the brick, and it seems solid enough to use.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The brick is still too damp to bear weight.

adobe_brick.name: adobe brick
adobe_brick.description: A compacted mass of soil and natural fibers, baked dry enough to harden into a brick.

mortar_adobe.name: adobe mortar
mortar_adobe.description: A thick, pasty mud, low in sand content to reduce crumbling once dry.  Used to glue larger, heavier pieces of mud and clay together.

tanbark.name: tanbark
tanbark.description: A sheet of tannin-rich bark from a tree, useful for tanning leather.

birchbark.name: birchbark
birchbark.description: A sheet of tough, water-resistant bark taken from a birch tree.

willowbark.name: willowbark
willowbark.description: A sheet of bark taken from a willow tree.  Used in the production of aspirin.

cured_hide.name: cured hide
cured_hide.description: A rolled up animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It could be tanned and transformed into usable leather patches.

cured_pelt.name: cured pelt
cured_pelt.description: A rolled up animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It could be tanned and transformed into usable fur pelts.

straw_pile.name: pile of straw
straw_pile.description: A pile of dry grass.  Can be used to craft a straw bed if there is nothing else to sleep on.

money_pile.name: pile of money
money_pile.description: A pile of cash.  Can be used to fill a bathtub with cash or as a comforting reminder of the past.

straw_doll.name: straw doll
straw_doll.description: Old straw doll.  Represents a woman in a dress.

pillow.name: pillow
pillow.description: A pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.

bodypillow.name: body pillow
bodypillow.description: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of an anime character on the front and their scantily clad version on the back.

down_pillow.name: down-filled pillow
down_pillow.description: A fluffy pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.

teddy.name: teddy bear
teddy.description: An old and half rotten teddy bear.  Looks like this one commemorates the grave of the child who once owned it.

teddy_bear.name: teddy bear
teddy_bear.description: A cuddly plush teddy bear.  It is wearing a little red tshirt but no pants.

money_bundle.name: money bundle
money_bundle.description: A bundle holding many 20 dollar bills, pretty useless now though.

cigar_lit.name: cigar
cigar_lit.description: The smoke billowing from this cigar has a sweet, musty odor.

use_action.msg: You extinguish the cigar.

blunt_lit.name: blunt
blunt_lit.description: The smoke billowing from this blunt has a sweet, fruity odor.

use_action.msg: You extinguish the blunt.

cigar_butt.name: cigar butt
cigar_butt.description: A true gentleman always finishes his cigars.

blunt_roach.name: blunt roach
blunt_roach.description: A true gangster always finishes their blunts.

cig_lit.name: cigarette
cig_lit.description: Smoke swirls from the lit end of this cigarette, filling the air with the thrilling smell of burning chemicals.

use_action.msg: You extinguish the cigarette.

cig_butt.name: cigarette butt
cig_butt.description:
What was once a wonderfully addictive tube of dried tobacco leaf is now just a smelly piece of trash.  What a tragedy!
The leftover tobacco in a few of these could probably be used to roll another cigarette.  If you're willing to go that far…

joint_lit.name: joint
joint_lit.description: The smell of skunk permeates the air as a thin trail of smoke floats off of this joint.

use_action.msg: You extinguish the joint.

joint_roach.name: joint roach
joint_roach.description:
The smoked-down butt of a joint, a reminder of some good times.  Pretty much trash now.  Bummer, man.
A few of these could probably be used to roll another joint.

cannabis.name: cannabis plant
cannabis.description: A psychoactive plant indigenous to Central Asia and the Indian subcontinent traditionally cultivated for its fiber, oil, for medicinal purposes, and for use as a recreational drug.  It requires further processing to be useful.

id_science.name: science ID card
id_science.description: This ID card once belonged to a scientist.  The reverse side describes protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

id_military.name: military ID card
id_military.description: This ID card once belonged to a military officer.  The reverse side describes protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

id_industrial.name: industrial ID card
id_industrial.description: This ID card once belonged to a high level technician.  The reverse side describes protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

neoprene.name: neoprene patch
neoprene.description: A moderately sized sheet of neoprene.  Can be used to craft light and stretchable clothing.

cerberus_laser.name: TX-5LR Laser Cannon
cerberus_laser.description: A laser cannon stripped from the barrel of a TX-5LR Cerberus laser turret.  Unusable as a weapon on its own without the necessary parts.

gatling_mech_laser_salvaged.name: salvaged CMES gatling laser
gatling_mech_laser_salvaged.description: A rapid-fire weapon system stripped from a wrecked combat exoskeleton.  No longer usable as a weapon in its current condition.

recon_mech_laser_salvaged.name: salvaged RMES marksman laser
recon_mech_laser_salvaged.description: A long-range weapon system stripped from a wrecked recon exoskeleton.  No longer usable as a weapon in its current condition.

light_bulb.name: light bulb
light_bulb.description: A rather outdated light bulb used in all sorts of light equipment.

clay_pot_flower.name: clay flower pot
clay_pot_flower.description: A nice looking clay pot used for planting.

plastic_pot_flower.name: plastic flower pot
plastic_pot_flower.description: A cheap plastic pot used for planting.

fluid_preserved_brain.name: fluid preserved brain
fluid_preserved_brain.description: This 3L jar contains a human brain preserved in a formaldehyde solution.

evaporator_coil.name: evaporator coil
evaporator_coil.description: A set of long, snakelike tubes for evaporating refrigerant.

condensor_coil.name: condenser coil
condensor_coil.description: A compressor and a fan work together to cool down the refrigerant.

refrigerant_tank.name: refrigerant tank
refrigerant_tank.description: A small tank containing some sort of refrigerant often used in devices such as freezers.  Hermetically sealed to prevent evaporation - cannot be opened without prior connection to compatible valve.

hard_steel_armor.name: hard steel armor plate
hard_steel_armor.description: An armor plating made of a very thick steel, specifically engineered for use in a bullet resistant vest.

steel_armor.name: steel armor plate
steel_armor.description: A steel armor plate, specifically engineered for use in a bullet resistant vest.

lock.name: small lock and key
lock.description: A small lock, with a set of keys still inserted.

craft.name: in progress craft
craft.description: This is an in progress craft.

spare_tire_carrier.name: spare tire carrier
spare_tire_carrier.description: A bumper mounted rig for attaching and storing a spare tire on the back of a vehicle.  Combine it with a wheel to get a mountable piece.

welding_components.name: welding component kit
welding_components.description: A set of components useful for constructing a full-featured welding station, complete with soldering capability.

amplifier_head.name: amplifier head
amplifier_head.description: An amplifier head.  Typically paired with a speaker cabinet for amplifying musical instruments.  Basically only good for spare parts now.

broken_turret.name: broken turret
broken_turret.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_turret_riot.name: broken riot control turret
broken_turret_riot.description: A broken riot control turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_laserturret.name: broken laser turret
broken_laserturret.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_secubot.name: broken M16A4 TALON
broken_secubot.description: A broken TALON UGV, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_tripod.name: broken tribot
broken_tripod.description: A broken tribot.  Now that its legs lie broken and immobile, the world seems a little less threatening.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_tankbot.name: broken tank drone
broken_tankbot.description: A broken tank drone.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_chickenbot.name: broken chickenbot
broken_chickenbot.description: A broken chicken walker.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.

use_action.friendly_msg: The chicken bot rolls out and begins acquiring targets.
use_action.hostile_msg: The chicken bot swivels its turret and aims directly at you.  Don your brown pants!

broken_talon_m202a1.name: broken M202A1 TALON
broken_talon_m202a1.description: A broken TALON UGV, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_talon_m249.name: broken M249 TALON
broken_talon_m249.description: A broken TALON UGV, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.

fire_brick.name: fire brick
fire_brick.description: A reinforced brick designed to withstand intense heat.  It could also be used as an impromptu anvil for light metalworking.

survival_kit.name: survival kit
survival_kit.description: A small box filled with tools and items to help you survive in case of an emergency.  Disassemble to get its content.

premium_survival_kit.name: survival kit
premium_survival_kit.description: The ultimate survival kit purchased either by the wealthy or the dedicated urban survivalist.  It contains tools and items to help you survive in case of an emergency.  Disassemble to get its contents.

salt_lick.name: salt lick
salt_lick.description: A heavy cube-shaped block of salt for livestock.  Don't lick it, it's gross.

broken_turret_light.name: broken light turret
broken_turret_light.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_robofac_turret_light.name: broken Hub 01 light turret
broken_robofac_turret_light.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_turret_medium.name: broken medium milspec turret
broken_turret_medium.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_turret_longrange.name: broken longrange milspec turret
broken_turret_longrange.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_turret_antimateriel.name: broken anti-materiel milspec turret
broken_turret_antimateriel.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_turret_mark19.name: broken grenade launcher milspec turret
broken_turret_mark19.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

wool_pillow.name: wool pillow
wool_pillow.description: A pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.  This one is made entirely of fluffy wool!

kevlar_plate.name: Kevlar plate
kevlar_plate.description: This is a plate of reinforced Kevlar.  It could be used to repair items made of Kevlar.

scute_piece.name: scute
scute_piece.description: A bony and scaled protrusion harvested from a large reptile.  Such things were used to make handbags before the Cataclysm, but the material is sturdy and protective.

bone_heavy.name: heavy bone
bone_heavy.description: A bone harvested from a large animal such as an elephant, or from certain types of zombies.  It is extremely dense and durable for its size, and largely inedible.

teeth_serrated.name: sharp teeth
teeth_serrated.description: Teeth harvested from a carnivore such as a shark, or from certain types of mutant animals.  They are extremely dense and durable for their size, and can very easily cause jagged wounds.

beehive_empty.name: empty beehive
beehive_empty.description: A large, enclosed wooden box with multiple sliding frames in it.  With something to attract bees, it can be used to grow a hive.

shark_plush.name: shark plush
shark_plush.description: A slightly large shark plushie, perfect for cuddles.

cargo_lock.name: locks and keys set
cargo_lock.description: A set of locks and keys designed to be installed on something you want to keep prying hands away.

wooden_plane_kit.name: hobby aircraft parts kit
wooden_plane_kit.description: This tightly-packed pallet of cardboard boxes contains the raw lumber and hardware for making homebuilt aircraft, along with the necessary parts diagrams.  You'd still need to provide your own engine, electronics, and a LOT of canvas.

makeshift_bayonet.name: makeshift bayonet
makeshift_bayonet.description: A makeshift version of a bayonet that consists of a mere spike with some string.

battleaxe.name: battle axe
battleaxe.description: This is a huge axe designed for warfare.  Though intended for use as a weapon, it can also be pressed into service as a rather clumsy woodcutting tool.

battleaxe_inferior.name: battle axe replica
battleaxe_inferior.description: This is a huge axe designed for warfare.  You notice that the axe heads aren't seated properly at all.

battleaxe_fake.name: battle axe fake
battleaxe_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a massive axe designed for warfare.

halberd.name: halberd
halberd.description: This is a versatile polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long stick.

halberd_fake.name: halberd fake
halberd_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long stick.

bowling_axe.name: The 7-10 Split
bowling_axe.description: An improvised weapon, made from two spikes attached to a bowling pin in the shape of a 'T'.

2h_flail_steel.name: war flail
2h_flail_steel.description: This is a stout pole with a large steel flanged mace head on a short chain attached to it, based on the peasant flail agricultural tool except now with a metal head and made to thresh people in metal armor rather than grain.

2h_flail_wood.name: peasant flail
2h_flail_wood.description: This is a stout pole with a wooden club on a leather cord attached to it, once used as a tool used to thresh wheat and occasionally people when the peasants got angry at their feudal lords.

bat.name: baseball bat
bat.description: A sturdy wood bat.  Makes a great melee weapon.

bat_metal.name: aluminum bat
bat_metal.description: An aluminum baseball bat, lighter than a wooden bat and a little easier to swing as a result.

bat_nerf.name: foam rubber bat
bat_nerf.description: A baseball bat made out of foam rubber with a plastic handle.  Light, well-balanced, and easy to wield, but almost completely ineffective.

bwirebat.name: barbed wire bat
bwirebat.description: A baseball bat wrapped with barbed wire.  A brutal melee weapon.

nailbat.name: nail bat
nailbat.description: A baseball bat with several nails driven through it, an excellent melee weapon.

bat_metal_bolted.name: bolted bat
bat_metal_bolted.description: An aluminum baseball bat with several large bolts driven through it, making it a brutal melee weapon.

baton.name: expandable baton
baton.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes an excellent melee weapon.  Activate to expand.

use_action.msg: You snap open your baton.

baton-extended.name: expandable baton (extended)
baton-extended.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes an excellent melee weapon.  Activate to collapse.

use_action.msg: You collapse your baton.

blackjack.name: blackjack
blackjack.description: This is a short, easily concealed bludgeoning weapon consisting of a weight embedded at the end of a short leather shaft.  Formerly used by law enforcement, this weapon is meant to stun or knock out the subject, although head strikes have a high risk of causing a permanent, disabling brain injury or being fatal.

bokken.name: bokken
bokken.description: This is a solid wood 'training' katana, exactingly crafted to mimic the weight and balance of the real thing.  Despite its lack of a sharp metal edge, it's still quite capable of inflicting deadly wounds.

bokken_inferior.name: bokken replica
bokken_inferior.description: This is a solid wood 'training' katana, but it looks to be mass-produced, and not quite as effective as the real deal.

bokken_fake.name: bokken fake
bokken_fake.description: This is a solid wood 'training' katana, but feels far too light to make an effective weapon.

bowling_pin.name: bowling pin
bowling_pin.description: A blunt bowling pin.  Makes a decent melee weapon, if somewhat short.

cane.name: walking cane
cane.description: Handicapped or not, you always walk in style.  Consisting of a metal headpiece and a wooden body, this makes a great bashing weapon in a pinch.

hollow_cane.name: hollow cane
hollow_cane.description: A cane designed to conceal blade.  This was a popular fashion accessory for the wealthy during the 18th and 19th centuries.

cudgel.name: cudgel
cudgel.description: A slender long rod of wood, while traditionally intended as a training tool for many dueling moves, it still makes a good melee weapon in a pinch.

golf_club.name: golf club
golf_club.description: A long handle with a big metal head, flat on one side, for driving golf balls.  Fore!

hammer_sledge.name: sledge hammer
hammer_sledge.description: A large, heavy hammer.  Makes an acceptable melee weapon for the very strong, but is nearly useless in the hands of the weak.

hammer_sledge_short.name: short sledge hammer
hammer_sledge_short.description: A shorter sledge hammer, still as weighty, however, due to the same steel head.  Worse as a melee weapon but is a more portable tool.

hammer_sledge_heavy.name: heavy sledge hammer
hammer_sledge_heavy.description: A large sledge hammer with a massive, heavy head.  This unwieldy tool is meant to break concrete, rock, brick, anything really.

hammer_sledge_engineer.name: engineer's hammer
hammer_sledge_engineer.description: A stout and hefty hammer, more akin to a sledge than a typical ball-peen.  Useful for portable demolition work, but is very unwieldy as a weapon.

hockey_stick.name: hockey stick
hockey_stick.description: A curved wooden stick with a wide and flat end.  Commonly used by hockey players.

homewrecker.name: homewrecker
homewrecker.description: A long piece of wood with several chunks of steel firmly tied to it.  The resulting weapon is unwieldy and slow but very heavy hitting.

lucern_hammer.name: lucerne hammer
lucern_hammer.description: This is a versatile polearm with a spiked hammer head, a spike, and a hook attached to a long stick.

lucern_hammerfake.name: lucerne hammer fake
lucern_hammerfake.description: This is a cheap piece of crap imitation of a versatile polearm with a spiked hammer head, probably used for LARPing.

mace.name: mace
mace.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy iron end.  It is heavy and slow, but its crushing damage is devastating.

mace_inferior.name: mace replica
mace_inferior.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy iron end.  That iron end feels a bit loose.

mace_fake.name: mace fake
mace_fake.description: A light, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon that would normally consist of a wood handle with a heavy iron end.

makeshift_sap.name: makeshift sap
makeshift_sap.description: This is an improvised sap, also known as a cosh, slapjack and slapper.  A short and flat bludgeoning weapon consisting of a weight embedded between two patches of leather.

mjolnir.name: Mjoelnir
mjolnir.description:
A large hammer, forged from the heart of a dying star.  It bears the inscription:

Whosoever holds this hammer,
If he be worthy,
Shall possess the power to…
CRUSH!'

morningstar.name: morningstar
morningstar.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.  It deals devastating crushing damage, with a small amount of piercing to boot.

morningstar_inferior.name: morningstar replica
morningstar_inferior.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.  That end feels lighter than it should.

morningstar_fake.name: morningstar fake
morningstar_fake.description: A light, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon that would normally consist of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.

nailboard.name: nailboard
nailboard.description: A long piece of wood with several nails through one end; essentially a simple mace.  Makes an acceptable melee weapon.

pool_cue.name: pool cue
pool_cue.description: A hard-wood stick designed for hitting colorful balls around a felt table.  Truly, the coolest of sports.

PR24-retracted.name: PR-24 baton (retracted)
PR24-retracted.description: The Monadnock PR-24 baton is a collapsible, lightweight, side-handle baton used by law enforcement all over the world.  The PR designation is rumored to mean Public Relations.  Activate to extend.

use_action.msg: You snap open your PR-24 baton.

PR24-extended.name: PR-24 baton (extended)
PR24-extended.description: The Monadnock PR-24 baton is a collapsible, lightweight, side-handle baton used by law enforcement all over the world.  The PR designation is rumored to mean Public Relations.  Activate to retract.

use_action.msg: You collapse your PR-24 baton.

q_staff.name: quarterstaff
q_staff.description: A smooth and sturdy staff that was finely oiled and sanded for durability.  Light and well-balanced, it is surprisingly easy to handle.  Also sometimes referred to as a bō in Japan and Okinawan martial arts.

i_staff.name: ironshod quarterstaff
i_staff.description: A smooth and sturdy staff with a leather-wrapped grip, which has been reinforced with metal bands and caps.  Durable and well-balanced, it is surprisingly easy to handle.

rock_sock.name: rock in a sock
rock_sock.description: A pair of nested socks filled with a stone.  A true weapon of despair.

shillelagh.name: shillelagh
shillelagh.description: A stout knotty stick with a large knob at the top that has been left to cure in a chimney.  A traditional Irish weapon, the shillelagh was originally used for settling disputes in a gentlemanly manner.

shillelagh_weighted.name: loaded club
shillelagh_weighted.description: A hollowed out wooden club that has been filled with lead or other easy to melt metals to make it more weighty; packs a surprising punch for how easy it is to make.

shillelagh_fake.name: shillelagh fake
shillelagh_fake.description: A fake shillelagh massproduced as a souvenir for tourists.  This knotty stick has not been cured in a chimney like a traditional shillelagh but has had fake black soot painted on.

tonfa.name: tonfa
tonfa.description: A hard plastic truncheon commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

tonfa_wood.name: wooden tonfa
tonfa_wood.description: A stout wooden truncheon of the sort commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a carved stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

warhammer.name: war hammer
warhammer.description: A medieval hammer made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.

qstaff_retracted.name: extendable quarterstaff (retracted)
qstaff_retracted.description: A custom-made telescoping steel quarterstaff, capable of shrinking down to the size of a baton for easy storage.  Its hollow nature makes it more lightweight but less sturdy than a more traditional staff.  It is currently retracted.

use_action.msg: You snap open your staff.

qstaff_extended.name: extendable quarterstaff (extended)
qstaff_extended.description: A custom-made telescoping steel quarterstaff, capable of shrinking down to the size of a baton for easy storage.  Its hollow nature makes it more lightweight but less sturdy than a more traditional staff.  It is currently extended.

use_action.msg: You retract your staff.

club_spiked.name: spiked survivor club
club_spiked.description: A wooden club with bands of iron or loops of wire and spikes carefully hammered onto it.  While it's not as effective or fancy as a proper mace or morningstar, its history throughout medieval and even early modern battlefields is noteworthy.  It was also known as a trench club during world war 1.

mace_bone.name: bone club
mace_bone.description: This hefty bludgeon is carved from sturdy bones mounted on a wooden haft, capable of bashing faces in with swiftness and efficiency.

spike_staff.name: spiked survivor staff
