spike_staff.description: A wooden staff with metal bands or a length of wire wrapped onto both ends and various nails or spikes attached to it, including a single wicked spike at the top.  Makeshift weapons have a long history throughout warfare, from the trench clubs of World War 1 to the staffs used by medieval peasants, and hopefully it will help you survive too.

battletorch_done.name: burnt out battletorch
battletorch_done.description: A sturdy wood bat, wrapped in flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  Makes a good melee weapon, but could be disassembled to recycle the baseball bat and some Nomex patches.

greatclub_wood.name: wooden greatclub
greatclub_wood.description: One of humanity's oldest weapons pushed to an inhuman extreme.  Despite its simplicity, this two-handed club carved from a log requires considerable strength and skill to use effectively.

greatclub_iron.name: ironshod greatclub
greatclub_iron.description: A massive two-handed club, carved from a log and reinforced with iron bands that give it even more heft.  This weapon embodies the phrase "like giving a kanabō to an oni" as anyone capable of using it effectively could likely tear their enemies apart with their bare hands.

bio_claws_weapon.name: bionic claws
bio_claws_weapon.description: Short and sharp claws made from a high-tech metal and edged with bonded nanocrystals.

bio_blade_weapon.name: monomolecular blade
bio_blade_weapon.description: A 30cm-long blade made from high-tech alloy and edged with bonded nanocrystals.

bio_wire_weapon.name: monofilament whip
bio_wire_weapon.description: A long, sharp thread of high-tech material, with a small counterweight at the end.

bullwhip.name: bullwhip
bullwhip.description: A long strip of braided leather with a handle on one end.  Originally developed to settle disagreements with cattle, it's better used now for flaying the rotten flesh off of walking corpses.  Great for when a problem comes along.

bullwhip_razor.name: scourge
bullwhip_razor.description: The "cat 'o nine tails", a handle with nine short leather whips each sporting a razor-sharp metal tip.  This ancient instrument of torture causes massive bleeding but is an ineffecient weapon by design.

glass_shiv.name: glass shiv
glass_shiv.description: A glass shard with wrapping at one end so it can be safely wielded.

sharp_toothbrush.name: plastic shank
sharp_toothbrush.description: An oblong plastic trinket with the far end ground down into a stabbing point.

pitchfork.name: pitchfork
pitchfork.description: An agricultural tool with long wooden shaft and four spikes.  Is used to lift hay.

pointy_stick.name: pointy stick
pointy_stick.description: A simple wood pole with one end sharpened.

pointy_stick_long.name: long pointy stick
pointy_stick_long.description: A stout wood pole with one end sharpened.  More clunky than a properly-made spear, but still has some heft to it.

spear_wood.name: wooden spear
spear_wood.description: A stout pole with an improvised grip and a fire-hardened point.

spear_forked.name: forked spear
spear_forked.description: A wooden pole with three spikes tied to it and decent grip.  It's specialized for catching weapons.

spear_pipe.name: pipe spear
spear_pipe.description: A stout metal pole with a sharp point.

spear_copper.name: copper spear
spear_copper.description: A stout wooden pole with a spearhead worked from copper.

spear_steel.name: steel spear
spear_steel.description: A stout wooden pole with a hand-forged steel spearhead.

spear_rebar.name: sharpened rebar
spear_rebar.description: A somewhat sharpened piece of rebar.

spear_stone.name: stone spear
spear_stone.description: A stout wooden pole with a sharp stone spearhead.

qiang.name: qiang
qiang.description: An ancient Chinese spear, typically with a tassel just below the spearhead.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao sabre, jian sword, and gun staff.

makeshift_scythe_war.name: makeshift war scythe
makeshift_scythe_war.description: This farming tool has been modified into an improvised weapon by rotating its blade 90 degrees, transforming it into a deadly giant blade on the end of a stick.  However it's quite fragile.

scythe_war.name: war scythe
scythe_war.description: A pole weapon with a curving single-edged blade.  Its blade bears some superficial resemblance to that of an agricultural scythe from which it likely evolved.

makeshift_halberd.name: makeshift glaive
makeshift_halberd.description: This is a large blade attached to a long stick.  It could do a considerable amount of damage.

glaive.name: glaive
glaive.description: A sturdy polearm with a sizable, single-edged blade on the end.

naginata.name: naginata
naginata.description: A sturdy polearm with a curved blade, made in the same manner as the katana and other Japanese blades.  Occasionally used by samurai in early periods, or by their wives in defense of the household.

naginata_inferior.name: naginata replica
naginata_inferior.description: A sturdy polearm with a curved blade, made in the same manner as the katana and other Japanese blades.  This one has a bit of wiggle to its blade and feels a bit shoddily made.

naginata_fake.name: naginata fake
naginata_fake.description: This is a dull, slightly floppy replica of a Japanese polearm with a curved blade.  With a little difficulty, you could use it administer a solid slap from a distance.

spear_survivor.name: survivor naginata
spear_survivor.description: This sturdy steel shaft with a sword blade at the end is good for both slashing and stabbing.

javelin.name: wooden javelin
javelin.description: A fire-hardened wooden spear honed to a sharper point.  The grip area has been carved and covered for better grip.

javelin_iron.name: iron javelin
javelin_iron.description: An iron-tipped wooden throwing spear.  The grip area has been carved and covered for better grip.

javelin_stone.name: stone javelin
javelin_stone.description: A throwing spear with a stone spearhead.

pike_wood.name: wooden pike
pike_wood.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft with a fire hardened point.

pike_copper.name: copper pike
pike_copper.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with a copper spearhead.

pike.name: pike
pike.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.

pike_inferior.name: pike replica
pike_inferior.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.  The head seems to be pretty dull, and the whole thing feels poorly made.

pike_fake.name: pike fake
pike_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.

spear_dory.name: dory
spear_dory.description: A well-made spear with a bronze head, Greek in origin.

ji.name: ji
ji.description: This is a bronze polearm that originated in the Shang dynasty of China, if not earlier.  It combines a spear head with the perpendicular blade of the earlier ge or dagger-axe.

spear_carbon.name: carbon fiber spear
spear_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed spear made out of carbon fiber with a steel-edged speartip.  It is more lightweight than a normal spear thanks to its method of manufacturing.

spear_tooth.name: sharktooth spear
spear_tooth.description: A stout wooden pole with several razor-sharp teeth set into the edges of its spearhead.

spear_stinger.name: stinger spear
spear_stinger.description: A stout wooden pole with a sharpened mutant insect stinger for a spearhead, to add a venomous touch to a classic weapon.

hit_you_effect.message: The stinger injects a small amount of poison into your target.

spear_triffid.name: triffid spear
spear_triffid.description: A stout wooden pole tipped with a stinger from a strange plant monster.  An alien twist on hunting with poison-tipped weapons made from natural sources.

hit_you_effect.message: The stinger injects a small amount of poison into your target.

glaive_bone.name: bone glaive
glaive_bone.description: This glaive's blade is carved from a large chunk of bone, and is capable of slicing foes in with swiftness and efficiency.

sword_wood.name: 2-by-sword
sword_wood.description: A two by four with a cross guard and whittled down point; not much for slashing, but a sharp point is better than nothing.

sword_nail.name: nail sword
sword_nail.description: The nail sword, or nord for short.  This wooden sword has a dozen nails sticking out at jagged angles from the edge of the blade, adding a bit of piercing to its swings.

sword_crude.name: crude sword
sword_crude.description: Several bits of thin scrap metal crudely beat into the semblance of an edge over a wooden sword.  The added weight is unbalanced, but the jagged edge offers a good bit of slashing power.

sword_metal.name: hand-forged sword
sword_metal.description: A simple, no-frills handmade sword.  Not accurate to any historical style, and the blade profile isn't as well-balanced as the real deal, but it's more than serviceable in the right hands.  It's just hefty enough to require a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

knife_combat.name: combat knife
knife_combat.description: This is a military combat knife.  It is light and extremely sharp, and could be deadly in either the right hands or when attached as a bayonet.

knife_combat_mod.name: modified combat knife
knife_combat_mod.description: This is a military combat knife.  It is light and extremely sharp, and could be deadly in either the right hands or when attached as a bayonet.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

knife_rambo.name: survival knife
knife_rambo.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.

knife_rm42.name: RM42 fighting knife
knife_rm42.description: This matte black Rivtech combat dagger features a long double-edged blade converging to a spear-point and a distinctive slip-resistant grip with low-profile grooves to affix to a firearm.  Improving on the design of the legendary Fairbarn-Sykes dagger with new materials, it was very popular in films and among collectors due to its fearsome appearance.

knife_trench.name: trench knife
knife_trench.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking, and the knife can also be used to butcher corpses.

knife_baselard.name: crude dagger
knife_baselard.description: A medieval dagger forged from rough iron.  It is not the sharpest tool in the shed, but it is certainly one of the largest.

machete.name: machete
machete.description: This huge steel knife makes an excellent tool for cutting down large vegetation or other 'obstacles.'

makeshift_machete.name: makeshift machete
makeshift_machete.description: This is a large blade that has had a portion of the handle wrapped in duct tape, making it easier to wield as a rough machete.

cavalry_sabre.name: cavalry saber
cavalry_sabre.description: This is a curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight but a deadly slashing weapon.

cavalry_sabre_fake.name: cavalry saber fake
cavalry_sabre_fake.description: This is a dull, cheap replica of a curved sword associated with cavalry, from the Early Modern period onwards.

kris.name: kris
kris.description: This wavy bladed dagger comes from Southeast Asia.  The design of the blade causes it to make broad, painful wounds.

kris_fake.name: kris fake
kris_fake.description: This is a dull, cheap replica of a wavy bladed dagger that comes from Southeast Asia.

kukri.name: kukri
kukri.description: This versatile implement is a modern take on a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly curved edge, it is used as both a tool and as a weapon.

jian.name: jian
jian.description: This is an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao sabre, qiang spear, and gun staff.

jian_inferior.name: jian replica
jian_inferior.description: This is an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword.  The sword is quite worn, and bent at an odd angle.

jian_fake.name: jian fake
jian_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard.

scimitar.name: scimitar
scimitar.description: This is a curved sword associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.  Designed for slashing, and quite deadly against unarmored targets.

scimitar_inferior.name: scimitar replica
scimitar_inferior.description: This is a curved sword associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.  This one seems oddly dull and worn.

scimitar_fake.name: scimitar fake
scimitar_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a curved sword, associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.

estoc.name: estoc
estoc.description: This is a thin, edgeless thrusting sword, a sort of predecessor to the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

estoc_inferior.name: estoc replica
estoc_inferior.description: This is a thin, edgeless thrusting sword, a sort of predecessor to the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.  It seems a bit too bendy.

estoc_fake.name: estoc fake
estoc_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply-made replica of a thin, edgeless thrusting sword predating the rapier.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

longsword.name: longsword
longsword.description: This is a classic medieval sword, in between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

longsword_inferior.name: longsword replica
longsword_inferior.description: This is a classic medieval sword, in between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  You feel like the pommel could just snap off if you used it.

longsword_fake.name: longsword fake
longsword_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply-made replica of the classic medieval longsword.  It requires a larger baldric or scabbard, compared to smaller swords.

arming_sword.name: arming sword
arming_sword.description: This is a classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed.

arming_sword_inferior.name: arming sword replica
arming_sword_inferior.description: This is a classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed.  This one doesn't seem to have been made right.

arming_sword_fake.name: arming sword fake
arming_sword_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a classic medieval sword, just the right size to use one-handed.

sword_xiphos.name: xiphos
sword_xiphos.description: A bronze sword of ancient Greek origin, wielded as a sidearm to the dory spear.

khopesh.name: khopesh
khopesh.description: This ancient bronze weapon features a curved, sickle-like blade sharpened on the outside edge.  Associated with the New Kingdom period of Ancient Egypt, it was designed mainly to hack through the light armor common to the region.

dao.name: dao
dao.description: An ancient Chinese sword consisting of a curved blade and a guard with a cupped design.  Existing since the Shang dynasty, this one is made of bronze.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the jian sword, qiang spear, and gun staff.

survivor_machete.name: survivor machete
survivor_machete.description: This common gardening tool has been customized and rebalanced to improve its performance as a weapon.

sword_bayonet.name: sword bayonet
sword_bayonet.description: A sword bayonet is a large slashing weapon that can be attached to the front of a firearm or crossbow converting it into a pike.

sword_bayonet_mod.name: modified sword bayonet
sword_bayonet_mod.description: A sword bayonet is a large slashing weapon that can be attached to the front of a firearm or crossbow converting it into a pike.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and SMGs, if you so want.

tanto.name: tanto
tanto.description: Long Japanese knives like this more-modern remake were the samurai's backup weapon, before the advent of the larger wakizashi.  It's still a deadly blade, even if it's smaller than its more famous relatives.

tanto_inferior.name: tanto replica
tanto_inferior.description: Long Japanese knives like this more-modern remake were the samurai's backup weapon, before the advent of the larger wakizashi.  This one doesn't feel well-balanced.

tanto_fake.name: tanto fake
tanto_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a long Japanese knife, typically used as a samurai's backup weapon.

wakizashi.name: wakizashi
wakizashi.description: This is a comparatively-common Japanese short sword.  Smaller and lighter than a katana, but still effective in combat.

wakizashi_inferior.name: wakizashi replica
wakizashi_inferior.description: This is a comparatively-common Japanese short sword.  There's something not quite right about this sword.

wakizashi_fake.name: wakizashi fake
wakizashi_fake.description: This is a dull, cheap replica of the more common wakizashi.  Smaller and lighter than a katana, but still effective in combat.

zweihander.name: zweihaender
zweihander.description: This is a huge two-handed sword from Germany.  It packs a real wallop.

zweihander_inferior.name: zweihaender replica
zweihander_inferior.description: This is a huge two-handed sword from Germany.  You're not quite sure it's supposed to be that bendy.

zweihander_fake.name: zweihaender fake
zweihander_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a huge two-handed sword from Germany.  It still packs a wallop.

kirpan.name: kirpan
kirpan.description: A ceremonial dagger carried by Sikh men.  This one is sharp and could be an effective weapon.

kirpan_cheap.name: kirpan replica
kirpan_cheap.description: A ceremonial dagger carried by Sikh men.  This one is not particularly well-made.

nodachi.name: nodachi
nodachi.description: This is a huge, curved, two-handed sword from Japan.  It is surprisingly light for its size.

nodachi_inferior.name: nodachi replica
nodachi_inferior.description: This is a huge, curved, two-handed sword from Japan.  It is surprisingly light for its size, but also much bendier than a sword should be.

nodachi_fake.name: nodachi fake
nodachi_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a huge, curved, two-handed sword from Japan.  It is surprisingly light for its size.

fencing_foil.name: fencing foil
fencing_foil.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  Unfortunately, a fencing foil is rather useless as a weapon, due to its flexible shaft and dull tip.

fencing_foil_sharpened.name: sharpened foil
fencing_foil_sharpened.description: This once mostly harmless fencing foil has had its electrical plunger assembly removed and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now somewhat more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

fencing_epee.name: fencing épée
fencing_epee.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  The épée is the heaviest and stiffest of the fencing weapons, and therefore perhaps the most useful.

fencing_epee_sharpened.name: sharpened épée
fencing_epee_sharpened.description: This once mostly harmless fencing épée has had its electrical plunger assembly removed and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now considerably more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

fencing_sabre.name: fencing saber
fencing_sabre.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  The fencing saber is marginally shorter than the foil and épée, but no less effective.

fencing_sabre_sharpened.name: sharpened saber
fencing_sabre_sharpened.description: This once mostly harmless fencing saber has had its rounded tip snapped off and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now considerably more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

sword_cane.name: sword cane
sword_cane.description: A sword with a thin blade designed to be hidden inside a hollow cane.

broadsword.name: broadsword
broadsword.description: This is an early modern sword seeing use in the 16th, 17th, and 18th centuries.  Called 'broad' to contrast with the slimmer rapiers.

broadsword_inferior.name: broadsword replica
broadsword_inferior.description: This is an early modern sword seeing use in the 16th, 17th, and 18th centuries.  This sword appears to be made very poorly, but it should still stand up to a few swings.

broadsword_fake.name: broadsword fake
broadsword_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of an early modern sword seeing use in the 16th, 17th, and 18th centuries.  Called 'broad' to contrast with the slimmer rapiers.

rapier.name: rapier
rapier.description: This is a thin sword with an ornate hand guard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish battle.

rapier_fake.name: rapier fake
rapier_fake.description: This is a blunted, cheap replica of a thin sword with an ornate hand guard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish battle.

katana.name: katana
katana.description: This is a rare sword from Japan.  Deadly against unarmored targets, and still very effective against armor.

katana_inferior.name: katana replica
katana_inferior.description: This is a rare sword from Japan.  While it's got the right edge and balance, the pommel just snaps off, and the blade seems pretty worn.

katana_fake.name: katana fake
katana_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a rare sword from Japan.

butterfly_swords.name: pair of butterfly swords
butterfly_swords.description: This is a matched pair of traditional Shaolin butterfly swords.  They are about the size of machetes but have hand guards and wider blades.

cutlass.name: cutlass
cutlass.description: This is a broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

cutlass_inferior.name: cutlass replica
cutlass_inferior.description: This is a broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates.  This sword appears to be made very poorly, but it should still stand up to a few swings.

cutlass_fake.name: cutlass fake
cutlass_fake.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates.

glass_macuahuitl.name: makeshift macuahuitl
glass_macuahuitl.description: A flat wooden club with sharpened pieces of stone sticking to both of its sides.

razor_macuahuitl.name: razorblade macuahuitl
razor_macuahuitl.description: A flat wooden club with razor blades set into the edges.  Significantly sharper than using stone blades.

lajatang.name: lajatang
lajatang.description: An exotic weapon comprised of a long pole of wood with curved blades on each end.  It can be deadly in skilled hands.

dagger_medieval.name: dagger
dagger_medieval.description: A medieval dagger, more finely crafted than a baselard.

dagger_bronze.name: bronze dagger
dagger_bronze.description: An archaic-looking bronze dagger, with a serviceable sharp edge.

knife_carbon.name: carbon fiber knife
knife_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed combat knife made out of carbon fiber and a steel edge.  It is more lightweight than a normal knife thanks to its method of manufacturing.

sword_carbon.name: carbon fiber katana
sword_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed single-bladed sword made out of carbon fiber and a steel edge.  It is more lightweight than a normal sword thanks to its method of manufacturing.

broadsword_carbon.name: carbon fiber sword
broadsword_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed double-bladed sword made out of carbon fiber and a steel edge.  It is more lightweight than a normal sword thanks to its method of manufacturing.

nodachi_carbon.name: carbon fiber nodachi
nodachi_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed single-bladed two-handed sword made out of carbon fiber and a steel edge.  It is more lightweight than a normal sword thanks to its method of manufacturing.

greatsword_carbon.name: carbon fiber greatsword
greatsword_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed two-handed sword made out of carbon fiber and a steel edge.  It is more lightweight than a normal sword thanks to its method of manufacturing.

knife_stinger.name: stinger dagger
knife_stinger.description: A dagger made from a sharpened mutant insect stinger.  It's only natural that the Cataclysm would advent new, creative forms of old weapons.

hit_you_effect.message: The stinger injects a small amount of poison into your target.

knife_triffid.name: triffid dagger
knife_triffid.description: A dagger made from the stinger of a strange plant monster.  Fitting that the Cataclysm brings with it a few creative twists on ancient weapons.

hit_you_effect.message: The stinger injects a small amount of poison into your target.

knife_tooth.name: sharktooth dagger
knife_tooth.description: A dagger made from a wooden handle with razor-sharp teeth lining the edge.

tooth_leiomano.name: sharktooth leiomano
tooth_leiomano.description: A flat wooden club with razor-sharp teeth set into the edges.  This was a weapon of various Polynesian peoples, and was used to great effect.

sword_bone.name: bone cleaver
sword_bone.description: This shortsword is carved from a large chunk of bone set in a wooden haft, and is capable of slicing foes in with swiftness and efficiency.

radiant_blade.name: radiant blade
radiant_blade.description: Trails of brilliant light snake across the blade of this masterwork sword. Integrated with the remains of a mutant triffid, it is light and versatile enough to be easily adapted to most sword fighting styles.

bagh_nakha.name: tiger claws
bagh_nakha.description: Also called bagh nakha or iron paw, this is a small claw-like bladed weapon from India designed to be concealed under and against the palm.

cestus.name: cestus
cestus.description: A leather hand and arm wrap incorporating metal plates over the knuckles to improve punching power and defence.

knuckle_brass.name: pair of brass knuckles
knuckle_brass.description: A metal weapon made of brass, designed to be gripped in the palm and cause punches to do extra damage.  A good, quick weapon - but you have to get within punching range to use it.

knuckle_katar.name: razorbar katar
knuckle_katar.description: Five pieces of rebar sharpened to cruel points and strapped to a brace fastened at wrist and forearm on both arms.  The next bub better watch out.

knuckle_nail.name: pair of nail knuckles
knuckle_nail.description: A pair of knuckles consisting of two small squares of wood with several nails coming through them.  Useful in nasty street fights.

knuckle_steel.name: pair of steel knuckles
knuckle_steel.description: A mass of scrap metal crudely beat into shape, with folded rags underneath to protect the wearers knuckles.  A good, quick weapon - but you have to get within punching range to use it.

punch_dagger.name: punch dagger
punch_dagger.description: A short and sharp double-edged dagger made to be gripped in the palm, with the blade protruding between the fingers.

katar.name: katar
katar.description: A steel brace with a metal blade at the end, designed to allow the user to stab and slash with the same motions as a punch.

jamadhar.name: jamadhar
jamadhar.description: A steel brace with two thinner, pointed blades at the end, designed primarily to stab victims when used to punch.

impact_knuckle.name: pair of impact knuckles
impact_knuckle.description: A pair of sturdy steel bracings, inlaid with padding material, which are then covered by hardened steel plates.  Can be used to safely deliver punches full force without the risk of harming ones hands.

spiked_boxing.name: spiked boxing gloves
spiked_boxing.description: Boxing gloves with nails driven through the inside.  Not exactly ring-legal, but there are no more referees.

sai_weapon.name: sai
sai_weapon.description: A pointed metal baton with two curved prongs projecting from the handle.  It's primarily used for disarming opponents, but can also make your punches puncture your foes.

jamadhar_carbon.name: carbon fiber jamadhar
jamadhar_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed jamadhar made out of carbon fiber with steel-edged blades.  It is more lightweight than a normal weapon thanks to its method of manufacturing.

katar_carbon.name: carbon fiber katar
katar_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed katar made out of carbon fiber and a steel edge.  It is more lightweight than a normal weapon thanks to its method of manufacturing.

cestus_tooth.name: sharktooth cestus
cestus_tooth.description: This weapon is a series of leather wrappings with a bone plate that has a series of razor-sharp teeth attached to it.  For when your punches need more bite.

flyer.name: flyer
flyer.description: A scrap of paper.  It's got stuff depicted on it, and a lot of boring words.  The stuff looks neat at least, but they probably don't make it anymore.

survnote.name: survivor's note
survnote.description: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.

character_sheet.name: character sheet
character_sheet.description: You're fairly certain this is a character sheet for some sort of game, either that or some poor kid's math homework.

newest_newspaper.name: newspaper page
newest_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It is possibly one of the last issues printed before New England was overwhelmed.  No doubt filled with trivial and out-of-date information, who even reads these things anymore?

many_years_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
many_years_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It seems to date from several years ago, and you've NO idea how it lasted this long.  No doubt filled with trivial and out-of-date information, who even reads these things anymore?

years_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
years_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It seems to date from a few years ago--amazing it has lasted this long.  No doubt filled with trivial and out-of-date information, who even reads these things anymore?

one_year_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
one_year_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed more than a year ago.  No doubt filled with trivial and out-of-date information, who even reads these things anymore?

months_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
months_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed in the months leading up to the Cataclysm.  No doubt filled with trivial and out-of-date information, who even reads these things anymore?

weeks_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
weeks_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed in the weeks leading up to the Cataclysm.  No doubt filled with trivial and out-of-date information, who even reads these things anymore?

necropolis_leaflet.name: vault leaflet
necropolis_leaflet.description: A folded glossy handout with a cross-section of a massive underground complex depicted on the first page.

death_note.name: note
death_note.description: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.

evac_pamphlet.name: FEMA evacuation pamphlet
evac_pamphlet.description: A scrap of paper with a lot of words printed on it.  Something about femurs?

movie_poster.name: movie poster
movie_poster.description: Posters promoting movies that were in theaters when the Cataclysm hit.

disc_golf.name: disc
disc_golf.description: A plastic disc made for playing disc golf, it is smaller and denser then a normal frisbee.

frisbee.name: frisbee
frisbee.description: A plastic frisbee made for outdoor games.

lawn_dart.name: lawn dart
lawn_dart.description: A large plastic dart made for outdoor games.

throwing_axe.name: throwing axe
throwing_axe.description: A lightweight hatchet made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and light weight makes it unsuitable for use as a tool.

throwing_knife.name: throwing knife
throwing_knife.description: A thin and flat knife made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape makes it unsuitable for use as a tool.

shuriken.name: shuriken
shuriken.description: A small throwing star.  Easy to store and quite light, but not very useful for anything but throwing.

resin_chunk.name: alien resin chunk
resin_chunk.description: This is a shattered fragment of alien resin.  It looks a bit like a large piece of sea glass, frosted and gritty with the edges rounded off.  It is somewhat warm to the touch.

glass_sheet.name: sheet of glass
glass_sheet.description: A large sheet of glass.  Easily shattered.  Useful for repairing windows.

use_action.done_message: You break the pane and place the shards on the ground, ready to be cracked by something passing by.

reinforced_glass_sheet.name: sheet of reinforced glass
reinforced_glass_sheet.description: A large sheet of glass strengthened with steel wiring.

tempered_glass_sheet.name: sheet of tempered glass
tempered_glass_sheet.description: A large, durable sheet of tempered glass, approximately six millimeters thick.  A common type of safety glass with the curious property of breaking into small, non-lethal pieces upon shattering.

peephole.name: peephole
peephole.description: A metal cylinder with a small lens inside intended to be installed on a door.

screen_mesh.name: mesh screen
screen_mesh.description: A roll of fine mesh screen for bug barriers on porches.

pipe.name: pipe
pipe.description: A steel pipe, makes a good melee weapon.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.

cartridgebrass.name: brass
cartridgebrass.description: Some brass scraps, if you have the right tools they could be formed into cartridge casings.

spike.name: spike
spike.description: A large and slightly misshapen spike, could do some damage mounted on a vehicle.

cu_pipe.name: copper tubing
cu_pipe.description: A copper tube, too thin to be much use as a melee weapon, but will do if nothing else is available.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.

material_aluminium_ingot.name: aluminum ingot
material_aluminium_ingot.description: A small aluminum ingot, standardized for further processing.  Light but durable, this could be cast into various shapes for construction or ground down to a powder, for more… high-profile applications.

scrap_copper.name: scrap copper
scrap_copper.description: A small chunk of copper, usable for crafting or repairs.

bee_sting.name: bee sting
bee_sting.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant bee.  Makes a mediocre melee weapon.

broom.name: broom
broom.description: A long-handled broom.  Makes a terrible weapon unless you're chasing cats.

ceramic_shard.name: ceramic shard
ceramic_shard.description: A broken ceramic shard.  It is heavy and has a somewhat sharp edge, but it's too irregular to cut properly.

fighter_sting.name: fungal fighter sting
fighter_sting.description: A short dart from a fungal fighter.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

mattress.name: mattress
mattress.description: This is a single, or twin, sized mattress.

down_mattress.name: down mattress
down_mattress.description: This is a single, or twin, sized down filled mattress.

sharp_rock.name: sharp rock
sharp_rock.description: A rock with sharp edges, that can be used as a butchering tool, if nothing else is available.  Makes a passable melee weapon.

ugl_buttstock.name: grenade launcher buttstock
ugl_buttstock.description: A collapsible buttstock designed for the M320 grenade launcher.  When combined with this stock, the M320 can be used as a standalone weapon

wasp_sting.name: wasp sting
wasp_sting.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant wasp.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

cannonball_4lb.name: cannonball
cannonball_4lb.description: A four-pound, cast-iron cannonball.  With some gunpowder, wadding, and a fuse, it could be prepared to load into a cannon.

wool_mattress.name: wool mattress
wool_mattress.description: A mattress made of wool.  It is quite soft and comfortable.

radiant_core.name: radiant core
radiant_core.description: This thorny organic orb, taken from the heart of a mutated triffid, glows with radiant light.  A skilled smith could probably turn this into a powerful weapon.

plastic_chunk.name: plastic chunk
plastic_chunk.description: This is a piece of plastic.  It could be used to fabricate, repair, or reinforce plastic items.

carbon_fiber_filament.name: carbon fiber filament
carbon_fiber_filament.description: A spool of fine carbon filament, used to make lightweight yet strong items.  Very useful if you can get your hands on a 3D printer, more advanced models might even allow you to make more.

nylon.name: synthetic fabric
nylon.description: This is small bolt of synthetic fabric.  Unlike you and other natural materials, it won't degrade much with age.  Maybe that's less of a bad thing now.

plastic_sheet.name: plastic sheet
plastic_sheet.description: This is a large sheet of heavy flexible plastic, the sort that might have been used for commercial wrapping or for weather-sealing a home.

rigid_plastic_sheet.name: rigid plastic sheet
rigid_plastic_sheet.description: A large, rigid sheet of translucent plastic, useful for all manner of things; from construction to art, or even junior snowboarding.

plastic_scrap.name: plastic scrap
plastic_scrap.description: This is a tiny piece of plastic.  Useless on its own, but could be melted down if you gather enough.

log.name: log
log.description: A large chunk of log, cut from a tree.  (a)ctivate a wood axe or wood saw to cut it into planks.

splinter.name: splintered wood
splinter.description: A splintered piece of wood, could be used as a skewer or for kindling.

stick.name: heavy stick
stick.description: A sturdy, heavy stick.  Makes a decent melee weapon.

stick_long.name: long stick
stick_long.description: A long stick.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be broken into heavy sticks for crafting.

long_pole.name: long pole
long_pole.description: A stout, ten-foot pole.  Could be used similarly to a spear.  The Cataclysm gives fresh meaning to walking softly and carrying a big stick.

2x4.name: plank
2x4.description: A narrow, thick plank of wood, like a 2 by 4 or similar piece of dimensional lumber.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be used for all kinds construction.

wood_beam.name: heavy wooden beam
wood_beam.description: An enormous beam of solid wood, very heavy and hard to lug around, but also very sturdy for construction.  You could saw or chop it into smaller pieces, like planks or panels.

wood_panel.name: wooden panel
wood_panel.description: A wide, thin wooden board - plywood, OSB, MDF, tongue-in-groove boards, or similar, already cut to shape.  These large flat boards are good for all kinds of construction, but for really big projects you'd need a proper sheet of uncut plywood or the like.

wood_sheet.name: large wooden sheet
wood_sheet.description: A standard 4x8 sheet of flat wood - usually plywood, OSB, or MDF.  Heavy and bulky, this is extremely useful for all manner of construction, but you might have to cut it to size before doing smaller projects.

fuel_briquette.name: fuel briquette
fuel_briquette.description: A hunk of dried plant matter condensed into a puck, then dried.  It burns well.

targeting_module.name: targeting module
targeting_module.description: This module integrates visual and proprioceptive information from peripheric sensors and outputs information necessary for accurate aiming.

identification_module.name: identification module
identification_module.description: This module continuously runs image recognition algorithms to identify friends from foe.

pathfinding_module.name: pathfinding module
pathfinding_module.description: This module uses a combination of vector integration and egocentric mapping to find the best path available.

memory_module.name: memory banks module
memory_module.description: Allows for storage and recovery of information.

sensor_module.name: sensor array
sensor_module.description: A wide range of sensors meant to give the ability to perceive the surrounding world.

self_monitoring_module.name: self monitoring sensors
self_monitoring_module.description: An array of sensors and diagnostic modules allowing the robot to perceive itself.

ai_module.name: AI core
ai_module.description: This module is responsible for decision-making, it basically runs the AI of the robot.

ai_module_basic.name: basic AI core
ai_module_basic.description: A very basic AI core with minimal cognitive abilities.

ai_module_advanced.name: advanced AI core
ai_module_advanced.description: An advanced AI core with impressive cognitive abilities.

gun_module.name: gun operating system
gun_module.description: This system can operate most conventional weapons.

spidery_legs_small.name: set of tiny spidery legs
spidery_legs_small.description: A set of tiny pointy legs, like the ones found under a skitterbot.

reverse_jointed_legs.name: set of reverse-jointed legs
reverse_jointed_legs.description: A set of reverse-jointed legs, like the ones found under a military walker.

omni_wheel.name: set of omni wheels
omni_wheel.description: A set of omni wheels, like the ones found under a police bot.

quad_rotors.name: set of rotors
quad_rotors.description: A set of rotors able to lift a small drone.

tank_tread.name: set of small tank tread
tank_tread.description: A set of small tank tread, like the one used by the "Beagle" mini-tank.

turret_chassis.name: turret interior chassis
turret_chassis.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton of a turret.

copbot_chassis.name: TALON chassis
copbot_chassis.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of a military bot.

policebot_chassis.name: police bot chassis
policebot_chassis.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of a police bot.

android_chassis.name: android skeleton
android_chassis.description: What's left when you strip an android body from its components.

tankbot_chassis.name: Beagle chassis
tankbot_chassis.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Beagle tank.

tripod_chassis.name: tripod chassis
tripod_chassis.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the tripod.

chickenbot_chassis.name: chicken walker chassis
chickenbot_chassis.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the chicken walker.

spidery_legs_big.name: set of spidery legs
spidery_legs_big.description: A set of big pointy legs, like the ones found under a tripod.

AID_bio_alarm.name: Alarm System CBM installation data
AID_bio_alarm.description: Precise step-by-step instructions and other required data for installation of Alarm System CBM, stored on a data card of proprietary form-factor, designed to be used extensively by an Autodoc, and allowing bionic installation with minimal failure chance.  Integrated security subroutine renders it unusable after installation.

Integrated security subroutine renders it unusable after installation.

software.name: software
software.description: IF YOU ARE SEEING THIS IT IS A BUG.

software_useless.name: misc software
software_useless.description: A miscellaneous piece of hobby software.  Probably useless.

software_utility.name: UniTool
software_utility.description: A versatile software toolkit - unzips archives, flashes drives, and a variety of other digital tasks.

software_lab_data.name: lab data
software_lab_data.description: Research archives from a government laboratory.

software_train_data.name: train data
software_train_data.description: Logistical data on subterranean train routes and schedules.

mind_scan_robofac.name: neural data
mind_scan_robofac.description:
Data stolen from a dead scientist memory banks.  Is the owner of these thoughts still hidden here, amidst the unreadable data; or are these just a collection of the precious moments of someone's life?

Whatever the case, the idea of perpetually keeping a part of you within a metallic pill makes you feel uncomfortable.

software_electronics_reference.name: integrated circuit datasheet archives
software_electronics_reference.description: Huge archives of numerous IC circuit datasheets from several major manufacturers.  Probably valuable to the right person, as it would be hard to salvage and reuse these components without them.

software_cryptow.name: undeclared crypto wallet
software_cryptow.description: A cryptocoin fortune equivalent to $250,000 that someone really didn't want to report to Uncle Sam. A pity it's useless now...

peanut_bush.name: uprooted peanut bush
peanut_bush.description: A peanut bush that's ready for transplanting.

peanut_bush_h.name: uprooted peanut bush
peanut_bush_h.description: A harvested peanut bush that's ready for transplanting.

blueberry_bush.description: A blueberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

blueberry_bush_h.name: uprooted blueberry bush
blueberry_bush_h.description: A blueberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

strawberry_bush.description: A strawberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

strawberry_bush_h.name: uprooted strawberry bush
strawberry_bush_h.description: A harvested strawberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

blackberry_bush.name: uprooted blackberry bush
blackberry_bush.description: A blackberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

blackberry_bush_h.name: uprooted blackberry bush
blackberry_bush_h.description: A harvested blackberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

huckleberry_bush.name: uprooted huckleberry bush
huckleberry_bush.description: A huckleberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

huckleberry_bush_h.name: uprooted huckleberry bush
huckleberry_bush_h.description: A harvested huckleberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

raspberry_bush.name: uprooted raspberry bush
raspberry_bush.description: A raspberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

raspberry_bush_h.name: uprooted raspberry bush
raspberry_bush_h.description: A harvested raspberry bush that's ready for transplanting.

grape_bush.name: uprooted grape bush
grape_bush.description: A grape bush that's ready for transplanting.

grape_bush_h.name: uprooted grape bush
grape_bush_h.description: A harvested grape bush that's ready for transplanting.

atomic_coffeepot.name: atomic coffee maker
atomic_coffeepot.description: This is a Curie-G coffeemaker, by CuppaTech.  It famously uses a radioactive generator to heat water for coffee.  Normally the water is heated using energy stored in a capacitor, and makes ordinary coffee.  However, as a special feature, water from the RTG containment area can be used, giving the coffee a very special kick.  The Curie-G is illegal in most countries.

butchering_kit.name: butchering kit
butchering_kit.description: This is a kit containing all the specialized knives you need to debone, skin, and prepare cuts of meat from an animal.

butter_churn.name: pseudo butter churn
butter_churn.description: This is a crafting_pseudo_item if you have it something is wrong.

can_sealer.name: can sealer
can_sealer.description: A hand crank powered cast steel machine designed to automatically seal tin cans.

clay_pot.name: clay pot
clay_pot.description: A crude clay pot with lid used for cooking.

clay_quern.name: clay quern
clay_quern.description: This is a simple hand-powered clay quern for grinding grain.

clay_teapot.name: clay teapot
clay_teapot.description: A clay teapot.  Now all you need is tea and water.

eggs_ferment.name: fermenting eggs jar
eggs_ferment.description: This jar contains a batch of eggs in a pickling solution.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You examine the batch and see that the pickling solution has done its job, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The eggs are not done yet.

flask_yeast.name: small sealed yeast culture
flask_yeast.description: A sealed flask holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

use_action.msg: You open the flask and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.

jar_yeast.name: sealed yeast culture
jar_yeast.description: A sealed jar holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

use_action.msg: You open the jar and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.

clay_yeast.name: sealed yeast culture
clay_yeast.description: A sealed clay bowl holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

use_action.msg: You remove the lid from the bowl and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.

jar_3l_glass_yeast.name: large sealed yeast culture
jar_3l_glass_yeast.description: A sealed 3L glass jar holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

use_action.msg: You open the jar and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.

wild_yeast.name: sealed wild yeast culture
wild_yeast.description: Mixture of water, sugar and fruits with some naturally occurring yeast, that will eventually produce a more sizable yeast culture.

use_action.msg: You open the jar and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.

wild_clay_yeast.name: sealed wild yeast culture
wild_clay_yeast.description: Mixture of water, sugar and fruits with some naturally occurring yeast, that will eventually produce a more sizable yeast culture.

use_action.msg: You remove the lid from the bowl and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.

drying_meat.name: dehydrating meat tray
drying_meat.description: A tray of dehydrating meat. Harvest it once it's fully dried out.

use_action.msg: You harvest the meat off of the tray.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The meat isn't done drying yet.

drying_veg.name: dehydrating vegetable tray
drying_veg.description: A tray of dehydrating vegetables. Harvest it once it's fully dried out.

use_action.msg: You harvest the vegetables off of the tray.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The vegetables aren't done drying yet.

drying_fruit.name: dehydrating fruit tray
drying_fruit.description: A tray of dehydrating fruit. Harvest it once it's fully dried out.

use_action.msg: You harvest the fruit off of the tray.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The fruit isn't done drying yet.

drying_fish.name: dehydrating fish tray
drying_fish.description: A tray of dehydrating fish. Harvest it once it's fully dried out.

use_action.msg: You harvest the fish off of the tray.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The fish isn't done drying yet.

drying_taint.name: dehydrating tainted meat tray
drying_taint.description: A tray of dehydrating tainted meat. Harvest it once it's fully dried out.

use_action.msg: You harvest the tainted meat off of the tray.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tainted meat isn't done drying yet.

heatpack.name: heat pack
heatpack.description: This is a chemical heat pack.  It's used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  It is usable only once.

jar_eggs_pickled.name: sealed jar of eggs
jar_eggs_pickled.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing pickled eggs.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the jar, exposing it to the atmosphere.

jar_pickles_pickled.name: sealed jar of pickles
jar_pickles_pickled.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing pickles.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the jar, exposing it to the atmosphere.

jar_sauerkraut_pickled.name: sealed jar of sauerkraut
jar_sauerkraut_pickled.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing sauerkraut.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the jar, exposing it to the atmosphere.

mess_tin.name: mess tin
mess_tin.description: A compact military-style pan and tray, designed for heating food over a fire or portable stove.  It is shallower than a proper pot or pan, and lacks the integrated heating elements modern mess kits have.

mortar_pestle.name: mortar and pestle
mortar_pestle.description: This is a simple combination of a small grindstone and a bowl-shaped stone.  Used for grinding grain, but time-consuming compared to more complex methods.

pastaextruder.name: pasta extruder
pastaextruder.description: A pasta extruder run by a hand-crank.  Useful in making pasta.  It comes with various heads to make various kinds of pasta.

pickles_ferment.name: fermenting pickle jar
pickles_ferment.description: This jar contains a batch of pickles set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The pickles are not done fermenting yet.

pressure_cooker.name: pressure cooker
pressure_cooker.description: Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.  This sealed pot is designed to cook food at higher pressures and temperatures.  Can also be used for pressure sensitive chemical reactions.

rock_quern.name: quern
rock_quern.description: This is a simple hand-powered stone quern for grinding grain.

sauerkraut_ferment.name: fermenting sauerkraut jar
sauerkraut_ferment.description: This jar contains a batch of sauerkraut set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The sauerkraut isn't done fermenting yet.

still.name: still
still.description: This is a still.  It's useful for creating distillation of alcohol and other, more curious substances.

retort_clay.name: clay retort
retort_clay.description: This is a primitive distillation tool made from clay, with a long neck that acts as a condenser.

retort_copper.name: copper retort
retort_copper.description: This is a primitive distillation tool made from copper, with a long neck that acts as a condenser.

teapot.name: teapot
teapot.description: A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.

waffleiron.name: waffle iron
waffleiron.description: A waffle iron.  For making waffles.

kimchi_hydria.name: kimchi gimjangdok
kimchi_hydria.description: A dok, or clay jar, in which kimchi is stored for the winter.  Traditionally, this is buried in the ground, but it doesn't matter if you leave it above ground; just close the lid and wait for it to ferment, and you'll have delicious kimchi.

use_action.msg: You lift the lid and the smell of tangy, spicy, ripe kimchi makes you salivate.
use_action.not_ready_msg: This kimchi is not done fermenting yet.

brazier.name: brazier
brazier.description: A large metal stand used to contain a fire.  Fires set in a brazier will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

hobo_stove.name: hobo stove
hobo_stove.description: This is a small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can or similar container of the right size.  It's too small to fit anything much larger than splintered wood.  Activate it to Deploy.

55gal_firebarrel.name: fire barrel (200L)
55gal_firebarrel.description: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

30gal_firebarrel.name: fire barrel (100L)
30gal_firebarrel.description: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

camp_chair.name: camp chair
camp_chair.description: Folded camp chair, deploy to sit down.

cot.name: cot
cot.description: This is a military style fold up cot.  While it may not be quite as comfortable as a bed, it's better than slumming it on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unfold the cot and place it on the ground.

metal_butcher_rack.name: metal butchering rack
metal_butcher_rack.description: Metal butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.  It is folded for easy transportation.

metal_smoking_rack.name: metal smoking rack
metal_smoking_rack.description: A metal rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  It is folded for easy transportation.

tourist_table.name: tourist table
tourist_table.description: Metal tourist table for off-road trips.  It is folded for easy transportation.

leather_tarp.name: leather tarp
leather_tarp.description: A large sheet of sewn leather that can be deployed instead of a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a butchery appliance as it does not soak in blood.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.

fiber_mat.name: fiber mat
fiber_mat.description: A large mat woven from fibrous material that can be used instead of a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a butchery appliance.  Too thin to be used as a comfortable sleeping place.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.

churn.name: folded butter churn
churn.description: A large wooden container used to turn raw milk into butter and buttermilk.  This model uses a foot crank and holds three gallons of raw milk.

atomic_butterchurn.name: folded atomic butter churn
atomic_butterchurn.description: The Rivtech Churninator 4000, the only churn to be banned by 13 religious sects.  The legs are currently folded up for travel.  This churn requires nothing but raw milk, salt and a healthy respect for glowing objects, even able to clarify butter with its awe-inspiring nuclear might.

water_mill.name: water mill
water_mill.description: A small water-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Can be placed via the construction menu.

wind_mill.name: wind mill
wind_mill.description: A small wind-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Can be placed via the construction menu.

directional_antenna.name: directional antenna
directional_antenna.description: This is an antenna designed to pick up signals better when pointed at the source.  You could use this with a radio to receive faint signals.

crowbar.name: crowbar
crowbar.description: This is a hefty prying tool.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

hairpin_picklock.name: hairpin lockpick
hairpin_picklock.description: This is a metal hairpin bent into shape by hand, worse than an improvised set but easier to work with than a bone skewer.  You need MacGyver-like skills to open locks with this as it is brittle, but it lowers the chance of an alarm being set off.  If you're crouched or prone, examining a locked door will have you prioritize picking the lock instead of using a crowbar on it.

crude_picklock.name: improvised lockpick
crude_picklock.description: This is an improvised set of picks and torsion wrenches made from scrap metal.  You need MacGyver-like skills to open locks with these as they are brittle, but they lower the chances of alarms being set off.  If you're crouched or prone, examining a locked door will have you prioritize picking the lock instead of using a crowbar on it.

iceaxe.name: ice axe
iceaxe.description: This is an ice axe with hammer on its head, a multi-purpose hiking and climbing tool used by mountaineers.  It is sturdy enough to pry open closed doors or lift manhole covers.

makeshift_crowbar.name: makeshift crowbar
makeshift_crowbar.description: This is a pipe whose ends have been bent and hammered flat to resemble a crowbar.  Use it to open locked crates without destroying them, to lift manhole covers, or even open doors and windows.  You could also wield it to fight with, in a pinch.

picklocks.name: locksmith kit
picklocks.description: This is a locksmith's set of sturdy steel lock picks and torsion wrenches.  It is essential for silently and quickly opening locks, provided you have some mechanical skill.  If you're crouched or prone, examining a locked door will have you prioritize picking the lock instead of using a crowbar on it.

fungicidalbomb.name: fungicidal gas grenade

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

fungicidalbomb.description: This is a canister grenade filled with fungicidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active fungicidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to fungal life forms.

fungicidalbomb_act.name: armed fungicidal gas canister

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

fungicidalbomb_act.description: This fungicidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic gas.

fungicidalbomb_makeshift.name: makeshift fungicidal gas grenade

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

fungicidalbomb_makeshift.description: This is a makeshift canister grenade filled with fungicidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active fungicidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to fungal life forms.

fungicidalbomb_makeshift_act.name: armed makeshift fungicidal gas canister

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

fungicidalbomb_makeshift_act.description: This makeshift fungicidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic haze.

gasbomb.name: tear gas grenade

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

gasbomb.description: This is a canister grenade filled with noxious irritant.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active tear gas grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for some time.  This gas damages and slows those who enter it, as well as obscuring vision and scent.

gasbomb_act.name: armed tear gas grenade

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

gasbomb_act.description: This smoke bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic gas.

insecticidalbomb.name: insecticidal gas grenade

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

insecticidalbomb.description: This is a canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to insect life forms.

insecticidalbomb_act.name: armed insecticidal gas grenade

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

insecticidalbomb_act.description: This insecticidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic haze.

insecticidalbomb_makeshift.name: makeshift insecticidal gas grenade

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

insecticidalbomb_makeshift.description: This is a makeshift canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a volatile spray that is highly toxic to insect life forms.

insecticidalbomb_makeshift_act.name: armed makeshift insecticidal gas grenade

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

insecticidalbomb_makeshift_act.description: This makeshift insecticidal bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic haze.

smokebomb.name: smoke bomb

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

smokebomb.description: This is a canister grenade filled with a variety of pyrotechnic chemicals.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active smoke bomb.  Five turns after you do that, it will begin to expel a thick black smoke.  This smoke will slow those who enter it, as well as obscuring vision and scent.

smokebomb_act.name: armed smoke bomb

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

smokebomb_act.description: This smoke bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling thick smoke.

magnifying_glass.name: magnifying glass
magnifying_glass.description: This is a magnifying glass.  May be useful for starting fires during sunny skies.

crash_axe.name: crash axe
crash_axe.description: A short lightweight emergency tool with a quarter circular blade, a short pick opposite the blade and an insulated handle.  Used on airplanes to chop down or pry walls or cabinets to gain access in case of fire.

fire_ax.name: fire axe
fire_ax.description: This is a large, two-handed pickhead axe normally used by firefighters.  It makes a powerful melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.

halligan.name: Halligan bar
halligan.description: This is a heavy multiple-use tool commonly carried by firefighters, law enforcement, and military rescue units.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

pike_pole.name: pike pole
pike_pole.description: A durable tool consisting of a sturdy fiberglass shaft tipped with a small steel hook.

ny_hook.name: New York hook
ny_hook.description: A shaft with a pair of hooks on one end and a pry bar on the other, forged from a single piece of steel.

fishing_hook_bone.name: improvised fishing hook
fishing_hook_bone.description: An improvised fishing hook carved from wood or bone.

fishing_rod_basic.name: basic fishing rod
fishing_rod_basic.description: 'Fishing rod' might be a bit too charitable of a description.  In truth, this is a stick with a piece of string and a hook.

fishing_rod_professional.name: pro fishing rod
fishing_rod_professional.description: A professional fishing rod with a matching set of weights.  With this you should be able to catch 'em all.

press.name: hand press
press.description: This is a small hand press for hand loading firearm ammunition.  It comes with everything you need to start hand loading your own munitions.

press_dowel.name: makeshift shotshell press
press_dowel.description: This is a collection of items improvised for field reloading of shotshells.  A plank with a hole cut in the center, a medium-sized nail, and a selection of whittled dowels are used to seat wads, decap primers, and reprime (carefully!) hulls.  The opposite side of the plank has been shaped to allow for roll crimping of the plastic hulls.

puller.name: kinetic bullet puller
puller.description: This is a tool used for properly disassembling firearm ammunition.

press_workbench_item.name: reloading press
press_workbench_item.description: This is an all-in-one handloading tool consisting of a multi-stage press, bullet molds, a hotplate, and a collet puller for disassembling cartridges.  It needs to be hooked up as grid furniture or mounted on a vehicle, but once you do it can handle both making your own ammunition and taking ammo apart for materials.

copper_knife.name: copper knife
copper_knife.description: A knife consisting of crudely-worked copper, and a simple handle.  Primitive, but a step above stone-age.

diveknife.name: dive knife
diveknife.description: This is a short, sturdy knife with a serrated edge for cutting lines and straps, and a blunt tip for prying.  Used primarily by divers, it is very light and takes up virtually no space in one's pockets.

honey_scraper.name: honey scraper
honey_scraper.description: A sharp, knife-like tool used in harvesting honey from beehives.  Makes a passable melee weapon.

pockknife.name: pocket knife
pockknife.description: This is a small pocket knife.  It isn't great for combat, but it's better than nothing.  It's sharp enough to butcher with.

primitive_knife.name: primitive knife
primitive_knife.description: This is a sharpened stone or shard of ceramic set into a hollowed handle.  Not nearly as usable as a proper knife, but it's better than nothing.

digging_stick.name: digging stick
digging_stick.description: This is a large stick, with the end carved into a broad blade for digging.  It could be used to dig shallow pits, but not deep ones.

g_shovel.name: trowel
g_shovel.description: A small, sharp gardening shovel, perfect for digging up grubs and worms.

hoe.name: hoe
hoe.description: This is a farming implement.  You can use it to turn tillable land into a slow-to-cross pile of dirt, or dig a shallow pit.

primitive_shovel.name: primitive shovel
primitive_shovel.description: This is a flattened stone or ceramic shard affixed to a stick.  It works passably well as a shovel but really can't compare to a real shovel.

scythe.name: scythe
scythe.description: This is an old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.  While it may be a giant blade on the end of a stick, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.

shovel.name: shovel
shovel.description: This is a digging tool.  Use it to dig pits adjacent to your location.

shovel_short.name: short shovel
shovel_short.description: This digging tool has had its handle cut shorter to be easier to carry.  Digs holes just like any other shovel, but less effective as a weapon.

sickle.name: sickle
sickle.description: This is an old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.  While it may be a massive curved blade on a handle, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.

atomic_lamp.name: atomic lamp
atomic_lamp.description: Powered by the magic of nuclear decay and low-energy LEDs, this very expensive lamp will emit a small amount of light for at least a decade.  Before the Cataclysm, it was mostly an expensive way to show off your preparedness.  Now, it's actually pretty cool.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.

use_action.msg: You close the lamp's cover.

atomic_lamp_off.name: atomic lamp (covered)
atomic_lamp_off.description: Powered by the magic of nuclear decay and low-energy LEDs, this very expensive lamp will emit a small amount of light for at least a decade.  Before the Cataclysm, it was mostly an expensive way to show off your preparedness.  Now, it's actually pretty cool.  The cover is closed.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.

use_action.msg: You open the lamp's cover.

atomic_light.name: atomic reading light
atomic_light.description: Powered by the magic of nuclear decay and low-energy LEDs, this extremely expensive little light will provide just enough light to read by for at least a decade.  It is also available with a cute cartoon bear cover to turn it into a nightlight for a very wealthy child with a fear of the dark.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.

use_action.msg: You close the nightlight's cover.

atomic_light_off.name: atomic reading light (covered)
atomic_light_off.description: Powered by the magic of nuclear decay and low-energy LEDs, this extremely expensive little light will provide just enough light to read by for at least a decade.  It is also available with a cute cartoon bear cover to turn it into a nightlight for a very wealthy child with a fear of the dark.  The cover is closed.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.

use_action.msg: You open the nightlight's cover.

glowstick_dead.name: dead glowstick
glowstick_dead.description: This is a spent glowstick.  It is essentially trash.

grinder_blade.name: grinder blade
grinder_blade.description: A 125mm angle grinder blade.  You could make a powertool with it, or throw it.  Wielding it without sturdy gloves is a bad idea.

scalpel.name: scalpel
scalpel.description: This is a very sharp knife designed for surgical cutting.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.

thermometer.name: thermometer
thermometer.description: A plastic thermometer that can read the air temperature.

wrapped_rad_badge.name: wrapped radiation badge
wrapped_rad_badge.description: This is a badge that detects radiation dosage sealed in a radiation-blocking bag.  Use it to remove it from the bag.

use_action.msg: You remove the badge from its wrapper, exposing it to ambient radiation.

anvil.name: anvil
anvil.description: This is an enormously heavy block of oddly shaped steel with a chisel-like projection set into the corner.  It's used in most metalworking fabrication recipes.

anvil_bronze.name: bronze anvil
anvil_bronze.description: This is a block of oddly shaped bronze with a chisel-like projection set into the corner.  It's used in most metalworking fabrication recipes.

boltcutters.name: pair of bolt cutters
boltcutters.description: This is a large pair of bolt cutters.  You could use them to cut padlocks or heavy gauge wire.

char_kiln.name: charcoal kiln
char_kiln.description: A stout metal box used for producing charcoal via pyrolysis; the incomplete burning of organic materials in the absence of oxygen.

chisel.name: metalworking chisel
chisel.description: This is a short, stout metalworking chisel.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

crucible.name: crucible
crucible.description: This is a small metalworking crucible.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

crucible_clay.name: clay crucible
crucible_clay.description: This is a primitive metalworking crucible made of clay.  You could use it for metalworking.

kiln_done.name: finished charcoal kiln
kiln_done.description: A charcoal kiln that has finished burning.  Disassemble it to retrieve the charcoal and kiln.

kiln_full.name: filled charcoal kiln
kiln_full.description: A kiln filled with wood which will become charcoal after a slow period of burning.

use_action.msg: You light the wood.
use_action.need_fire_msg: You need something to light it with!

kiln_lit.name: lit charcoal kiln
kiln_lit.description: A kiln full of wood that has been lit; better drop it!

use_action.msg: The kilns embers have died out, you can now disassemble it to harvest the charcoal.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The kiln is still burning.

link_sheet.name: chainmail sheet
link_sheet.description: This is a sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.

swage.name: swage and die set
swage.description: These are a set of swages and dies for metalsmithing.  These loops and metal blocks are used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

tongs.name: pair of metal tongs
tongs.description: These are long, metal tongs.  They are commonly used for cooking or in metalworking fabrication recipes.

alarmclock.name: alarm clock
alarmclock.description: A wind-up alarm clock.  Though the noise it makes is unpleasant to wake up to, it's always good to get an early start to your day.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.

cow_bell.name: cow bell
cow_bell.description: A brass cow bell.  You feel like you need more of it.

e_tool.name: entrenching tool
e_tool.description: This is a stout collapsible spade.  It's commonly used by military forces and favored by hikers for digging.  This was a popular weapon during WW1.

etched_skull.name: etched human skull
etched_skull.description: This is a human skull with strange etchings covering it.

fur_rollmat.name: fur rollmat
fur_rollmat.description: This is a bedroll made of pelts which can be rolled up for transport.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unroll the fur mat and lay it on the ground.

grapnel.name: grappling hook
grapnel.description: A folding grappling hook attached to a stout 30-foot long piece of lightweight cord.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.  Can be used in place of a long rope for butchering, in a pinch.

grip_hook.name: grip hook
grip_hook.description: A simple steel meathook with a circular steel handle.

hand_pump.name: hand pump
hand_pump.description: This pump is suitable for pumping air into inflatable objects.

horn_big.name: truck horn
horn_big.description: This is a very loud horn, usually found on large trucks like semis.

horn_ship.name: ship air horn
horn_ship.description: An enormous ship air horn, extremely loud and deafening.  Usually found on large vessels.

horn_car.name: car horn
horn_car.description: This is a car horn meant to be attached to a car's electrical system.

mind_splicer.name: mind splicer kit
mind_splicer.description: Surgical forceps, cables and a modified smartphone inside a small plastic pouch.  Assembled to steal the mind of some poor man, these are tools of the creepy high-tech sandman.

pocketwatch.name: pocket watch
pocketwatch.description: An old-fashioned pocket watch.  This one tells you the time and looks good doing it.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.

rollmat.name: rollmat
rollmat.description: This is a sheet of foam which can be rolled tightly for storage.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unroll the mat and lay it on the ground.

safe_box.name: safe deposit box
safe_box.description: This is a secure combination lock box.  Sadly, you don't know the combination.  Breaking inside it would destroy anything of value.

sarcophagus_access_code.name: sarcophagus access code
sarcophagus_access_code.description: This printout is a string of numbers to access the elevator in the hazardous waste sarcophagus.

labpass.name: lab door override code
labpass.description: This printout contains a one-time use emergency override code for any locked door in a science lab.

survivor_scope.name: survivor telescope
survivor_scope.description: A homemade collapsible telescope.  Too large and inaccurate to use as a weapon scope, but carrying this item in your inventory will double the distance that is mapped around you during your travels.

teleumbrella.name: telescoping umbrella
teleumbrella.description: A telescoping umbrella which collapses down for easy storage, useful for keeping dry when wielded.

testflames.name: Flaming Chunk of Steel +2
testflames.description: HOLY SHIT THIS THING IS ON FIRE

umbrella.name: umbrella
umbrella.description: An umbrella with a pointy end, useful for keeping dry when wielded.

pocketwatch_crude.name: handmade pocket watch
pocketwatch_crude.description: An old-fashioned pocket watch, useful for telling the time and not much else.

chicken_cage.name: chicken cage
chicken_cage.description: A wire container made for transporting chickens, but you can use it to hold any tiny animal.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

dog_whistle.name: dog whistle
dog_whistle.description: This is a small whistle.  When used, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.

shears.name: shears
shears.description: This is a set of shears designed to obtain wool from sheep.

horse_tack.name: horse tack
