horse_tack.description: A saddle, bridle, and associated tack that can be placed on a tamed animal that is capable of being ridden.

pet_carrier.name: pet carrier
pet_carrier.description: A plastic container meant to hold pets for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

pet_carrier_wooden.name: wooden pet carrier
pet_carrier_wooden.description: A wooden container meant to hold pets for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

dog_whistle_wood.name: wooden dog whistle
dog_whistle_wood.description: This is a whistle carved out of hardwood.  When used, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.

radio_car_base.name: radio car base
radio_car_base.description: Generic radio car kit, you shouldn't see this.

radio_car_box.name: radio car box
radio_car_box.description: An RC car, with radio-control and batteries included!  Disassemble to unpack and enjoy.

birchbark_funnel.name: birchbark funnel
birchbark_funnel.description: This is a small birchbark funnel.  Place it above an outdoor container to collect rainwater.

use_action.done_message: You place the birchbark funnel, waiting to collect rain.

funnel.name: funnel
funnel.description: This is a funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the funnel, waiting to collect rain.

leather_funnel.name: leather funnel
leather_funnel.description: This is a small, leather funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the leather funnel, waiting to collect rain.

makeshift_funnel.name: makeshift funnel
makeshift_funnel.description: This is a small, makeshift funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the makeshift funnel, waiting to collect rain.

metal_funnel.name: metal funnel
metal_funnel.description: This is a large metal funnel used to collect rainwater.  Less portable than plastic funnels, but collects more water.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the metal funnel, waiting to collect rain.

tarp_raincatcher.name: tarp raincatcher
tarp_raincatcher.description: Some sticks and string with a tarp to set up an improvised raincatcher.

use_action.done_message: You set up the raincatcher, waiting to collect water.

barometer.name: barometer
barometer.description: A plastic barometer that can read the atmospheric pressure.

chemistry_set_basic.name: basic chemistry set
chemistry_set_basic.description: This is a basic chemistry set which includes glass containers, hoses and safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined, but you'll need a source of heat.

hygrometer.name: hygrometer
hygrometer.description: A plastic hygrometer that can read the relative humidity in the air.

platinum_grille.name: platinum grille
platinum_grille.description: This is a metal grille with a layer of platinum plating, suitable for use as a catalyst for some chemical reactions.

telepad.name: teleport pad
telepad.description: This is a kit for a teleporter trap consisting of a teleporter and a solar cell that is triggered when stepped upon.

use_action.done_message: You place the telepad.

balance_small.name: small weight scale
balance_small.description: This is a simple scale that uses a set of steel weights on sliding bars to measure a sample's mass quite accurately.

vortex.name: vortex device
vortex.description: This is a small, hefty, boring looking machine.  Its weighted trapezoidal frame has a single on-off switch and a speed dial, and on top of it sits a rubber receptacle.  Pressing a test tube into the receptacle would, with power, rapidly shake and mix the contents of the test tube.  It's surprisingly fun to use.

light_detector.name: light detector
light_detector.description: This is a photodiode on a chip, designed to convert incoming light to electrical energy for quantification.

glass_prism.name: glass prism
glass_prism.description: This is a high quality crystal glass prism for separating and redirecting light.

glass_tube_small.name: small glass tube
glass_tube_small.description: This is a small glass tube.  What more could you possibly want to know about it?

microscope.name: microscope
microscope.description: A classic tool for the ages!  This hefty, durable piece of lab equipment makes small things look bigger.  Without electricity the light doesn't work, but the rest of it is surprisingly functional.  Unfortunately it's not useful for very much at the moment.

microscope_dissecting.name: dissecting microscope
microscope_dissecting.description: This microscope has less magnification than a standard one.  It's also stereoscopic and produces a neat 3d image of the surface.  It was typically used for doing dissections and other fine detail work on small creatures.  It still works pretty well with an added light source, but what would you do with it?

funnel_separation.name: separation funnel
funnel_separation.description: This thing doesn't look much like a funnel.  It's a teardrop shaped piece of glass with a stopper at the wide end and a valve at the other.  It can be used to wash one liquid with another, like water and an oil, and then draw off whichever of the two liquids contains a higher amount of whatever compound you're trying to isolate.  With a high level of skill it can also be used to make juvenile farting noises.

rotovap.name: rotary evaporator
rotovap.description: Just looking at this thing makes you feel like a proper mad scientist.  It's a series of glass tubes and round flasks, connected to a central motor and a heating element.  The heating element warms one flask, kept rotating by the motor, evaporating the contents.  The vapour is then condensed in the tubes and collected in another flask, in case you wanted to save it for later.

still_lab.name: fractional distillation apparatus
still_lab.description: One of the classic pieces of mad science glassware, this is basically a small volume still that passes the vapour through a fractional distillation column and then condenses the distillate in a cooled collection column.  A grad student or a robot (is there really any difference?) collects the distillate in fractions so that specific contents can be analyzed.  Going a few milliliters at a time, it would not be very effective to try to distill whiskey in this thing.

gelbox.name: electrophoresis tray
gelbox.description: This is a set of plastic trays, electrodes, and a power supply designed to create an electric voltage gradient through a liquid solution containing a solid gel.  Stuff like proteins and DNA would then get separated on the gel according to electrical charge and size.  Pretty useless now, for anything but salvage.

damaged_shelter_kit.name: damaged shelter kit
damaged_shelter_kit.description: This is a small shelter, made of sticks and skins.  Use it to place.  This shelter has been damaged, and needs repairs.

crackpipe.name: crack pipe
crackpipe.description: This is a fine glass tube with a bulb with a bowl on one end.  It's used to partake of certain illicit substances.

pipe_glass.name: glass pipe
pipe_glass.description: This is a hand-blown glass pipe.  It's of the type most commonly used to smoke recreational substances.

pipe_glass_bong.name: glass bong
pipe_glass_bong.description: This is a hand-blown glass beaker bong.  Easy to clean, hard to tip over, and functional even after society collapses.

pipe_tobacco.name: tobacco pipe
pipe_tobacco.description: This is a hand-carved wooden smoking pipe.  It's designed to facilitate consumption of fire cured tobacco leaves.

stapler.name: stapler
stapler.description: A stapler for fastening sheets of paper together.

scissors.name: pair of scissors
scissors.description: These are a long pair of heavy-duty scissors.  Use scissors to cut items made from cotton (like clothing) into rags.

paper.name: paper
paper.description: A piece of paper.  Can be used for fires.

awl_bone.name: bone sewing awl
awl_bone.description: This is a crude sharpened bone awl; those were used for leatherworking before metal was discovered.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.

awl_steel.name: steel sewing awl
awl_steel.description: This is a steel awl with a wooden grip, usually used for leatherworking.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.

knitting_needles.name: knitting needles
knitting_needles.description: A pair of stout wooden needles with round ends used to turn thread and yarn into cloth.

tailoring_pattern_set.name: tailoring pattern set
tailoring_pattern_set.description: This is a large set of tailoring patterns made from paper.  They're useful for making any kind of cloth or leather items from scratch, but are necessary for more advanced projects.

bathroom_scale.name: bathroom scale
bathroom_scale.description: This is a small bathroom scale, meant to weigh a person while naked.

brush.name: scrub brush
brush.description: This is a simple scrub brush.

mop.name: mop
mop.description: This is an unwieldy mop.  Good for cleaning up spills.  Use to mop up any 'mess' you may have made.

razor_blade.name: razor blade
razor_blade.description: A double-edged razor blade.  Finicky to use on its own, but can be used as a cutting tool in a pinch.

sponge.name: sponge
sponge.description: A sponge is a tool or cleaning aid made of soft, porous material.  Typically used for cleaning impervious surfaces, it can also be used for sanding wood when dried.

survivor_hairtrimmer.name: makeshift haircut kit
survivor_hairtrimmer.description: This is a kit with tools for cutting hair.

washboard.name: washboard
washboard.description: This is a wooden washboard.  You can use it to wash filthy clothing if it's supplied with cleansing agent.

wash_kit.name: washing kit
wash_kit.description: A combination kit of a washboard and a scrubbing tool.  Everything you need to clean items after the apocalypse.

beartrap.name: bear trap
beartrap.description: This is a spring-loaded pair of steel jaws connected to a sensitive pressure plate.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will ensnare and damage anything that steps on it.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.

use_action.done_message: You set the beartrap.

blade_trap.name: blade trap
blade_trap.description: This is a machete attached laterally to a motor, with a tripwire controlling its throttle.  When the tripwire is pulled, the blade is swung around with great force.  The trap forms a 3x3 area of effect.

use_action.done_message: You set the blade trap %d squares away.

board_trap.name: nailboard trap
board_trap.description: These are several pieces of wood nailed together, with some nails sticking straight up.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on it, they'll get nails through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You set the board trap on the %s, nails facing up.

boobytrap.name: booby trap
boobytrap.description: This is a crude explosive device triggered by a piece of string.  Use it to set up and watch some poor bastard trigger it.

use_action.done_message: You set the booby trap up and activate the grenade.

bubblewrap.name: bubble wrap
bubblewrap.description: This is a sheet of plastic covered with air-filled bubbles.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will warn you with noise when something steps on it.

use_action.done_message: You set the bubble wrap on the ground, ready to be popped.

caltrops.name: loose caltrops
caltrops.description: These are small metal objects covered with many sharp points.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a spine through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the caltrops on the %s.

caltrops_glass.name: loose glass caltrops
caltrops_glass.description: These are glass shards glued together to expose their sharp edges.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get cut.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the glass caltrops on the %s.

crossbow_trap.name: crossbow trap
crossbow_trap.description: This is a simple tripwire, which is attached to the trigger of a loaded crossbow.  When pulled, the crossbow fires.  Only a single round can be used, after which the trap is disabled.

use_action.done_message: You set the crossbow trap.

landmine.name: land mine
landmine.description: This is a military anti-personnel mine that is triggered when stepped upon.

use_action.done_message: You set the land mine.

shotgun_trap.name: double-barreled shotgun trap
shotgun_trap.description: This is a simple tripwire is attached to the trigger of a loaded double-barreled shotgun.  When pulled, the shotgun fires, discharging both barrels into the target.

use_action.done_message: You set the shotgun trap.

shotgun_trap_single.name: shotgun trap
shotgun_trap_single.description: This is a simple tripwire is attached to the trigger of a loaded single-barreled shotgun.  When pulled, the shotgun fires.

use_action.done_message: You set the shotgun trap.

tripwire.name: tripwire trap
tripwire.description: This is some thin strong cable with some affixing tools on either end.  A tripwire trap must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  Its purpose is to trip up bypassers, causing them to stumble and possibly hurt themselves slightly.

use_action.done_message: You string up the tripwire.

can_alarm_trap.name: makeshift perimeter alarm
can_alarm_trap.description: This is a set of empty cans used as makeshift noisemakers, strung up across a doorway or other thin passage.  It will make noise when activated to alert you of intruders, but is otherwise harmless.

use_action.done_message: You string up some cans on a tripwire.

glass_shard_trap.name: glass shard trap
glass_shard_trap.description: Same glass shard as before but you can activate it to place it on the ground, it will make noise when stepped on.

use_action.done_message: You carefully place the shards on the ground, ready to be cracked by something passing by.

ax.name: wood axe
ax.description: This is a large, two-handed wood axe.  It makes a good melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.

ax_bronze.name: bronze axe
ax_bronze.description: This is a large, two-handed wood axe with a bronze axehead.  It makes a good melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.

copper_ax.name: copper axe
copper_ax.description: This is a decent-sized chunk of worked copper affixed to a wooden shaft, to make a crude yet effective axe.

hatchet.name: hatchet
hatchet.description: A one-handed hatchet.  Makes a great melee weapon, and is useful both for chopping things and for use as a hammer.

primitive_adze.name: primitive adze
primitive_adze.description: This is a stone or ceramic adze, somewhat useful for smoothing wood objects.

primitive_axe.name: primitive axe
primitive_axe.description: This is a stone with a narrow edge affixed to a stick.  It can chop wood, but requires much more effort than a modern axe.

saw.name: wood saw
saw.description: This is a thin saw, useful for cutting through wood objects.

tomahawk_primitive.name: primitive tomahawk
tomahawk_primitive.description: A lightweight one-handed combat hatchet typically made of stone or bone, originally used by the Algonquian people.  It makes for a half decent tool and weapon.

tomahawk_copper.name: copper tomahawk
tomahawk_copper.description: A lightweight one-handed combat hatchet made using basic copper.  Slightly better than stone, though not as historically accurate.

sandpaper.name: sandpaper
sandpaper.description: A sheet of cloth or paper with an abrasive material glued to one side, historically glass or sand, modernly aluminum oxide or silicon carbide.  It is commonly used to smooth, roughen, or strip a wooden surface.

adobe_pallet_full.name: pallet of wet adobe bricks
adobe_pallet_full.description: A pallet full of heavy mud bricks which need to dry slowly to be usable.

use_action.msg: You test the bricks, and they're solid enough to use.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The bricks are still too damp to bear weight.

adobe_pallet_done.name: pallet of dry adobe bricks
adobe_pallet_done.description: A pallet of humble mud bricks that have dried out while you were out risking your life.  Disassemble it to retrieve your frame and building supplies.

clay_pallet_full.name: pallet of wet ceramic
clay_pallet_full.description: A pallet full of crushed wet ceramic, which needs to dry slowly to be usable.

use_action.msg: You test the ceramic, and it's the right consistency to use.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The ceramic is still too damp to be used.

clay_pallet_done.name: pallet of ceramic clay
clay_pallet_done.description: A pallet of ceramic clay which is now ready to be made into pottery.  Disassemble it to retrieve your sheet, frame and crafting supplies.

acetylene_machine.name: acetylene-gas machine
acetylene_machine.description: This bulky device takes water and calcium carbide and yields unpressurised acetylene.

carding_paddles.name: carding paddles
carding_paddles.description: A pair of toothy wooden paddles used to clean fibers for use in textile production.

clamp.name: clamp
clamp.description: This clamp is useful for keeping things still, especially if you have several of them.

claw_bar.name: claw bar
claw_bar.description: This is a small prying tool with a clawed bend at one end for pulling spikes.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

distaff_spindle.name: distaff and spindle
distaff_spindle.description: A pair of specialized wooden rods used to spin fibers into thread and yarn.

hacksaw.name: hacksaw
hacksaw.description: This is a sturdy saw, useful for cutting through metal objects.

wire_saw.name: wire saw
wire_saw.description: This is a flexible saw made from thin wire, with simple handles on either end.  It should suffice for light metal and wood sawing, or for cutting chain-link fences.

hammer.name: hammer
hammer.description: This is a demagnetized steel claw hammer with a wooden grip.  With a hammer, nails, and two by fours in your inventory, you could board up adjacent doors and windows.  It has myriad other uses as well.

hammer_bronze.name: bronze hammer
hammer_bronze.description: This is a bronze claw hammer with a wooden grip, commonly used where sparks from a steel hammer might be a safety hazard.  You could board up adjacent doors and windows, among myriad other uses.

hand_drill.name: hand drill
hand_drill.description: A primitive manual drill with a single drill bit.  It is slow and it will exhaust you quickly.

hose.name: rubber hose
hose.description: This is a flexible rubber hose.  It could be used for crafting, or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.

jack.name: bottle jack
jack.description: A portable hydraulic bottle jack used for lifting vehicles.

jack_makeshift.name: makeshift jack
jack_makeshift.description: A poorly constructed improvised scissor jack used for lifting vehicles if you're brave enough to use it.

jack_small.name: scissor jack
jack_small.description: A compact scissor jack used for lifting vehicles.

makeshift_hammer.name: makeshift hammer
makeshift_hammer.description: This is a crude hammer made from a piece of metal affixed to a stick.  It functions adequately as a hammer, but really can't compare to a proper one.

metal_file.name: metal fileset
metal_file.description: These tools are commonly used to remove small amounts of materials from the surface of metal objects.

metal_smoother.name: metallic smoother
metal_smoother.description: This metallic tool is most often used to smooth concrete, or mortar, in construction projects.

mold_plastic.name: plastic mold
mold_plastic.description: This is a plastic mold.  It could be shaped and used to craft items made of plastic.

multitool.name: multi-tool
multitool.description: A cleverly designed all-in-one tool which combines several smaller tools into the handles of a pair of pliers.

paint_brush.name: paint brush
paint_brush.description: A wide brush, suitable for painting walls.

pickaxe.name: pickaxe
pickaxe.description: This is a large steel pickaxe, suitable for breaking up hard things or (with enough skill) hard targets.  Strike the earth!

propick_debug.name: debugging prospecting pick
propick_debug.description: This is a medium pickaxe-slash-hammer that could reveal close by ore pockets. This one has an obscene range, for debugging. God save your CPU.

propick_alpha.name: crude prospecting pick
propick_alpha.description: This is a crude hammer-pick used for finding nearby mineral veins. Terrible for anything you're not basically standing on.

propick_beta.name: copper prospecting pick
propick_beta.description: This is a copper hammer-pick used for finding nearby mineral veins. Not accurate enough for long range, but works.

propick_charlie.name: steel prospecting pick
propick_charlie.description: This is a steel hammer-pick used for finding nearby mineral veins. Can help you sniff out even faint traces of minerals.

pin_reamer.name: pin reamer
pin_reamer.description: Handheld pin reamers of this kind are used to enlarge existing holes, or remove any burs and such from them.

pliers.name: pliers
pliers.description: This is a basic pair of slip-joint pliers, able to handle basic mechanical work and pulling apart some ammunition cartridges.  Anything too complex will require a wrench.

primitive_hammer.name: stone hammer
primitive_hammer.description: This is a rock affixed to a stick, in the crude facsimile of a hammer.  It functions adequately as a hammer, but really can't compare to a proper one.

screwdriver.name: screwdriver
screwdriver.description: This is a Philips-head screwdriver.  It is important for almost all electronics crafting, most mechanics crafting, and has many more uses.

screwdriver_set.name: screwdriver set
screwdriver_set.description: This is a set of screwdrivers in several sizes and blade types.  Guaranteed to have the right tools for more precise work.

toolbox.name: toolbox
toolbox.description: This is a stout metal box containing a complete tool kit suitable for most household maintenance and construction activities.

toolbox_workshop.name: workshop toolbox
toolbox_workshop.description: This is a stout metal box containing a complete tool kit suitable for most household maintenance and construction activities, as well as additional tools used in workshops for advanced fabrication jobs.

wood_smoother.name: wooden smoother
wood_smoother.description: This large makeshift tool is used in smoothing concrete or mortar in construction projects.  You could also use it as an improvised head-basher.

wool_staple.name: wool staple
wool_staple.description: The natural cluster of wool fibers.  Could be processed to the felt patches or yarns.

xacto.name: X-Acto knife
xacto.description: This is a small, sharp knife, designed for making precise cuts for textiles or crafts.  It could cause decent damage, but is difficult to hit things with it.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.  It is too small to butcher corpses with.

wrench.name: wrench
wrench.description: This is an adjustable crescent wrench.  It could be a decent melee weapon, and is used in many mechanics crafting recipes.

makeshift_hose.name: leather hose
makeshift_hose.description: This is a hose made out of leather.  Watertight and flexiable, it can be used to siphon fuel from a vehicle tank.  However, it's not as elastic a rubber hose.

makeshift_hand_drill.name: makeshift hand drill
makeshift_hand_drill.description: This is a makeshift manual drill made out of pipe and improvised drill bit.  It is very slow and it will exhaust you quickly.

alternator_car.name: car alternator
alternator_car.description: A standard alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.

alternator_motorbike.name: motorbike alternator
alternator_motorbike.description: A compact lightweight alternator used to power small vehicle electrical systems.

alternator_bicycle.name: bicycle alternator
alternator_bicycle.description: A very lightweight alternator used to power a bicycle's headlights.

alternator_truck.name: truck alternator
alternator_truck.description: A larger and more powerful alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.

generator_7500w.name: 7.5kW generator
generator_7500w.description: A bulky but efficient electrical generator designed to be attached to an engine.

rebar_plate.name: rebar grate
rebar_plate.description: Interlocked sections of rebar that allows for light and effective reinforcement of vehicle sections.

spring_plate.name: shock absorber
spring_plate.description: This makeshift combination of springs and scrap, when attached to a vehicle section, protects that section from impacts.  The springs can absorb a surprising amount of damage.

NBC_seal.name: NBC seal
NBC_seal.description: A series of lead-based gaskets, seals and other things meant to keep all Nuclear, Biological, and Chemical contaminants out of a vehicle.  Installing this on a tile will protect people seated there from toxic gas and radiation.

airship_balloon_item.name: airship balloon
airship_balloon_item.description: A big plastic airbag filled with hydrogen gas.  Provides lift if installed on a vehicle, but you'll need a propeller to do anything more than float up and down.

it_battery_mount.name: storage battery case
it_battery_mount.description: An empty case that can hold a storage battery, complete with charging controller chip, connecting wires, and mechanisms to help lift the battery to be mounted into position.

boat_board.name: wood boat hull
boat_board.description: A wooden board that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats.  Then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

raft_board.name: raft boat hull
raft_board.description: Logs tied together to make a vehicle float.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats.  Then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

gas_sac_buoyancy_cell.name: gas sac buoyancy cell
gas_sac_buoyancy_cell.description: Several bags tied together, filled with hydrogen to provide buoyancy.  Add buoyancy cells to a vehicle until it floats, or install enough to provide lift for an airship.

plastic_boat_hull.name: plastic boat hull
plastic_boat_hull.description: A rigid plastic sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats.  Then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

carbonfiber_boat_hull.name: carbon fiber boat hull
carbonfiber_boat_hull.description: A carbon fiber sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats.  Then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

sail.name: sail
sail.description: A small sail and makeshift rigging for a raft.

sail_large_item.name: large sail
sail_large_item.description: A wooden mast with sails fit for a yacht or sloop, and about as much rigging as a single sailor can handle.

basket.name: large wire basket
basket.description: A large wire basket from a shopping cart.

bike_rack.name: bike rack
bike_rack.description: A collection of pipes, cams, and straps, mounted on the edge of a vehicle and used to support another vehicle for transport.  It must be mounted on a vehicle to be used.

folding_basket.name: large folding wire basket
folding_basket.description: A large wire basket from a shopping cart, modified to be foldable.

bike_basket.name: small folding wire basket
bike_basket.description: A simple wire basket.  It is small and foldable.

cargo_rack.name: cargo carrier
cargo_rack.description: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo.

cargo_rack_carbon.name: carbon cargo carrier
cargo_rack_carbon.description: A sturdy, yet lightweight carbon structure outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo.

cargo_aisle.name: floor trunk
cargo_aisle.description: A section of flooring with a cargo-space beneath, and a hinged door for access.

cargo_aisle_carbon.name: carbon floor trunk
cargo_aisle_carbon.description: A section of carbon flooring with a cargo-space beneath, and a hinged door for access.

livestock_carrier.name: livestock carrier
livestock_carrier.description: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo, with additional railings to keep a large animal in place.  It is meant to hold large animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

mounted_spare_tire.name: mounted spare tire
mounted_spare_tire.description: A spare tire mounted on a carrier rig, ready to be attached to the rear bumper of a vehicle.

animal_locker.name: animal locker
animal_locker.description: A locker used to contain animals safely during transportation if installed properly.  There is room for animal food and other animal care goods.  It is meant to hold medium or smaller animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

camera_control.name: camera display
camera_control.description: A set of small monitors.  Required to view cameras' output.

omnicamera.name: security camera
omnicamera.description: A security camera you could connect to a display.  Image quality is quite low, but the field of vision is great.

vehicle_controls.name: vehicle controls
vehicle_controls.description: A set of various vehicle controls.  Useful for crafting.

veh_tracker.name: vehicle tracking device
veh_tracker.description: A vehicle tracking device.  When installed on a vehicle it allows you track the vehicle.

reins_tackle.name: rein and tackle
reins_tackle.description: A set of leather bindings to control a mountable creature.

vehicle_dashboard.name: dashboard
vehicle_dashboard.description: A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.  Useful for crafting.

electronics_controls.name: electronics control unit
electronics_controls.description: A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.  Useful for crafting.

drive_by_wire_controls.name: drive by wire controls
drive_by_wire_controls.description: Fully electronic vehicle control system.  You could control it remotely if you had proper tools.
drive_by_wire_controls.name_plural: sets of drive by wire controls

robot_controls.name: robot driving unit
robot_controls.description: A set of servos, microcontrollers and other devices, together capable of driving an unmanned vehicle.  Its AI is not functional, but it should still have some sort of maintenance mode.

turret_controls.name: turret control unit
turret_controls.description: A set of motor, camera, and various electronic modules banded together to allow for tracking targets, friend-or-foe identification, and firing the connected turret in full automatic mode.

laser_designator_item.name: vehicle laser designator
laser_designator_item.description: A laser rangefinder with associated targeting software, designed to be installed on a vehicle-mounted turret.  Installing it on a vehicle-mounted weapon will greatly increases accuracy, but only when firing it remotely such as from the vehicle control menu.

bomber_controls.name: bomb bay
bomber_controls.description: A set of motors and various mechanical linkages banded together to allow for activation and dropping of select items from cargo spaces.

engine_block_massive.name: massive engine block
engine_block_massive.description: The beginnings of a massive gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

engine_block_large.name: large engine block
engine_block_large.description: The beginnings of a large gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

engine_block_medium.name: medium engine block
engine_block_medium.description: The beginnings of a medium gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

use_action.training_msg: You examine the engine block, learning a bit about how its components fit together and operate.

engine_block_small.name: small engine block
engine_block_small.description: The beginnings of a small gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

use_action.training_msg: You examine the engine block, learning a bit about how its components fit together and operate.

engine_block_tiny.name: tiny engine block
engine_block_tiny.description: The beginnings of a tiny gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

use_action.training_msg: You examine the engine block, learning a bit about how its components fit together and operate.

cantilever_medium.name: steel boom crane
cantilever_medium.description: A large rigid steel boom.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 20 metric tonnes (or a bit over 44,000 pounds).

cantilever_small.name: telescopic cantilever crane
cantilever_small.description: A small steel telescoping cantilever.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 3.5 metric tonnes (or a bit over 7,700 pounds).

pallet_lifter.name: pallet lifter
pallet_lifter.description: A makeshift pallet lifter.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 0.5 metric tonnes (or a bit over 1,100 pounds).

v_rockwheel_item.name: rockwheel
v_rockwheel_item.description: A large and heavy jagged metal disc to dig trenches.

v_roadheader_item.name: roadheader
v_roadheader_item.description: A massive metal wheel-like drill used to bore tunnels.

v_airjack_item.name: airjack
v_airjack_item.description: An extendable metal pylon used to replace a portable jack.  If mounted to a vehicle, it could be used to lift it up, supporting vehicles up to 8.5 metric tonnes (or a bit over 18,700 pounds).

v_motorcycle_kickstand_item.name: motorcycle kickstand
v_motorcycle_kickstand_item.description: A kickstand to keep the bike from falling over.  You could use this to lean it forward or backward to change a tire, supporting vehicles up to 0.5 metric tonnes (or a bit over 1,100 pounds).

pulley_crane_small_wood.name: rope and pulley crane
pulley_crane_small_wood.description: A makeshift crane made from rope and pulleys.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 2 metric tonnes (or a bit over 4,400 pounds).

v_scoop_item.name: vehicle scoop
v_scoop_item.description: An assembly of motors and sheet metal that allows a vehicle to clean the road surface by removing debris and contaminants.

v_planter_item.name: seed drill
v_planter_item.description: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels, that when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.

v_reaper_item.name: reaper
v_reaper_item.description: An assembly of a blade, wheels, and a small lever for engaging/disengaging used to cut down crops prior to picking them up.

v_reaper_item_advanced.name: advanced reaper
v_reaper_item_advanced.description: An advanced electronic device used to cut down, collect and store crops.

v_planter_item_advanced.name: advanced seed drill
v_planter_item_advanced.description: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels, that when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.  This one is equipped with an electronic control system and will avoid damaging itself when used on untilled land.

v_plow_item.name: plow
v_plow_item.description: A heavy assembly of wheels and steel blades that turn up the ground.

foldframe.name: foldable-light frame
foldframe.description: A small foldable lightweight frame made from pipework.

xlframe.name: extra-light frame
xlframe.description: A small lightweight frame made from pipework.  Useful for crafting.

frame.name: steel frame
frame.description: A large frame made of steel.  Useful for crafting.

hdframe.name: heavy duty frame
hdframe.description: A large, reinforced steel frame, used in military vehicle construction.

frame_wood.name: wooden frame
frame_wood.description: A large frame made of wood.  Useful for crafting.

foldwoodframe.name: foldable wooden frame
foldwoodframe.description: A small foldable frame made from scrap wood.

frame_wood_light.name: light wooden frame
frame_wood_light.description: A small frame made of few pieces of wood, held together by rope.  Useful for crafting.

frame_plastic.name: plastic frame
frame_plastic.description: A large  foldable frame made of plastic.  Useful for cheap and lightweight vehicles.

frame_carbon.name: carbon fiber frame
frame_carbon.description: A large foldable frame made from sheets of carbon fiber.  Useful for lightweight yet sturdy vehicles.

frame_wood_deck.name: skateboard deck
frame_wood_deck.description: A small skateboard frame made of thin layers of wood glued together.

jet_thruster.name: jet thruster
jet_thruster.description: This is a jet propulsion module used in military fighter jets.  It provides extremely high thrust.

vtol_thruster.name: VTOL thruster
vtol_thruster.description: This is a vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) propulsion system used in military VTOL aircraft.  It provides both lift for taking off and thrust when in the air.

car_headlight.name: car headlight
car_headlight.description: A vehicle headlight to light up the way.

motorcycle_headlight.name: motorcycle headlight
motorcycle_headlight.description: A motorcycle headlight to light up the way.

car_wide_headlight.name: wide-angle car headlight
car_wide_headlight.description: A wide-angle vehicle headlight to light up the way.

headlight_reinforced.name: reinforced headlight
headlight_reinforced.description: A vehicle headlight with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.

wide_headlight_reinforced.name: reinforced wide-angle headlight
wide_headlight_reinforced.description: A wide-angle vehicle headlight with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.

light_emergency_red.name: emergency vehicle light (red)
light_emergency_red.description: One of the red-colored lights from the top of an emergency services vehicle.  When turned on, the lights rotate to shine in all directions.

light_emergency_blue.name: emergency vehicle light (blue)
light_emergency_blue.description: One of the blue-colored lights from the top of an emergency services vehicle.  When turned on, the lights rotate to shine in all directions.

light_emergency_white.name: emergency vehicle light (white)
light_emergency_white.description: One of the white-colored lights from the top of an emergency services vehicle.  When turned on, the lights rotate to shine in all directions.

floodlight.name: floodlight
floodlight.description: A large and heavy light designed to illuminate wide areas.

directed_floodlight.name: directed floodlight
directed_floodlight.description: A large and heavy light designed to illuminate a wide area in a half-circular cone.

hand_rims.name: set of hand rims
hand_rims.description: Hand rims for use on a wheelchair.

foot_crank.name: foot crank
foot_crank.description: The pedal and gear assembly from a bicycle.

wind_turbine.name: wind turbine
wind_turbine.description: A small turbine that can convert wind into electric power depending on wind speed.

xl_wind_turbine.name: large wind turbine
xl_wind_turbine.description: A large turbine that can convert wind into electric power depending on wind speed.

water_wheel.name: water wheel
water_wheel.description: A water wheel.  Will slowly recharge the vehicle's electrical power when built over shallow moving water.

xl_water_wheel.name: large water wheel
xl_water_wheel.description: A large water wheel with wooden supports.  Will recharge the vehicle's electrical power when built over shallow moving water.

motor.name: electric motor
motor.description: A powerful electric motor.  Useful for crafting.

motor_enhanced.name: enhanced electric motor
motor_enhanced.description: A very powerful and yet lightweight electric motor.  Useful for crafting, and its advanced design means it won't suffer power loss if multiple are installed on a vehicle.

motor_super.name: super electric motor
motor_super.description: The most powerful electric motor on the market.  Useful for crafting, and its advanced design means it won't suffer power loss if multiple are installed on a vehicle.

motor_large.name: large electric motor
motor_large.description: A large and very powerful electric motor.  Useful for crafting.

motor_small.name: small electric motor
motor_small.description: A small electric motor.  Useful for crafting.

motor_tiny.name: tiny electric motor
motor_tiny.description: A tiny electric motor.  Useful for crafting.

muffler.name: muffler
muffler.description: A muffler from a car.  Very unwieldy as a weapon.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.

beeper.name: back-up beeper
beeper.description: This is a safety device intended to warn passersby of a vehicle moving in reverse, but the usage of it now seems terribly unwise.

stereo.name: stereo system
stereo.description: A stereo system with speakers.  It is capable of being hooked up to a vehicle.

chimes.name: chime loudspeakers
chimes.description: A stereo system with loudspeakers and a built-in set of simple melodies that it will play.  Commonly used by ice cream trucks to draw the attention of children in the days when children wanted ice cream more than brains.

sheet_metal_lit.name: wired sheet metal
sheet_metal_lit.description: Sheet metal that has had light housing wired into it.

sheet_carbon.name: carbon sheet
sheet_carbon.description: A thin sheet of carbon fiber.

aluminium_sheet.name: aluminum sheet
aluminium_sheet.description: A thin sheet of aluminum, usable for lightweight car body panels or to keep a boat afloat.

wood_plate.name: wooden armor kit
wood_plate.description: A bundle of two by fours prepared to be used as vehicle armor.

steel_plate.name: steel plating
steel_plate.description: A piece of armor plating made of steel.

carbon_plate.name: carbon plating
carbon_plate.description: A piece of armor plating made of carbon fiber.

alloy_plate.name: superalloy plating
alloy_plate.description: A piece of armor plating made of sturdy superalloy.

alloy_sheet.name: superalloy sheet
alloy_sheet.description: A sheet of sturdy superalloy, incredibly hard, yet incredibly malleable.

spiked_plate.name: spiked plating
spiked_plate.description: A piece of armor plating made of steel.  It is covered with menacing spikes.

hard_plate.name: hard plating
hard_plate.description: A piece of very thick armor plating made of steel.

mil_plate.name: military composite plating
mil_plate.description: A thick sheet of military grade armor, best bullet stopper you can stick on a vehicle.

chitin_plate.name: chitin armor kit
chitin_plate.description: Light chitin plating made for a vehicle.

acidchitin_plate.name: biosilicified chitin armor kit
acidchitin_plate.description: Durable silica-coated chitin plating made for a vehicle.

bone_plate.name: bone armor kit
bone_plate.description: Bone plating made for a vehicle.

vp_portal_tap_item.name: dimensional portal tap
vp_portal_tap_item.description: An advanced interface module designed to siphon power from a linked dimensional portal directly into a vehicle's battery system.  It requires installation into a vehicle and linking to a specific portal before it will function.

metal_propeller_item.name: aircraft propeller
metal_propeller_item.description: A steel propeller and spinner from an airplane.  When attached to a vehicle, engine power will provide lift to any installed wings, allowing it to take off.

wood_propeller_item.name: wooden aircraft propeller
wood_propeller_item.description: A wooden propeller and spinner from an airplane.  When attached to a vehicle, engine power will provide lift to any installed wings, allowing it to take off.

tearer.name: shredder
tearer.description: This menacing looking attachment is meant to be powered by a vehicle's engine.  Upon doing so, the circular blades of this device will rotate rapidly; anything in front of it is likely to be ripped to shreds.  It is sturdy enough to withstand multiple impacts, and is designed to detach if it would take a hit that would break it.

chemlab.name: onboard chemistry lab
chemlab.description: Assembled from a chemistry set attached to a complex wiring harness, it is well suited to most any chemistry project you could imagine.  Unable to utilize standard batteries, it requires an external supply of electricity to operate.

craftrig.name: FOODCO kitchen buddy
craftrig.description: Assembled from a set of instructions you found in an old book of DIY projects, the *FOODCO kitchen buddy* claims to be *the perfect solution to all your home-cooking needs!*.  While it is surprisingly handy for vacuum-sealing as well as dehydrating food, the cheery sales pitch neglected to mention A - how awkward the damn thing is, B - That you still need a normal kitchen and C - how it doesn't take batteries.  You're going to have to weld it to a vehicle, or something else with a supply of electricity, if you want to use it.  In addition to the food preservation features, it also has a food processor, a water-purification system, a drawer for holding extra tools, and for some insane reason, a press and die set for hand-loading ammunition.

forgerig.name: vehicle forge rig
forgerig.description: A forge rig made to run off a vehicle's storage battery with integrated tool storage for metalworking equipment.

kilnrig.name: vehicle kiln
kilnrig.description: An electric kiln made to run off a vehicle's storage battery.

kitchen_unit.name: RV kitchen unit
kitchen_unit.description: A vehicle mountable electric range and sink unit with integrated tool storage for cooking utensils.

weldrig.name: vehicle welding rig
weldrig.description: A welding rig made to run off a vehicle's storage battery.  It has a soldering iron attachment for delicate work, and a compartment to store your extra tools in.

3d_printer_basicrig.name: vehicle 3D printer
3d_printer_basicrig.description: A 3D printer made to run off a vehicle's storage battery. Although it's not nearly as fancy as the experimental nanofabricators, this civilian-grade 3D printer can produce almost any item out of plastic, polymer, or carbon fiber…  so long as you can program it.  It's also useful for repairing items made out of plastic or carbon fiber.

3d_printer_advancedrig.name: vehicle advanced 3D printer
3d_printer_advancedrig.description: An advanced 3D printer made to run off a vehicle's storage battery. Recent advances in 3D printing technology have resulted in the ability to quickly and cheaply 3D print metals and alloys.  Such 3D printers are highly expensive, but sought out by collectors and preppers alike.  In addition to crafting, it can be used to repair polymer and metal items alike, or permeate fabric items with carbon fiber for added protection.

heavy_duty_military_rotor.name: heavy-duty military rotors
heavy_duty_military_rotor.description: A set of four rotor blades from a military attack helicopter.

small_helicopter_rotor.name: small civilian helicopter rotors
small_helicopter_rotor.description: A set of four rotor blades from a civilian light helicopter.
small_helicopter_rotor.name_plural: sets of small civilian helicopter rotors

homebuilt_gyrocopter_rotor.name: homebuilt gyrocopter rotors
homebuilt_gyrocopter_rotor.description: A two-bladed wooden rotor and propeller, for lightweight vehicles put together by hobbyists.

seat.name: seat
seat.description: A soft car seat made from synthetic fabric.

seat_leather.name: leather seat
seat_leather.description: A soft car seat covered with leather.

saddle.name: saddle
saddle.description: A leather-covered seat designed to be straddled.

solar_panel.name: solar panel
solar_panel.description: Electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  Useful for a vehicle.

reinforced_solar_panel.name: reinforced solar panel
reinforced_solar_panel.description: A solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal panel.  Useful for a vehicle.

solar_panel_v2.name: upgraded solar panel
solar_panel_v2.description: Electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  This panel has been upgraded to convert more sunlight into power.  Useful for a vehicle.

reinforced_solar_panel_v2.name: upgraded reinforced solar panel
reinforced_solar_panel_v2.description: An upgraded solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal upgraded panel.  Useful for a vehicle.

solar_panel_v3.name: quantum solar panel
solar_panel_v3.description: This solar panel is obviously cutting-edge technology and given where you found it, should probably provide a LOT of power.  It's covered in strange-looking material, but the covering looks rather fragile; it doesn't look like it could support a reinforcing sheet, either.

foldable_solar_panel.name: foldable solar panel
foldable_solar_panel.description: Electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  Useful for a vehicle.

solar_cell.name: solar cell
solar_cell.description: A small electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  Useful for crafting.

v_table.name: fancy table
v_table.description: A very fancy table from a very fancy RV.  If times were better it might be useful for something more than firewood.

workbench.name: workbench
workbench.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things.

survivors_workbench.name: survivors workbench
survivors_workbench.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things.  This one contains a few extra tools and supplies, making it more useful than a standard workbench.

robobench.name: robobench
robobench.description: Having upgraded the basic workbench, you've now created a robotic workbench that helps speed up crafting.

adv_butchery.name: advanced butchering station
adv_butchery.description: Combining a fixed-up dissector, workbench and advanced electronics, this is a marvel capable of butchering, dissecting and cutting like nothing else!

turret_mount.name: turret mount
turret_mount.description: A universal mount for weapons intended to be installed as turrets.

turret_autoloader.name: turret autoloader
turret_autoloader.description: An automated ammunition feeding system designed for vehicle-mounted turrets. Requires electric power to operate.

compact_reactor_assembly.name: compact reactor assembly
compact_reactor_assembly.description: A heavily shielded, vehicle-sized reactor package salvaged from a much larger nuclear core.  With enough supporting electronics and fuel, it could become the heart of a minireactor or plutonium generator.

recharge_station.name: recharging station
recharge_station.description: A universal recharging station designed to operate on vehicle power.  While on it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space, at a greater rate than most consumer chargers.  The system can only be installed onto existing storage compartments, and is controlled from a dashboard or electronics control unit.

battery_charger.name: battery charger
battery_charger.description: A small device for recharging batteries, given a source of electricty.  It could easily be wired into a vehicle with power.  It will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.  It can only be installed onto existing storage compartments.

programmable_autopilot.name: programmable autopilot
programmable_autopilot.description: A computer system hooked up to the steering and engine of a vehicle to allow it to follow simple paths.

minifridge.name: minifridge
minifridge.description: A very small fridge for keeping food cool.  Provides some insulation from outside weather.

minifreezer.name: minifreezer
minifreezer.description: Compact version of a chest freezer, designed as a mobile solution for freezing food.  Provides insulation from the elements.

cloning_vat.name: cloning vat
cloning_vat.description: A vessel designed to grow and sustain living beings.  If constructed and provided with sufficient power, it can take a sterile artificial womb and a DNA sample and create a viable clone.

vh_autoclave.name: mountable autoclave
vh_autoclave.description: This autoclave has been rigged to run off a vehicle power grid.

vh_autodoc.name: mountable autodoc
vh_autodoc.description: This autodoc has been rigged to run off a vehicle power grid.

vh_autodoc_couch.name: mountable autodoc couch
vh_autodoc_couch.description: This autodoc couch has been rigged to run off a vehicle power grid.

water_faucet.name: water faucet
water_faucet.description: A metal faucet that can be attached to a water tank for easy access.

vehicle_shower.name: vehicle shower
vehicle_shower.description: A compact shower head and drain that can be attached to a water tank.

wheel_mount_light.name: light wheel mount
wheel_mount_light.description: A piece of metal with holes suitable for a bike or motorbike wheel.

wheel_mount_medium.name: medium wheel hub assembly
wheel_mount_medium.description: A metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel on a car.  Fit for a car wheel.

wheel_mount_heavy.name: heavy wheel hub assembly
wheel_mount_heavy.description: A heavy metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel on a car.  Fit for a large car wheel.

wheel_mount_skateboard.name: pair of skateboard trucks
wheel_mount_skateboard.description: A pair metal skateboard trucks, for attaching wheels to.

wheel_mount_light_wood.name: light wooden wheel mount
wheel_mount_light_wood.description: A piece of wood with holes suitable for a bike or motorbike wheel.

wing_metal_item.name: metal aerofoil
wing_metal_item.description: A section of aircraft wing made of sheet metal skin over steel ribs and stringers.  Wings allow a vehicle to fly, but require a propeller and enough velocity to take off.

lit_wing_metal_item.name: wired metal aerofoil
lit_wing_metal_item.description: A section of aircraft wing made of sheet metal skin over steel ribs and stringers, and a navigation light wired into it.  Wings allow a vehicle to fly, but require a propeller and enough velocity to take off.

wing_carbon_item.name: carbon aerofoil
wing_carbon_item.description: A section of aircraft wing made of carbon fiber skin over solid carbon fiber ribs and stringers.  Wings allow a vehicle to fly, but require a propeller and enough velocity to take off.

lit_wing_carbon_item.name: wired carbon aerofoil
lit_wing_carbon_item.description: A section of aircraft wing made of sheet carbon skin over steel ribs and stringers, and a navigation light wired into it.  Wings allow a vehicle to fly, but require a propeller and enough velocity to take off.

wing_wood_item.name: wooden aerofoil
wing_wood_item.description: A section of aircraft wing made of fabric over wooden frame.  Wings allow a vehicle to fly, but require a propeller and enough velocity to take off.

lit_wing_wood_item.name: wired wooden aerofoil
lit_wing_wood_item.description: A section of aircraft wing made of fabric over wooden frame, and a navigation light wired into it.  Wings allow a vehicle to fly, but require a propeller and enough velocity to take off.

loom_frame.name: frame loom
loom_frame.description: This is a rather bulky and primitive wooden frame which can be used to weave cloth sheets.  It is very slow, though.

landough_calrisean.name: Dana's family sourdough starter
landough_calrisean.description: This crusty old jar has a glow-in-the-dark Millennium Falcon decal on the side, and a label that reads, "Landough Calrisean.  Dana's.  Do not touch on pain of death".  It's been abandoned for some time and doesn't look like it could be readily salvaged as a sourdough culture, but maybe an experienced sourdough baker could manage it.

leaf_spring.name: leaf spring
leaf_spring.description: A large, heavy-duty leaf spring.  Probably from some car or truck, and looks an awful lot like a bow.  You can barely bend it…

hydrangea_flower.name: hydrangea
hydrangea_flower.description: A hydrangea stalk with some petals.

hydrangea_bud.name: hydrangea bud
hydrangea_bud.description: A hydrangea bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a hydrangea flower.

tulip_flower.name: tulip
tulip_flower.description: A tulip stalk with some petals.

tulip_bud.name: tulip bud
tulip_bud.description: A tulip bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a tulip flower.

spurge_flower.name: spurge
spurge_flower.description: A spurge stalk with some petals.

spurge_bud.name: spurge bud
spurge_bud.description: A spurge bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a spurge flower.

black_eyed_susan_flower.name: black eyed susan
black_eyed_susan_flower.description: A black eyed susan stalk with some petals.

black_eyed_susan_bud.name: black eyed susan bud
black_eyed_susan_bud.description: A black eyed susan bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a black eyed susan flower.

lily_flower.name: lily
lily_flower.description: A lily stalk with some petals.

lily_bud.name: lily bud
lily_bud.description: A lily bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a lily flower.

lotus_flower.name: lotus
lotus_flower.description: A lotus stalk with some petals.

lotus_bud.name: lotus bud
lotus_bud.description: A lotus bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a lotus flower.

lilac_flower.name: lilac
lilac_flower.description: A lilac stalk with some petals.

lilac_bud.name: lilac bud
lilac_bud.description: A lilac bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a lilac flower.

rose_bud.name: rose bud
rose_bud.description: A rose bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a rose flower.

dahlia_bud.name: dahlia bud
dahlia_bud.description: A dahlia bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a dahlia.

rose_flower.name: rose
rose_flower.description: A rose stalk with some petals.

bluebell_flower.name: bluebell
bluebell_flower.description: A bluebell stalk with some petals.

dahlia_flower.name: dahlia
dahlia_flower.description: A dahlia stalk with some petals.

poppy_flower.name: poppy flower
poppy_flower.description: A poppy stalk with some petals.

bluebell_bud.name: bluebell bud
bluebell_bud.description: A bluebell bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a bluebell flower.

rock_pot.name: stone pot
rock_pot.description: A large stone, roughly hollowed out into a pot.

glass_plate.name: glass plate
glass_plate.description: A glass dinner plate, for people who don't have clumsy children.

plastic_plate.name: plastic plate
plastic_plate.description: A durable plastic plate, the sort you might use as patio dishware.

fork.name: fork
fork.description: A fork, if you stab something with it, you eat it right away.  Wait… nevermind.

spoon.name: spoon
spoon.description: Do not try to bend the spoon.  That is impossible.

knife_butter.name: butter knife
knife_butter.description: A dull knife, absolutely worthless in combat.  Excellent for spreading soft things on bread.

corkscrew.name: corkscrew
corkscrew.description: Many a pleasant date has been ruined by forgetting this important tool.

bottle_opener.name: bottle opener
bottle_opener.description: A simple lever for popping open bottles.

peeler.name: vegetable peeler
peeler.description: This is a simple tool for peeling the outer skin off fruit and veggies without stabbing yourself.

spork.name: spork
spork.description: The bastardized hybrid of a spoon and fork, with all the power and capabilities of both in a more annoying to use package.

foon.name: foon
foon.description: Clearly the superior instrument.  Sporks are just imitators.

chopsticks.name: chopsticks
chopsticks.description: One of the most popular eating utensils in the world.  Does double duty as a way of dealing with especially fragile vampires.

ladle.name: ladle
ladle.description: When you need to scoop some soup, this is the utensil for you.

whisk.name: whisk
whisk.description: Also known as a 'wire whip', this is a less effective weapon than it sounds.

potato_masher.name: potato masher
potato_masher.description: This tool can mash potatoes and soft root vegetables; it cannot do the twist.

garlic_press.name: garlic press
garlic_press.description: This tool can squash a clove or two of garlic into a fine paste.

can_opener.name: can opener
can_opener.description: It's not hard to open cans without this, but it's way messier.

carving_fork.name: carving fork
carving_fork.description: It's like a tiny pitchfork, or a very large dinner fork.  You use it to hold meat still while you slice it.

spatula.name: spatula
spatula.description: A rubber scraper for making sure you get every last scrap of cookie dough.

colander_steel.name: mesh colander
colander_steel.description: A stainless steel mesh colander, for washing rice, vegetables or straining liquid off from noodles or other foods.

splatter_guard.name: splatter guard
splatter_guard.description: A stainless steel mesh screen for preventing flying oil from getting all over your nice counters (or you) when frying.

cutting_board.name: cutting board
cutting_board.description: A large flat piece of wood for chopping vegetables on without ruining your knife or your countertop.

mess_tray.name: meal tray
mess_tray.description: A stainless steel tray used for serving food in cafeterias, mess halls, or similar places.

plastic_fork.name: plastic fork
plastic_fork.description: A plastic disposable fork.  Great for picnic lunches in the post apocalyptic wasteland.

plastic_spoon.name: plastic spoon
plastic_spoon.description: A plastic disposable spoon.  Easier to bend than the metal variety.

plastic_spoon_kids.name: kiddie spoon
plastic_spoon_kids.description: A plastic spoon designed for use by children.

plastic_knife.name: plastic knife
plastic_knife.description: A plastic butter knife.  It's actually a bit sharper than its metal counterpart, but that doesn't make it any more effective as a weapon.

plastic_straw.name: plastic straw
plastic_straw.description: A plastic straw, for drinking things and making litter

rolling_pin.name: rolling pin
rolling_pin.description: A stout piece of hardwood, turned and sanded smooth, with rounded handles at the ends.  This timeless kitchen tool also doubles as a very effective club.

shuttlecock.name: badminton shuttlecock
shuttlecock.description: A high-drag projectile used in the sport of badminton.

golf_tee.name: golf tee
golf_tee.description: A pin shaped piece of wood meant for holding a golf ball slightly off the ground.

golf_ball.name: golf ball
golf_ball.description: A small ball with round indentations on it.

pool_ball.name: pool ball
pool_ball.description: A colorful, hard ball.  Essentially a rock.

bowling_ball.name: bowling ball
bowling_ball.description: A large, heavy ball.  Before the apocalypse, its main purpose was to be rolled along waxed floors.

baseball.name: baseball
baseball.description: A baseball, good for throwing at enemies.  Getting hit with one of these hurts a lot more than you might think.

football.name: football
football.description: An oval made of leather and string, it's easily thrown but does little damage.  You could take it apart into leather if you wanted.

basketball.name: basketball
basketball.description: A high-quality indoor basketball.  You may throw it at zombies.

beach_volleyball.name: beach volleyball
beach_volleyball.description: A brightly colored beach volleyball.  It is slightly larger than a regular white one.

puck.name: hockey puck
puck.description: A heavy circular block of solid rubber, normally used for playing hockey.  You can throw it to cause some serious harm.

stopcock.name: plastic stopcock
stopcock.description: Stop giggling.  This is a tiny plastic valve, get your mind out of the gutter.

esapi_plate.name: ESAPI ballistic plate
esapi_plate.description: A polygonal ceramic ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile.  Its inner surface is coated with Ultra High Molecular Weight Polyethylene, and is labelled "TOP", while its outer surface is labelled "STRIKE FACE".  This is intended to be worn in a ballistic vest and can withstand several high energy rifle rounds before breaking.

esbi_plate.name: ESBI ballistic plate
esbi_plate.description: A polygonal ceramic ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile.  "STRIKE FACE" is printed on its outer surface.  This is designed to be worn in the sides of a plate carrier and can withstand several high energy rifle rounds before breaking.

broken_turret_rifle.name: broken M249 autonomous CROWS II
broken_turret_rifle.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
broken_turret_rifle.name_plural: broken M249 autonomous CROWS II turrets

broken_crows_m240.name: broken M240 autonomous CROWS II
broken_crows_m240.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
broken_crows_m240.name_plural: broken M240 autonomous CROWS II turrets

broken_turret_bmg.name: broken M2 autonomous CROWS II
broken_turret_bmg.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
broken_turret_bmg.name_plural: broken M2 autonomous CROWS II turrets

shed_stick.name: wooden shed stick
shed_stick.description: This is a short thin flat wooden stick, used as a tool while weaving cloth with a frame loom.

magnetron.name: microwave generator
magnetron.description: This electrical component is designed to produce microwaves, for use in your microwave.

flux_comp_gen.name: explosively pumped flux compression generator
flux_comp_gen.description: This large device consists mainly of a tube of copper wire surrounding a large copper tube filled with high explosives.  When detonated properly, the explosives allow the device to produce large amounts of electrical energy in a very short time.

tanning_hide.name: tanning leather hide
tanning_hide.description: A treated animal hide which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become leather.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

use_action.msg: You carefully unfold the tanning leather hide and shake it clean.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tanning leather hide isn't done yet.

tanning_pelt.name: tanning fur pelt
tanning_pelt.description: A treated animal pelt which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

use_action.msg: You carefully unfold the tanning fur pelt and shake it clean.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tanning fur pelt isn't done yet.

tanned_hide.name: tanned hide
tanned_hide.description: A folded sheet of leather made from carefully tanned animal hide.  Can be cut up or used as is.

tanned_pelt.name: tanned pelt
tanned_pelt.description: A folded sheet of leather made from carefully tanned animal hide, with the fur still intact.  Can be cut up or used as is.

milk_cream_jar.name: milk cream jar
milk_cream_jar.description: This jar contains raw milk separated into cream.  It is sealed until you are ready to use it.

milk_cream_rising.name: rising cream jar
milk_cream_rising.description: This jar contains raw milk separating into cream.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You examine the batch and see that the cream has risen to the top, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The cream has not risen yet.

soap_holder.name: soap dish
soap_holder.description: A shallow dish for holding a bar of soap.  It has ridges to help drain water away from the dish.  Not the most exciting of items.

toothbrush_plain.name: toothbrush
toothbrush_plain.description: A plastic brush with soft bristles for cleaning your teeth.

curler_hair.name: hair curler
curler_hair.description: A soft plastic cylinder you can wrap a lock of your hair around to curl it.

plunger_toilet.name: toilet plunger
plunger_toilet.description: A rubber-tipped tool for unclogging pipes, or a club for an immature survivor.

plunger_futuristic.name: professional plunger
plunger_futuristic.description: This hollow plastic toilet plunger's bell compresses like an accordion.  It is efficient at its intended purpose, and complete rubbish as a weapon.

brush_toilet.name: toilet brush
brush_toilet.description: Zombies cannot be intimidated or humiliated, so this stiff brush is only useful for scouring toilet bowls.

burette.name: burette
burette.description: A tall glass column with a stopcock at the end.

cuvettes.name: set of spectrometry cuvettes
cuvettes.description: This is a small box filled with precisely calibrated square plastic tubes for laboratory spectrometer use.

rack_test_tube.name: test tube rack
rack_test_tube.description: A plastic box with holes in it.  Not that exciting, unless you're desperate for a place to store a test tube.  Then it's great.

rack_test_tube_micro.name: microcentrifuge tube tray
rack_test_tube_micro.description: A plastic tray riddled with small holes, for storing microcentrifuge tubes.

stand_ring.name: ring stand
stand_ring.description: This is a heavy metal plate and a sturdy rod, for clamping lab stuff to.

stand_ring_clamps.name: set of ring stand clamps
stand_ring_clamps.description: This is a small box with a jumbled assortment of clamps for mounting on ring stands.  There seems to be some sort of rule that all of them are missing at least one wing nut for tightening them; it looks like judicious use of twist ties, duct tape, and other random stuff has been used to compensate.

filter_paper_qualitative.name: qualitative filter paper
filter_paper_qualitative.description: filter paper for seperating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 2 microns, seperating more solids out than quantitative filter paper but the process takes longer.

filter_paper_quantitative.name: quantitative filter paper
filter_paper_quantitative.description: filter paper for seperating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 20 microns, seperating less solids out than qualitative filter paper but the process is much faster.

recovery_pump.name: recovery pump
recovery_pump.description: A medium sized vacuum pump designed to recover solvent (hydrocarbons) from extracted essential oils.

AID_bio_watch.name: Internal Chronometer CBM installation data
AID_bio_watch.description: Precise step-by-step instructions and other required data for installation of Internal Chronometer CBM, stored on a data card of proprietary form-factor, designed to be used extensively by an Autodoc, and allowing bionic installation with minimal failure chance.  Integrated security subroutine renders it unusable after installation.

AID_bio_meteorologist.name: Weather Reader CBM installation data
AID_bio_meteorologist.description: Precise step-by-step instructions and other required data for installation of Weather Reader CBM, stored on a data card of proprietary form-factor, designed to be used extensively by an Autodoc, and allowing bionic installation with minimal failure chance.  Integrated security subroutine renders it unusable after installation.

washing_machine.name: washing machine
washing_machine.description: A very small washing machine designed for use in vehicles.

dishwasher.name: dishwasher
dishwasher.description: A very small dishwasher designed for use in vehicles.

reinforced_glass_pane.name: pane of reinforced glass
reinforced_glass_pane.description: A small pane of glass strengthened with steel wiring.

10mm_fmj.name: 10mm Auto FMJ
10mm_fmj.description: A jacketed 10mm Auto round.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.

bp_10mm_fmj.name: 10mm Auto FMJ, black powder
bp_10mm_fmj.description: A jacketed 10mm Auto round.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.

12mm.name: H&K 12mm
12mm.description: The Heckler & Koch 12mm projectiles are used in H&K railguns.  It's made of a ferromagnetic metal, probably cobalt.

12mm_makeshift.name: steel 12mm slug
12mm_makeshift.description: A handmade steel slug measured exactly 12mm in diameter intended for use with railguns.  The H&K G80 normally uses rare earth metals like cobalt for its ammunition, but it's not exactly something easy- or possible- to get outside of what was once the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

20x66_beanbag.name: 20x66mm beanbag
20x66_beanbag.description: 20x66mm caseless shotgun rounds, sublethal beanbag type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.  These are also subsonic, and thus work well with suppressors.

20x66_flechette_reloaded.name: 20x66mm flechette, handmade
20x66_flechette_reloaded.description: Handmade duplicates of Rivtech 20x66mm caseless flechette rounds.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

20x66_shot_reloaded.name: 20x66mm buckshot, handmade
20x66_shot_reloaded.description: Handmade duplicates of Rivtech 20x66mm caseless buckshot rounds.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.  These are also subsonic, and thus work well with suppressors.

20x66_slug_reloaded.name: 20x66mm slug, handmade
20x66_slug_reloaded.description: Handmade duplicates of Rivtech 20x66mm caseless solid projectile rounds.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

20x66_exp.name: 20x66mm explosive
20x66_exp.description: 20x66mm caseless shotgun rounds, explosive projectile type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

20x66_flare.name: 20x66mm flare
20x66_flare.description: 20x66mm caseless shotgun rounds, signal flare type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.  These are also subsonic, and thus work well with suppressors.

20x66_flechette.name: 20x66mm flechette
20x66_flechette.description: 20x66mm caseless shotgun rounds, flechette type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

20x66_frag.name: 20x66mm frag
20x66_frag.description: 20x66mm caseless shotgun rounds, explosive fragmentation type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

20x66_inc.name: 20x66mm incendiary
20x66_inc.description: 20x66mm caseless shotgun rounds, incendiary type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

20x66_shot.name: 20x66mm buckshot
20x66_shot.description: 20x66mm caseless shotgun rounds, buckshot type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.  These are also subsonic, and thus work well with suppressors.

20x66_slug.name: 20x66mm slug
20x66_slug.description: 20x66mm caseless shotgun rounds, solid projectile type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

22_cphp.name: .22 CPHP
22_cphp.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 30gr copper-plated, hollow-point bullets.  Has a higher velocity and slightly more stopping power than lead round-nose ammunition, but armor will have a magnified effect on its already-low penetration.

22_lr.name: .22 LR
22_lr.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 40gr unjacketed bullets.  The .22LR round is extremely weak with very low stopping power, short range, and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for rifle training, and hunting small animals.

22_ratshot.name: .22 rat-shot
22_ratshot.description: A .22 caliber cartridge loaded with very small pieces of shot contained within a fragmenting plastic capsule.  It has an extremely short range and penetration ability, but it can hit targets with greater ease.  Also, it is subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

bp_22_cphp.name: .22 LR CPHP, black powder
bp_22_cphp.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 30gr copper-plated, hollow-point bullets.  Has a higher velocity and slightly more stopping power than lead round-nose ammunition, but armor will have a magnified effect on its already-low penetration.

bp_22_lr.name: .22 LR, black powder
bp_22_lr.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 40gr unjacketed bullets.  The .22LR round is extremely weak with very low stopping power, short range, and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for rifle training, and hunting small animals.

556_incendiary.name: 5.56x45mm NATO tracer
556_incendiary.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M855A1 and M856 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

bp_223.name: 5.56x45mm '.223 Remington', black powder
bp_223.description: .223 Remington ammunition with 36gr JHP bullets.  The .223 round has been very popular with civilian shooters for almost a century, finding use in a wide variety of weapons.  It generates lower pressure than 5.56x45mm NATO leading to slightly decreased accuracy and recoil.

bp_556.name: 5.56x45mm NATO, black powder
bp_556.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition with a 62gr FMJ bullet containing a steel penetrator.  Its light weight, high accuracy, and manageable recoil lead to widespread use in the 20th century and it remains popular among militaries and civilians.

bp_556_incendiary.name: 5.56x45mm NATO tracer, black powder
bp_556_incendiary.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M855A1 and M856 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

277_fmj.name: 6.8x51mm 'Fury' FMJ
277_fmj.description: A rimless cartridge that was planned to be adopted by the US military to combat advances in modern body armor, but was quietly abandoned soon after the development of caseless ammo. The FMJ rounds are meant for training and civilian use, but nonetheless pack significant firepower.

277_hybrid.name: 6.8x51mm 'Fury' Hybrid
277_hybrid.description: A rimless cartridge that was planned to be adopted by the US military to combat advances in modern body armor, but was quietly abandoned soon after the development of caseless ammo.  These full-power Hybrid rounds offer significant armor penetration but greatly increased recoil and reduced accuracy.

bp_277_fmj.name: 6.8x51mm 'Fury' FMJ, black powder
bp_277_fmj.description: A rimless cartridge that was planned to be adopted by the US military to combat advances in modern body armor, but was quietly abandoned soon after the development of caseless ammo. The FMJ rounds are meant for training and civilian use, but nonetheless pack significant firepower.

bp_277_hybrid.name: 6.8x51mm 'Fury' Hybrid, black powder
