bp_277_hybrid.description: A rimless cartridge that was planned to be adopted by the US military to combat advances in modern body armor, but was quietly abandoned soon after the development of caseless ammo.  These full-power Hybrid rounds offer significant armor penetration but greatly increased recoil and reduced accuracy.

300_winmag.name: .300 Winchester Magnum
300_winmag.description: .300 Winchester Magnum rounds with 220gr JHP bullets.  The 300WM round is an extremely powerful and accurate rifle round introduced in 1963.  It has proven popular with hunters and snipers, although it is not as common as .308 or .30-06.

bp_300_winmag.name: .300 Winchester Magnum, black powder
bp_300_winmag.description: .300 Winchester Magnum rounds with 220gr JHP bullets.  The 300WM round is an extremely powerful and accurate rifle round introduced in 1963.  It has proven popular with hunters and snipers, although it is not as common as .308 or .30-06.

3006_incendiary.name: .30-06 M14A1 tracer
3006_incendiary.description: Armor piercing incendiary .30-06 M14A1 ammunition containing tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  It penetrates all but the strongest body armor with ease.

3006fmj.name: .30-06 M2 AP
3006fmj.description: Armor piercing .30-06 M2 ammunition with 168gr FMJ bullets.  It is an extremely powerful and accurate cartridge but pays for its armor penetration abilities with lowered damage.

bp_3006.name: .30-06 Springfield, black powder
bp_3006.description: .30-06 Springfield rounds with 165gr soft point bullets.  The .30-06 cartridge has excellent accuracy, range, and stopping power making it popular with hunters and snipers for well over a century.

bp_3006_incendiary.name: .30-06 Springfield tracer, black powder
bp_3006_incendiary.description: Armor piercing incendiary .30-06 M14A1 ammunition containing tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  It penetrates all but the strongest body armor with ease.

bp_3006fmj.name: .30-06 M2 AP, black powder
bp_3006fmj.description: Armor piercing .30-06 M2 ammunition with 168gr FMJ bullets.  It is an extremely powerful and accurate cartridge but pays for its armor penetration abilities with lowered damage.

300blk.name: .300 AAC Blackout
300blk.description: A .300 AAC Blackout round with a 125gr open tip match bullet.  300 BLK is an intermediate cartridge necked up from 5.56x45mm, designed to achieve similar ballistics to 7.62x39mm.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.

300blk_ss.name: .300 AAC Blackout, subsonic
300blk_ss.description: A subsonic .300 AAC Blackout round with a 220gr open tip match bullet.  300 BLK is an intermediate cartridge necked up from 5.56x45mm, designed to achieve similar ballistics to 7.62x39mm.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.  Its low speed makes it uniquely suited for use in suppressed firearms.

bp_300blk.name: .300 AAC Blackout, black powder
bp_300blk.description: A .300 AAC Blackout round with a 125gr open tip match bullet.  300 BLK is an intermediate cartridge necked up from 5.56x45mm, designed to achieve similar ballistics to 7.62x39mm.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.

762_51.name: 7.62x51mm NATO M80
762_51.description: A 7.62x51mm NATO round with a 147gr FMJ bullet.  It is a powerful rifle cartridge commonly used by hunters and military snipers because of its high accuracy and long range.

762_51_incendiary.name: 7.62x51mm NATO tracer
762_51_incendiary.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M80 and M62 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

bp_308.name: 7.62x51mm '.308 Winchester', black powder
bp_308.description: .308 Winchester ammunition with 168gr hollow point bullets.  The .308 round is one of the most popular hunting cartridges in the world due to its accuracy and power.

bp_762_51.name: 7.62x51mm NATO, black powder
bp_762_51.description: A 7.62x51mm NATO round with a 147gr FMJ bullet.  It is a powerful rifle cartridge commonly used by hunters and military snipers because of its high accuracy and long range.

bp_762_51_incendiary.name: 7.62x51mm NATO tracer, black powder
bp_762_51_incendiary.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M80 and M62 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

32_acp.name: .32 ACP
32_acp.description: The .32 ACP was a popular handgun cartridge in the 20th century.  Not so powerful as the .38 or the 9x19mm though.  It is however subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

bp_32_acp.name: .32 ACP, black powder
bp_32_acp.description: The .32 ACP was a popular handgun cartridge in the 20th century.  Not so powerful as the .38 or the 9x19mm though.  It is however subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

357mag_fmj.name: .357 magnum FMJ
357mag_fmj.description: Jacketed .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

357mag_jhp.name: .357 magnum JHP
357mag_jhp.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

bp_357mag_fmj.name: .357 Magnum FMJ, black powder
bp_357mag_fmj.description: Jacketed .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

bp_357mag_jhp.name: .357 Magnum JHP, black powder
bp_357mag_jhp.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 magnum ammunition.  The .357 magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.

357sig_fmj.name: .357 SIG FMJ
357sig_fmj.description: Jacketed .357 SIG ammunition.  The .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.

357sig_jhp.name: .357 SIG JHP
357sig_jhp.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 SIG ammunition.  The .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.

bp_357sig_fmj.name: .357 SIG FMJ, black powder
bp_357sig_fmj.description: Jacketed .357 SIG ammunition.  The .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.

bp_357sig_jhp.name: .357 SIG JHP, black powder
bp_357sig_jhp.description: Jacketed hollow point .357 SIG ammunition.  The .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.

36navy.name: .36 paper cartridge
36navy.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .36 projectile.  Used by the Colt M1861 Navy.

38_fmj.name: .38 FMJ
38_fmj.description: .38 Special ammunition with brass jacketed 130gr bullets.  The .38 Special round has been known from its inception for its accuracy and low recoil.  It is also subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

38_special.name: .38 Special
38_special.description: .38 Special ammunition with 130gr JHP bullets.  The .38 Special round was extremely common among US police forces during the 20th century.  It is also subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

bp_38_fmj.name: .38 FMJ, black powder
bp_38_fmj.description: .38 Special ammunition with brass jacketed 130gr bullets.  The .38 Special round has been known from its inception for its accuracy and low recoil.  It is also subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

bp_38_special.name: .38 Special, black powder
bp_38_special.description: .38 Special ammunition with 130gr JHP bullets.  The .38 Special round was extremely common among US police forces during the 20th century.  It is also subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

380_FMJ.name: .380 ACP FMJ
380_FMJ.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a brass jacketed 95gr bullet.  Subsonic.  Popular in pocket pistols for over a century, it is often considered the weakest caliber to consider carrying.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

380_JHP.name: .380 ACP JHP
380_JHP.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a 95gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  Subsonic.  It is a popular round for small concealable backup pistols, and often the weakest recommended defensive caliber.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

380_p.name: .380 ACP +P
380_p.description: Overpressure .380 ACP ammunition with a 90gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  These defensive loadings are designed to maximize performance and tend to be more accurate than practice ammo.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

bp_380_FMJ.name: .380 ACP FMJ, black powder
bp_380_FMJ.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a brass jacketed 95gr bullet.  Subsonic.  Popular in pocket pistols for over a century, it is often considered the weakest caliber to consider carrying.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

bp_380_JHP.name: .380 ACP JHP, black powder
bp_380_JHP.description: .380 ACP ammunition with a 95gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  Subsonic.  It is a popular round for small concealable backup pistols, and often the weakest recommended defensive caliber.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.

40fmj.name: .40 S&W FMJ
40fmj.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 180gr FMJ bullets.  Designed to retain the 10mm Auto cartridge's power with lower recoil, the .40 S&W round became popular for law enforcement and personal defense.  It is subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

40sw.name: .40 S&W JHP
40sw.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 135gr JHP bullets.  The .40 S&W round is a descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.

bp_40fmj.name: .40 S&W FMJ, black powder
bp_40fmj.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 180gr FMJ bullets.  Designed to retain the 10mm Auto cartridge's power with lower recoil, the .40 S&W round became popular for law enforcement and personal defense.  It is subsonic, and thus works well with suppressors.

bp_40sw.name: .40 S&W JHP, black powder
bp_40sw.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 135gr JHP bullets.  The .40 S&W round is a descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.

40x46mm_m1006.name: 40x46mm M1006 stun
40x46mm_m1006.description: A low velocity less-lethal 40x46mm round with a foam and plastic projectile intended to cause pain and disorientation to the target.  May still injure or kill.

40x46mm_m433.name: 40x46mm M433 HEDP
40x46mm_m433.description: A low velocity 40x46mm HEDP grenade.  It can penetrate 2 inches of steel armor and fragmentation of the projectile body also makes it suitable for use against infantry.

40x46mm_m576.name: 40x46mm M576 buckshot
40x46mm_m576.description: A 40x46mm buckshot load, designed for use in thick vegetation or room clearing.

40x46mm_m651.name: 40x46mm M651 teargas
40x46mm_m651.description: A low velocity 40mm tear gas canister.  It is effective for riot control and driving infantry from entrenched positions

40x46mm_slug.name: improvised 40x46mm slug
40x46mm_slug.description: An improvised 40x46mm load resembling an oversized shotgun slug, assembled from a reconditioned spent casing and handloaded components.

40x46mm_flechette.name: improvised 40x46mm flechette
40x46mm_flechette.description: An improvised 40x46mm flechette load containing a load of steel darts, assembled from a reconditioned spent casing and handloaded components.

40x46mm_makeshift_he.name: improvised 40x46mm HE
40x46mm_makeshift_he.description: A high velocity 40x46mm HEDP grenade, loaded with a homemade explosive round.  Packs quite a punch, though less effective against armor than proper HEDP.

40x53mm_m1001.name: 40x53mm M1001 flechette
40x53mm_m1001.description: 40x53mm canister shot loaded with 17 grain flechettes.

40x53mm_m430a1.name: 40x53mm M430A1 HEDP
40x53mm_m430a1.description: A high velocity 40x53mm HEDP grenade.  It can penetrate 3 inches of steel armor and fragmentation of the projectile body also makes it suitable for use against infantry.

40x53mm_buckshot_m169.name: improvised 40x53mm buckshot
40x53mm_buckshot_m169.description: An improvised 40x53mm buckshot load somewhat resembling M576.

40x53mm_slug_m169.name: improvised 40x53mm slug
40x53mm_slug_m169.description: An improvised 40x53mm load resembling an oversized shotgun slug.

40x53mm_makeshift_he.name: improvised 40x53mm HE
40x53mm_makeshift_he.description: A high velocity 40x53mm HEDP grenade, loaded with a homemade explosive round.  Packs quite a punch, though less effective against armor than proper HEDP.

410shot_000.name: .410 000 shot
410shot_000.description: A .410 shell with 5 000 pellets.  Good for a hunting or combat load.

bp_410shot_000.name: .410 000 shot, black powder
bp_410shot_000.description: A .410 shell with 5 000 pellets.  Good for a hunting or combat load.

44fmj.name: .44 Magnum FMJ
44fmj.description: A brass-jacketed variant of the .44 Magnum round.  This increases penetration at the cost of reduced damage from expansion.

44magnum.name: .44 Magnum
44magnum.description: .44 magnum ammunition with 240gr JHP bullets.  The .44 magnum round is one of the most powerful handgun cartridges available.  It has excellent stopping power but suffers from extremely high recoil for a handgun round.

bp_44magnum.name: .44 Magnum, black powder
bp_44magnum.description: .44 magnum ammunition with 240gr JHP bullets.  The .44 magnum round is one of the most powerful handgun cartridges available.  It has excellent stopping power but suffers from extremely high recoil for a handgun round.

bp_44fmj.name: .44 Magnum FMJ, black powder
bp_44fmj.description: A brass-jacketed variant of the .44 Magnum round.  This increases penetration at the cost of reduced damage from expansion.

44army.name: .44 paper cartridge
44army.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .44 projectile.

44army_smokeless.name: .44 smokeless paper cartridge
44army_smokeless.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of smokeless powder and a .44 projectile, for people who want to fire real civil war era weapons without getting a lungful of smoke.

45_acp.name: .45 ACP FMJ
45_acp.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 230gr FMJ bullets.  Noted for its stopping power, the .45 ACP round has been common for almost 150 years.  It's a subsonic round, and is known for working well with suppressors.

45_jhp.name: .45 ACP JHP
45_jhp.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 185gr JHP bullets.  The .45 ACP round was developed to replace the .38 Long Colt cartridge in the early 20th century.  It has good stopping power but above average recoil.  It's a subsonic round, and is known for working well with suppressors

45_super.name: .45 ACP +P
45_super.description: Overpressure .45 ACP ammunition with 200gr JHP bullets.  This +P ammunition has higher muzzle energy than typical loads leading to greater damage, accuracy and recoil.

bp_45_acp.name: .45 ACP FMJ, black powder
bp_45_acp.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 230gr FMJ bullets.  Noted for its stopping power, the .45 ACP round has been common for almost 150 years.  It's a subsonic round, and is known for working well with suppressors.

bp_45_jhp.name: .45 ACP JHP, black powder
bp_45_jhp.description: .45 ACP ammunition with 185gr JHP bullets.  The .45 ACP round was developed to replace the .38 Long Colt cartridge in the early 20th century.  It has good stopping power but above average recoil.  It's a subsonic round, and is known for working well with suppressors

4570_sp.name: .45-70 SP
4570_sp.description: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 305 grain soft point round.  One of the oldest cartridges still in use, it is still a favorite for large game hunting at short ranges.

4570_pen.name: .45-70 +P penetrator
4570_pen.description: .45-70 Government +P ammunition loaded with a 305 grain solid copper or brass penetrator projectile.  Designed for maximum penetration through thick hide and bone while maintaining ideal wounding characteristics.

4570_low.name: .45-70 LFN cowboy
4570_low.description: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 405 grain lead flat nose bullet to original specifications for safe use in antique firearms.  Quite a bit less powerful than modern ammo, but still packs a punch.

reloaded_4570_bp.name: .45-70, black powder
reloaded_4570_bp.description: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 405 grain lead flat nose bullet using black powder to original specifications.  Quite a bit less powerful and a lot dirtier than modern ammo, but still packs a punch.  This one has been hand-loaded.

45colt_jhp.name: .45 Colt JHP
45colt_jhp.description: .45 Colt ammunition with 250gr jacketed hollow point bullets.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  Originally a black powder cartridge, modern loads can make this round competitive in the new era.

bp_45colt_jhp.name: .45 Colt, black powder
bp_45colt_jhp.description: .45 Colt ammunition with 250gr jacketed hollow point bullets.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  Originally a black powder cartridge, this load is less powerful and dirtier than modern reproduction loads but still packs a decent punch.

50_incendiary.name: .50 BMG M17 tracer
50_incendiary.description: A tracer variant of the powerful .50 BMG round.  Tracer rounds help to keep the weapon they are fired from on target at the risk of igniting flammable substances.

50bmg.name: .50 BMG M33 Ball
50bmg.description: .50 BMG ammunition with mild steel cored 660gr FMJ bullets.  The .50 BMG is a very powerful rifle round designed for anti-aircraft use, later adapted to anti-vehicular and anti-personnel roles.  Its stupendous energy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.

50match.name: .50 BMG Match
50match.description: .50 BMG FMJ lead core ammunition manufactured with tighter tolerances for long-range competition shooting or other precision rifle use.

50ss.name: .50 BMG M2 AP
50ss.description: Variant of the .50 BMG round that uses a core of very dense, hardened tungsten steel.  Penetration is increased, but damage is reduced.

50_mk211.name: .50 BMG Raufoss Mk 211
50_mk211.description: This variant of the .50 BMG round makes the most of the caliber's potential payload delivery: the tip is loaded with an incendiary mix, which ignites on impact, detonating the RDX or PETN charge.  This also ignites a secondary zirconium powder incendiary charge that surrounds a tungsten carbide penetrator, both encased by a mild steel cup.  Fragments from the cup and burning metallic powder follow the penetrator through armored targets, increasing lethality.

bp_50_mk211.name: .50 BMG Raufoss Mk 211, black powder
bp_50_mk211.description: This variant of the .50 BMG round makes the most of the caliber's potential payload delivery: the tip is loaded with an incendiary mix, which ignites on impact, detonating the RDX or PETN charge.  This also ignites a secondary zirconium powder incendiary charge that surrounds a tungsten carbide penetrator, both encased by a mild steel cup.  Fragments from the cup and burning metallic powder follow the penetrator through armored targets, increasing lethality.

bp_50_incendiary.name: .50 BMG M17 tracer, black powder
bp_50_incendiary.description: A tracer variant of the powerful .50 BMG round.  Tracer rounds help to keep the weapon they are fired from on target at the risk of igniting flammable substances.

bp_50bmg.name: .50 BMG M33 Ball, black powder
bp_50bmg.description: .50 BMG ammunition with mild steel cored 660gr FMJ bullets.  The .50 BMG is a very powerful rifle round designed for anti-aircraft use, later adapted to anti-vehicular and anti-personnel roles.  Its stupendous energy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.

bp_50ss.name: .50 BMG M2 AP, black powder
bp_50ss.description: Variant of the .50 BMG round that uses a core of very dense, hardened tungsten steel.  Penetration is increased, but damage is reduced.

5x50dart.name: RA110 5x50mm flechette
5x50dart.description: Designed to defeat modern body armor, the Rivtech 5x50mm flechette round features a biodegradable sabot and a single, fin-stabilized penetrator.

5x50heavy.name: RA119 5x50mm penetrator
5x50heavy.description: Designed to defeat modern body armor, the Rivtech 5x50mm RA119 penetrator round features a biodegradable sabot and a single, fin-stabilized tungsten alloy projectile.

m235tpa.name: M74 rocket
m235tpa.description: 66mm incendiary rockets used in the M202 FLASH rocket launcher.  Their warheads are filled with a thickened pyrophoric agent, which burns at 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.

66mm_HEAT.name: 66mm HEAT
66mm_HEAT.description: A 66mm high-explosive anti-tank round.  It could blow through up to two feet of concrete.

762_m43.name: 7.62x39mm 57-N-231
762_m43.description: 7.62x39mm 57-N-231 ammunition with 121.9gr steel core FMJ bullets.  Developed in WW2 by the Soviet Union the 7.62x39mm round rapidly became extremely popular all over the world.  The bullet has poor wounding potential due to its stability, only beginning to yaw after 26cm.

762_m87.name: 7.62x39mm M67
762_m87.description: 7.62x39mm M67 rounds with 123gr bullets.  The inadequate terminal ballistics of the M43 round led to the development of the M67 round in Yugoslavia in the 1960s.  It destabilizes much faster than M43 after hitting a target leading to greater damage.

bp_762_m43.name: 7.62x39mm 57-N-231, black powder
bp_762_m43.description: 7.62x39mm 57-N-231 ammunition with 121.9gr steel core FMJ bullets.  Developed in WW2 by the Soviet Union the 7.62x39mm round rapidly became extremely popular all over the world.  The bullet has poor wounding potential due to its stability, only beginning to yaw after 26cm.

bp_762_m87.name: 7.62x39mm M67, black powder
bp_762_m87.description: 7.62x39mm M67 rounds with 123gr bullets.  The inadequate terminal ballistics of the M43 round led to the development of the M67 round in Yugoslavia in the 1960s.  It destabilizes much faster than M43 after hitting a target leading to greater damage.

762_54R.name: 7.62x54mmR
762_54R.description: 7.62x54mmR ammunition with 150gr FMJ bullets.  The 7.62x54mmR round is one of the oldest still in common use, primarily due to the popularity of the Mosin-Nagant rifle.  Although it has not been used by militaries for several decades it remains popular with civilians.  It is a powerful cartridge capable of killing most targets with one shot.

bp_762_54R.name: 7.62x54mmR, black powder
bp_762_54R.description: 7.62x54mmR ammunition with 150gr FMJ bullets.  The 7.62x54mmR round is one of the oldest still in common use, primarily due to the popularity of the Mosin-Nagant rifle.  Although it has not been used by militaries for several decades it remains popular with civilians.  It is a powerful cartridge capable of killing most targets with one shot.

84x246mm_he.name: 84x246mm HE rocket
84x246mm_he.description: A 84x246mm High Explosive anti-personnel round for the Carl Gustav M3 recoilless rifle.  Designed to be highly effective against personnel.

84x246mm_hedp.name: 84x246mm HEDP rocket
84x246mm_hedp.description: A 84x246mm High Explosive Dual Purpose anti-materiel round for the Carl Gustav M3 recoilless rifle.  Designed to be highly effective against vehicles and structures.

84x246mm_smoke.name: 84x246mm smoke rocket
84x246mm_smoke.description: A 84x246mm smoke marker round for the Carl Gustav M3 recoilless rifle.  Commonly used for signaling, target designation, and for screening troop movements.

8mm_jhp_reloaded.name: 8x40mm JHP, handmade
8mm_jhp_reloaded.description: Handmade duplicates of Rivtech 8x40mm JHP rounds.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

8mm_caseless_reloaded.name: 8x40mm caseless, handmade
8mm_caseless_reloaded.description: Handmade duplicates of Rivtech 8x40mm caseless rounds.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

8mm_hvp_reloaded.name: 8x40mm HVP, handmade
8mm_hvp_reloaded.description: Handmade duplicates of Rivtech 8x40mm HVP rounds.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

8mm_inc_reloaded.name: 8x40mm tracer, handmade
8mm_inc_reloaded.description: Handmade duplicates of Rivtech 8x40mm tracer rounds.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

8mm_caseless.name: 8x40mm caseless
8mm_caseless.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech firearms.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

8mm_civilian.name: 8x40mm sporting
8mm_civilian.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds, light sporting load sold for civilian use.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech firearms.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

8mm_hvp.name: 8x40mm HVP
8mm_hvp.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds, saboted high-velocity penetrator type.  Advanced military grade, armor-piercing ammunition that fires a single depleted uranium flechette.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

8mm_inc.name: 8x40mm tracer
8mm_inc.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds with tracers to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target at the risk of igniting flammable substances.  Military grade ammunition for Rivtech firearms.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

8mm_jhp.name: 8x40mm JHP
8mm_jhp.description: 8x40mm caseless rounds, jacketed hollowpoint.  Military grade ammunition for Rivtech firearms.  Being caseless rounds, these cannot be disassembled or reloaded.

9mm.name: 9x19mm JHP
9mm.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a 116gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  JHP rounds have inferior penetration to FMJ rounds but their expansion slightly increases stopping power against unarmored targets and reduces overpenetration.

9mmfmj.name: 9x19mm FMJ
9mmfmj.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It is a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use even after almost 150 years.

9mmP.name: 9x19mm +P
9mmP.description: Overpressure 9x19mm ammunition.  The round's increased velocity results in superior accuracy and stopping power at the cost of higher recoil.

9mmP2.name: 9x19mm +P+
9mmP2.description: A step beyond the high-pressure 9x19mm +P round, the +P+ has even higher internal pressure offering superior damage, accuracy, and penetration.

bp_9mm.name: 9x19mm JHP, black powder
bp_9mm.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a 116gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  JHP rounds have inferior penetration to FMJ rounds but their expansion slightly increases stopping power against unarmored targets and reduces overpenetration.

bp_9mmfmj.name: 9x19mm FMJ, black powder
bp_9mmfmj.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It is a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use even after almost 150 years.

atgm_heat.name: 152mm ATGM HEAT
atgm_heat.description: A tube-launched, optically tracked, wire-guided missile contained in a steel tube.  Designed to be highly effective against vehicles and structures.

barb_paralysis.name: paralyzing barb
barb_paralysis.description: Tiny droplets of venom trickle out of the sponge-like tissue of this sharp barb.

cannon_explosive_shell.name: explosive cannon shell
cannon_explosive_shell.description: A bundle of wadding, black gunpowder, and a tightly-packed explosive shell with a percussion fuse.  A Civil War era "common shell" for cannons of 3-inch bore, whatever it hits probably won't live to regret it.

cannon_round_ball.name: cannon round shot
cannon_round_ball.description: A bundle of wadding, black gunpowder, and a 3-inch cast-iron cannonball.  An explosive "common shell" would be preferable for a Civil War era cannon, but this can still ruin anyone's day.

cannon_canister_shot.name: cannon canister shot
cannon_canister_shot.description: A bundle of wadding, black gunpowder, and a good five pounds of round lead shot.  Used for hosing down formations of line infantry, and quite capable of absolutely ruining a zombie's day.

cannon_scrap_shot.name: cannon scrap shot
cannon_scrap_shot.description: A bundle of wadding, black gunpowder, and a load of improvised buckshot.  Certainly still quite dangerous to anything downrange.

gas_chloramine.name: sprayable toxic gas
gas_chloramine.description: A hazardous mixture made from household cleaners, improvised for use in a chemical thrower.  Best be used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.

gas_fungicidal.name: sprayable fungicide
gas_fungicidal.description: Fungicide enhanced with sulfur to create sprayable anti-fungal ammo for the chemical thrower.  Best be used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.

gas_insecticidal.name: sprayable insecticide
gas_insecticidal.description: Strong sprayable insecticide ammo for the chemical thrower.  Best be used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.

flintlock_ammo.name: paper cartridge
flintlock_ammo.description: A paper cartridge containing black powder and a metallic projectile.  Historically used to reload muzzleloaders in a more reasonable time.

flintlock_shot.name: paper shot cartridge
flintlock_shot.description: A paper cartridge containing black powder and metallic shot.  Historically used to reload muzzleloaders in a more reasonable time.

hellfire_heat.name: AGM-114L Hellfire Longbow
hellfire_heat.description: An anti-armor air-to-ground missile equipped with millimeter-wave radar seeking and a 9kg HEAT warhead, designed to have devastating effect against all manner of vehicles and structures.

hellfire_ninja.name: AGM-114R-R9X Hellfire 'Ninja'
hellfire_ninja.description: A highly specialized air-to-ground missile designed to eliminate high value targets while causing minimal collateral damage. Blades pop out of the missile after launch and devastate any single target.

rebar_rail.name: rebar rail
rebar_rail.description: A short piece of ferromagnetic rebar which has been straightened and sharpened on one end.  Could be used as a projectile by a sufficiently powerful electromagnetic weapon.

steel_rail.name: steel rail
steel_rail.description: A short piece of steel which has been forged true and sharpened on one end.  Could be used as a projectile by a sufficiently powerful electromagnetic weapon.

mininuke_mod.name: mininuke rocket
mininuke_mod.description: A heavily modified handheld nuclear device on a rocket.  Intended to be fired from a specialized launcher, it has been rigged to explode on impact instead of on a timer.  It can fly further than the explosion will reach, probably.

combatnail.name: flechette
combatnail.description: A tiny steel dart.  Can be fired from a nail gun or similar weapon or used when crafting ammunition

nail.name: nail
nail.description: A pin-shaped piece of iron, can be used to construct various things with a hammer.

paintball.name: paintball
paintball.description: A tube of small paintballs.  They deal virtually no damage.

RPG-7_ammo.name: PG-7VL RPG-7 rocket
RPG-7_ammo.description: 93mm single-stage high-explosive ammunition for the RPG-7.

RPG-7_pg7vr.name: PG-7VR RPG-7 rocket
RPG-7_pg7vr.description: 64mm/105mm high-explosive tandem ammunition for the RPG-7.

RPG-7_og7v.name: OG-7V RPG-7 rocket
RPG-7_og7v.description: 40mm high-explosive fragmentation antipersonnel ammunition for the RPG-7.

bp_shot_bird.name: birdshot, black powder
bp_shot_bird.description: Weak shotgun ammunition.  Designed for hunting birds and other small game, its applications in combat are very limited.

bp_shot_dragon.name: dragon's breath shell, black powder
bp_shot_dragon.description: A shotgun shell filled with magnesium pellets or shards, used mostly as a distress flare or pyrotechnics tool.  When the round is fired, high temperature sparks and flames shoot out of the barrel, igniting everything in their path.

bp_shot_00.name: 00 shot, black powder
bp_shot_00.description: A shell filled with metal pellets.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Favored by SWAT forces.

bp_shot_flechette.name: flechette shell, black powder
bp_shot_flechette.description: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Slices through most forms of armor with ease.

bp_shot_slug.name: shotgun slug, black powder
bp_shot_slug.description: A heavy metal slug used with shotguns to give them the range capabilities of a rifle.  Extremely damaging but rather inaccurate.

shot_00.name: 00 shot
shot_00.description: A shell filled with metal pellets.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Favored by SWAT forces.

shot_beanbag.name: shotgun beanbag
shot_beanbag.description: A beanbag round for shotguns, not deadly but designed to disable.

shot_bird.name: birdshot
shot_bird.description: Weak shotgun ammunition.  Designed for hunting birds and other small game, its applications in combat are very limited.

shot_dragon.name: dragon's breath shell
shot_dragon.description: A shotgun shell filled with magnesium pellets or shards, used mostly as a distress flare or pyrotechnics tool.  When the round is fired, high temperature sparks and flames shoot out of the barrel, igniting everything in their path.

shot_flechette.name: flechette shell
shot_flechette.description: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts.  Extremely damaging, plus the spread makes it very accurate at short range.  Slices through most forms of armor with ease.

shot_he.name: explosive slug
shot_he.description: A shotgun shell shooting a small explosive.  Damaging, but rather inaccurate and short ranged.  Banned in several states.

bp_shot_he.name: explosive slug, black powder
bp_shot_he.description: A shotgun shell shooting a small explosive.  Damaging, but rather inaccurate and short ranged.  Banned in several states.

shot_scrap.name: 00 shot, scrap loaded
shot_scrap.description: A shotgun shell filled with whatever was lying around.  They are more damaging than birdshot, but fairly inaccurate.

bp_shot_scrap.name: 00 shot, black powder, scrap loaded
bp_shot_scrap.description: A shotgun shell filled with whatever was lying around.  They are more damaging than birdshot, but fairly inaccurate.

shot_slug.name: shotgun slug
shot_slug.description: A heavy metal slug used with shotguns to give them the range capabilities of a rifle.  Extremely damaging but rather inaccurate.

shotcanister_scrap.name: scrap shotcanister
shotcanister_scrap.description: This small paper canister resembling a crude shotshell is filled to the brim with assorted pieces of scrap metal.

shotcanister_pebble.name: pebble shotcanister
shotcanister_pebble.description: This small paper canister resembling a crude shotshell is filled to the brim with tiny pebbles.  Damage is pathetic but flight is much more stable than scrap.

shotcanister_flechette.name: flechette shotcanister
shotcanister_flechette.description: This small paper canister resembling a crude shotshell is filled to the brim with handmade flechettes, giving it some armor piercing capabilities.

shotcanister_bearing.name: bearing shotcanister
shotcanister_bearing.description: This small paper canister resembling a crude shotshell is filled to the brim with handmade bearings, stabilizing its flight pattern a tiny bit.

shot_paper_00.name: 20ga paper shot
shot_paper_00.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and an equal volume of 00 buckshot.

shot_paper_bird.name: 20ga paper birdshot
shot_paper_bird.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and an equal volume of birdshot.  Used mostly for hunting small game or fowl.

shot_paper_dragon.name: 20ga paper pyrotechnic cartridge
shot_paper_dragon.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and an equal volume of flammable metals.  When fired, burning chunks of metal and sparks will shoot out of the barrel, igniting everything in their path.

shot_paper_slug.name: 20ga paper slug
shot_paper_slug.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .605 inch lead ball.

signal_flare.name: signal flare
signal_flare.description: A heavy plastic cartridge made for use in flare guns.  It appears to be a modified 12 gauge shotgun shell.

signal_flare_test.name: signal flare half-testing
signal_flare_test.description: A heavy plastic cartridge made for use in flare guns.  It appears to be a modified 12 gauge shotgun shell.

spray_paint.name: spray paint
spray_paint.description: A refill for spray paint cans, of non-descript color.

25mm_hei.name: 25x137mm M792 HEI
25mm_hei.description: A 25x137mm autocannon round, high explosive incendiary.  Designed for use against unarmored vehicles and to suppress infantry.

25mm_apds.name: 25x137mm M791 APDS
25mm_apds.description: A 25x137mm autocannon round using an armor-piercing, discarding sabot with a tungsten penetrator.  Used primarily against light armored vehicles and aerial targets.

25mm_slug.name: reloaded 25x137mm
25mm_slug.description: A 25x137mm autocannon round with its primer replaced, and loaded with a basic lead projectile.  Not as effective as the real thing, but still fairly potent.

bp_25mm_slug.name: reloaded 25x137mm, black powder
bp_25mm_slug.description: A 25x137mm autocannon round with its primer replaced, and loaded with a basic lead projectile.  Not as effective as the real thing, but still fairly potent.

25mm_he_reloaded.name: reloaded 25x137mm HE
25mm_he_reloaded.description: A 25x137mm autocannon round with its primer replaced, loaded with a homemade explosive round.  Useful against lightly armored targets, though not as effective as the real thing.

bp_25mm_he_reloaded.name: reloaded 25x137mm HE, black powder
bp_25mm_he_reloaded.description: A 25x137mm autocannon round with its primer replaced, loaded with a homemade explosive round.  Useful against lightly armored targets, though not as effective as the real thing.

105mm_heat.name: 105mm M456 HEAT
105mm_heat.description: A 105mm High Explosive Anti Tank round, designed for older models of tank held in reserve up until the world was on the brink of ending.  Now that the world has gone and ended, it still packs quite a punch.

105mm_ap.name: 105mm M833 APFSDS
105mm_ap.description: A 105mm Armor-Piercing Fin-Stabilized Discarding Sabot round, no longer commonly used except for hastily supplying obsolete tanks.  Brought out of mothballs or not, its depleted uranium projectile will still give whatever it hits a bad time.

105mm_slug.name: makeshift 105mm slug
105mm_slug.description: A 105mm shell with a new electric primer installed, loaded with a large handmade slug.  While hardly ideal, it packs quite a punch.

bp_105mm_slug.name: makeshift 105mm slug, black powder
bp_105mm_slug.description: A 105mm shell with a new electric primer installed, loaded with a large handmade slug.  While hardly ideal, it packs quite a punch.

105mm_he_reloaded.name: reloaded 105mm HE
105mm_he_reloaded.description: A 105mm shell with a new electric primer installed, loaded with a homemade explosive round.  Obsolete or not, it packs quite a punch.

bp_105mm_he_reloaded.name: reloaded 105mm HE, black powder
bp_105mm_he_reloaded.description: A 105mm shell with a new electric primer installed, loaded with a homemade explosive round.  Obsolete or not, it packs quite a punch.

120mm_usable_heat.name: 120mm M830A1 HEAT
120mm_usable_heat.description: A 120mm High Explosive Anti Tank round.  Packs an explosive punch that could ruin anyone's whole day.

120mm_usable_ap.name: 120mm M829A3 APFSDS
120mm_usable_ap.description: A 120mm Armor-Piercing Fin-Stabilized Discarding Sabot round.  Uses a depleted uranium projectile to give whatever it hits a really bad day.

120mm_usable_shot.name: reloaded 120mm shot
120mm_usable_shot.description: A makeshift, rebuilt 120mm shell with a new electric primer installed, filled with a large amount of buckshot.  Effectively similar to no-longer-produced canister shot, but of lower quality.

bp_120mm_usable_shot.name: makeshift 120mm shot, black powder
bp_120mm_usable_shot.description: A makeshift, rebuilt 120mm shell with a new electric primer installed, filled with a large amount of buckshot.  Effectively similar to no-longer-produced canister shot, but of lower quality.

120mm_usable_slug.name: reloaded 120mm slug
120mm_usable_slug.description: A makeshift, rebuilt 120mm shell with a new electric primer installed, loaded with a large handmade slug.  While hardly ideal, it packs quite a punch.

bp_120mm_usable_slug.name: makeshift 120mm slug, black powder
bp_120mm_usable_slug.description: A makeshift, rebuilt 120mm shell with a new electric primer installed, loaded with a large handmade slug.  While hardly ideal, it packs quite a punch.

120mm_usable_he_reloaded.name: reloaded 120mm HE
120mm_usable_he_reloaded.description: A makeshift, rebuilt 120mm shell with a new electric primer installed, loaded with a homemade explosive round.  Packs an explosive punch that could ruin anyone's whole day.

bp_120mm_usable_he_reloaded.name: reloaded 120mm HE, black powder
bp_120mm_usable_he_reloaded.description: A makeshift, rebuilt 120mm shell with a new electric primer installed, loaded with a homemade explosive round.  Packs an explosive punch that could ruin anyone's whole day.

155mm_heat.name: 155mm M712 HEAT
155mm_heat.description: A 155mm High Explosive Anti Tank round, normally laser-guided.  Separate-loading, it comes with the requisite fuze installed, a propellant bag, and percussion primer.  As its guidance feature requires a laser designator and has a minimum range of 3 kilometers, using it for direct fire is an astounding display of overkill.

155mm_frag.name: 155mm M795 frag
155mm_frag.description: A 155mm High Explosive Fragmentation round.  Separate-loading, it comes with the requisite fuze installed, a propellant bag, and percussion primer.  Designed to lob a heavy shell a long distance, using it direct-fire isn't exactly ideal, but it'll still give anything near what you hit a seriously bad time.

155mm_shot.name: makeshift 155mm shot
155mm_shot.description: A makeshift separate-loading shotshell for 155mm.  Consists of a canister of lead balls, a bag of propellant, and a replacement primer.  Effectively turns a howitzer into a punt gun on steroids.

bp_155mm_shot.name: makeshift 155mm shot, black powder
bp_155mm_shot.description: A makeshift separate-loading shotshell for 155mm.  Consists of a canister of lead balls, a bag of propellant, and a replacement primer.  Effectively turns a howitzer into a punt gun on steroids.

155mm_slug.name: makeshift 155mm slug
155mm_slug.description: A makeshift separate-loading round for 155mm.  Consists of a large lead ball, a bag of propellant, and a replacement primer.  Despite the lower effectiveness, whatever it hits is sure to feel it.

bp_155mm_slug.name: makeshift 155mm slug, black powder
bp_155mm_slug.description: A makeshift separate-loading round for 155mm.  Consists of a large lead ball, a bag of propellant, and a replacement primer.  Despite the lower effectiveness, whatever it hits is sure to feel it.

155mm_he_reloaded.name: reloaded 155mm HE
155mm_he_reloaded.description: A makeshift separate-loading HE round for 155mm.  Consists of a homemade explosive shell with fuze installed, a bag of propellant, and a replacement primer.  Using it for direct-fire isn't ideal, but it should be more than enough to ruin anyone's day.

bp_155mm_he_reloaded.name: reloaded 155mm HE, black powder
bp_155mm_he_reloaded.description: A makeshift separate-loading HE round for 155mm.  Consists of a homemade explosive shell with fuze installed, a bag of propellant, and a replacement primer.  Using it for direct-fire isn't ideal, but it should be more than enough to ruin anyone's day.

155mm_nuke.name: 155mm nuclear shell
155mm_nuke.description: A makeshift separate-loading round for 155mm, developed from experimental designs.  Uses a propellant bag and replacement primer to fire a modified mininuke, adapted to fit a howitzer.  Whatever would warrant such awesome firepower would best be engaged from a safe distance.

electric_primer_120mm.name: electric primer
electric_primer_120mm.description: Primer for a tank shell.  Seems to use an electric ignition.

primer_155mm.name: artillery primer
primer_155mm.description: Primer for an artillery shell.  Uses percussion ignition.

oxyacetylene.name: oxyacetylene
oxyacetylene.description: A highly explosive fuel mixture composed of equal parts of oxygen and acetylene gas.

battery.name: battery
battery.description: Some free-floating battery charge.  This can be reloaded into rechargable battery cells, but can never be unloaded.

aluminum_foil.name: aluminum foil
aluminum_foil.description: A thin foil made of aluminum.  Sometimes called 'tin foil' due to being made of tin in the past.

money.name: cent
money.description: IF YOU ARE SEEING THIS IT IS A BUG.

thread.name: thread
thread.description: A small quantity of thread that could be used to refill a sewing kit.

sinew.name: sinew
sinew.description: A tough sinew cut from a corpse, usable as thread.

plant_fibre.name: plant fiber
plant_fibre.description: Tough thin fiber, taken from a plant.  Can be used as thread.

yarn.name: yarn
yarn.description: Wool yarn, could be used to knit wool clothing.

soap.name: soap bar
soap.description: A cleansing agent made into bars.

duct_tape.name: duct tape
duct_tape.description: A roll of incredibly strong tape.  Its uses are innumerable.

rolling_paper.name: rolling paper
rolling_paper.description: These are thin paper strips intended for the rolling of cigarettes.

cable.name: copper wire
cable.description: Plastic jacketed copper cable of the type used in small electronics.

plut_cell.name: plutonium fuel cell
plut_cell.description: This power cell was designed to store enormous amounts of power, using plutonium-244 and now-irreplaceable compounds to make compact reactors more practical than ever.  Unfortunately it cannot be recharged by conventional means: expended cells had to be sent to a central reprocessing facility that almost certainly doesn't exist anymore.

plut_slurry_dense.name: plutonium slurry
plut_slurry_dense.description: Highly radioactive slurry.  It is probably best to get far away from this.

plut_slurry.name: watery plutonium slurry
plut_slurry.description: Highly radioactive slurry.  It is probably best to get far away from this.

rock.name: rock
rock.description: A rock the size of a baseball.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is also good for throwing at enemies.

pebble.name: pebble
pebble.description: A handful of pebbles, useful as ammunition for slings or slingshots.

pebble_clay.name: clay pellet
pebble_clay.description: A handful of round projectiles made of clay, useful for slings or slingshots.

marble.name: marble
marble.description: A handful of glass marbles, useful as ammunition for slings or slingshots.

bearing.name: bearings
bearing.description: A box of ball bearings, useful as ammunition for slings or slingshots.

bb.name: BB
bb.description: A box of small steel balls.  They deal virtually no damage.

feather.name: feather
feather.description: Feathers from a bird.  Useful for fletching arrows.

down_feather.name: down feather
down_feather.description: Fluffy down feathers from a bird.  Useful for making cozy bedclothes.

120mm_HEAT.name: 120mm HEAT
120mm_HEAT.description: A 120mm high-explosive anti-tank round.  It could ruin anyone's whole day.

plasma.name: hydrogen canister
plasma.description: A canister of pressurized hydrogen so heavily compressed it has turned solid.  With proper equipment, it could be heated to plasma.

c_hydrogen_gas.name: hydrogen gas
c_hydrogen_gas.description: A light, flammable gas compressed for use as fuel.  Requires a lot of energy to produce, even moreso without pre-cataclysm industry.  Quite energy dense, though not very volume-efficient.

smpistol_primer.name: small pistol primer
smpistol_primer.description: Primer from a small caliber pistol round.

lgpistol_primer.name: large pistol primer
lgpistol_primer.description: Primer from a large caliber pistol round.

smrifle_primer.name: small rifle primer
smrifle_primer.description: Primer from a small caliber rifle round.

lgrifle_primer.name: large rifle primer
lgrifle_primer.description: Primer from a large caliber rifle round.

rubber_slug.name: rubber slug
rubber_slug.description: Rubber slugs from a shotgun beanbag round.  You could use them to make new beanbag rounds, or sling them at people.

chunk_rubber.name: chunk of rubber
chunk_rubber.description: A chunk of useful rubber, can be molded easily.

copper.name: copper
copper.description: Copper scraps.  Could be used to craft something, for example makeshift shotgun shells.

medical_tape.name: medical tape
medical_tape.description: A roll of medical tape, similar to duct tape.

generic_no_ammo.name: placeholder ammunition
generic_no_ammo.description: IF YOU ARE SEEING THIS IT IS A BUG.

charcoal.name: charcoal
charcoal.description: A flammable carbon-based material produced by slowly burning wood.  Utilized in recipes requiring a pure, hot flame.  Can also be used in filters to remove contaminants out of air and water.

cac2powder.name: calcium carbide premix
cac2powder.description: A powdered mixture of coke and lime ready to be smelted into usable calcium carbide in an arc furnace.

coal_lump.name: coal
coal_lump.description: Flammable black chunks of carbon-based material commonly used for cooking and heating.

ampoule.name: RA21E medical ampoule
ampoule.description: A tiny glass vial filled with advanced fast-healing chemicals which can only be activated by a Rivtech jet injector device.  The packaged instructions describe its efficacy in dealing with infections, wounds, intoxications, envenomations, and general tiredness in enthusiastic detail.  A short safety section at the end warn - in much smaller typeface - against using more than two doses per hour.

stimpack_ammo.name: RA10K stimulant module
stimpack_ammo.description: A pressurized multi-chamber glass vial filled with powerful chemical stimulants which can only be activated by a Rivtech stimulant delivery system.

rebreather_filter.name: rebreather filter cartridge
rebreather_filter.description: A replacement filter cartridge for a rebreather.

gasfilter_s.name: filter mask cartridge
gasfilter_s.description: Small replacement filter cartridge for air filtration masks.

gasfilter_m.name: gas mask cartridge
gasfilter_m.description: Medium replacement filter cartridge for air filtration masks.

gasfilter_l.name: chemical mask cartridge
gasfilter_l.description: Heavy replacement filter cartridge for air filtration masks.

nicotine_liquid.name: nicotine liquid
nicotine_liquid.description: A liquid that is made up of propylene glycol, vegetable glycerin, flavorings and nicotine.

thc_liquid_unrefined.name: crude cannabis extract
thc_liquid_unrefined.description: An unrefined cannabis extract.  This slurry consists of butane, terpenes, and THC and is commonly referred to as BHO or butane hash oil.  This hasn't been properly purged yet, and can't be safely consumed.

thc_liquid.name: thc distillate
thc_liquid.description: A thick golden-amber colored liquid distillate containing cannabis terpenes and 90-99% THCA.  Perfect for vaping with a dab pen.

thc_wax.name: thc wax
thc_wax.description: An opaque, semi-solid cannabis concentrate, with wax-like consistency.  Its texture can vary from creamy (budder) to crumbly (honeycomb), making it suitable for dabbing.  This extract can generally reach 60-90% THCA.

fish_bait.name: fish bait
fish_bait.description: A bait used in traps to lure fish.

spiked_rocket.name: spiked homemade rocket
spiked_rocket.description: A hand built rocket, consisting of a spike welded onto a pipe that was filled with improvised rocket fuel.  Horribly inaccurate, as can be expected of this grade of weapon, but packs a fierce punch… if it hits.

explosive_hm_rocket.name: explosive homemade rocket
explosive_hm_rocket.description: A hand built rocket, consisting of a simple explosive warhead attached onto a pipe, filled with improvised rocket fuel.  Not very powerful, but can be made from scratch.

incendiary_hm_rocket.name: incendiary homemade rocket
incendiary_hm_rocket.description: A hand built rocket, consisting of a container of flammable gel attached onto a pipe, filled with improvised rocket fuel.  Short-range incendiary - handle with care!

unfinished_charcoal.name: unfinished charcoal
unfinished_charcoal.description: The result of an interrupted charcoal making process.  Useless, except as fuel in a charcoal kiln.

unfinished_cac2.name: unfinished calcium carbide
unfinished_cac2.description: The incomplete process of converting coal and lime into calcium carbide.  Useless in this state.

chain_link.name: chain link
chain_link.description: Small metal rings and wires for hand-made rivets, suitable for constructing chainmail.

nitrox.name: nitrox
nitrox.description: Mixture of oxygen and nitrogen in proportions suitable for diving.

tinder.name: tinder
tinder.description: Flammable material, finely divided for easy combustion.

RPG_die.name: RPG die
RPG_die.description: A die used to play various role-playing games.

metal_RPG_die.name: metal RPG die
metal_RPG_die.description: A metal die used to play various role-playing games

scrap_bronze.name: bronze
scrap_bronze.description: Decent-sized chunks of bronze, for fashioning some old-school items.

sling_bullet.name: sling bullet
sling_bullet.description: A ball of lead roughly the size of a baseball.  Traditionally thrown from a sling, and hits a lot harder than any old rock.

sling_bullet_small.name: small sling bullet
sling_bullet_small.description: A small ball of lead traditionally thrown from a sling.  It hits a lot harder than any old pebble.

atlatl_dart_wood.name: wooden atlatl dart
atlatl_dart_wood.description: A long, flexible dart for a spear-thrower, with a fire-hardened sharpened point.  Too thin and light to be very effective if thrown by hand.

atlatl_dart_iron.name: iron atlatl dart
atlatl_dart_iron.description: A long, flexible dart for a spear-thrower, with an iron spear point.  Too thin and light to be very effective if thrown by hand.

atlatl_dart_stone.name: stone atlatl dart
atlatl_dart_stone.description: A long, flexible dart for a spear-thrower, with a small stone spearhead.  Too thin and light to be very effective if thrown by hand.

atlatl_dart_copper.name: copper atlatl dart
atlatl_dart_copper.description: A long, flexible dart for a spear-thrower, with a copper spear point.  Too thin and light to be very effective if thrown by hand.

anesthetic.name: anesthetic
anesthetic.description: A variety of powerful hypnotic, analgesic, and stimulative drugs.  It's intended for use in specialized medical equipment, and can't be administered manually.  You can reload an anesthesia kit with it.

chem_sulphur.name: sulfur
chem_sulphur.description: A handful of pure sulfur.  Primarily used to make battery acid, sulfur is sometimes used as fuel for explosives.  Can be burned to produce acidic smoke, that is deadly to bacteria and humans alike, or oxidized to make paper-bleaching agents.

chunk_sulfur.name: chunk of sulfur
chunk_sulfur.description: A chunk of pure sulfur.  Break it up to use it.  Slinging it at someone might give their eyes some nasty burns.

material_cement.name: cement
material_cement.description: Portland is most likely long gone, but its memory persists in cement.  This ubiquitous binder can be used for all kinds of advanced masonry.  Just add water.

material_limestone.name: limestone
material_limestone.description: A handful of small chunks of limestone.  Useful for experiments at science fairs, or fired out of a slingshot.  Maybe something could be crafted from this stuff…

material_quicklime.name: quicklime
material_quicklime.description: The product of burning limestone, this white powder is a crucial ingredient in making cement.  That said, it is also extremely caustic and will cause severe burns to any tissue it comes in contact with.  This property could probably be exploited.

material_sand.name: sand
material_sand.description: A handful of New England sand.  If you had a stoked furnace, you could turn it into glass or cement.  Otherwise, it's only good for sanding wood.

material_soil.name: soil
material_soil.description: A pile of loosely packed, slightly damp loamy soil.  This mixture of sand, silt and clay is ideal for growing plants.

bleach.name: bleach
bleach.description: This is sodium hypochlorite, a common household cleaning agent.  It is highly unsafe to drink.

ammonia.name: ammonia
ammonia.description: This is ammonium hydroxide, a common household cleaning agent.  It is highly unsafe to drink.

fertilizer_liquid.name: liquid fertilizer
fertilizer_liquid.description: A nutrient rich elixir for plants.

insecticide.name: insecticide
insecticide.description: Agricultural-grade chemical insecticide powder designed to eradicate insect pests.

salt_water.name: salt water
salt_water.description: Water with salt added.  Not good for drinking.

soapy_water.name: soapy water
soapy_water.description: Water with soap added.  Not good for drinking.

sewage.name: sewage sample
sewage.description: A sample of sewage from a treatment plant.  Gross.

chem_aluminium_powder.name: aluminum powder
chem_aluminium_powder.description: A handful of finely ground aluminum powder.  This strong reducing agent was used in combination with various oxidants for chemical welding and explosives alike.  Just before the Cataclysm, however, it was the basis of virtually all commercial metallic-hued paints and anti-corrosive coatings.

chem_zinc.name: zinc oxide
chem_zinc.description: A handful of zinc oxide.  It can be reduced into zinc, or used for some other reactions of its own.

chem_manganese_dioxide.name: manganese dioxide
chem_manganese_dioxide.description: A handful of manganese dioxide powder.  Occurring naturally in the mineral pyrolusite, it is used commercially in the production of alkaline and zinc-carbon batteries.

chem_potassium_chloride.name: potassium chloride
chem_potassium_chloride.description: A handful of potassium chloride.  Although it occurs naturally in the mineral sylvite, it can be produced as a byproduct of the reaction of saltpeter and hydrochloric acid.  It can be used for making fertilizer, or potassium hydroxide by way of electrolysis.

chem_potassium_hydroxide.name: potassium hydroxide
chem_potassium_hydroxide.description: A handful of potassium hydroxide.  Commonly called caustic potash, it was mainly used industrially for its caustic nature.  It can be used as an electrolyte in alkaline batteries, among other applications.

chem_sulphuric_acid.name: sulfuric acid
chem_sulphuric_acid.description: Sulfuric acid: viscous, foul-smelling and extremely corrosive, particularly to organic matter and evil clowns.  Although used to prepare a number of chemicals, it is mostly known as battery acid, due to its widest commercial application.

chem_muriatic_acid.name: hydrochloric acid
chem_muriatic_acid.description: Hydrochloric acid, also known as muriatic acid.  It is a strong acid that has a distinctive smell, important and frequently used ever since its discovery.  It still has a vast multitude of uses.

chem_nitric_acid.name: nitric acid
chem_nitric_acid.description: Nitric acid, a strong oxidant and extremely corrosive material.  Mainly used in the production of synthetic fertilizers, for etching of circuit boards and in woodworking.  Remains quite useful both for making a vast array of pyrotechnic and explosive agents and as a direct weapon: not many beings enjoy being doused in nitric acid.

chem_chromium_oxide.name: chromium oxide
chem_chromium_oxide.description: A handful of chromium oxide.  This substance, typically known as the only stable green pigment for paints, is also a mild oxidizer, which can be mixed with aluminum powder to make thermite for welding.  If one had access to a CVD machine and a laboratory worth of reagents, they might be able to produce very durable ceramic layers.

chem_carbide.name: calcium carbide
chem_carbide.description: A handful of calcium carbide, giving off a faint, garlic-like smell.  Commercially, calcium carbide was used for on-the-spot manufacture of acetylene and historically to power acetylene lamps.  If mixed with water and sealed, it will explode with little strength, but with relatively loud noise and could maybe be used as a decoy.

chem_hexamine.name: hexamine
chem_hexamine.description: A handful of waxy hexamine tablets.  This ubiquitous fuel was used to start up almost every garden grill and no 'real' camping trip could do its cooking without it, until the Cataclysm.  Nowadays, it is even more valuable than before, being the key component in the preparation of several military-grade explosives.

chem_hydrogen_peroxide_conc.name: hydrogen peroxide (concentrated)
chem_hydrogen_peroxide_conc.description: Concentrated hydrogen peroxide is a powerful oxidant, violently decomposing in contact with most reducing agents.  Can be used as rocket fuel or to make high explosives.  Causes severe burns to any organic matter and may ignite it on contact.

chem_ammonium_nitrate.name: ammonium nitrate
chem_ammonium_nitrate.description: Some ammonium nitrate.  This white, crystalline powder is commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?

chem_ammonium_nitrate_pellets.name: ammonium nitrate pellets
chem_ammonium_nitrate_pellets.description: Some ammonium nitrate pellets.  These pellets are commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?

chem_saltpetre.name: saltpeter
chem_saltpetre.description: A handful of saltpeter.  Sometimes used as a fertilizer, this ubiquitous nitrate is the principal constituent of black gunpowder and simple rocket propellants, such as rocket candy.

material_niter.name: niter
material_niter.description: A large crystal of niter, the mineral form of potassium nitrate.  It can be processed into saltpeter.

chem_aluminium_sulphate.name: aluminum sulfate
chem_aluminium_sulphate.description: Several crystals of aluminum sulfate.  Historically, an agent for purifying water and as molluscicide, due to the fact that it degenerates their slime.  Just before the Cataclysm, its main uses were for adjusting the acidity of the soil and as an additive to baking powder.  If mixed with a strong acid, it could be used to saturate the soil with aluminum, causing all but the most resistant of plants to wither and die.

chem_acetic_acid.name: acetic acid
chem_acetic_acid.description: Concentrated acetic acid, typically used as a chemical reagent and antifungal agent.  Despite its horrid smell, it was used to prepare several types of perfumes, but would making perfume not be too fancy for postapocalyptic New England?

chem_formaldehyde.name: formaldehyde
chem_formaldehyde.description: Formaldehyde, here dissolved in water, was widely used before the Cataclysm as a precursor to production of many chemicals and materials and as an embalming agent.  Easily identifiable by its pungent odor.  Terribly toxic, carcinogenic, and volatile.

chem_thermite.name: thermite
chem_thermite.description: A handful of silvery-greenish powder, produced by mixing aluminum and chromium oxide.  This mixture, burning at a constant pace and at extremely high temperature, was once used for on-the-spot welding.  Can be used as an incendiary material in a pinch.

chem_anfo.name: ANFO
chem_anfo.description: Several brownish pellets that were made by absorbing organic fuel on ammonium nitrate.  This ammonium nitrate-fuel oil or ANFO, as it is called, mixture is a common industrial explosive due to its stability and low price.  Burns fast, but needs an explosive primer to detonate.

chem_black_powder.name: black gunpowder
chem_black_powder.description: A handful of black gunpowder, made by mixing charcoal and sulfur with saltpeter.  Pretty useless for making modern cartridges, as the soot produced when it burns will quickly clog any firearm, but it could be used to make some vicious bombs.

chem_match_head_powder.name: match head powder
chem_match_head_powder.description: Some match head powder from match heads, similar to black gunpowder but a bit weaker.  It can be used in crafting explosives and fuses when other more suitable candidates are less available.

chem_rdx.name: RDX
chem_rdx.description: Several off-white crystals of RDX or hexogen: a military-grade, shelf-stable high explosive.  Can be cast into shaped charges or mixed with scrap to pepper the blast area with high-velocity shrapnel.

chem_compositionb.name: composition b
chem_compositionb.description: Composition B is an explosive consisting of castable mixtures of RDX and TNT.  It is used as the main explosive filling in artillery projectiles, rockets, land mines, hand grenades and various other munitions.

chem_hmtd.name: HMTD
chem_hmtd.description: Hexamine peroxide: this fine, yellowish powder is a powerful primary explosive, used to initiate detonation of more stable explosives, such as RDX.  Relatively stable, but best not store it for too long.

chem_rocket_fuel.name: rocket fuel
chem_rocket_fuel.description: A mixture of fuel, oxidizer, and binder that provides a controlled burn, usable as solid rocket fuel.  Commercial-grade mixtures tend to be zinc powder and sulfur.

water_sewage.name: sewage water
water_sewage.description: Turbid liquid from the sewers with awful stench.

detergent.name: detergent
detergent.description: A popular pre-Cataclysm washing powder.  It is used for chemistry experiments such as manufacturing gelled gasoline.

soap_flakes.name: soap flakes
soap_flakes.description: A bar of soap cut into flakes.

lye.name: lye
lye.description: This is a liquid form of sodium hydroxide.  It is highly corrosive, handle with care.

nanomaterial.name: nanomaterial canister
nanomaterial.description: Steel canisters containing carbon, iron, titanium, copper and other elements in specifically engineered atomic scale configurations.  A nanofabricator can assemble them into usable items.

ash.name: wood ash
ash.description: This is almost weightless residue left after the burning of some substance.

ether.name: ether
ether.description: Diethyl ether largely supplanted the use of chloroform as a general anesthetic due to ether's more favorable therapeutic index, that is, a greater difference between an effective dose and a potentially toxic dose.

chem_chloroform.name: chloroform
chem_chloroform.description: Famous for its abilities as an illicit sedative, this substance is also a very good solvent.  In particular, it's used a lot in nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy.

chem_phenol.name: phenol
chem_phenol.description: This useful stuff is a potent solvent and has a wide range of reactive applications.  It can be used to make a huge number of plastics and polymers, it can be an antiseptic, it can strip paint and break down epoxy, and it can burn your skin away like tissue paper under a heat gun.  Wear gloves.

nuclear_waste.name: nuclear waste
nuclear_waste.description: A pellet of silvery metal, still warm to the touch.

nuclear_fuel.name: nuclear fuel pellet
nuclear_fuel.description: A small pellet of fissile material.  Handle carefully.

wooden_bead.name: wooden bead
wooden_bead.description: This is a wooden bead.  It can be used to craft inscribable jewelry or create a beaded curtain door.

rennet.name: rennet
rennet.description: Enzymes used to curdle milk, for making cheese.  Traditionally made from the stomachs of ruminant animals.

chem_ethanol.name: ethanol
chem_ethanol.description: Extremely pure alcohol suitable for use as a component in chemical reactions.  You could also water it down and drink it, or use it as fuel in alcohol-burning stoves.

denat_alcohol.name: denatured alcohol
denat_alcohol.description: A high-strength ethanol solution mixed with methanol to make it toxic to drink, so as to avoid pre-apocalyptic regulations on ethanol.  Intended for use in alcohol-burning stoves and as a solvent.

chem_methanol.name: methanol
chem_methanol.description: High purity methanol suitable for use in chemical reactions.  Could be used in alcohol-burning stoves.  Very toxic.

diesel.name: diesel
diesel.description: Petroleum-based fuel made from a byproduct of the gasoline making process.

jp8.name: JP8 fuel
jp8.description: A kerosene-based fuel used mainly by US military vehicles as a replacement for diesel and jet fuel, to simplify logistics.

avgas.name: avgas fuel
avgas.description: A specialized type of petroleum-based fuel used to power aircraft.

biodiesel.name: biodiesel
biodiesel.description: Vegetable oil- or animal fat-based diesel fuel consisting of long-chain alkyl (methyl, ethyl, or propyl) esters.

gasoline.name: gasoline
gasoline.description: Gasoline is a highly flammable liquid.  When under pressure, it has the potential for violent explosion.

lamp_oil.name: lamp oil
lamp_oil.description: A thin and clean-burning oil made for use in oil lamps.

motor_oil.name: motor oil
motor_oil.description: An oil made for use in car engines.

napalm.name: napalm
napalm.description: This is gasoline mixed with some other components to make it stick to the surface and increase burning temperature, meant to be used with a flamethrower.

gelled_gasoline.name: gelled gasoline
gelled_gasoline.description: A flammable gel composed of gasoline and a chemical that renders it to a gel, it is roughly similar in properties to napalm b.  It's meant to be used with a flamethrower.

flamethrower_fuel.name: flamethrower fuel
flamethrower_fuel.description: A mixture of gasoline and diesel oil in equal parts.  Its combustion properties make it unfit for applications where you would use any of them separately, but it can be used to feed a flamethrower.

chem_butane.name: butane
chem_butane.description: A flammable natural gas product typically used in lighters, stored as a pressurized liquid.  It could be useful as a fuel, but also as a solvent or chemical reagent.

pitch_wood.name: pitch
pitch_wood.description: Sticky resin made from pine or birch tar.  Can be used for waterproofing or holding together small items, or for improvised repairs with the right tools.  When dried further it's known as rosin, often used as flux for solder.

pouch_autoclave.name: autoclave pouch
pouch_autoclave.description: This is a medical device that bears the approval of the FDA (Food and Drug Administration).  If used properly, these pouches can keep things sterile indefinitely.

shrapnel.name: shrapnel
shrapnel.description: A twisted shard of jagged metal.

blun_slug.name: blunderbuss slug
blun_slug.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of a large hunk of metal.  Better for distance.

blun_shot.name: blunderbuss shot
blun_shot.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of marbles, pebbles, bearings, basically whatever is at hand.  The homemade pellet spread and number makes up for the shoddy quality.

blun_flechette.name: blunderbuss flechette
blun_flechette.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of homemade flechette made out of nails.  Shreds armor.

arrow_fire_hardened_fletched.name: crude wooden arrow
arrow_fire_hardened_fletched.description: A crude pointed wooden shaft with a notch at the back.  Stands a very low chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_field_point_fletched.name: wooden bodkin arrow
arrow_field_point_fletched.description: A fletched wooden arrow shaft with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_plastic.name: wooden rubber blunt arrow
arrow_plastic.description: A fletched wooden arrow shaft with a blunt rubber tip.  Can stun weaker enemies.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_small_game_fletched.name: simple wooden small game arrow
arrow_small_game_fletched.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with a blunted tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_wood.name: wooden broadhead arrow
arrow_wood.description: A fletched wooden arrow shaft with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximizing damage to the target.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_heavy_fire_hardened_fletched.name: simple fire-hardened arrow
arrow_heavy_fire_hardened_fletched.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with a fire-hardened and sharpened tip.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_heavy_field_point_fletched.name: wooden small game arrow
arrow_heavy_field_point_fletched.description: A fletched wooden arrow shaft with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_wood_heavy.name: makeshift field point arrow
arrow_wood_heavy.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with a makeshift arrowhead.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_stinger.name: stinger arrow
arrow_stinger.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with an arrowhead carved from a mutated insect stinger.  It poisons enemies it hits and stands a somewhat low chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_triffid.name: triffid arrow
arrow_triffid.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with an arrowhead carved from an alien plants stinger.  It paralyzes enemies it hits and stands a somewhat low chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_tooth.name: sharktooth arrow
arrow_tooth.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with an arrowhead carved from a serrated tooth.  It stands a somewhat low chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_metal_sharpened_fletched.name: simple metal arrow
arrow_metal_sharpened_fletched.description: A simple fletched steel arrow shaft with a flattened and sharpened tip.  Stands a somewhat low chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_metal.name: aluminum broadhead arrow
arrow_metal.description: A fletched aluminum arrow shaft with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximizing damage to the target.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_metal_bodkin.name: aluminum field point arrow
arrow_metal_bodkin.description: A fletched aluminum arrow shaft with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_metal_target.name: aluminum small game arrow
arrow_metal_target.description: A fletched aluminum arrow shaft with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_cf.name: carbon fiber hunting arrow
arrow_cf.description: A fletched carbon fiber arrow shaft with an expanding broadhead tip.  Deals impressive damage to targets, but less effective against armor.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

arrow_exploding.name: explosive arrow
arrow_exploding.description: This arrow has a small IED strapped to its tip.  Horribly inaccurate, heavy, and bulky, not only does this contraption require expert hands to pull off a shot, it requires one to loose this with a small measure of confidence that the shooter won't be caught in the blast radius.

arrow_flamming.name: flaming arrow
arrow_flamming.description: This arrow has a flaming rag wrapped around the shaft near the head.  You should shoot it soon before it burns your bow.

bolt_crude.name: crude wooden bolt
bolt_crude.description: A crude pointed wooden crossbow bolt with a notch at the back.  Stands a very low chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_simple_wood.name: simple fire-hardened bolt
bolt_simple_wood.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a fire-hardened and sharpened tip.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_simple_small_game.name: simple wooden small game bolt
bolt_simple_small_game.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a blunted tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_makeshift.name: makeshift field point bolt
bolt_makeshift.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a makeshift head.  Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_wood.name: wooden broadhead bolt
bolt_wood.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximising damage to the target.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_wood_bodkin.name: wooden bodkin bolt
bolt_wood_bodkin.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_wood_small_game.name: wooden small game bolt
bolt_wood_small_game.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_stinger.name: stinger bolt
bolt_stinger.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a tip carved from a mutated insect stinger.  It poisons enemies it hits and stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_triffid.name: triffid bolt
bolt_triffid.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a tip carved from an alien plants stinger.  It paralyzes enemies it hits and stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_tooth.name: sharktooth bolt
bolt_tooth.description: A simple fletched crossbow bolt shaft with a tip carved from a serrated tooth.  It stands a somewhat low chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_metal.name: simple metal bolt
bolt_metal.description: A simple fletched steel crossbow bolt with a flattened and sharpened tip.  Stands a somewhat low chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_steel.name: aluminum broadhead bolt
bolt_steel.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximising damage to the target.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_steel_bodkin.name: aluminum field point bolt
bolt_steel_bodkin.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_steel_target.name: aluminum small game bolt
bolt_steel_target.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_cf.name: carbon fiber hunting bolt
