bolt_cf.description: A fletched carbon fiber crossbow bolt shaft with an expanding broadhead tip.  Deals impressive damage to targets, but less effective against armor.  Stands a good chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolt_explosive.name: explosive crossbow bolt
bolt_explosive.description: A lightweight, sharpened bolt made from some kind of metal.  It is fairly unwieldy and only provides moderate accuracy, due to being filled with explosives and fitted with an impact trigger.

ammo_ballista_wood.name: wooden ballista bolt
ammo_ballista_wood.description: A thick wooden projectile sharpened at one end, not much longer than an arrow but much heavier.   Stands a low chance of remaining intact once fired.

ammo_ballista_iron.name: iron ballista bolt
ammo_ballista_iron.description: A thick wooden projectile not much longer than an arrow, tipped with a heavy iron point.   Stands a decent chance of remaining intact once fired.

ammo_ballista_copper.name: copper ballista bolt
ammo_ballista_copper.description: A thick wooden projectile not much longer than an arrow, tipped with a heavy copper point.   Stands a somewhat low chance of remaining intact once fired.

fishspear.name: wooden fishing spear
fishspear.description: An underwater fishing spear made from wood tipped with steel.  It's very light, but doesn't have much range.  Stands a below average chance of remaining intact once fired.

c_fishspear.name: carbon fiber fishing spear
c_fishspear.description: An underwater fishing spear made from carbon fiber.  It's very light, but doesn't have much range.  Stands a bad chance of remaining intact once fired.

m_fishspear.name: metal fishing spear
m_fishspear.description: An underwater fishing spear made from metal.  It's light, but doesn't have much range.  Stands a very good chance of remaining intact once fired.

bolas.name: bolas
bolas.description: Some ropes with weights, designed to tangle the legs of a target when thrown, usually at an animal.  Used by the Gauchos of Argentina.

bola_cartridge.name: bola cartridge
bola_cartridge.description: A single-use cartridge that fires a bola and leaves the ropes to tangle the target.

net.name: net
net.description: A mesh of string and weights, traditionally used to catch fish, and to entangle opponents in combat.

net_cartridge.name: net cartridge
net_cartridge.description: A disposable cartridge that launches a weighted net and lets its ropes do the tying.

throwing_stick.name: throwing stick
throwing_stick.description: A stick carved into a shape suitable for throwing at a target.  Not a boomerang, so don't expect it to return to your hand.

chem_potassium_alum.name: potassium alum
chem_potassium_alum.description: Small water-soluble white crystals with watery metallic odor, historically used for many different purposes.  Also known as potash alum and potassium aluminum sulfate; often called simply alum, as it's the most important member of the generic class of compounds called alums.

dye_powder.name: cloth dye powder
dye_powder.description: This is a powdered colorful cloth dye, which can be used to dye many fabrics if combined with water and some mordant.

glass_shard.name: glass shard
glass_shard.description: A broken shard of glass covered in sharp edges.  With a piece of rag you could use it to make it a primitive weapon.

scrap.name: scrap metal
scrap.description: A bulky assortment of small bits of scrap steel useful in all kinds of crafting.

bismuth.name: bismuth
bismuth.description: A dense but brittle metal often used as an alternative to lead.

gold_small.name: gold
gold_small.description: A soft shiny metal.  Before the apocalypse this would've been worth a small fortune but now its value is greatly diminished.

platinum_small.name: platinum
platinum_small.description: A soft shiny metal.  Before the apocalypse this would've been worth a small fortune but now its value is greatly diminished.

zinc_metal.name: zinc
zinc_metal.description: A slightly brittle metal.  Apart from being an essential mineral that the body needs, it reacts readily with acids, alkalis and other non-metals.  It can be crushed to make zinc powder, used in the production of batteries, among other things.

lead.name: lead
lead.description: A soft dull metal known since ancient times.  Due to its malleability it has a wide variety of uses including the manufacture of ammunition.

magnesium.name: magnesium powder
magnesium.description: A gray powder composed of the highly flammable alkaline earth metal magnesium.  Useful for constructing flares and similar items.

silver_small.name: silver
silver_small.description: A soft shiny metal.  Before the Cataclysm it was worth quite a bit but its value is now greatly diminished.

steel_chunk.name: chunk of steel
steel_chunk.description: A misshapen chunk of steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

steel_lump.name: lump of steel
steel_lump.description: A heavy formed piece of steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

hinge.name: door hinge
hinge.description: A small metal hinge with two metal plates with screw holes.  Useful for making doors.

tin.name: tin
tin.description: Tin can be used to make solder and for lining containers to prevent corrosion.

solder_wire.name: solder
solder_wire.description: A small spool of solder, able to be used in ammunition and electronics.

incendiary.name: incendiary
incendiary.description: Material from an incendiary round, useful in constructing incendiary ammunition.

fuse.name: fuse
fuse.description: A piece of fuse, long enough to give you enough time to get away from most explosions.

dna.name: DNA
dna.description: The DNA sample of some living creature.  This can be used in a cloning vat, together with a sterile artificial womb, to create a copy of the creature.

biomaterial.name: universal growth medium
biomaterial.description: A heavily processed nutrient liquid, containing the basic building blocks of life.  A genome workstation could take a stored sample off a USB drive, and convert this raw material into viable DNA for cloning.

laser_pack.name: fusion pack
laser_pack.description: In the middle of the 21st Century, military powers began to look towards energy based weapons.  The result was the standard fusion pack, capable of delivering bolts of superheated gas at near light speed with no recoil.

reloaded_laser_pack.name: bootleg fusion pack
reloaded_laser_pack.description: In the middle of the 21st Century, military powers began to look towards energy based weapons.  The result was the standard fusion pack, capable of delivering bolts of superheated gas at near light speed with no recoil.  This one has been hand-crafted from spare parts.

sole_rubber.name: rubber sole
sole_rubber.description: This is a sole made from rubber, usually found on the bottoms of boots.  Can be used for making actual boots.

chem_acetone.name: acetone
chem_acetone.description: Acetone, best known as the primary constituent of most nail polish removers.  Flammable and can be easily used for potent home-made explosives.

rosin.name: rosin
rosin.description: This is a chunk of yellowish rosin, usable as a flux for soldering.

belt25mm.name: 25x137mm ammo belt
belt25mm.description: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which disintegrate upon firing.

light_minus_battery_cell.name: ultra-light battery
light_minus_battery_cell.description: This is a light battery cell designed for small size over everything else.  It retains its universal compatibility, though.

light_minus_atomic_battery_cell.name: ultra-light plutonium battery
light_minus_atomic_battery_cell.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 and exotic nanocompound from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It is universally compatible with small devices.  It stores a huge amount of power, but cannot be recharged by external means, instead it steadily self-charges over time.

light_minus_disposable_cell.name: ultra-light disposable battery
light_minus_disposable_cell.description: This is a light battery cell designed for small size over everything else.  It retains its universal compatibility, though.  The battery's chemistry means that it has a very high capacity, but cannot be recharged.

light_battery_cell.name: light battery
light_battery_cell.description: This is a light battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of small devices.

light_plus_battery_cell.name: light battery (high-capacity)
light_plus_battery_cell.description: This is a high-capacity light battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of small devices.

light_atomic_battery_cell.name: light plutonium battery
light_atomic_battery_cell.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 and exotic nanocompound from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of personal electronic devices.  It stores a huge amount of power, but cannot be recharged by external means, instead it steadily self-charges over time.

light_disposable_cell.name: light disposable battery
light_disposable_cell.description: This is a light battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of small devices.  The battery's chemistry means that it has a very high capacity, but cannot be recharged.

medium_battery_cell.name: medium battery
medium_battery_cell.description: This is a medium battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of appliances and power tools.

medium_plus_battery_cell.name: medium battery (high-capacity)
medium_plus_battery_cell.description: This is a high-capacity medium battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of appliances and power tools.

medium_atomic_battery_cell.name: medium plutonium battery
medium_atomic_battery_cell.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 and exotic nanocompound from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of appliances and power tools.  It stores a huge amount of power, but cannot be recharged by external means, instead it steadily self-charges over time.

medium_disposable_cell.name: medium disposable battery
medium_disposable_cell.description: This is a medium battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of appliances and power tools.  The battery's chemistry means that it has a very high capacity, but cannot be recharged.

heavy_battery_cell.name: heavy battery
heavy_battery_cell.description: This is a heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.

heavy_plus_battery_cell.name: heavy battery (high-capacity)
heavy_plus_battery_cell.description: This is a high-capacity heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.

heavy_atomic_battery_cell.name: heavy plutonium battery
heavy_atomic_battery_cell.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 and exotic nanocompound from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.  It stores a huge amount of power, but cannot be recharged by external means, instead it steadily self-charges over time.

huge_atomic_battery_cell.name: military plutonium fuel cell
huge_atomic_battery_cell.description: This battery uses a thin plutonium-244 and exotic nanocompound from repurposed plutonium fission cells.  It was used in military mech-suits, was highly experimental, and had no civilian applications.  It stores a stupendous amount of power, but cannot be recharged by external means, instead it steadily self-charges over time.

heavy_disposable_cell.name: heavy disposable battery
heavy_disposable_cell.description: This is a heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.  The battery's chemistry means that it has a very high capacity, but cannot be recharged.

glock20mag.name: Glock 20 magazine
glock20mag.description: A compact light-weight steel and polymer magazine for use with Glock pistols chambered for 10mm Auto.

glock20bigmag.name: Glock 20 extended magazine
glock20bigmag.description: An extended 30-round polymer magazine for the Glock 20.

glock20drum50rd.name: Glock 20 50-round drum magazine
glock20drum50rd.description: Made to fit the Glock 20.  This drum magazine holds 50 rounds.

hk_g80mag.name: H&K G80 magazine
hk_g80mag.description: A magazine for H&K G80 railgun which can hold up to 20 ferromagnetic projectiles.

20x66_10_mag.name: RMSA10 20x66mm compact magazine
20x66_10_mag.description: A 10 round box magazine for use with the RM228 PDW and RM121 auxiliary shotgun.

20x66_20_mag.name: RMSB20 20x66mm magazine
20x66_20_mag.description: A 20 round box magazine for use with the RM20 caseless shotgun.

20x66_40_mag.name: RMSB40 20x66mm extended magazine
20x66_40_mag.description: A 40 round box magazine for use with the RM20 caseless shotgun.

22_speedloader8.name: .22 8-round speedloader

9mm_speedloader6.description: This speedloader can hold 6 rounds of 9x19mm Parabellum and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

pressurized_tank_chem.name: pressurized chemical tank
pressurized_tank_chem.description: A makeshift pressurized 2L canister designed to feed a makeshift chemical thrower.

pressurized_tank.name: pressurized fuel tank
pressurized_tank.description: A pressurized 3L canister designed to feed a flamethrower.

aux_pressurized_tank.name: small pressurized fuel tank
aux_pressurized_tank.description: A pressurized 0.5L canister built for use with a small auxiliary flamethrower.

rm4502.name: RM450-2 fuel canister
rm4502.description: A 2L pressurized steel canister with a valve designed for the RM451's feed system.

rm4504.name: RM450-4 fuel canister
rm4504.description: A 4L pressurized steel canister with a valve designed for the RM451's feed system.

nailmag.name: nail rifle magazine
nailmag.description: An improvised magazine for use with a nail rifle.  Little more than a tin can, spring and some duct tape it is awkward to reload and not especially reliable.

saiga10mag.name: Saiga-12 box magazine
saiga10mag.description: A removable plastic magazine for the Saiga-12 shotgun.  Holds 10 rounds.

saiga30mag.name: Saiga-12 drum magazine
saiga30mag.description: A removable plastic magazine for the Saiga-12 shotgun.  Holds 30 rounds.

USAS10mag.name: USAS-12 box magazine
USAS10mag.description: A removable plastic magazine for the USAS-12 shotgun.  Holds 10 rounds.

USAS20mag.name: USAS-12 drum magazine
USAS20mag.description: A removable plastic magazine for the USAS-12 shotgun.  Holds 20 rounds.

shotbelt_20.name: shotshell belt
shotbelt_20.description: A non-disintegrating cloth ammo belt which can hold up to 20 shotgun shells.  Notably less reliable than metal ammo belts.

shot_speedloader6.name: shotgun 6-round tube speedloader
shot_speedloader6.description: A plastic tube with a sliding handle that can be used to quickly load 6 rounds into a shotgun's tube in a much shorter period of time than by hand.  It needs to interface with a chute to be used with any speed.

shot_speedloader8.name: shotgun 8-round tube speedloader
shot_speedloader8.description: A plastic tube with a sliding handle that can be used to quickly load 8 rounds into a shotgun's tube in a much shorter period of time than by hand.  It needs to interface with a chute to be used with any speed.

tinyweldtank.name: small welding tank
tinyweldtank.description: A compact steel cylinder designed for holding pressurized welding gases.  It is marked with several faded and now unreadable symbols.

weldtank.name: welding tank
weldtank.description: A large steel cylinder designed for holding pressurized welding gases.  It is marked with several faded and now unreadable symbols.

battery_car.name: car battery
battery_car.description: A 12v lead-acid battery used to power car electrical systems.

battery_motorbike.name: motorbike battery
battery_motorbike.description: A 12v lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.

battery_motorbike_small.name: small motorbike battery
battery_motorbike_small.description: A miniature 12v lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.

large_storage_battery.name: very large storage battery
large_storage_battery.description: A huge storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Holds a tremendous amount of energy.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.

medium_storage_battery.name: medium storage battery
medium_storage_battery.description: A medium storage battery containing multiple lithium-ion cells.

sea_scooter_battery.name: sea scooter battery
sea_scooter_battery.description: A medium storage battery customized to fit specifically inside the hull of a sea scooter. It also weighs less.

small_storage_battery.name: small storage battery
small_storage_battery.description: A small storage battery created with pre-Cataclysm lithium-ion technology.  Useful for crafting.

storage_battery.name: large storage battery
storage_battery.description: A large storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.

fuel_bunker.name: fuel bunker
fuel_bunker.description: A bin for holding solid fuel.

famasmag.name: MAS 223 magazine
famasmag.description: A 25-round magazine for the MAS 223.  It resembles a STANAG magazine but is not compatible nor interchangeable.

ammo_pouch.name: ammo satchel
ammo_pouch.description: A small pouch that can be used to store most types of small ammunition, rockets will not fit.  Activate to store ammunition.

ammo_satchel.name: magazine satchel
ammo_satchel.description: A fabric ammo bag worn at the waist which is capable of holding two magazines, ammo belts, speedloaders of nearly any size close at hand.

chestpouch.name: chest magazine pouch
chestpouch.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your chest which is capable of holding two magazines or speedloaders close at hand.

chestrig.name: chest rig
chestrig.description: Popularized during the Vietnam War, chest rigs like these are typically plain, barebones affairs consisting of three or more pouches in a row, with straps to secure them on your chest.  This one can hold four magazines or speedloaders in its pouches.

javelin_bag.name: javelin bag
javelin_bag.description: An open medieval-looking bag, designed to store javelins for easy reach.

legpouch.name: ankle magazine pouch
legpouch.description: A small fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your ankle which is capable of holding a single small magazine or speedloader close at hand.

legpouch_large.name: leg magazine pouch
legpouch_large.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your leg and capable of holding two magazines close at hand.

mag_satchel_leg.name: leg magazine satchel
mag_satchel_leg.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to the leg, capable of holding a single magazine, ammo belt, or speedloader of modest size.

quiver.name: quiver
quiver.description: A leather quiver worn at the waist that can hold 20 arrows.  Activate to store arrows.

quiver_birchbark.name: birchbark quiver
quiver_birchbark.description: A quiver woven from strips of birch bark, worn at the waist, that can hold 20 arrows.  Activate to store arrows.

quiver_large.name: large quiver
quiver_large.description: A large leather quiver trimmed with metal, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows.  Historically used by horse archers, rather than foot archers, but neither of THEM had to fight zombies.  Activate to store arrows.

quiver_large_birchbark.name: large birchbark quiver
quiver_large_birchbark.description: A large quiver woven from strips of birchbark, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows.  Activate to store arrows.

quiver_atlatl.name: atlatl dart quiver
quiver_atlatl.description: A leather quiver worn at the waist, lengthened to hold atlatl darts.  Activate to store up to 10 darts.

quiver_birchbark_atlatl.name: birchbark atlatl dart quiver
quiver_birchbark_atlatl.description: A quiver woven from strips of birch bark, worn at the waist, lengthened to hold atlatl darts.  Activate to store up to 10 darts.

tacvest.name: tac vest
tacvest.description: This light vest is meant to carry your gear and ammunition comfortably distributed about your torso.  They are popular amongst law enforcement, but less so than combination tactical vests incorporating Kevlar.  Lightweight and easy to don, this vest can hold four magazines close at hand in its many pouches.

ammo_satchel_leg.name: leg ammo satchel
ammo_satchel_leg.description: A small pouch wrapped around the leg that can be used to store most types of small ammunition, rockets will not fit.  Activate to store ammunition.

shoulder_pouch.name: shoulder magazine pouch
shoulder_pouch.description: A shoulder pouch designed to be worn under a jacket or coat that can hold two small magazines or speedloaders. Normally meant to be worn alongside a shoulder holster, but can be used on its own.

belt_magazine.name: magazine belt
belt_magazine.description: A belt worn across the waist, with pouches that can hold up to eight small magazines or speedloaders.

2byarm_guard.name: pair of 2-by-arm guards
2byarm_guard.description: A pair of improvised arm guards made from broken pieces of a two by four that are tied to your arms with rags and string.  They offer good protection, but are really uncomfortable to wear.

armguard_chitin.name: pair of chitin arm guards
armguard_chitin.description: A pair of arm guards made from the exoskeletons of insects.  Light and durable.

armguard_acidchitin.name: pair of biosilicified chitin arm guards
armguard_acidchitin.description: A pair of arm guards crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Acid-resistant and very durable.
armguard_acidchitin.name_plural: pairs of biosilicified chitin arm guards

armguard_hard.name: pair of hard arm guards
armguard_hard.description: A pair of neoprene arm sleeves covered with molded plastic sheaths.

armguard_larmor.name: pair of leather arm guards
armguard_larmor.description: A pair of tough leather arm guards.  Light and comfortable.

armguard_lightplate.name: pair of steel arm guards
armguard_lightplate.description: A full assembly of medieval arm protection.  Rerebraces, couters, and vambraces, with leather straps to secure each piece and connect it as part of a set.

armguard_lightplate_superalloy.name: pair of superalloy arm guards
armguard_lightplate_superalloy.description: A full assembly of medieval arm protection, made from cutting-edge superalloy.  Rerebraces, couters, and vambraces, with leather straps to secure each piece and connect it as part of a set.

armguard_metal.name: pair of metal arm guards
armguard_metal.description: A pair of arm guards hammered out from metal.  Perfect for the Post-Apocalyptic Warrior look.

armguard_bronze.name: pair of bronze arm guards
armguard_bronze.description: A pair of arm guards hammered out from sheets of bronze, for a classical take on the Post-Apocalyptic Warrior look.

armguard_paper.name: pair of paper arm guards
armguard_paper.description: Arm guards made of stacked paper sheets held together with duct tape.

armguard_scrap.name: pair of scrap arm guards
armguard_scrap.description: A pair of arm guards made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.

armguard_soft.name: pair of neoprene arm sleeves
armguard_soft.description: A pair of soft neoprene arm sleeves.  Often used in contact sports.

chainmail_arms.name: pair of chainmail sleeves
chainmail_arms.description: Customized chainmail arms.  Each sleeve has straps to connect them with each other.  The lack of fingers makes them less cumbersome and allows them to be used with gloves.

elbow_pads.name: pair of elbow pads
elbow_pads.description: A pair of elbow pads made of stout plastic and cloth.

vambrace_larmor.name: pair of leather vambraces
vambrace_larmor.description: A pair of light leather arm guards, made for archery.

armguard_bone.name: pair of bone vambraces
armguard_bone.description: Arm protection made from strips of carved bone, laced together as splint armor.  Tough but stiff, and a bit brittle.

carbon_armguard.name: carbon fiber arm guards
carbon_armguard.description: Custom armguards of layered carbon fiber armor made using a 3D printer.  Its rigid plates are more comparable to a suit of armor than kevlar, but it's very protective and lightweight.

armguard_scute.name: scaleskin armguards
armguard_scute.description: Arm guards made from the hardened scales of large reptiles.

kevlar.name: Kevlar vest
kevlar.description: A lightweight, concealable bullet resistant vest.  It will reliably protect against anything up to 9x19mm, but will struggle against tougher rounds like .45 ACP or .357 Magnum.

dragonskin.name: dragon skin vest
dragonskin.description: An improved iteration of a flexible, bullet-resistant vest that originally suffered from reliability issues.  Reliably protects against 5.56x45mm rounds while being less cumbersome than normal hard ballistic armor.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

dragonskinempty.name: lamellar Kevlar vest
dragonskinempty.description: A lamellar Kevlar vest, providing modest protection from pistol rounds up to .40 S&W.  It was designed to slot in multiple small ceramic disks to improve bullet resistance.

modularvest.name: MBR vest (empty)
modularvest.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  It has pouches for extra armor inserts, but even without them it will protect against anything up to .40 S&W.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

modularvestceramic.name: MBR vest (ceramic plates)
modularvestceramic.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Ceramic plates have been inserted to improve its protection, protecting against anything up to 7.62x51mm at the expense of moderate encumbrance, and being less durable than other plate options.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

modularvesthard.name: MBR vest (hard plates)
modularvesthard.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Hardened steel plates have been inserted, reliably negating anything up to 7.62x51mm at the cost of a great deal of weight and loss of flexibility.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

modularveststeel.name: MBR vest (steel plating)
modularveststeel.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Its armor pouches have steel plates in them, protecting against 5.56x45mm but making the vest much heavier and encumbering.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

modularvestsuper.name: MBR vest (superalloy)
modularvestsuper.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Its armor pouches have superalloy plating in them, protecting against anything up to 5.56x45mm with marginal flexibility loss and additional weight.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

oldguard_armor.name: Old Guard IOTV suit (empty)
oldguard_armor.description: A military ballistic vest rated for .40 S&W, modified with additional protective panels to improve coverage at the expense of encumbrance.  Made and used by military remnants to provide robust protection against the new threats of the cataclysm, it has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

oldguard_armor_ceramic.name: Old Guard IOTV suit (ceramic plates)
oldguard_armor_ceramic.description: A military ballistic vest with additional protective panels, improving coverage at the expense of encumbrance.  Ceramic plates have been inserted to improve its protection, protecting against anything up to 7.62x51mm at the expense of moderate encumbrance, and being less durable than other plate options.  Made and used by military remnants to provide robust protection against the new threats of the cataclysm, it has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

oldguard_armor_hardsteel.name: Old Guard IOTV suit (hard plates)
oldguard_armor_hardsteel.description: A military ballistic vest with additional protective panels, improving coverage at the expense of encumbrance.  Hardened steel plates have been inserted, reliably negating anything up to 7.62x51mm at the cost of a great deal of weight and loss of flexibility.  Made and used by military remnants to provide robust protection against the new threats of the cataclysm, it has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

oldguard_armor_steel.name: Old Guard IOTV suit (steel plating)
oldguard_armor_steel.description: A military ballistic vest with additional protective panels, improving coverage at the expense of encumbrance.  Its armor pouches have steel plates in them, protecting against 5.56x45mm but making the vest much heavier and encumbering.  Made and used by military remnants to provide robust protection against the new threats of the cataclysm, it has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

oldguard_armor_superalloy.name: Old Guard IOTV suit (superalloy)
oldguard_armor_superalloy.description: A military ballistic vest with additional protective panels, improving coverage at the expense of encumbrance.  Its armor pouches have superalloy plating in them, protecting against anything up to 5.56x45mm with marginal flexibility loss and additional weight.  Made and used by military remnants to provide robust protection against the new threats of the cataclysm, it has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.

flotation_vest_sandbag.name: makeshift ballistic vest
flotation_vest_sandbag.description: A flotation vest, cut open and tightly packed with sand or earth as improvised ballistic protection.  Incredibly cumbersome, it won't do much but it'll keep your organs inside your torso against anything up to .40 S&W.

armor_trench.name: hard steel trench armor
armor_trench.description: Cumbersome body armor forged from hardened steel plating.  Very heavy, but able to take considerable punishment, laughing off anything up to .44 Magnum.

helm_trench.name: hard steel trench helmet
helm_trench.description: A cumbersome full-face helm forged from hardened steel plating.  Very heavy, but able to take considerable punishment, laughing off anything up to .44 Magnum.

bandolier_pistol.name: pistol bandolier
bandolier_pistol.description: An embroidered leather bandolier for keeping pistol cartridges close to hand.  If this doesn't make you feel like a cowboy, nothing will.

bandolier_rifle.name: rifle bandolier
bandolier_rifle.description: A leather bandolier for keeping rifle cartridges close to hand.

bandolier_shotgun.name: waist shotgun bandolier
bandolier_shotgun.description: A leather bandolier worn around the waist for keeping shotgun shells close to hand.

torso_bandolier_shotgun.name: torso shotgun bandolier
torso_bandolier_shotgun.description: A leather bandolier strapped around the torso for keeping shotgun shells close to hand.

flintlock_pouch.name: paper cartridge pouch
flintlock_pouch.description: A covered leather pouch, worn at the waist to store and protect prepared blackpowder cartridges.

bandolier_wrist.name: wrist bandolier
bandolier_wrist.description: A small fabric bandolier for rifle cartridges designed to be worn around the wrist.

grenade_pouch.name: grenade ammo pouch
grenade_pouch.description: A small pouch for storing cartridge grenades with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing.

stone_pouch.name: stone pouch
stone_pouch.description: A medium-sized pouch for storing rocks, with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing.

grenadebandolier.name: hand grenade pouch
grenadebandolier.description: A pouch for holding up to four full-sized grenades of various types.

bandolier_grenade.name: grenade ammo bandolier
bandolier_grenade.description: A leather bandolier for keeping cartridge grenades close to hand.

bandolier_knife.name: throwing knife bandolier
bandolier_knife.description: A bandolier worn across the chest with small leather loops sewn on.  Able to hold up to twelve small knives or similar tools, whether throwing knives, shurikens, or other small items.  Activate to sheath or draw a tool.

sheet.name: sheet
sheet.description: A large fabric sheet, could be used as a curtain or bedsheets; or cut up for a bunch of rags.

blanket.name: blanket
blanket.description: Hiding under here will not protect you from the monsters.

down_blanket.name: down-filled blanket
down_blanket.description: Hiding under here will not protect you from the monsters, but it'll keep you warm.

fur_blanket.name: fur blanket
fur_blanket.description: A heavy fur blanket that covers most of your body.

afs_quilt.name: quilt
afs_quilt.description: A big, comfy quilt made of thick wool in a triangle pattern.  Extremely cozy!

afs_quilt_patchwork.name: patchwork quilt
afs_quilt_patchwork.description: A huge, patchwork wool quilt.  Very, very warm.

sleeping_bag.name: sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: A large sleeping bag that covers you head to toe.  This one is medium weight.

use_action.msg: You roll up the sleeping bag, preparing it for transport.

fireman_belt.name: firefighter belt
fireman_belt.description: A stout firefighter's belt.  Useful for keeping your bunker gear up, it also doubles as an equipment belt with a reinforced loop for holding a large tool.

judo_belt_black.name: black belt
judo_belt_black.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a master.

judo_belt_blue.name: blue belt
judo_belt_blue.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a strong intermediate.

judo_belt_brown.name: brown belt
judo_belt_brown.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a near-master.

judo_belt_green.name: green belt
judo_belt_green.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising an intermediate.

judo_belt_orange.name: orange belt
judo_belt_orange.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a fresh intermediate.

judo_belt_white.name: white belt
judo_belt_white.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a novice.

judo_belt_yellow.name: yellow belt
judo_belt_yellow.description: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a moderate novice.

leather_belt.name: leather belt
leather_belt.description: A leather belt.  Useful for making your pair of pants fit.

police_belt.name: police duty belt
police_belt.description: Black leather belt used by police officers.  It has several pouches and a holder for a baton.

survivor_belt_notools.name: survivor belt
survivor_belt_notools.description: A custom-built leather utility belt covered with straps and pouches to store up to six tools or blades.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

tool_belt.name: tool belt
tool_belt.description: A common belt with pockets, loops and sheaths to store up to six tools or blades.  Widely used by handymen and electricians.

webbing_belt.name: webbing belt
webbing_belt.description: A 2-inch nylon webbing belt commonly used by military forces.

bastsandals.name: pair of cord sandals
bastsandals.description: Lightweight sandals made from wound cord.  They offer little in the way of protection, but keep you cool during warmer months.

boots_bone.name: pair of occult boots
boots_bone.description: Leather boots covered with tiny finely carved bones.  With each step the bones collide with each other producing a strange song.

boots_bunker.name: pair of turnout boots
boots_bunker.description: A pair of steel-toed rubber boots, the sort worn by firefighters.  Highly resistant to heat and flame, they provide excellent protection from injury.

boots_chitin.name: pair of chitinous boots
boots_chitin.description: Boots made from the exoskeletons of insects.  Light and durable.

boots_acidchitin.name: pair of biosilicified chitin boots
boots_acidchitin.description: Boots crafted from carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Acid-resistant and very durable.

boots_combat.name: pair of combat boots
boots_combat.description: Modern reinforced tactical combat boots.  Very durable.

boots_fsurvivor.name: pair of survivor fireboots
boots_fsurvivor.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored Nomex boots, modified to provide maximum protection from harm and the elements, even when knee-deep in the dead.

boots_fur.name: pair of fur boots
boots_fur.description: Boots lined with fur for warmth.

boots_h20survivor.name: pair of survivor wetsuit boots
boots_h20survivor.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored neoprene boots, modified to provide maximum protection from harm and the elements, even when knee-deep in the dead.

boots_hiking.name: pair of hiking boots
boots_hiking.description: Tough yet light leather boots.  Durable and comfortable.

boots_hsurvivor.name: pair of heavy survivor boots
boots_hsurvivor.description: A pair of customized Kevlar boots, heavily armored with steel and modified to provide maximum protection from harm, even when knee-deep in the dead.

boots_sasurvivor.name: pair of superalloy survivor boots
boots_sasurvivor.description: A pair of customized Kevlar boots, heavily armored with superalloy and modified to provide maximum protection from harm, even when knee-deep in the dead.

boots_larmor.name: pair of leather armor boots
boots_larmor.description: Thick leather boots made specifically to protect the feet.  Light and tough.

boots_plarmor.name: pair of plated leather boots
boots_plarmor.description: Thick leather boots that have been reinforced with strategically-placed metal plates.  Strong yet light.

boots_lsurvivor.name: pair of light survivor boots
boots_lsurvivor.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored cloth boots, modified to provide maximum protection from harm, even when knee-deep in the dead.

boots_plate.name: pair of armored boots
boots_plate.description: An extremely heavy set of armor plated boots.

boots_plate_superalloy.name: pair of superalloy armored boots
boots_plate_superalloy.description: A set of armor plated boots, made with lightweight superalloy.

boots_rubber.name: pair of rubber boots
boots_rubber.description: A pair of rubber boots, often used while cleaning with caustic materials.

boots_steel.name: pair of steeltoed boots
boots_steel.description: Leather boots with a steel toe.  Extremely durable.

boots_survivor.name: pair of survivor boots
boots_survivor.description: A pair of customized leather boots, armored with Kevlar and modified to provide maximum protection from harm, even when knee-deep in the dead.

boots_western.name: pair of western boots
boots_western.description: Stiff leather boots with intricate embroidery and one-inch heels.  They look good, but aren't made for running.  Each boot is large enough to conceal a small holdout pistol.

boots_wsurvivor.name: pair of winter survivor boots
boots_wsurvivor.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored fur boots, modified to provide maximum protection from harm and the elements, even when knee-deep in the dead.

cleats.name: pair of cleats
cleats.description: Sport shoes with hard undersides, and studs on the bottom designed to dig into the grass.

golf_shoes.name: pair of golf shoes
golf_shoes.description: Snug fit sport shoes with hard ridges on the bottom.

clogs.name: pair of wooden clogs
clogs.description: Known as klompen in the Netherlands and sabots in France, these wooden shoes have endured through the ages due to their simple design and durability.

clownshoes.name: pair of clown shoes
clownshoes.description: Gigantic shoes fit for a clown.  Incredibly difficult to walk in.

dance_shoes.name: pair of dance shoes
dance_shoes.description: Expensive black dance shoes with large heels.

dress_shoes.name: pair of dress shoes
dress_shoes.description: Fancy patent leather shoes.  Not designed for running in.

flip_flops.name: pair of flip-flops
flip_flops.description: Simple sandals.  Very difficult to run in.

flip_flops_exp.name: pair of expensive flip-flops
flip_flops_exp.description: These are upmarket "luxury" flip-flops.  Very difficult to run in.

crocs.name: pair of crocs
crocs.description: Highly fashionable plastic clogs.  They stay on, even during Cataclysms.  These are in relaxed mode, optimal for fashionability.

use_action.msg: You flip the crocs to sport mode.

crocs_sport.name: pair of crocs (sport mode)
crocs_sport.description: Highly fashionable plastic clogs.  They stay on, even during Cataclysms.  These are in sport mode, so everyone knows you mean business.

use_action.msg: You flip the crocs to relaxed mode.

footrags.name: pair of foot rags
footrags.description: Rags tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, still better than nothing.

footrags_fur.name: pair of fur foot wraps
footrags_fur.description: Fur pelts tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, still better than nothing.

footrags_leather.name: pair of leather foot wraps
footrags_leather.description: Leather patches tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, still better than nothing.

footrags_wool.name: pair of wool foot wraps
footrags_wool.description: Felt patches tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, still better than nothing.

heels.name: pair of heels
heels.description: A pair of high heels.  Difficult to even walk in.

knee_high_boots.name: pair of knee-high boots
knee_high_boots.description: Very long leather boots that cover the lower legs.  Difficult to wear but extremely durable.

leathersandals.name: pair of leather sandals
leathersandals.description: Sturdy leather hiking sandals with a heel strap.  Offers little in the way of protection, but keeps you cool during warmer months.

lowtops.name: pair of lowtop tennis shoes
lowtops.description: Lightweight shoes made of cloth and rubber.

mocassins.name: pair of moccasins
mocassins.description: Simple shoes made from animal pelts.

motorbike_boots.name: pair of motorcycle boots
motorbike_boots.description: A pair of durable boots to be used by dirt bikers and motorcyclists.

roller_blades.name: pair of rollerblades

cowboy_hat.description: Whether yer hunting varmints, fixing up the ranch, or heading into the sunset, this is the hat for the job.

drinking_hat.name: drinking hat
drinking_hat.description: This is an improvised harness that can be worn over other headgear or bare head, made from two small liquid containers, a rubber hose, a bundle of steel wire, and some cordage.  A convenient and simple device for hands-free drinking, though the liquid inside would spill if you put it into your backpack.

eboshi.name: eboshi
eboshi.description: A high, black cap with a very narrow top.  Traditionally worn by Shinto priests.

hat_boonie.name: boonie hat
hat_boonie.description: Also called a "bucket hat." Often used in the military.  Its wide brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.

hat_ball.name: baseball cap
hat_ball.description: A Red Sox cap.  It provides a little bit of warmth.

hat_chef.name: toque
hat_chef.description: A traditional chef's hat, standing tall and proud against the vulgarities of the world.

hat_cotton.name: cotton hat
hat_cotton.description: A snug-fitting cotton hat.  Quite warm.

hat_fur.name: fur hat
hat_fur.description: A hat made from the pelts of animals.  Extremely warm.

hat_faux_fur.name: faux fur hat
hat_faux_fur.description: A stylish hat made of faux fur.  Like real fur, but without the suffering, if the tag is to be believed.  Very warm.

bearskin_hat.name: bearskin hat
bearskin_hat.description: A tall ceremonial hat once worn by European soldiers.  Very warm.  Very tall.

hat_hard.name: hard hat
hat_hard.description: A hard plastic hat worn in construction sites.  Excellent protection from cuts and percussion.

hat_hard_hooded.name: hooded hard hat
hat_hard_hooded.description: A hard plastic hat worn in construction sites, with a cloth tucked in under it to serve as a makeshift hood.  Makes it a bit more comfortable to wear, and better protects the neck from sun and rain.

hat_hunting.name: hunting cap
hat_hunting.description: A red plaid hunting cap with ear flaps.  Notably warm.

hat_knit.name: knit hat
hat_knit.description: A snug-fitting wool hat.  Very warm.

hat_newsboy.name: newsboy cap
hat_newsboy.description: A slouching wool cap with a short front brim, traditionally associated with newspaper delivery boys.  Quite warm.

hat_noise_cancelling.name: noise canceling headgear
hat_noise_cancelling.description: Padding over your ears kept in place by some string.  They block enough incoming sound to make it easier to sleep, but aren't designed to protect your hearing.

hat_sombrero.name: sombrero
hat_sombrero.description: A felt orange sombrero with traditional white and yellow hand stitching.  The wide brim keeps the sun out of your eyes, and a thin strap hooks around your chin.

kippah.name: kippah
kippah.description: A thin, rounded skullcap.  A traditional headdress in Judaism.

kufi.name: kufi cap
kufi.description: A brimless, short and rounded cap.

porkpie.name: porkpie hat
porkpie.description: A flat-topped hat with circular indent and a narrow brim.  Most popular in the 40s and 50s, still common among those in the mod scene, hipsters, and people named Heisenberg.

postman_hat.name: mail carrier hat
postman_hat.description: A traditional mail carrier's cap, with the US postal service logo embroidered on the front above the plastic cap.  A symbol of a bygone world.

straw_hat.name: straw hat
straw_hat.description: Hat that is woven out of straw.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.

tinfoil_hat.name: tinfoil hat
tinfoil_hat.description: A sheet of aluminum foil that has been molded into a form-fitting hat.  Perfect for protecting yourself from the government, Illuminati, aliens, and THEM.

tophat.name: top hat
tophat.description: The only hat for a gentleman.  Look exquisite while laughing in the face of danger!

tricorne.name: tricorne
tricorne.description: A classic design, the "tricorne", or three-cornered hat, simply pins a large and floppy brim out of the way, though this example adds well-embroidered designs and is oiled against water.  Whether you're the "guvnah" of a settlement, or the captain of a post-apocalyptic crew, this is the hat for you.

hat_golf.name: golf cap
hat_golf.description: You're not actually sure if this is called a golf cap, but it's the stereotypical cap golfers wear.

pot_helmet.name: pot helmet
pot_helmet.description: A helmet made from a soup pot.  It's not very good protection, but it's better than nothing.

bucket_helmet.name: bucket helmet
bucket_helmet.description: A full-face helmet made by punching eyeholes and breath holes into a metal bucket.  No longer watertight thanks to all the holes in it, but wearing it makes you feel like an intergalactic supervillain.

headgear.name: headgear
headgear.description: Lightweight sports headgear designed to protect the head while sparring.

helmet_army.name: army helmet
helmet_army.description: A heavy helmet that provides excellent protection from fragmentation and can resist pistol rounds up to .40 S&W.  It is labeled as the advanced combat helmet.

helmet_steel.name: steel combat helmet
helmet_steel.description: A heavy helmet made of hardened steel with a chin strap.  Designed to protect against shrapnel and impacts, but can handle pistol rounds up to 9x19mm.  Various designs were once used by armies around the world, modern ballistic helmets have mostly relegated this to military surplus.

tac_fullhelmet.name: tactical full helmet
tac_fullhelmet.description: An all-encompassing black helmet that covers your entire face and neck, providing excellent protection from all sorts of damage.

tac_helmet.name: tactical helmet
tac_helmet.description: A lightweight black helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.

firehelmet.name: firefighter helmet
firehelmet.description: A distinctive helmet worn by firefighters.  More than just a piece of firefighting equipment, it serves as a badge of honor and respect.

helmet_ball.name: baseball helmet
helmet_ball.description: A hard plastic helmet that covers the head and ears.  Designed to protect against a baseball to the head.

helmet_barbute.name: barbute helm
helmet_barbute.description: An open medieval helmet that provides excellent protection for the head.

helmet_barbute_superalloy.name: superalloy barbute helm
helmet_barbute_superalloy.description: An open medieval helmet remade in modern superalloy.  Provides excellent protection for the head.

helmet_bike.name: bike helmet
helmet_bike.description: A thick foam helmet.  Designed to protect against concussion.

helmet_chitin.name: chitinous helmet
helmet_chitin.description: A helmet made from the exoskeletons of insects.  Covers the entire head; very light and durable.

helmet_conical.name: conical helm
helmet_conical.description: A conical iron helm with additional protection for the neck, associated with the Mongol Empire.

helmet_acidchitin.name: biosilicified chitin helmet
helmet_acidchitin.description: A helmet crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Covers the entire head; acid-resistant and very durable.

helmet_football.name: football helmet
helmet_football.description: A heavy plastic helmet normally worn by football players.

helmet_galea.name: galea
helmet_galea.description: An Imperial Roman helmet, with distinct projections protecting the sides of the head.

helmet_kabuto.name: kabuto
helmet_kabuto.description: A medieval Japanese helmet with a scowling facemask that provides excellent protection to the entire head and face.

helmet_larmor.name: leather armor helmet
helmet_larmor.description: A thick leather helmet that provides excellent protection for the head.

helmet_plarmor.name: plated leather helmet
helmet_plarmor.description: A thick leather helmet that has been reinforced with strategically-placed metal plates.  Provides excellent protection for the head.

helmet_skull.name: large wolf skull
helmet_skull.description: The top part of an unusually large wolf skull equiped with leather straps to secure it on your head.  Every inch of it has been carved with a maze of fine intertwined symbols that make your eyes water.

helmet_liner.name: helmet liner
helmet_liner.description: This goes inside a helmet to help keep your head warm in cold climates.

armored_helmet_liner.name: armored helmet liner
armored_helmet_liner.description: This experimental helmet liner is made out of advanced materials to provide protection while maintaining flexibility. Initially designed as supplemental head protection for the phase immersion suit, it's too thick to wear with power armor.

cap_arming.name: arming cap
cap_arming.description: This goes inside a helmet to help keep your head warm in cold climates.

helmet_lobster.name: lobster helmet
helmet_lobster.description: A heavy helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.  It has a tail coming off the back that provides protection to your neck.

helmet_motor.name: motorcycle helmet
helmet_motor.description: A helmet with covers for your head and chin, leaving space in-between for you to wear goggles.

helmet_nasal.name: nasal helm
helmet_nasal.description: An early medieval helmet with a projection guarding the nose, to better protect the face without obstructing vision.  Proper viking gear, unlike the stereotypical horned helm.

helmet_nomad.name: nomad cowl
helmet_nomad.description: A makeshift cowl with protection for the eyes from rain and sun, designed for long travels.

helmet_plate.name: great helm
helmet_plate.description: A medieval helmet that provides excellent protection to the entire head, at the cost of great encumbrance.

helmet_plate_superalloy.name: superalloy great helm
helmet_plate_superalloy.description: A medieval helmet remade in modern superalloy.  Provides excellent protection to the entire head, at the cost of encumbrance.

helmet_scrap.name: scrap helmet
helmet_scrap.description: A helmet made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.

helmet_skid.name: skid lid
helmet_skid.description: A small metal helmet that covers the head and protects against cuts and percussion.

helmet_survivor.name: survivor helmet
helmet_survivor.description: A customized, heavily armored Kevlar helmet, modified with leather reinforcements to provide maximum comfort and protection from harm.

helmet_hsurvivor.name: heavy survivor helmet
helmet_hsurvivor.description: A customized, heavily armored steel and Kevlar helmet, modified to provide maximum comfort and protection from harm.  All the added material has made it rather heavy.

helmet_sasurvivor.name: superalloy survivor helmet
helmet_sasurvivor.description: A customized, heavily armored superalloy and Kevlar helmet, modified to provide maximum comfort and protection from harm.  All the added material has made it rather heavy.

pickelhaube.name: pickelhaube
pickelhaube.description: A spiked helmet once worn by German military officers.  The spike is very sharp.

helmet_corinthian.name: Corinthian helm
helmet_corinthian.description: An ancient Greek bronze helmet that provides excellent protection for the head, with slits for the eyes and mouth.

pot_xlhelmet.name: XL pot helmet
pot_xlhelmet.description: A huge makeshift helmet made from a canning pot.  For the truly desperate man-bear-pig.

helmet_bone.name: bone helmet
helmet_bone.description: A helmet made from carved bone, laced together into a pattern resembling a Mycenaean boar's tusk helmet.  Tough but stiff, and a bit brittle.

carbon_helmet.name: carbon fiber helmet
carbon_helmet.description: A custom helmet of layered carbon fiber armor made using a 3D printer.  Its rigid plates are more comparable to a suit of armor than kevlar, but it's very protective and lightweight.

helmet_scute.name: scaleskin helmet
helmet_scute.description: A helmet made from the hardened scales of large reptiles.

back_holster.name: back holster
back_holster.description: A leather holster, big enough for a rifle or other large gun.  Designed to be strapped to the back.  Whilst initially cumbersome it becomes much easier to use with practice.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

bootstrap.name: ankle holster
bootstrap.description: A small concealed holster worn on the ankle.  It is awkward to use without practice.  Activate to holster/draw a small pistol.

wristholster.name: wrist holster
wristholster.description: A small concealed holster worn on the wrist.  It is quick to use but can only carry very small pistols, gamblers' derringers and the like.  Activate to holster/draw a pistol.

bow_sling.name: bow sling
bow_sling.description: A somewhat complicated set of straps and fabric to keep your bow close to hand and (mostly) out of harms way.  Activate to holster/draw your bow.

holster.name: holster
holster.description: A leather strap worn on the hip for holding pistol sized guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

sholster.name: fast draw holster
sholster.description: A comfortable quick draw holster for small guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

bholster.name: deep concealment holster
bholster.description: An elastic band with numerous provisions for concealing a small pistol close to the body.  It is awkward to use without practice.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

shoulder_holster.name: shoulder holster
shoulder_holster.description: A shoulder holster designed to be worn under a jacket or coat that allows a gun to hang comfortably beneath the arm.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

survivor_vest.name: survivor harness
survivor_vest.description: A custom-built light harness covered with pouches and including a few integral tactical slings for firearms, magazines, and field tools.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to holster/draw your weapon.

baldric_holster.name: baldric holster
baldric_holster.description: A leather harness which can hold up to six pistol-sized guns in total, available for quick drawing.  Historically, similar harnesses were used by pirates to carry multiple loaded flintlock pistols at once, as reloading them is a lengthy process.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

XL_holster.name: XL holster
XL_holster.description: A belt holster consisting of a loop and strap intended for use with larger firearms.  Slightly more cumbersome than a standard holster due to the straps that hold it flat against your leg, Activate to holster/draw a gun.

beekeeping_hood.name: beekeeping hood
beekeeping_hood.description: A beekeeping hood.  Keeps the bees out, but lets fresh air in.  Rather cumbersome to wear, as it is rather bulky and hinders vision.

chainmail_hood.name: chainmail coif
chainmail_hood.description: A customized chainmail hood.  Can be worn comfortably under helmets.

hood_fsurvivor.name: survivor firehood
hood_fsurvivor.description: A customized armored Nomex and Kevlar hood, very strong and durable.

hood_lsurvivor.name: light survivor hood
hood_lsurvivor.description: A customized armored cloth and Kevlar hood, very light and durable.

hood_rain.name: rain hood
hood_rain.description: A waterproof hood made to be worn in bad weather.  Provides extra protection from rain.

hood_survivor.name: survivor hood
hood_survivor.description: A customized, heavily armored leather and Kevlar hood, designed to provide comfort and protection from harm.

hood_wsurvivor.name: winter survivor hood
hood_wsurvivor.description: A customized armored fur and Kevlar hood, very warm and durable.

nomex_hood.name: flame-resistant hood
nomex_hood.description: A snug fitting garment that protects your head and neck, made from lightweight Nomex fire-resistant fabric.  Tough yet breathable, it is light and comfortable to wear under clothing.

bead_bracelet.name: beaded bracelet
bead_bracelet.description: A simple bracelet of string and wooden beads.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.  Also doubles as a set of prayer beads, if you're so inclined.

bead_ear.name: pair of beaded earrings
bead_ear.description: A simple pair of earrings made of string and wooden beads.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

bead_necklace.name: beaded necklace
bead_necklace.description: A simple necklace made of string and wooden beads.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.  Also doubles as a set of prayer beads, if you're so inclined.

bracelet_friendship.name: friendship bracelet
bracelet_friendship.description: A homemade bracelet crafted from colorful knickknacks.  It's not very expensive, but it's the effort that makes it special.

bronze_medal.name: bronze medal
bronze_medal.description: A medal awarded for achieving third place in some event.  It might be worth something if it was made of bronze; this one is made from iron.

diamond_dental_grill.name: diamond dental grill
diamond_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with diamonds, worn over the teeth.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.  For that high-class gangsta rap look.

garnet_dental_grill.name: garnet dental grill
garnet_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with garnets, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

amethyst_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with amethysts, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

emerald_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with emeralds, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

alexandrite_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with alexandrites, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

ruby_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with rubys, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

citrine_dental_grill.name: citrine dental grill
citrine_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with citrines, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

blue_topaz_dental_grill.name: blue topaz dental grill
blue_topaz_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with blue topaz, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.

diamond_ring.name: diamond and gold ring
diamond_ring.description: A gold ring with a sparkling diamond mounted on top of it.  Back in the old days this could be worth a fortune.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

diving_watch.name: diver's watch
diving_watch.description: A waterproof, self-winding watch on a stainless steel watchband.  Tells the time and current temperature.  Activate to check the digital thermometer.

collarpin.name: collar pin
collarpin.description: A staple accessory for gentlemen.  Keeps your shirt collar in place and provides a more aesthetically pleasing arc to your necktie.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

copper_bracelet.name: copper bracelet
copper_bracelet.description: An old-fashioned, copper bracelet.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

copper_ear.name: pair of copper earrings
copper_ear.description: A pair of copper earrings.  It's pretty heavy.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

copper_hairpin.name: copper hairpin
copper_hairpin.description: A hairpin made from copper.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

copper_locket.name: copper locket
copper_locket.description: A circular, copper locket.  It's been tarnished with use, and has gained some dull green spots.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

copper_necklace.name: copper necklace
copper_necklace.description: A simple chain of copper, with a clasp in the middle to create a necklace.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

copper_ring.name: copper ring
copper_ring.description: A plain, copper ring.  Not very shiny, and not very popular.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

cufflinks.name: pair of cufflinks
cufflinks.description: An unmarked, pair of silver cufflinks.  Cufflinks are used to secure the cuffs of dress shirts - a must-have for men in formal wear.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

cufflinks_intricate.description: An expensive pair of silver cufflinks, stylized with detailed overlays of gold gears and fractal patterns.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

ear_spool.description: Those round things people plug into their earlobes as earrings, also called "ear plug" or "ear spool."  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

gold_bracelet.name: gold bracelet
gold_bracelet.description: A fancy golden bracelet.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

gold_dental_grill.name: gold dental grill
gold_dental_grill.description: Fake golden teeth, worn over the teeth.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.

gold_ear.description: A pair of shiny gold earrings.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

gold_hairpin.description: A gold hairpin, designed by the rich, for the rich.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

gold_locket.description: A heart-shaped, gold locket with a frame inside to store photographs or small objects.  You can wear it if you like, but it won't provide any effects.

gold_medal.name: gold medal

knee_pads.name: pair of knee pads
knee_pads.description: A pair of knee pads made of stout plastic and cloth.

legguard_bronze.name: pair of bronze greaves
legguard_bronze.description: A pair of bronze leg guards with a simple leather lining.

legguard_hard.name: pair of hard leg guards
legguard_hard.description: A pair of polyurethane leg guards with neoprene backing.

legguard_lightplate.name: pair of steel leg guards
legguard_lightplate.description: A full assembly of medieval leg protection.  Cuisses, poleyns, and greaves, with leather straps to secure each piece and connect it as part of a set.

legguard_lightplate_superalloy.name: pair of superalloy leg guards
legguard_lightplate_superalloy.description: A full assembly of medieval leg protection, made from cutting-edge superalloy.  Cuisses, poleyns, and greaves, with leather straps to secure each piece and connect it as part of a set.

legguard_metal.name: pair of iron greaves
legguard_metal.description: A pair of iron leg guards with a simple leather lining.

legguard_paper.name: pair of paper leg guards
legguard_paper.description: Leg guards made of stacked paper sheets held together with duct tape.

legguard_scrap.name: pair of scrap leg guards
legguard_scrap.description: A pair of leg guards made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.

lsurvivor_pants.name: light survivor cargo pants
lsurvivor_pants.description: Lightweight, Kevlar armored cargo pants designed to hold as much as possible.  Strong and mostly waterproof.

motorbike_pants.name: motorcycle pants
motorbike_pants.description: A pair of pants designed for dirt bikers and motorcyclists.

pants_survivor.name: survivor cargo pants
pants_survivor.description: A pair of Kevlar armored pants covered with pouches and pockets.  Custom-built to be durable, comfortable, and easy to wear.

skirt_armor.name: padded skirt
skirt_armor.description: A knee-length skirt made of overlapping quilted pads, similar to those used by ancient Roman and Greek soldiers.  Doesn't cover as much as a gambeson, but it's far less hot and encumbering.

skirt_armor_leather.name: leather armor skirt
skirt_armor_leather.description: A knee-length skirt made of overlapping leather armor plates, similar to those used by ancient Roman and Greek soldiers.  It's not very encumbering compared to proper legplates, but provides less coverage too.

skirt_armor_plate.name: plated leather skirt
skirt_armor_plate.description: An armored skirt made of leather with metal plates expertly sewn into it.  Covers less than proper leg armor, but it's also far more tolerable to wear in the summer and far easier to move in.

greaves_bone.name: pair of bone greaves
greaves_bone.description: Leg guards made from strips of carved bone, laced together as splint armor.  Tough but stiff, and a bit brittle.

carbon_legguard.name: carbon fiber leg guards
carbon_legguard.description: Custom legs of layered carbon fiber armor made using a 3D printer.  Its rigid plates are more comparable to a suit of armor than kevlar, but it's very protective and lightweight.

b_shorts.name: basketball shorts
b_shorts.description: A pair of basketball shorts.  Comfortable and light.

breeches.name: breeches
breeches.description: A well-made pair of old-fashioned pants, made of stiff yet baggy material.  Comfortable, but lacks pockets.

fishing_waders.name: pair of fishing waders
fishing_waders.description: Waterproof fishing waders with a single large front pocket.

hot_pants.name: hot pants
hot_pants.description: A simple pair of short shorts.

hot_pants_fur.name: fur hot pants
hot_pants_fur.description: A simple pair of fur short shorts.

hot_pants_leather.name: leather hot pants
hot_pants_leather.description: A simple pair of leather short shorts.

jeans.name: jeans
jeans.description: A pair of blue jeans with two deep pockets.

jeans_red.name: red jeans
jeans_red.description: A pair of tight-fitting candy-apple-red jeans with two deep pockets.

kilt.name: kilt
kilt.description: No true Scotsman would leave home without his kilt.

kilt_leather.name: leather kilt
kilt_leather.description: No true Scotsman would leave home without his kilt.

leggings.name: leggings
leggings.description: Skin-tight nylon leggings, sometimes used when exercising, that keep your legs nice and warm.

loincloth.name: loincloth
loincloth.description: Rags stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.

loincloth_fur.name: fur loincloth
loincloth_fur.description: A fur pelt tied into a loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.  Now you are a true barbarian warrior.

loincloth_leather.name: leather loincloth
loincloth_leather.description: Leather patches stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.

loincloth_wool.name: wool loincloth
loincloth_wool.description: Bits of wool stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.

nanoskirt.name: nanoskirt
nanoskirt.description: Apparently the microskirt wasn't short enough.

pants.name: pants
pants.description: A pair of khaki pants.  Slightly warmer than jeans.

pants_army.name: army pants
pants_army.description: A tough pair of pants lined with pockets.  Favored by the military.

pants_tacticool.name: multicam black tactical pants
pants_tacticool.description: A tough set of army pants lined with pockets, in a not-very-stealthy black camo pattern.

pants_cargo.name: cargo pants
pants_cargo.description: A pair of pants lined with pockets, offering lots of storage.

pants_checkered.name: checkered pants
pants_checkered.description: In a pinch, these pants can be used for an impromptu game of checkers.

pants_fur.name: fur pants
pants_fur.description: A hefty pair of fur-lined pants.

pants_faux_fur.name: faux fur pants
pants_faux_fur.description: A pair of long cotton pants lined with warm imitation fur.

pants_leather.name: leather pants
pants_leather.description: A pair of black leather pants.  Very tough, but cumbersome and without much storage.

pants_ski.name: ski pants
pants_ski.description: A pair of pants meant for alpine skiing.

postman_shorts.name: mail carrier shorts
postman_shorts.description: A pair of dark blue shorts, the kind used by postal service workers.

shorts_cargo.name: cargo shorts
shorts_cargo.description: A pair of shorts lined with pockets, offering decent storage.

shorts_denim.name: denim shorts
shorts_denim.description: A pair of denim shorts.  Thick and tough, they provide excellent protection from cuts.

skirt.name: skirt
skirt.description: A short, breezy cotton skirt.  Easy to move in, but only has a single small pocket.

skirt_leather.name: leather skirt
skirt_leather.description: A very short leather skirt, clearly designed to look good, not be practical.

striped_pants.name: striped pants
striped_pants.description: A pair of pants with horizontal black and white stripes.

technician_pants_gray.name: work pants
technician_pants_gray.description: A pair of gray work pants.

winter_pants_army.name: army winter pants
winter_pants_army.description: A tough pair of pants lined with pockets, thickly padded for warmth.  Favored by the military.

zubon_gi.name: zubon
zubon_gi.description: Plain white zubon for use in martial arts.

balclava.name: balaclava
balclava.description: A warm covering that protects the head and face from the cold.

makeshift_headwrap.name: makeshift headwrap
makeshift_headwrap.description: A bulky covering for your head made from a wrapped blanket.  Very warm, but very encumbering.

bandana.name: bandana
bandana.description: A cotton bandana, worn over the mouth for warmth and minor protection from dust and other contaminants.  Activate to adjust it to wear over your head instead.

use_action.msg: You adjust the %s to cover your head.

bandana_head.name: head bandana
bandana_head.description: A cotton bandana, worn over the head for warmth and to keep the wind out of your hair.  Activate to adjust it to wear over your mouth instead.

use_action.msg: You adjust the %s to cover your mouth.

bondage_mask.name: bondage mask
bondage_mask.description: A tight mask made of black leather.  The eyes and mouth can be closed using zippers.

use_action.msg: You zip the eyes and mouth of the bondage mask closed.

bondage_mask_zipped.name: bondage mask (zipped)
bondage_mask_zipped.description: A tight mask made of black leather.  The eyes and mouth have been zipped closed.

use_action.msg: You unzip the eyes and mouth of the bondage mask.

fencing_mask.name: fencing mask
fencing_mask.description: A tough hood made of steel mesh used by fencers.

mask_bal.name: ballistic mask
mask_bal.description: A protective reinforced Kevlar mask that covers the face.  Provides protection from ballistic threats up to 9x19mm.

mask_cavalry_iron.name: iron battle mask
mask_cavalry_iron.description: A full-face mask made of iron, in the vein of Roman cavalry masks.  Provides decent protection and gives an imposing post-apocalyptic look.

mask_cavalry_bronze.name: bronze battle mask
mask_cavalry_bronze.description: A full-face mask made of bronze, in the vein of Roman cavalry masks.  Provides decent protection and gives an imposing post-apocalyptic look.

mask_dust.name: dust mask
mask_dust.description: A simple piece of paper or cloth that straps over the mouth.  Provides a small amount of protection from airborne illness and dust.

mask_guy_fawkes.name: Guy Fawkes mask
mask_guy_fawkes.description: Remember, remember, the fifth of November.

mask_hockey.name: hockey mask
mask_hockey.description: A protective face mask made of thick plastic.  Commonly worn by hockey goalies.

mask_rioter.name: rioter mask
mask_rioter.description: This is a t-shirt with sleeves tied on the back.  These are usually worn by rioters to hide their identity.

clown_wig.name: clown wig
clown_wig.description: A colorful and ridiculous wig fit for a clown.

crown_golden.name: golden crown
crown_golden.description: A delicate golden crown featuring flowering trees.

crown_golden_survivor.name: golden crown
crown_golden_survivor.description: A golden crown for the monarch of survivors.

mouthpiece.name: protective mouthpiece
mouthpiece.description: A protective piece of equipment commonly used by athletes, which is worn inside the mouth to protect your teeth.

tie_skinny.name: skinny tie
tie_skinny.description: A skinny black and white checkered necktie.

sleeping_bag_roll.name: rolled sleeping bag
sleeping_bag_roll.description: A large sleeping bag rolled up for transport.  It has a strap to carry it with.

use_action.msg: You unroll the sleeping bag.

sleeping_bag_fur.name: fur sleeping bag
sleeping_bag_fur.description: A large sleeping bag lined with fur.  Who needs a tent?

use_action.msg: You roll up the fur sleeping bag, preparing it for transport.

sleeping_bag_fur_roll.name: rolled fur sleeping bag
sleeping_bag_fur_roll.description: A large sleeping bag lined with fur, rolled for transport.  It has a strap to carry it with.

use_action.msg: You unroll up the fur sleeping bag.

tie_bow.name: bow tie
tie_bow.description: A simple black bow tie.  Best worn with a suit.

tie_clipon.name: clip-on tie
tie_clipon.description: A clip-on necktie, with blue and silver stripes.  It's quick and easy to put on, and much better than the necktie.

tie_necktie.name: necktie
tie_necktie.description: An ordinary, green necktie.  It's more difficult to put on, but it takes real skill to do so.  Wearing a necktie is much better than wearing a clip-on tie.

tarp.name: plastic tarp
tarp.description: A plastic sheet with several grommets for securing it with rope or cord.  Useful for improvised rain protection.

saddlebag.name: pair of saddle bags
saddlebag.description: A pair of covered pouches laid across the back of a medium quadruped behind the saddle.

saddlebag_small_quadruped.name: pair of saddle bags for small quadruped
saddlebag_small_quadruped.description: A pair of covered pouches laid across the back of a small quadruped.
saddlebag_small_quadruped.name_plural: pairs of saddle bags for small quadruped

depowered_exo.name: salvaged power armor exoskeleton
depowered_exo.description: This used to be a powered exoskeleton with an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove, its chassis, machinery, and bodyglove stripped down.  More cumbersome and without the bells and whistles of a proper powered exoskeleton, but less encumbering than an unpowered exoskeleton.  Stripping out most of the chemical bodyglove allows wearing it over other equipment, at the expense of environmental protection.

depowered_armor.name: salvaged power armor suit
depowered_armor.description: This used to be a powered exoskeleton with a set of heavy armor plates, its chassis and bodyglove stripped down.  More cumbersome and without the bells and whistles of a proper powered suit, but less encumbering than an unpowered suit.  Stripping out most of the chemical bodyglove allows wearing it over other equipment, at the expense of environmental protection, and the stripped down plates are lighter at the expense of worse ballistic resistance.

depowered_helmet.name: salvaged power armor helmet
depowered_helmet.description: This used to be a military-grade full-head helmet, its advanced optics and environmental filters having been stripped for parts.  While still quite durable, it's harder to see out of than an active power helmet.

power_armor_back_hardpoint.name: power armor weapon rack
power_armor_back_hardpoint.description: A heavy duty set of clamps and rail interfaces, secured to the back.  Can comfortably hold blades or firearms of various sizes.  Designed to interface with a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to holster/draw a blade or gun.

power_armor_leg_hardpoint.name: power armor leg mount
power_armor_leg_hardpoint.description: A set of seals and rail interfaces to comfortably hold a wide range of firearms and tools.  Designed to interface with a power armor exoskeleton, clipped to the leg.  Activate to holster/draw a blade, tool, or gun.

power_armor_chest_rig.name: power armor magazine carrier
power_armor_chest_rig.description: A set of compartments capable of carrying two magazines close at hand, including larger drum mags, ammo belts, or UPS batteries.  Designed to interface with a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to store/retrieve your magazines.

power_armor_back_holster.name: power armor back holster
power_armor_back_holster.description: A leather holster, big enough for a rifle or other large gun.  Designed to be strapped to the back, it's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

power_armor_holster.name: power armor holster
power_armor_holster.description: A leather strap worn on the hip for holding pistol sized guns.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

power_armor_sholster.name: power armor fast draw holster
power_armor_sholster.description: A comfortable quick draw holster for small guns.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

power_armor_shoulder_holster.name: power armor shoulder holster
power_armor_shoulder_holster.description: A shoulder holster that allows a gun to hang comfortably beneath the arm, converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

power_armor_XL_holster.name: power armor XL holster
