power_armor_XL_holster.description: A belt holster consisting of a loop and strap intended for use with larger firearms.  Slightly more cumbersome than a standard holster, it's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

power_armor_axe_ring.name: power armor ring holster
power_armor_axe_ring.description: A combination of leather and a metal ring to hold an axe, hammer, or similar tool at your side.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.

power_armor_baldric.name: power armor baldric
power_armor_baldric.description: A leather scabbard, big enough for anything up to a longsword, or even a bit larger than that.  Designed to be worn at the waist, it's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to sheath/draw a sword.

power_armor_bscabbard.name: power armor back scabbard
power_armor_bscabbard.description: A leather scabbard, big enough for almost any sword.  Designed to be strapped to the back, it's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to sheath/draw a sword.

power_armor_scabbard.name: power armor scabbard
power_armor_scabbard.description: A large, adjustable sheath for holding swords and other large blades.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

power_armor_sheath.name: power armor sheath
power_armor_sheath.description: A leather sheath for holding knives and other small blades.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

power_armor_ammo_pouch.name: power armor ammo satchel
power_armor_ammo_pouch.description: A small pouch that can be used to store most types of small ammunition, rockets will not fit.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to store ammunition.

power_armor_ammo_satchel.name: power armor magazine satchel
power_armor_ammo_satchel.description: A fabric ammo bag worn at the waist which is capable of holding two magazines, ammo belts, speedloaders of nearly any size close at hand.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.

power_armor_legpouch_large.name: power armor leg magazine pouch
power_armor_legpouch_large.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your leg and capable of holding two magazines close at hand, converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.

power_armor_mag_satchel_leg.name: power armor leg magazine satchel
power_armor_mag_satchel_leg.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to the leg, capable of holding a single magazine, ammo belt, or speedloader of modest size.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.

power_armor_ammo_satchel_leg.name: power armor leg ammo satchel
power_armor_ammo_satchel_leg.description: A small pouch wrapped around the leg that can be used to store most types of small ammunition, rockets will not fit.  It's been converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.  Activate to store ammunition.

power_armor_grenade_pouch.name: power armor grenade ammo pouch
power_armor_grenade_pouch.description: A small pouch for storing cartridge grenades with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing, converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.

power_armor_grenadebandolier.name: power armor hand grenade pouch
power_armor_grenadebandolier.description: A pouch for holding up to four full-sized grenades of various types, converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.

power_armor_shoulder_pouch.name: power armor shoulder magazine pouch
power_armor_shoulder_pouch.description: A shoulder pouch that can hold two small magazines or speedloaders, converted to clip onto a power armor exoskeleton.

cowl_wool.name: knit cowl
cowl_wool.description: A snuggly woolen cowl.  It's one of those stylish and bulky cowls you see in fashion magazines.

headscarf.name: headscarf
headscarf.description: A loose cloth worn over the head and around the neck.

keffiyeh.name: keffiyeh
keffiyeh.description: A type of headdress traditionally used in the Middle East.  It can be used in different ways to protect the head and mouth from the elements.

marloss_scarf.name: cyan scarf
marloss_scarf.description: A simple cloth scarf worn by Marloss Voices.  Wherever the Voices go, long sought peace soon follows, for better or for worse.

axe_ring.name: ring holster
axe_ring.description: A combination of leather and a metal ring to hold an axe, hammer, or similar tool at your side.

baldric.name: baldric
baldric.description: A leather scabbard, big enough for anything up to a longsword, or even a bit larger than that.  Designed to be worn at the waist, secured by a shoulder belt.  Activate to sheath/draw a sword.

bootsheath.name: ankle sheath
bootsheath.description: A small concealed knife sheath worn on the ankle.  It is awkward to use without practice.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

wristsheath.name: wrist sheath
wristsheath.description: A small concealed knife sheath worn on the wrist.  It is quick to use but can only carry very small blades.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

bscabbard.name: back scabbard
bscabbard.description: A leather scabbard, big enough for almost any sword.  Designed to be strapped to the back, it's very difficult to draw from without considerable practice.  Activate to sheath/draw a sword.

scabbard.name: scabbard
scabbard.description: A large, adjustable sheath for holding swords and other large blades.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

sheath.name: sheath
sheath.description: A leather sheath for holding knives and other small blades.  It is easy to use without much practice.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

sheath_birchbark.name: birchbark sheath
sheath_birchbark.description: A hand made sheath made from birch bark, for holding knives and other small blades.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.

spearsling.name: spear strap
spearsling.description: A leather strap tied around the torso for toting spears, two-handed axes, or similar weapons while keeping your hands free.  Activate to holster/draw a weapon.

shield_wooden.name: wooden shield
shield_wooden.description: A crude wooden shield lacking any metal or leather reinforcement.  Tolerable weight but not very tough.

shield_wooden_large.name: large wooden shield
shield_wooden_large.description: A crude wooden tower shield lacking any metal or leather reinforcement.  Bulky, but offers a decent amount of protection.

shield_riot.name: riot shield
shield_riot.description: A large but fairly light plastic shield designed for riot police officers.  Not too encumbering, but designed for fending off thrown rocks rather than bullets.

shield_ballistic.name: ballistic shield
shield_ballistic.description: A heavy composite shield used by SWAT teams and other armed forces.  It can handle pistol bullets up to .40 S&W, but its heavy-duty nature means it's quite encumbering and doesn't cover the legs very well.

shield_ballistic_large.name: large ballistic shield
shield_ballistic_large.description: A tall composite shield used by SWAT teams and other armed forces, rated for pistol bullets up to .40 S&W.  Covers the body and legs quite well, but is much heavier and more encumbering than lighter models.

shield_leather.name: leather-reinforced shield
shield_leather.description: A simple round shield made of wood with leather reinforcement.  Sturdier and stronger than a simple wooden shield, and less encumbering than a metal one.

shield_kevlar.name: kevlar-lined shield
shield_kevlar.description: A simple shield made of wood, faced with a layer of kevlar to improve ballistic resistance.

shield_banded.name: banded shield
shield_banded.description: A simple round shield made of wood with bands of iron reinforcing it.  Stronger than a simple wooden shield, but also more encumbering.

shield_leather_large.name: large leather-reinforced shield
shield_leather_large.description: A large shield made of wood with leather reinforcement.  Sturdier and stronger than a basic wooden shield, and less encumbering than a metal one.

shield_kevlar_large.name: large kevlar-lined shield
shield_kevlar_large.description: A large shield made of wood, faced with a layer of kevlar to improve ballistic resistance.

shield_banded_large.name: large banded shield
shield_banded_large.description: A large shield made of wood with iron bands reinforcing it.  Stronger than a simple wooden shield, but also more encumbering.

shield_welded.name: welded shield
shield_welded.description: A shield made out of steel armor plating with handles welded on.  It's a lot heavier and less well-made compared to a proper medieval shield, but it certainly works.

shield_welded_hard.name: welded hard steel shield
shield_welded_hard.description: A shield made out of hardened steel armor plating with handles welded on.  While incredibly heavy compared to a traditional shield, it's also quite protective.

shield_welded_composite.name: welded composite shield
shield_welded_composite.description: A shield made out of military grade vehicle armor with handles welded on.  Incredibly heavy but can also take a fair bit of punishment.

shield_welded_superalloy.name: welded superalloy shield
shield_welded_superalloy.description: A shield made out of superalloy armor plating with handles welded on.  It's heavier and less well-made compared to a proper medieval shield, but it certainly works.

shield_buckler.name: buckler
shield_buckler.description: A small metal shield historically used for dueling rather than protection from arrows.  It's small and light enough to not hinder the use of your hands.

shield_buckler_superalloy.name: superalloy buckler
shield_buckler_superalloy.description: A small metal shield historically used for dueling rather than protection from arrows.  This one is made of modern superalloy instead of steel.  It's small and light enough to not hinder the use of your hands.

shield_spiked.name: spiked shield
shield_spiked.description: A metal reinforced shield with spikes jutting out of it.  Can be used as a melee weapon if need be.

shield_spiked_large.name: large spiked shield
shield_spiked_large.description: A large metal reinforced shield with spikes jutting out of it.  Can be used as a melee weapon if need be.

shield_bronze.name: bronze shield
shield_bronze.description: A simple round shield made of wood, faced with a sheet of work-hardened bronze in the vein of a Greek hoplon.  Tougher against cutting weapons than iron-banded shields for the same encumbrance, but heavier and less protective against bashing weapons.

shield_scute.name: scaleskin shield
shield_scute.description: A tall oval shield made from the hardened scales of large reptiles, stitched together and boiled to harden it into a single stiff panel, then mounted on a central wooden handgrip similar to shields historically associated with southeastern Africa.  Surprisingly light and durable.

shield_targe_wooden.name: wooden targe
shield_targe_wooden.description: A small, round wooden shield designed more for swashbuckling than for fending off arrows.  It's small and light enough to not hinder the use of your hands.

carbon_buckler.name: carbon fiber buckler
carbon_buckler.description: A custom buckler made out of layered carbon fiber armor over synthetic fabric padding made using a 3D printer.  Its rigid plates are more comparable to a sheet of metal than kevlar, but it's very protective and lightweight.

carbon_shield.name: carbon fiber ballistic shield
carbon_shield.description: A custom ballistic shield made out of layered carbon fiber armor over synthetic fabric padding made using a 3D printer.  Its rigid plates are more comparable to a sheet of metal than kevlar, but it's very protective and lightweight.

backpack.name: backpack
backpack.description: A small backpack.  Good storage for a little encumbrance.

backpack_hiking.name: hiking backpack
backpack_hiking.description: A large sized hiking backpack with plenty of storage space.

backpack_giant.name: giant novelty backpack
backpack_giant.description: A huge fabric backpack made mostly as a joke before the Cataclysm.  Now, it's still rather silly, but it can store a lot of stuff.

backpack_leather.name: leather backpack
backpack_leather.description: A small leather backpack.  Good storage for a little encumbrance.

backpack_tactical_large.name: large tactical backpack
backpack_tactical_large.description: A large tactical multi-compartment backpack that has great lower back support.

basket_laundry.name: laundry basket
basket_laundry.description: A plastic basket meant for storing and hauling clothing.

bigback.name: high-volume rucksack
bigback.description: Also known as a "bigpack", this rucksack is prized by pack rats but may lead to a bad back.

bindle.name: bindle
bindle.description: You're ready for a trip down some train tracks.  Also known as a hobo stick.

boxpack.name: box backpack
boxpack.description: A makeshift backpack comprised of a wooden box and a pair of ropes.

briefcase.name: briefcase
briefcase.description: Useful for carrying money, documents, or smuggled goods.

case_violin.name: violin case
case_violin.description: Useful to carry your precious musical instrument around protected from any harm.

daypack.name: daypack
daypack.description: An ultralight nylon backpack intended for one-day hiking trips.  Waterproof, slim, and spacious.

dive_bag.name: dive bag
dive_bag.description: A lightweight mesh backpack, commonly worn by swimmers and divers.

duffelbag.name: duffel bag
duffelbag.description: A huge duffel bag.  Provides plenty of storage, but is severely encumbering.

dump_pouch.name: tactical dump pouch
dump_pouch.description: An expandable pouch secured with straps.  Provides a bit of extra storage with minimal encumbrance.

fanny.name: fanny pack
fanny.description: Provides a bit of extra storage, with minimal encumbrance.

golf_bag.name: golf bag
golf_bag.description: A tall canvas and nylon bag with fold-out legs used for golfing.  It even has straps to be worn on the back.

hk_briefcase.name: H&K operational briefcase (empty)
hk_briefcase.description: This is a plain, hard-sided black briefcase with a trigger in the handle and a concealed hole in the side.  Squeezing the trigger would currently do nothing, as it is empty.  Don't forget to put a suitable MP5 back inside before you try to pay any ransom fees with lead.

jerrypack.name: jerrypack
jerrypack.description: A jerrycan modified to be worn in a similar manner to a backpack.

leather_pouch.name: leather pouch
leather_pouch.description: A bag stitched together from leather scraps.  Doesn't hold an awful lot but is easy to wear.

legrig.name: pair of drop leg pouches
legrig.description: A set of pouches that can be worn on the thighs using buckled straps.  This variety is favored by the military.

makeshift_knapsack.name: makeshift knapsack
makeshift_knapsack.description: A pair of pants with the bottom ends tied with string, and then passed through the belt loops so the knapsack can be carried on the back.

makeshift_sling.name: makeshift sling
makeshift_sling.description: A large sheet tied into a crude, over-the-shoulder sling.

mbag.name: messenger bag
mbag.description: Light and easy to wear, but doesn't offer much storage.

molle_pack.name: MOLLE pack
molle_pack.description: The Modular Lightweight Load-carrying Equipment is an advanced military backpack.  Covered with pockets and equipment straps, it strikes a fine balance between storage space and encumbrance.

petpack.name: petpack
petpack.description: Before the Cataclysm this would allow your four-legged friend to see the world, now it's used to shield them from the world.

plastic_shopping_bag.name: plastic shopping bag
plastic_shopping_bag.description: A bag used to carry groceries home.

purse.name: purse
purse.description: A bit cumbersome to wear, but provides some storage.

ragpouch.name: pouch
ragpouch.description: A makeshift bag, cobbled together from rags.  Doesn't hold an awful lot but is easy to wear.

rucksack.name: military rucksack
rucksack.description: A huge military rucksack, provides a lot of storage.

runner_bag.name: runner pack
runner_bag.description: The obvious choice for outdoor athletes, this ergonomic backpack is light and easy to wear, ensuring comfort when carrying heavy and bulky items.

slingpack.name: sling pack
slingpack.description: A simple single-sling backpack.  Easier to access than a normal backpack, but can't comfortably hold as much.

straw_basket.name: straw basket
straw_basket.description: Hand made straw basket.  Carry it with you for extra storage.

pack_basket.name: pack basket
pack_basket.description: A large hand made straw basket, with shoulder straps to wear like a backpack.

suitcase_l.name: suitcase
suitcase_l.description: A huge wheeled suitcase used mainly for transporting clothes and other possessions during trips, provides a decent amount of storage but hauling it around is neither fast nor comfortable.

suitcase_m.name: suitcase
suitcase_m.description: A mid-sized suitcase used mainly for transporting clothes and other possessions during trips, provides a decent amount of storage but hauling it around is not exactly comfortable.

survivor_hiking_backpack.name: survivor hiking backpack
survivor_hiking_backpack.description: A custom-built hiking backpack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

survivor_duffel_bag.name: survivor duffel bag
survivor_duffel_bag.description: A custom-built heavy duffel bag.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

survivor_pack.name: survivor MOLLE pack
survivor_pack.description: A custom-built backpack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible, as well as covered with equipment straps for quick access to weapons.

survivor_rucksack.name: survivor rucksack
survivor_rucksack.description: A custom-built heavy backpack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

survivor_runner_pack.name: survivor runner pack
survivor_runner_pack.description: A custom-built lightweight runner pack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.

swag_bag.name: swag bag
swag_bag.description: A large canvas sack, re-purposed for makeshift storage.  Goes well with a striped shirt and a domino mask.

travelpack.name: travelpack
travelpack.description: A hiking pack used for short trips.

vest.name: utility vest
vest.description: A light vest covered in pockets and straps for storage.

bondage_suit.name: bondage suit
bondage_suit.description: A suit of snug, black leather.  Has no pockets, but does feature an abundance of unusually located zippers.

clown_suit.name: clown suit
clown_suit.description: A colorful and ridiculous costume fit for a clown.  Provides decent storage.

dinosuit.name: dinosaur suit
dinosuit.description: A full-body costume in the form of an anthropomorphic dinosaur.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.

jumpsuit.name: jumpsuit
jumpsuit.description: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit; similar to those worn by prisoners.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.

robofac_jumpsuit.name: Hub 01 jumpsuit
robofac_jumpsuit.description: A brown jumpsuit worn by the staff of Hub 01.

subsuit_xl.name: subject suit
subsuit_xl.description: A thin, short-sleeved and short-legged one-piece suit.  Judging by the odd tailoring and adjustment points… maybe you don't want to know who wore it.  Provides nominal storage and is not very encumbering.

union_suit.name: union suit
union_suit.description: A one-piece suit of full-body long underwear that helps to maintain body temperature.  It laces closed in the front.

wolfsuit.name: wolf suit
wolfsuit.description: A full body fursuit in the form of an anthropomorphic wolf.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.

wool_suit.name: wool suit
wool_suit.description: An encumbering wool suit covered in nice patterns.  It looks like full body armor but it only protects against cold, sadly.

zentai.name: zentai
zentai.description: Short for 'zenshin taitsu', a zentai is a form fitting full body nylon and spandex garment.  Though it covers your face, you can see through the integrated hood.  With a couple of these and some friends and you could put on some kabuki.

aep_suit.name: AEP suit
aep_suit.description: An armored environmental protection suit.  Custom-built from a cleansuit and body armor, it provides excellent protection against both physical harm and ambient radiation.

anbc_suit.name: ANBC suit
anbc_suit.description: An armored, impermeable full-body suit that functions as body armor, as well as protecting from nuclear, biological, and chemical hazards.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

armor_blarmor.name: boiled leather armor
armor_blarmor.description: Thick leather body armor that has been hardened via chemical treatment.  Light and strong.

armor_chitin.name: chitinous armor
armor_chitin.description: Leg and body armor made from the exoskeletons of insects.  Light and durable.

armor_acidchitin.name: biosilicified chitin armor
armor_acidchitin.description: Leg and body armor crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Acid-resistant and very durable.

armor_farmor.name: fur body armor
armor_farmor.description: Thick body armor made from furs.  Warm and comfortable.

armor_larmor.name: leather body armor
armor_larmor.description: Thick leather body armor.  Light and comfortable.

armor_lightplate.name: plate armor
armor_lightplate.description: A suit of Gothic plate armor, forged from solid steel and shaped to deflect blows.  It's heavy, but surprisingly easy to move in.

armor_lightplate_superalloy.name: superalloy plate armor
armor_lightplate_superalloy.description: A suit of Gothic plate armor, forged from modern superalloy and shaped to deflect blows.  It's lighter than steel armor.

armor_nomad.name: nomad gear
armor_nomad.description: A makeshift outfit made from pre-Cataclysm clothing designed for long travels.  It has a lot of storage space.

armor_nomad_light.name: light nomad gear
armor_nomad_light.description: A light makeshift outfit made from pre-Cataclysm clothing designed for long summer travels.  It offers less storage space and armor compared to regular nomad gear.

armor_plarmor.name: plated leather armor
armor_plarmor.description: Thick leather body armor that has been reinforced with strategically-placed metal plates.  Strong and comfortable.

armor_plate.name: ornamental plate armor
armor_plate.description: An extremely heavy suit of plate armor, with a prominent codpiece.  The decorative etchings inlaid with gold make it look more like a display piece than serious armor, but the heavy steel plating should be more than enough to keep the wearer safe.

armor_plate_superalloy.name: ornamental superalloy plate armor
armor_plate_superalloy.description: A heavy suit of plate armor, forged from modern superalloy, with a prominent codpiece.  It is decorated with menacing spikes and has been polished to a mirror shine.

armor_riot.name: riot armor
armor_riot.description: Black armor used by riot police officers.  The padded layers and hard plastic shoulder guards offer good protection without much encumbrance.  The word POLICE is emblazoned across the front.

armor_samurai.name: O-yoroi
armor_samurai.description: An ornamental suit of Japanese samurai armor.

armor_scavenger.name: scavenger gear
armor_scavenger.description: A sturdy scavenger's outfit made from refitted protective gear and reinforced with kevlar and heavy plastic.  It has a lot of storage space.

armor_scrapsuit.name: scrap suit
armor_scrapsuit.description: A suit of armor made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.

beekeeping_suit.name: beekeeping suit
beekeeping_suit.description: A white suit commonly worn by professional beekeepers with straps on your ankles and wrists to prevent bees from flying in.  It's not a very tough fabric, but it's lightweight and has plenty of storage thanks to a chest pocket.

chainmail_hauberk.name: chainmail hauberk
chainmail_hauberk.description: A fully customized chainmail outfit, leaving the head uncovered.  The shirt, arms, and leggings have been modified with straps and combined with a gambeson to deal with uneven weight distribution, cold environments and to allow them to be used separately.

chainmail_suit.name: chainmail armor
chainmail_suit.description: A fully customized chainmail suit.  The coif, shirt, arms, and leggings have been modified with straps and combined with a gambeson to deal with uneven weight distribution, cold environments and to allow them to be used separately.

chainmail_suit_faraday.name: faraday chainmail suit
chainmail_suit_faraday.description: A fully customized chainmail suit that can be worn over your normal clothing.  The suit is conductively interconnected, protecting against electricity.

cleansuit.name: cleansuit
cleansuit.description: A simple hazardous materials handling suit.  Though somewhat restrictive and fragile, wearing it will provide excellent protection against ambient radiation.

entry_suit.name: entry suit
entry_suit.description: A flame-resistant whole-body garment worn by firefighters as protection against extreme heat.  Though very restrictive, wearing it will provide excellent protection against fire and smoke.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

fsurvivor_suit.name: survivor firesuit
fsurvivor_suit.description: Heavy, hand-built combination armor made from a cut-down bulletproof vest and a reinforced flame-resistant Nomex jumpsuit.  Protects the wearer from fire and the elements.

gambeson.name: gambeson
gambeson.description: A thick jacket of quilted fabric extending down to your knees, designed to be worn underneath mail or other armor.  Or worn on its own, if you can't afford proper armor.

hazmat_suit.name: hazmat suit
hazmat_suit.description: An impermeable whole-body garment worn as protection against hazardous materials.  Though very restrictive and fragile, wearing it will provide complete protection against ambient radiation.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

hsurvivor_suit.name: heavy survivor suit
hsurvivor_suit.description: A heavy, hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and a metal-plated jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

sasurvivor_suit.name: superalloy survivor suit
sasurvivor_suit.description: A heavy, hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and a superalloy-plated jumpsuit.  Lighter and easier to move in than an equivalent suit made with steel.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

salsurvivor_suit.name: light superalloy survivor suit
salsurvivor_suit.description: A lightweight, hand-built combination armor made from a bulletproof vest and a fabric jumpsuit, all reinforced with superalloy.  It's fairly protective, but less so than a thicker, more comprehensive suit.

lsurvivor_suit.name: light survivor suit
lsurvivor_suit.description: A lightweight, hand-built combination armor made from a cut-down bulletproof vest and a reinforced fabric jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

nomex_suit.name: flame-resistant suit
nomex_suit.description: A snug body suit made from thin and lightweight Nomex fire-resistant fabric.  Tough yet breathable, it is light and comfortable to wear under clothing.

robofac_enviro_suit.name: Hub 01 environmental suit
robofac_enviro_suit.description: A lightweight environmental suit worn by Hub personnel in their rare forays aboveground.  Colored brown and blue, the white seal of Hub 01 is embroidered on both of its upper arms.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

stillsuit.name: WS-47G moisture retention suit
stillsuit.description: The WebbStar moisture retention suit utilizes advanced technology to prevent up to 30% of moisture loss through perspiration.  The suit is powered by the micro-motions of the body, especially breathing and walking motions.  Because of this, your walking speed is impaired while wearing it.

suit.name: suit
suit.description: A full-body cotton suit.  Makes the apocalypse a truly gentlemanly experience.

survivor_suit.name: survivor suit
survivor_suit.description: A hand-built combination armor made from a bulletproof vest and a reinforced leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

swat_armor.name: SWAT armor
swat_armor.description: A suit of black bulletproof armor with lots of pockets.  The word SWAT is emblazoned across the back.

touring_suit.name: leather touring suit
touring_suit.description: A thick leather body suit made for protection while riding motorcycles.  Light and very comfortable.

wsurvivor_suit.name: winter survivor suit
wsurvivor_suit.description: A warm and heavy hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and an insulated leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

armor_carbonplate.name: carbon fiber armor
armor_carbonplate.description: A custom suit of layered carbon fiber armor over neoprene padding made using a 3D printer.  Its rigid plates are more comparable to a suit of armor than kevlar, but it's very protective and moves surprisingly well.

armor_scute.name: scaleskin armor
armor_scute.description: Leg and body armor made from the hardened scales of large reptiles.

trunks.name: pair of swimming trunks
trunks.description: A pair of swimming trunks, with netting.

wetsuit_hood.name: wetsuit hood
wetsuit_hood.description: A neoprene hood, commonly worn by divers.

hood_h20survivor.name: survivor wetsuit hood
hood_h20survivor.description: A customized armored neoprene and Kevlar hood, very strong and durable.

h20survivor_suit.name: survivor wetsuit
h20survivor_suit.description: A lightweight, hand-built combination armor made from a cut-down bulletproof vest and a reinforced neoprene wetsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

gloves_h20survivor.name: pair of survivor wetsuit gloves
gloves_h20survivor.description: A pair of customized, Kevlar armored neoprene gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.

wetsuit_spring.name: spring suit
wetsuit_spring.description: A pink neoprene wetsuit that leaves the legs exposed.  Not as protective as a full-body suit, but also less restrictive and more comfortable in the summer.

shark_suit_faraday.name: faraday shark suit
shark_suit_faraday.description: A one piece chainmail suit used by scuba divers for protection against shark bites.  It has been conductively interconnected, protecting against electricity.

shark_suit.name: shark suit
shark_suit.description: A one piece chainmail suit used by scuba divers for protection against shark bites.  It comes with attached plastic helmet and booties.

goggles_swim.name: pair of swim goggles
goggles_swim.description: A small pair of goggles made for swimming.

wetsuit_gloves.name: pair of swimming gloves
wetsuit_gloves.description: A pair of very flexible neoprene-silicone rubber gloves, suitable for underwater use.

armor_cuirass.name: bell cuirass
armor_cuirass.description: An ancient Greek breastplate, made of bronze.

armor_lamellar.name: lamellar cuirass
armor_lamellar.description: A cuirass made of multiple pieces of tough leather, laced together for durable yet flexible protection.

armor_lamellar_plated.name: plated lamellar cuirass
armor_lamellar_plated.description: A cuirass made of multiple pieces of tough leather and metal scales laced together, forming durable yet flexible protection.

armor_lorica.name: lorica segmentata
armor_lorica.description: An ancient Roman laminar armor, made of overlapping metal strips connected to internal leather straps.

bookplate.name: bookplate
bookplate.description: A crude form of armor made from stacked paper and rolls of duct tape, this breastplate offers a surprising amount of protection.

chainmail_vest.name: chainmail vest
chainmail_vest.description: A customized chainmail vest.  It's a sleeveless piece of chainmail with small straps designed to better distribute the weight.

chestguard_hard.name: hard chest guard
chestguard_hard.description: A plastron of interlocking plastic plate protecting your torso.

cuirass_lightplate.name: cuirass
cuirass_lightplate.description: A steel breastplate, and a vital part of plate armor.  Even as full armor went into decline, cuirasses remained in use among cavalry in Europe.

cuirass_lightplate_superalloy.name: superalloy cuirass
cuirass_lightplate_superalloy.description: A superalloy breastplate, and a vital part of plate armor.  Even as full armor went into decline, cuirasses remained in use among cavalry in Europe.

cuirass_scrap.name: scrap cuirass
cuirass_scrap.description: A cuirass made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.

fencing_jacket.name: fencing jacket
fencing_jacket.description: A padded jacket with the zipper on the back used by fencers to prevent accidents.  It doesn't have any storage room, but it is very comfortable.

jacket_leather_mod.name: armored leather jacket
jacket_leather_mod.description: An armored jacket made from thick leather and metal plates.  Cumbersome, but offers excellent protection from harm.

jacket_leather_bone.name: occult bone armor
jacket_leather_bone.description: A black jacket made from thick leather and covered with intricately carved bones.  You've never seen patterns like those before, each time you look at them you spot a new one as if they were changing on their own.

lame_foil.name: lamé (foil)
lame_foil.description: A thin, lightweight conductive vest with the zipper on the back used by fencers for electronic scoring.  Its outer layer is a woven mix of sturdy cotton and stainless steel strands.

lame_saber.name: lamé (saber)
lame_saber.description: A thin, lightweight conductive jacket used by fencers for electronic scoring.  Its outer layer is a woven mix of sturdy cotton and stainless steel strands.

football_armor.name: football armor
football_armor.description: Heavy plastic armor for your upper torso.  Normally worn by football players.

lsurvivor_armor.name: light survivor body armor
lsurvivor_armor.description: Lightweight, custom-built body armor made from Kevlar and tough fabric.  Mostly waterproof.

motorbike_armor.name: motorcycle armor
motorbike_armor.description: A suit of armor used by dirt bikers and motorcyclists.

plastron_cotton.name: underarm protector
plastron_cotton.description: A sturdy cotton plastron that protects much of the torso, the dominant shoulder, and underarm while fencing.

plastron_plastic.name: plastic chest protector
plastron_plastic.description: A rigid plastic plastron with molded cups to be worn by female fencers for protection while fencing.

vest_leather_mod.name: armored leather vest
vest_leather_mod.description: An armored vest made from thick leather and metal plates.  Cumbersome, but offers excellent protection from harm.

cuirass_bone.name: bone cuirass
cuirass_bone.description: A cuirass made from large pieces of carved bone, laced together like lamellar armor.  Tough but stiff, and a bit brittle.

carbon_chestguard.name: carbon fiber chestguard
carbon_chestguard.description: A custom chestplate of layered carbon fiber armor made using a 3D printer.  Its rigid plates are more comparable to a suit of armor than kevlar, but it's very protective and lightweight.

apron_leather.name: leather apron
apron_leather.description: An apron made of thick leather.  Cumbersome, but offers excellent protection from cuts.

blazer.name: blazer
blazer.description: A professional-looking wool blazer.  Quite cumbersome.

dress.name: dress
dress.description: A long cotton dress.  Though comfortable to wear, it lacks any storage space.

dress_shirt.name: dress shirt
dress_shirt.description: A white button-down shirt with long sleeves.  Looks professional!

dress_wedding.name: wedding dress
dress_wedding.description: A beautiful white wedding dress.  What good will it be now?

flag_shirt.name: flag shirt
flag_shirt.description: A t-shirt embroidered with the pattern of an American flag.

flotation_vest.name: flotation vest
flotation_vest.description: A brightly-colored vest designed to keep you upright and floating in water.

flotation_vest_ms.name: makeshift flotation vest
flotation_vest_ms.description: A flotation vest made of inflated animal skins.

gown.name: evening gown
gown.description: A luxurious evening gown.  It accentuates your curves, or lack thereof.

halter_top.name: halter top
halter_top.description: A short top made from cotton.  It is light and easy to wear.

hoodie.name: hoodie
hoodie.description: A sweatshirt with a hood and a "kangaroo pocket" in the front for storage.

jersey.name: sports jersey
jersey.description: A shirt made of thick material imprinted with the name and logo of a sports team.

leotard.name: leotard
leotard.description: A skin-tight spandex garment, covering the body from the groin to the shoulders.  With its deep scoop-cut back and high waist cuts, this garment is perfect for showcasing your physique on the stage.

linuxtshirt.name: Linux t-shirt
linuxtshirt.description: A t-shirt with a Linux logo on it and a pithy slogan of some sort.

maid_dress.name: French maid clothes
maid_dress.description: The French maid dress, blue with a frilly white apron.

polo_shirt.name: polo shirt
polo_shirt.description: A short-sleeved cotton shirt, slightly thicker than a t-shirt.

postman_shirt.name: mail carrier shirt
postman_shirt.description: A light blue button down shirt with a couple of pockets in front and the US postal service logo embroidered on it.

sheriffshirt.name: sheriff's shirt
sheriffshirt.description: A tan button-down shirt with long sleeves.

striped_shirt.name: striped shirt
striped_shirt.description: A long-sleeved shirt with horizontal black and white stripes.

sundress.name: sundress
sundress.description: A light and breezy cotton dress.  Though cool and comfortable to wear, it lacks any storage space.

sweatshirt.name: sweatshirt
sweatshirt.description: A thick cotton shirt.  Provides warmth and a bit of padding.

technician_shirt_gray.name: work t-shirt
technician_shirt_gray.description: A gray work t-shirt with a small front pocket.

tshirt_text.name: t-shirt
tshirt_text.description: A short-sleeved cotton shirt.  It's got some text printed on it.

hoodie_drugrug.name: drug rug
hoodie_drugrug.description: A hooded pullover made of a coarse, woven fabric.  Popular among festival-goers and chill backpackers.  Smells faintly of patchouli.

vest_leather.name: leather vest
vest_leather.description: A vest made from thick leather.  Offers excellent protection from cuts.

wool_hoodie.name: wool hoodie
wool_hoodie.description: A wool hooded shirt.  It offers decent protection against the cold.  The front pocket offers both storage room and shelter for your hands.

alohashirt.name: hawaiian shirt
alohashirt.description: A colorful short-sleeved button-up shirt.  Fashionable and comfortable for a day out at the beach.

arm_warmers.name: pair of arm warmers
arm_warmers.description: Snug, soft cloth sleeves to keep your arms warm.

army_top.name: camo tank top
army_top.description: A sleeveless cotton shirt with camouflage dye.  Very easy to move in.

boxer_briefs.name: boxer briefs
boxer_briefs.description: The age-old question, boxers or briefs?  Your answer?  Yes.

boxer_shorts.name: boxer shorts
boxer_shorts.description: Men's boxer shorts.  More fashionable than briefs and just as comfortable.

boy_shorts.name: boy shorts
boy_shorts.description: Female underwear similar to men's boxer shorts, but much more close-fitting.

bra.name: bra
bra.description: A simple bra.  For protecting those bits you don't want zombies to look at.

briefs.name: briefs
briefs.description: A pair of briefs.  Comfortable underwear worn by men.

camisole.name: camisole
camisole.description: A small camisole made from silk.  Typically used as an undergarment, they are light and easy to wear.

chestwrap.name: chestwrap
chestwrap.description: Rags wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.

chestwrap_fur.name: fur chestwrap
chestwrap_fur.description: Fur pelts wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.

chestwrap_leather.name: leather chestwrap
chestwrap_leather.description: Leather patches wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.

chestwrap_wool.name: wool chestwrap
chestwrap_wool.description: Felt patches wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.

corset.name: leather corset
corset.description: A snug, black leather corset.  Has no pockets, but its thick material provides good protection from harm.

leg_warmers.name: pair of leg warmers
leg_warmers.description: Snug, soft cloth sleeves to keep your legs warm.

leg_warmers_f.name: pair of fur leggings
leg_warmers_f.description: Snug fur sleeves to keep your legs warm.  Simple yet effective since prehistoric times.

long_underpants.name: long underwear bottom
long_underpants.description: A pair of long underwear that help to maintain body temperature.

long_undertop.name: long underwear top
long_undertop.description: A long underwear top that helps to maintain body temperature.

long_undertop_sleeveless.name: sleeveless underwear top
long_undertop_sleeveless.description: A sleeveless underwear top that helps to maintain body temperature.

panties.name: panties
panties.description: Underwear designed to be worn by women.  Preserves your modesty in desperate times.

thermal_shirt.name: thermal shirt
thermal_shirt.description: A lightweight, form-fitting long-sleeved spandex undershirt that helps maintains body temperature.

sports_bra.name: sports bra
sports_bra.description: A sturdy nylon bra to provide additional support during physical movement.  Typically worn when exercising, it clings to the skin and is easy to wear.

tank_top.name: tank top
tank_top.description: A sleeveless cotton shirt.  Very easy to move in.

tights.name: tights
tights.description: A snug cloth garment which clings tightly to the legs and feet to protect them from the cold.

under_armor.name: compression top
under_armor.description: Nylon sportswear that clings to your chest and maintains body temperature.

under_armor_shorts.name: compression shorts
under_armor_shorts.description: Nylon sportswear that clings to your upper legs, aiding muscle tone and maintaining warmth.

undershirt.name: undershirt
undershirt.description: A simple white undershirt.  Worn beneath your regular clothes, it provides a little extra warmth.

unitard.name: unitard
unitard.description: A skin-tight spandex garment resembling a crew necked leotard combined with leggings.  Commonly used by gymnasts, dancers and equestrian vaulters, the unitard provides overall coverage with great flexibility.

arm_splint.name: arm splint
arm_splint.description: A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.

arm_xlsplint.name: arm splint XL
arm_xlsplint.description: A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge survivors.

blindfold.name: blindfold
blindfold.description: A simple fabric covering tied over the eyes to block sight.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.

ear_plugs.name: pair of ear plugs
ear_plugs.description: Industrial grade ear plugs that fit inside the ear.  Adequate for most purposes, though you'll want to pair them with protective earmuffs if you're firing high-powered rifles or artillery.

gobag.name: go bag
gobag.description: A huge duffel bag with backpack attached, both packed to the gills.  Judging by the feel, a National Guard soldier could have packed this to be ready for deployment.  Activate to unpack and enjoy.

personal_gobag.name: personal go bag
personal_gobag.description: A huge duffel bag with backpack attached, both packed to the gills.  You have packed this to be ready for deployment.  Activate to unpack and enjoy.

leg_splint.name: leg splint
leg_splint.description: A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.

leg_xlsplint.name: leg splint XL
leg_xlsplint.description: A tool to help set bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge people.

welding_mask.name: welding mask
welding_mask.description: A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to push it up your head.

use_action.msg: You push your %s up your head.

welding_mask_crude.name: crude welding mask
welding_mask_crude.description: A crude welding mask made from shaped steel.  It's less dark than a proper welding mask, and therefore less difficult to see in, but also less protective when welding.  Activate it to push it up your head.

use_action.msg: You push your %s up your head.

welding_mask_crude_raised.name: crude welding mask (raised)
welding_mask_crude_raised.description: A crude welding mask made from shaped steel.  It's less dark than a proper welding mask, and therefore less difficult to see in, but also less protective when welding.  Activate it to lower it over your face.

use_action.msg: You lower your crude welding mask over your face.

welding_mask_raised.name: welding mask (raised)
welding_mask_raised.description: A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to lower it over your face.

use_action.msg: You lower your welding mask over your face.

attached_ear_plugs_on.name: pair of attached ear plugs (in)
attached_ear_plugs_on.description: A pair of industrial grade ear plugs attached together by some string.  Adequate for most purposes, though you'll want to pair them with protective earmuffs if you're firing high-powered rifles or artillery.  They are inside your ears, activate them to take them out.

use_action.msg: You take the ear plugs out.

attached_ear_plugs_off.name: pair of attached ear plugs (out)
attached_ear_plugs_off.description: A pair of industrial grade ear plugs, they are attached together by some string.  They hang around your neck, use them to plug them in.  They'll protect your hearing from most sounds when plugged in, though for high-powered rifles or artillery you'd want to pair them with protective earmuffs.

use_action.msg: You plug up your ears.

mask_halfsurvivor.name: survivor half-mask
mask_halfsurvivor.description: A custom-built, reinforced gas mask that covers just the mouth.  Provides excellent protection from smoke.  It must be prepared before use.

nature_ghillie.name: woodland ghillie suit
nature_ghillie.description: A bulky woodland camo suit covered with natural and synthetic foliage meant to reduce visibility in natural environments.

urban_ghillie.name: urban ghillie suit
urban_ghillie.description: A bulky gray camo suit covered with debris and garbage bags meant to reduce visibility in urban and rocky environments.

armor_bone.name: bone body armor
armor_bone.description: Body armor consisting of a leather suit with strategically-placed bone reinforcement.  Light and strong.

gauntlets_bone.name: pair of bone armor gauntlets
gauntlets_bone.description: Leather gauntlets with bone armor reinforcement.  Very light and strong.

ballistic_vest_empty.name: empty ballistic vest
ballistic_vest_empty.description: Ballistic armor without any armor inserts.  The soft armor plate carrier is still protective but it won't stop high energy projectiles.

ballistic_vest_esapi.name: ESAPI ballistic vest
ballistic_vest_esapi.description: Ballistic armor with ESAPI ceramic armor plates.

modularvestkevlar.name: MBR vest (Kevlar plates)
modularvestkevlar.description: A Modular Bullet Resistant Vest.  Kevlar plates have been inserted to improve its protection.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

xlkevlar.name: XL Kevlar vest
xlkevlar.description: A massive, hand-built Kevlar vest based on the design of existing bullet resistant vests.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

optical_cloak.name: FB51 optical cloak
optical_cloak.description: A plastic cloak embedded with cameras and LEDs that will render you fully invisible to normal vision when powered and worn.  You must be carrying a unified power supply, or UPS, to use it.  Activate to toggle visibility.

use_action.msg: Your optical cloak flickers as it becomes transparent.
use_action.need_charges_msg: You don't have enough UPS charges to turn on the %s

optical_cloak_on.name: FB51 optical cloak (on)
optical_cloak_on.description: A plastic cloak embedded with cameras and LEDs that will render you fully invisible to normal vision when powered and worn.  You must be carrying a unified power supply, or UPS, to use it.  Activate to toggle visibility.

use_action.msg: The %s flickers for a moment as it becomes opaque.

helmet_scavenger.name: scavenger cowl
helmet_scavenger.description: A sturdy protective cowl extending down to the neck, fitted with a respirator, helmet, certain level of glare and eye protection.  For dangerous scavenging ventures.

clown_nose.name: clown nose
clown_nose.description: A red latex nose often seen being worn by clowns.  Squeezing the nose makes it honk.

depowered_plating.name: salvaged power armor plating
depowered_plating.description: This used to be a set of heavy power armor plates, now stripped down, but still having standard power armor attachment points.  Removing much of the cumbersome plating results in a less encumbering set of plates that come at the expense of ballistic resistance.

use_action.msg: The %s feels lighter.

depowered_plating_on.name: salvaged power armor plating (active)
depowered_plating_on.description: This used to be a set of heavy power armor plates, now stripped down, but still having standard power armor attachment points.  Removing much of the cumbersome plating results in a less encumbering set of plates that come at the expense of ballistic resistance.

use_action.msg: The %s feels heavier.

depowered_plating_on.name_plural: sets of salvaged power armor plating (active)

power_armor_exo_1.name: prototype power armor exoskeleton
power_armor_exo_1.description: Colloquially known as a 'tank suit' in the media, these bulky exoskeletons, complete with a similarly bulky chemical resistant bodyglove, were tested in military service a few years back and determined to be too heavy and expensive for regular use. It doubles your effective weight, and it's almost impossible not to bump into things.  This exoskeleton features the required attachment points to equip power armor plating, helmets, and attachments.  The bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.

use_action.msg: The %s engages.
use_action.set_charges_msg: You need a UPS or a bionic armor interface to power this.

power_armor_exo_1_on.name: prototype power armor exoskeleton (active)
power_armor_exo_1_on.description: Colloquially known as a 'tank suit' in the media, these bulky exoskeletons, complete with a similarly bulky chemical resistant bodyglove, were tested in military service a few years back and determined to be too heavy and expensive for regular use. It doubles your effective weight, and it's almost impossible not to bump into things.  This exoskeleton features the required attachment points to equip power armor plating, helmets, and attachments.  The bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s disengages.

power_armor_plating_1.name: heavy power armor plating
power_armor_plating_1.description: These thick segmented armor plates were tested in military service a few years back and determined to be too heavy and expensive for regular use.  Now that they're in your hands, though, you have a set of massive armor plates with standard power armor exoskeleton attachment points, capable of negating anything up to armor-piercing .30-06 rounds.  On the other hand, they are tremendously heavy and somewhat encumbering, even when used with an active exoskeleton.

use_action.msg: The %s feels lighter.

power_armor_plating_1.name_plural: sets of heavy power armor plating

power_armor_plating_1_on.name: heavy power armor plating (active)
power_armor_plating_1_on.description: These thick segmented armor plates were tested in military service a few years back and determined to be too heavy and expensive for regular use.  Now that they're in your hands, though, you have a set of massive armor plates with standard power armor exoskeleton attachment points, capable of negating anything up to armor-piercing .30-06 rounds.  On the other hand, they are tremendously heavy and somewhat encumbering, even when used with an active exoskeleton.

use_action.msg: The %s feels heavier.

power_armor_plating_1_on.name_plural: sets of heavy power armor plating (active)

power_armor_exo_2.name: power armor exoskeleton
power_armor_exo_2.description: These were the second wave of military combat exoskeleton, and got a lot of media attention, with popular Navy commercials featuring them heavily.  It consists of a muscle-boosting exoskeleton frame with an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove.  Despite advancements over the original bulky 'tank suits', it's still highly cumbersome when inactive.  This exoskeleton features the required attachment points to equip power armor plating, helmets, and attachments.  The bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.

use_action.msg: The %s engages.
use_action.set_charges_msg: You need a UPS or a bionic armor interface to power this.

power_armor_exo_2_on.name: power armor exoskeleton (active)
power_armor_exo_2_on.description: These were the second wave of military combat exoskeleton, and got a lot of media attention, with popular Navy commercials featuring them heavily.  It consists of a muscle-boosting exoskeleton frame with an integrated chemical resistant bodyglove.  Despite advancements over the original bulky 'tank suits', it's still highly cumbersome when inactive.  This exoskeleton features the required attachment points to equip power armor plating, helmets, and attachments.  The bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s disengages.

power_armor_plating_2.name: power armor plating
power_armor_plating_2.description: These were made with the second wave of military combat exoskeleton, and got a lot of media attention, with popular Navy commercials featuring them heavily.  It consists of overlayed segmented alloy plating with standard power armor exoskeleton attachment points, rated to provide complete protection against 7.62x51mm rounds.

use_action.msg: The %s feels lighter.

power_armor_plating_2_on.name: power armor plating (active)
power_armor_plating_2_on.description: These were made with the second wave of military combat exoskeleton, and got a lot of media attention, with popular Navy commercials featuring them heavily.  It consists of overlayed segmented alloy plating with standard power armor exoskeleton attachment points, rated to provide complete protection against 7.62x51mm rounds.

use_action.msg: The %s feels heavier.

power_armor_exo_3.name: advanced power armor exoskeleton
power_armor_exo_3.description: The final iteration of military combat exoskeletons before the fall of civilization, this type - a powered strength-boosting exoskeleton made with lightweight high-tech materials and a slimmed-down integrated chemical resistant bodyglove - was designed for actual widespread combat use and was seen on the front lines during the last days of the cataclysm.  Much more light, maneuverable, and powerful than the heavier suits.  Unfortunately, the world ended before it could roll out in significant numbers.  This exoskeleton features the required attachment points to equip power armor plating, helmets, and attachments.  The bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.

use_action.msg: The %s engages.
use_action.set_charges_msg: You need a UPS or a bionic armor interface to power this.

power_armor_exo_3_on.name: advanced power armor exoskeleton (active)
power_armor_exo_3_on.description: The final iteration of military combat exoskeletons before the fall of civilization, this type - a powered strength-boosting exoskeleton made with lightweight high-tech materials and a slimmed-down integrated chemical resistant bodyglove - was designed for actual widespread combat use and was seen on the front lines during the last days of the cataclysm.  Much more light, maneuverable, and powerful than the heavier suits.  Unfortunately, the world ended before it could roll out in significant numbers.  This exoskeleton features the required attachment points to equip power armor plating, helmets, and attachments.  The bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s disengages.

power_armor_plating_3.name: light power armor plating
power_armor_plating_3.description: The final iteration of military power armor plating before the fall of civilization, this type - made with lightweight high-tech segmented plating with standard power armor exoskeleton attachment points - was designed for actual widespread combat use and was seen on the front lines during the last days of the cataclysm.  Much more light and maneuverable than heavier plates, and still reliably protects against anything up to 5.56x45mm.  Unfortunately, the world ended before it could roll out in significant numbers.

use_action.msg: The %s feels lighter.

power_armor_plating_3.name_plural: sets of light power armor plating

power_armor_plating_3_on.name: light power armor plating (active)
power_armor_plating_3_on.description: The final iteration of military power armor plating before the fall of civilization, this type - made with lightweight high-tech segmented plating with standard power armor exoskeleton attachment points - was designed for actual widespread combat use and was seen on the front lines during the last days of the cataclysm.  Much more light and maneuverable than heavier plates, and still reliably protects against anything up to 5.56x45mm.  Unfortunately, the world ended before it could roll out in significant numbers.

use_action.msg: The %s feels heavier.

power_armor_plating_3_on.name_plural: sets of light power armor plating (active)

power_armor_helmet_basic.name: power armor helmet
power_armor_helmet_basic.description: A fully enclosed combat helmet for hazardous environments, this was designed to fit with a powered exoskeleton, using cameras to expand visual range.  In practice, the cameras were unreliable and easily fouled.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

use_action.msg: The %s seals shut and beeps once.

power_armor_helmet_basic_on.name: power armor helmet (active)
power_armor_helmet_basic_on.description: A fully enclosed combat helmet for hazardous environments, this was designed to fit with a powered exoskeleton, using cameras to expand visual range.  In practice, the cameras were unreliable and easily fouled.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

use_action.msg: The %s powers down.

power_armor_helmet_heavy.name: heavy power armor helmet
power_armor_helmet_heavy.description: An extremely heavy-duty fully enclosed combat helmet for hazardous environments, this was designed to fit with a powered exoskeleton.  In the field, soldiers reported that the protection was not worth the awkward size and limited visuals.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

use_action.msg: The %s seals shut and beeps once.

power_armor_helmet_heavy_on.name: heavy power armor helmet (active)
power_armor_helmet_heavy_on.description: An extremely heavy-duty fully enclosed combat helmet for hazardous environments, this was designed to fit with a powered exoskeleton.  In the field, soldiers reported that the protection was not worth the awkward size and limited visuals.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

use_action.msg: The %s powers down.

power_armor_helmet_light.name: light power armor helmet
power_armor_helmet_light.description: This full-enclosure helmet was designed based on commercial diving equipment, in response to complaints that earlier designs were impossible to use in combat.  While still a little more restrictive than regular combat headgear - and frustrating should your nose itch - this one received far better reviews from soldiers.  Sadly, civilization ended before they could roll out in significant numbers.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

use_action.msg: The %s seals shut and beeps once.

power_armor_helmet_light_on.name: light power armor helmet (active)
power_armor_helmet_light_on.description: This full-enclosure helmet was designed based on commercial diving equipment, in response to complaints that earlier designs were impossible to use in combat.  While still a little more restrictive than regular combat headgear - and frustrating should your nose itch - this one received far better reviews from soldiers.  Sadly, civilization ended before they could roll out in significant numbers.  The environmental controls function best with direct-skin contact.

use_action.msg: The %s powers down.

power_armor_frame.name: power armor hauling frame
power_armor_frame.description: A heavy duty hauling frame designed to interface with power armor exoskeletons.

heavy_power_armor_frame.name: advanced power armor hauling frame
heavy_power_armor_frame.description: A cutting-edge advanced hauling frame made from superalloy designed to interface with power armor exoskeletons, and compact enough to be used alongside a normal hauling frame.  Barely deployed before the Cataclysm struck.

exosuit_survivor.name: powered survivor suit
exosuit_survivor.description: Although power armor took the world's militaries by storm, not everyone has access to it.  This particular suit is cobbled together from scavenged materials, but it works for what it is.

use_action.msg: The %s engages.

exosuit_survivor_on.name: powered survivor suit (active)
exosuit_survivor_on.description: Although power armor took the world's militaries by storm, not everyone has access to it.  This particular suit is cobbled together from scavenged materials, but it works for what it is.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s disengages.

exosuit_military.name: military exo-suit
exosuit_military.description: Although power armor took the world's militaries by storm, the technologies used to make them also allowed for smaller, less protective external rigging that rely on UPS to boost strength and speed, ones designed for operatives or light infantry.

use_action.msg: The %s engages.

exosuit_military_on.name: military exo-suit (active)
exosuit_military_on.description: Although power armor took the world's militaries by storm, the technologies used to make them also allowed for smaller, less protective external rigging that rely on UPS to boost strength and speed, ones designed for operatives or light infantry rather than heavy infantry.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s disengages.

exosuit_industrial.name: industrial exo-suit
exosuit_industrial.description: Although power armor took the world's militaries by storm, the technologies used to make them also allowed for smaller, industrial powered suits meant for heavy lifting.

use_action.msg: The %s engages.

exosuit_industrial_on.name: industrial exo-suit (active)
exosuit_industrial_on.description: Although power armor took the world's militaries by storm, the technologies used to make them also allowed for industrial powered suits meant for heavy lifting.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s disengages.

wrist_comp_budget.name: wrist computer
wrist_comp_budget.description: A fancy wrist-mounted computer, with a menagerie of useful features, such as SD reading, a built-in thermometer, and even a radiation monitor!

use_action.msg: You activate the flashlight.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The wrist computer's charge is too low.

use_action.training_msg: You update software and check logs, improving your understanding slightly.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The wrist computer's batteries need more charge.

wrist_comp_control.name: wrist control computer
wrist_comp_control.description: A modified wrist-mounted computer, now capable of transmitting in the ultra-high frequencies utilized by robots, including drones which provide targeting info.  Activate it to command robots from afar or utilize its other features.

use_action.msg: You activate the flashlight.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The wrist computer's charge is too low.

use_action.msg: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The wrist control computer's batteries need more charge.

miner_hat.name: mining helmet
miner_hat.description: This is a mining helmet with a heavy-duty LED flashlight.  Using this will turn the flashlight on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

use_action.msg: You turn the helmet on.

miner_hat_on.name: mining helmet (on)
miner_hat_on.description: This is a mining helmet with a heavy-duty LED flashlight.  The flashlight is turned on, and continually draining its batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s flicks off.

game_watch.name: smart watch
game_watch.description: A waterproof smart watch, powered by UPS.  It has reliable weather data from its built-in sensors and some pre-installed apps.  Activate to use.

holo_cloak.name: hologram cloak
holo_cloak.description: A cloak woven with metallic fibers and covered with hexagonal sheets of reflective carbide.  When activated, it will create a holographic decoy of its wearer.

fedora.name: fedora

use_action.msg: You tip your %s.

fedora.description: A high-crowned, wide-brimmed, sable colored fedora.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.  The perfect hat for treasure hunting.

thermal_socks.name: pair of thermal electric socks
thermal_socks.description: This is a pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

thermal_socks_on.name: pair of thermal electric socks (on)
thermal_socks_on.description: This is a pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  They are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

thermal_suit.name: thermal electric suit
thermal_suit.description: This is a full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

thermal_suit_on.name: thermal electric suit (on)
thermal_suit_on.description: This is a full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

thermal_gloves.name: pair of thermal electric gloves
thermal_gloves.description: This is a pair of gloves with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

thermal_gloves_on.name: pair of thermal electric gloves (on)
thermal_gloves_on.description: This is a pair of gloves with internal battery-powered heating elements.  They are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

thermal_mask.name: thermal electric balaclava
thermal_mask.description: This is a snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

thermal_mask_on.name: thermal electric balaclava (on)
thermal_mask_on.description: This is a snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

thermal_cooling.name: liquid cooling outfit
thermal_cooling.description: This skintight suit covers you from head to toe and is designed to keep you at an ideal temperature using a number of heatsinks and heating coils tied to a liquid coolant system.  It also includes some handy features such as a built-in thermometer.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

thermal_cooling_on.name: liquid cooling outfit (on)
thermal_cooling_on.description: This skintight suit covers you from head to toe and is designed to keep you at an ideal temperature using a number of heatsinks and heating coils tied to a liquid coolant system.  It also includes some handy features such as a built-in thermometer.  It is currently on, use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

thermal_cooling_mask.name: liquid cooling balaclava
thermal_cooling_mask.description: This face mask is designed to keep your face and head at an ideal temperature using a number of heatsinks and heating coils tied to a liquid coolant system.  It also includes some handy features such as a built-in thermometer.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

thermal_cooling_mask_on.name: liquid cooling balaclava (on)
thermal_cooling_mask_on.description: This face mask is designed to keep your face and head at an ideal temperature using a number of heatsinks and heating coils tied to a liquid coolant system.  It also includes some handy features such as a built-in thermometer.  It is currently on, use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

thermal_cooling_suit.name: liquid cooling suit
thermal_cooling_suit.description: This a bodysuit with a number of heatsinks and heating coils tied to a liquid coolant system, and a built-in thermometer.  Use it to turn it on, helping to keep the entire body at an ideal temperature

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

thermal_cooling_suit_on.name: liquid cooling suit (on)
thermal_cooling_suit_on.description: This a bodysuit with a number of heatsinks and heating coils tied to a liquid coolant system, and a built-in thermometer.  It is currently working to keep the entire body at an ideal temperature, use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

binoculars.name: pair of binoculars
binoculars.description: A pair of optics with a neck strap attached.  Useful for seeing long distances.  Wearing this item or carrying it in your inventory will double the distance around you that is mapped during your travels.  You could also use them to focus the sunlight.

wearable_light.name: headlamp
wearable_light.description: This is an LED headlamp with an adjustable strap so as to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the headlamp on.

wearable_light_on.name: headlamp (on)
wearable_light_on.description: This is an LED headlamp with an adjustable strap so as to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s flicks off.

sparkledogsuit.name: sparkledog suit
sparkledogsuit.description: A full body fursuit in the form of some unidentifiable species. It's a riot of clashing neon colors, LEDs, and glitter. It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.  Using it will turn the LEDs on.

use_action.msg: You turn your fursuit's LEDs on.

sparkledogsuit_on.name: sparkledog suit (on)
sparkledogsuit_on.description: A full body fursuit in the form of some unidentifiable species. It's a riot of clashing neon colors, LEDs, and glitter. It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.  Using it will turn the LEDs on.

use_action.msg: You turn your fursuit off.

survivor_light.name: survivor headlamp
survivor_light.description: This is a custom-made LED headlamp reinforced to be more durable and with a more efficient battery pack.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the survivor headlamp on.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The survivor headlamp batteries are dead.

survivor_light_on.name: survivor headlamp (on)
survivor_light_on.description: This is a custom-made LED headlamp reinforced to be more durable, and with a more efficient battery pack.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s flicks off.

wearable_atomic_light.name: atomic headlamp
wearable_atomic_light.description: This is a custom-made reinforced headlamp powered by the magic of nuclear decay, focused for more usable brightness.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.

use_action.msg: You close the headlamp's cover.

wearable_atomic_light_off.name: atomic headlamp (covered)
wearable_atomic_light_off.description: This is a custom-made reinforced headlamp powered by the magic of nuclear decay, focused for more usable brightness.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.

use_action.msg: You open the headlamp's cover.

rm13_armor.name: RM13 combat armor
rm13_armor.description: Internally powered by a maximum of ten plutonium fuel cells, this full-body suit of sleek black military armor represents the pinnacle of Rivtech's non-rigid powered armor technology.  While inactive it can protect from most pistol rounds.  When active, its powered ballistic shielding can shrug off 5.56x45mm.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your RM13 combat armor.
use_action.need_charges_msg: It seems like this device needs power.

rm13_armor_on.name: RM13 combat armor (on)
rm13_armor_on.description: Internally powered by a maximum of ten plutonium fuel cells, this full-body suit of sleek black military armor represents the pinnacle of Rivtech's non-rigid powered armor technology.  It is turned on and continually draining power, its powered ballistic shielding protecting against anything up to 5.56x45mm.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your RM13 combat armor turns off.

dimensional_anchor.name: 5-point anchor
dimensional_anchor.description: A featureless, disc-shaped device mounted on a harness.  The words "X.E.D.R.A" and "5-point anchor" are inscribed on its front and back.

use_action.msg: A LED light in the %s LED flickers on.
use_action.need_charges_msg: It seems like this device needs power.

dimensional_anchor_on.name: 5-point anchor (on)
dimensional_anchor_on.description: The harness' shoulder mounted LED glows with a soft green hue.  There's no further indication of anything happening.

use_action.msg: The %s LED light flickers off.

phase_immersion_suit.name: phase immersion suit
phase_immersion_suit.description: Covered in interlocking plates of reflective metal, this advanced suit resembles both plate armor and an astronaut's spacesuit.  Designed to protect its wearer during extra dimensional excursions, it offers unparalleled environmental protection, both in this Earth and beyond.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg:
Initiating
Running suit integrity diagnostics…
All systems operational.
use_action.need_charges_msg: Warning: Operating on minimal power.  Protection compromised.

phase_immersion_suit_on.name: phase immersion suit (on)
phase_immersion_suit_on.description: Covered in interlocking plates of reflective metal, this advanced suit resembles both plate armor and an astronaut's spacesuit.  It is turned on, and continually draining power.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Suit shutting down.

rebreather.name: rebreather mask
rebreather.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

rebreather_on.name: rebreather mask (on)
rebreather_on.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

rebreather_xl.name: XL rebreather mask
rebreather_xl.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been expanded substantially and can accommodate exotic anatomy.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

rebreather_xl_on.name: XL rebreather mask (on)
rebreather_xl_on.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been expanded substantially and can accommodate exotic anatomy.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

mask_filter.name: filter mask
mask_filter.description: A mask that straps over your mouth and nose and filters air.  Protects from smoke, dust, and other contaminants quite well.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_gas.name: gas mask
mask_gas.description: A full gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and other contaminants.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_gas_xl.name: XL gas mask
mask_gas_xl.description: A rather roomy mask with filters attached, designed to accommodate exotic anatomy.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and other contaminants.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_fsurvivor.name: survivor firemask
mask_fsurvivor.description: A custom-built, Nomex-insulated gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  It provides excellent protection from heat, smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_bunker.name: firefighter PBA mask
mask_bunker.description: A full-face mask commonly used by firefighters.  The protective breathing apparatus provides excellent protection from smoke, flame, and other dangers.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_hsurvivor.name: heavy survivor mask
mask_hsurvivor.description: A custom-built, steel reinforced gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_sasurvivor.name: superalloy survivor mask
