mask_sasurvivor.description: A custom-built, superalloy reinforced gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_lsurvivor.name: light survivor mask
mask_lsurvivor.description: A custom-built, reinforced gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_survivor.name: survivor mask
mask_survivor.description: A custom-built, leather reinforced gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_wsurvivor.name: winter survivor mask
mask_wsurvivor.description: A custom-built, fur-trimmed gas mask that covers the face and eyes.  Quite warm, it still provides excellent protection from smoke, teargas, and shrapnel.  It must be prepared before use.

goggles_nv.name: pair of light amp goggles
goggles_nv.description: A pair of battery-powered goggles that amplify ambient light, allowing you to see in the dark.  Use it to turn them on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s and pull them down over your eyes.

goggles_nv_on.name: pair of light amp goggles (on)
goggles_nv_on.description: A pair of battery-powered light amplifying goggles with an infrared illuminator, allowing you to see in the dark.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates and you push them up.

goggles_nv_enhanced.name: enhanced light amp goggles
goggles_nv_enhanced.description: Modern light enhancement goggles that greatly amplify ambient light, allowing you to see in the dark almost perfectly, all while looking properly tactical.  Use it to turn them on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s and pull them down over your eyes.

goggles_nv_enhanced_on.name: enhanced light amp goggles (on)
goggles_nv_enhanced_on.description: Modern light enhancement goggles that greatly amplify ambient light, allowing you to see in the dark almost perfectly, all while looking properly tactical.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates and you push them up.

goggles_ir.name: pair of infrared goggles
goggles_ir.description: A pair of battery-powered goggles that grant infrared vision, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark.  Use it to turn them on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s and pull them down over your eyes.

goggles_ir_on.name: pair of infrared goggles (on)
goggles_ir_on.description: A pair of battery-powered goggles that grant infrared vision, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark.  Use it to turn them off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates and you push them up.

wearable_rx12.name: wearable RX12 jet injector
wearable_rx12.description: This is a modified RX12 jet injector which can be worn on the body.  A label on the side warns against using more than two doses per hour.

rx11_stimpack.name: RX11 stimulant delivery system
rx11_stimpack.description: The Rivtech RX11 stimulant delivery system is a jet autoinjector system worn on the user's body.  A simple press of its activator injects powerful chemical stimulants into the bloodstream without using a needle.

mask_h20survivor.name: survivor divemask
mask_h20survivor.description: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes.  It provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

mask_h20survivor_on.name: survivor divemask (on)
mask_h20survivor_on.description: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes.  It provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

folding_poncho_on.name: unfolded poncho
folding_poncho_on.description: A lightweight plastic rain poncho with a hood.  Use it to fold for storage.

emer_blanket_on.name: emergency blanket
emer_blanket_on.description: A blanket made of space-age material that covers your most important body parts.  Use it to fold for storage.

rad_monitor.name: radiation biomonitor
rad_monitor.description: A small battery-powered biometric safety device worn on the wrist.  Activate to check your current level of radiation exposure.

hairpin.name: hairpin
hairpin.description: A plain hairpin to keep your hair in place.

fc_hairpin.name: fancy hairpin
fc_hairpin.description: A pink hairpin with cute flower textures.

towel.name: towel
towel.description: This is a fluffy and large towel.  It could be used to dry yourself.  Any person that can travel the length and breadth of the apocalypse, rough it, slum it, struggle against terrible odds, win through and still know where their towel is, is clearly a force to be reckoned with.

towel_wet.name: towel
towel_wet.description: This is a large, sopping wet towel.  If you wait a little bit, it should dry out.  Don't panic.

towel_soiled.name: soiled towel
towel_soiled.description: This is a large towel, covered in a thick, gooey liquid.  You'll need to wash it in some water to make it usable again.  Don't panic.

straw_fedora.name: straw fedora

straw_fedora.description: Straw fedora hat, comfortable and stylish.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.

patchwork_scarf.name: simple patchwork scarf
patchwork_scarf.description: A simple and light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.

use_action.msg: You loosen your %s.

patchwork_scarf_loose.name: simple patchwork scarf (loose)
patchwork_scarf_loose.description: A simple and light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it tighter if you get too cold.

use_action.msg: You wrap your scarf tighter.

long_patchwork_scarf.name: long patchwork scarf
long_patchwork_scarf.description: A very long light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle oversized wearers and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.

use_action.msg: You loosen your %s.

thermal_outfit.name: thermal electric outfit
thermal_outfit.description: This suit of thin thermal underwear covers you from head to toe and is equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s.

thermal_outfit_on.name: thermal electric outfit (on)
thermal_outfit_on.description: This suit of thin thermal underwear covers you from head to toe and is equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

mask_ski.name: ski mask

use_action.msg: You adjust your ski mask for less warmth.

mask_ski.description: A warm wool mask that protects the head and face from cold.  It has a full face opening that can be adjusted to set how much is exposed.

mask_ski_loose.name: ski mask (open)

use_action.msg: You adjust your ski mask for more warmth.

mask_ski_loose.description: A warm wool mask that protects the head and face from cold.  It has a full face opening that can be adjusted to set how much is exposed.

whistle.name: whistle
whistle.description: A simple metal whistle, with a cord to wear it around your neck.

harmonica_holder.name: harmonica with a holder

player_descriptions: You produce a happy tune on the harmonica.
You whistle on the harmonica.
npc_descriptions: produce a happy tune on the harmonica.

harmonica_holder.description: A harmonica with a holder, so that you can play it without a free hand.

acoustic_guitar.name: acoustic guitar

player_descriptions: You strum a few chords on the guitar.
You pluck a few notes on the guitar.
You play a slow blues-y tune on the guitar.
npc_descriptions: strum a few chords on the guitar.
pluck a few notes on the guitar.
play a slow blues-y tune on the guitar.

acoustic_guitar.description: A simple wooden acoustic guitar with a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.

guitar_electric.name: electric guitar

player_descriptions: You plink out a shredding solo on your guitar.
You play an epic classic rock riff on your guitar.
You play a furious, muted riff on your guitar.
You play a crunchy stoner tune on your guitar.
You play an old Britpop song on your guitar.
You play a tasteful classical piece on your guitar.
You play a jangly folk ditty on your guitar.
You play a melancholy melody on your guitar.

guitar_electric.description: A standard factory-made electric guitar.  It's probably better at smashing heads than melting faces, these days.  Has a strap.

bagpipes.name: bagpipes

player_descriptions: Your pipes drone loudly as you strikes a battle hymn from the chanter.
Your pipes drone a slow and piercing dirge.
You strike a lively quick step march on their pipes.
npc_descriptions: pipes drone loudly as it strikes a battle hymn from the chanter.
pipes drone a slow and piercing dirge.
strike a lively quick step march on their pipes.

bagpipes.description: A traditional musical instrument using enclosed reeds fed from a reservoir of air contained within a leather bag.  It has a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.

tuba.name: tuba

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on the tuba.
You play a ditty on the tuba.
You play a marching tune on the tuba.
npc_descriptions: play a little tune on the tuba.
play a ditty on the tuba.
play a marching tune on the tuba.

tuba.description: A big ol' tuba.  Much easier to play when wearing.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on the saxophone.
You play a soulful jazz piece on the sax.
You play a quick, energetic ditty on the sax.
npc_descriptions: play a little tune on the saxophone.
play a soulful jazz piece on the sax.
play a quick, energetic ditty on the sax.

saxophone.description: A brass alto saxophone with a neck strap, so you can wear it while playing.

powered_earmuffs.name: shooter's earmuffs
powered_earmuffs.description: A pair of earmuffs favored by shooters.  Currently turned off they block most sounds, though you should pair them with ear plugs if firing high-powered rifles or artillery.  If turned on they provide the same protection while still allowing you to hear normal sounds.

use_action.msg: You turn the earmuffs on.

powered_earmuffs_on.name: shooter's earmuffs (on)
powered_earmuffs_on.description: A pair of earmuffs favored by shooters.  The earmuffs are turned on, protecting you from most loud sounds short of high-powered rifles or artillery without compromising your ability to hear.

use_action.msg: The %s flicks off.

army_powered_earmuffs.name: tactical headset
army_powered_earmuffs.description: An active headset used by the military.  Currently turned off they block most sounds, though you should pair them with ear plugs if firing high-powered rifles or artillery.  If turned on they provide the same protection while still allowing you to hear normal sounds, and double as a two-way radio.

use_action.msg: You turn the headset on.

army_powered_earmuffs_on.name: tactical headset (on)
army_powered_earmuffs_on.description: An active headset used by the military.  They're turned on, serving as a two-way radio and protecting you from most loud sounds short of high-powered rifles or artillery, without compromising your ability to hear.

use_action.msg: The %s flicks off.

stethoscope.name: stethoscope
stethoscope.description: This is a medical listening tool.  Use it to listen to things.  Closely.

makeshift_stethoscope.name: makeshift stethoscope
makeshift_stethoscope.description: This is a relatively cumbersome DIY child's medical listening toy.  Use it to listen to things.  Closely.

solarpack.name: solar backpack (folded)
solarpack.description: Personal portable charging system consisting of an array of solar panels neatly folded in a form of a large backpack.  It can be worn as one, and has an integrated cable to plug it into a cable charger system.

solarpack_on.name: solar backpack (unfolded)
solarpack_on.description: Unfolded array of portable solar panels ready to push some power into an active cable charger system.

helmet_riot.name: riot helmet
helmet_riot.description: A helmet with a plastic shield that covers your entire face.  Activate to raise the face shield.

use_action.msg: You raise your visor.

helmet_riot_raised.name: riot helmet (raised visor)
helmet_riot_raised.description: A riot helmet with a plastic face shield which is raised up.  Activate to lower the shield.

use_action.msg: You put down your visor.

scuba_tank.name: scuba tank
scuba_tank.description: This is a high-pressure 232 bar diving tank that can contain up to 12L of compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is equipped with an on-demand regulator and a mouthpiece designed mostly for underwater use.

scuba_tank_on.name: scuba tank (on)
scuba_tank_on.description: This is a high-pressure 232 bar diving tank that can contain up to 12L of compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is equipped with an on-demand regulator and a mouthpiece designed mostly for underwater use.

small_scuba_tank.name: small scuba tank
small_scuba_tank.description: This is a small high-pressure 200 bar backup diving tank, that can contain 4L of compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is equipped with an on-demand regulator and a mouthpiece designed mostly for underwater use.

small_scuba_tank_on.name: small scuba tank (on)
small_scuba_tank_on.description: This is a small high-pressure 200 bar backup diving tank, that can contain 4L of compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is equipped with an on-demand regulator and a mouthpiece designed mostly for underwater use.

electric_blanket.name: electric blanket
electric_blanket.description: A heated blanket made of polyester.  The most comfortable thing on Earth.  Its cost is usually negligible, but with the power out, it chews through batteries insanely quickly.

use_action.msg: You turn the blanket's heating elements on.

electric_blanket_on.name: electric blanket (on)
electric_blanket_on.description: A heated blanket made of polyster.  It's turned on, making it nice and toasty while it lasts.

use_action.msg: You turn the blanket's heating elements off.

foodperson_mask.name: Foodperson mask
foodperson_mask.description: Foodperson, the mascot your stomach deserves!

use_action.msg: Your HUD lights-up: "Greetings Foodperson, your shift begins now.  Good luck!"

foodperson_mask_on.name: Foodperson mask (on)
foodperson_mask_on.description: Foodperson, the mascot your stomach deserves!

scouter.name: scouting visor
scouter.description: This device is a head-mounted, UPS-powered, augmented reality electronic multitool used by tech enthusiasts before the Cataclysm struck, projecting a HUD onto a transparent screen that goes over your eye.  They have a variety of features, including a clock, smart phone capabilities, two-way radio, GPS, various environmental sensors, and night vision.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s's night vision mode.

scouter_nv_on.name: scouting visor (NV Mode)
scouter_nv_on.description: This device is a head-mounted, UPS-powered, augmented reality scanning tool used by tech enthusiasts before the Cataclysm struck, projecting a HUD onto a transparent screen that goes over your eye.  The night vision mode is currently on, draining power.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

mil_scouter.name: upgraded scouting visor
mil_scouter.description: This device is a head-mounted, UPS-powered, augmented reality scanning tool that projects a HUD onto a transparent screen that goes over your eye.  This particular visor has been illegally upgraded to use military GPS satellite connections, broadening its range and allowing it to receive targeting info from any nearby friendly drones.

use_action.msg: You activate your %s's night vision mode.

mil_scouter_nv_on.name: upgraded scouting visor (NV Mode)
mil_scouter_nv_on.description: This device is a head-mounted, UPS-powered, augmented reality scanning tool used by tech enthusiasts before the Cataclysm struck, projecting a HUD onto a transparent screen that goes over your eye.  The night vision mode is currently on, draining power.

use_action.msg: Your %s deactivates.

q_solarpack.name: quantum solar backpack (folded)
q_solarpack.description: Personal portable charging system consisting of an array of quantum solar panels neatly folded in a form of a large backpack.  It can be worn as one, and has an integrated cable to plug it into a cable charger system.  Cutting edge technology.

q_solarpack_on.name: quantum solar backpack (unfolded)
q_solarpack_on.description: Unfolded array of portable quantum solar panels ready to push some power into an active cable charger system.

fitness_band.name: fitness band
fitness_band.description: A fitness band that can track your heartbeat, exercise level and also has a clock.  Activate to see your metrics.

power_armor_basic.name: power armor
power_armor_basic.description: These were the second wave of military combat exoskeleton, and got a lot of media attention, with popular Navy commercials featuring them heavily.  It consists of a muscle-boosting exoskeleton frame with overlayed segmented alloy plating, rated to provide complete protection against 7.62x51mm rounds.  Despite advancements over the original bulky 'tank suits', it's still highly cumbersome when inactive.  An integrated chemical resistant bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.

use_action.msg: The %s engages.
use_action.set_charges_msg: You need a UPS or a bionic armor interface to power this.

power_armor_basic_on.name: power armor (active)
power_armor_basic_on.description: These were the second wave of military combat exoskeleton, and got a lot of media attention, with popular Navy commercials featuring them heavily.  It consists of a muscle-boosting exoskeleton frame with overlayed segmented alloy plating, rated to provide complete protection against 7.62x51mm rounds. An integrated chemical resistant bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s disengages.

power_armor_heavy.name: heavy power armor
power_armor_heavy.description: Colloquially known as a 'tank suit' in the media, these bulky exoskeletons, covered in thick segmented armor plates, were tested in military service a few years back and determined to be too heavy and expensive for regular use.  Now that it's in your hands, though, you have a massive suit of power armor capable of negating anything up to armor-piercing .30-06 rounds.  On the other hand, it doubles your effective weight, and it's almost impossible not to bump into things.  An integrated chemical resistant bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.

use_action.msg: The %s engages.
use_action.set_charges_msg: You need a UPS or a bionic armor interface to power this.

power_armor_light.description: The final iteration of military power armor before the fall of civilization, this type - a powered exoskeleton with high-tech segmented plating - was designed for actual widespread combat use and was seen on the front lines during the last days of the cataclysm.  Much more light and maneuverable than the heavier suits, and still reliably protects against anything up to 5.56x45mm.  Unfortunately, the world ended before it could roll out in significant numbers.  An integrated chemical resistant bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.

An integrated chemical resistant bodyglove precludes wearing other clothing, aside from most undergarments or handheld equipment like shields.  It is currently turned on, activate it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: The %s disengages.

kevlar_armor_medium_quadruped.name: Kevlar-lined medium quadruped peto
kevlar_armor_medium_quadruped.description: A heavy mattress-like armor of cloth, leather and thick linings of Kevlar, originally used as protection in bullfighting.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

acidchitin_armor_medium_quadruped.name: biosilicified chitin medium quadruped armor
acidchitin_armor_medium_quadruped.description: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from biosilicified chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

chitin_armor_medium_quadruped.name: chitin medium quadruped armor
chitin_armor_medium_quadruped.description: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

chainmail_armor_medium_quadruped.name: chainmail medium quadruped armor
chainmail_armor_medium_quadruped.description: A heavy covering of chainmail, suitably made for medium quadrupeds as protection.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

leather_armor_medium_quadruped.name: boiled leather medium quadruped barding with caprison
leather_armor_medium_quadruped.description: A full barding for medium quadrupeds consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison is depicting a battle between a monstrous dragon and regal griffin.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.
leather_armor_medium_quadruped.name_plural: boiled leather medium quadruped bardings with caprison

leatherbone_armor_medium_quadruped.name: boiled leather medium quadruped barding with bones
leatherbone_armor_medium_quadruped.description: Decorative bones affixed to leather medium quadruped barding to invoke fear in bandits and raiders and traders all!  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.
leatherbone_armor_medium_quadruped.name_plural: boiled leather medium quadruped bardings with bones

rubber_armor_medium_quadruped.name: medium quadruped rain sheet
rubber_armor_medium_quadruped.description: A thin plastic covering adapted for medium quadrupeds to protect from acid rain and other caustic sources.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

superalloy_armor_medium_quadruped.name: superalloy medium quadruped armor
superalloy_armor_medium_quadruped.description: A thin mesh interwoven with superalloy plates for military working medium quadrupeds that covers from the dewlap to the croup, down to the elbows.  You could put this on a friendly medium quadruped.

kevlar_armor_small_quadruped.name: Kevlar-lined small quadruped peto
kevlar_armor_small_quadruped.description: A heavy mattress-like armor of cloth, leather and thick linings of Kevlar, originally used as protection in bullfighting.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

acidchitin_armor_small_quadruped.name: biosilicified chitin small quadruped armor
acidchitin_armor_small_quadruped.description: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from biosilicified chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

chitin_armor_small_quadruped.name: chitin small quadruped armor
chitin_armor_small_quadruped.description: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

chainmail_armor_small_quadruped.name: chainmail small quadruped armor
chainmail_armor_small_quadruped.description: Protecteth yon hund fram ful daemons!  A heavy covering of chainmail, suitably made for small quadrupeds as protection.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

leather_armor_small_quadruped.name: boiled leather small quadruped barding with caprison
leather_armor_small_quadruped.description: A full barding for small quadrupeds consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison is depicting a battle between a monstrous dragon and regal griffin.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.
leather_armor_small_quadruped.name_plural: boiled leather small quadruped bardings with caprison

leatherbone_armor_small_quadruped.name: boiled leather small quadruped barding with bones
leatherbone_armor_small_quadruped.description: Decorative bones affixed to leather small quadruped barding to invoke fear in bandits and raiders and traders all!  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.
leatherbone_armor_small_quadruped.name_plural: boiled leather small quadruped bardings with bones

rubber_armor_small_quadruped.name: small quadruped rain sheet
rubber_armor_small_quadruped.description: A thin plastic covering adapted for small quadrupeds to protect from acid rain and other caustic sources.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

superalloy_armor_small_quadruped.name: superalloy small quadruped armor
superalloy_armor_small_quadruped.description: A thin mesh interwoven with superalloy plates for military working small quadrupeds that covers from the dewlap to the croup, down to the elbows.  You could put this on a friendly small quadruped.

hide_bag.name: hide bag
hide_bag.description: The raw skin of an animal, quickly turned into a makeshift bag for storage.  It will still rot, and needs to be cured and tanned.

hide_tainted_bag.name: tainted hide bag
hide_tainted_bag.description: The raw skin of a monster, quickly turned into a makeshift bag for storage.  It will still rot, and needs to be cured and tanned.

feces_bird.name: bird litter
feces_bird.description: Bird dropping, feathers, and soiled bits of rubbish.

feces_cow.name: cow pie
feces_cow.description: A fresh cow pie, could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.

feces_manure.name: manure
feces_manure.description: Common manure, could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.

feces_roach.name: roach dirt
feces_roach.description: Large black pellets of rotting material.

fungicide.name: fungicide
fungicide.description: Agricultural grade chemical anti-fungal powder designed to destroy infections in plants.

water_acid.name: acid water
water_acid.description: Water collected during an acid rainstorm.  Don't drink it.  Boiling it concentrates the acid.

water_acid_weak.name: weak acid water
water_acid_weak.description: A mixture of rain and acid rain.  Don't drink it.  Boiling it concentrates the acid.

pur_tablets.name: water purification tablet
pur_tablets.description: Intended for the clarification and disinfection of unsafe drinking water, these halazone-based purification tablets remove dangerous contaminants using powerful chemicals.  The label says one tablet purifies up to 2L of water.

chem_DMSO.name: dimethyl sulfoxide
chem_DMSO.description: Dimethyl sulfoxide, or DMSO, is a common and important aprotic solvent, capable of dissolving a huge range of things.  It can help many chemical agents diffuse more quickly through the skin, and has a mild analgesic effect on its own.

chem_peptone_broth.name: peptone broth powder
chem_peptone_broth.description: This is a pre-mixed salty solution of protein and sugar.  It's meant for bacteria to eat, but if you were desperate you could eat it too; it's not much different from cup noodle stock.

chem_agar.name: agar
chem_agar.description: These clear cubes of processed seaweed can be dissolved in boiling water to create a very sturdy, temperature resistant gel.  Not only is it good for making gels to separate molecules by size, but it's a great cheat ingredient to make sure your jellies set properly.

acetylene.name: acetylene
acetylene.description: A flammable gas that explodes under pressure.  Combined with oxygen, acetylene makes a great welding gas.

shimmer.name: Shimmer! Floor Wax and Dessert Topping
shimmer.description: It's durable and it's scuff resistant!  It even cleans your clothes!  But despite the advertisements, it is not, in fact, delicious.
shimmer.name_plural: Shimmer! Floor Wax and Dessert Topping

wine_mycus.name: marloss wine
wine_mycus.description: Goopy white wine, made from the fruit of the marloss.

wine_riesling.name: Riesling
wine_riesling.description: Sparkling white wine, made from the world's noblest grape.

wine_chardonnay.name: Chardonnay
wine_chardonnay.description: America's most popular wine, and for good reason.

wine_cabernet.name: Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_cabernet.description: The heavily disputed king of red wines.  Pairs well with red meats and pasta.

wine_noir.name: pinot noir
wine_noir.description: Prized by collectors and adored by critics, it is one of the rarer and more elegant wines.

wine_marsala.name: marsala
wine_marsala.description: A wine popularly used in dishes served in Italian restaurants.

wine_vermouth.name: vermouth
wine_vermouth.description: A soft wine with a pleasant herbal flavor and aroma.  It is a common cocktail ingredient, and can be used as a substitute for white wine.

whiskey.name: whiskey
whiskey.description: A distilled grain alcohol, made from, by, and for real Southern colonels!

vodka.name: vodka
vodka.description: A beverage of alcohol, water, and not much else.  In America, men make vodka, but in Soviet Russia, vodka makes the man.

gin.name: gin
gin.description: An alcoholic beverage flavored with juniper berries.  It smells faintly of berries, but mostly booze.

rum.name: rum
rum.description: A distilled alcoholic beverage made from fermenting molasses.  Drinking it might make you feel like a pirate.  Or not.

tequila.name: tequila
tequila.description: A distilled alcoholic beverage made from a succulent plant with spiky leaves.  Don't eat the worm!  Wait, there's no worm in this bottle.

triple_sec.name: triple sec
triple_sec.description: An orange flavored liquor used in many mixed drinks.

mixed_alcohol_strong.name: strong mixed alcohol
mixed_alcohol_strong.description: Strong alcoholic drinks, mixed with no regard for taste.

mixed_alcohol_weak.name: weak mixed alcohol
mixed_alcohol_weak.description: Weak alcoholic drinks, mixed with no regard for taste.

fruit_wine.name: fruit wine
fruit_wine.description: Cheap booze made from fermented fruit juice.  Tastes just like it sounds.

brandy.name: brandy
brandy.description: Wine that has been distilled to a higher proof.  Great as an after-dinner drink, but packs a punch.

irish_coffee.name: Irish coffee
irish_coffee.description: Sweetened coffee and whiskey topped with milk.  Start your day the closeted alcoholic way!

irish_coffee_atomic.name: atomic Irish coffee
irish_coffee_atomic.description: Sweetened atomic coffee and whiskey topped with milk.  This coffee cocktail has been created using an atomic coffee pot's FULL NUCLEAR brewing cycle.  Start your day the neo-alcoholic way!

long_island.name: Long Island iced tea
long_island.description: A blend of incredibly strong-flavored liquors that somehow tastes like none of them.  It contains no tea, but the inclusion of cola gives it a tea-like color.

drink_screwdriver.name: screwdriver cocktail
drink_screwdriver.description: A mix of orange juice and vodka.  It's the surreptitious drunkard mechanic's drink of choice.

drink_wild_apple.name: wild apple
drink_wild_apple.description: Like apple cider, only with vodka.

drink_rumcola.name: rum & cola
drink_rumcola.description: Suitable for tropical retreats and Canadian artists alike.

beer.name: beer
beer.description: A grain alcohol flavored with hops.  It's best served cold, in a glass, and with a lime - but you're not that lucky.

mead.name: spiced mead
mead.description: Well-aged honey wine, spiced with a hint of hops.  Goes down bittersweet.

dandelion_wine.name: dandelion wine
dandelion_wine.description: A light and delicious wine made from dandelion flowers.  Slightly effervescent, it is smooth and crisp.

burdock_wine.name: burdock wine
burdock_wine.description: A light and delicious wine made from burdock roots.  Somewhat sweet.

pine_wine.name: pine wine
pine_wine.description: A potent wine flavored with pine resin.  Bold and pungent, its biting taste and strong aroma takes some getting used to.

hb_beer.name: homebrew beer
hb_beer.description: Not the finest drink you've had, but hey, it's alcohol by the gallon.

moonshine.name: moonshine
moonshine.description: Only the strongest, purest, good ol' fashioned hooch, distilled from corn and sugar.  Guaranteed to make you forget about the whole Cataclysm thing, or you get your vision back.

european_pilsner.name: European pilsner
european_pilsner.description: A lager beer imported from Europe.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.

pale_ale.name: American pale ale
pale_ale.description: A tasty craft beer.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.

india_pale_ale.name: India pale ale
india_pale_ale.description: A very flavorful microbrewed beer.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.

stout.name: stout
stout.description: A tasty craft beer, as dark in color as the days ahead.

belgian_ale.name: Belgian ale
belgian_ale.description: A flavorful and filling beer brewed by monks in Belgium.  Best served in a goblet.

imperial_stout.name: imperial stout
imperial_stout.description: A very flavorful beer that has been aged in bourbon barrels.  It is as black as midnight on a moonless night and has the viscosity of oil.  While very tasty, it also has an alcohol content on the level with wine.

drink_strawberry_surprise.name: strawberry surprise
drink_strawberry_surprise.description: Strawberries left to ferment with a few other choice ingredients offer up a surprisingly palatable mixture; you barely even have to force yourself to drink it after the first few gulps.

drink_boozeberry.name: boozeberry
drink_boozeberry.description: This fermented blueberry mixture is surprisingly hearty, though the soup-like consistency is slightly unsettling no matter how much you drink.

single_malt_whiskey.name: single malt whiskey
single_malt_whiskey.description: Only the finest whiskey straight from the bung.

single_pot_whiskey.name: single pot still Irish whiskey
single_pot_whiskey.description: A whiskey made from a mixed mash of malted and unmalted barley.

canadian_whiskey.name: Canadian whiskey
canadian_whiskey.description: A multi-grain liquor made from a mash of corn and rye.

sherry.name: sherry
sherry.description: East India Solera.  A true drink of a British gentleman.  Sherry, Niles?

bristol_sherry.name: Bristol Cream
bristol_sherry.description: A fine sherry that has been aged in American oak casks and bottled in Bristol, England.

madeira.name: Madeira wine
madeira.description: Fortified wine from Madeira.  A true Royal Navy drink.

drink_hobo.name: fancy hobo
drink_hobo.description: This definitely tastes like a hobo drink.

drink_kalimotxo.name: kalimotxo
drink_kalimotxo.description: A mix of equal parts wine and cola.  It's not as bad as some might imagine, and pretty popular among young and/or poor people in some countries.

drink_beeknees.name: bee's knees
drink_beeknees.description: This cocktail dates from the Prohibition era.  Gin, honey and lemon in a delightful mix.

drink_wsour.name: whiskey sour
drink_wsour.description: A mixed drink made of whiskey and lemon juice.

honey_gold.name: honeygold brew
honey_gold.description: A mixed drink containing all the advantages of its ingredients and none of their disadvantages.  It tastes great and it's a good source of nourishment.

honey_ant.name: honey ball
honey_ant.description: Droplet shaped ant food.  It's like a thick balloon the size of a baseball, filled with sticky liquid.  Unlike bee honey, this has mostly a sour taste, probably because ants feed upon a variety of things.

eggnog_spiked.name: spiked eggnog
eggnog_spiked.description: Smooth and rich, this spoon-coating mixture of milk, cream, eggs, and booze is a popular traditional holiday drink.  Having been fortified with alcohol, it will keep for a long time.

drink_martini.name: martini
drink_martini.description: This is a popular cocktail made with gin and dry vermouth, dating from the Prohibition era.

sake.name: sake
sake.description: The traditional alcohol of Japan, this wine is made from rice.

donut_holes.name: donut holes
donut_holes.description: These balls of dough have been cut into shape, covered with sugar, and cooked to a crisp.  A staple of fairgrounds everywhere.

sourdough_young_uncovered.name: juvenile sourdough starter
sourdough_young_uncovered.description: A floury paste that is slowly going bad.  Someday it will be sourdough.

use_action.msg: After feeding it and caring for it for a week, your sourdough starter is finally ready for the big leagues.
use_action.not_ready_msg: You've been caring for your starter for a while, but it's going to need longer before you can do anything tasty with it.

sourdough_split_uncovered.name: freshly fed sourdough starter
sourdough_split_uncovered.description: A floury paste with sourdough starter mixed in.  It needs a day to recover its strength before it can be used again.

use_action.msg: The starter is now stinky and bubbly, and looks ready for cooking.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The starter isn't quite ready to go.

sourdough_starter_uncovered.name: sourdough starter
sourdough_starter_uncovered.description: A precious mix of flour, water, molds and bacteria from the air.  When you add flour and water to it, after a few hours it froths and rises.

sourdough_bread.name: sourdough bread
sourdough_bread.description: Healthy and filling, with a sharper taste and thicker crust than yeast-only bread.

bread_garlic.name: garlic bread
bread_garlic.description: Bread cooked with garlic, oil and seasonings.

johnnycake.name: johnnycake
johnnycake.description: A dense and tasty fried bread treat.

blinkie.name: blinkie
blinkie.description: A sweet, cream-filled snack cake with an indefinitely long shelf life. For all you know, this could be the last one that anyone will enjoy in the whole universe.

fried_blinkie.name: fried blinkie
fried_blinkie.description: A sweet, cream-filled snack cake.  This one has been removed from the packaging and deep fried, greatly reducing its shelf life.

tortilla_corn.name: corn tortilla
tortilla_corn.description: A round, thin flatbread made from finely ground corn flour.

hardtack.name: hardtack
hardtack.description: A dry and virtually tasteless bread product capable of remaining edible without spoilage for vast lengths of time.

biscuit.name: biscuit
biscuit.description: Wholesome and filling, this home made biscuit is pretty good!

wastebread.name: wastebread
wastebread.description: Flour is a commodity these days and to deal with that, most survivors resort to mix it with leftovers of other ingredients and bake it all into bread.  It's filling, and that's what matters.

brew_mycus_wine.name: mycus wine must
brew_mycus_wine.description: Unfermented mycus wine.  A goopy white mess, made from fruit of mycus.  It smells sweetly of mushrooms.

brew_whiskey.name: whiskey wort
brew_whiskey.description: Unfermented whiskey.  The base of a fine drink.  Not the traditional preparation, but you don't have the time.

wash_whiskey.name: whiskey wash
wash_whiskey.description: Fermented, but not distilled whiskey.  No longer tastes sweet.

brew_gin.name: fermenting gin mash
brew_gin.description: Undistilled gin mash.  Distilling it will produce gin.

gin_mash.name: gin mash
gin_mash.description: Gin mash, after the junipers have had time to add flavor, ready to be distilled or drunk as is.

brew_vodka.name: vodka wort
brew_vodka.description: Unfermented vodka.  Water with sugar from enzymatic breakdown of malted grains or just added in pure form.

wash_vodka.name: vodka wash
wash_vodka.description: Fermented, but not distilled vodka.  No longer tastes sweet.

brew_rum.name: rum wort
brew_rum.description: Unfermented rum.  Sugar caramel or molasses brewed into sweet water.  Basically a saccharine soup.

wash_rum.name: rum wash
wash_rum.description: Fermented, but not distilled rum.  No longer tastes sweet.

brew_fruit_wine.name: fruit wine must
brew_fruit_wine.description: Unfermented fruit wine.  A sweet, boiled juice made from berries or fruit.

brew_dandelion_wine.name: dandelion wine must
brew_dandelion_wine.description: Unfermented dandelion wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and dandelion petals.

brew_burdock_wine.name: burdock wine must
brew_burdock_wine.description: Unfermented burdock wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and burdock roots.

brew_pine_wine.name: pine wine must
brew_pine_wine.description: Unfermented pine wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and pine resins.

brew_mead.name: spiced mead must
brew_mead.description: Unfermented spiced mead.  Diluted honey and yeast.

brew_hb_beer.name: beer wort
brew_hb_beer.description: Unfermented homebrew beer.  A boiled and chilled mash of malted barley, spiced with some fine hops.

brew_moonshine.name: moonshine mash
brew_moonshine.description: Unfermented moonshine.  Just some water, sugar and corn, like good ol' aunt's recipe.

wash_moonshine.name: moonshine wash
wash_moonshine.description: Fermented, but not distilled moonshine.  Contains all the contaminants you don't want in your moonshine.

brew_vinegar.name: unfermented vinegar
brew_vinegar.description: Mixture of water, alcohol and fruit juice that will eventually become vinegar.

fish.name: fillet of fish
fish.description: Freshly caught fish.  Makes a passable meal raw.

fish_cooked_seasoned.name: cooked seasoned fish
fish_cooked_seasoned.description: Freshly cooked fish with seasoning.  Very nutritious.

hstomach.name: human stomach
hstomach.description: The stomach of a human.  It is surprisingly durable.

hstomach_large.name: large human stomach
hstomach_large.description: The stomach of a large humanoid creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

human_fat.name: chunk of human fat
human_fat.description: Freshly harvested from a human body.

human_tallow.name: human tallow
human_tallow.description: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered human fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

human_lard.name: human lard
human_lard.description: A smooth white block of dry-rendered human fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

human_flesh.name: human flesh
human_flesh.description: Freshly butchered from a human body.

human_cooked.name: cooked creep
human_cooked.description: A freshly cooked slice of some unpleasant person.  Tastes great.

human_cooked_seasoned.name: cooked seasoned creep
human_cooked_seasoned.description: A freshly cooked slice of some unpleasant person.  Tastes great especially with the seasoning.

meat.name: chunk of meat
meat.description: Freshly butchered meat.  You could eat it raw, but cooking it is better.

meat_scrap.name: scrap of meat
meat_scrap.description: This is a tiny scrap of edible meat.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.

mutant_meat.name: chunk of mutant meat
mutant_meat.description: Meat from a heavily mutated animal.

mutant_meat_scrap.name: scrap of mutant meat
mutant_meat_scrap.description: A tiny scrap of meat from a heavily mutated animal.  It smells a bit odd, and is hard to chew.  Still, seems digestible at least, if you cook it and remove the worst parts.

mutant_human_flesh.name: mutant humanoid meat
mutant_human_flesh.description: Freshly butchered from the body of a heavily mutated creature that was unsettlingly humanoid in appearance.  It smells like a failed chemical experiment.  You'd have to be crazy or starving to eat this.

mutant_human_cooked.name: cooked cretin
mutant_human_cooked.description: Cooked meat from a heavily mutated humanoid.  Now that it no longer smells like industrial waste, it's probably digestible, if not very appetizing.

mutant_human_cooked_seasoned.name: cooked seasoned cretin
mutant_human_cooked_seasoned.description: Cooked meat from a heavily mutated humanoid with added seasoning.

meat_cooked.name: cooked meat
meat_cooked.description: This is a chunk of freshly cooked meat.  It's filling and nutritious, but unseasoned and a bit bland.

meat_cooked_seasoned.name: cooked seasoned meat
meat_cooked_seasoned.description: This is a chunk of freshly cooked meat with added seasoning.  It's filling and nutritious.

meat_scrap_cooked.name: cooked scrap of meat
meat_scrap_cooked.description: This is a tiny scrap of cooked meat.  Tasty, if not exactly filling.

meat_scrap_cooked_seasoned.name: cooked scrap of seasoned meat
meat_scrap_cooked_seasoned.description: This is a tiny scrap of cooked meat with added seasoning.

mutant_meat_cooked.name: cooked mutant meat
mutant_meat_cooked.description: This is a cooked chunk of meat from a mutated animal.  Still tough and the color is wrong, but at least it smells edible now.

mutant_meat_scrap_cooked.name: cooked scrap of mutant meat
mutant_meat_scrap_cooked.description: This is a tiny scrap of meat from a mutated animal.  Still tough and the color is wrong, but at least it smells edible now.

mutant_meat_cooked_seasoned.name: cooked seasoned mutant meat
mutant_meat_cooked_seasoned.description: This is a cooked chunk of meat from a mutated animal with added seasoning.  Still tough and the color is wrong, but at least it smells edible now.

mutant_meat_scrap_cooked_seasoned.name: cooked scrap of seasoned mutant meat
mutant_meat_scrap_cooked_seasoned.description: This is a tiny scrap of meat from a mutated animal with added seasoning.  Still tough and the color is wrong, but at least it smells edible now.
mutant_meat_scrap_cooked_seasoned.name_plural: cooked scraps of seasoned mutant meat

offal.name: raw offal
offal.description: Offal is uncooked internal organs and entrails.  It's filled with essential vitamins, but most people consider it a bit gross unless very carefully prepared.

offal_pickled.name: pickled offal
offal_pickled.description: This is a mass of entrails and organ meat, preserved in brine.  Packed with essential vitamins, and although it looks like a lab specimen, it actually tastes pretty palatable.

offal_canned.name: canned offal
offal_canned.description: Freshly cooked organ meat and entrails, preserved by canning.  Unappetizing, but filled with essential vitamins.

mutant_offal.name: raw mutant offal
mutant_offal.description: Unidentified organs of a mutated animal.  Wildly different between individual specimens, even those otherwise identical.  Many resemble unmutated organs on the outside, but their placement often clearly implies different function.  Weirdly colored fluids and the chemical smell make them unappetizing.

mutant_bug_organs.name: mutant organs
mutant_bug_organs.description: These organs came from a giant mutant bug.

stomach.name: stomach
stomach.description: The stomach of a woodland creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

stomach_large.name: large stomach
stomach_large.description: The stomach of a large woodland creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

jerky.name: meat jerky
jerky.description: Salty dried meat that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.

salted_fish.name: salted fish
salted_fish.description: Salty dried fish that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.

meat_smoked.name: smoked meat
meat_smoked.description: Tasty meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.

fish_smoked.name: smoked fish
fish_smoked.description: Tasty fish that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.

lung.name: piece of raw lung
lung.description: A portion of lung from an animal.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.  It can be a delicacy if properly prepared - but if improperly prepared, it's a chewy lump of flavorless connective tissue.

mutant_bug_lungs.name: mutant lungs
mutant_bug_lungs.description: You're pretty sure this is lung tissue.

liver.name: raw liver
liver.description: The liver from an animal.  Although many dislike the texture, it's one of the more vitamin rich parts of the animal.  It is very good in sausages, but maybe a little less appetizing when cooked on its own.

brain.name: raw brains
brain.description: The brain from an animal.  You wouldn't want to eat this raw…

kidney.name: raw kidney
kidney.description: The kidney from an animal.  Preparing it for cooking is a challenge unless you want the kitchen to smell strongly of urine.

sweetbread.name: raw sweetbread
sweetbread.description: Sweetbreads are the thymus or pancreas of an animal.  These are a delicacy, if prepared properly.

blood.name: blood
blood.description: Blood, possibly that of a human.  Disgusting!

animal_blood.name: animal blood
animal_blood.description: Blood extracted from a living creature.

blood_concentrate.name: concentrated blood
blood_concentrate.description: Blood concentrated by some means.  It just looks and feels wrong.

animal_blood_concentrate.name: concentrated animal blood
animal_blood_concentrate.description: Blood extracted from a living creature, concentrated by some means.

mutant_blood.name: mutant blood
mutant_blood.description: Blood extracted from a heavily mutated creature.

mutant_blood_concentrate.name: concentrated mutant blood
mutant_blood_concentrate.description: Blood from a mutated creature, concentrated by some means.  Despite it being a liquid, some parts are thicker than the other.

bone.name: bone
bone.description: A bone from some creature or other.  Could be used to make some stuff, like needles.

fat.name: chunk of fat
fat.description: Freshly butchered fat.  You could eat it raw, but it is better used as an ingredient in other foods or projects.

tallow.name: tallow
tallow.description: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered animal fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

lard.name: lard
lard.description: A smooth white block of dry-rendered animal fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

mutant_fat.name: chunk of mutant fat
mutant_fat.description: Freshly butchered fat from a heavily mutated animal.  You could eat it raw, but it is better used as an ingredient in other foods or projects.

mutant_tallow.name: mutant tallow
mutant_tallow.description: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered fat sourced from a mutant animal.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

mutant_lard.name: mutant lard
mutant_lard.description: A smooth white block of dry-rendered fat sourced from a mutant animal.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

mutant_human_fat.name: chunk of mutant humanoid fat
mutant_human_fat.description: Freshly butchered fat from a heavily mutated humanoid.

mutant_human_tallow.name: mutant humanoid tallow
mutant_human_tallow.description: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered fat sourced from a mutant humanoid.  It won't rot for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

mutant_human_lard.name: mutant humanoid lard
mutant_human_lard.description: A smooth white block of dry-rendered fat sourced from a mutant humanoid.  It won't rot for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

blood_tainted.name: tainted blood
blood_tainted.description: Blood that's obviously unhealthy.  You could drink it, but it will poison you.

blood_tainted_concentrate.name: concentrated tainted blood
blood_tainted_concentrate.description: Poisonous and unhealthy blood, concentrated by some means.  You swear you could see it pulsing ever so slightly.

meat_tainted.name: chunk of tainted meat
meat_tainted.description: Meat that's obviously unhealthy.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

bone_tainted.name: tainted bone
bone_tainted.description: A rotten and brittle bone from some unnatural creature or other.  Could be used to make some stuff, like charcoal or glue.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

bone_human.name: human bone
bone_human.description: A bone from a human being.  Could be used to make some stuff, if you're feeling sufficiently ghoulish.

fat_tainted.name: tainted fat
fat_tainted.description: A watery yellow glob of fat from some unnatural creature or other.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

tallow_tainted.name: tainted tallow
tallow_tainted.description: A smooth grayish block of cleaned and rendered monster fat.  It will remain 'fresh' for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many projects.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

stomach_boiled.name: large boiled stomach
stomach_boiled.description: A boiled stomach from an animal, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

hstomach_boiled.name: boiled large human stomach
hstomach_boiled.description: A boiled stomach from a large humanoid creature, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

small_stomach_boiled.name: boiled stomach
small_stomach_boiled.description: A small boiled stomach from an animal, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

small_hstomach_boiled.name: boiled human stomach
small_hstomach_boiled.description: A small boiled stomach from a human, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

raw_leather.name: raw hide
raw_leather.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from an animal.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

raw_tainted_leather.name: tainted hide
raw_tainted_leather.description: A carefully folded poisonous raw skin harvested from an unnatural creature.  You can cure it for storage and tanning.

raw_hleather.name: raw human skin
raw_hleather.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a human.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

raw_fur.name: raw pelt
raw_fur.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing animal.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

raw_tainted_fur.name: tainted pelt
raw_tainted_fur.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing unnatural creature.  It still has the fur attached and is poisonous.  You can cure it for storage and tanning.

raw_hfur.name: raw human pelt
raw_hfur.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing mutant human.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

flesh_golem_heart.name: seeping heart
flesh_golem_heart.description: A thick mass of flesh superficially resembling a mammalian heart, covered in dimpled grooves and the size of your fist.

jabberwock_heart.name: putrid heart
jabberwock_heart.description: A thick, hulking mass of flesh superficially resembling a mammalian heart, covered in ribbed grooves and easily the size of your head.  It's still full of, er, whatever passes for blood in jabberwocks, and is heavy in your hands.  After everything you've seen lately, you can't help but remember old sayings about eating the hearts of your enemies…

jabberwock_heart_desiccated.name: desiccated putrid heart
jabberwock_heart_desiccated.description: A huge strip of muscle - all that remains of a putrid heart that has been sliced open and drained of blood.  It could be eaten if you're hungry, but looks *disgusting*.

meat_frond.name: alien fronds
meat_frond.description: The fleshy fronds harvested from an alien plant.  Eating these membranous leaves and gut-like stems is likely a terrible idea, and yet they have a paradoxically pleasant and inviting sweet smell.  Might be non-vegan.

leech_flower.name: leech flower
leech_flower.description: The alien beauty of this indigo flower is betrayed by its disgustingly fleshy composition.  What from afar appear to be petals are but layered membranes of transparent veiny flesh, given color by a covering of blue iridescent ichor.  Even if it is certainly poisonous, it has a pleasant medicinal smell to it.

use_action.activation_message: Even a close smell of this alien flower feels deeply intoxicating.

meat_bark.name: leech bark
meat_bark.description: Dry and tough bark matter harvested from an alien plant.  It is slightly translucent, and if placed against the light you can distinguish glistening blue veins running through it.

assorted_bugs.name: assorted bugs
assorted_bugs.description: A handful of random edible bugs - beetles, grasshoppers, worms, caterpillars, even the occasional spider.  Not very appetizing raw, but it will keep you alive.

clam.name: clam
clam.description: A fresh clam, still in its shell.  Mild, briny, and full of micronutrients, but not very filling.

milk_raw.name: raw milk
milk_raw.description: This is raw, unhomogenized and unpasteurized milk from a cow.  It couldn't be any fresher unless you drank it straight from the cow, which might upset it.  Depending on your dietary sensibilities, you might want to pasteurize or even boil this before drinking.

milk_UHT.name: shelf stable milk
milk_UHT.description: This is milk that has been pasteurized at much higher temperatures than normal.  It tastes slightly different, but, unopened, will last far longer than regular milk.

milk_evap.name: evaporated milk
milk_evap.description: Milk that's had about 60% of its water removed prior to canning.

yoghurt.name: yogurt
yoghurt.description: Delicious fermented dairy.  It tastes of vanilla.

butter.name: butter
butter.description: A yellow stick of milkfat and milk solids, usually made from cow's milk.

ghee.name: ghee
ghee.description: Clarified butter, free from milk solids and water.  Will last a very long time.

pudding.name: pudding
pudding.description: Sugary, fermented dairy.  A wonderful treat.

cheese_fresh.name: fresh cheese
cheese_fresh.description: A type of soft fresh cheese, like paneer or cottage cheese.  Also known as farmer's cheese.  It won't last very long, but can be preserved through smoking.

cheese_hard.name: hard cheese
cheese_hard.description: Hard, dry cheese made to last, unlike modern processed cheese.  Will make you thirsty though.

cheese.name: cheese
cheese.description: A block of yellow processed cheese.

quesadilla_cheese.name: quesadilla
quesadilla_cheese.description: A tortilla filled with cheese and lightly grilled.

milk_powder.name: powdered milk
milk_powder.description: Dehydrated milk powder.  Mix with water to make drinkable milk.

con_milk.name: condensed milk
con_milk.description: Cow's milk that has been partly dehydrated to vastly increase its shelf life, and also sweetened.

buttermilk.name: buttermilk
buttermilk.description: This is cultured milk defatted either due to churning or curdling.  Spoils quickly.

sauce_red.name: red sauce
sauce_red.description: A minimally seasoned sauce of cooked tomatoes.

maple_sap.name: maple sap
maple_sap.description: A water and sugar solution that has been extracted from a maple tree.

mayonnaise.name: mayonnaise
mayonnaise.description: A gloppy mix of egg, oil, and salt that is traditionally used to moisten sandwiches.

ketchup.name: ketchup
ketchup.description: A viscous paste of tomato, salt, and vinegar.

mustard.name: mustard
mustard.description: A condiment made from the seeds of a mustard plant (/Brassica/ or /Sinapis/), vinegar, salt, and spices.

honey_bottled.name: forest honey
honey_bottled.description: Honey, that stuff bees make.  This one is "forest honey", a liquid form of honey.  This honey won't spoil and is good for your digestion.

peanutbutter.name: peanut butter
peanutbutter.description: A brown goo that tastes very little like its namesake.  It's not bad, but it'll stick to the roof of your mouth.

vinegar.name: vinegar
vinegar.description: Shockingly tart white vinegar.  This is what you get when you let your booze ferment too long.

cooking_oil.name: vegetable cooking oil
cooking_oil.description: Thin yellow vegetable oil used for cooking.

cooking_oil2.name: animal cooking oil
cooking_oil2.description: Thin yellow animal oil used for cooking.

molasses.name: molasses
molasses.description: An extremely sugary tar-like syrup, produced by repeatedly boiling the juice of sugarcane or sugar beets.  It has a slightly bitter aftertaste.

horseradish.name: horseradish
horseradish.description: A spicy grated root vegetable packed in vinegared brine.

coffee_syrup.name: coffee syrup
coffee_syrup.description: A thick syrup made of water and sugar strained through coffee grounds.  Can be used to flavor many foods and beverages.

apple_cider.name: apple cider
apple_cider.description: Pressed from fresh apples.  Tasty and nutritious.

almond_milk.name: almond milk
almond_milk.description: Milk some almonds?  Not quite, but blend them with water, yes!  A dairy-free alternative strong in calcium!  Rival to soy milk.

soy_milk.name: soy milk
soy_milk.description: Milk some soybeans?  Not quite, but blend them with water, yes!  A dairy-free alternative strong in protein!  Rival to almond milk.

coffee.name: coffee
coffee.description: The morning ritual of the pre-apocalyptic world, created from coffee cherries through a complex process of seed removal, roasting, grinding, and brewing.  Coffee is substantially richer in caffeine than its rival tea.

atomic_coffee.name: atomic coffee
atomic_coffee.description: This serving of coffee has been created using an atomic coffee pot's FULL NUCLEAR brewing cycle.  Every possible microgram of caffeine and flavor has been carefully extracted for your enjoyment, using the power of the atom.

bee_balm_tea.name: bee balm tea
bee_balm_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from bee balm steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to reduce negative effects of common cold or flu.

can_coconut.name: coconut milk
can_coconut.description: A dense, sweet creamy sauce, often used in curries.

chai_tea.name: chai tea
chai_tea.description: A traditional south Asian mixed-spice tea with milk.

chamomile_tea.name: chamomile tea
chamomile_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from chamomile flowers steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to treat insomnia.

choc_drink.name: chocolate drink
choc_drink.description: A chocolate flavored beverage made of artificial flavoring and milk byproducts.  Shelf stable and vaguely appetizing even when lukewarm.

coffee_substitute.name: coffee substitute
coffee_substitute.description: Homemade not-coffee created from the Kentucky coffeetree, just like the Meskwaki tribe!  Doesn't actually have any caffeine, and is very bitter, but it'll pass in a pinch.

chicory_coffee.name: chicory brew
chicory_coffee.description: Toasted, ground chicory root steeped in boiling water.  This bitter brew is used as a coffee substitute, though it tastes nothing like coffee.

cola.name: dark cola
cola.description: Things go better with cola.  Sugar water with caffeine added.

zero_cola.name: zero cola
zero_cola.description: Dark cola, now with sugar substitutes. Mmm, lime flavor.

cola_syrup.name: dark cola soda syrup
cola_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form dark cola.

colamdew.name: energy dew
colamdew.description: It tastes and looks like windshield wiper fluid, but it's loaded to the brim with sugar and caffeine.

colamdew_syrup.name: energy dew soda syrup
colamdew_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form energy dew.

creamsoda.name: cream soda
creamsoda.description: A caffeinated, carbonated drink, flavored with vanilla.

creamsoda_syrup.name: cream soda syrup
creamsoda_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form cream soda.

suicidesoda.name: suicide
suicidesoda.description: A chaotic blend of every possible soda combined into one.  The result is a hyper-sweet, color-shifting mess that tastes like childhood and poor decisions.  Release your inner child.

cranberry_juice.name: cranberry juice
cranberry_juice.description: Made from real Massachusetts cranberries.  Delicious and nutritious.

crispycran.name: crispy cranberry
crispycran.description: Mixing cranberry juice and lemon-lime soda works out quite well.

dandelion_tea.name: dandelion tea
dandelion_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from dandelion roots steeped in boiling water.

dandelionburdock_tea.name: dandelion and burdock tea
dandelionburdock_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from dandelion and burdock roots steeped in boiling water.  The additional ingredient makes it slightly healthier and fun.

eggnog.name: eggnog
eggnog.description: Smooth and rich, this spoon-coating mix of milk, cream, and eggs is a popular traditional holiday drink.  While often spiked, it is still delicious on its own.  Meant to be stored cold, it will spoil rapidly.

energy_drink.name: energy drink
energy_drink.description: A heavily caffeinated soft drink.  Energy drinks are popular among those who need to stay up late working.

energy_drink_syrup.name: energy drink syrup
energy_drink_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form an energy drink.

energy_drink_atomic.name: atomic energy drink
energy_drink_atomic.description: According to the label, this loathsome-tasting beverage is called ATOMIC POWER THIRST.  Alongside the lengthy health warning, it promises to make the consumer UNCOMFORTABLY ENERGETIC using ELECTROLYTES and THE POWER OF THE ATOM.

energy_drink_atomic_syrup.name: atomic energy drink syrup
energy_drink_atomic_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form an atomic energy drink.  There is an additional label on the box: 'WARNING: DO NOT CONSUME UNDILUTED!'

herbal_tea.name: herbal tea
herbal_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from herbs steeped in boiling water.

hot_chocolate.name: hot chocolate
hot_chocolate.description: Also known as hot cocoa, this heated chocolate beverage is perfect for a cold winter day.

juice.name: juice
juice.description: Freshly-squeezed from real fruit!  Tasty and nutritious.

kompot.name: kompot
kompot.description: Clear juice obtained by cooking fruit in a large volume of water.

lemonade.name: lemonade
lemonade.description: Lemon juice mixed with water and sugar to dull the sourness.  Delicious and refreshing.

lemonlime.name: lemon-lime soda
lemonlime.description: Unlike cola this is caffeine free, however it is still carbonated and has plenty of sugar.  Not to mention a lemon-lime taste.

lemonlime_syrup.name: lemon-lime soda syrup
lemonlime_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form lemon-lime soda.

lotus_tea.name: lotus tea
lotus_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from lotus flowers steeped in boiling water.

mex_chocolate.name: Mexican hot chocolate
mex_chocolate.description: This semi-bitter chocolate drink made from cocoa, cinnamon, and chilies, traces its history to the Maya and Aztecs.  Perfect for a cold winter day.

milk.name: milk
milk.description: Baby cow food, appropriated for adult humans.  Spoils rapidly.

milk_reconstituted.name: reconstituted milk
milk_reconstituted.description: Baby cow food, appropriated for adult humans.  This milk has been reconstituted from a processed milk.  Spoils rapidly.

milk_atomic_coffee.name: atomic coffee milk
milk_atomic_coffee.description: Atomic coffee mixed into milk.  This serving of coffee has been created using an atomic coffee pot's FULL NUCLEAR brewing cycle.

oj.name: orange juice
oj.description: Freshly-squeezed from real oranges!  Tasty and nutritious.

orangesoda.name: orange soda
orangesoda.description: Unlike cola this is caffeine free, however it is still carbonated, sweet, and tastes vaguely orange-like.

orangesoda_syrup.name: orange soda syrup
orangesoda_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form orange soda.

pine_tea.name: pine needle tea
pine_tea.description: A fragrant and healthy beverage made from pine needles steeped in boiling water.

pine_soda.name: pine needle soda
pine_soda.description: A fragrant and healthy beverage made from pine needles steeped in boiling water, and then carbonated.

purple_drink.name: grape soda
purple_drink.description: A mass-produced grape flavored beverage of artificial origin.  Good for when you want something that tastes like fruit, but still don't care about your health.

purple_drink_syrup.name: grape soda syrup
purple_drink_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form grape soda.

rootbeer.name: root beer
rootbeer.description: Like cola, but without caffeine.  Still not that healthy.

rootbeer_syrup.name: root beer soda syrup
rootbeer_syrup.description: A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form root beer.

spezi.name: spezi
spezi.description: Originating in Germany almost a century ago, this mix of cola and orange soda tastes great.

sports_drink.name: sports drink
sports_drink.description: Consisting of a special blend of electrolytes and simple sugars, this beverage tastes like bottled sweat but rehydrates the body faster than water.

spurge_tea.name: spurge tea
spurge_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from spurge flowers steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to prevent asthma attacks.

rehydration_drink.name: rehydration drink
rehydration_drink.description: A basic oral rehydration therapy drink.  It will rehydrate you faster than water, but it tastes kind of strange.

sweet_water.name: sweet water
sweet_water.description: Water with sugar or honey added.  Tastes okay.

tea.name: tea
tea.description: The beverage of gentlemen everywhere, made from applying hot water to leaves of the tea plant /Camellia sinensis/.

coca_tea.name: coca tea
coca_tea.description: An aromatic drink made by pouring hot water over the leaves of the coca tree.  Drinking it can give you a mild high from the cocaine content, but if you drink it too often, it can cause addiction.

tea_bark.name: bark tea
tea_bark.description: Often regarded as folk medicine in some countries, bark tea tastes awful and tends to dry you out, but can help flush out stomach or other gut bugs.

V8.name: V8
V8.description: Contains up to eight vegetables!  Nutritious and tasty.

water.name: water
water.description: Water, the stuff of life, the best thirst-quencher available.  It would be safer to drink once purified.

water_clean.name: clean water
water_clean.description: Fresh, clean water.  Truly the best thing to quench your thirst.

water_mineral.name: mineral water
water_mineral.description: Fancy mineral water, so fancy it makes you feel fancy just holding it.

coffee_sweetened.name: sweet coffee
coffee_sweetened.description: The morning ritual of the pre-apocalyptic world, created from coffee cherries through a complex process of seed removal, roasting, grinding, and brewing.  Coffee is substantially richer in caffeine than its rival tea.  With added sweetener for better taste.

tea_sweetened.name: sweet tea
tea_sweetened.description: The beverage of gentlemen everywhere, made from applying hot water to leaves of the tea plant /Camellia sinensis/. Added sweetener for a better taste.

milk_tea_sweetened.name: sweet milk tea
milk_tea_sweetened.description: Hot tea with cold milk and added sweetener.

coffee_substitute_sweetened.name: sweet coffee substitute
coffee_substitute_sweetened.description: Homemade not-coffee created from the Kentucky coffeetree, just like the Meskwaki tribe!  Doesn't actually have any caffeine, and is very bitter, but it'll pass in a pinch.  The added sweetness neutralize the bitterness somewhat.

milk_coffee_sweetened.name: sweet coffee milk
milk_coffee_sweetened.description: Coffee mixed into milk.  Added sweetener for those who like it sweet.

milk_atomic_coffee_sweetened.name: sweet atomic coffee milk
milk_atomic_coffee_sweetened.description: Atomic coffee mixed into milk.  This serving of coffee has been created using an atomic coffee pot's FULL NUCLEAR brewing cycle.  Added sweetener for those who like it even sweeter.

atomic_coffee_sweetened.name: sweet atomic coffee
atomic_coffee_sweetened.description: This serving of coffee has been created using an atomic coffee pot's FULL NUCLEAR brewing cycle.  Every possible microgram of caffeine and flavor has been carefully extracted for your enjoyment, using the power of the atom.  With added sugar.

sikhye.name: sikhye
sikhye.description: A traditional Korean beverage made from rice, often served as a dessert or a digestive aid.

egg_bird.name: bird egg
egg_bird.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_chicken.name: chicken egg
egg_chicken.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_bird_unfert.name: unfertilized bird egg
egg_bird_unfert.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.  This one is unfertilized and is probably from a farm.

egg_grouse.name: grouse egg
egg_grouse.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_crow.name: crow egg
egg_crow.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_duck.name: duck egg
egg_duck.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_goose_canadian.name: goose egg
egg_goose_canadian.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_turkey.name: turkey egg
egg_turkey.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_pheasant.name: pheasant egg
egg_pheasant.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_cockatrice.name: cockatrice egg
egg_cockatrice.description: Nutritious egg laid by a bird.

egg_reptile.name: reptile egg
egg_reptile.description: An egg belonging to one of reptile species found in New England.

egg_insect.name: Insect Egg
egg_insect.description: An egg belonging to some kind of insect.  If you are seeing this then it is a bug.

ant_egg.name: ant egg
ant_egg.description: A large white ant egg, the size of a softball.  Extremely nutritious, but incredibly gross.

spider_egg.name: spider egg
spider_egg.description: A egg from a giant spider, a bit bigger than a chicken one.  Incredibly gross.

egg_roach.name: roach egg
egg_roach.description: A egg from a giant roach, a bit bigger than a chicken one.  Incredibly gross.

egg_roach_plague.name: roach egg
egg_roach_plague.description: A egg from a giant roach, a bit bigger than a chicken one.  Incredibly gross.

egg_locust.name: insect egg
egg_locust.description: A egg from a locust, a bit bigger than a chicken one.

egg_firefly.name: firefly egg
egg_firefly.description: The fist-sized egg of a mutant firefly.  Glows faintly in the dark.

egg_dragonfly.name: dragonfly egg
egg_dragonfly.description: The still wet egg of a mutated dragonfly.  Serves as a disgusting substitute for the real thing, just don't let it hatch in the water.

egg_centipede.name: centipede egg
egg_centipede.description: A large, soft egg you got from butchering a mutant centipede.  Inside, you can already see a bundle of spindly legs, twitching in anticipation.

egg_wasp.name: wasp egg
egg_wasp.description: A white, flexible wasp egg.  It looks like a pristine grain of rice, grown to the size of your palm.

razorclaw_roe.name: razorclaw roe
razorclaw_roe.description: A clump of razorclaw eggs.  A post-Cataclysm delicacy.

egg_fish.name: roe
egg_fish.description: Common roe from an unknown fish.

egg_fish_tiny.name: roe
egg_fish_tiny.description: Common roe from an unknown tiny fish.

egg_fish_small.name: roe
egg_fish_small.description: Common roe from an unknown small fish.

egg_fish_medium.name: roe
egg_fish_medium.description: Common roe from an unknown medium fish.

egg_fish_large.name: roe
egg_fish_large.description: Common roe from an unknown large fish.

egg_fish_huge.name: roe
egg_fish_huge.description: Common roe from an unknown huge fish.

powder_eggs.name: powdered egg
powder_eggs.description: Whole fresh eggs, dehydrated into an easy to store powder.

boiled_egg.name: boiled egg
boiled_egg.description: A hard-boiled egg, still in its shell.  Portable and nutritious!

boiled_egg_condiment.name: boiled egg with condiment
boiled_egg_condiment.description: A hard-boiled egg can be bland, just plaster it with some condiments and all will be better!

pickled_egg.name: pickled egg
pickled_egg.description: A pickled egg.  Rather salty, but tastes good and lasts for a long time.

wild_veggy_omelette.name: wild vegetable omelette
wild_veggy_omelette.description: An omelette made with wild vegetables.

milkshake.name: milkshake
milkshake.description: An all-natural cold beverage made with milk and sweeteners.  Tastes great when frozen.

milkshake_fastfood.name: fast food milkshake
milkshake_fastfood.description: A milkshake made by freezing a premade mix.  Tastes better due to how much sugar is in it, but is bad for your health.

milkshake_deluxe.name: deluxe milkshake

cheese_fries.name: cheese fries

sausage_wasteland_cooked.name: cooked wasteland sausage

currywurst.description: Sausage covered in a curry ketchup sauce.  Fairly spicy and impressive at the same time!

lutefisk.description: Lutefisk is preserved fish that has been dried in a lye solution.  Vile and soap-like yet highly nutritious, it is reminiscent of the afterbirth of a dog or the world's largest chunk of phlegm.
