sashimi.description: Delicious slivers of thinly sliced raw fish and tasty vegetables.

dry_meat_tainted.name: dehydrated tainted meat
dry_meat_tainted.description: Pieces of poisonous meat that have been dried to prevent them from rotting away.  It will still poison you if you eat this.

pelmeni.name: pelmeni
pelmeni.description: Delicious cooked dumplings consisting of a meat filling wrapped in thin dough.

homemade_burrito.name: homemade burrito
homemade_burrito.description: A traditional Mexican dish of meat and vegetable stuffing put on a corn tortilla and rolled into a tube shape, like those you find in gas stations but homemade and delicious!

curdled_blood.name: chunk of curdled blood
curdled_blood.description: A chunk of solid cooked blood.

bibimbap.name: bibimbap
bibimbap.description: A mixed meat and rice dish from Korea, often with eggs and various veggies.  This version has gone for a full-house of ingredients, making it extra tasty.

bibimbap_simple.name: simple bibimbap
bibimbap_simple.description: A mixed meat and rice dish from Korea, often with eggs and various veggies.

deluxe_rice_kimchi.name: kimchi fried rice
deluxe_rice_kimchi.description: Fried rice with the unique flavor of kimchi.  The rich oil and spicy flavor are well balanced.

samhap.name: samhap
samhap.description: A Korean dish that combines boiled meat, kimchi, and raw fish all at once.  The flavors blend into delicious harmony.

bossam.name: bossam
bossam.description: A Korean dish of boiled meat served with kimchi.  The tender meat is paired with a spicy flavor.

kebab.name: kebab
kebab.description: Cooked meats and veggies on a stick.  Popular street food originating from the Middle East and later spread to Asia and the rest of the world.

kebab_meat.name: meat kebab
kebab_meat.description: Cooked meats on a stick.  Popular street food originating from the Middle East and later spread to Asia and the rest of the world.

assorted_bugs_fried.name: fried bugs
assorted_bugs_fried.description: A crispy, crunchy mix of fried bugs.  Roasted and seasoned, they almost taste like a snack food if you can get over what you're eating.

clam_fried.name: fried clam
clam_fried.description: Crispy fried clam strips, golden-brown and delicious.  A New England specialty.

melatonin_tablet.name: melatonin tablet
melatonin_tablet.description: Over-the-counter melatonin supplements, commonly prescribed to treat sleep deprivation and to mitigate its effects.  One tablet a day combined with a good night's sleep will help you recover faster.

fungal_painkiller.name: nerve dampening tablet
fungal_painkiller.description: A chemical that suppresses pain response, made from alien fungal tissues.  Without a central nervous system, the only thing fungus can feel is rage.  Seems to be safe from spore infection, though there still might be unpleasant effects after it wears off…

use_action.activation_message: You pop a nerve dampening tablet.

adderall.name: Adderall
adderall.description: Medical grade amphetamine salts mixed with Dextroamphetamine salts, commonly prescribed to treat hyperactive attention deficits.  It suppresses the appetite, and is quite addictive.

adrenaline_injector.name: syringe of adrenaline
adrenaline_injector.description: A syringe filled with a shot of adrenaline.  It serves as a powerful stimulant when you inject yourself with it.  Asthmatics can use it in an emergency to clear their asthma.

antibiotics.name: antibiotics
antibiotics.description: A strong antibacterial medication designed to prevent or stop the spread of infection.  It's the safest way to cure any infections you might have.  One dose lasts twelve hours.

antifungal.name: antifungal drug
antifungal.description: Powerful chemical tablets designed to eliminate fungal infections in living creatures.

antiparasitic.name: antiparasitic drug
antiparasitic.description: Broad spectrum chemical tablets designed to eliminate parasitic infestations in living creatures.  Though designed for use on pets and livestock, it will likely work on humans as well.

aspirin.name: aspirin
aspirin.description: Acetylsalicylic acid, a mild anti-inflammatory.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.

bandages.name: bandage
bandages.description: Simple cloth bandages.  Used for healing small amounts of damage.

bandages_makeshift.name: makeshift bandage
bandages_makeshift.description: Simple cloth bandages.  Better than nothing.

bandages_makeshift_bleached.name: bleached makeshift bandage
bandages_makeshift_bleached.description: Simple cloth bandages.  It is white, as real bandages should be.

bandages_makeshift_boiled.name: boiled makeshift bandage
bandages_makeshift_boiled.description: Simple cloth bandages.  It was boiled to make it more sterile.

bfipowder.name: antiseptic powder
bfipowder.description: A powdered form of chemical antiseptic, this bismuth formic iodide cleans wounds quickly and painlessly.

caff_gum.name: caffeinated chewing gum
caff_gum.description: Sugar-free chewing gum with added caffeine, it's a nice pick-me-up.

use_action.activation_message: You chew your caffeinated chewing gum.

caffeine.name: caffeine pill
caffeine.description: No-doz brand caffeine pills, maximum strength.  Useful in pulling an all-nighter, one pill is about equivalent to a strong cup of coffee.

chaw.name: chewing tobacco
chaw.description: Fruit flavored chewing tobacco.  While still absolutely terrible for your health, it was once a favorite amongst baseball players, cowboys, and other macho types.

chem_hydrogen_peroxide.name: hydrogen peroxide
chem_hydrogen_peroxide.description: Dilute hydrogen peroxide, for use as an antiseptic and for bleaching hair or textiles.  Foams a little when in contact with organic matter, but otherwise harmless.

cig.name: cigarette
cig.description: A mixture of dried tobacco leaf, pesticides, and chemical additives, rolled into a filtered paper tube.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health.

cigar.name: cigar
cigar.description: Rolled, cured tobacco leaf, addictive and hazardous to health.

chloroform_rag.name: chloroform soaked rag
chloroform_rag.description: A debug item that lets you put NPCs (or yourself) to sleep.

codeine.name: codeine
codeine.description: A mild opiate used in the suppression of pain, cough, and other ailments.  While relatively weak for a narcotic, it is still addictive, with a potential for overdose.

coke.name: cocaine
coke.description: Crystalline extract of the coca leaf, or at least, a white powder with some of that in it.  A topical analgesic, it is more commonly used for its stimulatory properties.  Highly addictive.

use_action.activation_message: You snort a bump of coke.

cola_meth.name: methacola
cola_meth.description: A potent cocktail of amphetamines, caffeine and corn syrup, this stuff puts a spring in your step, a fire in your eye, and a bad case of tachycardia tremors in your somersaulting heart.

contacts.name: pair of contact lenses
contacts.description: A pair of extended wear contacts with soft lenses designed to be discarded after a week of use.  They are a great replacement to wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.

cotton_ball.name: cotton balls
cotton_ball.description: Fluffy balls of clean white cotton.  Can serve as makeshift bandages in an emergency.

crack.name: crack
crack.description: Deprotonated cocaine crystals, incredibly addictive and deleterious to brain chemistry.

use_action.activation_message: You smoke your crack rocks.  Mother would be proud.

dayquil.name: non-drowsy cough syrup
dayquil.description: Daytime cold and flu medication.  Non-drowsy formula.  Will suppress coughing, aching, headaches and runny noses, but you'll still need lots of fluids and rest.

disinfectant.name: antiseptic
disinfectant.description: A powerful antiseptic commonly used for contaminated wounds.

disinfectant_makeshift.name: makeshift antiseptic
disinfectant_makeshift.description: Makeshift antiseptic made from ethanol.  Can be used to disinfect a wound.

diazepam.name: diazepam
diazepam.description: A strong benzodiazepine drug used to treat muscle spasms, anxiety, seizures, and panic attacks.

eyedrops.name: saline eye drop
eyedrops.description: Sterile saline eye drops.  Can be used to treat dry eyes, or to wash out contaminants.

gum.name: chewing gum
gum.description: Sugar-free chewing gum wrapped in bright pink packaging, with a question mark on the label.  It's a mystery what flavor it is, but the label claims there's 20 unique flavors.

handrolled_cig.name: hand-rolled cigarette
handrolled_cig.description: A roll-your-own made from tobacco and rolling paper.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Despite being hand crafted, it's still highly addictive and hazardous to health.

use_action.activation_message: You light up the hand-rolled cigarette.

fake_ecig.name: phantom vape
fake_ecig.description: A fake item used for ecig addiction.  This is a bug if you have it.

heroin.name: heroin
heroin.description: An extremely strong opioid narcotic derived from morphine.  Incredibly addictive, the risk of overdose is extreme, and the drug is contraindicated for nearly all medical purposes.

ghb.name: GHB
ghb.description: A potent CNS depressant and natural neurotransmitter, used medically for narcolepsy and sometimes alcohol withdrawal.  Recreational use is risky due to high overdose potential, especially with alcohol.

use_action.activation_message: You measure out a dose of GHB with the syringe.

iodine.name: potassium iodide tablet
iodine.description: Potassium iodide tablets.  If taken prior to exposure, they help to mitigate injury caused by radiation absorption.

joint.name: joint
joint.description: Marijuana, cannabis, pot.  Whatever you want to call it, it's rolled up in a piece of paper and ready for smokin'.

blunt.name: blunt
blunt.description: Marijuana, cannabis, pot.  Whatever you want to call it, it's rolled up in a large tobacco leaf and ready for smokin'.

lsd.name: pink tab
lsd.description: Tiny pink tabs resembling postage stamps, already dosed with some sort of drug.  Really only useful for entertainment.  Will cause hallucinations.

medical_gauze.name: medical gauze
medical_gauze.description: This is decent sized piece of cotton, sterilized and sealed.  It's designed for medical purposes.

meth.name: low-grade methamphetamine
meth.description: A profoundly addictive and powerful stimulant.  While extremely effective at enhancing alertness, it is hazardous to health and the risk of an adverse reaction is great.

morphine.name: morphine
morphine.description: A very strong semi-synthetic narcotic used to treat intense pain in hospital settings.  This injectable drug is very addictive.

mugwort_oil.name: mugwort oil
mugwort_oil.description: Some essential oil made from mugwort, which may kill parasites when ingested.  Consume it with water!

nic_gum.name: nicotine gum
nic_gum.description: Mint flavored sugar-free nicotine chewing gum.  For smokers who desire to quit.

nyquil.name: cough syrup
nyquil.description: Nighttime cold and flu medication.  Useful when trying to sleep with a head full of virions.  Will cause drowsiness.

oxycodone.name: oxycodone
oxycodone.description: A strong semi-synthetic narcotic used in the treatment of intense pain.  Highly addictive.

pills_sleep.name: Ambien
pills_sleep.description: A habit-forming tranquilizer with a variety of psychoactive side effects.  Used in the treatment of insomnia.  Its active ingredient is zolpidem tartrate.

poppy_pain.name: poppy painkiller
poppy_pain.description: Potent opioid palliative produced by the refining of the mutated poppy.  Notably devoid of euphoric or sedative effects, as an opiate it may still be addictive.

poppy_sleep.name: poppy sleep
poppy_sleep.description: A potent sleep aid extracted from mutated poppy seeds.  Effective, but as an opiate, it may be addictive.

poppysyrup.name: poppy cough syrup
poppysyrup.description: Cough syrup made from mutated poppy.  Will make you sleepy.

sizzurp.name: sizzurp lean
sizzurp.description: An extremely common polysubstance street-drug that almost anyone can make out of soda, candy, cough syrup and opiates.  Many argue that it's not the real thing if not made with a list of specific ingredients, however, most of them are gone now.  Very euphoric but once you pick up the cup, it will be hard to put it down.

use_action.activation_message: You take a sip of purple.

prozac.name: Prozac
prozac.description: A common and popular antidepressant.  It will elevate mood, and can profoundly affect the action of other drugs.  It is only rarely habit-forming, though adverse reactions are not uncommon.  Its generic name is fluoxetine.

prussian_blue.name: Prussian blue tablet
prussian_blue.description: Tablets containing oxidized ferrous ferrocyanide salts.  Capable of purging nuclear contaminants from the body if taken after radiation exposure.

quikclot.name: hemostatic powder
quikclot.description: A powdered antihemorrhagic compound that reacts with blood to immediately form a gel-like substance that stops bleeding.

saline.name: saline solution
saline.description: A solution of sterilized water and salt for intravenous infusion.  Can be used to flush contaminants from wounds.

thorazine.name: Thorazine
thorazine.description: Anti-psychotic medication.  Used to stabilize brain chemistry, it can arrest hallucinations and other symptoms of psychosis.  Carries a sedative effect.  Its generic name is chlorpromazine.

thyme_oil.name: thyme oil
thyme_oil.description: Some essential oil made from thyme, which can act as a mildly irritating antiseptic.

tobacco.name: rolling tobacco
tobacco.description:
Loose, fine-cut tobacco leaves.  Popular in Europe and among hipsters.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health.
Can either be rolled into a cigarette with some rolling papers or smoked through a pipe.

tramadol.name: tramadol
tramadol.description: A painkiller used to manage moderate pain.  The effects last for several hours, but are relatively subdued for an opioid.

vaccine_shot.name: gamma globulin shot
vaccine_shot.description: This immunoglobulin booster contains concentrated antibodies prepared for intravenous injection to temporarily strengthen the immune system.  It is still in its original packaging.

vitamins.name: multivitamin
vitamins.description: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in pill form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.

calcium_tablet.name: calcium tablet
calcium_tablet.description: White calcium tablets.  Widely used by elderly people with osteoporosis as a method to supplement calcium before the apocalypse.

bonemeal_tablet.name: bone meal tablet
bonemeal_tablet.description: Homemade calcium supplement made out of bone meal.  Tastes horrible and is hard to swallow but it does its job.

flavored_bonemeal_tablet.name: flavored bone meal tablet
flavored_bonemeal_tablet.description: Homemade calcium supplement made out of bone meal.  Due to some sweetness mixed in to counteract the powdery texture and the taste of ash, it's almost as palatable as the pre-Cataclysm tablets.

gummy_vitamins.name: gummy vitamin
gummy_vitamins.description: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in a fruit-flavored chewy candy form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.

inj_vitb.name: injectable vitamin B
inj_vitb.description: Small vials of pale yellow liquid containing soluble vitamin B for injection.

inj_iron.name: injectable iron
inj_iron.description: Small vials of dark yellow liquid containing soluble iron for injection.

weed.name: marijuana
weed.description: The dried flower buds and leaves harvested from a psychoactive variety of hemp plant.  Used to reduce nausea, stimulate appetite and elevate mood.  It can be habit-forming, and adverse reactions are possible.

use_action.activation_message: You smoke some weed.  Good stuff, man!

xanax.name: Xanax
xanax.description: Anti-anxiety agent with a powerful sedative effect.  May cause dissociation and loss of memory.  It is dangerously addictive, and withdrawal from regular use should be gradual.  Its generic name is alprazolam.

disinrag.name: antiseptic soaked rag
disinrag.description: A rag soaked in antiseptic.  Useful for light wounds, probably won't help with deep bites.

disincotton_ball.name: antiseptic soaked cotton balls
disincotton_ball.description: Fluffy balls of clean white cotton.  Now soaked with antiseptic, they are somewhat useful to disinfect a wound.

weak_antibiotic.name: weak antibiotics
weak_antibiotic.description: A broad-spectrum antibiotic used to suppress infections and prevent them from setting in.  It isn't strong enough to purge infections outright, but it boosts the body's resistance against them.  One dose lasts twelve hours.

pepto.name: heartburn medicine
pepto.description: Creamy pink heartburn syrup that soothes upset stomachs and quells vomitous urges; with a twist off cap that doubles as a dosage cup.

panacea.name: Panaceus
panacea.description: An apple-red gel capsule the size of your thumbnail, filled with a thick oily liquid that shifts from black to purple at unpredictable intervals, flecked with tiny gray dots.  Given the place you got it from, it's either very potent, or highly experimental.  Holding it, all the little aches and pains seem to fade, just for a moment…

cattail_jelly.name: cattail jelly
cattail_jelly.description: Clear jelly harvested from cattail, has antiseptic properties and works as a painkiller.

strong_antibiotic.name: strong antibiotics
strong_antibiotic.description: A prescription-strength antibacterial medication designed to prevent or stop the spread of infection.  It contains nearly toxic levels of antibiotics, but can treat any bacterial infections you may encounter.  One dose lasts twelve hours.

mre_chilibeans.name: chili & beans entree
mre_chilibeans.description: The chili & beans entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good.

mre_bbqbeef.name: BBQ beef entree
mre_bbqbeef.description: The BBQ beef entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_chickennoodle.name: chicken noodle entree
mre_chickennoodle.description: The chicken noodle entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes bland and gross, even after all the flavoring added.

mre_spaghetti.name: spaghetti entree
mre_spaghetti.description: The spaghetti entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good.

mre_chicken.name: chicken chunks entree
mre_chicken.description: The chicken chunks entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good, if not a bit bland.

mre_beeftaco.name: beef taco entree
mre_beeftaco.description: The beef taco entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good, but the flavors are a bit off.

mre_beef.name: beef brisket entree
mre_beef.description: The beef brisket entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_meatball.name: meatballs & marinara entree
mre_meatball.description: The meatballs & marinara entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good.

mre_beefstew.name: beef stew entree
mre_beefstew.description: The beef stew entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_chilimac.name: chili & macaroni entree
mre_chilimac.description: The chili & macaroni entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes fantastic, could be one of the best MRE menus you can get your hands on.

mre_veggy.name: vegetarian taco entree
mre_veggy.description: The vegetarian taco entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes decent, not good but not offensive either.

mre_macaronimarinara.name: macaroni & marinara entree
mre_macaronimarinara.description: The macaroni & marinara entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_cheesetort.name: cheese tortellini entree
mre_cheesetort.description: The cheese tortellini entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good.

mre_mushroomfettuccine.name: mushroom fettuccine entree
mre_mushroomfettuccine.description: The mushroom fettuccine entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes horrible, but a few steps above the infamous vomelette.

mre_mexicanchickenstew.name: Mexican chicken stew entree
mre_mexicanchickenstew.description: The Mexican chicken stew entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good.

mre_chickenburritobowl.name: chicken burrito bowl entree
mre_chickenburritobowl.description: The chicken burrito bowl entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes delicious.

mre_maplesausage.name: maple sausage entree
mre_maplesausage.description: The maple sausage entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good.

mre_ravioli.name: ravioli entree
mre_ravioli.description: The ravioli entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes decent, but the flavor is just not there.

mre_pepperjackbeef.name: pepper jack beef entree
mre_pepperjackbeef.description: The pepper jack beef entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes decent and just a step above bland.

mre_hashbrownbacon.name: hash browns & bacon entree
mre_hashbrownbacon.description: The hash browns & bacon entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good.

mre_lemontuna.name: lemon pepper tuna entree
mre_lemontuna.description: The lemon pepper tuna entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes decent, the sweet flavor is just too strong.

mre_asianbeef.name: asian beef & vegetables entree
mre_asianbeef.description: The asian beef & vegetables entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes good and exotic.

mre_chickenpesto.name: chicken pesto & pasta entree
mre_chickenpesto.description: The chicken pesto & pasta entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes decent, just enough to eat.

mre_southwestbeef.name: southwest beef & beans entree
mre_southwestbeef.description: The southwest beef & beans entree from an MRE.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  This one tastes fantastic, could be one of the best MRE menus you can get your hands on.

mre_hotdog.name: frankfurters & beans entree
mre_hotdog.description: The dreaded four fingers of death.  It seems to be several decades old.  Sterilized using radiation, so it's safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  You have the potential to become the first person on Earth to be capable of enjoying this, with enough training.

mre_omelette.name: cheese omelette entree
mre_omelette.description: The unholy vomelette.  It seems to be several decades old.  Sterilized using radiation, so you might be mistaken that it is safe to eat.  It's wrapped in an atmospherically-sealed package.  Keep this one for the dogs that you happen to really, really hate.

mushroom_morel.name: morel mushroom
mushroom_morel.description: Prized by chefs and woodsmen alike, morel mushrooms are delicious but must be cooked before they are safe to eat.

morel_fried.name: fried morel mushroom
morel_fried.description: A delicious serving of fried morsels of morel mushroom.

dry_mushroom.name: dried mushroom
dry_mushroom.description: Dried mushrooms are a tasty and healthy addition to many meals.

mushroom.name: mushroom
mushroom.description: Mushrooms are tasty, but be careful.  Some can poison you, while others are hallucinogenic.

iv_mutagen.name: mutagenic serum
iv_mutagen.description: A super-concentrated mutagen.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_alpha.name: alpha serum
iv_mutagen_alpha.description: A super-concentrated mutagen strongly resembling blood.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_beast.name: beast serum
iv_mutagen_beast.description: A super-concentrated mutagen as red as a matador's cape.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_bird.name: bird serum
iv_mutagen_bird.description: A super-concentrated mutagen the color of the pre-Cataclysmic skies.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_cattle.name: cattle serum
iv_mutagen_cattle.description: A super-concentrated mutagen the color of grass.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_cephalopod.name: cephalopod serum
iv_mutagen_cephalopod.description: A super-concentrated mutagen as black as ink.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_chimera.name: chimera serum
iv_mutagen_chimera.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that churns with iridescence.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_elfa.name: elf-a serum
iv_mutagen_elfa.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that's a striking sylvan green.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_feline.name: feline serum
iv_mutagen_feline.description: A super-concentrated mutagen, yellow and highly reflective.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_fish.name: fish serum
iv_mutagen_fish.description: A super-concentrated mutagen the color of the ocean, with white foam at the top.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_insect.name: insect serum
iv_mutagen_insect.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that's a beautiful amber color.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_lizard.name: lizard serum
iv_mutagen_lizard.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that shifts between various shades of green.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_serpent.name: serpent serum
iv_mutagen_serpent.description: A super-concentrated mutagen resembling congealed venom.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_lupine.name: lupine serum
iv_mutagen_lupine.description: A super-concentrated mutagen as white as a full moon.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_medical.name: medical serum
iv_mutagen_medical.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that looks like a mixture of bodily fluids.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_plant.name: plant serum
iv_mutagen_plant.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that looks like pureed spinach.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_rabbit.name: rabbit serum
iv_mutagen_rabbit.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that looks like pureed carrots.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_raptor.name: raptor serum
iv_mutagen_raptor.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that seems to shift slightly whenever you look at it.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_rat.name: rat serum
iv_mutagen_rat.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that's a rather unappealing beige.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_slime.name: slime serum
iv_mutagen_slime.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that looks very much like the black ooze in the zombies' eyes.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_spider.name: spider serum
iv_mutagen_spider.description: A super-concentrated mutagen with pale filaments suspended in it.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_troglobite.name: troglobite serum
iv_mutagen_troglobite.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that seems to recoil from the light.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_ursine.name: ursine serum
iv_mutagen_ursine.description: A super-concentrated mutagen that's the color of honey, and is just as thick.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

iv_mutagen_mouse.name: mouse serum
iv_mutagen_mouse.description: A super-concentrated mutagen resembling liquefied metal.  You need a syringe to inject it… if you really want to?

mutagen.name: mutagen
mutagen.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_jabberblood.name: congealed blood
mutagen_jabberblood.description: A thick, soupy red liquid.  It looks and smells disgusting, and seems to bubble with an intelligence of its own…

mutagen_beast.name: beast mutagen

mutagen_rat.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_slime.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_ursine.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_mouse.name: mouse mutagen
mutagen_mouse.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

purifier.name: purifier
purifier.description: A rare stem-cell treatment that causes mutations and other genetic defects to fade away.

iv_purifier.name: purifier serum
iv_purifier.description: A super-concentrated stem cell treatment.  You need a syringe to inject it.

purifier_smart_shot.name: purifier smart shot
purifier_smart_shot.description: An experimental stem cell treatment utilizing medical nanomachines, offering limited control over which genetic traits are altered. You can use it to selectively remove mutations. The liquid sloshes strangely inside of this syringe.

fetus.name: misshapen fetus
fetus.description: A deformed human fetus.  Eating this would be the most vile thing you can think of, and just might cause you to mutate.

arm.name: mutated arm
arm.description: A misshapen human arm.  Eating this would be incredibly disgusting and probably cause you to mutate.

leg.name: mutated leg
leg.description: A malformed human leg.  This would be gross to eat, and probably cause mutations.

taint_tornado.name: tainted tornado
taint_tornado.description: A frothing slurry of alcohol-soaked zombie rotten blood, it smells almost as bad as it looks.  Will make you mutate uncontrollably.

drink_sewerbrew.name: sewer brew
drink_sewerbrew.description: Improvised, uncontrolled mutagen.  It tastes horrible too!

drink_sewersoda.name: sewer soda
drink_sewersoda.description: Improvised, uncontrolled mutagen.  It tastes bearable now that it's been loaded with sugar and carbonated, however still not 'enjoyable.'  It is sewage, after all.

pine_nuts.name: pine nuts
pine_nuts.description: A handful of tasty crunchy nuts from a pinecone.

juniper.name: junipers
juniper.description: A handful of junipers, for making gin and earthy flavors.  Technically a seed cone, but resembles a small blue berry.  Spicy, tastes similar to rosemary.

pistachio.name: pistachios
pistachio.description: A handful of nuts from a pistachio tree.

pistachio_roasted.name: roasted pistachios
pistachio_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a pistachio tree.

almond.name: almonds
almond.description: A handful of nuts from an almond tree.

almond_pulp.name: almond pulp
almond_pulp.description: Pulp left over after making almond milk.  It's gritty and incredibly bland.

almond_roasted.name: roasted almonds
almond_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from an almond tree.

pecan.name: pecans
pecan.description: A handful of pecans which are a sub-species of hickory nuts.

pecan_roasted.name: roasted pecans
pecan_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a pecan tree.

beech_nuts.name: beech nuts
beech_nuts.description: A handful of hard pointy nuts from a beech tree.

walnut.name: walnuts
walnut.description: A handful of raw hard nuts from a walnut tree.

walnut_roasted.name: roasted walnuts
walnut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a walnut tree.

chestnut.name: chestnuts
chestnut.description: A handful of raw hard nuts from a chestnut tree.

chestnut_roasted.name: roasted chestnuts
chestnut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a chestnut tree.

hazelnut.name: hazelnuts
hazelnut.description: A handful of raw hard nuts from a hazelnut tree.

hazelnut_roasted.name: roasted hazelnuts
hazelnut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a hazelnut tree.

hickory_nut.name: hickory nuts
hickory_nut.description: A handful of raw hard nuts from a hickory tree.

hickory_nut_roasted.name: roasted hickory nuts
hickory_nut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a hickory tree.

hickory_nut_ambrosia.name: hickory nut ambrosia
hickory_nut_ambrosia.description: Delicious hickory nut ambrosia.  A drink worthy of the gods.

acorns.name: acorns
acorns.description: A handful of acorns, still in their shells.  Squirrels like them, but they're not very good for you to eat in this state.

acorn_roasted.name: roasted acorns
acorn_roasted.description: A handful roasted nuts from an oak tree.

acorns_cooked.name: cooked acorn meal
acorns_cooked.description: A serving of acorns that have been hulled, chopped, and boiled in water before being thoroughly toasted until dry.  Filling and nutritious.

foie_gras.name: foie gras
foie_gras.description: Though it's not technically foie gras, you don't have to think about that.

liver_onion.name: liver & onions
liver_onion.description: A classic way to serve liver.

fried_livers.name: fried liver
fried_livers.description: Nothing tastier than something that's deep-fried!

humble_pie.name: humble pie
humble_pie.description: Also known as 'Umble' pie, made with chopped organ meats.  Not half bad, and really good for you!

stewed_tripe.name: stewed tripe
stewed_tripe.description: Stomach lining, cut up and stewed for an hour in broth.  Better than it sounds.

fried_tripe.name: deep-fried tripe
fried_tripe.description: Nothing tastier than something that's deep-fried!

leverpostej.name: leverpostej
leverpostej.description: A traditional Danish pate.  Probably better if you spread it on some bread.

brain_cooked.name: cooked brains
brain_cooked.description: Now you can emulate those zombies you love so much!  Preparing brain for eating is challenging, and this doesn't seem to be the best way to do it.

fried_brain.name: fried brain
fried_brain.description: I don't know what you were expecting.  It's deep-fried.

deviled_kidney.name: deviled kidney
deviled_kidney.description: A delicious way to prepare kidneys.

sweetbread_cooked.name: cooked sweetbread
sweetbread_cooked.description: Normally a delicacy, it needs a little… something.

grilled_sweetbread.name: grilled sweetbread
grilled_sweetbread.description: Not sweet, like the name would suggest, but delicious all the same!

liver_cooked.name: cooked liver
liver_cooked.description: Chock-full of B-Vitamins!  Cooked liver isn't all that bad, depending on how you feel about the texture, but this is probably the least fancy way to do it.

canned_liver.name: canned liver
canned_liver.description: Livers preserved in a can.  Chock-full of B vitamins!

lung_cooked.name: cooked piece of lung
lung_cooked.description: Prepared in this way, it's a chewy grayish lump of flavorless connective tissue.  It doesn't look any tastier than it did raw, but the parasites are all cooked out.

lung_provence.name: lung provence
lung_provence.description: A delicious way to prepare lungs.

scrambledeggsandbrain.name: scrambled eggs and brain
scrambledeggsandbrain.description: Brains and eggs, why didn't you ever think to put these together?

sausage_casings.name: sausage casing
sausage_casings.description: Sausage casings made from animal intestines.  Ready to be used for forming meat products.

sausage_casings_plastic.name: artificial sausage casing
sausage_casings_plastic.description: Sausage casings made from plastic.  Ready to be used for forming meat products.

homemade_hotdogs.name: homemade hot dog
homemade_hotdogs.description: A heavily processed sausage, commonplace at baseball games before the Cataclysm.  It would taste much better prepared.

offal_cooked.name: fried offal
offal_cooked.description: This is freshly cooked organ meat and entrails.  Deep-frying it makes it more palatable, and while it's probably less healthy it's still filled with essential vitamins.

testcomest.name: diet pill
testcomest.description: Not very nutritious.  Warning: contains calories, unsuitable for breatharians.

slime_scrap.name: blob glob
slime_scrap.description: A little hunk of glop that fell off a blob monster.  It doesn't seem hostile, but it does wiggle occasionally.

honeycomb.name: honey comb
honeycomb.description: A large chunk of wax filled with honey.  Very tasty.

wax.name: wax
wax.description: A large chunk of beeswax.  Not very tasty or nourishing, but okay in an emergency.

royal_jelly.name: royal jelly
royal_jelly.description: A translucent hexagonal chunk of wax, filled with dense, milky jelly.  Rich with the most beneficial substances post-cataclysm hives can produce, it can cure various afflictions and serve as an antitoxin.  However, it's also rich in mutagenic toxins of its own, given the creatures producing it.

use_action.activation_message: You feel warm inside after eating the royal jelly.

marloss_berry.name: marloss berry
marloss_berry.description: This looks like a blueberry the size of your fist, but pinkish in color.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.

marloss_gel.name: marloss gelatin
marloss_gel.description: This looks like a handful of lemon-colored liquid which has taken a set, much like pre-Cataclysm Jello.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.

mycus_fruit.name: mycus fruit
mycus_fruit.description: Humans might call this a Gray Delicious apple: large, gray, and smells even better than the Marloss.  If they didn't reject it for its alien origins.  But we know better.

yeast.name: yeast
yeast.description: A powder-like mix of cultured yeast, good for baking and brewing alike.

meal_bone.name: bone meal
meal_bone.description: This bone meal can be used to craft fertilizer and some other things.

meal_bone_tainted.name: tainted bone meal
meal_bone_tainted.description: This is a grayish bone meal made from rotten bones.

meal_chitin_piece.name: chitin powder
meal_chitin_piece.description: This chitin powder can be used to craft fertilizer and some other things.

can_beans.name: canned beans
can_beans.description: Canned beans.  A staple among canned goods, these are reputedly good for one's coronary health.

dry_beans.name: dried beans
dry_beans.description: Dehydrated great northern beans.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.

beans_cooked.name: cooked beans
beans_cooked.description: A hearty serving of cooked great northern beans.

tofu.name: tofu
tofu.description: Tofu, a soy protein crucial to East Asian cuisine.  It absorbs flavors very well and can be used as a meat alternative in many dishes.

tofu_fried.name: fried tofu
tofu_fried.description: Tofu, a soy protein crucial to East Asian cuisine.  It absorbs flavors very well and can be used as a meat alternative in many dishes.

dry_tofu.name: dehydrated tofu
dry_tofu.description: Dehydrated tofu, sealed and still extra firm to last a long time.

soybean.name: soybeans
soybean.description: Light brown beans, they have many uses, mildly toxic and not recommended, but you could eat them raw.

raw_edamame.name: raw edamame
raw_edamame.description: Light green raw edamame still in its pod, you should boil or freeze these, or you could eat them while they are still toxic.

dry_lentils.name: dried lentils
dry_lentils.description: A humble but nutrient-rich legume.  Should be cooked prior to consumption.

foodplace_food.name: Foodplace's delicious food™
foodplace_food.description: The best-seller from Foodplace, delicious food™, is made with real foodstuff and is guaranteed 100% edible!

lentils_cooked.name: cooked lentils
lentils_cooked.description: Some delicious cooked lentils.  Humble but nutrient-rich.

coffee_raw.name: coffee powder
coffee_raw.description: Ground coffee beans.  You can boil it into a mediocre stimulant, or something better if you had an atomic coffee pot.

coffee_raw_kentucky.name: Kentucky coffee grounds
coffee_raw_kentucky.description: Coffee grounds created through washing, cleaning, and roasting the pods from a Kentucky coffeetree.  They can be used to create coffee.

honey_glassed.name: candied honey
honey_glassed.description: Honey, that stuff the bees make.  This variant is "candied honey", a variant of very thick consistence.  This honey won't spoil and is good for your digestion.

can_tomato.name: canned tomato
can_tomato.description: Canned tomato.  A staple in many pantries, and useful for many recipes.

human_brain_embalmed.name: embalmed human brain
human_brain_embalmed.description: This is a human brain soaked in a solution of highly toxic formaldehyde.  Eating this would be a terrible idea.

cattlefodder.name: cattle fodder
cattlefodder.description: What cattle eat.  Mainly made of grass, silage or legumes.  It's perfect for ruminants.  Activate it to attempt to tame an adjacent wild animal, or to feed it to pets to speed up healing and productivity.

birdfood.name: bird food
birdfood.description: What birds eat.  Mainly made of seeds, silage or legumes.  It's perfect for small birds.  Activate it to attempt to tame an adjacent wild animal, or to feed it to pets to speed up healing and productivity.

dogfood.name: dog food
dogfood.description: This is food for dogs.  It smells strange, but dogs seem to love it.  Activate it to attempt to tame an adjacent wild animal, or to feed it to pets to speed up healing and productivity.

catfood.name: cat food
catfood.description: This is food for cats.  It smells strange, but cats seem to love it.  Activate it to attempt to tame an adjacent wild animal, or to feed it to pets to speed up healing and productivity.

jellied_insects_petfood.name: jellied insects
jellied_insects_petfood.description: Preserved insect organs, perfect for animals who like extra proteins.  Activate it to attempt to tame an adjacent wild animal, or to feed it to pets to speed up healing and productivity.

grass.name: grass
grass.description: Some grass, edible by grazers and ruminants only.  Seeing this item is a bug.

underbrush.name: underbrush
underbrush.description: Some underbrush, edible by ruminants only.  Seeing this item is a bug.

nectar.name: nectar
nectar.description: Some nectar.  Seeing this item is a bug.

protein_drink.name: protein drink
protein_drink.description: A thin slurry of refined protein mixed with water.  While quite nutritious, it is not particularly tasty.

protein_powder.name: protein powder
protein_powder.description: Raw, refined protein.  While quite nutritious, it is impossible to enjoy in its pure form, try adding water.

protein_bar_evac.name: protein ration
protein_bar_evac.description: SoyPelusa ran a highly successful crowdfunding campaign for this protein bar.  A person can live on one of these bars, three times a day, presumably forever.  After backers received their product, a single flaw was found: most consumers found starvation preferable to the flavor.  Warehouses of the product went unsold as the company went bankrupt, providing the perfect opportunity for FEMA to scoop them up and stock the evac shelters.  Now, you hold a piece of famous crowdfunding history in your hands.  How exciting.

protein_shake.name: protein shake
protein_shake.description: A thick and tasty beverage made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit.

protein_shake_fortified.name: fortified protein shake
protein_shake_fortified.description: A thick and tasty beverage made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit.  It has been supplemented with extra vitamins and minerals

apple.name: apple
apple.description: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.

banana.name: banana
banana.description: A long, curved yellow fruit in a peel.  Some people like using them in desserts.  Those people are probably dead.

cacao_pod.name: cacao pod
cacao_pod.description: The cacao fruit, scientifically known as Theobroma cacao, is the source of cocoa beans used to make chocolate.  It is a tropical fruit that contains cocoa beans surrounded by a sweet-tasting, white pulp.  The beans are harvested, fermented, and processed to produce various chocolate products.

orange.name: orange
orange.description: Sweet citrus fruit.  Also comes in juice form.

lemon.name: lemon
lemon.description: Very sour citrus.  Can be eaten if you really want.

blueberries.name: blueberries
blueberries.description: They're blue, but that doesn't mean they're sad.

strawberries.name: strawberries
strawberries.description: Tasty, juicy berry.  Often found growing wild in fields.

cranberries.name: cranberries
cranberries.description: Sour red berries.  Good for your health.

huckleberries.name: huckleberries
huckleberries.description: Huckleberries, often times confused for blueberries.

mulberries.name: mulberries
mulberries.description: Mulberries, this red variety is unique to east North America and is described to have the strongest flavor of any variety in the world.

elderberries.name: elderberries
elderberries.description: Elderberries, toxic when eaten raw but great when cooked.

rose_hips.name: rose hips
rose_hips.description: The fruit of a pollinated rose flower.

juice_pulp.name: juice pulp
juice_pulp.description: Left-over from juicing the fruit.  Not very tasty, but contains a lot of healthy fiber.

grapefruit.name: grapefruit
grapefruit.description: A citrus fruit, whose taste ranges from sour to semi-sweet.

cherries.name: cherries
cherries.description: A red, sweet fruit that grows in trees.

plums.name: plum
plums.description: A handful of large, purple plums.  Healthy and good for your digestion.

pineapple.name: pineapple
pineapple.description: A large, spiky pineapple.  A bit sour, though.

coconut.name: coconut
coconut.description: A fruit with a hard and hairy shell.

peach.name: peach
peach.description: This fruit's large pit is surrounded by its tasty flesh.

watermelon.name: watermelon
watermelon.description: A fruit, bigger than your head.  It is very juicy!

melon.name: melon
melon.description: A large and very sweet fruit.

mango.name: mango
mango.description: A fleshy fruit with large pit.

pomegranate.name: pomegranate
pomegranate.description: Under this pomegranate's spongy skin lies hundreds of fleshy seeds.

papaya.name: papaya
papaya.description: A very sweet and soft tropical fruit.

kiwi.name: kiwi
kiwi.description: A large, brown and fuzzy-skinned berry.  Its delicious insides are green.

apricot.name: apricots
apricot.description: A smooth-skinned fruit, related to the peach.

cholla_bud.name: cholla bud
cholla_bud.description: Edible bud of a cholla cactus, with spines removed; the candy of the Mojave indigenous peoples.  Tastes similar to asparagus.

cactus_pad.name: cactus pad
cactus_pad.description: An edible pad of a cactus.

barley.name: barley
barley.description: Grainy cereal used for malting.  A staple of brewing everywhere.  It can also be ground into flour.

bee_balm.name: bee balm
bee_balm.description: A snow-white flower also known as wild bergamot.  Smells faintly of mint.

broccoli.name: broccoli
broccoli.description: It's a bit tough, but quite delicious.

buckwheat.name: buckwheat
buckwheat.description: Seeds from a wild buckwheat plant.  Not particularly good to eat in their raw state, they are commonly cooked or ground into flour.

grape_leaves.name: grape leaves
grape_leaves.description: Edible leaves of a grape vine.  Typically used in salads or as food wrapping.

carrot.name: carrot
carrot.description: A healthy root vegetable.  Rich in vitamin A!

cattail_rhizome.name: cattail rhizome
cattail_rhizome.description: A stout branching rhizome from a cattail plant.  Its crisp white flesh is very starchy and fibrous, but you really ought to cook it before you attempt to eat it.

cattail_stalk.name: cattail stalk
cattail_stalk.description: A stiff green stalk from a cattail plant.  It is starchy and fibrous, but it would be much better if you cooked it.

celery.name: celery
celery.description: Neither tasty nor very nutritious, but it goes well with salad.

cotton_boll.name: cotton boll
cotton_boll.description: A tough protective capsule bulging with densely packed fibers and seeds, this cotton boll can be processed into usable material with the right tools.

cucumber.name: cucumber
cucumber.description: Comes from the gourd family.  Not tasty but very juicy.

dahlia_root.name: dahlia root
dahlia_root.description: The large, tuberous root of a dahlia flower.  It smells spicy, but is too starchy to eat without cooking.

salsify_raw.name: salsify
salsify_raw.description: An herb with a small purple flower.  The roots are nutritious, but tough and bland until cooked.

chicory_raw.name: chicory
chicory_raw.description: A modest blue flower.  The flower's roots are very bitter and not meant to be eaten raw.

carrot_wild.name: wild root
carrot_wild.description: A weed with a cluster of tiny white flowers.  These are often wild carrots, but beware of poisonous lookalikes.

dogbane.name: dogbane
dogbane.description: A stalk of dogbane.  It has very fibrous stems and is mildly poisonous.

garlic.name: garlic bulb
garlic.description: A pungent garlic bulb.  Popular as a seasoning for its strong flavor.  Can be disassembled to cloves.

hops.name: hops flower
hops.description: A cluster of small cone-like flowers, indispensable for brewing beer.

horseradish_root.name: horseradish root
horseradish_root.description: Large white tapered root of a horseradish plant.  Way too spicy in this form, but can be used for making condiments.

lettuce.name: lettuce
lettuce.description: A crisp head of iceberg lettuce.

mugwort.name: mugwort
mugwort.description: A stalk of mugwort.  Smells wonderful.

onion.name: onion
onion.description: An aromatic onion used in cooking.  Cutting these up can make your eyes sting!

plant_sac.name: fungal fluid sac
plant_sac.description: A fluid bladder from a fungus based lifeform.  Not very nutritious, but fine to eat anyway.

popcorn_raw.name: raw popcorn
popcorn_raw.description: A special variety of corn which could be used for making popcorn, after it's dried.  Unlike normal corn, it's not sweet and is more dry.

potato.name: raw potato
potato.description: Mildly toxic and not very tasty raw.  When cooked, it is delicious.

pumpkin.name: pumpkin
pumpkin.description: A large vegetable, about the size of your head.  Not very tasty raw, but is great for cooking.

horseradish_greens.name: horseradish greens
horseradish_greens.description: Leaves of a horseradish plant with a sharp, bitter and peppery taste.  They're edible, but not commonly eaten.

raw_dandelion.name: dandelions
raw_dandelion.description: A collection of freshly picked yellow dandelions.  In their current raw state they are quite bitter.

raw_burdock.name: burdocks
raw_burdock.description: Burdock, a bitter thistle-like vegetable.  Can be eaten raw or cooked.

rhubarb.name: rhubarb
rhubarb.description: Sour stems of the rhubarb plant, often used in baking pies.

sugar_beet.name: sugar beet
sugar_beet.description: This fleshy root is ripe and flowing with sugars; just takes some processing to extract them.

tea_raw.name: tea leaf
tea_raw.description: Dried leaves of a tropical plant.  You can boil them into tea, or you can just eat them raw.  They aren't too filling though.

coca_leaf.name: coca leaf
coca_leaf.description: Coca leaves.  Have a long history of medicinal and culinary uses, and can produce a mild high when chewed.  You can boil them into tea or you can just eat them raw.  Can cause addiction if consumed in large quantities.

tomato.name: tomato
tomato.description: Juicy red tomato.  It gained popularity in Italy after being brought back from the New World.

veggy.name: plant marrow
veggy.description: A nutrient rich chunk of plant matter, could be eaten raw or cooked.

veggy_tainted.name: alien fungus chunk
veggy_tainted.description: This is a chunk of fungal matter from some sort of alien mushroom creature.  Eating unfamiliar mushrooms is a bad idea.

veggy_wild.name: wild vegetables
veggy_wild.description: An assortment of edible-looking wild plants.  Most are quite bitter-tasting.  Some are inedible until cooked.

canola.name: canola
canola.description: A pretty stalk of canola.  Its seeds can be pressed into oil.

raw_beans.name: raw beans
raw_beans.description: Raw, uncooked beans.  They are mildly toxic in this form, but you could cook them to make them tasty.

raw_lentils.name: raw lentils
raw_lentils.description: Raw, uncooked lentils.  They could be cooked.

fiddlehead_raw.name: fiddleheads
fiddlehead_raw.description: A handful of immature fern fronds, still curled up like the head of a fiddle.  Delicious when cooked, but consuming raw can cause food poisoning.

rice_bran.name: rice bran
rice_bran.description: The leftover outer layer of rice seeds, this vegetable matter is quite nutritionally dense and makes for a good cooking oil.

lake_greens.name: aquatic greens
lake_greens.description: Shoots and leaves from underwater plants, such as hornwort or pondweed.  A bit like raw seaweed.

sandwich_generic.name: GENERIC SANDWICH
sandwich_generic.description: If you can see this, you shouldn't be able to.  This is to solve dumb copy-from issues.

sandwich_deluxe.name: deluxe sandwich
sandwich_deluxe.description: A sandwich of meat, vegetables, and cheese with condiments.  Tasty and nutritious!

sandwich_cheese_grilled.name: grilled cheese sandwich
sandwich_cheese_grilled.description: A delicious grilled cheese sandwich, because everything is better with melted cheese.

sandwich_fairy.name: fairy bread
sandwich_fairy.description: An 'open-faced sandwich' consisting of sliced white bread, a healthy crust-to-crust slathering of butter, and sprinkles.  Supposedly a staple of birthday parties in Australia.

sandwich_sauce.name: sauce sandwich
sandwich_sauce.description: A simple sauce sandwich.  Not very filling but beats eating just the bread.

sandwich_pb.name: peanut butter sandwich
sandwich_pb.description: Some peanut butter smothered between two pieces of bread.  Not very filling and will stick to the roof of your mouth like glue.

sandwich_pbj.name: PB&J sandwich
sandwich_pbj.description: A delicious peanut butter and jelly sandwich.  It reminds you of the times your mother would make you lunch.

sandwich_pbh.name: PB&H sandwich
sandwich_pbh.description: Some damned fool put honey on this peanut butter sandwich, who in their right mind- oh wait this is pretty good.

sandwich_pbm.name: PB&M sandwich
sandwich_pbm.description: Who knew you could mix maple syrup and peanut butter to create yet another different sandwich?

sandwich_okay.name: okay sandwich
sandwich_okay.description: A simple sandwich, little more than meat and veggies on bread.  Rather dry.

sandwich_deluxe_nocheese.name: dairy-free deluxe sandwich
sandwich_deluxe_nocheese.description: A deluxe sandwich with meat, veggies, and sauce, but no cheese.

seed_hops.name: hop rhizomes
seed_hops.description: Roots of a hop plant, for growing your own.

seed_cotton_boll.name: cotton seeds
seed_cotton_boll.description: Some cotton seeds.  Can be processed to produce an edible oil.

seed_cattail.name: cattail seeds
seed_cattail.description: Some cattail seeds.  Must be planted in shallow water.

seed_wildcarrot.name: wild root seeds
seed_wildcarrot.description: Some seeds from a white flower.

seed_flower.name: decorative plant seeds
seed_flower.description: Some small decorative plant seeds, likely grass or flower.  Don't expect them to be useful for anything other than dry plant material.

garlic_clove.name: garlic clove
garlic_clove.description: Cloves of garlic.  Useful as a seasoning, or for planting.

seed_potato_raw.name: seed potato
seed_potato_raw.description: A raw potato, cut into pieces, separating each bud for planting.

seed_weed.name: cannabis seeds
seed_weed.description: Seeds of the cannabis plant.  Filled with vitamins, they can be roasted or eaten raw.

marloss_seed.name: Marloss seed
marloss_seed.description: This looks like a sunflower seed the size of your palm.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.  You could probably plant it.

seed_beans.name: bean seeds
seed_beans.description: Raw, uncooked beans, ready for planting.

seed_lentils.name: seed lentils
seed_lentils.description: Raw, uncooked lentils, ready for planting.

seed_canola.name: canola seeds
seed_canola.description: Some canola seeds.  You could press them into oil.

seed_pumpkin.name: pumpkin seeds
seed_pumpkin.description: Some raw pumpkin seeds.  Could be fried and eaten.

seed_sunflower.name: sunflower seeds
seed_sunflower.description: Some raw sunflower seeds.  Could be pressed into oil.

seed_wild_herbs.name: wild herb seeds
seed_wild_herbs.description: Some seeds harvested from wild herbs.

datura_seed.name: datura seeds
datura_seed.description: Small, dark seeds from the spiny pods of a datura plant.  Full of powerful psychoactive chemicals, these tiny seeds are a potent analgesic and deliriant, and can be deadly in cases of overdose.

fried_seeds.name: fried seeds
fried_seeds.description: Some fried seeds of a sunflower, pumpkin or other plant.  Quite nutritious and tasty.

coffee_pod.name: Kentucky coffee pod
coffee_pod.description: Coffee pods taken from a Kentucky coffeetree.  If washed thoroughly and roasted, you could use them to make a dark and bitter brew much like coffee.

coffee_bean.name: coffee beans
coffee_bean.description: Some coffee beans, can be roasted.

roasted_coffee_bean.name: roasted coffee beans
roasted_coffee_bean.description: Some roasted coffee beans, can be ground into powder.

seed_mustard.name: mustard seeds
seed_mustard.description: Some mustard seeds.  Could be ground into mustard powder.

seed_rice.name: raw wild rice
seed_rice.description: Some northern wild rice, ready for planting or drying.  Must be planted in shallow water.

mushroom_culture.name: mushroom culture
mushroom_culture.description: A chunk of compost laden with spores and mycelium, for growing your own mushrooms.  You'll need to "plant" these on tree trunks, or dedicated mushroom racks, for it to grow.

mushroom_morel_culture.name: morel mushroom culture
mushroom_morel_culture.description: A chunk of compost laden with spores and mycelium, for growing your own morel mushrooms.  You'll need to "plant" these on tree trunks, or dedicated mushroom racks, for it to grow.

seed_mycus_fruit.name: mycus fruit seedpod
seed_mycus_fruit.description: A cluster of stony seeds entangled in a net of fine gray mycelium.  If planted on a tree trunk or dedicated mushroom rack, great things could grow from it.

broth.name: broth
broth.description: Vegetable stock.  Tasty and fairly nutritious.

broth_bone.name: bone broth
broth_bone.description: A tasty and nutritious broth made from bones.

soup_veggy.name: vegetable soup
soup_veggy.description: A nutritious and delicious hearty vegetable soup.

soup_meat.name: meat soup
soup_meat.description: A nutritious and delicious hearty meat soup.

soup_blood.name: blood soup
soup_blood.description: Soup made of animal blood and vinegar.  Not something everyone likes, but a delicacy in parts of Germany, also named "Schwarzsauer".

soup_fish.name: fish soup
soup_fish.description: A nutritious and delicious hearty fish soup.

curry_veggy.name: curry
curry_veggy.description: Spicy, and filled with bits of peppers.  It's pretty good.

curry_meat.name: curry with meat
curry_meat.description: Spicy, and filled with bits of peppers and meat!  It's pretty good.

soup_woods.name: woods soup
soup_woods.description: A nutritious and delicious soup, made of gifts of nature.

soup_chicken.name: chicken noodle soup
soup_chicken.description: Chicken chunks and noodles swimming in a salty broth.  Rumored to help cure colds.

soup_mushroom.name: mushroom soup
soup_mushroom.description: A mushy, gray semi-liquid soup made from mushrooms.

soup_tomato.name: tomato soup
soup_tomato.description: It smells of tomatoes.  Not very filling, but it goes well with grilled cheese.

soup_dumplings.name: chicken and dumplings
soup_dumplings.description: A soup with chicken chunks and balls of dough.  Not bad.

soup_cullenskink.name: cullen skink
soup_cullenskink.description: A rich and tasty fish chowder from Scotland, made with preserved fish and creamy milk.

chilly-p.name: chili powder
chilly-p.description: Chilly P, Yo!  Not edible on its own, but it could be used to make seasoning.

cinnamon.name: cinnamon
cinnamon.description: Ground cinnamon bark with a sweet but slightly spicy aroma.

curry_powder.name: curry powder
curry_powder.description: A blend of spices meant to be used in some South Asian dishes.  Can't be eaten raw, why would you even try that?

pepper.name: black pepper
pepper.description: Ground black spice berries with a pungent aroma.

salt.name: salt
salt.description: Yuck!  You surely wouldn't want to eat this.  It's good for preserving meat and cooking, though.

seasoning_italian.name: Italian seasoning
seasoning_italian.description: A fragrant mix of dried oregano, basil, thyme and other spices.

seasoning_salt.name: seasoned salt
seasoning_salt.description: Salt mixed with a fragrant blend of secret herbs and spices.

sugar.name: sugar
sugar.description: Sweet, sweet sugar.  Bad for your teeth and surprisingly not very tasty on its own.

sprinkles.name: sprinkles
sprinkles.description: Known as nonpareils, sprinkles, jimmies, sugar strands or 'hundreds-and-thousands', these colorful balls, rods or flakes of sugar and starch are intended for use decorating soft surfaces of sweets.  Like sugar, they are bad for your teeth and surprisingly not very tasty on their own.

wild_herbs.name: wild herbs
wild_herbs.description: A tasty collection of wild herbs including violet, sassafras, mint, clover, purslane, fireweed, and burdock.

thyme.name: thyme
thyme.description: A stalk of thyme.  Smells delicious.

mustard_powder.name: mustard powder
mustard_powder.description: A fragnant yellow powder.  Not edible in this form.

gochujang.name: gochujang
gochujang.description: A spicy and sweet Korean condiment, quite often used throughout Korean cooking.

cooked_cattail_stalk.name: cooked cattail stalk
cooked_cattail_stalk.description: A cooked stalk from a cattail plant.  Its fibrous outer leaves have been stripped away and now it is quite delicious.

starch.name: starch
starch.description: Sticky, gooey carbohydrate paste extracted from plants.  Spoils rather quickly if not prepared for storage.

garlic_roasted.name: roasted garlic
garlic_roasted.description: Exposed cloves of garlic that have been coated in oil and then roasted.  Much better than eating them raw.

chili_pepper_roasted.name: roasted chili pepper
chili_pepper_roasted.description: Spicy chili pepper that has been roasted on high heat, with skin removed.  Much better than eating it raw, and could also be used for other cooking recipes.

dandelion_cooked.name: cooked dandelion greens
dandelion_cooked.description: Cooked leaves from wild dandelions.  Tasty and nutritious.

dandelion_fried.name: fried dandelions
dandelion_fried.description: Wild dandelion flowers that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

burdock_cooked.name: cooked burdock greens
burdock_cooked.description: Cooked burdock leaves.  Tasty and nutritious.

burdock_fried.name: fried burdocks
burdock_fried.description: Wild burdocks that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

dandelionburdock_fried.name: fried dandelions and burdocks
dandelionburdock_fried.description: Wild dandelions and burdocks that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

veggy_cooked.name: cooked plant marrow
veggy_cooked.description: A freshly cooked chunk of plant matter, tasty and nutritious.

veggy_wild_cooked.name: cooked wild vegetables
veggy_wild_cooked.description: Cooked wild edible plants.  An interesting mix of flavors.

veggy_aspic.name: vegetable aspic
veggy_aspic.description: A dish in which vegetables are set into a gelatin made from a plant stock.

buckwheat_cooked.name: cooked buckwheat
buckwheat_cooked.description: A serving of cooked buckwheat groats.  Healthy and nutritious but bland.

can_corn.name: corn
can_corn.description: Canned corn in water.  Eat up!

hominy.name: hominy
hominy.description: Corn kernels which have been cooked in an alkaline solution and then rinsed, making them better suited for eating or cooking.

cornmeal.name: cornmeal
cornmeal.description: This yellow cornmeal is useful for baking.

deluxe_veggy_beans.name: vegetarian baked beans
deluxe_veggy_beans.description: Slow-cooked beans with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

dry_rice.name: dried rice
dry_rice.description: Dehydrated long-grain rice.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.

rice_cooked.name: cooked rice
rice_cooked.description: A hearty serving of cooked long-grain white rice.

deluxe_veggy_rice.name: fried rice
deluxe_veggy_rice.description: Delicious fried rice with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

beansnrice.name: beans and rice
beansnrice.description: A serving of beans and rice that has been cooked together.  Delicious and healthy!

tofu_rice.name: tofu fried rice
tofu_rice.description: Delicious tofu fried rice with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

tofu_stirfry.name: tofu stirfry
tofu_stirfry.description: A tofu stirfry with rice and a sweet bold flavor sure to be on your mind through these dark days.

deluxe_veggy_beansnrice.name: deluxe vegetarian beans and rice
deluxe_veggy_beansnrice.description: Slow-cooked beans and rice with vegetables and seasonings.  Tasty and very filling.

potato_baked.name: baked potato
potato_baked.description: A delicious baked potato.  Got any sour cream?

cooked_pumpkin.name: mashed pumpkin
cooked_pumpkin.description: This is a simple dish made by cooking the pumpkin pulp and then mashing.

pie_veggy.name: vegetable pie
pie_veggy.description: A delicious baked pie with a delicious vegetable filling.

pizza_veggy.name: vegetable pizza
pizza_veggy.description: A vegetarian pizza, with delicious tomato sauce and a fluffy crust.  Its smell brings back great memories.

sauce_pesto.name: pesto
sauce_pesto.description: Olive oil, basil, garlic, pine nuts.  Simple and delicious.

veggy_canned.name: canned veggy
veggy_canned.description: This mushy pile of vegetable matter was boiled and canned in an earlier life.  Better eat it before it oozes through your fingers.

veggy_salted.name: salted veggy chunk
veggy_salted.description: Vegetable chunks pickled in a salt bath.  Goes well with burgers, if only you can find one.

spaghetti_pesto.name: spaghetti al pesto
spaghetti_pesto.description: Spaghetti, with a generous helping of pesto on top.  Yum!

pickle.name: pickle
pickle.description: A pickled cucumber.  Rather sour, but tastes good and lasts for a long time.

sauerkraut_onions.name: sauerkraut w/ sautee'd onions
sauerkraut_onions.description: This is a delicious sautee of lovely diced onions and sauerkraut.  The smell alone is enough to make your mouth water.

veggy_pickled.name: pickled veggy
veggy_pickled.description: This is a serving of crisply brined and canned vegetable matter.  Tasty and nutritious.

dry_veggy.name: dehydrated vegetable
dry_veggy.description: Dehydrated vegetable flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.

rehydrated_veggy.name: rehydrated vegetable
rehydrated_veggy.description: Reconstituted vegetable flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.

veggy_salad.name: vegetable salad
veggy_salad.description: Salad with all kind of vegetables.

dried_salad.name: dried salad
dried_salad.description: Dried salad packed in a box with mayonnaise and ketchup.  Add water to enjoy.

insta_salad.name: insta-salad
insta_salad.description: Dried salad with water added, not very tasty but still a decent substitution for real salad.

dahlia_baked.name: baked dahlia root
dahlia_baked.description: Baking this dahlia root has broken down the starch, making it softer and sweeter.

salsify_baked.name: roasted salsify
salsify_baked.description: When properly cooked, salsify tastes vaguely like oysters.  Makes a great side dish.

sushi_rice.name: sushi rice
sushi_rice.description: A serving of sticky vinegared rice commonly used in sushi.

onigiri.name: onigiri
onigiri.description: A triangular block of tasty sushi rice with a healthy green vegetable folded around it.

sushi_veggyroll.name: vegetable hosomaki
sushi_veggyroll.description: Delicious chopped vegetables wrapped in tasty sushi rice and rolled up in a healthy green vegetable.

dry_veggy_tainted.name: dehydrated alien fungus chunk
dry_veggy_tainted.description: Pieces of alien mushroom that have been dried to prevent them from rotting away.  It will still poison you if you eat this.

sauerkraut.name: sauerkraut
sauerkraut.description: This crunchy, sour topping made from lettuce or cabbage is perfect for your hot dogs and hamburgers, or, if you're desperate, straight to your stomach.

nopalitos.name: nopalito
nopalitos.description: A less prickly version of cactus pads.

fiddlehead_boiled.name: boiled fiddleheads
fiddlehead_boiled.description: Boiled fiddleheads.  Not bad, but would be better sauteed in butter.

fiddlehead_sauteed.name: sauteed fiddleheads
fiddlehead_sauteed.description: Fiddleheads sauteed in fat.  Tender and delicious.

veggy_sausage.name: smoked veggy sausage
veggy_sausage.description: A plant based sausage that has been cured and smoked for long term storage.

veggy_sausage_cooked.name: cooked veggy sausage
veggy_sausage_cooked.description: A plant based sausage that has been cooked.

edamame_roasted.name: roasted edamame
edamame_roasted.description: Roasted edamame, a heart healthy snack.

soy_nuts.name: roasted soy nuts
soy_nuts.description: Roasted soybeans, often called soy nuts.

kimchi.name: kimchi
kimchi.description: A spicy pickled veggie made of variable ingredients.  Before the Cataclysm, it was traditionally stored in a dedicated refrigerator, but it's actually a preserved food.

kimchi_raw.name: unfermented kimchi
kimchi_raw.description: A spicy, seasoned vegetable that takes on a more complex flavor when fermented.  Traditionally, they are fermented in large clay pots.

buchimgae_veggy.name: buchimgae
buchimgae_veggy.description: A Korean vegetable fritter made by coating ingredients in a light egg batter and pan-frying them into a thin, savory pancake.

tofu_kimchi.name: tofu kimchi
tofu_kimchi.description: Soft, boiled tofu served with spicy, stir-fried kimchi.  The mild tofu complements the bold flavors of the kimchi for a balanced taste.

kebab_veggy.name: vegetable kebab
kebab_veggy.description: Cooked veggies on a stick.  Popular street food originating from the Middle East and later spread to Asia and the rest of the world.

cereal2.name: wheat cereal
cereal2.description: Whole-grain wheat cereal.  It's surprisingly good, and allegedly good for your heart.

porridge_cooked.name: boiled grain
porridge_cooked.description: Whole wheat or barley kernels that have been boiled in water.  Very bland on their own, but will do if you can't prepare them in a different way.

spaghetti_raw.name: raw spaghetti pasta
spaghetti_raw.description: A type of pasta usually used when preparing spaghetti.  It could be eaten raw if you're desperate, but is much better cooked.

lasagne_raw.name: raw lasagne pasta
lasagne_raw.description: A pasta sheet used in making lasagne.  It could be eaten raw if you're desperate, but is much better cooked.

spaghetti_cooked.name: boiled noodles
spaghetti_cooked.description: Fresh wet noodles.  Fairly bland, but fills you up.

macaroni_raw.name: raw macaroni
macaroni_raw.description: It could be eaten raw if you're desperate, but is much better cooked.

macaroni_cooked.name: mac & cheese
macaroni_cooked.description: When the cheese starts flowing, Kraft gets your noodle going.

flour.name: flour
flour.description: This enriched white flour is useful for baking.

oatmeal.name: oatmeal
oatmeal.description: Dry flakes of flattened grain.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, it also doubles as food for horses while dry.

oatmeal_cooked.name: cooked oatmeal
oatmeal_cooked.description: A filling and nutritious New England classic that has sustained pioneers and captains of industry alike.

oatmeal_deluxe.name: deluxe cooked oatmeal
oatmeal_deluxe.description: A filling and nutritious New England classic that has been improved with the addition of extra wholesome ingredients.

pancakes.name: pancake
pancakes.description: Fluffy and delicious pancakes with real maple syrup.

fruit_pancakes.name: fruit pancake
fruit_pancakes.description: Fluffy and delicious pancakes with real maple syrup, made sweeter and healthier with the addition of wholesome fruit.

frenchtoast.name: French toast
frenchtoast.description: Slices of bread dipped in a milk and egg mixture then fried.

waffles.name: waffle
waffles.description: Hey it's waffle time, it's waffle time.  Won't you have some waffles of mine?

fruit_waffles.name: fruit waffle
fruit_waffles.description: Crunchy and delicious waffles with real maple syrup, made sweeter and healthier with the addition of wholesome fruit.

crackers.name: cracker
crackers.description: Dry and salty, these crackers will leave you quite thirsty.

pie.name: fruit pie
pie.description: A delicious baked pie with a sweet fruit filling.

cream_pie.name: cream pie
cream_pie.description: A delicious baked pie filled with a white, thick cream.

pizza_cheese.name: cheese pizza
pizza_cheese.description: A delicious pizza with molten cheese on top.

granola.name: granola
granola.description: A tasty and nutritious mixture of oats, honey, and other ingredients that has been baked until crisp.

pie_maple.name: maple pie
pie_maple.description: A sweet and delicious baked pie with pure maple syrup.

noodles_fast.name: fast noodles
noodles_fast.description: So-called ramen noodles.  Can be eaten raw.

cloutie_dumpling.name: cloutie dumpling
cloutie_dumpling.description: This traditional Scottish treat is a sweet and filling little boiled cake studded with dried fruit.

brioche.name: brioche
brioche.description: Filling bread buns, taste good with tea on a Sunday morning breakfast.

sponge_cake.name: sponge cake
sponge_cake.description: Plain, fluffy cake for the proletariat.

space_cake.name: space cake
space_cake.description: This cake's destiny is to take you on a gnarly trip.

use_action.activation_message: You start scarfing down the delicious cake.  It tastes a little funny though…

brownie.name: brownie
brownie.description: A rich chocolate brownie, just like how grandma used to bake them.

brownie_weed.name: 'special' brownie
brownie_weed.description: This is definitely not how grandma used to bake them.

use_action.activation_message: You start scarfing down the delicious brownie.  It tastes a little funny though…

noodles_kimchi.name: kimchimari guksu
noodles_kimchi.description: Noodles served chilled with kimchi.  The cold but spicy flavor brings a unique refreshment.

stick_fiber.name: fibrous stalk
stick_fiber.description: A rather green stick.  Very fibrous.

tobacco_raw.name: raw tobacco
tobacco_raw.description: Various parts of tobacco plant, full of nicotine.  They need to be dried to become smokable.

Dana_sourdough_bread.name: Dana's sourdough bread
Dana_sourdough_bread.description: This round loaf of bread has a thick, dark crust, and smells very enticing.

chem_glycerol.name: glycerol
chem_glycerol.description: This innocent, sweet, colorless liquid can be used for all kinds of things, from sweetening food to manufacturing medicine to making potent explosives.

chem_acrylamide.name: acrylamide
chem_acrylamide.description: This highly carcinogenic white powder can be readily polymerized into a whole bunch of useful water-soluble gels.

ruined_chunks.name: butchery refuse
ruined_chunks.description: Eugh.  This is a mess of dirt, excreta, connective tissue, and bits of matter like hair and claws, leftover from the butchering process.  Eating it isn't even worth thinking about, but disposing of it might be a concern as it could attract vermin.

brew_milk_curdled.name: curdling milk
brew_milk_curdled.description: Milk with natural rennet added.  Used for making cheese if left in a fermenting vat for some time.

milk_curdled.name: curdled milk
milk_curdled.description: Milk that has been curdled with rennet.  It still needs to be salted and drained of whey.

milk_cream.name: heavy cream
milk_cream.description: Cream that has been skimmed from the top of raw milk left to sit.

flu_shot.name: flu shot
flu_shot.description: Pharmaceutical flu shot designed for mass vaccinations, still in the packaging.  Purported to provide immunity to influenza.

hi_q_shatter.name: high quality shatter
hi_q_shatter.description: Concentrated cannabis extract, commonly known as dabs.  This particular style of concentrate in is a thin sheet and shatters like glass at room temperature.  Argueably its one of the better styles of concentrate compared to wax, crumble, or distilate.  Normal cannabis contains around 20%THC, this shatter should be around 55%THC.

use_action.activation_message: You take a dab. Wow that's got some killer terpenes!

hi_q_wax.name: high quality wax
hi_q_wax.description: Concentrated cannabis extract, commonly known as dabs.  This particular style of concentrate has the look and consistency of a yellow waxy substance at room temperature.  Normal cannabis contains around 20%THC, this wax should be around 45%THC.

use_action.activation_message: You take a dab of some wax.  *cough cough* good stuff!

hi_q_crude_oil.name: high quality crude oil
