use_action.activation_message: You smoke some bad dabs.  Not a good idea.

hi_q_crude_oil.description: This is high quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis.  It still has some residual solvents in it so it needs to be purged in a vacuum oven, whipped over a heated surface, or distilled before it is safe to consume.

lo_q_crude_oil.name: low quality crude oil

use_action.activation_message: You smoke some really bad dabs.  Not a good idea.

lo_q_crude_oil.description: This is low quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis.  It still has some residual solvents in it so it needs to be purged in a vacuum oven, whipped over a heated surface, or distilled before it is safe to consume.

lo_q_crude_oil_ethanol.name: (ethanol) low quality crude oil
lo_q_crude_oil_ethanol.description: This is low quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol and heated over a hotplate.  The next step would be to filter it through a buchner flask.

hi_q_crude_oil_ethanol.name: (ethanol) high quality crude oil
hi_q_crude_oil_ethanol.description: This is high quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol and heated over a hotplate.  The next step would be to filter it through a buchner flask.

lo_q_crude_oil_ethanol_filtered.name: (ethanol) filtered low quality crude oil
lo_q_crude_oil_ethanol_filtered.description: This is low quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol, heated over a hotplate, and filtered through a buchner flask.  The next step would be to run it through a rotovap.

hi_q_crude_oil_ethanol_filtered.name: (ethanol) filtered high quality crude oil
hi_q_crude_oil_ethanol_filtered.description: This is high quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol, heated over a hotplate, and filtered through a buchner flask.  The next step would be to run it through a rotovap.

lo_q_crude_oil_filtered.name: filtered low quality crude oil
lo_q_crude_oil_filtered.description: This is low quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol, heated over a hotplate, filtered through a buchner flask, and all the ethanol recovered using a rotary evaporator.  It is ready for the distillation.

use_action.activation_message: You smoke some really bad dabs.  Not a good idea.

hi_q_crude_oil_filtered.name: filtered high quality crude oil
hi_q_crude_oil_filtered.description: This is high quality concentrated oil derived from cannabis thats been diluted in ethanol, heated over a hotplate, filtered through a buchner flask, and all the ethanol recovered using a rotary evaporator.  It is ready for the distillation.

use_action.activation_message: You smoke some really bad dabs.  Not a good idea.

hi_q_distillate_heads.name: high quality distillate (heads)
hi_q_distillate_heads.description: Concentrated cannabis extract.  This is the 'heads' portion from a distilled batch of crude oil.  It still needs to be ran through a lab grade still one more time before its a finished product.

hi_q_distillate_tails.name: high quality distillate (tails)
hi_q_distillate_tails.description: Concentrated cannabis extract.  This material is the 'tails' portion from a distilled batch of crude oil.  It needs to be ran through a lab grade still another time.

hi_q_distillate.name: high quality distillate
hi_q_distillate.description: Concentrated cannabis extract.  This style of extract goes through the most processing, eliminating most if not all harmful ingredients.  Normal cannabis contains around 20%THC, this distillate should be around 88%THC.  Can be smoked in a bowl, used in a dab pen, or used to make distillate cartridges.

use_action.activation_message: You take a dab of some distillate.  Sooooo smooth...

hi_q_distillate_cart.name: high quality distillate cartridge
hi_q_distillate_cart.description: A small cartridge containing concentrated cannabis extract thats used with dab pens.  This style of extract goes through the most processing, eliminating most if not all harmful ingredients.  Normal cannabis contains around 20%THC, this distillate should be around 70%THC after reintroducing terpenes for flavoring.

use_action.activation_message: You hit your dab pen.  Sooooo smooth...

lobster.name: chunk of lobster meat
lobster.description: A chunk of uncooked lobster meat.

lobster_cooked.name: cooked lobster
lobster_cooked.description: A chunk of delicious cooked lobster meat.

lobster_smoked.name: smoked lobster
lobster_smoked.description: Tasty lobster that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.

dry_lobster.name: dehydrated lobster
dry_lobster.description: Dehydrated lobster flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.

rehydrated_lobster.name: rehydrated lobster
rehydrated_lobster.description: Reconstituted lobster flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.

lobster_pickled.name: pickled lobster
lobster_pickled.description: This is a serving of crisply brined and canned lobster.  Tasty and nutritious.

lobster_salted.name: salted lobster slice
lobster_salted.description: lobster slices cured in brine.  Salty but tasty in a pinch.

lobster_canned.name: canned lobster
lobster_canned.description: Low-sodium preserved lobster.  It was boiled and canned.  Contains most of the nutrition, but little of the savor of cooked lobster.

soup_lobster.name: lobster soup
soup_lobster.description: A nutritious and delicious hearty lobster soup.

fish_bagel.name: fish and spinach bagel
fish_bagel.description: A delicious fish bagel with spinach and eggs.

blt.name: BLT
blt.description: A bacon, lettuce, and tomato sandwich on toasted bread.

sandwich_cucumber.name: cucumber sandwich
sandwich_cucumber.description: A refreshing cucumber sandwich.  Not very filling, but quite tasty.

strawberries_cooked.name: cooked strawberry
strawberries_cooked.description: It's like strawberry jam, only without sugar.

blueberries_cooked.name: cooked blueberry
blueberries_cooked.description: It's like blueberry jam, only without sugar.

battery_test.name: test battery
battery_test.description: This is a testing item for the BATTERY item type.  If you found one in game, it's a bug.

bio_adrenaline.name: Adrenaline Pump CBM
bio_adrenaline.description: A stimulator system that is implanted alongside the adrenal glands, allowing the user to trigger their body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

bio_ads.name: Active Defense System CBM
bio_ads.description: This bionic charges a forcefield around your body that deflects incoming attacks.  Bullets are heavily deflected, piercing well deflected, slashing moderately deflected and bashing barely deflected.  This bionic charges at half speed for 3 turns after being hit, and doesn't consume power when fully charged.

bio_wings.name: Thermofluidic Propulsion Modules CBM
bio_wings.description: An advanced mobility system implanted along the lower spine, legs, and feet, the Thermofluidic Propulsion Modules utilize controlled bursts of heated fluid dynamics and high-efficiency micro-thrusters to achieve lift and precise maneuverability.  This system enables short-range flight and levitation by manipulating pressure and thermal gradients, providing enhanced mobility across challenging terrain.

bio_alarm.name: Alarm System CBM
bio_alarm.description: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert the user.  This is very useful during sleep, or if the user suspects a cloaked pursuer.

bio_armor_arms.name: Arms Alloy Plating CBM
bio_armor_arms.description: Alloy plating that replaces the flesh on the user's arms.  Provides 6 bash and cut protection, 5 ballistic protection, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

bio_armor_eyes.name: Protective Lenses CBM
bio_armor_eyes.description: A bionic package that seals the user's eye sockets with highly protective mirrored lenses and re-routes their tear ducts to their mouth.  Provides 3 bash and cut protection, and 7 environmental protection.

bio_armor_head.name: Head Alloy Plating CBM
bio_armor_head.description: Alloy plating that replaces the flesh on the user's head, protecting both their head and jaw regions.  Provides 6 bash and cut protection, and 5 ballistic protection.

bio_armor_legs.name: Legs Alloy Plating CBM
bio_armor_legs.description: Alloy plating that replaces the flesh on the user's legs.  Provides 6 bash and cut protection, 5 ballistic protection, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

bio_armor_torso.name: Torso Alloy Plating CBM
bio_armor_torso.description: Alloy plating that replaces the flesh on the user's torso, protecting it from physical trauma.  Provides 6 bash and cut protection, and 5 ballistic protection.

bio_batteries.name: Battery System CBM
bio_batteries.description: A battery draining attachment to make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.

bio_blade.name: Monomolecular Blade CBM
bio_blade.description: A deadly 30cm-long blade made of advanced material that is installed inside the forearm, capable of being extended through the back of the user's wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

bio_monowire.name: Monofilament Whip CBM
bio_monowire.description: A razor-sharp thread of advanced material that is installed inside the hand, capable of being extended at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

bio_shotgun.name: Shotgun Arm CBM
bio_shotgun.description: A concealed, single shot 12 gauge shotgun that is implanted inside the left forearm.  Perfect in a pinch.

bio_blood_anal.name: Blood Analysis CBM
bio_blood_anal.description: Small sensors that are implanted in the user's heart, allowing them to analyze their blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

bio_blood_filter.name: Blood Filter CBM
bio_blood_filter.description: A filtration system that is installed in the heart and can actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs, with limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in the system will be affected.

bio_cable.name: Cable Charger System CBM
bio_cable.description: A complex port that is mounted above the hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a battery via cable.

bio_cable_upgrade.name: Cable Charger Upgrade CBM
bio_cable_upgrade.description: A kit for upgrading a pre-installed cable charger with enhanced power throughput.

bio_cable_mkII.name: Cable Charger System CBM Mk. II
bio_cable_mkII.description: This is a military-grade electronic port and power converter system which are surgically mounted above your hip, it has ten times higher throughput than basic version.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via cable.
bio_cable_mkII.name_plural: Cable Charger System CBM Mk. IIs

bio_carbon.name: Subdermal Carbon Filament CBM
bio_carbon.description: A thin armor made of carbon nanotubes, implanted just beneath the skin.  This reduces all bashing damage by 5%, cutting damage by 10%, and ballistic damage by 15%.

bio_chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning CBM
bio_chain_lightning.description: A chain lightning generator that emits a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake and jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

bio_claws.name: Bionic Claws CBM
bio_claws.description: Vicious, retractable claws that are implanted inside the user's fingers.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

bio_climate.name: Internal Climate Control CBM
bio_climate.description: A network of thermal piping which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures once activated.

bio_cloak.name: Cloaking System CBM
bio_cloak.description: This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make the user blend into their surroundings, rendering them fully invisible to eyes and optical sensors.  However, this doesn't prevent detection from other means such as infrared, sonar, etc.

bio_cqb.name: Close Quarters Battle CBM
bio_cqb.description: A set of bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs.  Whilst active, the CQB module will improve the user's hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents them from improving them through combat experience.

bio_dex_enhancer.name: Wired Reflexes CBM
bio_dex_enhancer.description: Bionic nerve stimulators that greatly enhance reaction times, granting a +2 bonus to dexterity.

bio_digestion.name: Expanded Digestive System CBM
bio_digestion.description: This module contains three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only will these extract much more nutrition from food, but also make the user immune to foodborne illness, parasites, and even allow the digestion of rotten food.

bio_ears.name: Enhanced Hearing CBM
bio_ears.description: While this bionic is active, the user's hearing will be drastically improved, allowing them to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage their hearing.

bio_emp_armgun.name: EMP Projector CBM
bio_emp_armgun.description: A ranged EMP generator system that is implanted in the user's right arm and hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.

bio_ethanol.name: Ethanol Burner CBM
bio_ethanol.description: A reactor that burns alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.  It can store up to 500ml and accepts ethanol, methanol and denatured alcohol as fuel.

bio_evap.name: Aero-Evaporator CBM
bio_evap.description: This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.

bio_eye_enhancer.name: Diamond Cornea CBM
bio_eye_enhancer.description: A set of diamond corneas which greatly enhance the user's vision, granting a +2 bonus to perception.

bio_eye_optic.name: Telescopic Lenses CBM
bio_eye_optic.description: An array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses that replaces your natural lenses.  This fixes any mundane vision problems and allows for an increased vision range akin to binoculars.  Once installed they will be impossible to remove, having replaced part of your eyes.

bio_face_mask.name: Facial Distortion CBM
bio_face_mask.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, this bionic module lets the user alter their facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.

bio_faraday.name: Dielectric Capacitance System CBM
bio_faraday.description: A network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors, implanted throughout the body to protect from external electrical discharge.

bio_fingerhack.name: Fingerhack CBM
bio_fingerhack.description: A miniature electrohack, surgically embedded in a finger of the right hand.  This is an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like, but not computers.  Computer proficiency is important, and a failed use may cause damage.

bio_flashbang.name: Flashbang Generator CBM
bio_flashbang.description: A combination of LEDs and speakers that create a flash and sound comparable to a flashbang grenade, deafening and blinding nearby enemies.

bio_minirose.name: Minirose CBM
bio_minirose.description: An implanted dead man's switch and mininuke payload. Detonates upon death or manual trigger. You wouldn't want to use it, unless you'd like to demonstrate the bottomless malice within the human heart to a certain ant.

bio_flashlight.name: Cranial Flashlight CBM
bio_flashlight.description: A small, but powerful LED flashlight that is mounted between the eyes.

bio_tattoo_led.name: LED Tattoo
bio_tattoo_led.description: An LED display implanted beneath the epidermis that can display patterns or pictures through the skin.  When active it glows dimly, providing a very small amount of light.

bio_geiger.name: Integrated Dosimeter CBM
bio_geiger.description: Small radiation sensors that are implanted throughout the body, allowing the user to analyze their level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert the user whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

bio_gills.name: Respirator CBM
bio_gills.description: A complex respiration augmentation system that increases the user's maximal oxygen uptake and allows for underwater breathing akin to gills.  Will automatically activate if the user is drowning.

bio_ground_sonar.name: Terranian Sonar CBM
bio_ground_sonar.description: Precision sonar equipment, implanted in the feet to allow the detection of below-ground movement, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

bio_heat_absorb.name: Heat Drain CBM
bio_heat_absorb.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and recharging the user's bionic power reserves slightly.

bio_heatsink.name: Thermal Dissipation CBM
bio_heatsink.description: Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are woven into the user's flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent external heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect the internal body temperature.

bio_hydraulics.name: Hydraulic Muscles CBM
bio_hydraulics.description: A hydraulic muscle support system that when active, increases strength by 20.

bio_infolink.name: Infolink CBM
bio_infolink.description: Before the Cataclysm this was a state-of-the-art communications package.  Even without cell service, it can still double as a two-way radio if installed.  Also comes with an internal chronometer with silent alarm clock feature, an air temperature sensor, and more detailed weather readouts when activated.

bio_infrared.name: Infrared Vision CBM
bio_infrared.description: A bionic module that extends the range of vision into the infrared, allowing the user to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark and through smoke.

bio_int_enhancer.name: Cerebral Booster CBM
bio_int_enhancer.description: Bionic coprocessors that are implanted in the brain, granting a +2 bonus to intelligence.

bio_laser.name: Finger-Mounted Laser CBM
bio_laser.description: A small, high-powered laser that is embedded in the fingertip.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

bio_leukocyte.name: Leukocyte Breeder System CBM
bio_leukocyte.description: Bionic stimulators which augment the user's haematopoiesis system, allowing them to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is designed for continuous use and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.

bio_lighter.name: Finger Lighter CBM
bio_lighter.description: Powerful fire starters which extend from the tip of both hands' index fingers.

bio_lockpick.name: Fingerpick CBM
bio_lockpick.description: An electronic lockpick that is embedded in a fingertip.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

bio_magnet.name: Electromagnetic Unit CBM
bio_magnet.description: A powerful electromagnet that is implanted into the user's right hand, allowing them to indiscriminately pull all nearby magnetic objects towards them.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

bio_membrane.name: Nictating Membrane CBM
bio_membrane.description: A thin membrane that closes over the eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.

bio_memory.name: Enhanced Memory Banks CBM
bio_memory.description: A set of highly-advanced quantum storage drives used to enhance memory.  While active, they increase the rate that the user learns skills, and give them near-perfect memory of skills.

bio_metabolics.name: Metabolic Interchange CBM
bio_metabolics.description: This module interconnects the user's digestive system and power supply, letting them replenish bionic energy by burning calories.

bio_nanobots.name: Repair Nanobots CBM
bio_nanobots.description: A fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will reduce the intensity of one bleed effect every 30 seconds, and heal all injured body parts by 1 HP (or broken limbs by 1%) every 2 minutes if you have 3 kJ bionic power and 5 kcal per body part.  If you don't have enough, they will prioritize based on the resources you have.

bio_night.name: Artificial Night Generator CBM
bio_night.description: When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.

bio_gas_remover.name: Contaminant Particle Ionizer CBM
bio_gas_remover.description: When active, this bionic emits a low energy electric field, causing dangerous airborne particles such as smoke and poison gas within a 5 tile radius to ionize and dissipate rapidly.

bio_night_vision.name: Implanted Night Vision CBM
bio_night_vision.description: This bionic module modifies the user's eyes to amplify existing light, allowing them to see in the dark.

bio_ods.name: Offensive Defense System CBM
bio_ods.description: A thin forcefield gets projected around the user's body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.

bio_painkiller.name: Sensory Dulling CBM
bio_painkiller.description: This module lets the user's nervous system inhibit pain signals, allowing them to dull their senses at will.  This also means the user does not need anesthesia when undergoing bionic surgery with an Autodoc.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction times and drowsiness.

bio_power_armor_interface.name: Power Armor Interface CBM
bio_power_armor_interface.description: Interfaces the user's bionic power system with the internal charging port on suits of power armor, allowing them to draw from the user's bionic power banks.  Twice as efficient as using a UPS.

bio_power_armor_interface_mkII.name: Power Armor Mk. II Interface CBM
bio_power_armor_interface_mkII.description: Interfaces the user's bionic power system with the internal charging port on suits of power armor, allowing them to draw from the user's bionic power banks.  Four times as efficient as using a UPS, the Mk. II was designed by DoubleTech Inc., to meet the popularity of the Mk. II power armor series.
bio_power_armor_interface_mkII.name_plural: Power Armor Mk. II Interface CBMs

bio_power_storage.name: Power Storage CBM
bio_power_storage.description: A Compact Bionics Module that upgrades the user's power capacity by 100 units.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  The user will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.

bio_power_storage_mkII.name: Power Storage CBM Mk. II
bio_power_storage_mkII.description: A Compact Bionics Module developed at DoubleTech Industries as a replacement for the highly successful Power Storage CBM.  Increases the user's power capacity by 250 units.

bio_probability_travel.name: Probability Travel CBM
bio_probability_travel.description: Increases the body's wavelength, allowing the user to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Once installed, activate and select a direction to use.  Tunneling costs 100 bionic power per tile traveled through.

bio_purifier.name: Air Filtration System CBM
bio_purifier.description: An advanced filtration system that is implanted in the trachea.  If toxins, or airborne diseases find their way into the windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.

bio_radscrubber.name: Radiation Scrubber System CBM
bio_radscrubber.description: A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.  While activated if irradiated stacks are present will remove 1 stack of irradiated every 10 minutes costing 10kJ.

bio_railgun.name: Railgun CBM
bio_railgun.description: EM field generators in the user's arms increase the range and damage of thrown magnetic objects at a cost of 1 bionic power per throw.  They will create a trail of electricity that can cause additional damage.

bio_razors.name: Fingertip Razors CBM
bio_razors.description: A set of ten double-edged, four centimeter long razor-sharp claws that are implanted underneath the fingernails.  These will deal a fair amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever the user's fingertips are uncovered, and allow the user to somewhat precisely slice things apart.

bio_fuel_cell_gasoline.name: Gasoline Fuel Cell CBM
bio_fuel_cell_gasoline.description: A small gasoline fuel cell able to convert gasoline to bionic power.  It's connected to a diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders able to hold up to 500 ml of gasoline.

bio_fuel_cell_hydrogen.name: Hydrogen Fuel Cell CBM
bio_fuel_cell_hydrogen.description: A small hydrogen fuel cell able to generate bionic power at a decent rate of efficiency.  It's connected to a diffuse network of compressors and compact canisters able to hold up to 2 liters of hydrogen.

bio_reactor.name: Internal Microreactor CBM
bio_reactor.description: This stripped down mini-reactor will generate impressive amounts of bionic power, but may not be the safest thing to install.  1 plutonium fuel cell provides 1000 charges producing 10kW of power.  Produces 50W of power while inactive.

bio_advreactor.name: Advanced Microreactor CBM
bio_advreactor.description: This module upgrades a pre-installed microreactor with enhanced maximum yield and limited automatic radiation scrubbing capabilities.  1 plutonium fuel cell provides 1500 charges producing 10kW of power.  Produces 75W of power while inactive.

bio_reactoroverride.name: Micro Reactor Safety Override CBM
bio_reactoroverride.description: Disables the radiation safety protocols allowing for much higher energy production.  While active produces 40kJ of power a turn and 1 irradiated stack every 20 turns.

bio_atomic_battery.name: Atomic Battery CBM
bio_atomic_battery.description: Effectively a plutonium fuel cell converted into an alphavoltaic battery, this bionic will provide a limitless source of power at a steady 50 watts when active, with only minimal exposure to radiation while in use.

bio_atomic_battery_upgrade.name: Atomic Battery Upgrade CBM
bio_atomic_battery_upgrade.description: A kit for upgrading a pre-installed atomic battery into a Microreactor, providing options for significantly more power generation potential and fuel capacity at the cost of increased radiation exposure.

bio_reactor_upgrade.name: Microreactor Upgrade CBM
bio_reactor_upgrade.description: A kit for upgrading a pre-installed microreactor with enhanced maximum yield and limited automatic radiation scrubbing capabilities.

bio_recycler.name: Recycler Unit CBM
bio_recycler.description: A series of filters and processors that is implanted in the user's digestive system, allowing them to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.

bio_remote.name: Remote Controller CBM
bio_remote.description: A small module that connects to the user's brain and allows them to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.

bio_resonator.name: Sonic Resonator CBM
bio_resonator.description: This bionic module allows the user's entire body to resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.

bio_scent_mask.name: Olfactory Mask CBM
bio_scent_mask.description: While this system is powered, the user's body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track them by scent.

bio_shock.name: Electroshock Unit CBM
bio_shock.description: While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock the user's opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

bio_shockwave.name: Shockwave Generator CBM
bio_shockwave.description: This bionic module generates a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knock back any creatures they collide with.

bio_speed.name: Synaptic Accelerator CBM
bio_speed.description: Bionic stimulators that enhance the nervous system, granting a 10% boost to your speed.

bio_str_enhancer.name: Muscle Augmentation CBM
bio_str_enhancer.description: Myomer fibers that enhance the muscular system, granting a +2 bonus to strength.

bio_surgical_razor.name: Autonomous Surgical Scalpels CBM
bio_surgical_razor.description: A system of surgical grade scalpels that is implanted in the user's fingers.  They allow for automated precise cuts and can be used as a high-quality butchering tool.

bio_sunglasses.name: Anti-Glare Compensators CBM
bio_sunglasses.description: A set of quick-reacting transition lenses that are installed over the user's eyes.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect from bright flashes, and protect the eyes when welding.

bio_targeting.name: Targeting System CBM
bio_targeting.description: This bionic module contains range finders and synchronizes the movement of the user's eyes with their arms, to a degree.  Shots they fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long ranges.

bio_teleport.name: Teleportation Unit CBM
bio_teleport.description: This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting the user's body up to 25 feet in a random direction at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

bio_time_freeze.name: Time Dilation CBM
bio_time_freeze.description: At the cost of all stored bionic power, the user may increase their body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  Violent or rapid movements may cause damage due to friction.

bio_tools.name: Integrated Toolset CBM
bio_tools.description: A surgically implanted set of tools - screwdriver, hammer, wrench, hacksaw, drill, welder and heating elements.  These can be used in place of many tools when crafting.

bio_torsionratchet.name: Joint Torsion Ratchet CBM
bio_torsionratchet.description: Torsion ratchets that replace the user's joints to slowly generate power when they move.  These can be toggled to generate more power, but movement will require more effort.

bio_jointservo.name: Joint Servo CBM
bio_jointservo.description: A set of servomotors that get installed on leg joints to provide power-assisted movement.  They are optimized for running, but walking also requires less effort while this bionic is active.  In passive mode, it provides a smaller benefit by enforcing optimal movement technique.

bio_uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge CBM
bio_uncanny_dodge.description: Bionic processors that augment the user's nervous system, increasing their ability to dodge while active.  Dodge skill will also allow evading attacks beyond normal human capability, such as bullets.

bio_ups.name: Unified Power System CBM
bio_ups.description: A Unified Power System that is wired into the user's bionic power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now directly draw power from the bionic power supply.

bio_underwater_propellers.name: Underwater Propellers CBM
bio_underwater_propellers.description: A set of underwater propellers that can be extended or retracted from the users upper torso.  When extended, they grant increased movement speeds if the user is submerged.

bio_water_extractor.name: Water Extraction Unit CBM
bio_water_extractor.description: This module contains nanotubes that are embedded in the palm of the hand to pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into potable water.  Water container not included.

bio_syringe.name: Intravenous Needletip CBM
bio_syringe.description: A small tube with a retractable needle that terminates in a net of tiny hoses instead of a plunger.  Installed, it allows the user to draw substances directly into their bloodstream akin to a regular syringe.

bio_weight.name: Skeletal Bracing CBM
bio_weight.description: A set of hinges, springs, and other synthetic augments for the skeletal structure.  These artificial enhancers strengthen the knees and elbows, allowing the user to carry more weight.

bio_storage.name: Internal Storage CBM
bio_storage.description: Space inside your chest cavity has been converted into a storage area.  You may carry an extra 2 liters of volume.

bio_shock_absorber.name: Kinetic Shock Absorbers CBM
bio_shock_absorber.description: A set of hydraulic springs and foldable padding that replaces most of the flesh in the limbs and upper torso.  While active, these absorbers will negate damage from severe impacts such as falling, at the cost of reducing the user's ability to move effectively.

bio_taste_blocker.name: Taste Modifier CBM
bio_taste_blocker.description: A set of highly sensitive sensors implanted in the user's mouth, combined with a sophisticated analyzer.  While active, it will block all unpleasant taste and texture at the cost of bionic energy.

bio_soporific.name: Soporific Induction CBM
bio_soporific.description: A microscopic electrode designed to gently stimulate a particular cluster of neurons in the hypothalamus, helping the user to fall asleep.

bio_ankles.name: Squeaky Ankles
bio_ankles.description: A pair of defective bionics that make squeaking noises.

bio_deformity.name: Bionic-Induced Deformity
bio_deformity.description: A jumble of broken metal pieces that were removed during reconstructive surgery.

bio_dis_acid.name: Acidic Discharge
bio_dis_acid.description: This CBM has been breached in several places and some acid is leaking from it.

bio_dis_shock.name: Electrical Discharge
bio_dis_shock.description: This CBM is a mess of naked wire and burnt resistors.

bio_drain.name: Electrical Drain
bio_drain.description: This CBM was wired incorrectly and would drain power from any system connected to it.

bio_itchy.name: Itchy Metal Thing
bio_itchy.description: You can't recognize what this is supposed to be, but it's a very awkward thing to have in one's body.

bio_glowy.name: Glowy Thing
bio_glowy.description: It's a… thing?  And it glows, at least it did when it was plugged in.

bio_leaky.name: Leaky Bionic
bio_leaky.description: A mess of pierced pipes and broken seals, something unpleasant is leaking from it.

bio_noise.name: Noisemaker
bio_noise.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  When powered, it occasionally emits a loud burst of noise.

bio_nostril.name: Bionic Nostril
bio_nostril.description: This thing was up someone's nose, they're probably glad to be rid of it.

bio_pokedeye.name: Bionic Visual Impairment
bio_pokedeye.description: A defective bionic that impairs vision.

bio_power_weakness.name: Power Overload
bio_power_weakness.description: A bunch of defective power circuits that are prone to short-circuiting.

bio_shakes.name: Bionic Short Circuit
bio_shakes.description: This bionic is poorly wired and occasionally short-circuits.

bio_sleepy.name: Endocrine Enervator
bio_sleepy.description: This malfunctioning bionic causes fatigue by altering the unfortunate user's brain chemistry.

bio_synaptic_regen.name: Synaptic Regeneration System CBM
bio_synaptic_regen.description: An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you won't become sleep deprived; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will boost the rate of recovery.

bio_spasm.name: Motor Control Overstimulator
bio_spasm.description: The result of poor configuration, this bionic module frequently causes debilitating muscle spasms.

bio_stiff.name: Wire-Induced Stiffness
bio_stiff.description: A length of poorly installed wiring that would cause stiffness.

bio_thumbs.name: Self-Locking Thumbs
bio_thumbs.description: A pair of faulty, self-locking thumb bionics.

bio_trip.name: Visual Disruptor
bio_trip.description: A pair of defective ocular bionics that cause visual distortion and pixelation.

bio_voice.name: Voice Remodulator
bio_voice.description: Part of the autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package', this bionic gives the user a creepy robot voice.

bio_grossfood.name: Taste Fouler
bio_grossfood.description: A broken and mis-wired module that would cause food and drink to taste terrible.

bio_sleep_shutdown.name: Sleep Mode Shutdown CBM
bio_sleep_shutdown.description: This CBM completely shuts down all communication between the user's brain and the rest of their body when they fall asleep, preventing them from waking up under any circumstance until their natural sleep cycle completes.  An inability to trigger its effects manually makes it useless as an anesthesia substitute.

bn_bio_solar.name: Solar Panels CBM
bn_bio_solar.description: Installed on your back is a set of retractable solar panels.  When in direct sunlight, they will automatically deploy and slowly recharge your power level.

afs_bio_missiles.name: Deployable Grenade Launcher CBM
afs_bio_missiles.description: Your right hand can fold inward to reveal a mechanism capable of igniting and firing 40mm grenades across medium distances with great accuracy due built in ballistic calculator.

afs_bio_linguistic_coprocessor.name: Linguistic Coprocessor CBM
afs_bio_linguistic_coprocessor.description: A microcomputer installed into the left hemisphere of your brain to increase the speed that it processes language.  When installed, it provides a passive boost to reading speed.

afs_bio_dopamine_stimulators.name: Dopamine Stimulators CBM
afs_bio_dopamine_stimulators.description: A set of tiny bionic nerve stimulators that install into the reward center of your brain.  When run with bionic power, it periodically releases a hit of dopamine and other reward chemicals, inducing a state of euphoria and suppressing fear.

bio_blaster.name: Fusion Blaster Arm CBM
bio_blaster.description: Heavy-duty fusion blaster was integrated into your left arm!  You may use your energy banks to fire a damaging heat ray.

bio_electrosense.name: Electrosense CBM
bio_electrosense.description: An advanced set of digital scanning equipment for reading electrical signals.  When installed it can be activated to scan nearby corpses for bionics, with the added bonus of detecting robots and creatures charged with electricity through walls.  A secondary mode allows it to assist with electrical work like a voltmeter, for checking and modifying grid connections.

bio_perpetual_test.name: Perpetual Generator CBM
bio_perpetual_test.description: Installed within you is a perpetual generator powered by nonsensoleum.  When activated its power gen doubles.  If you are seeing this, you'd better be debugging.

debug_bio_fuel_cell.name: Debug Fuel Cell CBM
debug_bio_fuel_cell.description: The power of the sun, in the palm of my hand!  Installed within you is a perpetual generator powered by nonsensoleum.  When activated its power gen doubles.  If you are seeing this, you'd better be debugging.

bio_portal_tap.name: Dimensional Portal Tap CBM
bio_portal_tap.description: An implanted interface for siphoning power from a linked dimensional portal.  Must be linked to a specific portal by examining it.  While the linked portal's grid has power, this bionic passively draws energy into your reserves each turn.

bio_furnace.name: Internal Furnace CBM
bio_furnace.description: When this bionic is active, you can burn nearly any organic material as fuel (use 'E'), recharging your power level.  Some materials will burn better than others.

bio_scent_vision.name: Scent Vision CBM
bio_scent_vision.description: This system lets the user visually sense their own scent, making it possible for them to recognize their surroundings even in complete darkness.

bio_emp.name: Directional EMP CBM
bio_emp.description: Small parabolic EMP field generators that are mounted in the palm of the user's right hand.  These can be used to instantly fire a wide, but short-ranged blast which will disable electronics and robots.

bio_watch.name: Obsolete Bionic
bio_watch.description: The effects of this bionic in the code have been replaced with Bionic Infolink, so this should no longer spawn.  If you're still finding these in the wild, update your mods.

bio_meteorologist.name: Obsolete Bionic
bio_meteorologist.description: The effects of this bionic in the code have been replaced with Bionic Infolink, so this should no longer spawn.  If you're still finding these in the wild, update your mods.

book_archery.name: Lessons for the Novice Bowhunter
book_archery.description: This hefty paperback book contains all the information needed for novice archers to get started hunting with a variety of bows and crossbows.
book_archery.name_plural: copies of Lessons for the Novice Bowhunter

mag_archery.name: Archery for Kids
mag_archery.description: Will you be able to place the arrow right into the bullseye?  It is not that easy, but once you know how it's done, you will have a lot of fun with archery.

manual_archery.name: Zen and the Art of Archery
manual_archery.description: This massive book contains a wealth of vital information for the novice archer.
manual_archery.name_plural: copies of Zen and the Art of Archery

textbook_archery.name: The Professional Bowhunter's Journal
textbook_archery.description: A lengthy autobiography from an award-winning hunter, filled with detailed and advanced descriptions of bow techniques.

mag_barter.name: car buyer's guide
mag_barter.description: Normally this glossy, ad-filled magazine about cars would be pointless, but it has a series of articles on haggling techniques.

manual_business.name: How to Succeed in Business
manual_business.description: Useful if you want to get a good deal when purchasing goods.
manual_business.name_plural: copies of How to Succeed in Business

mag_bashing.name: Batter Up!
mag_bashing.description: A baseball magazine that focuses on batting tips.  There are lots of colorful, full-page photos of skilled athletes demonstrating proper form and technique.

manual_bashing.name: tactical baton defense manual
manual_bashing.description: An informative guide to self-defense using clubs and batons.  Aimed at the law enforcement and military market, it is packed with time tested, no-nonsense information and written to be understandable for beginners.

textbook_bashing.name: TC 7-21.1 (CUI) Special Forces Blunt Weapon Techniques
textbook_bashing.description: A large military manual describing advanced techniques and practices for all manner of blunt weapons, from batons and quarterstaffs to makeshift clubs and large rocks. Requires some experience to understand.
textbook_bashing.name_plural: TC 7-21.1 (CUI) Special Forces Blunt Weapon Techniquess

mycenacean_hymns.name: Mycenacean Hymns
mycenacean_hymns.description: A vellum book containing the hymns central to Marloss faith.  As the verses lead to each other, the text sings of unity and promised paradise.

holybook_bible2.name: Eastern Orthodox Bible
holybook_bible2.description: An English copy of the Eastern Orthodox translation of The Holy Bible.

holybook_bible3.name: Gideon Bible
holybook_bible3.description: An English translation of the Christian Bible, distributed free of charge by Gideons International.

holybook_bible4.name: Catholic Bible
holybook_bible4.description: An English copy of the Catholic Bible, including the whole 73 book canon recognized by the Catholic church.

holybook_granth.name: The Guru Granth Sahib
holybook_granth.description: A single-volume copy of the central religious texts of Sikhism.
holybook_granth.name_plural: copies of The Guru Granth Sahib

holybook_hadith.name: Hadith
holybook_hadith.description: A Muslim religious text containing an account of the sayings and actions of the prophet Muhammad.

holybook_kallisti.name: Principia Discordia
holybook_kallisti.description: A book that embodies the main beliefs of Discordianism.  It seems to primarily concern chaos, and features a card in the back which informs you that you are now a 'genuine and authorized Pope of Discordia'.

holybook_kojiki.name: The Kojiki
holybook_kojiki.description: The oldest extant chronicle of Japan's myths and history, the stories contained in the Kojiki are part of the inspiration behind Shinto practices.

holybook_mormon.name: The Book of Mormon
holybook_mormon.description: The sacred text of the Latter Day Saint movement of Christianity, originally published in 1830 by Joseph Smith.
holybook_mormon.name_plural: copies of The Book of Mormon

holybook_pastafarian.name: The Gospel of the Flying Spaghetti Monster
holybook_pastafarian.description: A book that embodies the main beliefs of the Church of the Flying Spaghetti Monster.  It seems to involve a lot of pirates and some sort of invisible drunken monster made of pasta.
holybook_pastafarian.name_plural: copies of The Gospel of the Flying Spaghetti Monster

holybook_quran.name: Quran
holybook_quran.description: An English translation of the Muslim book of holy scriptures, with explanatory notes and commentaries to aid in understanding.

holybook_scientology.name: Dianetics
holybook_scientology.description: This book is the canonical text of Scientology.  Written by a science fiction author, it contains self-improvement techniques and musings on psychology called Dianetics.

holybook_slack.name: The Book of the SubGenius
holybook_slack.description: A book about the Church of the SubGenius.  It seems to involve a salesman named J. R. "Bob" Dobbs and a concept called 'slack'.
holybook_slack.name_plural: copies of The Book of the SubGenius

holybook_sutras.name: The Sutras of the Buddha
holybook_sutras.description: A collection of discourses attributed to the Buddha and his close disciples.
holybook_sutras.name_plural: copies of The Sutras of the Buddha

holybook_talmud.name: Talmud
holybook_talmud.description: One of the central texts of Rabbinic Judaism, the Talmud expounds upon the Hebrew Bible with teachings and opinions of thousands of rabbis.

holybook_tanakh.name: Tanakh
holybook_tanakh.description: A single-volume book containing the complete canon of the Jewish Bible.

holybook_tripitaka.name: The Tripitaka
holybook_tripitaka.description: A collection of sacred Buddhist writings describing their canons of scriptures.

holybook_upanishads.name: The Upanishads
holybook_upanishads.description: A collection of sacred Hindu writings regarding the nature of reality and describing the character and form of human salvation.

holybook_vedas.name: The Four Vedas
holybook_vedas.description: A single volume containing all four Vedas, which are the oldest scriptures of Hinduism.

holybook_satanic.name: The Satanic Bible
holybook_satanic.description: A collection of essays, observations, and rituals published by Anton LaVey in 1969.

holybook_havamal.name: Hávamál
holybook_havamal.description: An English translation of several Old Norse poems.  The poems contain proverbs and stories attributed to the god Odin, many transcribed from oral history.

holybook_taoism.name: Tao Te Ching
holybook_taoism.description: An English translation of the collection of poetry and sayings that guides Taoist thought and actions.

holybook_confucianism.name: Lunyu
holybook_confucianism.description: An English translation of the most-revered sacred scripture in the Confucian tradition, compiled by the succeeding generations of Confucius's disciples.  It is sometimes viewed as a philosophy and sometimes as a religion.

holybook_paganism.name: Book of Pagan prayer
holybook_paganism.description: A comprehensive selection of prayers to guide the reader on Pagan and Wiccan worship.
holybook_paganism.name_plural: copies of Book of Pagan prayer

holybook_shamanism.name: Book of shamanistic and folk practices
holybook_shamanism.description: A comprehensive book detailing the practices of a single region of shamanistic or folk beliefs.
holybook_shamanism.name_plural: copies of Book of shamanistic and folk practices

priest_diary.name: priest's diary
priest_diary.description: A small book filled with journal entries in Latin.

guidebook.name: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Cataclysm
guidebook.description: Inscribed on the cover in large, friendly letters, is the message "Don't Panic".
guidebook.name_plural: copies of The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Cataclysm

novel_crime_murdergrape.name: Murdered by the Grapevine
novel_crime_murdergrape.description: This cheap paperback tells the story of a mob boss done in by mere suspicion.  She never breaks a confidence, never rats out an accomplice, and never turns her back on a friend.  Nonetheless her grip on the reigns of the underworld is eroded by rumor and paranoia.
novel_crime_murdergrape.name_plural: copies of Murdered by the Grapevine

novel_spy_comefly.name: Come Fly the Treacherous Skies
novel_spy_comefly.description: This tale of intrigue betrays the story of a debonair mechanic driven by a lust for revenge.  As she uncovers a sophisticated network of amateur pilots turned smugglers, the good guys and the bad guys begin to all look the same.
novel_spy_comefly.name_plural: copies of Come Fly the Treacherous Skies

novel_spy_rocketsci.name: Lies, Damn Lies, and Rocket Science
novel_spy_rocketsci.description: This spy novel tells the story of a jaded rocket scientist looking for redemption in all the wrong places.  As selling state secrets becomes her career, she learns there isn't much of difference between a double-agent and a triple-agent.
novel_spy_rocketsci.name_plural: copies of Lies, Damn Lies, and Rocket Science

visions_solitude.name: Visions in Solitude
visions_solitude.description: A small book detailing 'visions' a prisoner had on death row.

ZSG.name: Zombie Survival Guide
ZSG.description: While this seems like it would be very useful in this situation, the sheer amount of misinformation present makes it practically useless.

SICP.name: SICP
SICP.description: A classic text, "The Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs." Written with examples in LISP, but applicable to any language.

computer_science.name: Computer Science 301
computer_science.description: A college textbook on computer science.

howto_computer.name: How to Browse the Web
howto_computer.name_plural: copies of How to Browse the Web

mag_computer.name: Computer World
mag_computer.description: An informative magazine all about computers, both hardware and software.

textbook_computer.name: Principles of Advanced Programming
textbook_computer.description: A heavy textbook dedicated to advanced-level software design, written for several different programming languages.
textbook_computer.name_plural: copies of Principles of Advanced Programming

sa_cryptology_key.name: High Level Commercial and Military Cryptology
sa_cryptology_key.description: An incredibly dense volume describing different advanced cryptographical methods, their strenghts, and weaknesses.  This text would probably be easier to digest with an added decade in Computer Science Academia.
sa_cryptology_key.name_plural: High Level Commercial and Military Cryptology

adv_chemistry.name: Advanced Physical Chemistry
adv_chemistry.description: A university-level textbook on advanced principles of chemistry, both organic and inorganic.

brewing_cookbook.name: The Homebrewer's Bible
brewing_cookbook.description: A book full of easy-to-follow recipes and useful advice on homebrewing, malting, and fermenting.  It even smells faintly of booze.

cookbook.name: Cooking on a Budget
cookbook.description: A nice cook book that goes beyond recipes and into the chemistry of food.
cookbook.name_plural: copies of Cooking on a Budget

cookbook_italian.name: Cucina Italiana
cookbook_italian.description: This cookbook is written in Italian, but handily illustrated with step by step photo instructions.

cookbook_sushi.name: Sushi Made Easy
cookbook_sushi.description: A simple text for the aspiring sushi lover, this easy to read guide is filled with lots of helpful illustrations for everything from basic rice preparation to setting a proper Japanese table.

family_cookbook.name: family cookbook
family_cookbook.description: A big binder full of somebody's family recipes.  The well-turned pages and creased corners speak volumes of the culinary knowledge contained within.  You could probably learn a lot about cooking from studying this domestic artifact.

mag_cooking.name: Bon Appetit
mag_cooking.description: Exciting recipes and restaurant reviews.  Full of handy tips about cooking.

mag_glam.name: Glamopolitan
mag_glam.description: This is a full-size glossy women's magazine.  There are a few unoriginal recipes and some simple cooking tips somewhere in between the fashion photos and the sex advice columns.

modern_tanner.name: The Modern Tanner
modern_tanner.description: An in-depth and easy to read guide that details a very modern take on the ancient art of leather tanning.

recipe_alpha.name: PE050 "Alpha": Preliminary Report
recipe_alpha.description: This sheaf of papers--dated two weeks before all this started--describes some new chemical formula, and its effects on human subjects.  It's stamped "APPROVED"…

recipe_animal.name: lab journal-Dionne
recipe_animal.description: This team logbook details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, focusing on those derived from various Earth fauna.  The team seems quite enthusiastic--if not eager--about their results.

recipe_chimera.name: PE065 "Chimera": Best Practices
recipe_chimera.description: This sheaf of papers describes a new chemical formula in detail and supplies instructions for its use as some sort of… crowd-control catalyst?  That can't be right…

recipe_creepy.name: lab journal-Smythe
recipe_creepy.description: This team logbook details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, focusing on those derived from flesh contaminated with XE037.  The results look promising but the procurement methods seem awfully vague…

recipe_elfa.name: standpipe maintenance log
recipe_elfa.description: This binder details the scheduled maintenance for several plumbing systems throughout the facility.  However, some of the log sheets seem to be filled with… a chemical formula?

recipe_labchem.name: chemical reference-CLASSIFIED
recipe_labchem.description: This somewhat technical binder has several intimidating security warnings on the cover, yet guarantees unauthorized readers "permanent employment, for life".  It contains useful information on "basic" chemical projects like methamphetamine and heroin, along with briefing on things called "XE037" and "PE012".

recipe_maiar.name: lab journal-x-|xp
recipe_maiar.description: This damaged team logbook lacks (deliberately?) any identifying information, but still contains useful information on several types of mutagen and their development.

recipe_medicalmut.name: PE023 "Medical": Application and Findings
recipe_medicalmut.description: This binder of highly technical papers describes some new chemical formula, and its effects on human subjects.  It's stamped "APPROVED"…
recipe_medicalmut.name_plural: copies of PE023 "Medical": Application and Findings

recipe_raptor.name: PE070 "Raptor": Proposal
recipe_raptor.description: This sheaf of papers is a highly speculative proposal for focusing "PE065".  Scribbled notes throughout seem to think that it might work, but that there's no time.

recipe_serum.name: Best Practices for Compound Delivery
recipe_serum.description: This internal manual details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, as well as describing the protocols used to concentrate mutagens for quicker results.  The authors recommend that researchers ensure that their subjects are well-fed and in good health, as the concentrated serums draw heavily on subjects' bodies.
recipe_serum.name_plural: copies of Best Practices for Compound Delivery

reference_cooking.name: CRC-Merck Handbook, 4th edition
reference_cooking.description: This huge hardbound book is a collection of reference data and formulae pertinent to many technical disciplines.  If poring over tables of chemical and physical data is your thing, this is the book for you.

scots_cookbook.name: Ye Scots Beuk o Cuikery
scots_cookbook.description: A semi-translated cookbook from thirteenth century Scotland.  While a bit difficult to read, as there are a disquieting number of illustrations of people stabbing each other mixed amongst the recipes, it provides insights into medieval Scottish culture and fashion as well as new uses for oatmeal, fish, and sheep liver.
scots_cookbook.name_plural: copies of Ye Scots Beuk o Cuikery

vinegar_maker.name: The Vinegar Maker's Handbook
vinegar_maker.description: This book describes in detail all the ways that one can make vinegar.  You would have thought that there wasn't much to making vinegar, but the girth of this book tells you otherwise.

preserving_juice.name: Drink the Harvest
preserving_juice.description: Canning foods doesn't have to stop with jam and pickles.  This book provides a plethora of juices that can be preserved.

offalcooking.name: Offal Holiday Cooking
offalcooking.description: Offal Holiday Cooking, by Evelyn Turncoat, is a book of holiday recipes that utilize organ meats from various animals.  For the true nose-to-tail cook.

dairy_book.name: Things to do with Milk
dairy_book.description: Whatever you want to do with milk, you will probably find it in this book.
dairy_book.name_plural: copies of Things to do with Milk

cookbook_liverforkids.name: Liver-Licious Recipes Your Kids Will Love
cookbook_liverforkids.description: This cookbook is written by liver enthusiast Tamsyn Beckerleg.  Inside you'll find a great deal of anecdotes about the near-certain ruination of children who refuse to eat their liver.

cookbook_daintydishes.name: Dainty Dishes Fit for a King
cookbook_daintydishes.description: This cookbook contains many fanciful recipes.  Some of them are even worth the trouble to actually prepare.  Lovely pen and ink illustrations of overweight knights and gluttonous monks line the pages.

cookbook_eatyrway.name: Eat Your Way to a Fit Physique
cookbook_eatyrway.description: This self-help book is as dubious as its title.  Worse, it is boring.  It does, however, contain a few basic cooking instructions.

cookbook_foodfashions.name: Food Fashions for Young Moderns
cookbook_foodfashions.description: A cookbook professing itself to be for those seeking "daring and sophisticated flavors."  The book exhorts the reader to defy convention and break the rules, and then presents a number of useful rules and conventions for preparing food.

winemaking_beginner.name: Winemaking for Beginners
winemaking_beginner.description: Winemaking, is an art form.  This book teaches you how to crayon within the lines.

manual_canning.name: You Can Can at Home
manual_canning.description: This entry-level guide to home canning talks about the importance of acidity and food contents in preservation, and how to avoid contaminants in your canning batches.
manual_canning.name_plural: copies of You Can Can at Home

manual_sealing.name: Can Sealer Instructions
manual_sealing.description: This dry guide to a home-use tin can sealer goes into clear detail on everything you can seal with the device and how to do it safely, and includes some basic recipes.

baking_book.name: The Baker's Companion
baking_book.description: This book promises to teach you the ways of baking, from cakes to souffles.

fermenting_book.name: Fermenting Culture
fermenting_book.description: Fermenting as a cooking practice only recently came back into vogue before the Cataclysm.  Here is a book with dozens of recipes, many of which you are unlikely to ever see the ingredients for again.

distilling_cookbook.name: Out of the Holler and into the Home: A guide to home distilation.
distilling_cookbook.description: A book describing the history of at home distillation by liquor.  Each chapter contains a complete recipe for its namesake.
distilling_cookbook.name_plural: copies of Out of the Holler

sweets_book.name: Sweets for your Sweet Child
sweets_book.description: Sweets for your Sweet Child is the best selling cooking book to the parents of young children.  Every recipe uses oversized text, easy words and diagram instructions for children learning to cook with their parents.

survivalflavor_book.name: Pocket Survival Cookbook
survivalflavor_book.description: The smallest cookbook on the market, marketed exclusively to the outdoorsman.  Packs a surprising number of recipes for its tiny size.

cookbook_indian.name: Tasting India
cookbook_indian.description: A thick hardcover book as much about Indian culture as it is a cookbook, clearly written with adoration.

note_mutagen_conspiracy.name: Chemicals in the Water
note_mutagen_conspiracy.description: A binder of notes printed off some website attempting to prove that the government puts chemicals in the water, to poison the population.  It purports to show how to isolate "soul poisons" found in tap water among other claims.  Someone who understands actual chemistry could learn how to isolate mutagenic compounds using improvised tools, though the many conspiracy theories and strange tangents mixed in make it hard to parse.
note_mutagen_conspiracy.name_plural: copies of Chemicals in the Water

mag_cutting.name: All About Swords
mag_cutting.description: An interesting magazine that contains information about swords and sword fighting techniques from all across the world.

manual_cutting.name: knife fighter's notes
manual_cutting.description: It seems to be a guide to edged weapon combat, poorly photocopied and released on spiral- bound paper.  Still, there are lots of useful tips for beginners.

manual_knives.name: Spetsnaz Knife Techniques
manual_knives.description: A classic Soviet text on the art of attacking with a blade.

textbook_cutting.name: TC 7-21.2 (CUI) Special Forces Cutting Weapon Techniques
textbook_cutting.description: A large military manual describing advanced techniques and practices for all manner of cutting weapons, from large knives and swords to razors and sharp rocks. Requires some experience to understand.
textbook_cutting.name_plural: TC 7-21.2 (CUI) Special Forces Cutting Weapon Techniquess

mag_dodge.name: Dance Dance Dance!
mag_dodge.description: Learn the moves of the trendiest dances right now.

manual_dodge.name: The Book of Dances
manual_dodge.description: This massive antique book documents dances from all around the world in great detail.  A perceptive reader could learn a lot about defensive footwork from some of the war dances.
manual_dodge.name_plural: copies of The Book of Dances

manual_dodge_kid.name: Break a Leg!
manual_dodge_kid.description: The Kids' Guide to Acting and Stagecraft.

textbook_dodge.name: Professional Dancer's Textbook
textbook_dodge.description: A giant textbook aimed towards those pursuing professional dance, with descriptions of highly advanced footwork which could be invaluable to those wishing to dance around enemy attacks.

decoy_anarch.name: AAA Guide
decoy_anarch.description: A tourist-centric guide to points of interest throughout the country.  Though it focuses on the north-central US, the driving sections contain some practical tips on proper driving techniques.

mag_cars.name: Top Gear magazine
mag_cars.description: Lots of articles about cars and driving techniques.

manual_driving.name: The Rules of the Road
manual_driving.description: A thick textbook for beginning drivers.  It contains chapters on laws, safe vehicle operation, and defensive driving concepts.
manual_driving.name_plural: copies of The Rules of the Road

textbook_anarch.name: AAA Guide
textbook_anarch.description: A tourist-centric guide to points of interest throughout the country.  This particular copy is apparently the Anonymous Anarchist's Annual: the cover conceals a wealth of ways to help stick it to The Man, along with plenty of advice for avoiding police.

advanced_electronics.name: Advanced Electronics
advanced_electronics.description: A college textbook on circuit design.

mag_electronics.name: Ham Radio Illustrated
mag_electronics.description: An amusing magazine about ham radio, with lots of diagrams and illustrations for making your own electronic devices.

manual_electronics.name: What's a Transistor?
manual_electronics.description: A basic manual of electronics and circuit design.

radio_book.name: Amateur Home Radio for Enthusiasts
radio_book.description: A book about ham radio and citizen's band radio.  It contains numerous diagrams and illustrations explaining the science behind the electronics.
radio_book.name_plural: copies of Amateur Home Radio for Enthusiasts

recipe_atomic_battery.name: computer printout
recipe_atomic_battery.description: One side of this sheet is printed with a meaningless jumble of characters, but the other side shows a complicated, hand-drawn circuit diagram.

recipe_augs.name: Augmentative Tech Review
recipe_augs.description: This annual publication covers the various ways in which people use technology to improve their bodies.  There are a few in-depth and thoroughly illustrated articles on bionic systems, though they tend to use too much jargon.

recipe_lab_elec.name: lab journal-Herrera
recipe_lab_elec.description: This hefty binder contains a multitude of diagrams and technical specifications for various electronic materials.  Some of the diagrams use symbols you've not seen before…

recipe_mil_augs.name: 2XI design binder-CLASSIFIED
recipe_mil_augs.description: This Doubletech Industries binder has several intimidating security warnings on the cover.  Probably because it contains complete design specs, technical drawings, and test results for their military-grade bionic implants.

repeater_mod_guide.name: plans for a radio repeater mod
repeater_mod_guide.description: Instructions on how to create a mod for a radio station terminal which converts the entire system into a repeater.
repeater_mod_guide.name_plural: plans for a radio repeater mod

textbook_electronics.name: Electronic Circuit Theory
textbook_electronics.description: An advanced college textbook on circuit theory, design, and organization.

textbook_robots.name: Robots for Fun & Profit
textbook_robots.description: A rare book on the design of robots, with lots of helpful step-by-step guides.

manual_survival.description: A guide detailing the basics of woodsmanship and outdoor survival.

pocket_survival.name: Pocket Survival Guide
pocket_survival.description: This pocket-sized leather-bound survival guide combines a wealth of concise information with simple to follow instructions and easy to read illustrations.

survival_book.name: Autobiography of a Mountain Man
survival_book.description: An amusing historical novel filled with detailed descriptions of surviving in the wild, potentially containing great insights for an experienced outdoorsman.
survival_book.name_plural: copies of Autobiography of a Mountain Man

textbook_survival.name: Outdoor Survival Guide
textbook_survival.description: A thick soft-cover book filled with vital information about surviving in the wild, aimed at the experienced backpacker.

isherwood_herbal_remedies.name: Natural Remedies of New England
isherwood_herbal_remedies.description: A leather bound manuscript, it features native herbal remedies with hand colored illustrations of each plant.
isherwood_herbal_remedies.name_plural: copies of Natural Remedies of New England

mag_swimming.name: Swim Planet
mag_swimming.description: The world's leading resource about aquatic sports.

manual_swimming.name: Water Survival Training Field Manual
manual_swimming.description: A commercially produced survival guide that details swimming and deep water survival techniques tailored to emergency scenarios.
manual_swimming.name_plural: copies of Water Survival Training Field Manual

mag_animecon.name: Boston AnimeCon magazine
mag_animecon.description: A short magazine printed as an advertisement for the now canceled Boston AnimeCon.  A few costume ideas are intermixed with miscellaneous information about the event.

mag_beauty.name: Beauty Magazine
mag_beauty.description: This is a full-size glossy women's magazine.  There are a few simple patterns and basic sewing tips somewhere in between the fashion photos and the makeup advertisements.

mag_tailor.name: Sew Awesome Monthly
mag_tailor.description: A well presented monthly magazine all about knitting, crocheting, and needlepoint.  Filled with ideas and project patterns.

tailor_portfolio.name: clothing designer's portfolio
tailor_portfolio.description: A leather bound portfolio that once belonged to a clothing designer.  Filled with sketches and notes, a skilled tailor could learn a lot from this volume.

tailor_japanese.name: Traditional Japanese Kimono
tailor_japanese.description: An illustrated textbook on the crafting of Japanese traditional garb.

recipe_fauxfur.name: Friendly, Humane Fashion
recipe_fauxfur.description: An educational book detailing the uses of fake fur, as well as its benefits and disadvantages.  The prose is rather passionate, and a disclaimer on the cover proudly states that the book is printed and distributed by the Gryphon Animal Rights Organization.

textbook_tailor.name: Sewing Techniques for Designers
textbook_tailor.description: A massive, hardbound book full of a wealth of information for the professional clothing designer.
textbook_tailor.name_plural: copies of Sewing Techniques for Designers

mag_throwing.name: Diskobolus
mag_throwing.description: A biannual magazine devoted to the art and science of discus-throwing.

manual_throw.name: The Complete Guide to Pitching
manual_throw.description: A detailed guide for baseball pitchers that combines time-tested techniques and information mixed with a common sense approach to pitching.
manual_throw.name_plural: copies of The Complete Guide to Pitching

howto_traps.name: How to Trap Anything
howto_traps.description: A worn manual that describes how to set and disarm a wide variety of traps.
howto_traps.name_plural: copies of How to Trap Anything

mag_traps.name: Trapper's Life
mag_traps.description: An in-depth magazine about trapping game.  There are lots of articles and diagrams that explain simple trap designs.

manual_traps.name: The Modern Trapper
manual_traps.description: An extensive volume that details numerous methods of trapping game.

manual_traps_mil.name: FM 20-32 Mine/Countermine Operations manual
manual_traps_mil.description: A hefty military field manual about mine-warfare principles, the mechanics of different types of mines/IED's, and countermine operations.
manual_traps_mil.name_plural: copies of FM 20-32 Mine/Countermine Operations manual

textbook_traps.name: The Compleat Trapper
textbook_traps.description: An in-depth book about trapping game animals, covering methods both modern and ancient.

trappers_companion.name: The Trapper's Companion
trappers_companion.description: A folksy guide to trapping wild game using time-tested methods.  A bit in-depth for the beginner, it can provide a wealth of information to a knowledgeable trapper.

mag_unarmed.name: Boxing Monthly
mag_unarmed.description: An exciting monthly magazine about boxing.  There are lots of large, colorful photos of pugilistic exploits.

manual_brawl.name: 101 Wrestling Moves
manual_brawl.description: It seems to be a wrestling manual, poorly photocopied and released on spiral-bound paper.  Still, there are lots of useful tips for unarmed combat.

textbook_brawl.name: TC 7-21.4 (CUI) Special Forces Unarmed Combat Techniques
textbook_brawl.description: A large military manual describing advanced techniques and practices for unarmed combat. Requires some experience to understand.
textbook_brawl.name_plural: TC 7-21.4 (CUI) Special Forces Unarmed Combat Techniquess

novel_coa2.name: coming of age novel
novel_coa2.description: A graphic novel about a young girl living in Iran during the 1980's, seeing the world change around her as Iraq invaded her country.

novel_crime2.name: crime novel
novel_crime2.description: A story about three people in the fictional city of Los Santos, a gangster, an upper-class man, and a psychopath, eventually banding together to pull-off the biggest heist in the city's history

novel_war2.name: war novel
novel_war2.description: A story about a Bosnian citizen who goes through many hardships and near death during the breakup of Yugoslavia.

textbook_extraction.name: The Essential Oil Enthusiasts Handbook
textbook_extraction.description: A heavy hardback book explaining the process of essential oil making, with schematics for the equipment to do it.  Good luck, and don't blow yourself up!
textbook_extraction.name_plural: copies of The Essential Oil Enthusiasts Handbook

acid_spit.name: acid spit gun
acid_spit.description: Fake gun that fires acid globs.

reach_bow.name: reach bow
reach_bow.description: A test item that is both a ranged weapon and a reach weapon

migo_bio_gun.name: mi-go bio-gun
migo_bio_gun.description: Fake gun that fires some sort of solidified organic matter at very high speed by unknown means of propulsion.

glock_20.name: Glock 20
glock_20.description: A full-sized version of the highly successful Glock, chambered in hard-hitting 10mm Auto.  The third model of Glock designed, all other full-sized, large framed Glocks are adaptations of this one.

asr_10mm.name: TNW Aero Survival Rifle
asr_10mm.description: A pistol caliber carbine made of aircraft aluminum.  This is the 10mm version and can use Glock 20 magazines.

hk_g80.name: H&K G80 railgun
hk_g80.description: Developed by Heckler & Koch, this railgun magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Powered by UPS and exceptionally quiet.

rm120c.name: RM120c shotgun
rm120c.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM120c caseless pump-action shotgun was designed for hunting big game, with durability and ease of use as priorities.

rm20.name: RM20 autoshotgun
rm20.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM20 caseless automatic combat shotgun was designed with durability and overwhelming power in mind.

rm228.name: RM228 PDW
rm228.description: Chambering the powerful 20x66mm caseless shotgun cartridge, the Rivtech RM228 PDW was designed for the civilian personal defense market with durability and ease of use as priorities.  While lauded for its small size and light weight, its hefty price tag kept it out of the reach of casual collectors.

american_180.name: American-180
american_180.description: The American-180 is a submachine gun developed in the 1960's that fires .22 LR, unusual for an SMG.  Though the round is low-powered, the high rate of fire and large magazine makes the 180 a formidable weapon.

marlin_9a.name: Marlin 39A
marlin_9a.description: The oldest and longest-produced shoulder firearm in the world.  Though it fires the weak .22 round, it is highly accurate and damaging, and has essentially no recoil.

moss_brownie.name: Mossberg Brownie
moss_brownie.description: The first gun produced by O.F. Mossberg & Sons.  A small pocket pistol, marketed to trappers during the early 20th century.  Its four barrels can accept .22 Short and .22 LR cartridges.

ruger_1022.name: Ruger 10/22
ruger_1022.description: A combination of negligible recoil, high customization, and inexpensive ammunition made the Ruger 10/22 a popular choice among enthusiasts and small game hunters.  Even though it fires the weak .22 round, it's perfectly capable of killing.

ruger_lcr_22.name: Ruger LCR .22
ruger_lcr_22.description: A compact, double-action-only revolver designed for easy concealment, with a stainless steel cylinder and aluminum frame.

sig_mosquito.name: SIG Mosquito
sig_mosquito.description: A popular, small .22 LR pistol.  One of the many polymer frame pistols produced during the latter 20th-early 21st centuries; it has an underbarrel rail.

j22.name: Jimenez JA-22
j22.description: One of the quintessential 'saturday night specials', the Jimenez JA-22 was very affordably priced with its injection molded zinc slide and frame.  Intended to fill the void left after small pocket pistols were banned from import, these were more commonly used by criminals unfazed by their glaring safety issues.

walther_p22.name: Walther P22
walther_p22.description: The Walther P22 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol.  It is about half the size of most Walthers.  It is made mostly with plastic, with the slide and key components being made of die-cast zinc alloy

acr.name: Remington ACR
acr.description: This carbine was developed for military use in the early 21st century.  It is damaging and accurate, though its rate of fire is a bit slower than competing 5.56x45mm carbines.

ar15.name: AR-15
ar15.description: This ubiquitous rifle is the forefather of M16 rifle series.  It is lightweight and accurate, but will malfunction if not properly maintained.  This one is a semi-automatic civilian version.

ar_pistol.name: AR pistol
ar_pistol.description: A compact, 7.5 inch barrel version of the classic AR-15 design, commercially marketed as a home defense weapon.

famas.name: FAMAS G2
famas.description: A select fire bullpup assault rifle that was used by French armed forces until recently.  While the FAMAS was famous for its high fire rate and futuristic look, the failure of the disposable magazine design principle and lack of rails necessitated the invention of the G2 variant.  It can not utilize oversized STANAG snail and drum mags but it retains the integral bipod and blistering rate of fire.

h&k416a5.name: H&K416 A5
h&k416a5.description: Designed to replace the M4A1, the Heckler and Koch 416A5 features most of the former's strengths, while being considerably more durable.

hk_g36.name: H&K G36
hk_g36.description: Designed as a replacement for the early H&K G3 battle rifle, the G36 is more accurate, and uses the much-lighter 5.56x45mm round, allowing for a higher ammo capacity.

m249.name: M249
m249.description: The M249 is a mountable machine gun used by the US military and SWAT teams.  Quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M249 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.

m27iar.name: M27 IAR
m27iar.description: A H&K416 carbine outfitted with a heavier barrel to enable higher amounts of suppressive fire while retaining a good degree of mobility.

m4a1.name: M4A1
m4a1.description: A popular carbine, long used by the US military.  Though accurate, small, and lightweight, it is infamous for its unreliability when not properly maintained.

m16a4.name: M16A4
m16a4.description: The M16 is a very common assault rifle descended from the AR-15, used by militaries across the world for over 50 years.  It is a gas operated, rotating bolt rifle known for its accuracy and controllable recoil.

m16a4_turret_fake.name: M16A4
m16a4_turret_fake.description: If you see it - it is bug!

oa93.name: OA-98
oa93.description: An AR-15 derivative carbine manufactured by Olympic Arms in the nineties.  The main difference compared to the AR-15 is that the recoil spring has been moved to the top of the gun, circumventing the necessity for a solid buttstock.

ruger_mini.name: Ruger Mini-14
