ruger_mini.description: A small, lightweight semi-auto carbine designed for civilian and police use.  Its superb accuracy and low recoil makes it more suitable than full-auto rifles for some situations.

scar_l.name: FN SCAR-L
scar_l.description: A highly accurate and modular assault rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'L' in its name stands for light, as it uses the lightweight 5.56x45mm round.

sig552.name: SIG 552 SWAT
sig552.description: A select fire rifle originally made for the Swiss military and redesigned for American specifications.  This is the shortened version, made with SWAT teams and vehicle crewmen in mind.  Unlike the European original it features a STANAG magwell.

steyr_aug.name: Steyr AUG
steyr_aug.description: The Steyr AUG is an Austrian assault rifle that uses a bullpup design.  It is used in the armed forces and police forces of many nations, and enjoys low recoil and high accuracy.

carbon_rifle.name: carbon fiber assault rifle
carbon_rifle.description: This assault rifle was made using a 3D printer with no metal parts except the barrel, resulting in a very lightweight weapon.

m7.name: M7
m7.description: Once touted to be the next generation of infantry weapon, boasting a powerful cartridge and cutting-edge optics, the M7 was panned by soldiers for a multitude of problems including its heavy weight, quick barrel burn, and lack of quality control.  Soon after the development of Rivtech's caseless designs, the M7 was quietly relegated to special forces armories and reserves.

m250.name: M250
m250.description: The M250 is a light machine gun once meant to replace the M249 SAW.  Despite its powerful cartridge and advanced optics, the M250 suffered from several flaws as a result of the extremely high-pressure round it used along with poor quality control, and as a result was relegated to special forces armories and reserves after the development of Rivtech's caseless designs.

m2010.name: M2010 ESR
m2010.description: A bolt-action, box-magazine-fed, sniper rifle chambered in the powerful .300 Winchester Magnum round.  The M2010 had completely replaced the M24 rifle series by 2017.

weatherby_5.name: Weatherby Mark V
weatherby_5.description: The Weatherby Mark V is one of the finest bolt action rifles.  Designed in 1955 by Roy Weatherby and Fred Jennie, it has a strong action designed to safely fire high-pressure cartridges.  These rifles were presented to celebrities as part of a marketing campaign.

win70.name: Winchester Model 70
win70.description: The Winchester Model 70 is a bolt action sporting rifle.  It has an iconic place in American sporting culture and has been held in high regard by shooters since it was introduced in 1936.

browning_blr.name: Browning BLR
browning_blr.description: A highly accurate lever-action hunting rifle chambered for the powerful .30-06 round.  Notable for using a detachable magazine instead of a traditional tube.

garand.name: M1 Garand
garand.description: A semi-automatic .30-06 battle rifle, developed to replace the M1903 Springfield.  It didn't completely supplant the older bolt-action until after World War II.

m1903.name: M1903 Springfield
m1903.description: A powerful military rifle chambered in .30-06, developed to replace the US Army's older Krag rifle.  Served as the main American rifle in World War I, was used alongside the M1 Garand in World War II, and was used as a sniper rifle as late as the Vietnam War.

m1918.name: Browning Automatic Rifle
m1918.description: Designed near the end of World War I, the BAR provided fire support for the US Army from World War II all the way to the Vietnam War.  Too much firepower to serve as a battle rifle, but not enough to be an ideal light machine gun, it still found a niche on the battlefield.

remington_700.name: Remington 700 .30-06
remington_700.description: A very popular and durable hunting or sniping rifle.  Popular among SWAT and US Marine snipers.  Highly damaging, but perhaps not as accurate as the competing Browning BLR.

handmade_carbine.name: handmade carbine
handmade_carbine.description: A modular handmade lever-action carbine chambered in .30-06 with a 5-round internal magazine.  A marked improvement over the crude single-shot pipe rifle, its simple design allows for field conversion to .223 or .308, and various magazine adapters can be fitted.

acr_300blk.name: Remington ACR .300BLK
acr_300blk.description: This carbine was developed for military use in the early 21st century.  It is damaging and accurate, though its rate of fire is a bit slower than competing carbines.  This version is chambered for the .300 AAC Blackout round.

iwi_tavor_x95_300blk.name: IWI Tavor X95 .300BLK
iwi_tavor_x95_300blk.description: The IWI Tavor X95 (also called Micro-Tavor or MTAR) is an Israeli bullpup assault rifle designed and produced by Israel Weapon Industries.  This is the civilian version chambered for .300 AAC Blackout.

ar15_retool_300blk.name: AR-15
ar15_retool_300blk.description: This ubiquitous rifle is the forefather of M16 rifle series.  It is lightweight and accurate, but will malfunction if not properly maintained.  This one is a semi-automatic civilian version.

sig_mcx.name: SIG MCX
sig_mcx.description: The SIG MCX was designed to deliver optimal performance with a suppressor and .300 AAC Blackout, though it features a system to use 5.56x45mm and 7.62x39mm with the proper conversion kit.  It is used by SWAT teams and special forces around the world.  This is the law enforcement and military version, featuring full auto capability.

fn_fal.name: FN FAL
fn_fal.description: Originally designed during the Cold War, the FN FAL is probably the most successful battle rifle ever designed.  Even though often labeled as obsolete, its high rate of fire and powerful ammunition make it perfectly capable of holding its ground against modern competitors.

hk_g3.name: H&K G3
hk_g3.description: An early battle rifle developed after the end of WWII.  The G3 is designed to unload large amounts of deadly ammunition, but it is less suitable over long ranges.

m134.name: M134D-H Minigun
m134.description: The M134D-H Minigun is a (relatively) lightweight heavy rotary machine gun.  Its six barrels are rotated by an electric motor, powered by UPS or vehicle.  If you could find enough ammo for it, it would become a devastating weapon.

m14ebr.name: M14 EBR-RI
m14ebr.description: A highly modified version of the M14 rifle designed to cover both CQB and designated marksman roles.  A very powerful and versatile rifle, if somewhat heavy.

m14ebr_turret_fake.name: M14 EBR-RI
m14ebr_turret_fake.description: If you see it - it is bug!

m1a.name: M1A
m1a.description: The child of the M1 Garand World War 2 rifle, the M1A is a semi-automatic variant of the M14, favored for its accuracy and modular use.

m240.name: M240
m240.description: The M240 is a medium machine gun used by the US military, replacing the older M60.  Quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M240 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.

m60.name: M60
m60.description: The M60 is a general-purpose machine gun developed to replace the .30-caliber M1918 and M1919.  Heavy and difficult to handle fired from the shoulder, as most people aren't action-movie heroes.

savage_111f.name: Savage 111F
savage_111f.description: A very accurate rifle chambered for the powerful 7.62x51mm (.308) round.  Its very low ammo capacity is offset by its accuracy and near-complete lack of recoil.

scar_h.name: FN SCAR-H
scar_h.description: A highly accurate and modular battle rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'H' in its name stands for heavy, as it uses the powerful 7.62x51mm (.308) round.

M24.name: M24
M24.description: The M24 Sniper is the military and police version of the Remington Model 700 rifle, M24 being the model name assigned by the United States Army after adoption as their standard sniper rifle in 1988.  The M24 is referred to as a 'weapon system' because it consists of not only a rifle, but also a detachable telescopic sight and other accessories.

hk417_13.name: H&K417 A2
hk417_13.description: A German battle rifle with a 13" barrel and telescopic stock.  It is a gas operated, rotating bolt rifle with a short-stroke piston design similar to that of the G36.

m110a1.name: M110A1
m110a1.description: A derivative of H&K's G28 with an aluminum upper receiver to meet US Army weight requirements.  It is a gas operated, rotating bolt rifle accurate to 1.5 MOA with standard ammunition.

ar10.name: AR-10
ar10.description: Somewhat similar to the later AR-15, the AR-10 is a gas operated, rotating bolt rifle chambered for 7.62x51mm rounds.

sig_p230.name: SIG Sauer P230
sig_p230.description: The SIG Sauer P230 is a small, semi-automatic handgun chambered in .32 ACP.  Due to its small dimensions, it was often carried as a backup weapon.

skorpion_61.name: Skorpion Vz. 61
skorpion_61.description: The Skorpion Vz. 61 is a Czechoslovak submachine gun from the 1950s, chambered in .32 ACP.

walther_ppk.name: Walther PPK
walther_ppk.description: One of the most famous handguns of the 20th century.  Your name is not Bond, but you might find this little gun still useful.

kp32.name: Kel-Tec P32
kp32.description: One of Kel-tec's oldest designs, the P32 is a popular option for deep concealment and backup usage.  Despite its extreme light weight and small size, its .32 ACP chambering makes for good handling and recoil control.

p226_357sig.name: SIG P226
p226_357sig.description: A SIG Sauer P226 chambered for .357 SIG.  The P226 is a DA/SA, short-recoil operated semi-automatic pistol.

glock_31.name: Glock 31
glock_31.description: A full size .357 SIG Glock pistol.  It is extremely similar to the Glock 22, and could be converted to fire .40 S&W by switching the barrel.

p320_357sig.name: SIG P320 Compact
p320_357sig.description: The P320 Compact is a semi-automatic, short recoil operated pistol.  This one is chambered for .357 SIG.

ar_357sig.name: Moriarti AR .357sig
ar_357sig.description: A semi-automatic rifle using .357 SIG rounds, also known as Moriarti MA-357Sig-16.  It is also compatible with Glock 31 magazines.

colt_navy.name: Colt M1861 Navy
colt_navy.description: The Colt Model 1861 Navy cap & ball .36-caliber revolver was a six-shot, single-action percussion weapon produced by Colt's Manufacturing Company from 1861 until 1873.

cop_38.name: COP .357 Derringer
cop_38.description: A small, chubby derringer pistol bearing a slight resemblance to the Mossberg Brownie.  It uses a rotating firing pin to fire the individual hammers of the four barrels arranged in a square formation.

model_10_revolver.name: S&W Model 10
model_10_revolver.description: A six-shot revolver, produced since 1899 and known as the most popular handgun of the 20th century.  It has a swing-out cylinder for ease of reloading.

ruger_lcr_38.name: Ruger LCR .38
ruger_lcr_38.description: A compact, double-action-only revolver designed for easy concealment, with a stainless steel cylinder and aluminum frame.

sw_619.name: S&W 619
sw_619.description: A seven-round .38 revolver sold by Smith & Wesson.  It features a fixed rear sight and a reinforced frame.

colt_python.name: Colt Python
colt_python.description: A six inch, six-round revolver chambered in .357 Magnum/.38 Special.  Favorite of sheriffs and post-Cataclysm survivor group leaders.

marlin_1894c.name: Marlin 1894C
marlin_1894c.description: The Marlin Model 1894 is a lever-action repeating rifle.  It comes with a walnut stock and foreend.  The C version is chambered in .357 Magnum/.38 Special.

handmade_revolver.name: handmade revolver
handmade_revolver.description: A sturdy improvised revolver chambered for .38 Special and .357 Magnum.  Its simple design allows for field conversion to 9mm, .40 S&W, .44 Magnum, or .45 ACP with replacement barrel and cylinder assemblies.

mac_11.name: MAC-11
mac_11.description: A lesser known variant of the MAC-10, this machine pistol is chambered in .380 ACP for a smaller overall size while remaining inherently subsonic.  Smaller in almost every dimension, this inexpensive automatic weapon was declared 'fit only for combat in a phone booth' due to its low weight and absurd fire rate ranging from 1200 to 1400 rounds per minute.

kp3at.name: Kel-Tec P3AT
kp3at.description: Essentially a slightly scaled up Kel-tec P32 in .380 ACP, the ever popular P3AT offers better ballistics in a small, concealable lightweight package.  Handling leaves something to be desired due to snappier recoil and diminuitive controls.

fn1910.name: FN 1910 .380
fn1910.description: Made infamous in Sarajevo in 1914, the FN1910 was a popular pocket pistol, albeit in .32 ACP.  Collectors value the .380 model for its notoriety and more modern terminal performance.  If such a humble firearm could start a world war, could it perhaps protect you from the undead?

rugerlcp.name: Ruger LCP
rugerlcp.description: One of the best-selling modern day 'pocket pistol's, the LCP is an affordable, polymer framed pistol chambered in .380 ACP.  Despite the round's relatively low power, the pistol's low weight and short sight radius make for a moderately poor handling pistol.

hptcf380.name: Hi-Point CF-380
hptcf380.description: The Hi-Point CF-380 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal.

taurus_spectrum.name: Taurus Spectrum
taurus_spectrum.description: A .380 subcompact pistol.  Designed for concealed carry and built from high-quality, durable materials.

hipoint_3895.name: Hi-Point 3895
hipoint_3895.description: A .380 carbine, fun to shoot, not so much useful against anything larger.  Usually good for training.  Also available in pink camo.

90two40.name: Beretta 90-two .40 S&W
90two40.description: A more modern version of Beretta's popular 92 series of handguns, the 90-two performs largely the same.  The main difference is a sleeker, almost futuristic-looking design owed in large parts to the polymer underbarrel rail cover.  This one is chambered in .40 S&W.

glock_22.name: Glock 22
glock_22.description: A .40 S&W variant of the popular Glock 17 pistol.  The standard-issue firearm of the FBI and of countless other law enforcement agencies worldwide.

px4_40.name: Beretta Px4 Storm .40 S&W
px4_40.description: Lighter than Beretta's iconic 92 series of guns, the Px4 Storm was built by utilizing light-weight polymer construction with steel inserts.  Its shape was also optimized for concealed carry.  This one is chambered in .40 S&W.

sig_40.name: SIG Pro .40
sig_40.description: Originally marketed as a lightweight and compact alternative to older SIG handguns, the Pro .40 is popular among European police forces.

sw_610.name: S&W 610
sw_610.description: The Smith and Wesson 610 is a classic six-shooter revolver chambered for 10mm rounds, or for S&W's own .40 round.

hi_power_40.name: Browning Hi-Power .40 S&W
hi_power_40.description: The Browning Hi-Power is a semi-automatic handgun developed shortly before the second world war.  Widely issued since then, it remains in use by India, Canada and Australia.  This is a commercial variant produced by Browning Arms in .40 S&W.

walther_ppq_40.name: Walther PPQ .40 S&W
walther_ppq_40.description: The Walther PPQ is a semi-automatic pistol originating from the Walther P99QA, and maintains compatibility with some of its predecessor's accessories.  This model is chambered in .40 S&W.

hptjcp.name: Hi-Point Model JCP
hptjcp.description: The Hi-Point Model JCP is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.

mkg_banshee.name: CMMG MkG Banshee
mkg_banshee.description: A semi-automatic rifle using .40 S&W rounds.  It is also compatible with Glock 22 magazines.

hk_ump45_retool_40.name: H&K UMP
hk_ump45_retool_40.description: Developed as a lower-cost successor to H&K's own MP5, the Universal Machine Pistol is a closed-bolt, simple blowback sub-machine gun constructed of lightweight polymer.  Originally designed for .45 ACP, it is also available in .40 S&W and 9x19mm, and can be converted to fire those calibers with the proper conversion kit.

kriss_vector.name: KRISS Vector .40 S&W
kriss_vector.description: A submachine gun with a sleek in-line design.  It features a 2-round burst mode to make the most out of its unique recoil mitigation system alongside a blistering full-auto mode.  This one is chambered in .40 S&W and uses Glock 22 magazines.

launcher_simple.name: tube 40mm launcher
launcher_simple.description: A simple, home-made grenade launcher.  Basically a tube with a pin firing mechanism to activate the grenade.

m320.name: M320 standalone launcher
m320.description: Heckler & Koch's M320 grenade launcher offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  This one is combined with a buttstock for standalone operation.

m79.name: M79 launcher
m79.description: A widely-used grenade launcher that first saw use by American forces in the Vietnam War.  Though mostly replaced by more modern launchers, the M79 still sees use with many units worldwide.

mgl.name: Milkor MGL
mgl.description: The Milkor Multi-Grenade Launcher is designed to compensate for the drawback of single-shot grenade launchers by allowing sustained heavy firepower.  However, it is still slow to reload and must be used with careful planning.

rm802.name: RM802 grenade launcher
rm802.description: The Rivtech RM802 pump-action 40mm grenade launcher was designed to be a step ahead of single-shot grenade launchers by allowing sustained heavy firepower, and its durable alloy receiver allows it to even fire high-velocity 40x53mm shells in a pinch.  However, its capacity is fairly limited so it must be used with careful planning.

triple_launcher_simple.name: triple-barrel 40mm launcher
triple_launcher_simple.description: A homemade triple-barrel 40mm grenade launcher.  Capable of launching all three grenades at once, it is extremely powerful for a homemade weapon.

pseudo_m203.name: M203 array
pseudo_m203.description: An array of six M203 grenade launchers for use on the TALON UGV platform.

afs_bionic_rocket.name: deployed grenade launcher
afs_bionic_rocket.description: A grenade launcher mounted onto your right-hand wrist.  It contains integrated ballistic calculator and quick load mechanism.  Adaptive caliber allow to load most types grenades.

mark19.name: Mark 19 grenade launcher
mark19.description: A heavy, tripod-mounted belt-fed grenade launcher used by the US Military since the start of the Cold War all the way to the cataclysm, and if you can find some 40mm grenades, maybe even beyond.

mark19_turret_fake.name: Mark 19 grenade launcher
mark19_turret_fake.description: If you see it - it is bug!

saiga_410.name: Saiga-410
saiga_410.description: The Saiga-410 is a semi-automatic shotgun designed on the same Kalashnikov pattern as the AK47 rifle.  It reloads with a magazine, rather than one shell at a time like most shotguns.

shotgun_410.name: Winchester M37 .410
shotgun_410.description: A single-shot break-action shotgun, chambered in .410 bore.  Designed as a lower-recoil alternative to 12 gauge shotguns, it is light and easy to manufacture.

deagle_44.name: Desert Eagle .44
deagle_44.description: One of the most recognizable handguns due to its popularity in movies and video games, the Desert Eagle is better known for its menacing appearance than its performance.  It's a large pistol, but its heavy weight reduces recoil.

henry_big_boy.name: Henry Big Boy .44
henry_big_boy.description: This fine lever action rifle is chambered in the powerful .44 magnum cartridge and features a sleek octagonal barrel with a tube fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!

ruger_redhawk.name: Ruger Redhawk
ruger_redhawk.description: One of the most powerful handguns in the world when it was released in 1979, the Redhawk offers very sturdy construction, with an appearance that is reminiscent of "Wild West" revolvers.

sw629.name: S&W 629
sw629.description: A stainless steel, six-shot, double-action revolver with a matte black plastic handle manufactured by Smith & Wesson.  Though hardly the most powerful handgun in the world any more, it could still blow a zombie's head clean off.

colt_army.name: Colt M1860 Army
colt_army.description: The Colt Army Model 1860 is a cap & ball .44-caliber revolver.  It was used during the American Civil War, and made by Colt's Manufacturing Company.

lemat_revolver.name: LeMat revolver
lemat_revolver.description: A Pietta reproduction of the civil war era LeMat revolver, a rare and unusual cap & ball .44-caliber revolver.  While its original non-standard .42 or .35 caliber curbed its usefulness for the CSA army, this reproduction is offered in more prevalent .44 caliber.  Despite modern quality materials, the design is still rather delicate.

colt_ring.name: Colt Ring Lever Rifle
colt_ring.description: The Colt Ring Lever Rifle was one of the first true lever-action rifles, designed to utilize the same caplock ammo as Colt revolvers.  It was famously used in the second Seminole war, where the Seminole people had learned to strike American soldiers while they were reloading their muskets.

TDI.name: TDI Vector
TDI.description: The TDI Vector is a submachine gun with a unique, in-line design that makes recoil very manageable, even in the powerful .45 caliber.

hk_ump45.name: H&K UMP
hk_ump45.description: Developed as a lower-cost successor to H&K's own MP5, the Universal Machine Pistol is a closed-bolt, simple blowback sub-machine gun constructed of lightweight polymer.  Originally designed for .45 ACP, it is also available in .40 S&W and 9x19mm, and can be converted to fire those calibers with the proper conversion kit.

m1911.name: M1911
m1911.description: The M1911 was the US Military standard-issue sidearm for most of the 20th Century.  It remains one of the most popular .45 pistols today.

m1911_MEU.name: M45A1
m1911_MEU.description: The M45A1 supplanted earlier M45 MEUSOC pistols in use by Force Recon elements of Marine Expeditionary Units.  Where the original M45 pistols were gutted M1911A1's hand-fitted by USMC armorers, the updated M45A1's are hardly different from any other commercial 1911 design save for their dual recoil springs.  Most were replaced in 2016 with Glock 19's due to logistics issues.

mac_10.name: MAC-10
mac_10.description: The MAC-10 is a popular machine pistol originally designed for military use.  For many years they were the most inexpensive automatic weapon in the US, and enjoyed great popularity among criminals less concerned with quality firearms.

tommygun.name: Thompson submachine gun
tommygun.description: An American-made submachine gun developed during the very end of World War I, too late to see action.  Infamous during the 1920s for its use by gangsters, and was used during World War II before being mostly replaced with less-expensive alternatives.

usp_45.name: USP .45
usp_45.description: A popular pistol, widely used among law enforcement.  Extensively tested for durability, it has been found to stay accurate even after being subjected to extreme abuse.

mk23.name: MK 23 MOD 0
mk23.description: Jokingly referred to as "The World's Only Crew-Served Pistol", this massive pistol was designed as a primary weapon for select "special operators".  Its cumbersome nature, the introduction of the derivative HK USP series and the logistics of getting .45 ACP ammunition in theater doomed this behemoth to US SOCOM armories.  Like the USP, the Mk 23 is a remarkably reliable gun; someone could probably take out a nuclear equipped walking tank with this in their holster.

walther_ppq_45.name: Walther PPQ .45 ACP
walther_ppq_45.description: The Walther PPQ is a semi-automatic pistol originating from the Walther P99QA, and maintains compatibility with some of its predecessor's accessories.  This model is chambered in .45 ACP.

hptjhp.name: Hi-Point Model JHP
hptjhp.description: The Hi-Point Model JHP is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.

glock_21.name: Glock 21
glock_21.description: A full-sized version of the highly successful Glock.  This model is chambered in .45 ACP.

mkg_guard.name: CMMG MkG Guard
mkg_guard.description: A semi-automatic rifle using .45 ACP rounds.  It is also compatible with Glock 21 magazines.

1895sbl.name: Marlin 1895 SBL
1895sbl.description: A handy but powerful lever-action rifle chambered for .45-70 Government.  Designed for wilderness guides for defense against large predators such as grizzly bears, moose, and dinosaurs.

bfr.name: Magnum Research BFR
bfr.description: A massive single-action revolver.  While the .45-70 rifle round loses significant velocity in its short pistol barrel, it still competes with other large magnum handguns in terms of power.

sharps.name: 1874 Sharps
sharps.description: A reproduction of an antique single-shot .45-70 rifle once used to hunt buffalo and other large game in the late 19th Century.  Highly accurate and powerful for the time, this one is made to handle modern smokeless ammunition.

m1874_gatling.name: M1874 Gatling gun
m1874_gatling.description: A rotary firearm from the 19th Century driving multiple barrels with a hand crank for sustained fire.  This one is a reproduction of a five-barrel version using the .45-70 cartridge, and can fit Broadwell drums holding 240 rounds each.

bond_410.name: Bond Arms Derringer
bond_410.description: The Bond Arms Derringer is a series of multi-barrel compact pistols.  Most commonly chambered for .45 Colt, with chambers long enough to accept .410 shotgun shells.

colt_lightning.name: Colt Lightning .45 Carbine
colt_lightning.description: A modern reproduction of a Colt pump-action rifle.  Originally chambered in .44-40, modern versions most commonly use .45 Colt, complementing the Single Action Army as a Cowboy Action Shooting firearm.

colt_saa.name: Uberti Cattleman
colt_saa.description: This 7.5" barreled Uberti Cattleman is a modern reproduction of the legendary Colt Single Action Army, or Colt Peacemaker, one of the first revolvers to use a modern self-contained cartridge.  Made famous by westerns, it is still in demand for Cowboy Action Shooting, reenactors and collectors.  Unlike modern revolvers, the cylinder cannot swing out for loading, and spent brass must be ejected one at a time.

taurus_judge.name: Taurus Judge
taurus_judge.description: The Taurus Judge is a 5-shot revolver chambered in .45 Colt.  It can fire .410 shotshells as well.

m107a1.name: Barrett M107A1
m107a1.description: A large, shoulder-fired, .50 caliber anti-materiel rifle.  Its large size, recoil, and noise is offset by its damage and range.

m2browning.name: M2HB Browning HMG
m2browning.description: A heavy machine gun used by the US Military from its inception to the Cataclysm, and even rarely by Cataclysm survivors.

m2browning_turret_fake.name: M2HB Browning MG
m2browning_turret_fake.description: If you see it - it is bug!

m2browning_sawn.name: .50 caliber rifle
m2browning_sawn.description: Modified from the massive M2 Browning, this pared down rifle has been altered to be fired unmounted.  The burst fire has been disabled, and its belt fed mechanism has been modified into a much smaller single round chamber.

as50.name: AI AS50
as50.description: .50 caliber anti-materiel rifle made by Accuracy International.  With high accuracy for long range target and high fire rate, this weapon is still being used by Greek national guard.

tac50.name: McMillan TAC-50
tac50.description: A long-range anti-materiel and anti-personnel sniper rifle made by McMillan Firearms, serving the Canadian Army since 2000 as the C15, and the Navy Seals as the Mk 15 Mod 0.  This .50 caliber bolt-action rifle is capable of defeating light vehicles, radar installations and crew served weapons at extreme distances.  It notably holds the longest range confirmed sniper kill, as well as the 4th and 5th longest.

bfg50.name: Serbu BFG-50
bfg50.description: A single-shot, bolt-action rifle made by Serbu Firearms, the BFG-50 is a very affordable firearm for those wishing to shoot .50 BMG.

needlegun.name: RM216 SPIW
needlegun.description: This light carbine fires 5x50mm armor-piercing flechette cartridges.  Classified as a special purpose individual weapon, this advanced firearm was developed by Rivtech for the US military shortly before the end of the world.  Designed to be fired in bursts, it excels in close combat.

needlepistol.name: RM232 IDW
needlepistol.description: This lightweight machine pistol fires 5x50mm armor-piercing flechette cartridges.  Classified as an individual defense weapon, this advanced firearm was developed by Rivtech for the US military shortly before the end of the world.  Designed to be fired in bursts, it excels in close combat.

m202_flash.name: M202A1 FLASH
m202_flash.description: An American rocket launcher designed in the 1970s to replace WW2 era flamethrowers still in use in Vietnam.  It has four barrels sharing the 66mm caliber of the M72 LAW.

LAW.name: M72 LAW
LAW.description: A disposable light anti-tank rocket launcher.  Once fired, it cannot be reloaded and must be disposed of.

ak47.name: AKM
ak47.description: One of the most recognizable assault rifles ever made, the AKM is renowned for its durability even under the worst conditions.

arx160.name: Beretta ARX-160
arx160.description: The Beretta ARX-160 was a Phase II contender in the United States Army Individual Carbine competition to replace the M4 carbine.  It failed to replace it, but it is widely used by military all around the world.  This version is chambered for 7.62x39mm.

sks.name: SKS
sks.description: Developed by the Soviets in 1945, this rifle was quickly replaced by the full-auto AK47.  However, due to its superb accuracy, low recoil and deployable integrated bayonet, this gun maintains immense popularity.

aksemi.name: AK-47 semi
aksemi.description: Civilian-legal clones of the iconic Kalashnikov, like this one, were manufactured and imported by many different firms.  Even without full-auto function, their solid firepower and reliability in harsh conditions make them valuable weapons in this new world.

draco.name: Mini Draco
draco.description: Essentially a semi-auto AK with a short barrel and no stock, this unwieldy "pistol" has seen some popularity with civilian shooters and gangbangers alike.

mosin44.name: Mosin-Nagant M44
mosin44.description: The Model 44 is the carbine sized variant of the standard 1891/30.  It has a shorter barrel, therefore it is weaker than the 1891/30, but easier to carry.

mosin44_ebr.name: Mosin-Nagant M44-EBR
mosin44_ebr.description: This carbine packs the classic Mosin-Nagant model 44 action in a modern-day stock capable of accepting modifications.

mosin91_30.name: Mosin-Nagant 1891/30
mosin91_30.description: The Mosin-Nagant 1891/30 is a bolt action, internal magazine-fed, military rifle, developed by the Russian Empire, and later used and perfected by the Soviet Union.

mosin91_30_ebr.name: Mosin-Nagant 1891/30-EBR
mosin91_30_ebr.description: This Mosin-Nagant has exchanged the classic wooden stock for a modern synthetic model, carefully balanced to the same weight and handling yet offering support for modern accessories.

m3_carlgustav.name: M3 recoilless rifle
m3_carlgustav.description: Manufactured in Sweden, the Carl Gustav M3 is a breech-loading 84 millimeter man-portable, reusable, multi-role recoilless rifle commonly used by the US military.

AT4.name: AT4
AT4.description: Mil-Spec rocket launcher.  An 84-mm unguided, portable, single-shot recoilless smoothbore weapon used primarily by the US military.

rm103a_pistol.name: RM103A automagnum
rm103a_pistol.description: Considered overkill by many, the Rivtech M103A remains one of the most powerful sidearms ever developed.  Accepts stick magazines.

rm11b_sniper_rifle.name: RM11B scout rifle
rm11b_sniper_rifle.description: Intended to function as a long-range sharpshooter support weapon for the military, the Rivtech RM11B scout rifle was designed for durability and accuracy under less than ideal circumstances.  Its bullpup layout, integrated suppressor and digital scope, and two round burst mode allows it to deliver precise long-range takedowns, utilizing the proprietary Rivtech 8mm caseless round.  Accepts stick magazines.

rm2000_smg.name: RM2000 submachine gun
rm2000_smg.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM2000 submachine gun was designed for durability and ease of carrying under less than ideal circumstances.  Accepts stick magazines.

rm298.name: RM298 HMG
rm298.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM298 heavy machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

rm51_assault_rifle.name: RM51 assault rifle
rm51_assault_rifle.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM51 assault rifle was designed for durability and ease of use under less than ideal circumstances, with its considerable bulk minimized by a compact and ergonomic layout.  Accepts box magazines.

rm614_lmg.name: RM614 LMG
rm614_lmg.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM614 light machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

rm88_battle_rifle.name: RM88 battle rifle
rm88_battle_rifle.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM88 battle rifle was designed for durability and extreme firepower under less than ideal circumstances, with a heavy ported barrel for maximum controllability.  Accepts box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

rm99_pistol.name: RM99 revolver
rm99_pistol.description: Considered overkill by some, the Rivtech M99 remains an exceedingly powerful addition to the arsenal of any gunslinger.

90two.name: Beretta 90-two
90two.description: A more modern version of Beretta's popular 92 series of handguns, the 90-two performs largely the same.  The main difference is a sleeker, almost futuristic-looking design owed in large parts to the polymer underbarrel rail cover.

calico.name: Calico M960
calico.description: The Calico M960 is an automatic carbine with a unique circular magazine that allows for high capacities and reduced recoil.

cx4.name: Cx4 Storm
cx4.description: A small pistol caliber carbine designed for police use and civilian self-defense, the Cx4 Storm uses magazines that are interchangeable with other Beretta 9x19mm handguns.

glock_19.name: Glock 19
glock_19.description: Possibly the most popular pistol in existence.  The Glock 19 is often derided for its plastic construction, but it is easy to shoot.

hk_mp5.name: H&K MP5A4
hk_mp5.description: The Heckler & Koch MP5 is one of the most widely-used submachine guns in the world, and has been adopted by special police forces and militaries alike.  Its high degree of accuracy and low recoil are universally praised.

hk_mp5sd.name: H&K MP5SD
hk_mp5sd.description: The H&K MP5SD offers subsonic performance in almost the same footprint as the H&K MP5, retaining its handiness.  The large suppressor cuts down on muzzle flash greatly, aiding in night operations.  It has also seen some popularity with SWAT teams, as it lowers the risk of fire and explosions in illegal laboratories.  With body armor in more common use, the MP5SD has waned in popularity among special forces due to its decreased terminal performance.

hk_mp5k.name: H&K MP5K-PDW
hk_mp5k.description: The Heckler & Koch MP5 is one of the most widely-used submachine guns in the world, and has been adopted by special police forces and militaries alike.  Its high degree of accuracy and low recoil are universally praised.  The MP5K-PDW model features a shorter barrel, a built-in foregrip, and a side folding stock for vehicle or aircraft crew use.

hk_mp5_semi_pistol.name: PTR 603
hk_mp5_semi_pistol.description: The PTR 603 is a semi-automatic copy of the famous MP5 series, domestically produced for the US market on original Heckler and Koch tooling by PTR Industries.  Like the MP5, its roller delayed blowback action offers smooth shooting and precision, setting it apart from other submachine guns and pistol caliber carbines.  This model is configured as a pistol to avoid inconvenient and costly NFA regulations.  A welded on section of M1913 rail offers convenient mounting for aftermarket optics, but precludes the use of claw mounts.

briefcase_smg.name: H&K operational briefcase
briefcase_smg.description: This is a hard-sided briefcase with a trigger in the handle and a concealed hole in the side.  To fire the internally mounted MP5K-PDW, one braces the briefcase at the waist, ensures the briefcase is pointed at the enemy, and squeezes the trigger.  Precision and handling are severely hampered all around, however if you need to 'hand over the goods' or look low profile while bodyguarding, this is your gun.  When the briefcase is open the MP5 may be reloaded or dismounted.

ksub2000.name: Kel-Tec SUB-2000
ksub2000.description: A uniquely designed pistol caliber carbine with an integral folding stock and that makes use of 9x19mm Glock magazines.

ksub2000_turret_fake.name: Kel-Tec SUB-2000
ksub2000_turret_fake.description: If you see it - it is bug!

m9.name: Beretta M9A1
m9.description: An iconic 9x19mm pistol, the M9 was the standard issue sidearm of US armed force from 1985 only until recently.  It was formerly popular amongst law enforcement before the advent of commercially available polymer-framed handguns and the FBI's adoption of .40S&W.

px4.name: Beretta Px4 Storm
px4.description: Lighter than Beretta's iconic 92 series of guns, the Px4 Storm was built by utilizing light-weight polymer construction with steel inserts.  Its shape was also optimized for concealed carry, while maintaining the reliability the 92 series is known for.

sten.name: STEN
sten.description: A British submachine gun developed during World War II, to make up for shortages of supplies.  Designed to be made using unskilled labor and not known for reliability, its main advantages were low cost and being able to use German 9mm ammunition.

tec9.name: TEC-9
tec9.description: The TEC-9 is a machine pistol made of cheap polymers and machine stamped parts.  Its rise in popularity among criminals is largely due to its intimidating looks and low cost.

usp_9mm.name: USP 9mm
usp_9mm.description: A popular pistol, widely used among law enforcement.  Extensively tested for durability, it has been found to stay accurate even after being subjected to extreme abuse.

uzi.name: Uzi 9mm
uzi.description: The Uzi 9x19mm has enjoyed immense popularity, selling more units than any other submachine gun.  It is widely used as a personal defense weapon, or as a primary weapon by elite frontline forces.

glock_17.name: Glock 17
glock_17.description: Designed for all shooters, the Glock 17 is marketed towards law-enforcement and military.

glock_18c.name: Glock 18C
glock_18c.description: A selective fire variation on the Glock 17, originally designed for Austria's EKO Cobra unit.  It has compensator cuts along its barrel to make recoil more manageable.

kpf9.name: Kel-Tec PF-9
kpf9.description: The Kel-Tec PF-9 remains one of the most popular backup pistols due to its history of reliability, affordability, and concealability.  Chambered in 9x19mm, recoil is best described as unpleasant, and follow-up shots are difficult to place quickly.

m17.name: M17
m17.description: The M17 is a semi-automatic, short recoil operated pistol derived from the SIG Sauer P320.

hi_power_9mm.name: Browning Hi-Power 9x19mm
hi_power_9mm.description: The Browning Hi-Power is a semi-automatic handgun developed shortly before the second world war.  Widely issued since then, it remains in use by India, Canada and Australia.  This is a commercial variant produced by Browning Arms in 9x19mm Parabellum.

walther_p38.name: Walther P38
walther_p38.description: The Walther P38 is a semi-automatic handgun adopted shortly before the second world war.  Developed due to the high production costs of its predecessor, the Luger P08, the P38 is also chambered in 9mm Parabellum.  This early DA/SA locked-breech design would introduce features later seen on more modern firearms such as the Beretta 92 series, and served Germany until 2004.

walther_ppq_9mm.name: Walther PPQ 9mm
walther_ppq_9mm.description: The Walther PPQ is a semi-automatic pistol originating from the Walther P99QA, and maintains compatibility with some of its predecessor's accessories.  This model is chambered in 9x19mm Parabellum.

hptc9.name: Hi-Point C-9
hptc9.description: The Hi-Point C-9 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.

cz75.name: CZ-75
cz75.description: The CZ-75 is a semi-automatic pistol developed in Czechoslovakia, and is one of the original wonder nines.  Though designed for export to western countries, it was declared a state secret; lack of international patent protection meant that many clones and variants were produced and distributed around the world, with Česká zbrojovka only joining in the 90's.  This pistol remains wildly popular among competition shooters.

walther_ccp.name: Walther CCP
walther_ccp.description: The Walther CCP is a gas-delayed blowback semi-automatic pistol intended for the concealed carry consumer market.  Internally, it is nearly identical to the cult classic H&K P7.  Its fixed barrel design makes it potentially more accurate than many other pistols, though this may difficult to realize with its average trigger and short sight radius.

carbon_pistol.name: carbon fiber machine pistol
carbon_pistol.description: This 3D printed machine pistol is made completely without any metal parts except the barrel.  As a result, it is very lightweight.

kriss_vector_9mm.name: Kriss Vector 9mm
kriss_vector_9mm.description: A submachine gun with a sleek in-line design.  It features a 2-round burst mode to make the most out of its unique recoil mitigation system alongside a blistering full-auto mode.  This one is chambered in 9mm and uses full-size Glock 17 magazines.

hk_ump45_retool_9mm.name: H&K UMP
hk_ump45_retool_9mm.description: Developed as a lower-cost successor to H&K's own MP5, the Universal Machine Pistol is a closed-bolt, simple blowback sub-machine gun constructed of lightweight polymer.  Originally designed for .45 ACP, it is also available in .40 S&W and 9x19mm, and can be converted to fire those calibers with the proper conversion kit.

smg_luty.name: Luty SMG
smg_luty.description: A Luty pattern makeshift smoothbore SMG crudely constructed out of various steel parts using some of the more advanced powered hand tools; likely one of the most complex guns that are feasible to make outside of a machine shop, but still very unreliable.  This one is chambered for 9x19mm cartridges by default and accepts STEN compatible magazines.  The modular design allows for field conversion to .40 S&W or .45 ACP.

atgm_launcher.name: BGM-71F TOW
atgm_launcher.description: A launcher for anti-tank guided missiles, capable of being deployed as a crew-served weapon or mounted on vehicles.  While fairly accurate, it isn't fire-and-forget.

atgm_turret.name: BGM-71F TOW Under Armor
atgm_turret.description: A twin-tube launcher for anti-tank guided missiles, specifically designed for vehicle use.  While fairly accurate, it isn't fire-and-forget.  Obviously it needs to be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

bio_shotgun_gun.name: bionic shotgun
bio_shotgun_gun.description: Bionic retracting shotgun integrated with your arm.

blunderbuss.name: blunderbuss
blunderbuss.description: A homemade version of a crude precursor to the shotgun.  Able to fire just about anything you put down the barrel, but it will degrade pretty quick.

cannon_3in_ordnance.name: 3-inch ordnance rifle
cannon_3in_ordnance.description: A light (by artillery standards) rifled cannon widely used in the American Civil War, noted for its reliability.

cannon_3in_makeshift.name: makeshift 3-inch cannon
cannon_3in_makeshift.description: A muzzleloading blackpowder cannon made from logs bored for 3-inch shells, reinforced with iron bands.  While lighter and easier to produce, it's not as effective and less durable than the real deal.

chemical_thrower.name: makeshift chemical thrower
chemical_thrower.description: A bulky, self-made chemical sprayer with an internal conversion mechanism that allows all sorts of chemicals to be dispersed to your surroundings.

professional_chemical_thrower.name: chemical thrower
professional_chemical_thrower.description: A bulky, commercial-grade chemical sprayer with an internal conversion mechanism that allows all sorts of chemicals to be dispersed to your surroundings.

combination_gun.name: combination gun
combination_gun.description: A break action firearm comprised of a .30-06 barrel over two 12 gauge smooth bore barrels.  Historically used by egomaniac hunters in Africa, now used by their egomaniac descendants in New England.

pipe_combination_gun.name: pipe combination gun
pipe_combination_gun.description: A home-made triple-barreled firearm, one barrel chambered in .30-06 and two other for shotgun shells.  It is made from pipes and parts cannibalized from a double barrel shotgun.

m6_asw.name: M6 Aircrew Survival Weapon
m6_asw.description: A lightweight combination rifle, combining a .22 rimfire barrel with .410 shotgun barrel, and designed to fold for compact storage.  Produced for military aircraft pilots who might be stranded after a crash, later produced commercially by various companies.

flamethrower.name: flamethrower
flamethrower.description: A large flamethrower with substantial gas reserves.  Very menacing and deadly.

rm451_flamethrower.name: RM451 flamethrower
rm451_flamethrower.description: A military-grade combat flamethrower designed by Rivtech, the RM451 flamethrower incorporates a cycling pressure rapid-feed fuel system with a high-speed piezoelectric igniter.  Solidly built with durability in mind, it serves as an incredibly destructive weapon in the right hands.

flamethrower_crude.name: spraycan flamethrower
flamethrower_crude.description: A favorite of hooligans around the world, this lighter duct-taped to a spray can is probably as dangerous to the user as anyone else.  The nozzle has been crudely modified to disperse gasoline, and a small pump attached to the side allows for repressurization, though this process takes a few minutes.

flamethrower_simple.name: simple flamethrower
flamethrower_simple.description: A simple, home-made flamethrower.  While its capacity is not superb, it is more than capable of igniting terrain and monsters alike.

carbine_flintlock.name: flintlock carbine
carbine_flintlock.description: This short rifle design once dominated the battlefields of ancient Europe, and may yet re-earn its feared status due to its ease of handling and ability to use easily-crafted ammunition.

carbine_flintlock_double.name: handmade double-barrel flintlock
carbine_flintlock_double.description: This is a compact muzzle-loading rifle combining a pair of rudimentary flintlock actions and two barrels.  Whereas an antique multiple-barrel flintlock is an intricate work of gunsmithing, this weapon is simpler yet still serviceable.

pistol_flintlock.name: flintlock pistol
pistol_flintlock.description: A beautifully decorated flintlock pistol.  If using this doesn't make you feel a pirate, nothing will.

rifle_flintlock.name: flintlock musket
rifle_flintlock.description: For once, something *good* came back from the dead.  This ancient design lacks the fire-rate of modern weapons, but packs as much punch as the best of 'em and rewards the skilled shooter with easily-crafted ammunition.

longrifle_flintlock.name: flintlock rifle
longrifle_flintlock.description: Also called a Pennsylvania rifle, this long barreled rifled flintlock gun has significantly increased accuracy at the cost of taking even longer to reload.

hellfire_launcher.name: Hellfire missile rack
hellfire_launcher.description: A quad rack for Hellfire missiles, specifically designed for vehicle use.  Needs to be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

heavy_rail_rifle.name: heavy rail rifle
heavy_rail_rifle.description: This overpowered and overengineered variant of the ferromagnetic rail rifle was designed to deliver electromagnetically-driven obliteration right through whatever obstacles that lies in front of it, be it buildings, vehicles or hordes of walking dead.  However, the hefty bulk and weight of this weapon compared to most contemporary rifles makes it unfeasible to fire without supporting it properly; not to mention that it consumes UPS charges at a tremendous rate, making it impractical for use in prolonged engagements.  Unlike the handheld variant, this weapon has an internal feeder designed to make reloading easier.

rebar_rifle.name: makeshift ferromagnetic rail rifle
rebar_rifle.description: An electrically propelled steel rail launcher handcrafted from scrap.  The hypervelocity metal stake that it fires is accelerated to the point of spontaneous combustion by a Lorentz force generated by electromagnetic induction, powered by a standard UPS.

rebar_railgun.name: ferromagnetic rail rifle
rebar_railgun.description: An electrically propelled steel rail launcher designed for urban warfare situations where ammo is scarce.  The hypervelocity metal stake that it fires is accelerated to the point of spontaneous combustion by a Lorentz force generated by electromagnetic induction, powered by a standard UPS.

mininuke_launcher.name: mininuke launcher
mininuke_launcher.description: A powerful handheld launcher handcrafted from scrap.  Made to launch modified handheld nuclear weapons, it is an exceedingly powerful weapon.

surv_rocket_launcher.name: crude rocket launcher
surv_rocket_launcher.description: An improvised, direct ignition launcher for home-made rockets.  Essentially, a thick-walled steel pipe, equipped with a pilot light, several batteries and a simple circuit board.  Effective only at medium range, barely.

watercannon.name: water cannon
watercannon.description: A water cannon from a fire truck.  Mounted on a vehicle, it could be used to stop fires or "protesters".  Or it could be loaded with something more corrosive, for a lot less firefighting and a lot more excessive force.

bola_net_launcher.name: restraint launcher
bola_net_launcher.description: A compact pistol-style launcher designed to fire bola or net cartridges for non-lethal control.

oldguard_rifle.name: old guard NTSR
oldguard_rifle.description: The new threat service rifle, an M4A1 modified by military remnants to fire and accept magazines for most common military rifle calibers at the cost of higher weight and worsened ballistics and handling. Designed for a new battlefield where scavenging ammo is a neccesity and logistics are difficult.

barb_launcher.name: barb launching organ
barb_launcher.description: A mutated organ capable of launching bony barbs at great speed.

feral_human_thrown_rock.name: hurled rubble
feral_human_thrown_rock.description: Stone at the ready to crush that which isn't part of the blob.

feral_jackboot_gun.name: feral bikers' shotgun
feral_jackboot_gun.description: A fake shotgun for feral bikers (because monster aiming is too lethal).

emp_frond.name: electric alien frond
emp_frond.description: Electricity unnaturally arcs from the tips of this alien frond.

radiant_triffid_boss_sunray.name: radiant triffid sun ray
radiant_triffid_boss_sunray.description: Sunlight radiates from this mutated triffid petal.

zombie_swat_thrown_teargas.name: thrown tear gas grenade
zombie_swat_thrown_teargas.description: Tear gas grenade thrown from practiced muscle memory.

feral_pa_boss_grenade.name: feral armored bio-operator grenade launcher
feral_pa_boss_grenade.description: Fake grenade launcher used for the grenade launcher feral armored bio-op.

talon_m249.name: TALON M249
talon_m249.description: Low accuracy M249 used by the M249 TALON UGV.

nailgun.name: nail gun
nailgun.description: A tool used to drive nails into wood or other material.  It could also be used as an ad-hoc weapon.

coilgun.name: coilgun
coilgun.description: A homemade gun, using electromagnets to accelerate a small ferromagnetic projectile to high velocity.  Powered by UPS.

nailrifle.name: nail rifle
nailrifle.description: This is a nailgun that has been extensively modified with the addition of a short barrel, stock and hand guard.  It can be reloaded using detachable magazines and is an overall much more effective weapon.

paintballgun.name: Paintball gun
paintballgun.description: A fairly harmless gun that shoots small paintballs.

pipe_pistol.name: modular pipe pistol
pipe_pistol.description: A home-made pistol.  It is simply a short pipe attached to a grip, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.  A pipe gun caliber conversion kit can be installed to change its caliber.

2_shot_special.name: 2 Shot Special
2_shot_special.description: A crudely made double barrel pistol.  Unfortunately, the name is less about the double barrels and more about the number of shots you'll get before it breaks down on you.  A pipe gun caliber conversion kit can be installed to change its caliber.

pipe_rifle.name: modular pipe rifle
pipe_rifle.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds. A pipe gun caliber conversion kit can be installed to change its caliber.

pipe_shotgun.name: pipe shotgun
pipe_shotgun.description: A home-made shotgun.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

pipe_double_shotgun.name: double-barrel pipe shotgun
pipe_double_shotgun.description: A home-made double-barreled shotgun.  It is simply two pipes attached to a stock, with a pair of hammers to strike the two rounds it holds.

plasma_gun.name: PPA-5
plasma_gun.description: Portable Plasma Accelerator Model Five, developed by Lockheed Martin Corporation.  This device uses highly advanced capacitor banks to create a torus of superheated hydrogen plasma and accelerate it to incredible speed.  It was designed to take down heavy vehicles, and was expected to fully enter US Army service not long before the Cataclysm.

plasma_rifle.name: Boeing XM-P plasma rifle
plasma_rifle.description: Boeing developed the focused plasma weaponry together with DARPA.  It heats solid hydrogen to create plasma and envelops it with polymers to reduce blooming.  While powerful, it suffers from short range.  Powered by UPS.

RPG.name: RPG-7
RPG.description: The emblematic RPG-7 launcher.  Its simple, inexpensive, and reliable design made it a popular choice among armies and insurgent groups worldwide.

ashot.name: 12 gauge pistol
ashot.description: A single shot pistol that loads 12 gauge shotgun shells, handcrafted from scrap.

bigun.name: 12-gauge gatling gun
bigun.description: An electrically driven six barrel gatling shotgun, fed from handmade cloth belts.  Even properly mounted, this seems like an unwieldy beast, and the six separate barrels make for difficult zeroing.  The externally driven action means this is much less likely to jam.

browning_a5.name: Browning Auto 5
browning_a5.description: This humble looking shotgun was the earliest successful semi-automatic shotgun, and the second most successful in U.S. history, with over 2.7 million made between 1902 and 1998.  The recoil tuning mechanism under the handguard and long dwell time of the action make for pleasant shooting.

ksg.name: Kel-Tec KSG
ksg.description: A bullpup pump-action shotgun, the Kel-Tec KSG uses a pair of magazine tubes to increase its capacity.  Each tube has to be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.  An integral top rail is provided for mounting sights, without which it will perform poorly.

ksg-25.name: Kel-Tec KSG-25
ksg-25.description: A bullpup pump-action shotgun, the Kel-Tec KSG-25 uses a pair of magazine tubes to increase its capacity.  Each tube has to be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.  The big brother of the KSG, it has a longer barrel and longer magazine tubes.  An integral top rail is provided for mounting sights, without which it will perform poorly.

dp-12.name: DP-12
dp-12.description: A bullpup pump-action shotgun, the Standard Manufacturing DP-12 uses a pair of magazine tubes to increase its capacity.  Each tube has to be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.  No coverage for injuries caused by a sudden urge to play vigilante and pick fights with a cat-eared person.

m1014.name: M1014 shotgun
m1014.description: Benelli's first gas-operated shotgun, featuring dual pistons for enhanced reliability with various loads and a collapsible buttstock that reduces length by almost 8 inches.  Adopted in 1999 as the M1014 Joint Service Combat Shotgun, the Benelli M4 is one of the finest combat shotguns available.

mossberg_500.name: Mossberg 500 Field
mossberg_500.description: The Mossberg 500 is a popular series of pump-action shotguns, often acquired for military use.  It is noted for its high durability and low recoil.  This one is fitted with a 28 inch barrel with sight rib.

mossberg_500_security.name: Mossberg 500 Security
mossberg_500_security.description: The Mossberg 500 is a popular series of pump-action shotguns, often acquired for military use.  It is noted for its high durability and low recoil.  This one is fitted with an 18.5 inch barrel.

mossberg_590.name: Mossberg 590A1
mossberg_590.description: The Mossberg 590A1 is a military and police oriented version of the Mossberg 500.  It features a heavier barrel, a bayonet lug, and a different magazine tube for easier cleaning and maintenance.

mossberg_930.name: Mossberg 930 SPX
mossberg_930.description: This semi-automatic offering from Mossberg features a recoil reducing gas system, rifle style sights and a factory-installed picatinny rail.  Affordable pricing and decent ergonomics make this a popular entry-level 3-gun shotgun.

remington_870.name: Remington 870 Wingmaster
remington_870.description: With over 10 million made, the Remington 870 is one of the most popular shotguns on the market, and finds use with hunters and law enforcement agencies alike thanks to its high accuracy and muzzle velocity.  This one is a 28 inch barreled model for hunting fowl and game.

remington_870_breacher.name: Remington 870 MCS
remington_870_breacher.description: This Remington 870 Modular Combat System shotgun is currently setup for breaching operations, with a 10 inch barrel and no stock.  It is small enough to carry as a secondary weapon, specifically to pop open any pesky doors you might come across.  The grip's design makes for controllable recoil, and the barrel lacks any integral sights, requiring you to install your own if you want better accuracy.

remington_870_express.name: Remington 870 express
remington_870_express.description: With over 10 million made, the Remington 870 is one of the most popular shotguns on the market, and finds use with hunters and law enforcement agencies alike thanks to its high accuracy and muzzle velocity.  This one is an 18.5 inch barreled defensive model.

remington_1100.name: Remington 1100 competition
remington_1100.description: This semi-automatic shotgun features a self compensating gas system that will feed a wide array of shells while also reducing recoil.  Introduced in 1963, it is favored by law enforcement, hunters and competition shooters, and has been the best-selling autoloading shotgun in U.S. history.  This is the nickel finished, teflon coated competition model, with a full length magazine tube and 30 inch barrel.

revolver_shotgun.name: shotgun revolver
revolver_shotgun.description: A shotgun modified to use a revolver cylinder mechanism, it can hold 6 cartridges.

saiga_12.name: Saiga-12
saiga_12.description: The Saiga-12 is a semi-automatic shotgun designed on the same Kalashnikov pattern as the AK47 rifle.  It reloads with a magazine, rather than one shell at a time like most shotguns.  It is one of the last designs of Mikhail Kalashnikov, and was popular in open division shotgun competitions prior to its ban from import via executive order.

shotgun_d.name: double barrel shotgun
shotgun_d.description: An old shotgun, possibly antique.  It is little more than a pair of barrels, a wood stock, and a hammer to strike the cartridges.

shotgun_s.name: single barrel shotgun
shotgun_s.description: An old shotgun, possibly antique.  It is little more than a barrel, a wood stock, and a hammer to strike the cartridge.  Its simple design keeps it both light and accurate.

streetsweeper.name: Cobray Streetsweeper
streetsweeper.description: Less shotgun and more comically oversized revolver, the Cobray Streetsweeper sold poorly before it was deemed a destructive device.  The cylinder is driven by a clockspring, cannot be indexed by hand, and must be ejected with an ejector rod.  Its unique design allows for all 12 shells to be fired in under 3 seconds, as demonstrated by the ATF technical branch.

SPAS_12.name: Franchi SPAS-12
SPAS_12.description: Mean and intimidating looking, the SPAS 12 has the dubious honor of being declared a destructive device and being banned from import by name, adding to its already considerable appeal.  It is a combination pump-action and semi-automatic firearm, with an arm stabilizing hook for one handed shooting.

tavor_12.name: Tavor TS12
tavor_12.description: This is a triple tube magazine fed, gas-operated bullpup shotgun of Israeli Weapon Industries make.  It is capable of loading 15 shells, all in a relatively small package.  Like many other modern IWI designs, this looks more like a sci-fi prop gun than a firearm.  An integral top rail is provided for mounting sights, without which it will perform poorly.

USAS_12.name: USAS 12
USAS_12.description: The USAS 12 looks like a boxy upsized caricature of the M16A2.  Like its Auto Assault-12 predecessor, it is a select-fire shotgun fed from large box or drum magazines.  The in-line recoil system and sheer weight make for pleasant shooting.

winchester_1887.name: Winchester 1887
winchester_1887.description: One of the first commercially successful repeating shotguns, the Winchester 1887 was specifically made lever-action at Winchester's request.  Though later overshadowed in success by pump designs, the 1887 remains popular today.  This one has a very short barrel, no stock, and would pair nicely with a motorcycle jacket and a Harley Davidson.

winchester_1897.name: Winchester 1897
winchester_1897.description: The Winchester 1897 was one of the first commercially successful pump action shotguns.  In its 'trench' configuration it has become a heavily romanticized American icon of World War 1.  With its barrel shroud, bayonet lug and 17 inch bayonet, this shotgun is undeniably fearsome in appearance.  There aren't any more trenches to clear, so the next zombie infested town will have to suffice.

BP_12.name: BP-12
BP_12.description: A bullpup, magazine fed, semi-automatic shotgun, possessing the accuracy of a full-length barrel in a compact frame.

shotgun_paper.name: 20ga muzzleloading shotgun
shotgun_paper.description: A percussion cap fired shotgun, most likely a modern reproduction.  Favored over flintlocks for modern day blackpowder hunting, this one is chambered in .62 caliber or 20 gauge.

flaregun.name: flaregun
flaregun.description: A plastic single shot pistol that can be loaded with signal flares.

25mm_autocannon.name: M242 Bushmaster autocannon
25mm_autocannon.description: A chain-driven autocannon chambered in 25x137mm, designed for the Bradley IFV and other ground vehicles, with some naval use as well.  Electric-driven, it would be very difficult to fire if not mounted on a vehicle.

25mm_autocannon_sawn.name: stripped-down 25mm cannon
25mm_autocannon_sawn.description: Modified from a M242 Bushmaster autocannon, this pared down weapon has been altered into a makeshift anti-materiel rifle.  Its chain-driven mechanism has been removed, reducing weight in exchange for converting it into a single-shot design.  Still extremely bulky, requiring it to be deployed or mounted on a vehicle.

25mm_cannon_crude.name: makeshift 25mm cannon
25mm_cannon_crude.description: A makeshift cannon crudely chambered for 25x137mm, with a short thick-walled barrel and a breechblock fashioned out of hardened steel.  Very unreliable and massively reduces performance, but simpler to install and easier to repair.  Only holds a single shot, and must be deployed or mounted on a vehicle.  You get the impression you should put on a lot of hearing protection before you fire this.

25mm_rotary_cannon.name: GAU-22 rotary cannon
25mm_rotary_cannon.description: A four-barreled gatling chambered in 25x137mm, designed for aircraft such as the F-35 Lightning.  It boasts a devastating rate of fire combined with hard-hitting ammunition, but is only remotely practical to use mounted on a vehicle.

tank_gun_manual.name: M246 120mm tank gun
tank_gun_manual.description: A version of the Rheinmetall Rh-120, this 120mm cannon is most notably used in the M1 Abhrams.  Uses electric ignition, and obviously needs to be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

tank_gun_auto.name: XM246E1 autoloading tank gun
tank_gun_auto.description: An experimental variant of the Rheinmetall Rh-120, this 120mm cannon is equipped with a 5-round autoloader.  Uses electric ignition, and obviously needs to be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

tank_gun_crude.name: makeshift 120mm tank gun
tank_gun_crude.description: A makeshift cannon crudely chambered for 120mm tank shells, with a short thick-walled barrel and a breechblock fashioned out of hardened steel.  Very unreliable and massively reduces performance, but simpler to install and easier to repair.  Only holds a single shot, uses electric ignition, and must be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

tank_gun_manual_105mm.name: M68 105mm tank gun
tank_gun_manual_105mm.description: A version of the Royal Ordinance L7, this 105mm rifled cannon is used in various armored vehicles worldwide, many no longer in service, some still in use, and some brought back out of reserve in the desperate last days before the world ended.  Uses electric ignition, and obviously needs to be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

tank_gun_crude_105mm.name: makeshift 105mm tank gun
tank_gun_crude_105mm.description: A makeshift cannon crudely chambered for 105mm tank shells, with a short thick-walled barrel and a breechblock fashioned out of hardened steel.  Very unreliable and massively reduces performance, but simpler to install and easier to repair.  Only holds a single shot, uses electric ignition, and must be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

howitzer_gun.name: M284 howitzer
howitzer_gun.description: A 155mm cannon designed for self-propelled guns such as the M109.  Obviously it needs to be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

howitzer_gun_crude.name: makeshift 155mm howitzer
howitzer_gun_crude.description: A makeshift cannon crudely chambered for 155mm artillery shells, with a short thick-walled barrel and a breechblock fashioned out of hardened steel.  Very unreliable and massively reduces performance, but simpler to install and easier to repair.  Only holds a single shot, and must be mounted on a vehicle to fire.

tank_gun_auto_monster.name: XM246E1 monster tank gun
tank_gun_auto_monster.description: This exists to alter the dispersion of the new tank drone.  This is a bug if you find one of these.

emp_gun.name: XM34 EMP projector
emp_gun.description: A powerful electrolaser developed by the R&D outfit "Aerial Labs".  Especially effective against electronic targets.

gatling_mech_laser.name: CMES laser cannon
gatling_mech_laser.description: This is the integral weapon system for the CMES exoskeleton mech-suit, a rotating-barrel active-cooled rapid-fire laser system, can spray death downrange with ease.

gatling_mech_laser_rebuilt.name: rebuilt CMES gatling laser
gatling_mech_laser_rebuilt.description: A rapid-fire weapon system stripped from a combat mech, modified for handheld use.  While less efficient and too bulky to fire without proper support, its rotating-barrel laser system can still spray death downrange with ease.

recon_mech_laser.name: RMES marksman system
recon_mech_laser.description: This is the integral weapon system for the RMES exoskeleton mech-suit, a quiet and accurate marksman laser rifle.

recon_mech_laser_rebuilt.name: rebuilt RMES marksman laser
recon_mech_laser_rebuilt.description: A long-range weapon system stripped from a recon mech, modified for handheld use.  While less efficient and too bulky to fire without proper support, it's still a quiet and relatively accurate marksman laser rifle.

laser_cannon.name: handheld laser cannon
laser_cannon.description: This is a triple-barreled laser cannon stripped from a TX-5LR Cerberus laser turret, that has been modified to use UPS power for firing.  Bulky, yet provides decent firepower.

laser_cannon_turret_fake.name: TX-5LR Laser Cannon
laser_cannon_turret_fake.description: If you see it - it is bug!

laser_rifle.name: A7 laser rifle
laser_rifle.description: A state-of-the-art laser rifle developed by the R&D outfit "Aerial Labs".  Initial performance rivaled Rivtech's finest, with rumors flying about corporate skulduggery.  Though the Cataclysm put that on the ash heap of history, this weapon can still do the same to your foes.

v29.name: V29 laser pistol
v29.description: This V29 laser pistol was one of the first handheld laser weapons.  It is larger than most traditional handguns, but displays no recoil whatsoever.

laser_rifle_cheap.name: shoddy laser rifle
laser_rifle_cheap.description: This is a cheap laser rifle made from common components.  Weak, but can be powered with UPS.

laser_maxim.name: shoddy autolaser
laser_maxim.description: This is a handmade laser weapon with an equally handmade heat sink, using evaporative cooling to allow for a higher rate of fire.  It's massively heavy, but the lack of recoil means it's still somewhat manageable as a weapon if you can lift it.  It uses UPS power, and you need to fill the reservoir with water before you can fire it.

selfbow.name: self bow
selfbow.description: A primitive bow fashioned from a single piece of wood, made specifically for the person using it.  Weak and wildly inaccurate, it doesn't work that well, unfortunately…

shortbow.name: short bow
shortbow.description: Though not as powerful as the longbow, this bow is quicker and easier to draw, and can be used effectively by those of average strength.  Good for small game or the survivor on the go.

compbow.name: compound bow
compbow.description: A high-power bow with shaped cams and extra cables for high velocity shots that can be used effectively by fairly strong archers.  Currently set to a medium weight, activate it to choose between a lower or higher draw weight.

use_action.msg: You tighten the limbs, increasing the strength of the bow.
You loosen the limbs, decreasing the strength of the bow.

compbow_high.name: compound bow (high)
compbow_high.description: A high-power bow with shaped cams and extra cables for high velocity shots that can be used effectively by very strong archers.  Currently set to a high weight, and ready to cause some real damage - if you can draw it.  Activate it to adjust it to lower draw weights.

use_action.msg: You loosen the limbs, decreasing the strength of the bow significantly.
You loosen the limbs, decreasing the strength of the bow.

compbow_low.name: compound bow (low)
compbow_low.description: A high-power bow with shaped cams and extra cables for high velocity shots that can be used effectively by average archers.  Currently set to a low weight, making it much easier to draw.  Activate it to adjust it to higher draw weights.

use_action.msg: You tighten the limbs, increasing the strength of the bow.
You tighten the limbs, increasing the strength of the bow significantly.

compositebow.name: composite longbow
compositebow.description: A six-foot bow made from multiple materials for increased energy efficiency.  Complicated to make, but stronger than an all-wood longbow.

compositebow_short.name: composite short bow
compositebow_short.description: A bow made from multiple materials for increased energy efficiency.  Complicated to make, but stronger than an all-wood short bow.

longbow.name: longbow
longbow.description: A six-foot wooden bow that takes a fair amount of strength to draw.  It can be used effectively by those of above-average strength.  Used mainly in medieval England in wartime, but pierces zombie hide just as well as chainmail.

woodgreatbow.name: wooden greatbow
woodgreatbow.description: An extremely large and stiff longbow, made with enormous limbs and a thick string to take an immense amount of energy.  Takes considerable strength to draw.

compgreatbow.name: composite greatbow
compgreatbow.description: An extremely large and powerful composite bow, made with enormous reinforced limbs and a thick string to take an immense amount of energy.  Takes considerable strength to draw.

bullet_crossbow.name: bullet crossbow
bullet_crossbow.description: A modified version of the classic crossbow which utilizes stones as projectiles instead of the traditional quarrel.  Primarily intended for hunting small game, stronger people can reload it much faster.

crossbow_makeshift.name: makeshift crossbow
crossbow_makeshift.description: A simple, handmade crossbow of the Skane style, with a wooden peg that is pushed up from underneath to loose the bowstring.  Not as powerful as other crossbow designs, but it is easier to draw the bow back.  Bolts fired from this weapon have a good chance of remaining intact for re-use.

hand_crossbow.name: pistol crossbow
hand_crossbow.description: A small concealable pistol-like crossbow.  It's weak due to its small size and draw, so it is best suited for hunting small game.  Bolts fired from this weapon have a good chance of remaining intact for re-use.

crossbow.name: crossbow
crossbow.description: A slow-loading hand weapon that launches bolts.  Stronger people can reload it much faster.  Bolts fired from this weapon have a good chance of remaining intact for re-use.

compositecrossbow.name: composite crossbow
compositecrossbow.description: A slightly larger, more powerful crossbow utilizing composite material limbs and somewhat more modern design practices.

compcrossbow.name: compound crossbow
compcrossbow.description: A high-power crossbow with shaped cams and extra cables for high-power shots.  Takes less time to reload due to a modern string-pulling system.

huge_crossbow.name: heavy crossbow
huge_crossbow.description: A HUGE medieval crossbow from Germany with a very slow, difficult reloading process not suited for unskilled users.  Its tension is so powerful that you feel it shake after firing.  Bolts fired from this weapon have a good chance of remaining intact for re-use.

rep_crossbow.name: repeating crossbow
rep_crossbow.description: A custom-made crossbow with a clever mechanism that loads and fires bolts in a single motion, it has a wooden magazine that holds 10 bolts.  Bolts fired from this weapon have a good chance of remaining intact for re-use.

crossbow_carbon.name: carbon fiber repeating crossbow
crossbow_carbon.description: A custom 3D-printed pump-action repeating crossbow made out of carbon fiber and synthetic fabric.  This expensive hunting weapon is surprisingly lightweight thanks to its construction, but it can only be repaired using a 3D printer.

launcher_ballista.name: ballista
launcher_ballista.description: A massive weapon resembling a crossbow, powered by two torsion springs made from tightly-wound rope and drawn using a winch.  Relatively light as far as siege weapons go, it's far too heavy to fire without adequate support and slow to reload.  Even so, it can send stones or specially-designed bolts downrange with devastating force.

bbgun.name: BB gun
bbgun.description: Popular among children.  It's fairly accurate, but BBs deal nearly no damage.

helsing.name: pneumatic bolt driver
helsing.description: A ten-shot, revolving barrel, pneumatic bolt driver handcrafted from scrap.  Be careful where you reload it, pumping air into the tank takes a few seconds.  It is pretty quiet and quite deadly.

tihar.name: pneumatic assault rifle
tihar.description: A multistroke pneumatic rifle handcrafted from scrap.  Be careful where you reload it, pumping air into the tank takes a few seconds.  It is pretty quiet and quite deadly.

pneumatic_shotgun.name: pneumatic shotgun
pneumatic_shotgun.description: A double-barreled pneumatic air shotgun handcrafted from scrap.  Though its firepower is lacking compared to more conventional shotguns, this thing can still pack quite a punch.  That is, if your target is directly in front of you.

sling.name: sling
sling.description: A leather sling, easy to use and accurate.  It uses pebbles or rocks as ammunition.

staff_sling.name: staff sling
staff_sling.description: A leather sling attached to a staff, easy to use and accurate.  It uses rocks as ammunition.

slingshot.name: slingshot
slingshot.description: A wooden slingshot, easy to use and accurate.  It uses pebbles as ammunition.

wristrocket.name: brace slingshot
wristrocket.description: A modern slingshot with a wrist brace, it is easy to use, accurate, and quite powerful.

slingshot_cannon.name: slingshot cannon
slingshot_cannon.description: Somewhere between a bullet crossbow and a slingshot on steroids, this shoulder-mounted weapon uses a winch to keep several elastic bands under tension.  It fires full-size rocks with much more power and range than pebbles out of a normal slingshot.  High strength will make it faster to reload.

atlatl.name: atlatl
atlatl.description: A wooden tool for supporting a javelin, to throw it more effectively than by hand.

airspeargun.name: pneumatic speargun
airspeargun.description: A sophisticated underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using a hand-pump pressure system.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

minispeargun.name: mini speargun
minispeargun.description: A small underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using tension in a rubber band.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

speargun.name: speargun
speargun.description: An underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using tension in a rubber band.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

doublespeargun.name: double speargun
