doublespeargun.description: A double-loading underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using tension in a rubber band.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

acid_spray.name: acid dart volley
acid_spray.description: Fake gun that fires acid globs.

acid_sniper.name: acid dart gun
acid_sniper.description: Fake gun that fires acid globs.

acid_artillery.name: acid artillery
acid_artillery.description: Fake gun that fires acid globs.

monster_scrap_gun.name: scrap metal volley
monster_scrap_gun.description: Fake gun that fires bits of scrap metal.

unbio_blaster_gun.name: fusion blaster rifle
unbio_blaster_gun.description: A cyborg's fusion blaster arm, cannibalized and converted into a rifle.  This improvised weapon is powered by a standard UPS connection.

ftk93.name: FTK-93 fusion gun
ftk93.description: A very powerful fusion rifle developed shortly before the influx of monsters.  It can only hold two rounds at a time, but a special superheating unit causes its bolts to be extremely deadly.

v29_cheap.name: homemade laser pistol
v29_cheap.description: This laser pistol was based on the V29 laser pistol designed in the mid-21st century.  While little more than duct tape and electronics, it runs on a standard UPS.

TANK.name: Tankbot Main Gun
TANK.description: The 120mm cannon from a tankbot.  If you have this, you'd best be debugging!

survivor_special_700.name: Special 700
survivor_special_700.description: A rusty receiver, a R700 pattern barrel and half a broken crutch; all held together in the shape of a rifle with nothing more than glue, duct tape, and generous amounts of faith.

recurbow.name: recurve bow
recurbow.description: A modern bow that curves away from the archer at the tips for increased power, which can be used effectively by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Good and easy to use, but nothing special.

reflexbow.name: reflex bow
reflexbow.description: A bow with limbs that curve away from the archer near the riser for power.  Smaller than some bows, but decently powerful and quick.

hybridbow.name: hybrid longbow
hybridbow.description: A modernized, six-foot longbow that curves away from the archer at the tips for increased power.  It can be used effectively by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Designed for archers that appreciate the smoothness of a traditional longbow, but desire the superior power of a modern recurve.

reflexrecurvebow.name: reflex recurve bow
reflexrecurvebow.description: A modernized bow that combines the traits from both the reflex and the recurve bows, with both limbs and tips curving away from the archer, and reinforced with composite materials.  This dramatically increases the power and requires significant strength to draw the bow effectively, but can still be fired quickly.

rifle_22.name: pipe rifle: .22
rifle_22.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

rifle_38.name: pipe rifle: .38 Special
rifle_38.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

rifle_40.name: pipe rifle: .40 S&W
rifle_40.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

rifle_44.name: pipe rifle: .44 Magnum
rifle_44.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

rifle_45.name: pipe rifle: .45
rifle_45.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

rifle_9mm.name: pipe rifle: 9x19mm
rifle_9mm.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

rifle_223.name: pipe rifle: 5.56x45mm
rifle_223.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

rifle_3006.name: pipe rifle: .30-06
rifle_3006.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

rifle_308.name: handmade heavy carbine
rifle_308.description: A homemade lever-action magazine-fed smoothbore rifle.  While still a primitive pipe and 2x4 design, some minor improvements have been made, such as being able to accept G3 compatible magazines, and chambering the more powerful 7.62x51mm (.308) rounds.

surv_carbine_223.name: handmade carbine
surv_carbine_223.description: A well-designed improvised lever-action carbine with a shortened barrel.  Accepting crude detachable magazines or STANAG magazines, this is one of the better homemade weapons.

smg_9mm.name: Luty SMG: 9x19mm
smg_9mm.description: A Luty pattern makeshift smoothbore SMG crudely constructed out of various steel parts using some of the more advanced powered hand tools; likely one of the most complex guns that are feasible to make outside of a machine shop, but still very unreliable.  This one is chambered for 9x19mm cartridges and accepts STEN compatible magazines.

smg_40.name: Luty SMG: .40 S&W
smg_40.description: A Luty pattern makeshift smoothbore SMG crudely constructed out of various steel parts using some of the more advanced powered hand tools; likely one of the most complex guns that are feasible to make outside of a machine shop, but still very unreliable.  This one is chambered for .40 S&W cartridges and accepts custom-made makeshift magazines.

smg_45.name: Luty SMG: .45
smg_45.description: A Luty pattern makeshift smoothbore SMG crudely constructed out of various steel parts using some of the more advanced powered hand tools; likely one of the most complex guns that are feasible to make outside of a machine shop, but still very unreliable.  This one is chambered for .45 ACP cartridges and accepts MAC-10 compatible magazines.

surv_six_shooter.name: handmade six-shooter
surv_six_shooter.description: A homemade 6-shot revolver.  While it's not as good as the pre-Cataclysm manufactured weapons, it's a decent piece of work, all things considered.

surv_hand_cannon.name: homemade hand cannon
surv_hand_cannon.description: A large and heavy revolver evidently welded from scrap.  It's not pretty, but the .45 it's chambered with packs a serious punch.  Just watch out for the kick.

2lcanteen.name: 2.5L canteen
2lcanteen.description: A large plastic water canteen, with a 2.5 liter capacity and carrying strap.

power_armor_2lcanteen.name: power armor 2.5L canteen
power_armor_2lcanteen.description: A large plastic water canteen, with a 2.5 liter capacity.  It's been converted to clip onto power armor.

30gal_barrel.name: 30 gallon barrel
30gal_barrel.description: A huge plastic barrel with a resealable lid.

30gal_drum.name: steel drum (100L)
30gal_drum.description: A huge steel barrel with a resealable lid.

55gal_drum.name: steel drum (200L)
55gal_drum.description: A massive steel barrel with a resealable lid.

bag_canvas.name: canvas sack
bag_canvas.description: A large and sturdy canvas sack.  Smells faintly of earth and hard work.

bag_canvas_small.name: canvas bag
bag_canvas_small.description: Small bag made of canvas.  Looks fine to store dried herbs in.

bag_plastic.name: plastic bag
bag_plastic.description: A small, open plastic bag.  Essentially trash.

bag_zipper.name: resealable plastic bag
bag_zipper.description: A plastic bag with a zipper closure that lets it be resealed.  Essentially trash, though could carry liquids in a pinch.

bag_zipper_small.name: small resealable plastic bag
bag_zipper_small.description: A small plastic bag with a zipper closure that lets it be resealed.  Essentially trash, though could carry liquids in a pinch.

bag_body_bag.name: body bag
bag_body_bag.description: A large, human size, rectangular bag made of strong plastic, with a zipper in the middle.  Used to hold a dead body.

bag_iv.name: IV bag
bag_iv.description: A small, sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy.

bottle_glass.name: glass bottle
bottle_glass.description: A resealable glass bottle, holds 750 ml of liquid.

bottle_plastic.name: plastic bottle
bottle_plastic.description: A resealable plastic bottle, holds 500 ml of liquid.

condiment_bottle_sealed.name: condiment bottle
condiment_bottle_sealed.description: An inverted plastic bottle for condiments.  Still sealed from the factory, preserves content from rot until opened.

condiment_bottle_unsealed.name: opened condiment bottle
condiment_bottle_unsealed.description: An inverted plastic bottle for condiments.

bottle_plastic_small.name: small plastic bottle
bottle_plastic_small.description: A resealable plastic bottle, holds 250 ml of liquid.

bottle_twoliter.name: large plastic bottle
bottle_twoliter.description: It's a two-liter plastic bottle that can hold a lot of soda, or, nowadays, boiled water.

bowl_clay.name: clay bowl
bowl_clay.description: A clay bowl with a waterproofed hide lid.  Can be used as a container or as a tool.  Holds 250 ml of liquid.

box_cigarette.name: pack
box_cigarette.description: SURGEON GENERAL'S WARNING: Smoking Causes Lung Cancer, Heart Disease, Emphysema And May Complicate Pregnancy.

box_small.name: small cardboard box
box_small.description: A small cardboard box.  No bigger than a foot in dimension.

box_medium.name: cardboard box
box_medium.description: A sturdy cardboard box, about the size of a banana box.  Great for packing.

box_huge.name: huge cardboard box
box_huge.description: A very large cardboard box, the sort you could find storing cargo for transport.

box_large.name: large cardboard box
box_large.description: A very large cardboard box, the sort children would have loved to hide in, when there were still children.

bucket.name: bucket
bucket.description: A galvanized bucket for peanuts, chilled wine, iced beer, lobster, crab legs, French fries, animal feed, farm use, tailgating, crafts, planting flowers, holding gift baskets, containing a fruit basket and herbs, loose item storage or as an ice bucket.

camelbak.name: hydration pack
camelbak.description: A slim and lightweight insulated plastic bladder worn on the back.  It has a large pocket and a capped mouth for filling with liquid with a hose that allows the wearer to drink hands-free.

can_drink.name: aluminum can
can_drink.description: An aluminum can, like what soda comes in.

can_drink_unsealed.name: opened aluminum can
can_drink_unsealed.description: An aluminum can, like what soda comes in.  This one is opened and can't be easily sealed.

carton_sealed.name: paper carton
carton_sealed.description: A half gallon carton constructed of a paper, aluminum and plastic laminate.  It has a threaded cap for easy resealing.

carton_unsealed.name: opened paper carton
carton_unsealed.description: A half gallon carton constructed of a paper, aluminum and plastic laminate.  This one is open and its contents will spoil.

plastic_bag_vac.name: vacuum-packed bag
plastic_bag_vac.description: This is a bag of vacuum-packed food.

can_food.name: small tin can
can_food.description: A small tin can, like what tuna comes in.

can_food_unsealed.name: small opened tin can
can_food_unsealed.description: A small tin can, like what tuna comes in.  This one is opened and can't be easily sealed.

can_medium.name: medium tin can
can_medium.description: A medium tin can, like what soup comes in.

can_medium_unsealed.name: medium opened tin can
can_medium_unsealed.description: A medium tin can, like what soup comes in.  This one is opened and can't be easily sealed.

canteen.name: plastic canteen
canteen.description: A military-style water canteen with a 1.5 liter capacity.  Commonly worn at the hip.

power_armor_canteen.name: power armor canteen
power_armor_canteen.description: A military-style water canteen with a 1.5 liter capacity.  Commonly worn at the hip, it's been converted to clip onto power armor.

thermos.name: thermos
thermos.description: A Thermos brand vacuum flask.  Built for temperature retention, helps keep things hot or cold.  Contains 1L of liquid.

clay_canister.name: clay canister
clay_canister.description: A fragile clay vessel.  It can be used to make crude impact grenades or to store liquid.

clay_hydria.name: clay hydria
clay_hydria.description: A 15-liter clay pot with three handles for carrying and for pouring.

clay_watercont.name: large clay pot
clay_watercont.description: A bulky and heavy clay pot with a waterproofed hide lid, meant to store water, but can carry other liquids in a pinch.

cup_plastic_unsealed.name: opened plastic cup
cup_plastic_unsealed.description: A small, vacuum formed cup, essentially trash.

flask_glass.name: glass flask
flask_glass.description: A 250 ml laboratory conical flask, with a rubber bung.

test_tube.name: test tube
test_tube.description: A 10ml laboratory cylindrical test tube, with a rubber stopper.

beaker.name: beaker
beaker.description: A 250ml laboratory beaker.  Basically a cup with delusions of grandeur.

gradcylinder.name: graduated cylinder
gradcylinder.description: A tall, narrow glass cylinder with precise markings for measuring fluid quantities.  An important science tool, it is also useful for anal retentive chefs.

test_tube_micro.name: microcentrifuge tube
test_tube_micro.description: These plastic tubes, with little built in snap-caps, are a great way to store a tiny amount of liquid.  Great for jello shooters if 1mL is enough for a shot for you.  Cool people call these "eppies".

flask_hip.name: hip flask
flask_hip.description: A 250 ml metal flask with a hinged screw-on lid, commonly used to discreetly transport alcohol.

jar_3l_glass.name: 3L glass jar
jar_3l_glass.description: A three-liter glass jar with a metal screw top lid, used for canning.

jar_3l_glass_sealed.name: sealed 3L glass jar
jar_3l_glass_sealed.description: A three-liter glass jar with a metal screw top lid, used for canning.  Sealed tightly to preserve contents from rot.

jar_glass.name: glass jar
jar_glass.description: A half-liter glass jar with a metal screw top lid, used for canning.

jar_glass_sealed.name: sealed glass jar
jar_glass_sealed.description: A half-liter glass jar with a metal screw top lid, used for canning.  Sealed tightly and will preserve the contents from rot (assuming it was sterile before sealing).

jerrycan.name: plastic jerrycan
jerrycan.description: A bulky plastic jerrycan, meant to carry fuel, but can carry other liquids in a pinch.

jerrycan_big.name: steel jerrycan
jerrycan_big.description: A steel jerrycan, meant to carry fuel, but can carry other liquids in a pinch.

jug_clay.name: clay jug
jug_clay.description: A clay container with a lid, used to hold and pour liquids.

jug_plastic.name: gallon jug
jug_plastic.description: A standard plastic jug used for milk and household cleaning chemicals.

bag_in_a_box.name: bag in a box
bag_in_a_box.description: A plastic, watertight bag stored inside of a cardboard box with a dispensing port.

keg.name: aluminum keg
keg.description: A reusable lightweight aluminum keg, used for shipping beer.  It has a capacity of 50 liters.

keg_steel.name: steel keg
keg_steel.description: A reusable heavy steel keg, used for shipping beer.  It has a capacity of 50 liters.

large_stomach_sealed.name: large sealed stomach
large_stomach_sealed.description: The stomach of a large creature, cleaned and sealed with strings.  It can hold 3 liters of water.

metal_tank.name: metal tank (60L)
metal_tank.description: A large metal tank for holding liquids.  Useful for crafting.

metal_tank_little.name: metal tank (2L)
metal_tank_little.description: A small metal tank for gas or liquids.  Useful for crafting.

canteen_wood.name: wooden canteen
canteen_wood.description: A water canteen made from wood, secured by metal bands and sealed with wax or pitch.  Holds 1.5 liters and has a simple carry strap.

stomach_sealed.name: sealed stomach
stomach_sealed.description: The stomach of a creature, cleaned and sealed with a string.  It can hold 1.5 liters of water.

waterskin.name: small waterskin
waterskin.description: A small watertight leather bag with a carrying strap, can hold 1.5 liters of water.

waterskin2.name: waterskin
waterskin2.description: A watertight leather bag with a carrying strap, can hold 3 liters of water.

waterskin3.name: large waterskin
waterskin3.description: A large watertight leather bag with a carrying strap, can hold 5 liters of water.

wooden_barrel.name: wooden barrel
wooden_barrel.description: Traditionally made of white oak; these vessels are known for delivering delicious whiskey to the future.  It has a capacity of 100 liters.

wooden_barrel_small.name: small wooden barrel
wooden_barrel_small.description: A wooden keg held together by copper bands, with a capacity of 20 liters.  Good for storing liquor, or more volatile substances, in a size easily transported by hand.

wrapper.name: paper wrapper
wrapper.description: Just a piece of butcher's paper.  Good for starting fires.

styrofoam_cup.name: styrofoam cup
styrofoam_cup.description: A cheap, disposable cup with a plastic lid and straw.

plastic_bucket.name: plastic tub
plastic_bucket.description: A big, square plastic bucket usually used for carrying ice cream.

condom.name: condom
condom.description: A gentleman's balloon.  A single use life preventer.  A thumbless latex mitten.  This could be used as a makeshift water container, but otherwise it's anyone's guess what it's for.

balloon.name: balloon
balloon.description: A child's balloon.  This could be used as a makeshift water container.

can_food_big.name: large tin can
can_food_big.description: A large tin can, like what beans come in.  Holds a substantial amount of food.

can_food_big_unsealed.name: large opened tin can
can_food_big_unsealed.description: A large tin can, like what beans come in.  This one is opened and can't be easily sealed.

survival_kit_box.name: survival kit box
survival_kit_box.description: An aluminum box that used to contain a small survival kit.  Can hold 1 liter of liquid.

hazardous_waste_drum.name: hazardous waste drum
hazardous_waste_drum.description: A yellow drum meant for the storage of hazardous substances.

trash_can_empty.name: plastic trash can
trash_can_empty.description: A small plastic wastebasket for offices and kitchens.  Could be repurposed as an open-top container if you're desperate, or placed back down.

dehydrator_tray.name: dehydrator tray
dehydrator_tray.description: A flat metal tray for dehydrating meat. Intended for use in a dehydrator in stacks.

bowl_plastic.name: plastic bowl
bowl_plastic.description: A plastic bowl with a convenient sealing lid.  Holds 750 ml of liquid.

bottle_metal.name: steel bottle
bottle_metal.description: A stainless steel water bottle, holds 750ml of liquid.

bottle_folding.name: foldable plastic bottle
bottle_folding.description: A non-rigid plastic bottle for easy storage, holds 500 ml of liquid.

vacutainer.name: blood draw kit
vacutainer.description: This is a kit for drawing blood, including a test tube for holding the sample.  Use this tool to draw blood, either from yourself or from a corpse you are standing on.

fridgetank.name: refrigerated tank
fridgetank.description: A 60L refrigerated tank for keeping liquids cool.  Provides some insulation from outside weather.

arrowrest.name: arrow rest
arrowrest.description: A small extension above the grip which an arrow rests upon while being aimed.  Improves accuracy with no drawbacks.

bow_stabilizer.name: bow stabilizer
bow_stabilizer.description: A counterweight placed forward of the bow's grip allows for greater accuracy.  Aside from increased weight and size, there are no drawbacks.

bow_stabilizer_set.name: bow stabilizer system
bow_stabilizer_set.description: A set of three stabilizing, dampened rods with a spring-loaded bracket to mount on modern bows.  Takes extra time to set up when wielding, but doesn't take much extra space.

bow_silencer.name: bow dampening kit
bow_silencer.description: A set of simple pads and strips of fur or rubber with adhesive backing, designed to stick on the limbs and string of a bow to absorb vibrations.  This substantially reduces noise during firing and can help with accuracy.

crossbow_lever.name: crossbow spanning lever
crossbow_lever.description: A medieval-style "goat's foot" lever, that hooks onto medium-sized crossbows to assist with drawing them.  Makes reloading easier, but takes a bit longer to set up when wielding.

crossbow_draw_assist.name: crossbow draw motor
crossbow_draw_assist.description: An electric motor and transmission that can be attached to a crossbow's string to make it easier to draw back. It makes reloading faster, but requires UPS power and makes the crossbow bulkier and heavier. Who said crossbows needed to be medieval?

belt_clip.name: belt clip
belt_clip.description: This is a belt clip that attaches to the grip or slide of a pistol so as to facilitate 'Mexican carry', the practice of carrying without a holster.  It does not offer any protection for the trigger, so users are strongly advised to carry with the chamber empty or select a firearm with a very heavy trigger pull.

barrel_small.name: shortened barrel
barrel_small.description: A shortened barrel results in markedly reduced accuracy, and a minor increase in noise, but also greatly improves the ease with which the weapon can be carried and wielded.

upstest.name: upstest
upstest.description: Testmod for UPS drain on mods, this should never spawn, if you see this, it's a bug.  50x more UPS drain.

accelerator_gunmod.name: makeshift rifle accelerator
accelerator_gunmod.description: Advents in power transfer technology has resulted in coilguns becoming much more viable.  Makeshift coilgun conversions like this one were a rare but known sight in the riots before the Cataclysm, and it may help you survive it.  This particular attachment is designed for long-barreled guns.

accelerator_pistol_gunmod.name: makeshift pistol accelerator
accelerator_pistol_gunmod.description: Advents in power transfer technology has resulted in coilguns becoming much more viable.  Makeshift coilgun conversions like this one were a rare but known sight in the riots before the Cataclysm, and it may help you survive it.  This particular attachment is designed for short-barreled guns.

aux_flamer.name: aux flamethrower
aux_flamer.description: This custom-built miniature flamethrower is made to be attached to most firearms, greatly expanding its lethality.

barrel_takedown_kit.name: barrel takedown kit
barrel_takedown_kit.description: A takedown barrel assembly that allows the barrel to be folded or detached for compact storage.  Reduces the weapon's volume when stowed but the hinged mechanism is less rigid than a fixed barrel, impacting handling.  Must be unfolded before firing.

bio_powershot.name: Power shot
bio_powershot.description: This is a pseudo item -- the builtin part of a fusion blaster for the maximum power firing mode.

brass_catcher.name: brass catcher
brass_catcher.description: A bag that hangs off the side of your gun and catches ejected casings so you don't have to pick them up.

retool_ar15_300blk.name: .300 AAC Blackout AR-15 conversion kit
retool_ar15_300blk.description: A complete AR-15 upper assembly with a .300 AAC Blackout barrel.

retool_ump45_40.name: .40 S&W UMP conversion kit
retool_ump45_40.description: A bolt and barrel assembly to convert the UMP to fire .40 S&W.

retool_ump45_9mm.name: 9x19mm UMP conversion kit
retool_ump45_9mm.description: A bolt and barrel assembly to convert the UMP to fire 9x19mm.

40x53mm_conversion_kit.name: 40x53mm grenade launcher conversion kit
40x53mm_conversion_kit.description: Given the varied total length of different 40x46mm loads, many launchers can TECHNICALLY fit 40x53mm high-pressure rounds.  This set of reinforcement parts allows doing so without it blowing up in your face.

retool_mcx_223.name: 5.56x45mm SIG MCX conversion kit
retool_mcx_223.description: A conversion kit to convert the SIG MCX to fire 5.56x45mm.

retool_mcx_762.name: 7.62x39mm SIG MCX conversion kit
retool_mcx_762.description: A conversion kit to convert the SIG MCX to fire 7.62x39mm.

retool_pipe_22.name: .22 LR pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_22.description: A replacement barrel and chamber assembly for a pipe gun, bored out to fire .22 LR cartridges.

retool_pipe_38.name: .38 Special pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_38.description: A replacement barrel and chamber assembly for a pipe gun, bored out to fire .38 Special cartridges.

retool_pipe_40.name: .40 S&W pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_40.description: A replacement barrel and chamber assembly for a pipe gun, chambered for the .40 S&W cartridge.

retool_pipe_44.name: .44 Magnum pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_44.description: A reinforced replacement barrel and chamber assembly for a pipe gun, allowing it to fire the powerful .44 Magnum cartridge.

retool_pipe_45.name: .45 ACP pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_45.description: A replacement barrel and chamber assembly for a pipe gun, chambered for .45 ACP cartridges.

retool_pipe_9mm.name: 9x19mm pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_9mm.description: A replacement barrel and chamber assembly for a pipe gun, chambered for 9x19mm Parabellum cartridges.

retool_pipe_223.name: 5.56x45mm pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_223.description: A heavy-barreled replacement assembly for a pipe gun, chambered for the high-pressure 5.56x45mm cartridge.  The longer barrel and reinforced action make the weapon noticeably heavier.

retool_pipe_3006.name: .30-06 pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_3006.description: A heavy, full-length barrel and reinforced action assembly for a pipe gun, chambered for the powerful .30-06 Springfield cartridge.  The long barrel and strengthened receiver make the weapon considerably heavier.

retool_pipe_308.name: 7.62x51mm pipe gun conversion kit
retool_pipe_308.description: A heavy, full-length barrel and reinforced action assembly for a pipe gun, chambered for the powerful 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge.  Even with reinforcement, the high pressures produced by this round take a heavy toll on the improvised action.

retool_hc_223.name: 5.56x45mm handmade carbine conversion kit
retool_hc_223.description: A replacement barrel and receiver assembly for a handmade carbine, converting it to fire 5.56x45mm NATO .223 rounds.  The action is adapted to accept the smaller cartridge and standard STANAG magazines.

retool_hc_308.name: 7.62x51mm handmade carbine conversion kit
retool_hc_308.description: A replacement barrel and receiver assembly for a handmade carbine, converting it to fire 7.62x51mm .308 rounds and accept G3 detachable box magazines.

retool_luty_40.name: .40 S&W Luty SMG conversion kit
retool_luty_40.description: A replacement bolt and barrel assembly for a Luty SMG, converting it to fire .40 S&W cartridges and accept custom-made makeshift magazines.

retool_luty_45.name: .45 ACP Luty SMG conversion kit
retool_luty_45.description: A replacement bolt and barrel assembly for a Luty SMG, converting it to fire .45 ACP cartridges and accept MAC-10 compatible magazines.

retool_hmr_40.name: .40 S&W handmade revolver conversion kit
retool_hmr_40.description: A replacement barrel and cylinder assembly for a handmade revolver, converting it to fire .40 S&W cartridges.

retool_hmr_44.name: .44 Magnum handmade revolver conversion kit
retool_hmr_44.description: A reinforced replacement barrel and cylinder assembly for a handmade revolver, converting it to fire .44 Magnum cartridges.

retool_hmr_45.name: .45 ACP handmade revolver conversion kit
retool_hmr_45.description: A replacement barrel and cylinder assembly for a handmade revolver, converting it to fire .45 ACP cartridges.

retool_hmr_9mm.name: 9x19mm handmade revolver conversion kit
retool_hmr_9mm.description: A replacement barrel and cylinder assembly for a handmade revolver, converting it to fire 9x19mm Parabellum cartridges.

retool_pipe_410.name: .410 pipe shotgun conversion kit
retool_pipe_410.description: A replacement barrel and chamber assembly for a pipe shotgun, bored out to fire .410 shells.

fluted_grip.name: fluted large grip
fluted_grip.description: Ring-like patterns made of rubber grooved into the thick handle of a greatbow. Helps maintain a stable grip and dampen vibrations with no downsides. Irremovable, as the grip of the bow must be carved in to install.

light_grip.name: lightweight replacement furniture
light_grip.description: A set of lightweight composite grips and furniture that reduces a firearm's weight, and as a consequence, its handling and melee damage.

pistol_grip.name: ergonomic grip
pistol_grip.description: A set of ergonomic replacement furniture for a firearm improving handling.

breacher_grip.name: breacher grip
breacher_grip.description: A very uncomfortable straight grip.  Designed to absorb recoil while blasting open obstacles, at the expense of accuracy.

carbon_grip.name: carbon fiber furniture
carbon_grip.description: A set of carbon fiber replacement grips and furniture, 3D-printed for maximum weight savings.  Significantly lighter than polymer furniture at the cost of reduced handling and melee effectiveness.

beam_scatterer.name: beam scatterer
beam_scatterer.description: A set of optics made to fit on laser weapons, which will diffract the laser beam into several lower powered beams.  This increases point-blank damage, but greatly reduces range.

focusing_lens.name: focusing lens
focusing_lens.description: A set of optics to concentrate the laser beam on a smaller focus point.  This increases range and damage output, but complicates targeting.

electrolaser_conversion.name: electrolaser conversion
electrolaser_conversion.description: A set of high-tech electronics and optics.  These converts a laser weapon into a less-lethal electrolaser capable of stunning targets, at the cost of a decreased damage output and increased power consumption.

effective_emitter.name: effective emitter
effective_emitter.description: A set of electronics to optimize emitter workcycle and increase overall energy efficiency.  Decreases power consumption.

high_density_capacitor.name: high density capacitor
high_density_capacitor.description: A capacitor with a higher energy density increases range and damage; at the cost of a markedly increased power consumption.

arredondo_chute.name: speedloader chute
arredondo_chute.description: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.

match_trigger.name: match trigger
match_trigger.description: A precision weighted trigger assembly that improves a firearm's accuracy.

dias.name: drop-in auto sear
dias.description: This is a vaguely 'U' shaped piece of metal with a vaguely 'T' shaped flapper on a pin.  Once tucked into an AR-15's lower receiver, the rifle will become selective fire-capable.  The handcrafted-sear surface isn't as good as actual full-auto parts, so precision suffers slightly.

llink.name: lightning link
llink.description: Originally designed for the Colt SP-1, this 'reproduction' is intended to convert an AR-15 into a full-auto only rifle.  Once the necessary modifications are made and the link is in place, semi-auto is disabled and full-auto is enabled.  Reliability and precision suffer greatly due to questionable craftsmanship and lack of unobtainium SP-1 parts.

universal_autolink.name: universal auto link
universal_autolink.description: A crude, adjustable link and modified disconnector intended to defeat a rifle's semi-auto fire control group.  When carefully fitted, it turns many semiautomatic rifles into full-auto only, at the cost of reliability and accuracy.

universal_auto_conversion_kit.name: universal automatic conversion kit
universal_auto_conversion_kit.description: A collection of oversized, semi-finished fire-control parts, gauges, and springs meant to be hand-fitted to a wide range of semiautomatic rifles.  When successfully installed it provides burst and full-auto fire, but the compromises required for a one-size-fits-many kit reduce precision.

glockswitch.name: glock switch
glockswitch.description: Patented in 1998 the Glock auto-sear or switch as it is called was illegal due to being able to turn Glock firearms full auto by applying force to a Glock's trigger bar.  The switch allows for selective fire modes, a single shot or when flipped, a three round burst, or six round full auto fire.

waterproof_gunmod.name: firearm waterproofing
waterproof_gunmod.description: A set of seals and gaskets that will allow a firearm to operate reliably while submerged in water.

g36_stanag_adapter.name: G36 STANAG adapter
g36_stanag_adapter.description: A custom magwell which is installed into the lower receiver of a G36 to enable the use of most STANAG magazines save for the largest ones.

aug_nato_conversion.name: AUG NATO conversion kit
aug_nato_conversion.description: A STANAG sized magwell and a modified trigger group to facilitate the use of STANAG magazines on an AUG rifle.  Most versions of the rifle come with this out of the factory as the A3 variant but it's quite simple to convert the older variants.  Fits all but the largest STANAG magazines.

xbow_string.name: steel prod
xbow_string.description: A forged steel bowlimb reinforcement designed for crossbows.  Its increased draw strength makes the bolts fly farther and faster, but it makes reloading more difficult.

mod_air_pump.name: powered air pump
mod_air_pump.description: A motor that attaches to a pneumatic weapon's hand pump, converting it into an electric compressor.  It makes reloading significantly faster, at the cost of requiring UPS power to function.

mod_makeshift_capacitor.name: handmade coil capacitor
mod_makeshift_capacitor.description: This particular modification is a handmade, but by no means crude, capacitor bank designed to increase transferrance efficiency as well as utilizing an atomic battery to reduce, but not eliminate, the power draw.  It was even rarer to see than the makeshift railgun weapons and firearm conversions during the protests before the Cataclysm, if only because of the sheer rarity of particular materials.  It unfortunately cannot effect makeshift accelerators thanks to them lacking the proper internal components.

autofire.name: auto-fire mechanism
autofire.description: A simple mechanism that converts a pistol to a selective fire weapon with a burst size of three rounds.  However it reduces accuracy and increases noise.

beltfeed.name: belt feed adapter
beltfeed.description: A kit providing the necessary parts for permanently converting a firearm from magazine to belt-feed.  Guaranteed to void your warranty.

tuned_mechanism.name: tuned mechanism
tuned_mechanism.description: A set of finely tuned internal components which increase the precision and reliably of a firearm.

hc_bar_mag_adapter.name: homemade carbine BAR magazine adapter
hc_bar_mag_adapter.description: A modified magwell that allows a handmade carbine chambered in .30-06 to accept Browning Automatic Rifle detachable box magazines.  The adapter replaces the internal floorplate and catch assembly.

carbon_receiver.name: carbon fiber upper receiver
carbon_receiver.description: A 3D-printed carbon fiber replacement upper receiver for AR-15 pattern rifles.  Significantly lighter than the original aluminum receiver with no impact on accuracy or reliability.

barrel_ported.name: ported barrel
barrel_ported.description: A ported barrel redirects exhaust gases to compensate for muzzle climb, improves recoil but increases noise and reduces accuracy slightly.

muzzle_brake.name: muzzle brake
muzzle_brake.description: A muzzle brake redirects exhaust gases to compensate for muzzle climb, improving recoil but increasing bulk and noise.

muzzle_brake_mod.name: modified muzzle brake
muzzle_brake_mod.description: A muzzle brake redirects exhaust gases to compensate for muzzle climb, improving recoil but increasing bulk, noise, and reducing accuracy slightly.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any firearm other than launchers, if you so want.

crafted_suppressor.name: homemade suppressor
crafted_suppressor.description: A homemade suppressor made from a pipe and improvised wipe media.  For as long as the wipes hold up, it will reduce the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm by a decent amount, and a bit more with subsonic ammunition.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels, as well as slightly reducing recoil.  This simple suppressor is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.

filter_suppressor.name: 'solvent trap' suppressor
filter_suppressor.description: This is an automotive filter crudely adapted to mate up with a firearm's barrel, generating an illegal, unregistered suppressor that somewhat reduces noise.  Good thing there don't seem to be any ATF agents around to arrest you.  While close in design to a real suppressor, it was not designed for high pressures involved and will eventually lose effectiveness.  The installed filter is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun. Works better with subsonic ammunition

bottle_suppressor.name: soda bottle silencer
bottle_suppressor.description: This is a 'silencer' made from a 2 liter soda bottle, some smaller bottles for baffles, and a generous length of duct tape.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection and you can be certain that this will not save your ears whatsoever.  What it might do is allow you to get a shot or two off with a slightly quieter report.  This simple suppressor is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun. Works better with subsonic ammunition

riv_suppressor.name: RK6S34 suppressor
riv_suppressor.description: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  This RK6S34 Mustela is a rather advanced version integral to the RM11B rifle system.

shot_suppressor.name: shotgun suppressor
shot_suppressor.description: A large suppressor designed to work with shotguns.  It works better with subsonic ammunition.  It's a lot more complex than a suppressor for a pistol or rifle, but works almost as well.

shot_crafted_suppressor.name: homemade shotgun suppressor
shot_crafted_suppressor.description: A large homemade suppressor designed for shotguns.  More complex than normal makeshift suppressors, its improvised baffles will deteriorate with use.  It works better with subsonic ammunition.  When attached, it will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun, but it reduces noise almost as much as an industrially-produced version.

suppressor.name: suppressor
suppressor.description: A suppressor considerably reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  It works better with subsonic ammunition.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels.

mp5sd_suppressor.name: MP5SD integral suppressor
mp5sd_suppressor.description: This is the integrated suppressor for the H&K MP5SD.  Its large expansion chamber decelerates ammunition via several ports in the barrel, rendering most ammo subsonic at the cost of terminal performance.  It is very effective.

suppressor_compact.name: compact suppressor
suppressor_compact.description: A compact suppressor designed for pistols and best used with smaller calibers, as it reduces noise slightly less than standard silencers.  It works better with subsonic ammunition.

mod_flamethrower_nozzle.name: high-pressure combustion nozzle
mod_flamethrower_nozzle.description: An attachment resembling a rocket nozzle along with parts from a pump assembly.  Installing this on a flamethrower will increase its maximum range and damage, but increase fuel consumption.

gun_crossbow.name: rail-mounted crossbow
gun_crossbow.description: A kit to attach a pair of crossbow arms and a firing rail to the barrel of a long firearm.  It allows crossbow bolts to be fired.

gun_crossbow_mod.name: modified rail-mounted crossbow
gun_crossbow_mod.description: A kit to attach a pair of crossbow arms and a firing rail to the barrel of a long firearm.  It allows crossbow bolts to be fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and SMGs, if you so want.

offset_sights.name: offset iron sights
offset_sights.description: An alternative set of iron sights mounted at 45° for use when a scope or other modification prevents use of the primary sights.

offset_sights_mod.name: modified offset iron sights
offset_sights_mod.description: An alternative set of iron sights mounted at 45° for use when a scope or other modification prevents use of the primary sights.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon, if you so want.

offset_sight_rail.name: offset sight rail
offset_sight_rail.description: An additional rail set at 45° for attaching a secondary optic.

offset_sight_rail_mod.name: modified offset sight rail
offset_sight_rail_mod.description: An additional rail set at 45° for attaching a secondary optic.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon, if you so want.

rail_laser_sight.name: rail laser sight
rail_laser_sight.description: A small visible-light laser that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.

stabilizer.name: gyroscopic stabilizer
stabilizer.description: An advanced unit that straps onto the side of your firearm and reduces vibration, greatly reducing recoil and slightly increasing accuracy.

stabilizer_mod.name: modified gyroscopic stabilizer
stabilizer_mod.description: An advanced unit that straps onto the side of your firearm and reduces vibration, greatly reducing recoil and slightly increasing accuracy.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

bow_sight.name: five pin bow sight
bow_sight.description: A set of adjustable optic fiber aiming pins with a bracket to mount on modern bows.  Improves accuracy substantially, but takes a bit longer to line up.

bow_sight_pin.name: single pin bow sight
bow_sight_pin.description: A single aluminum pin with a bracket to mount on modern bows.  Quick to use, but not very accurate.

bow_scope.name: bow scope
bow_scope.description: A single magnifying scope mounted on an adjustable bracket, with accompanying clarifier peep sight.  Designed for extra long shots, but easily adjusted for short range.  Spectacularly accurate.

holo_sight.name: holographic sight
holo_sight.description: Used extensively by military forces, it increases accuracy and weight.  This is a step up from a red dot sight.

hybrid_sight.name: hybrid holographic sight
hybrid_sight.description: Used extensively by military forces, it increases accuracy and weight.  This sight combines a holographic sight with a toggleable 3x magnifier, allowing effective usage at short and medium range.

improve_sights.name: iron sights
improve_sights.description: A basic set of removable iron sights, suitable as a backup if a gun doesn't come with its own optics.

pistol_scope.name: pistol scope
pistol_scope.description: A small scope intended for use on a handgun.  Increases weight but improves accuracy greatly.

red_dot_sight.name: red dot sight
red_dot_sight.description: Adds a red dot optic to the top of your gun, replacing the iron sights.  Provides a balance of improved accuracy and faster target acquisition.

rifle_scope.name: sniper scope
rifle_scope.description: A 3-18x44 rifle scope.  It is adjustable for windage and elevation in 1/10th mrad increments and is remarkably small and light for its magnification.

rifle_scope_mod.name: modified sniper scope
rifle_scope_mod.description: A 3-18x44 rifle scope.  It is adjustable for windage and elevation in 1/10th mrad increments and is remarkably small and light for its magnification.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and SMGs, if you so want.

acog_scope.name: ACOG scope
acog_scope.description: A 4x32 TA01 Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight with a tritium illuminated crosshair.

acog_scope_mod.name: modified ACOG scope
acog_scope_mod.description: A 4x32 TA01 Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight with a tritium illuminated crosshair.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

riv_scope.name: RS1219 scope
riv_scope.description: An integral component of the RM11B rifle system, the RS1219 Accipiter digital scope provides auto-adjusting focal length, a user-selectable reticle, and an offset reflex sight for close objectives.

tele_sight.name: telescopic sight
tele_sight.description: A simple hand-crafted telescopic sight, essentially a small telescope with crosshairs.  Not as good as the ones made before the Cataclysm.  Increases weight but improves accuracy.

tele_sight_pistol.name: telescopic pistol sight
tele_sight_pistol.description: A simple telescopic sight intended for use on a handgun.  Increases weight but improves accuracy greatly.

shoulder_strap.name: shoulder strap
shoulder_strap.description: A shoulder strap allows the rifle to be worn over your shoulders like a piece of clothing.  However, it offers no protection.

pistol_lanyard.name: pistol lanyard
pistol_lanyard.description: A pistol lanyard allows the attached gun to hang freely off your belt, so you won't lose it in case it's not in a holster.  However, it offers no protection.

adjustable_stock.name: adjustable stock
adjustable_stock.description: An adjustable replacement stock improving both recoil and accuracy.

folding_stock.name: folding stock
folding_stock.description: A folding stock which reduces volume but needs unfolding before use.  Increases the time needed to wield the weapon.

wire_stock.name: folding wire stock
wire_stock.description: A folding wire stock which folds up very compactly but needs unfolding before use.  It's somewhat wobbly but is better than nothing at all.  Increases the time needed to wield the weapon.

pistol_stock.name: pistol stock
pistol_stock.description: An add-on stock for handguns considerably improving control of recoil.

recoil_stock.name: recoil stock
recoil_stock.description: A replacement stock designed to absorb perceived recoil.

cheek_pad.name: cheek pad
cheek_pad.description: A stock accessory for sniper rifles and even DMRs considerably improving eye relief efficiency, prevents slipping, and reduces recoil to the neck and cheek.

stock_small.name: shortened stock
stock_small.description: Removing the stock results in markedly reduced accuracy and recoil handling, but also greatly improves the ease with which the weapon can be carried and wielded.

carbon_stock.name: carbon fiber stock
carbon_stock.description: A 3D-printed carbon fiber replacement stock.  Lighter than polymer or wood stocks with a minor handling penalty due to reduced mass in the rear of the weapon.

bipod.name: bipod
bipod.description: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they noticably improve handling and precision they are slow to equip and usable only on certain mountable surfaces such as window frames and mounds of dirt.

bipod_mod.name: modified bipod
bipod_mod.description: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they noticably improve handling and precision they are slow to equip and usable only on certain mountable surfaces such as window frames and mounds of dirt.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon, if you so want.

combination_gun_shotgun.name: combination gun shotgun
combination_gun_shotgun.description: The integrated underbarrel shotgun of a combination gun which holds two shots.  It's irremovable.

combination_gun_shotgun_pipe.name: pipe combination gun shotgun
combination_gun_shotgun_pipe.description: The integrated underbarrel shotgun of a pipe combination gun which holds two shots.  It's irremovable.

grip.name: forward grip
grip.description: A grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.

grip_mod.name: modified forward grip
grip_mod.description: A grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon, if you so want.

inter_bayonet.name: integrated bayonet
inter_bayonet.description: This is the bayonet integrated in the firearm.

ksg_aux_shotgun.name: KSG second magazine
ksg_aux_shotgun.description: The integrated second shotgun magazine of the Kel-Tec KSG which holds 7 shots.  It's irremovable.

ksg25_aux_shotgun.name: KSG-25 second magazine
ksg25_aux_shotgun.description: The integrated second shotgun magazine of the Kel-Tec KSG-25 which holds 12 shots.  It's irremovable.

dp12_aux_shotgun.name: DP-12 second magazine
dp12_aux_shotgun.description: The integrated second shotgun magazine of the DP-12 which holds 7 shots.  It's irremovable.

ts12_aux_shotgun.name: TS12 second magazine
ts12_aux_shotgun.description: The integrated second shotgun magazine of the Tavor TS12 which holds 5 shots.  It's irremovable.

ts12_aux_shotgun2.name: TS12 third magazine
ts12_aux_shotgun2.description: The integrated third shotgun magazine of the Tavor TS12 which holds 5 shots.  It's irremovable.

laser_sight.name: underbarrel laser sight
laser_sight.description: A visible-light laser that mounts under a firearm's barrel to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.

lemat_revolver_shotgun.name: LeMat revolver shotgun
lemat_revolver_shotgun.description: The Lemat revolver is unique in that its cylinder axis pin is also a fully functional 20ga percussion-primed smoothbore barrel.  It's irremovable.

m203.name: M203
m203.description: The M203 was originally designed for use with M16 variants but today can be attached to almost any rifle.  It allows a single 40mm grenade to be loaded and fired.

m203_mod.name: modified M203
m203_mod.description: The M203 was originally designed for use with M16 variants but today can be attached to almost any rifle.  It allows a single 40mm grenade to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.

m320_mod.name: M320 GLM
m320_mod.description: The M320 Grenade Launcher Module offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  It can be either attached to a rifle or combined with a buttstock for standalone use.

m320_mod_mod.name: modified M320 GLM
m320_mod_mod.description: The M320 Grenade Launcher Module offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  It can be either attached to a rifle or combined with a buttstock for standalone use.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.

M6_shotgun.name: M6 Aircrew Survival Weapon shotgun
M6_shotgun.description: The integrated .410 shotgun barrel of the M6 Aircrew Survival Weapon.  It's irremovable.

masterkey.name: masterkey shotgun
masterkey.description: A minimalist pump action shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows a total of four shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.

masterkey_mod.name: modified masterkey shotgun
masterkey_mod.description: A minimalist pump action shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows a total of four shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.

pipe_launcher40mm.name: 40mm pipe launcher
pipe_launcher40mm.description: This is a home built launcher tube that can be attached to almost any weapon except handguns.  It allows a single 40mm grenade to be loaded and fired.

pistol_bayonet.name: pistol bayonet
pistol_bayonet.description: A pistol bayonet is a stabbing weapon that can be attached to the front of a handgun, allowing a melee attack to deal piercing damage.

rm121aux.name: RM121 aux shotgun
rm121aux.description: The Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.

rm121aux_mod.name: modified RM121 aux shotgun
rm121aux_mod.description: The Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

u_shotgun.name: underslung shotgun
u_shotgun.description: A short shotgun with 2 barrels, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows two shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.

u_shotgun_mod.name: modified underslung shotgun
u_shotgun_mod.description: A short shotgun with 2 barrels, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows two shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

barrel_big.name: barrel extension
barrel_big.description: A longer barrel increases the muzzle velocity of a firearm, contributing to both accuracy and damage but reduces portability and slows aiming.

barrel_rifled.name: rifled barrel
barrel_rifled.description: Rifling a shotgun barrel is mainly done in order to improve its accuracy when firing slugs.  The rifling makes the gun less suitable for shot, however.

blowback.name: rapid blowback
blowback.description: An improved blowback mechanism makes your firearm's automatic fire faster, at the cost of reduced accuracy and increased noise.

retool_22.name: .22 caliber conversion kit
retool_22.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9x19mm, .38, .40, 5.7mm, 4.6mm, 7.62x39mm or .223 firearm converts it to a .22 firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

retool_308.name: 7.62x51mm caliber conversion kit
retool_308.description: This kit is used to convert a shotgun or 7.62x39mm, .223 or .30-06 rifle to the popular and powerful 7.62x51mm caliber.  The conversion results in reduced ammo capacity and a slight reduction to accuracy.

retool_45.name: .45 caliber conversion kit
retool_45.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9x19mm, .38, .40 or .44 firearm converts it to a .45 firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

retool_9mm.name: 9x19mm caliber conversion kit
retool_9mm.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9x18mm, .38, .40, .44 or .45 firearm converts it to a 9x19mm firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

grip_mount.name: replaceable furniture kit
grip_mount.description: This is a kit consisting of various steel and plastic parts; when installed, it would permanently modify and partially replace some of the weapon's furniture so that it could be easily changed if needed.  This allows installing any kind of more advanced grips or other furniture.

rail_mount.name: side mount
rail_mount.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching a rail accessory, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

sights_mount.name: sights mount
sights_mount.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon other than launchers and pistols, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

sights_mount_launcher.name: launcher sights mount
sights_mount_launcher.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any launcher, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on rocket launchers.

sights_mount_pistol.name: pistol sights mount
sights_mount_pistol.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any pistol, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on pocket pistols.

stock_mount.name: replaceable stock kit
stock_mount.description: This is a kit consisting of various steel parts; when installed, it would remove the weapon's original fixed stock, install a new stock mount on its place, modify original stock to fit it and then reattach it to the gun, or simply attach a stock mount if gun had no stock to start with.  This allows easy installation of any kind of more advanced stocks.

underbarrel_mount.name: bottom mount
underbarrel_mount.description: This is a plastic mount for attaching an underbarrel accessory, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

battery_ups.name: UPS conversion mod
battery_ups.description: This device replaces conventional battery connections with a connector port that can plug into a UPS.  Any device modified with this can be used without a battery as long as you have a charged UPS with you.

battery_ups_toggle.name: UPS battery conversion mod
battery_ups_toggle.description: This device extends the conventional battery connections with a connector port that can plug into a UPS.  Any device modified with this can toggle whether to charge its battery from UPS power.

magazine_battery_mod.name: battery compartment mod
magazine_battery_mod.description: A battery compartment mod that allows using vehicle and storage batteries in regular tools, up to the size of a large storage battery, as unwieldy as that may be.

magazine_battery_light_mod.name: light battery mod
magazine_battery_light_mod.description: A battery compartment mod that allows the use of light batteries in tools that otherwise could not.

magazine_battery_medium_mod.name: medium battery mod
magazine_battery_medium_mod.description: A battery compartment mod that allows the use of medium batteries in tools that otherwise could not.

magazine_battery_heavy_mod.name: heavy battery mod
magazine_battery_heavy_mod.description: A battery compartment mod that allows the use of heavy batteries in tools that otherwise could not.

double_plutonium_core.name: reactor core expansion device
double_plutonium_core.description: This is an expansion device for use on plutonium-powered equipment.  With enough electronics skill, you could attach this to an atomic tool to double the amount of plutonium it can hold.  Note that this device is incompatible with the atomic battery mod.

yoke_harness.name: yoke and harness
yoke_harness.description: A bar and harness to attach a creature to a wheeled vehicle, they then should be able to pull it.

hovercraft_section.name: hovercraft impeller
hovercraft_section.description: An impeller and skirt used by air-cushion-vehicles to float just above the surface of land or water.

hover_repulsor.name: hover repulsor
hover_repulsor.description: This is an experimental hover repulsor module mounted on the underside of a vehicle.  It allows the vehicle to glide and fly over rough terrain and obstacles.  Though originally thought to be frictionless, unknown antigrav phenomena nonetheless causes vehicles to experience a force similar to friction when near the ground.

wheel_slick.name: racing wheel
wheel_slick.description: A wide, smooth wheel intended for racing.  The slick surface provides better speed on pavement but penalizes off-road speed.

wheel_armor.name: armored wheel
wheel_armor.description: A wide military grade wheel.  Performs well off-road.

wheel_barrow.name: wheelbarrow wheel
wheel_barrow.description: A small wheel from a common garden wheelbarrow.

wheel_bicycle_or.name: off-road bicycle wheel
wheel_bicycle_or.description: A wide, studded, bicycle wheel intended for off-road biking.

wheel_caster.name: set of casters
wheel_caster.description: A set of casters, like on a shopping cart.

wheel_10.name: set of wheels
wheel_10.description: A set of four small wheels with tough rubber tires.

wheel_rail.name: rail wheel
wheel_rail.description: A strong rail wheel.  A flange helps keep it on a rail, but makes it perform terribly when not on a rail.

wheel_rail_small_pair.name: pair of small rail wheels
wheel_rail_small_pair.description: A pair of small rail wheels.  It fits small railroad rails found in places like amusement parks.  Mostly for hobby purposes rather than transportation.

wheel_motorbike_or.name: off-road motorbike wheel
wheel_motorbike_or.description: A motorbike wheel, studded for improved off-road performance.

hd_steel_drum.name: large steel drum
hd_steel_drum.description: A large cylinder fashioned out of thick plates of hardened steel, that is normally found on road rollers.  Numerous massive spokes, attached to a central axis, reinforce its structure even further, making it an unstoppable force once it starts rolling.

wheel_small.name: small wheel
wheel_small.description: A pretty small wheel.  Probably from one of those Segway things.  It is not very menacing.

wheel_tricycle.name: set of tricycle wheels
wheel_tricycle.description: A set of hard plastic wheels with one larger than the other two.  Proudly made in the USA by Double Dango Productions.

wheel_wheelchair.name: pair of wheelchair wheels
wheel_wheelchair.description: A pair of wheels for a wheelchair.

wheel_wide_or.name: off-road wide wheel
wheel_wide_or.description: A wide wheel.  \o/ This wide.  It's studded to provide better grip off-road at the cost of some performance on pavement.

wheel_wood.name: wooden cart wheel
wheel_wood.description: A wooden cart wheel, hand made.

wheel_wood_b.name: banded wooden cart wheel
wheel_wood_b.description: A wooden cart wheel with metal bands for durability, hand made.

makeshift_sled_runners_item.name: sled runners
makeshift_sled_runners_item.description: Simple wooden runners for a hand-pulled sled.  They make it easier to drag a cart across rough terrain, but that's about all they do.

tread1.name: rubber caterpillar track
tread1.description: A short, interlocking set of hard rubber tracks reinforced by stiff wire held in place by a set of smaller wheels.  Similar with what you might see used on light construction vehicles.  It's significantly stronger than regular tires due to not being at risk of bursting; but is quite heavy.

tread2.name: steel caterpillar track
tread2.description: A short, interlocking set of shaped steel tracks held in place by a set of smaller wheels.  Similar with what you might see used on large construction vehicles.  It's significantly stronger than regular tires due to not being at risk of bursting; but is very heavy.

tread3.name: reinforced caterpillar track
tread3.description: A short, interlocking set of shaped steel tracks held in place by a set of smaller wheels.  Similar with what you might see used on APCs and armored vehicles.  It's significantly stronger than regular tires due to not being at risk of bursting; but is extremely heavy.

1cyl_combustion_large.name: large 1-cylinder engine
1cyl_combustion_large.description: A powerful high-compression single-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine.

i4_combustion.name: Inline-4 engine
i4_combustion.description: A small, yet powerful 4-cylinder combustion engine.

v8_combustion.description: A large and very powerful 8-cylinder combustion engine.

use_action.training_msg: You examine the V6 engine, disassembling and reassembling it in an effort to learn a bit about how its components fit together and operate.

v12_combustion.description: A massive and extremely powerful V12 engine, usually built into high end sports cars.

v12_diesel.name: V12 diesel engine

use_action.training_msg: You examine the V6 engine, disassembling and reassembling it in an effort to learn a bit about how its components fit together and operate.

v12_diesel.description: A massive and extremely powerful V12 engine, usually built into heavy trucks.

steam_watts_small.name: makeshift steam engine
steam_watts_small.description: A small, primitive, steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed cycle system.

steam_triple_small.name: small steam engine
steam_triple_small.description: A small steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed cycle system.

steam_triple_medium.name: medium steam engine
steam_triple_medium.description: A medium-sized steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed cycle system.

steam_turbine.name: 1350 hp steam turbine engine
steam_turbine.description: A powerful steam engine for power plants, burning coal to heat water into steam and driving a turbine.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed cycle system.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption, but installing multiple turbines will not affect vehicle power.

small_turbine_engine.name: 1350 hp gas turbine engine
small_turbine_engine.description: A gas turbine engine, usually used for military vehicles.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption, but installing multiple turbines will not affect vehicle power.

medium_turbine_engine.name: 1900 hp gas turbine engine
medium_turbine_engine.description: A large gas turbine engine, usually used for military helicopters.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption, but installing multiple turbines will not affect vehicle power.

large_turbine_engine.name: 6000 hp gas turbine engine
large_turbine_engine.description: A massive gas turbine engine, used to power the V-22 Osprey.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption, but installing multiple turbines will not affect vehicle power.
